projectDesc.p: A plain, archival TEI rendering of the text published on e-Mādhavanidāna (https://github.com/sushrutaproject/eMadhava), itself built from the digital edition named in the sourceDesc. The file was first generated from the site's chapter pages; since 2026-11-12 it is the master copy of the text, and the web edition (reading pages, search index and the root-text-only download) is generated from it.

editorialDecl.p: The text is given in IAST as it appears on the web edition. Chapter and verse divisions follow the source edition. Each stretch of text ending in one of the source's verse or section numbers (e.g. ||12||) is encoded as seg[@type='unit'] with that number in @n; the number itself is retained in the text.

Root text and commentary follow the source's own division of every word into registers. Root-text blocks are ab[@type='mula']; commentary blocks are ab[@type='commentary'], with @subtype naming the commentary and @resp pointing to its author(s) in the titleStmt.

The foot-of-chapter notes (pāṭhāntarāḥ) of the source record variant readings from the printed edition. Notes are placed at their point of reference as note[@place='foot'][@type='variant'], with the source's note number in @n.
The work has no sthāna division; the 70 adhyāyas are direct children of body.
A note with no anchor in the text (it records a variant of the chapter title) is placed in the chapter head.
One passage in adhyāya 21 (Ātaṅkadarpaṇa) is untagged in the source and could not be transliterated; it is kept in the source's ASCII romanization as seg[@type='untransliterated'].

Word spaces have been added (2026-11) between the words that the source runs together, in the root text and the commentaries but not in the editor's notes: sandhi forms are kept as they are and only a space is inserted (tasminn eva, tac chāstram, ity eke); fused vowels and compounds are not divided; a space precedes an avagraha after e or o (te 'pi). No letter, punctuation mark or element of the source was changed.

Verse in the root text is marked by metre: each half-verse (up to a daṇḍa or the verse number) is an l, the half-verses of a verse that stand together an lg. Where commentary interrupts a verse, its parts are lg[@part='I'], [@part='M'] and [@part='F'] (a single pāda split off: l[@part]). Prose, headings, colophons and source references stay outside lg. In the commentaries, quoted or composed verses are marked as lg where two or more consecutive half-verses scan.

revisionDesc.change: Word spacing added to root text and commentaries, and verse marked as lg/l by metre (tools/spacing/).
This file became the master copy of the text: the web edition is now generated from it by tools/tei2site.py, no longer the other way round.

div.head: pañcanidānalakṣaṇam‘pañcalakṣaṇanidānam’ iti pā.|

ab.seg:
pañcanidānalakṣaṇam |
praṇamya jagadutpattisthitisaṃhārakāraṇam |
svargāpavargayor dvāraṃ trailokyaśaraṇaṃ śivam ||1||

śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ|
śaśiruciraharārdhavyaktasaktārdhadeho diśatu ghanaghanābhaḥ padmanābhaḥ śriyaṃ vaḥ|
tridaśasaridaśītadyotajāvārimadhyabhramibhavam iva nābhau vārijaṃ yasya reje||1||

lg.l: īśānakārtikasukīra ‘...sudhīśvaravīravaidyai...’ iti pā.| sudhīravaidyair maitreyamādhavamukhair likhitaṃ vicintya||2||
tantrāntarāṇy api vilokya mamaiṣa yatnaḥ sadbhir vidheya iha doṣavidhau samādhiḥ|
martyair asarvavidurair vihite kva nāma granthe 'sti doṣavirahaḥ sucirantane 'pi||3||

ab.seg: tattadgranthatarubhyo ‘...leśamākṛṣya’ iti pā.| vyākhyākusumarasaleśam āhṛtya| bhramareṇeva mayā'yaṃ vyākhyāmadhukośa ārabdhaḥ||4||

atha prathitasarvāyurvedabodhaviśuddhabuddhiḥ śrīmādhavakaro vikāranikarahetvāditattvabubhutsotsukacikitsakajanānujighṛkṣayā vidhitsitagranthasandarbhārambhe tatpratyūhavyūhavyapohahetuṃ paramāptācāraparamparāpariprāptaṃ sveṣṭadevatāpraṇāmaṃ prāk prāṇaiṣīt; ‘granthādhyetṝṇāmapi’ iti pā.| granthaśrotṝṇām api viśveśvaramaheśvarasya praṇāmānuvādamātrād api ‘sarvavighnoparamaḥ’ iti pā.| vighnopaśamo bhavatīty abhiprāyeṇa taṃ granthādau nibaddhavān– praṇamyety ādi| atra praśabdo bhaktyatiśayakhyāpakaḥ| nibandhanakriyāpekṣayā praṇāmasya pūrvakālabhāvitvāt praṇameḥ ktvāpratyayaḥ| jagacchabdenotpattimantaḥ ‘pṛthivyādayo' ... ’ iti pā.| kṣityādayo 'bhidhīyante; teṣām utpattau svakāraṇasamavāye, sthitau katicitkālāvasthāne, saṃhāre pradhvaṃse, kāraṇaṃ kartāram| svargaḥ sukham, apavargo mokṣaḥ ātyantikaduḥkhanivṛttilakṣaṇaḥ, tayor dvāram upāyaṃ pradhānakāraṇam| etena sakalapuruṣārthahetutvam uktaṃ, sukhāvāptiduḥkhahānivyatiriktasya puruṣārthasyābhāvāt| ata eva trailokyaśaraṇaṃ trailokyarakṣitāram| na coktajagatsthitikāraṇatvena paunaruktyaṃ, jagacchabdenotpattimatām evābhidhānāt| atra tu trailokyaśabdo bhuvanatrayavarticetanācetanasamūhavācī, lokaśabdasya bhuvanajanayor abhidhāyakatvāt| tathā cāmaraḥ– “lokas tu bhuvane jane” (a. ko. kā. 3 va. 3) iti| trailokyam iti svārthe ṣyañ; ‘catvāro varṇāścāturvarṇyam’ iti pā.| cāturvarṇyavat| harādiparyāyān parityajya śivapadanirdeśena granthasya tadadhyetṝṇāṃ ca sakalakalyāṇam abhilaṣan śivapadaṃ nibaddhavān; śivakāritvenaiva maheśvarasya śivapadābhidhānam iti||1||

lg.l: kim api tribhavaikamūlakandaṃ paramānandam ahaṃ mahaḥ smarāmi||1||
yasya prauḍhasabhāṅgaṇeṣv api yaśaḥsvarlokakallolinī- kallolāmalam aṅganāḥ sumanasāṃ gāyanti romāñcitāḥ||2||
pratyarthikṣitināthasārthavanitāvaidhavyadīkṣāguroḥ śauryaṃ yasya raṇāṅgaṇe suragaṇaiḥ paśyan surāṇāṃ patiḥ|
labdhvā netrasahasrajaṃ phalam alaṃ smṛtvā nijābhyarthitaṃ rāmaṃ rāvaṇaghātinaṃ ca samabhūt tuṣṭo vilakṣaḥ punaḥ||3||
‘sauśarmanāmā’ iti pā.| raiśarmanāmā prathitaḥ kalābhir mahanmadakṣoṇipateḥ sabhāyām||5||

ab.seg: anyaś ca tasyāsti sutaḥ kanīyān vācaspatiḥ sattvaguṇaikasaṅgaḥ|| sahodaraprītatamaḥ samastā yo vaidyavidyāḥ svayam adhyajīgapat||6||

lg.l: guruvacanavicāraiś cārucañcaccaritraś carakacaturacetāḥ suśrute suśruto yaḥ|
tenojjvalā vivṛtir alpadhiyāṃ hitāya sambaddhyate vibudhamādhavasaṅgrahasya|

ab.seg: tatra granthārambhe prārabdhagranthaparisamāptyarthaṃ granthaśrotṝṇām api ‘pratyūhavyapohārtham’ iti pā.| pratyūhavyūhavyudāsārthaṃ śiṣṭācāraparipālanārthaṃ granthakāraḥ prāg viśiṣṭeṣṭadevatāpraṇāmaṃ nibaddhavān– praṇamyety ādi| yugmam| mayā rogaviniścayo grantho nibaddhyata iti sambandhaḥ| kiṃ kṛtvā? praṇamya| ‘atra’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | atra prakarṣārthadyotakena praśabdena granthakṛdbhaktyatiśayaṃ khyāpayati| kaṃ? śivam| sakalabhuvanapater maheśvarasya nāmabāhulye 'pi tadadhyāpakādhyetṝṇāṃ kalyāṇam abhilaṣan granthakāraḥ śivapadaṃ nibaddhavān| kīdṛśaṃ śivaṃ? jagadutpattisthitisaṃhārakāraṇam| jagacchabdenotpattimantaḥ pṛthivyādayo 'bhidhīyante; teṣām utpattau svakāraṇasamavāye, sthitau katicitkālāvasthāne, saṃhāre saṃharaṇe, kāraṇaṃ hetum| punaḥ kīdṛśaṃ? svargāpavargayor dvāraṃ; svargaḥ sukham, apavargo mokṣaḥ, ‘ubhayordvāram’ iti pā.| tayor dvāram upāyaṃ pradhānakāraṇam| punaḥ kīdṛśaṃ? trailokyaśaraṇaṃ bhuvanatrayasya rakṣitāram||1||

lg.l: nānāmunīnāṃ vacanair idānīṃ samāsataḥ sadbhiṣajāṃ niyogāt |
sukhaṃ vijñātum ātaṅkam ayam eva bhaviṣyati ||3||

ab.seg:
abhidheyasambandhaprayojanopadeśam antareṇa prekṣāvatāṃ na pravṛttiḥ ‘syāt iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | syāt iti, atas tadabhidhānārthaṃ ślokadvayam āha– nānety ādi| rogāṇāṃ viśeṣeṇa ‘vātādijatvasādhyāsādhyatvādirūpeṇa’ iti pā.| vātajatvādisādhyāsādhyatvādirūpeṇa niścayo jñānaṃ yena sa rogaviniścayo grantho nibadhyate 'bhidhīyate, ‘asmābhiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| tasya viśeṣaṇam– sopadravety ādi| saha upadravādibhir vartate yaḥ sa tathā; ‘etenāsya viśeṣaṇadvārā’ iti pā.| etena viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa upadravāriṣṭanidānaliṅgasvarūpam abhidheyam uktaṃ bhavati, ‘etadvyatirekeṇāsya granthasya’ iti pā., ‘etadvyatirekeṇābhidheyābhāvāt’ iti ca pā.| etadvyatiriktasyābhidheyasyābhāvāt; tathā sati upadravādibhir abhidheyaiḥ saha granthasya vācyavācakalakṣaṇaḥ sambandho 'yabhihitaḥ| tatra, upadravo rogārambhakadoṣaprakopajanyo 'nyavikāraḥ, ‘uktaṃ ca carake– “vyādherupari yo vyādhirbhavatyuttarakālajaḥ| upakramāvirodhī ca sa upadrava ucyate||” iti;’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | uktaṃ ca carake–
“vyādher upari yo vyādhir bhavaty uttarakālajaḥ|
upakramāvirodhī ca sa upadrava ucyate||” iti; niyatamaraṇakhyāpakaṃ liṅgam ariṣṭaṃ; nidānaṃ rogotpādako hetuḥ; liṅgaṃ rogakhyāpako hetuḥ| tena ‘liṅgyate jñāyate vyādhir anena’ iti pā.[ “liṅgyante jñāyante vyādhayo 'nena” iti vyutpattyā pūrvarūparūpopaśayasamprāptayo 'bhidhīyante| yady api nidānam api rogaviśeṣaṃ bodhayati, tathā'py utpattijñaptihetutvena kāraṇadvaividhyapratipādanārthaṃ tasya pṛthag abhidhānam| eṣāṃ copadravādīnāṃ vistarābhidhānaṃ yathāvasaraṃ kariṣyate| nanu, roganidānāditattvam atisūkṣmatvenāsarvajñasya ‘na jñānaviṣayaḥ’ iti pā.| jñānaviṣayaḥ, tat kathaṃ tadupadeśe prekṣāvatāṃ pravṛttir ity ata āha– nānāmunīnām ity ādi| etena granthasya prāmāṇyaṃ pravṛttyaṅgatvam uktaṃ bhavati; munayo hi tapoyogardhibalāt traikālikanikhilajñānaśālinaḥ puruṣātiśayā ucyante| nanu, yady evambhūtaḥ ‘kasyacidgrantho'pyanya āste’ iti pā.| kasyacid grantho 'nyo 'py āste, tenaiva vyavahārasiddheḥ kṛtakāryatvenāsya niṣprayojanatā syād ity ata āha– idānīm ity ādi| idānīm asmābhir eva ‘prathamam’ iti pā.| prāthamyena nānāmunīnāṃ vacanair evaṃvidho nibandhaḥ kriyate| samāsata iti saṅkṣepataḥ| ‘etenālpabuddhīnāmativistaratvenāpravṛttidoṣaḥ’ iti pā.| etenālpabuddhīnām ativistaratvenāpravṛttyaṅgatādoṣaḥ parihṛto bhavati| nanu, kṛte 'pi granthe 'nupādeyapuruṣapraṇītatvena na kaścid bhiṣak pravartiṣyata iti granthasya vaiyarthyaṃ syād ity ata āha– sadbhiṣajāṃ niyogād iti| niyogo niyojanam “asmadupakārāya granthaḥ kriyatām” ity evaṃ prārthanety arthaḥ; athavā niyoga ājñā, etenātmanaḥ savinayatvam uktaṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ| atra ‘nanu, nānāmunivacanabāhulyādalpamedhasāṃ kathaṃ pravṛttirityata āha-’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| nānātantrety ādi| sukhaṃ yathā bhavati tathā ātaṅkaṃ rogaṃ vijñātum ayam eva grantho bhaviṣyati, ‘kāraṇam’ iti śeṣaḥ| etena rogajñānaṃ prayojanam ity uktaṃ, phalaṃ cāsya cikitsitam iti mantavyam yad uktaṃ carake–
“rogam ādau parīkṣeta tato 'nantaram auṣadham|
tataḥ karma bhiṣak paścāj jñānapūrvaṃ samācaret||” iti (ca. sū. a. 20)| nanu, nānāmunīnāṃ vacanair eva rogajñānaṃ bhaviṣyati, kim anena tadupajīvinā granthenety ata āha– alpamedhasām iti alpamedhasām alpabuddhīnām; mahābuddhayo hi ‘vistaraduradhigamanātantrādhyayanakṣamā’ iti pā.| ativistaraduradhigamanātantrādhyayanakṣamā bhavanti, na tv alpabuddhaya iti| mahādhiyām api ālasyānāsāditadurupapādāśeṣasaṃhitānām ayam eva rogajñānāya bhaviṣyatīty āha– nānātantrety ādi||2-3||

nānāmunīnām ity ādi| ayaṃ rogaviniścayo grantho nibadhyate vidhīyate, rogāṇāṃ viniścayo jñānaṃ yasmāt sa tathā| kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ? sopadravāriṣṭanidānaliṅgaḥ; sahopadravādibhir vartate kvacitpustake ‘iti sopadravaḥ’ etatsthāne ‘sa tathā’ iti pā.| iti sopadravaḥ, upadravo rogārambhakadoṣaprakopajanyo vikāraḥ| uktaṃ ca carake–
“vyādher upari yo vyādhir bhavaty uttarakālajaḥ|
upakramāvirodhī ca sa upadrava ucyate||” ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti; niyatamaraṇakhyāpakaṃ liṅgam ariṣṭaṃ; nidānaṃ rogotpādako hetuḥ, niścīyate ‘pratigrāhyate’ iti pā.| pratipādyate vyādhir aneneti nidānaṃ; liṅgaṃ rogakhyāpako hetuḥ, tena liṅgyate jñāyate 'neneti vyutpattyā pūrvarūparūpopaśayasamprāptayo vijñāyante iti| nanu, sarvajñajñānaviṣaye paramasūkṣmanidānāditattvajñāne 'sarvajñapuruṣavākyaiḥ kathaṃ buddhimatāṃ pravṛttir ity ata āha– nānāmunīnāṃ ‘vacanaiḥ’ iti pā.| vacanair iti| yogardhibalāt traikālikajñānadarśī ‘puruṣātiśayānmunirucyate’ iti pā.| puruṣātiśayo munir ucyate| idānīm iti– asmābhir eva prādhānyena nānāmunīnāṃ vacanair evaṃvidho granthaḥ kriyate; anyair ācāryair evaṃvidho grantho na kṛta ity arthaḥ| samāsata iti saṅkṣepāt| nanu, kṛte 'pi granthe na kaścid bhiṣak pravartiṣyata iti granthasya vaiyarthyaṃ syād ity ata āha– sadbhiṣajāṃ ‘niyogāt’ iti pā.| niyogād iti| niyogo niyojanam, asmadupakārāya granthaḥ kriyatām evambhūtā prārthanety arthaḥ ‘granthasyāsyotkarṣamāha’ iti pā.| granthasyāsyotkṛṣṭatvam āha– nānety ādi| mahābuddhayo hi duradhigamatantrādhyayanakṣamā bhavanti, ato nānātantravihīnānām alpabuddhīnāṃ bhiṣajāṃ sukhaṃ yathā bhavati tathā ātaṅkaṃ rogaṃ vijñātum ayam eva grantho ‘bhaviṣyati’ iti pā.| bhaviṣyatīti; ‘kāraṇam’ iti śeṣaḥ| ‘uktaṃ ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | uktaṃ ca–
“rogajñānārtham evādau yatnaḥ kāryo bhiṣagvaraiḥ|
sati tasmin kriyārambhaḥ puṇyāya yaśase śriyai||” rogam ādau parīkṣeta tato 'nantaram auṣadham| tataḥ karma bhiṣak paścāj jñānapūrvaṃ samācaret iti||2-3||

div.ab:
nidānaṃ pūrvarūpāṇi rūpāṇy upaśayas tathā |
samprāptiś ceti vijñānaṃ rogāṇāṃ pañcadhā smṛtam ||4|| (vā. ni. a. 1) |

ab.seg:
vyādher jñātavyasya ‘pañcadhā’ iti pā.| pañca jñānopāyā bhavantīti tān āha– nidānam ity ādi| ete pañca vyastāḥ samastāś ca vyādhibodhakāḥ| na ca samastapakṣe kṛtakaraṇatvaṃ vācyaṃ, pramāṇasamplavasyāpi dṛṣṭatvāditi yataḥ pramātuḥ pramātavye'rthe pramāṇānāṃ pratyakṣānumānopamānaśabdānāṃ samplavaḥ samūho dṛṣṭaḥ, ataḥ samastapakṣe kṛtakaraṇatvaṃ na ca vācyam| pramāṇasamplavasyāpi dṛṣṭatvāt| ( ( ) etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | anumitavahnau pratyakṣopamānaśabdānām api sthitisattvāt) na yo anumānena pratīto yo vahniḥ sa kiṃ pratyakṣāgamābhyāṃ nopalabhyate? nahi, api tūpalabhyata eva| hy anumānena pratīto vahniḥ sa eva pratyakṣāgamābhyāṃ nopalabhyate [ ‘na ca nidānādīni prekṣāvanti, yenaivamālocayeyurekenaiva pratipāditamiti, vayamihodāsmahe iti’ iti pā., ‘athavā ye prekṣāvantaste nidānādīni na evam ālocayeyuḥ? na, apitu santi nidānādīni ālocayeyureva|’ iti ca pā.| na vā nidānādīni prekṣāvanto ye naivam ālocayeyuḥ; ( ( ) etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kintu ye prekṣāvante nidānādīni syur ity eva vetsyanti) ‘atisārādīnāṃ madhye kenacidekenaiva pratipādito vyādhiriti mataṃ vayamihodāsmahe na śraddadhmahe’ iti pā.| ekenaiva pratipādito vyādhir iti vayam ihodāsmahe ( ( ) etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | na manyāmahe)| kiñ ca, ‘ekenā'pi pratipādite’ iti pā.| ekena pratipādite 'pi vyādhāv apare 'vaśyam abhidhātavyāḥ, bhinnaprayojanatvāt| tathā hi– yadi nidānaṃ nocyate tadā tatparivarjanaṃ kathaṃ labhyate? uktaṃ hi suśrute–
“ ‘vātādīnāṃ pratīkāraḥ prokto vistarataḥ punaḥ|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vātādīnāṃ pratīkāraḥ prokto vistarataḥ punaḥ|
saṅkṣepataḥ kriyāyogo nidānaparivarjanam||” iti (su. u. taṃ. a. 1)| kiñ ca, yathā– mṛdbhakṣaṇāt pāṇḍurogaḥ, makṣikābhakṣaṇāc ca chardir avasīyate; na ‘ca’ iti pā.| tu tathā nidānena sarvatra niyatarogādhyavasāyaḥ, ‘jaṭharagulmādīnāmekakāraṇatvāt’ iti pā.| jvaragulmādīnām ekakāraṇatvāt| yad āha carakaḥ–
“eko hetur anekasya tathaikasyaika eva hi|
vyādher ekasya ‘cāneko bahūnāṃ bahavo'pi ca’ iti carake pāṭhaḥ| bahavo bahūnāṃ bahavas tathā||” iti (ca. ni. a. 8)| api ca kadācit pratyāsannaṃ nidānaṃ bādhitvā viprakṛṣṭanidānakṛto doṣasañcayo vyādhiṃ kuryāt, tasmāt ‘kevalānnidānādapi na’ iti pā.| kevalān nidānān na vyādhijñānaṃ bhavatīti pūrvarūpādīnām upādānam iti ‘bāṣpacandraḥ’ iti pā.| vāpyacandraḥ| asati pūrvarūpābhidhāne tatroktaḥ kriyāviśeṣo na saṅgacchate| uktaṃ hi carake– “ ‘tatra pūrvarūpadarśane jvarādau vā hitaṃ laghvaśanamapatarpaṇaṃ vā’ iti carake pāṭhaḥ| jvarasya pūrvarūpe laghvaśanam apatarpaṇaṃ vā||” iti (ca. ni. a. 1)| tathā ca suśrute– “jvarasya pūrvarūpeṣu vartamāneṣu buddhimān| pāyayeta ghṛtaṃ svacchaṃ tataḥ sa labhate sukham||” iti (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) suśrute pāṭhaḥ| vātikajvarapūrvarūpe ghṛtapānam iti| tathā'sādhyatvaṃ ca nopalabhyeta| uktaṃ ca carake–
“pūrvarūpāṇi sarvāṇi jvaroktāny atimātrayā|
yaṃ viśanti viśaty enaṃ mṛtyur jvarapuraḥsaraḥ||
anyasyāpi ca rogasya pūrvarūpāṇi yaṃ naram|
viśanty anena kalpena tasyāpi maraṇaṃ dhruvam||” (ca. i. a. 5) iti| tathā raktapittapramehayor viśeṣajñānaṃ ca na jāyate| uktaṃ ca carake–
“hāridravarṇaṃ rudhiraṃ ca mūtraṃ vinā pramehasya hi pūrvarūpaiḥ|
yo mūtrayet taṃ na vadet pramehaṃ raktasya pittasya hi sa prakopaḥ||” iti (ca. ci. a. 6)| asati rūpābhidhāne ‘vyādheraśeṣaviśeṣeṇa’ iti pā.| vyādher aśeṣeṇa svarūpam eva na vyavacchidyate; kiṃ ca sādhyāsādhyatvaṃ ca na jñāyate| tathā hi sukhasādhyalakṣaṇe carakaḥ–
“hetavaḥ pūrvarūpāṇi rūpāṇy alpāni yasya vai|
na ca tulyaguṇo dūṣyo na doṣaḥ prakṛtir bhavet||” iti (ca. sū. a. 10); kaṣṭasādhyalakṣaṇe carakaḥ– “nimittapūrvarūpāṇāṃ rūpāṇāṃ madhyame bale|” (ca. sū. a. 10) iti; tathā– “sarvasampūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ| sannipātajvaro 'sādhyaḥ” (ca. sū. a. 3) iti| asaty upaśayābhidhāne saṅkīrṇalakṣaṇe 'nabhivyaktaklaṣaṇe vā vyādhau viśeṣabodho na syāt| tad uktaṃ carake– “gūḍhaliṅgaṃ vyādhim upaśayānupaśayābhyāṃ” (parīkṣeta) (ca. vi. a. 4) iti| asatyāṃ ca samprāptau pūrvarūpādipratītasyāpi vyādheś cikitsopayoginoṃ'śāṃśavikalpanābalakālāder apratīteś cikitsāviśeṣo na syāt| tasmāt pañcāpi nidānādayo vaktavyāḥ| pañcavidham apy etad vyādhyutpattijñaptihetubhūtaṃ nidānaśabdenocyate| yad āha suśrutaḥ– “hetulakṣaṇanirdeśān nidānāni” (su. sū. a. 3) iti| tatraivaṃ ‘nidānaśabdaniruktiruktā’ iti pā.| nidānaśabdaniruktiḥ– “nirdiśyate vyādhir aneneti nidānaṃ”; “diśeḥ pṛṣodarāditvād rūpasiddhiḥ|” iti gadādharaḥ; “niścitya dīyate pratipādyate vyādhir aneneti nidānam||” iti jejjaṭaḥ| bhaṭṭāraharicandreṇāpi ‘tantrayuktyā nidānādivivaraṇaprastāve’ iti pā.| tantrayuktyādivivaraṇaprastāve eṣaiva niruktir uktā| niśabdo niścaye| tathā ca vararucer upasargasūtram– “ni niścayaniṣedhayoḥ” iti| loke 'pi ‘adya te nidānaṃ kariṣyāmi’ ity ukte niścayaṃ ‘ ... pratīyate’ iti pā.| kariṣyāmīty avagamyate| nidānam iti karaṇe lyuṭ; tena ‘vyādhiniścayakaraṇaṃ nidānam’ iti nidānādipañcakasāmānyalakṣaṇam| nidānaśabdo 'yaṃ ‘nidānaviśeṣajātau’ iti pā.| nidānaviśeṣe jātau ca vartate; yathā– tṛṇaśabdaḥ tṛṇaviśeṣe tṛṇajātau ca vartate| yat tu, ‘bhaṭṭāraharicandreṇāpi’ iti pā.| bhaṭṭāraharicandreṇa nidānasthāne– “yā gauḥ sudohā bhavati na tāṃ ‘nidīyeta’ iti pā., ‘ninanadīta’ iti ca pā.| nidadīta|” iti vyāsaprayogam upanyasya nibandhārtho nidānaśabdo vyākhyātaḥ ‘nidīyate nibadhyate ‘hetvādisambandho’ iti pā.| hetvādisambaddho vyādhir anena’ iti kṛtvā; tat tu nidānasthānarūpagranthābhiprāyeṇa, na hi hetvādayo ‘hetvādisambandham’ iti pā.| hetvādisambaddhaṃ vyādhiṃ pratipādayanti svātmani kriyāvirodhādityarthaḥ|||4||

tasya ca vyādher jñātavyasya pañca jñānopāyā bhavanti tān āha– ‘nidānamityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | nidānam ity ādi| nidānaṃ pūrvarūpaṃ rūpam upaśayaḥ samprāptiś caite pañca vyastāḥ samastāś ca vyādhibodhakāḥ| rogāṇāṃ vijñānaṃ viśiṣṭajñānaṃ, pañcadhā pañcaprakāreṇa, smṛtaṃ kathitaṃ, ‘munīndraiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| ‘yathā nidānapūrvarūparūpāṇi rogāṇāṃ vijñānāya tathopaśayo'pīti’ iti pā.| upaśayas tatheti ‘tulyakṛtyatām’ iti pā.| tathāśabdas tulyakṛtyatāṃ dyotayati, evaṃ samprāptiś cety atra cakāro 'pi| iti parisamāptau| ‘rogāṇām’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | rogāṇāṃ tac ca nidānaṃ sannikṛṣṭaviprakṛṣṭabhedena dvidhā bhavati| sannikṛṣṭaṃ yathā– vātādayaḥ kupitāḥ jvarādirogam utpādayanti| viprakṛṣṭaṃ yathā– hemante nicitaḥ śleṣmā vasante ca prakupyati; tathā''hārādir api, tatra kaṭukāmladadhyādikaṃ pittajvarasya| pūrvarūpaṃ yathā– jvarasyaivālasyādayaḥ| rūpaṃ yathā– svedāvarodha ity ādi;
“ ‘ āgamāpagamakṣobhakāṭhinyamṛdutā vedanoṣmaṇām’ iti pā.| āgamāpagamakṣobhakāṭhinyamṛdutoṣmaṇām|
vaiṣamyaṃ tatra tatrāṅge tās tāḥ syur vedanāś calāt||” ity ādi ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca| upaśayo yathā– vātaḥ snehanamardanādinopaśānta upalabhyate sa ‘upaśaya’ ity ucyate| samprāptir yathā-yathā duṣṭenety ādilakṣaṇāt| nanv ekenaiva kvacitpustake ‘roganiścaye'nyeṣāmupādānaṃ vyartham? ucyate-’ etatsthāne ‘roganiścaye'nyeṣāmupādānavaiyarthyaṃ vaktavyam’ iti pā.| roganiścaye 'nyeṣām upādānaṃ vyartham? ucyate– bhinnaprayojanatvāt nānyataravaiyarthyam| tac ca yathā– nidānenādhigatasya vyādhes tatparivarjanam; uktaṃ ca suśrute– “saṅkṣepataḥ kriyāyogo nidānaparivarjanam|” iti| kvacitpustake ‘pūrvarūpeṇa vyādherviśeṣajñānaṃ jāyate| yathā carake– “hāridravarṇaṃ rudhiraṃ ca mūtraṃ vinā pramehasya ca pūrvarūpaiḥ| yo mūtrayettaṃ na vadetpramehaṃ raktasya pittasya hi sa prakopaḥ||” iti; tathā'dhigatasya vyādhestatroktakriyākramaśca lakṣyate; ukte ca carake’ etatsthāne ‘pūrvarūpeṇādhigatasya vyādhestatroktakriyākramo lakṣyate; uktaṃ ca carake’ iti pā.| pūrvarūpeṇa vyādher viśeṣajñānaṃ jāyate| yathā carake–
“hāridravarṇaṃ rudhiraṃ ca mūtraṃ vinā pramehasya ca pūrvarūpaiḥ|
yo mūtrayet taṃ na vadet pramehaṃ raktasya pittasya hi sa prakopaḥ||” iti; tathā'dhigatasya vyādhes tatroktakriyākramaś ca lakṣyate; ukte ca carake– “jvarasya pūrvarūpe laghvaśanam apatarpaṇaṃ ‘ca’ iti pā.| vā|” iti; tathā ca suśrute– “vātikajvarapūrvarūpe ghṛtapānam|” iti| tathā ca sādhyāsādhyatvam api jñāyate| uktaṃ ca carake–
“pūrvarūpāṇi sarvāṇi jvaroktāny atimātrayā|
yaṃ viśanti viśaty enaṃ mṛtyur jvarapuraḥsaraḥ||
anyasyāpi ca rogasya pūrvarūpāṇi yaṃ naram|
viśanty anena kalpena tasyāpi maraṇaṃ dhruvam||” ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| rūpeṇāpi ca vyādheḥ sukhasādhyatvaṃ kaṣṭasādhyatvam asādhyatvaṃ ca jñāyate; yato 'lparūpaḥ sukhasādhyo vyādhiḥ, madhyarūpaḥ kaṣṭasādhyaḥ, sampūrṇarūpas tv asādhya iti| tathā ca sukhasādhyalakṣaṇe carakaḥ–
“hetavaḥ pūrvarūpāṇi ‘sūkṣmāṇyalpāni’ iti pā.| rūpāṇy alpāni yasya ca|
na ca tulyaguṇo dūṣyo na doṣaḥ prakṛtir bhavet||” iti; kaṣṭasādhyalakṣaṇe carakaḥ– “ ‘nimittaṃ pūrvarūpāṇi’ iti pā.| nimittapūrvarūpāṇāṃ rūpāṇāṃ madhyame bale|” iti; ‘tathā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tathā “ ‘sampūrṇarūpaḥ’ iti pā.| sarvasampūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ sannipātajvaro 'sādhyaḥ|” ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| upaśayena vinā pratītasya vyādheḥ saṅkīrṇalakṣaṇe 'nabhivyaktalakṣaṇe vā vyādhau viśeṣāvabodho na syāt, uktaṃ hi carake– “gūḍhaliṅgaṃ vyādhim upaśayānupaśayābhyāṃ buddhyeta|” iti| tathā ca suśrute–
“ ‘abhyaṅgasnehasvedādyairvātadoṣo’ iti pā.| abhyaṅgasnehasvedādyair vātarogo na śāmyati|
vikāras tatra vijñeyo duṣṭam atrāsti śoṇitam||” iti| śoṇitasekas tatropaśama iti| asatyāṃ ca samprāptau pūrvarūpādibhiḥ pratītasyāpi vyādheś cikitsitopayogyāṃśāṃśavikalpabalakālādīnām ajñāne cikitsāviśeṣo na syāt, tasmān nidānādipañcakavijñānena sarve rogā viśeṣeṇāvabudhyanta iti||4||

div.ab:
nimittahetvāyatanapratyayotthānakāraṇaiḥ |
nidānam āhuḥ paryāyaiḥ... |5| (vā. ni. a. 1) |

eṣāṃ nidānādīnāṃ madhye samānāsamānajātīyavyāvartakaṃ ‘nidānalakṣaṇamāha’ iti pā.| kāraṇarūpanidānasya lakṣaṇam āha– nimittety ādinā paryāyair ity antena| etaiḥ śabdair yo 'rtho 'bhidhīyate tan nidānaṃ; yathā– “buddhir upalabdhir jñānam ity anarthāntaram|” (nyā. da. pra. ā. sū. 15) ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| nanu, kiṃ militair ekaikaśo vā? nādyaḥ, ekārthābhidhāyināṃ śabdānāṃ militānām aprayogāt; dvitīyaś cet tadā savyabhicāraḥ; nimittasya śakunādau, hetoḥ ‘dhūmavatvādityādivacane’ iti pā.| prayojake kartari, āyatanasya sthāne, pratyayasya laḍādau, utthānasya ‘udgamanotsavayoḥ’ iti pā., ‘udgamanotsargayoḥ’ iti ca pā.| udgamanotsargayoś ca darśanāt| naivaṃ, śakunādīnāṃ nimittādibhiḥ sarvair anabhidhānāt| ata evāha– paryāyair iti| na hi teṣāṃ te paryāyāḥ, yataḥ krameṇaikārthavācakāḥ śabdāḥ parasparaṃ paryāyā ucyante| tasmān nimittādiśabdaiḥ ‘paryāyeṇa’ iti pā.| paryāyair abhidhīyamānatvaṃ nidānatvam| etac ca paryāyakathanaṃ śāstre vyavahārārtham| idaṃ tu saṅkṣepato lakṣaṇam– “setikartavyatāko rogotpādakahetur nidānam|” iti| yanmate doṣetikartavyatārūpā samprāptir iṣyate tanmate samprāptivyudāsārthaṃ ‘setikartavyatāka’ iti padaṃ, tasyā ‘tasyāṃ doṣetikartavyatārūpāyām’ iti pā.| itikartavyatāntarābhāvāditi itikartavyatā vyāpāraḥ, itikartavyatāntarasya vyāpārāntarasyābhāvāt, vyāpāre vyāpārāntaraṃ na tiṣṭhatīti bhāvaḥ| doṣetikartavyatārūpāyā itikartavyatāntarābhāvāt| yanmate vyādhijanma samprāptiḥ, tanmate ‘vyādhyutpattihetur nidānam’ iti lakṣaṇam| ubhayatrāpi ‘utpatti’ ‘etat’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | etat padaṃ jñaptihetupūrvarūpādivyavacchedārtham| sa ca hetur anekadhā; tatra ‘prathamaṃ caturvidhaḥ’ iti pā.| prathamaś caturvidhaḥ, yad āha upakalpanīyādhyāye haricandraḥ– “sannikṛṣṭaviprakṛṣṭavyabhicāriprādhānikabhedāc caturdhā|” iti| sannikṛṣṭo yathā– naktandinartubhuktāṃśā doṣaprakopasya hetavaḥ, na te cayādikam apekṣante| viprakṛṣṭo yathā– “hemante nicitaḥ śleṣmā vasante kapharogakṛt|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 64); ‘kiñca’ iti ca pā.| kiṃ vā sannikṛṣṭo jvarasya rūkṣādisevā, viprakṛṣṭo rudrakopaḥ| vyabhicārī yathā– yo durbalatvād vyādhyadhikaraṇāsamarthaḥ| yad āha carakaḥ– “( ‘doṣā abalīyāṃso yadā vā'nubadhyante na tadā'vaśyaṃ vikārābhinirvṛttirbhavatīti’ iti pā.| nidānādiviśeṣā) abalīyāṃso 'thavā'nubandhnanti, na tadā vikārābhinirvṛtiḥ|” iti (ca. ni. a. 4)| prādhāniko yathā– viṣādiḥ; trividho vā, asātmyendriyārthasaṃyogaprajñāparādhapariṇāmabhedāt| tatra, asātmyendriyārthasaṃyogo 'yogātiyogamithyāyogayuktā rūparasādayaḥ, prajñāparādho mithyājñānādiḥ, pariṇāmo 'yogādiyuktā ṛtusvabhāvajāḥ śītādayaḥ| “adharmasya ca rogahetor atraivāntarbhāvaḥ” iti bhaṭṭāraharicandraḥ, tasyāpi kālāntarapariṇatasya duḥkhakartṛtvāt| cakras tu prajñāparādhe tasyāntarbhāvam āha; mithyājñānakṛtabrahmavadhādijanmano 'dharmasya prajñāparādha eva mūlaṃ; ‘balābalatvaṃ tatra’ iti pā., ‘balābalatvamatra ca’ iti ca pā.| balābalaṃ tv atra na nirūpyate, rogakāraṇatvenādharmasya sarvathā siddhatvād iti| doṣavyādhyubhayahetubhedāc ca ‘sa’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sa trividhaḥ| doṣahetavo yathā– cayaprakopapraśamanimittā yathartūtpannā madhurādayaḥ| vyādhihetavo yathā– mṛdbhakṣaṇaṃ pāṇḍurogasya kāraṇam| yady api mṛd api doṣaṃ prakopayaty eva; yad uktaṃ carake– “kaṣāyā mārutaṃ, pittam ūṣarā, madhurā kapham|” iti (ca. ci. a. 16) tathā'pi tajjair doṣaiḥ pāṇḍuroga evārabhyate na tv anyo vikāra iti vyādhihetutā bhavati| ubhayahetur yathā vātarakte– “hastyaśvoṣṭrair gacchataś cāśnataś ca” (su. ni. a. 1) ity ādi| ‘atra’ iti pā.| tatra yady api ‘doṣaprakopapūrvakam’ iti pā.| doṣaprakopapūrvakam eva vyādhijananaṃ, tathā'pi doṣavad vyādhāv api tasya kāraṇatvam iti bodhayati| tena tatra ‘na’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | na vyādhiharamātraṃ bheṣajaṃ prayojyaṃ, kintūbhayapratyanīkam| na ca vācyaṃ kāraṇabhūtadoṣanivṛttyaiva ‘kāryasya’ iti pā.| kāryabhūtasya vyādher nivṛttir iti; yataḥ pratiniyataśaktikāni bheṣajadravyāṇi bhavanti; katham anyathā ślaiṣmikatimire ‘śleṣmaharaṇam’ iti pā.| śleṣmaharam eva vamanaṃ na prayujyate| yad uktaṃ suśrute– “na vāmayet taimirikaṃ na gulminaṃ na cāpi ‘pāṇḍurogiṇam’ iti pā.| pāṇḍūdararogapīḍitam|” (su. ci. a. 33) iti| sa evotpādakavyañjakabhedāc ca dvidhā| tatrotpādako yathā– hemantajo madhurarasaḥ kaphasya| vyañjako yathā– tasyaiva ‘kaphacayasya’ iti pā.| kaphasya vyañjako vasante sūryasantāpaḥ iti bhaṭṭāraharicandraḥ| tatra vyañjakaḥ ‘abhivyaktikārakaḥ’ iti pā.| preraka ity arthaḥ| bāhyābhyantarabhedāc ca dvidhā| tatra bāhyā āhārācārakālādayaḥ| etadabhiprāyeṇa ‘trijaṭācāryaḥ’ iti pā.| tīsaṭācāryaḥ–
“vyāyāmād apatarpaṇāt prapatanād bhaṅgāt kṣayāj jāgarād vegānāṃ ca vidhāraṇād atiśucaḥ śaityād atitrāsataḥ|
rūkṣakṣobhakaṣāyatiktakaṭukair ebhiḥ prakopaṃ vrajed vāyur vāridharāgame pariṇate cānne 'parāhṇe 'pi ca||
kaṭvamloṣṇavidāhitīkṣṇalavaṇakrodhopavāsātapastrīsamparkatilātasīdadhi-surāśuktāranālādibhiḥ|
bhukte jīryati bhojane ca śaradi grīṣme sati prāṇināṃ madhyāhne ca tathā'rdharātrisamaye pittaṃ prakopaṃ vrajet||
gurumadhurarasātisnigdhadugdhekṣubhakṣyadravadadhidinanidrāpūpasarpiṣprapūraiḥ|
tuhinapatanakāle śleṣmaṇaḥ samprakopaḥ prabhavati divasādau bhuktamātre vasante||” (ca. ka. a. 29-31) iti| ābhyantarā ‘yathā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yathā– doṣā dūṣyāś ca| tatra doṣo 'pi prakupitaḥ prākṛtādibhedād anekadhā| prākṛto yathā– vasante śleṣmā, śaradi pittaṃ, ‘varṣāsu’ iti pā.| prāvṛṣi vāyuḥ| vaikṛtas tu yathā– vasante pittaṃ vāyur vā, varṣāsu kaphaḥ pittaṃ vā, śaradi kapho vāyur vā| asya prayojanaṃ sukhasādhyatvādi| yad uktaṃ carake– “prākṛtaḥ sukhasādhyas tu vasantaśaradudbhavaḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 3) ity ādi| anubandhyānubandhabhedāc ca dvidhā| anubandhyaḥ pradhānam, anubandho 'pradhānam| yad āha carakaḥ– “svatantro vyaktaliṅgo yathoktasamutthānopaśamo bhavaty anubandhyaḥ, tadviparītalakṣaṇas tv anubandhaḥ|” (ca. vi. a. 6) iti| asya prayojanaṃ saṃsargaje vyādhāv anubandhyo viśeṣeṇa cikitsyo 'nubandhāvirodhena| ‘yaduktam’ iti pā.| tad uktaṃ carake– “tatropadravasya prāyaḥ pradhānapraśamāt praśamaḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 21) iti| upadravo 'nubandhaḥ| prakṛtivikṛtito yathā– vātaprakṛter vātarogaḥ kaṣṭasādhyo bhavati, ‘kaphaprakṛtestu’ iti pā.| kaphapittaprakṛtes tu sukhasādhyaḥ| yad āha sukhasādhyalakṣaṇe carakaḥ– “na ca tulyaguṇo dūṣyo na doṣaḥ prakṛtir bhavet” (ca. sū. a. 10) iti| āśayāpakarṣato yathā– yadā ‘sthānasthitameva’ iti pā.| svamānasthitam eva doṣaṃ svāśayād ākṛṣya vāyuḥ sthānāntaraṃ gamayati tadā ‘samānastho'pi’ iti pā.| svamānastho 'pi sa vikāraṃ janayati| yad āha carakaḥ–
“prakṛtisthaṃ yadā pittaṃ mārutaḥ śleṣmaṇaḥ kṣaye|
sthānād ādāya gātreṣu yatra yatra ‘prasarpati’ iti pā.| visarpati||
tadā ‘todaśca’ iti pā.| bhedaś ca dāhaś ca tatra tatrānavasthitaḥ|
gātradeśe bhavaty asya śramo daurbalyam eva ca||” iti (ca. sū. a. 17)| asya prayojanaṃ vātasyaiva tatra viguṇasya svasthānānayanaṃ kāryaṃ, ‘natu pittasya hrāsanena svāśayāpakarṣaṇam’ iti pā.| na tu pittasya hrāsanaṃ; “ye tv enāṃ pittasya sthānākṛṣṭiṃ na vidanti, te dāhopalambhena pittavṛddhiṃ manyamānāḥ pittaṃ hrāsayantaḥ pittakṣayalakṣaṇaṃ rogāntaram evotpādayanta āturam atipātayanti|” iti bhaṭṭāraharicandraḥ| anye tv āhuḥ– bhrājakādibhedena sarvadehasthite pitte yadā svāśayākṛṣṭaṃ pittam avayavāntaram anilena prāpitaṃ tadā tadavayavāntarasthaṃ pittam āgantupittasambandhenādhikam eva jātaṃ, tataś ca pittavṛddhilakṣaṇaiveyaṃ duṣṭir na duṣṭyantaram, anyathā dāha eva na syāt na hi ‘samānastho’ iti pā.| svamānastho doṣo vikāraṃ janayatīti| bhaṭṭāraharicandrasya tv ayam abhiprāyaḥ– yady apy evaṃ tathā'pi cikitsābhedārthaṃ vṛddhikṣayavyatiriktasthānāntaragatirūpo duṣṭiviśeṣo 'vaśyam eveṣṭavyaḥ, anyathā vṛddhaṃ pittam iti matvā virecanaṃ pittahrāsanaṃ vā kāryaṃ, na ca tat tatra yogyaṃ, kiṃ tu svasthānānayanam| yac coktaṃ carakeṇa– “kṣayaḥ sthānaṃ ca vṛddhiś ca ‘doṣāṇām’ iti pā.| vijñeyā trividhā gatiḥ|” (ca. sū. a. 17) ity ādi, tat prāyikam iti| gatito yathā– gatir doṣāṇāṃ kṣīṇavṛddhatvādayaḥ| yad uktaṃ carake
“kṣayaḥ sthānaṃ ca vṛddhiś ca doṣāṇāṃ trividhā gatiḥ|
ūrdhvaṃ cādhaś ca tiryak ca vijñeyā trividhā parā|| trividhā cāparā koṣṭhaśākhāmarmāsthisandhiṣu|” (ca. sū. a. 17) iti|| atra sthānam iti samatvam| tatra kṣayādilakṣaṇaṃ yathā– “doṣāḥ pravṛddhāḥ svaṃ liṅgaṃ darśayanti yathābalam| kṣīṇā jahati svaṃ liṅgaṃ, samāḥ svaṃ karma kurvate||” (ca. sū. a. 17)– iti| svaṃ liṅgam iti kupitasya vāyo raukṣyādayo dharmāḥ, karmāṇi ca sraṃsaśūlādīni| yad āha carakapāṭhasaṃvādī ‘sudattasenaḥ’ iti pā.| sudāntasenaḥ–
“ādhmānastambharaukṣyasphuṭanavimathanakṣobhakampapratodāḥ, kaṇṭhadhvaṃsāvasādau ‘takramavilapanam’ iti pā.| śramakavilapanaṃ sraṃsaśūlaprabhedāḥ|
pāruṣyaṃ karṇanādo ‘viṣayapariṇatibhraṃśadṛṣṭipramohā’ iti pā.| viṣamapariṇatibhraṃśadṛṣṭipramohā, ‘vispandācchādanāni’ iti pā.| vispandodghaṭṭanāni glapanam aśayanaṃ tāḍanaṃ pīḍanaṃ ca|| ‘nāmonmānau’ iti pā.|
nāmonnāmau viṣādo ‘bhramaparisadanam’ iti pā.| bhramaparipatanaṃ jṛmbhaṇaṃ romaharṣo, vikṣepākṣepaśoṣagrahaṇaśuṣiratācchedanaṃ veṣṭanaṃ ca|
varṇaḥ śyāvo 'ruṇo vā tṛḍ api ca mahatī svāpaviśleṣasaṅgā, vidyāt karmāṇy amūni prakupitamarutaḥ syāt kaṣāyo rasaś ca||
visphoṭāmlakadhūmakāḥ pralapanaṃ svedasrutir mūrchanaṃ, daurgandhyaṃ daraṇaṃ mado ‘viśaraṇam’ iti pā.| visaraṇaṃ pāko 'ratis tṛḍbhramau|
ūṣmā'tṛptitamaḥ praveśadahanaṃ kaṭvamlatiktā rasā, varṇaḥ pāṇḍuvivarjitaḥ kvathitatā karmāṇi pittasya vai|| tṛptis tandrā gurutā staimityaṃ kaṭhinatā malādhikyam| snehāpaktyupalepāḥ śaityaṃ kaṇḍūḥ prasekaś ca|| carakartṛtvaṃ śotho nidrādhikyaṃ rasau paṭusvādū| varṇaḥ śveto 'lasatā karmāṇi kaphasya jānīyāt|| dvidoṣaliṅgaḥ saṃsargaḥ sannipātas triliṅgakaḥ|” iti| liṅgajñānaprayojanaṃ ca cikitsābhedārtham| yad āha suśrutaḥ– “kṣīṇā vardhayitavyāḥ, vṛddhā hrāsayitavyāḥ, samāḥ pālayitavyāḥ” (su. ci. a. 33)– iti| ūrdhvādigatir yathā– ūrdhvagaṃ raktapittam ity ādi| asya prayojanaṃ raktapittasyordhvagasya virecanam, adhogasya vamanam| yathoktaṃ carake– “ ‘pratilomam’ iti pā.| pratimārgaṃ ca haraṇaṃ raktapitte vidhīyate|” (ca. ni. a. 2) iti| yas tu gatibhedānabhijñaḥ saḥ “virekaḥ pittaharāṇāṃ” (ca. sū. a. 25) iti vacanād adhoge raktapitte virekaṃ prayuñjāna āturasyānartham evotpādayati; jvarādiṣu tiryagdoṣagatiṣu yathoktaṃ cikitsitam iti| vṛddhā doṣāḥ kadācit koṣṭhaṃ, kadācic chākhāḥ, kadācin marmāsthisandhīn āśritya rujanti; marmāsthisandhiṣu gatiḥ kṛcchrasādhyatvopādakatvād ekatvena nirdiṣṭā| koṣṭha āmāśayādiḥ, śākhā raktādayo dhātavas tvak ceti, ‘carakakṛtaivaitā’ iti pā.| carakakṛtaiveyaṃ sañjñā| koṣṭhādyabhidhānaprayojanaṃ cikitsābhedārtham| yathoktaṃ carake–
“āmāśayagate vāte kaphe pakvāśayāśrite|
rūkṣapūrvo hitaḥ svedaḥ snehapūrvas tathaiva ca||” (ca. sū. a. 14); tathā– “santataṃ rasaraktasthaḥ so 'nyedyuḥ piśitāśritaḥ|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) ity ādi; tathā– “nāgnikarmopadeṣṭavyaṃ snāyumarmavraṇeṣu ca|” (ca. ci. a. 25) iti| ete ca doṣāḥ sāmatvanirāmatvābhyām api jñātavyāḥ| yad uktam–
“ūṣmaṇo 'lpabalatvena dhātum ādyam apācitam|
duṣṭam āmāśayagataṃ rasam āmaṃ pracakṣate||
āmena tena saṃyuktā doṣā dūṣyāś ca dūṣitāḥ|
sāmā ity upadiśyante ye ca rogās tadudbhavāḥ||
srotorodhabalabhraṃśagauravānilamūḍhatāḥ|
ālasyāpaktiniṣṭhīvamalabhedāruciklamāḥ|| liṅgaṃ malānāṃ sāmānāṃ nirāmāṇāṃ viparyayaḥ|” (vā. sū. a. 13)| “vāyuḥ sāmo vibandhāgnisādatandrāntrakūjanaiḥ||
vedanāśothanistodaiḥ kramaśo 'ṅgāni pīḍayet|
vicared yugapac cāpi gṛhṇāti kupito bhṛśam|
snehādyair vṛddhim āpnoti sūryameghodaye niśi|
nirāmo viśado rūkṣo nirvibandho 'lpavedanaḥ||
viparītaguṇaiḥ śāntiṃ snigdhair yāti viśeṣataḥ|
durgandhaṃ haritaṃ śyāvaṃ pittam amlaṃ sthiraṃ guru||
amlikākaṇṭhahṛddāhakaraṃ sāmaṃ vinirdiśet|
ātāmraṃ pittam atyuṣṇaṃ rase kaṭukam asthiram||
pakvaṃ vigandhaṃ vijñeyaṃ rucipaktṛbalapradam|
āvilas tantulaḥ styānaḥ kaṇṭhadeśe 'vatiṣṭhate|
sāmo balāso durgandhaḥ kṣududgāravighātakṛt||
phenavān piṇḍitaḥ pāṇḍur niḥsāro 'gandha eva ca|
pakvaḥ sa eva vijñeyaś chedavān vaktraśuddhikṛt||” iti| asya prayojanaṃ sāme pācanaṃ, nirāme śamanam iti| ete ca doṣāḥ ‘parasparasambaddhāstāratamyādibhedena’ iti pā.| parasparasambaddhās taratamādibhedena dviṣaṣṭidhā bhavanti| tadudāharaṇāni vistaratvāpatter atra na likhyante, sauśrutadoṣabhedavikalpādhyāye (su. u. taṃ. a. 66) draṣṭavyāni| uktahetudoṣabhedayoḥ saṅgrahaślokau–
“catvāro vyabhicāridūranikaṭaprādhānikatvāt, punas te 'sātmyendriyakārthayukpariṇatiprajñāparādhāt tridhā|
rugdoṣobhayakāraṇād api tathā, dvau vyañjakotpādakau, bāhyābhyantarabhedato 'pi kathitā hetoḥ prabhedā amī||
doṣasya ca prākṛtavaikṛtābhyāṃ, bhedo 'nubandhyād api cānubandhāt|
tathā prakṛtyaprakṛtitvayogāt tathā''śayākarṣavaśād gateś ca||” iti nidānam|5|–

nidānasya paryāyaśabdān āha– nimittety ādi| ‘paryāyairiti nimittādibhiḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | paryāyair iti nimittādibhiḥ ṣaḍbhir eva paryāyair nidānam āhuḥ, ‘munayaḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ; etac ca ‘nidānakathanam’ iti pā.| paryāyakathanaṃ śāstre vyavahārāya, tatra tatra śāstrapradeśe nidānam etaiḥ paryāyair boddhavyam iti| ekārthavācakāḥ śabdāḥ parasparaṃ paryāyā ucyante||5||–

...prāgrūpaṃ yena lakṣyate ||5||
utpitsur āmayo doṣaviśeṣeṇānadhiṣṭhitaḥ |
liṅgam avyaktam alpatvād vyādhīnāṃ ‘yathāyathaṃ yadyasya vyādherjvarādyanyatamasya ātmīyamātmīyam; ataśca prāgrūpaṃ tridhā dṛśyate– kiñcicchārīraṃ, kiñcinmānasaṃ, kiñcicchārīramānasaṃ ceti-tatra śārīraṃ yathā– jvarasyālasyāsyavairasyagātragauravajṛmbhāsāsrākulākṣatetyevamprāyaṃ; mānasaṃ ca– “aratirhitopadeśeṣvakṣāntiḥ” ityevamprāyaṃ; kiñcicchārīramānasaṃ yathā– “prītiramle paṭūṣaṇe, dveṣaḥ svāduṣu bhakṣyeṣu” ityevaṃ prāyaṃ, śārīramānasadoṣajanitatvāt’ iti vāgbhaṭaṭīkāyāmaruṇadattaḥ (vā. ni. a. 1) tad yathāyatham ||6|| (vā. ni. a. 1) |

ab.seg:
nidānānantarīyakatvāt pūrvarūpādīnāṃ tadanantaraṃ prāgrūpam āha– ‘prāgrūpaṃ yenetyādi’ iti pā.| prāgrūpam ity ādi| dvividhaṃ hi pūrvarūpaṃ bhavati, sāmānyaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ ca| tatra sāmānyaṃ yena doṣadūṣyasammūrchanāvasthājanitena bhāvijvarādivyādhimātraṃ pratīyate, na tu vātādijanitatvādiviśeṣaḥ| yathā– ‘śramo 'ratir vivarṇatvaṃ’ (su. u. taṃ. a. 39); ity ādi, tathā ‘guruvākyabālapradveṣādi’ iti pā.| devaguruvipradveṣādi; sāmānyābhiprāyeṇaivata tantrāntaram–
“vyādher jātir bubhūṣā ca pūrvarūpeṇa lakṣyate|
bhāvaḥ kimātmakatvaṃ ca lakṣyate lakṣaṇena hi||” iti| ‘tathāhi’ iti pā.| tathā''ha parāśaraḥ– “pūrvarūpaṃ nāma yena bhāvivyādhiviśeṣo lakṣyate na tu doṣaviśeṣaḥ|” iti| viśiṣṭaṃ yathā– uraḥkṣatādau liṅgāny eva vātādijāny avyaktāni| yad uktaṃ tatraiva– “avyaktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tasya pūrvarūpam iti smṛtam|” (ca. ci. a. 11) iti tathā suśrutaḥ–
“sāmānyato viśeṣāt tu jṛmbhā'tyarthaṃ samīraṇāt|
pittān nayanayor dāhaḥ kaphād annārucis tathā||” iti (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) hārīte 'py uktam– “iti pūrvarūpam aṣṭānāṃ jvarāṇāṃ sāmānyataḥ, viśeṣatas tu jṛmbhāṅgamardabhūyiṣṭhaṃ hṛdayodvegi vātajam|” ity ādi| nanu, cātyarthaṃ vyaktatvaṃ tataś ca jṛmbhāder api rūpatvaṃ prasajyeta; yad vakṣyati– “tad eva vyaktatāṃ yātaṃ rūpam ity abhidhīyate|” (vā. ni. a. 1) iti| ucyate– yathā śramādaya itararogavyatiriktaṃ bhāvijvaramātraṃ bodhayanti na tu vātajatvādiviśeṣam ity atas teṣām avyaktatvaṃ, tathā pittādijvaravyatiriktaṃ bhaviṣyadvātajvaramātraṃ bodhayanti jṛmbhādayaḥ, na tu vātasya rūkṣaśītadhātukṣayāvaraṇādijanyatvarūpaviśeṣaṃ bodhayanti; ity ato 'vyaktavātajvarabodhakatvād avyaktatvam eva jṛmbhādīnām iti jejjaṭavāpyacandramādhavakarakārtikakuṇḍādayo vyācakṣate| anye tv āhuḥ– ‘prabhūtāvyaktapūrvarūpasahacaritavyaktasyāpi’ iti pā.| prabhūtāvyaktapūrvarūpasahacaritasya vyaktasyāpi jṛmbhādeḥ pūrvarūpavyapadeśaḥ; yathā– māṣarāśiḥ; chatriṇo gacchanty evamādi| na ca vyaktatvena rūpād abhedaḥ; niyamena pūrvarūparūpayor bhāvivartamānavyādhibodhakatvād iti| tatra ‘viśiṣṭapūrvarūpam’ iti pā.| viśiṣṭaṃ prāgrūpaṃ rūpāvasthāyām anuvartate eva, tasyaivābhivyaktasya rūpatvāt; na tu doṣadūṣyasammūrchanāvasthājanitaṃ ‘romaharṣaguruvākyabālapradveṣādikam’ iti pā.| romaharṣabālapradveṣādikaṃ niyamenānurvate, yady anuvarteta tadā sarvajvarāṇām asādhyatvaṃ prasajyeta| etadabhiprāyeṇa,
“pūrvarūpāṇi sarvāṇi jvaroktāny atimātrayā|
yaṃ viśanti viśaty enaṃ mṛtyur jvarapuraḥsaraḥ||” (ca. i. a. 5)– iti carakavacanam ity āhuḥ| tad evaṃ dvividhe pūrvarūpe vyavasthite sāmānyapūrvarūpam āha– ‘prāgrūpaṃ yena lakṣayate| utpitsurāmayo doṣaviśeṣeṇānadhitiṣṭhitaḥ|| iti|’ iti pā.| prāgrūpam ity ādi| yena śramādinā, utpitsuḥ sāmagrīsākalyād utpādecchuḥ, āmayo rogaḥ, doṣaviśeṣeṇa vātādijanyāsādhāraṇavepathvādinā, anadhiṣṭhito 'sambaddho, lakṣyate jñāyate, tat prāgrūpam iti| viśiṣṭaprāgrūpam āha– liṅgam avyaktam alpatvād vyādhīnāṃ tad yathāyatham iti| prāgrūpam ity anena pūrvoktena sambandhaḥ| liṅgaṃ lakṣaṇam; avyaktaṃ nātyabhivyaktam, atra hetur alpatvād aṇutvāt, ‘natvāvaraṇādiyogādityarthaḥ’ iti pā.| na tv āvaraṇādiyogād avyaktam ity arthaḥ; yathāyathaṃ yasya vyādher yad rūpaṃ tad evāvyaktaṃ ‘tasya’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tasya pūrvarūpam ity arthaḥ| anye tu pūrvarūpalakṣaṇam āhuḥ–
“sthānasaṃśrayiṇaḥ kruddhā bhāvivyādhiprabodhakam|
doṣāḥ kurvanti yal liṅgaṃ pūrvarūpaṃ tad ucyate||” iti| tan nātiyuktaṃ, rājayakṣmaṇaḥ pūrvarūpasya tṛṇakeśanipātāder adṛṣṭajanyasyāvyāpakatvāt| yad āha carakaḥ–
“yakṣmiṇāṃ ghūṇakeśānāṃ tṛṇānāṃ patanāni ca|
prāyo 'nnapāne, keśānāṃ nakhānāṃ ‘cātivardhanam’ iti pā.| cābhivardhanam||” (ca. ci. a. 8) iti| na ca tad api doṣajaṃ, doṣāṇāṃ tṛṇādibhir asambandhāt, asambaddhasya ca bhāvasya kāraṇatvenādṛṣṭatvāt; paramparayā tu sambandhakalpanayā'tiprasaṅgāt, sarvaṃ sarvasya kāraṇaṃ syāt| etaddoṣaparijihīrṣayaiva paramakuśalena ‘vāgbhaṭenādṛṣṭadoṣajasakalapūrvarūpasaṅgrāhakam’ iti pā.| vāgbhaṭenādṛṣṭadoṣajasarvapūrvarūpopasaṅgrāhakaṃ yenetipadaṃ nibaddham iti atra ‘carakenoktam’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| carakenoktaṃ matvā tadīyapūrvarūpalakṣaṇam eva mādhavakaro likhitavān| saṅkṣepatas tu lakṣaṇam– “bhāvivyādhibodhakam eva liṅgaṃ pūrvarūpam|” iti| evakāreṇa nidānopaśayayoḥ samprāpteś ca doṣetikartavyatārūpāyā vyavacchedaḥ, ‘teṣām’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | teṣāṃ tajjātīyānām utpannānutpannavyādhibodhakatvāt| tathā hi– nidānaṃ mṛdbhakṣaṇarūpaṃ bhāvipāṇḍurogam anupaśayarūpaṃ ca vartamānaviśiṣṭavyādhiṃ bodhayati; upaśayo 'pi pūrvarūpāvasthāprayukto bhāviviśiṣṭavyādhiṃ atra ‘jñāpayati’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| jñāpayati, rūpāvasthāprayuktaś ca vartamānaviśiṣṭavyādhiṃ ‘gamayati’ iti pā.| jñāpayati; samprāptiś ca pūrvarūpasya madhyāhnādāv utpattiprakopābhyāṃ ‘bhāviviśiṣṭavyādhim’ iti pā.| bhaviṣyadviśiṣṭavyādhiṃ, ‘rūpam’ iti pā., ‘rūpe’ iti ca pā.| rūpasya ca madhyāhnaprakopādinā vartamānaviśiṣṭavyādhiṃ jñāpayati; ity eṣām utpannānutpannavyādhibodhakatvam| nanu, yadā ‘pūrvarūpam’ iti pā.| pūrvarūpaviśeṣaṃ smṛtvotpannavyādher viśeṣāvadhāraṇaṃ tadā pūrvarūpam api vartamānavyādhibodhakaṃ, yathoktaṃ raktapittaprameharūpasandehe carakeṇa– “hāridravarṇaṃ rudhiraṃ ca mūtraṃ vinā pramehasya hi pūrvarūpaiḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 6) ity ādi| atrocyate– kiṃ vyādhijanmanaḥ pūrvaṃ pūrvarūpaṃ gṛhītaṃ na vā? ādye bhāvivyādhibodhakatvam eva; dvitīye smaraṇotpattir eva na syāt, anubhavābhāvāt| athocyate– pūrvarūpaṃ ‘dantānām’ iti pā.| dantādīnāṃ malāḍhyatvādirūpaṃ svarūpeṇānubhūtam eva, kintu ‘pramehaliṅgatayā’ iti pā.| pramehapūrvarūpatayā na pratibhātam; utpanne tu vyādhau tat smṛtaṃ pramehaviśeṣam avadhārayati| ‘maivaṃ iti pā.| evaṃ ‘pūrvarūpasmaraṇaṃ tarhikāraṇam’ iti pā.| tarhi pūrvarūpasmaraṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ na tu pūrvarūpaṃ, rūpāvasthāyāṃ tasya vyapagatatvāt| smaraṇaṃ na pramāṇam iti cet, satyaṃ; kintu ( ) etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | (pūrvānubhavajanitasaṃskāropasthita)smaraṇasahakṛtaṃ ‘rūpam’ iti pā.| pūrvarūpaṃ vyādhiviśeṣabodhakaṃ, na tu kevalaṃ smaraṇaṃ; yathā– saṃskāropasthāpitasmaraṇasahakṛtaṃ cakṣuḥ pratyabhijñāyāṃ prāgavasthāviśiṣṭaghaṭāvabodhakam– so 'yaṃ ghaṭa iti| evaṃ smaraṇavad āptopadeśe 'pi vācyaṃ, ‘tasya ca liṅgapadena vyudāsaḥ;’ etatsthāne ‘tasya liṅgapadena vyudāsaḥ; bhāvipadena rūpasya ca;’ iti pā.| tasya ca liṅgapadena vyudāsaḥ; bhāvipadena rūpasya; liṅgapadena cakṣurādeḥ, tasya ghaṭajñānādisādhāraṇatvenāliṅgatvāt; asādhāraṇaṃ hi liṅgaṃ bhavati| etac ca ‘pūrvarūpamavidyamānasya’ iti pā.| pūrvarūpam avidyamānasyāpi vyādher liṅgaṃ bhavaty eva; yathā– viśiṣṭameghodayo vṛṣṭeḥ| iti pūrvarūpam||5-6||

prāgrūpalakṣaṇam āha– ‘prāgrūpamityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | prāgrūpam ity ādi| yena ‘jṛmbhālasyādinā’ iti pā.| jṛmbhālasyārucyādinā utpitsur udbubhūṣur āmayo jvarādir lakṣyate jñāyate tat prāgrūpaṃ bhāvivyādhibodhakaliṅgam ity arthaḥ| kimbhūta āmayaḥ? kvacitpustake ‘doṣaviśeṣeṇa vātādinā, anadhiṣṭhitaḥ’ etatsthāne ‘doṣaviśeṣeṇānadhiṣṭhitaḥ’ iti pā.| doṣaviśeṣeṇa vātādinā, anadhiṣṭhitaḥ anāsāditaḥ| tarhi ‘vātādidoṣeṇānadhiṣṭhitatvāt’ iti pā.| vātādidoṣeṇānadhiṣṭhitasya vyādher utpitsutaiva na ghaṭate, kāraṇābhāvāt; na hi vātādīn vihāya vyādheḥ prāyeṇānyataḥ sambhavaḥ sambhāvyate, tathā hi– “sarveṣām eva rogāṇāṃ nidānaṃ kupitā malāḥ|” iti; tasmād doṣaviśeṣeṇānadhiṣṭhitatvam utpitsor āmayasya yad ucyate, tad avyaktarūpadoṣāpekṣayā'vagantavyam iti| tat prāgrūpam| utpitsūnāṃ jvarādīnām, alpatvād anāsāditabalavattvāt, avyaktaliṅgam aspaṣṭalakṣaṇam| yathāyatham iti yathā yena ‘yadāsya’ iti pā.| yasya vyādheḥ jvarādyanyatamasyātmīyātmīyam avagantavyam| tac ca prāgrūpaṃ dvividham– sāmānyaṃ, viśiṣṭaṃ ca| yena doṣadūṣyadhātusammūrchanāvasthājanitena bhāvijvarādivyādhimātraṃ pratīyate, na tu vātādijanitatvādiviśeṣaḥ, tat sāmānyaṃ; yathā– jvarasya ‘śramo 'ratir vivarṇatvam’ ity ādi; yena bhāvivyādhyārambhakadoṣacihnapradeśamātraṃ pratīyate tad viśiṣṭaṃ, yathā– “jṛmbhā'tyarthaṃ samīraṇāt| pittān nayanayor dāhaḥ, kaphān nānnābhinandanam||” iti| atra tu viśiṣṭe prāgrūpe jṛmbhādirūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpatvam eva na vaktavyaṃ, vyādhyārambhakadoṣamātrasūkṣmacihnarūpatvāt; ‘tathāhi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tathā hi tṛṇādicaye patite 'gnikaṇe sūkṣmatvāt dhūmamātravyaktiṃ jñātvā karavastrāditāḍanapratīkārais tadupaśamaḥ kartuṃ śakyate, na tu prajvalite vahnau; tathā– ‘bhaviṣyaddoṣārambhakadoṣāttatkṣaṇaikamātram’ iti pā.| bhaviṣyadrogārambhakadoṣalakṣaṇaikamātraṃ vyaktaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ prāgrūpaṃ jñātvā bhāvivyādher upaśamaḥ kartuṃ ‘śakyate’ iti pā.| pāryate iti| atas tu pūrvarūparūpayor bheda eva| taddvayam api kvacic chārīraṃ dṛśyate, kvacin mānasaṃ ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca| tatra śārīraṃ yathā– “ ‘jvarasyālasyagātragauravasāsrākulekṣaṇam’ iti pā., ‘jvarasya gātragauravasāsrākulekṣaṇam’ iti ca pā.| jvarasyālasyavairasyagātragauravasāsrākulekṣaṇam|” ity ādikam| mānasaṃ yathā– aratir hitopadeśeṣv akṣāntiḥ ‘amlakaṭvaśane prītirityādikam’ iti pā.| ity ādikam||5-6||

div.ab:
tad eva vyaktatāṃ yātaṃ rūpam ity abhidhīyate |
saṃsthānaṃ vyañjanaṃ liḍgaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ cihnam ākṛtiḥ ||7|| (vā. ni. a. 1) |

ab.seg:
yady api pūrvarūpānantaraṃ samprāptir bhavati, tathā'pi vyādhisvarūpajñānārthaṃ rūpam āha– “tadevetyevaśabdenaitad dyotayati– yadeva śārīraṃ prāgrūpaṃ pūrvopavarṇitaṃ tadeveha grahītavyaṃ, sthāyitvāt; taddhyāmayānubandhi| mānasaṃ śārīramānasaṃ vā'sthāyitvānna grahītavyaṃ, taddhi dvayamutpitsuvyādhisamanantaraṃ prāyeṇa naśyatīti tadvyaktatāṃ na yāti| ataḥ śārīramevotpitsuvyādhiprāgrūpamiha tadā parāmraṣṭuṃ yuktam” iti vāgbhaṭaṭīkāyāmaruṇadattaḥ (vā. ni. a. 1)| tad evety ādi| tad eva pūrvarūpam eva| vyaktatām udbhūtatām iti| nanu vyaktatvaṃ pūrvarūpasya kiṃ kārtsyena, ekadeśena vā? ādye ‘sarvajvarādeḥ’ iti pā.| sarvajvarāṇām asādhyatvaṃ syāt; yad uktaṃ carake– “pūrvarūpāṇi sarvāṇi” (ca. i. a. 5) ity ādi; dvitīye hi “jṛmbhā'tyarthaṃ samīraṇāt| pittān nayanayor dāhaḥ” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) ity āder api pūrvarūpasya rūpatvaprasaṅgaḥ? naivam, anabhyupagamān na kṛtsnasya nāpy ekadeśasya, kintv anirdhāritaikatvānekatvaviśeṣasya pūrvarūpamātrasya vyaktasya ‘vyādhiliṅgatvam’ iti pā.| vyādher liṅgatvaṃ; yathā– tārṇapārṇādiviśeṣaviraheṇa dhūmamātrasya vahnibodhakatvam| evaṃ vyavasthite yadā sarvasyābhivyaktis tadā na sādhyatvam, anyathā tu sādhyatvam| na ca ‘jṛmbhādau’ iti pā.| jṛmbhāde rūpatvaprasaṅgaḥ, tasya prāg eva vyaktatvāt; avyaktaṃ sad vyaktatāṃ yātaṃ tasya ‘rūpābhidhānatvābhyupagamāt’ iti pā.| rūpatvenābhidhānāt; aparaprabhūtāvyaktaliṅgasahacaritatvena pūrvarūparūpayor asamānakālatvena ca rūpatvāyogād iti īśvarasenas tv āha– “ ‘vyādheḥ svarūpamavyaktaṃ pūrvarūpaṃ, yadvyaktaṃ tadrūpam”’ iti pā.| vyādheḥ svarūpaṃ yad vyaktaṃ tad rūpam” iti| tan na, vikalpāsahatvāt| tathā hi– svarūpam iti kiṃ ‘svaṃ rūpam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | svaṃ rūpaṃ svarūpam? āhosvit ‘svīyaṃ rūpaṃ svarūpaṃ? svīyamapi dharmaḥ, kāryaṃ vā?‘ etatsthāne ‘svīyaṃ rūpaṃ? svīyo'pi dharmaḥ, svīyaṃ kāryaṃ vā?’ iti pā., ‘svakīyaṃ rūpaṃ? svakīyo'pi dharmaḥ, svakīyaṃ kāryaṃ vā?’ iti ca. pā.| svīyaṃ rūpaṃ svarūpaṃ? svīyam api dharmaḥ, kāryaṃ vā? na tāvat svarūpaṃ, svātmani kriyāvirodhāt; rūpaṃ hi vyādhipratipattinimittam uktaṃ, tac ced vyādhisvabhāva eva tarhi vyādhisvabhāvād eva vyādhisvabhāvaḥ pratīyata iti vyaktaḥ svātmani kriyāvirodhaḥ| nāpi dharmaḥ, ‘ ... viṇmūtranetratvāderarśorūpatvānupapatteḥ’ iti pā.| carakoktakṛṣṇatvaṅnakhaviṇmūtratvāder arśorūpatvānupapatteḥ| na hi ‘kṛṣṇatvaṅnakhaviṇmūtranetratvādikamarśodharmaḥ’ iti pā.| kṛṣṇatvaṅnakhādikam arśodharmaḥ, atanniṣṭhatvāt; dharmāṇāṃ ca dharminiṣṭhatvāt, anyathā'tiprasaṅgāt| nāpi kāryam, upadravāder api rūpatvaprasaṅgāt| tad api kṛcchrasādhyāsādhyavyādher liṅgam iti cet, naivam; ‘asādhyatvādestalliṅgam’ iti pā.| asādhyatvāder eva tal liṅgaṃ, na tu vyādheḥ; ‘tasya kṛcchrasādhyāsādhyasya pūrvarūpeṇaiva jñātatvāt’ iti pā.| tasya pūrvam eva jñātatvād, bhedenopādānāc ca; ‘yaduktam’ iti pā.| tad uktam– “sopadravāriṣṭanidānaliṅgo nibadhyate rogaviniścayo 'yam|” iti, nanu, upadravo na vyādheḥ kāryaṃ, kintu vyādhyārambhakadoṣasya; yad uktaṃ suśrute– “sa ‘tanmūla’ iti pā.| tanmūlamūla evopadravasañjñakaḥ|” iti (su. sū. a. 35); vyācakṣate ca ṭīkākṛtaḥ– “ “tanmūlaṃ taddoṣarūpaṃ mūlaṃ yasya sa tanmūlaḥ|’ iti pā.| tanmūlaṃ tasya vyādher mūlaṃ doṣarūpaṃ mūlaṃ yasya sa tanmūlaḥ|” iti| naivam, apacāreṇa mūlabhūtadoṣopabṛṃhaṇalabdhabalaś ced vyādhir upadravaṃ karoti tena ‘ ‘tanmūla’ iti pā.| tanmūlamūla’ ity uktavān| ata evāha carakaḥ– “kaścid dhi rogo rogasya hetur bhūtvā praśāmyati|” (ca. ni. a. 8) ity ādi| ‘svarūpaśabdavācyaṃ kāryaṃ kvacidāśrīyate’ iti pā., ‘sarvamevaitatsvarūpaśabdasya vācyaṃ kvacitkiñciditi’ iti ca pā.| sarvam evaitat svarūpaśabdavācyaṃ kvacit kiñcid iti; tathā ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca sati na vyabhicāra iti kecit| ‘tadapi’ iti pā.| tathā'pi vyavasthāmātraṃ syān na tu lakṣaṇam, ekasya sakalarūpasaṅgrāhakasya ‘dharmasyābhāvāt; dharmasyānvayavyatirekeṇa tanniṣṭhatvāt; upadravasya ca’ iti pā.| dharmasyābhāvāt, upadravasyāpi vyādhisvarūpatvāpatteś ceti| tasmāt “utpannavyādhibodhakam eva liṅgaṃ rūpam” iti lakṣaṇam| ‘utpanna’ iti padaṃ pūrvarūpavyavacchedārtham; ‘evakāro'pi nidānasamprāptyupaśayān vyavacchinatti’ iti pā.| evakāreṇa nidānasamprāptyupaśayā vyavacchidyante, teṣām utpannānutpannavyādhibodhakatvāt; tac ca darśitam eva; liṅgapadena cakṣurāder vyudāsaḥ; yanmate vyādhijanmarūpā samprāptis tanmate tasyā liṅgapadena vyavacchedaḥ, na hi sā vyādhijñāne liṅgaṃ, kintu kāraṇamātram| śāstre vyavahārārthaṃ ‘lakṣaṇārthaṃ ca nidānavat’ iti pā.| nidānaval lakṣaṇārthaṃ ca rūpaparyāyān āha– saṃsthānam ity ādi| ‘nanu rūpeṇa vyādhirjñāyeta, yadi rūpavyatirekeṇānyo vyādhirupalabhyeta’ iti pā.| nanu, rūpeṇa vyādhir jñāyate, na ca rūpavyatirekeṇa vyādhir upalabhyate; yato militā arucyādaya eva jvaraḥ, kāsādyekādaśarūpāṇy eva rājayakṣmā| ucyate– naivaṃ, tathāvidhadoṣadūṣyasammūrchanāviśeṣo jvarādirūpo vyādhiḥ, tatkāryāś cārucyādayaḥ asyāgre ‘evaṃ kāsādirūpātirekeṇaiva yakṣmā, tatkāryāṇi kāsādaya iti’ ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate |; ‘kiṃvā’ iti pā.| kiñ ca arucyādaya eva pratyekaśo rūpāṇi, tatsamudāyo vyādhiḥ, yataḥ samudāyibhyo 'nya eva samudāyaḥ, yathā– khadiratarūṇāṃ vanam iti; anye tu rāhoḥ śiraḥ, śilāputrasya śarīram itivad asaty api bhede bhedavivakṣayā samarthayanti; naiyāyikās tu tatrāpi bhedam āpādayanti| nanu, “vikāro duḥkham eva ca|” iti (ca. sū. a. 9) carakavacanād duḥkhasyātmaguṇasya katham arucyādisamudāyatvaṃ? naivaṃ, duḥkhayatīti duḥkham iti vyutpattyā duḥkhahetor dhātuvaiṣamyāder vyādhitvasvīkārāt| arucyādayas tu svarūpeṇa vikārā eva, ‘yadā'nyapratipādakāstadā liṅgānyucyante’ iti pā.| yadā tv anyapratipādakās tadā liṅgāny evocyante| yad āha carakaḥ–
“jñānārthaṃ yāni coktāni vyādhiliṅgāni saṅgrahe|
vyādhayas te tadātve tu liṅgānīṣṭāni nāmayāḥ||” iti (ca. ni. a. 8)| ‘iti rūpalakṣaṇam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti rūpalakṣaṇam||7||

idānīṃ rūpaṃ lakṣayitum āha– tad evety ādi| ‘tadeva’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tad eva prāgrūpaṃ vyaktatāṃ yātaṃ rūpam iti kathyate; anirdhāritaikatvānekatvaviśeṣasya pūrvarūpamātrasya vyaktasya vyādher liṅgatvaṃ, yathā ‘tṛṇaparṇādiviśeṣaviraheṇa’ iti pā.| tārṇapārṇādiviśeṣaviraheṇa dhūmamātrasya vahnibodhakatvam iti| saṃsthānam ity ādi| kvacitpustake ‘saṃsthānādyākṛtyantāḥ ṣaḍrūpasya paryāyavācakāḥ, tathā pūrvarūpasyāpi; yathā– pūrvasaṃsthānaṃ, pūrvavyañjanamityādyapare'pi’ etatsthāne ‘saṃsthānādyākṛtayastāḥ yaḍrūpasya paryāyavācakāḥ, tathā saṃsthānaṃ, pūrvavyañjanamityapare'pi’ iti pā.| saṃsthānādyākṛtyantāḥ ṣaḍ rūpasya paryāyavācakāḥ, tathā pūrvarūpasyāpi; yathā– pūrvasaṃsthānaṃ, pūrvavyañjanam ity ādy apare 'pi||7||

div.ab:
hetuvyādhiviparyastaviparyastārthakāriṇām |
auṣadhānnavihārāṇām upayogaṃ sukhāvaham ||8||
vidyād upaśayaṃ vyādheḥ sa hi sātmyam iti smṛtaḥ |
viparīto 'nupaśayo vyādhyasātmyābhisañjñitaḥ ||9|| (vā. ni. a. 1) |

ab.seg:
upaśayam āha– hetuvyādhīty ādi| hetur bāhya ābhyantaraś ca, vyādhir jvarādiḥ, ‘etayorheturogayorvyastasamastayorviparyastā’ iti pā.| etayor hetuvyādhyor vyastasamastayor viparyastā viparītāḥ, etayor eva vyastasamastayor viparyastārthakāriṇo ‘nidānasadharmiṇo'pi’ iti pā.| nidānasamānadharmiṇo 'pi prabhāvād rogapraśamakāriṇaḥ; evaṃvidhā ye auṣadhānnavihārā bheṣajāhārācārās teṣām upayogam ācaraṇaṃ sukhāvahaṃ sukhakaram upaśayaṃ kvacitpustake ‘vidyādupaśayākhyaṃ jānīyādvyādheḥ’ etatsthāne ‘vidyādvyādheḥ’ iti pā.| vidyād upaśayākhyaṃ jānīyād vyādheḥ| tasya paryāyam āha– sa hi sātmyam iti smṛta iti| carake 'py uktam– “sātmyārtho hy upaśayārthaḥ” iti (ca. ni. a. 1)| hiśabdaḥ pādapūraṇe| sukhāvaham iti sukhaṃ roganivṛttilakṣaṇaṃ; yathā vyapadiśanti loke– ‘bhārāpagame sukhinaḥ saṃvṛttāḥ sma’ iti, tat sukham āvahati samyag āyattyā'nubandhena ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca karotīti sukhāvaham| etena sadāhatṛṣṇānavajvariṇaḥ śītalajalapānaṃ tatkālasukhakaram api nopaśaya ‘tadātvasukhakaramapi nopaśayakaram’ iti pā.| iti tātparyārthaḥ| atra, auṣadhānnavihārāṇām ity upalakṣaṇaṃ; tena deśakālāv api boddhavyau| ata eva vṛddhavāgbhaṭena ‘vyādhyādikamabhidhāya’ iti pā.| vyādhyādiviparītam abhidhāya “etena deśakālāv api vyākhyātau” (vṛ. vā. ni. a. 1) ity ākhyātam| ‘sudattaseno'pyāha’ iti pā.| sudāntaseno 'py āha–
“sukhānubandho yo hetur vyādhyādiviparītakaḥ|
deśādikaś copaśayo jñeyo 'nupaśayo 'nyathā||” iti| saṅkṣepatas tu lakṣaṇam– “auṣadhādijanitaḥ sukhānubandha upaśayaḥ” iti| ‘srakcandanavanitādijanita ... ’ iti pā.| srakcandanavanitādyupabhogajanitasukhanivṛttyartham auṣadhādipadam, anubandhaśabdaś ca ‘apathyajanitatadātvasukhanivṛtyarthaḥ’ iti pā.| apathyajanitatadātvasukhavyavacchedārthaḥ| etad apy udāharaṇadarśanaparaṃ, na tu lakṣaṇam; auṣadhādīnāṃ ‘hetvādiviparītānām’ iti pā.| hetuviparītādīnāṃ ca parasparavyabhicāreṇa lakṣaṇatvāyogāt| tasmāt ‘samyagvyādhijaduḥkhopaśamahetur upaśayaḥ’, ‘sātmyam upaśayaḥ’ iti vā lakṣaṇam; ‘auṣadhajanitaḥ sukhānubandha upaśayaḥ’ iti vā lakṣaṇam| carake; āhārācāradeśakālalaṅghanādīnāṃ dravyādravyabhūtānām auṣadhatvenābhidhānāt| athaiṣām udāharaṇāni; tatra hetuviparītāni; auṣadhaṃ yathā– śītakaphajvare śuṇṭhyādy uṣṇaṃ bheṣajam| yad uktam–
“śītenoṣṇakṛtān rogān śamayanti ‘bhiṣagvarāḥ’ iti pā.| bhiṣagvidaḥ|
ye ‘ca’ iti pā.| tu śītakṛtā rogās teṣām uṣṇaṃ bhiṣagjitam||” iti (ca. vi. a. 3)| annaṃ yathā– śramānilaje jvare rasaudanam| vihāro yathā– divāsvapnotthe kaphe rātrau jāgaraṇam iti| atha vyādhiviparītāni| auṣadhaṃ yathā– atisāre stambhanaṃ pāṭhādi, tathā śirīṣo viṣaṃ hanti, khadiraḥ kuṣṭhaṃ, haridrā prameham iti; naite doṣam apekṣante ‘rogapraśamakāriṇaḥ’ iti kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | prabhāvād rogapraśamakāriṇa iti| vāpyacandras tv āha– “jvarādivyādhiharaṃ yad dravyaṃ tad api doṣapratyanīkaṃ”, ‘kintu’ iti kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | kintu doṣapratyanīkād asyāyaṃ bhedaḥ– yad doṣapratyanīkaṃ tan nāvaśyaṃ vyādhiharaṃ; yathā– vamanalaṅghane kaphahare na kaphagulmaṃ harataḥ; uktaṃ hi carake–
“kaphe laṅghanasādhye tu kartari jvaragulmayoḥ|
tulye 'pi deśakālādau laṅghanaṃ na ca sammatam||” iti; tathā– “na vāmayet taimirikaṃ na gulminaṃ na cāpi ‘pāṇḍurogiṇam’ iti pā.| pāṇḍūdararogapīḍitam|” iti; (su. ci. a. 33); “yat tu vyādhiharaṃ tad avaśyaṃ doṣaharaṃ, tad vyādhiṃ ‘śamayedetadārambhakadoṣaṃ ca’ iti pā.| śamayat tadārambhakadoṣam api śamayati; anyathā sa rogo jita eva na syāt, ‘kāraṇasya tādavasthyāt’ iti pā.| kāraṇatādavasthyāt” iti| tan nātisaṅgatam ity anye; yato doṣas tatra samavāyī nimittaṃ vā; na ca samavāyinimittābhāvaprayukto niyamena kāryābhāvaḥ, ‘kintvasamavāyikāraṇābhāvaprayukto'pi’ iti pā.| kintv asamavāyinimittābhāvaprayukto 'pi; yathā– kvacitpustake ‘kapālamālāsaṃyogasyāsamavāyikāraṇasya vināśādapi ghaṭābhāvaḥ’ etatsthāne ‘kapālamālāsaṃyogasyāsamavāyikāraṇasyābhāvādghaṭābhāvaḥ’ iti pā.| kapālamālāsaṃyogasyāsamavāyikāraṇasya vināśād api ghaṭābhāvaḥ; tathā– roge 'pi samprāptilakṣaṇasya saṃyogasya ‘vināśādapi’ pā.| vināśād rogasyāpi vināśaḥ, doṣas tu svataḥ kriyāntareṇa vā nivartate; ‘kiñca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kiñ ca yadi vyādhipratyanīkam avaśyaṃ doṣaṃ nivartayed iti svīkriyate, tadobhayapratyanīkād bhedo durupapādaḥ syād iti| nanu, yadi nimittakāraṇaṃ doṣas tat kathaṃ tadārabdhavikāre vamanādinā doṣaharaṇaṃ vidhīyate? na hi daṇḍakulālādyucchede ghaṭoccheda iti| ucyate, yatra yāvannimittakāraṇasthāyikāryaṃ tatra ‘nimittakāraṇanāśādapi’ iti pā.| nimittakāraṇocchedād api kāryanāśaḥ; yathā– ‘vartitailanāśāddīpanāśaḥ’ iti pā.| vartitailanāśād api pradīpanāśaḥ; tathābhūtāś ca doṣāḥ ‘prāyaśaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustakeṣu na paṭhyate| prāyaśa iti| annaṃ yathā– atisāre stambhanaṃ masūrādi| vihāro yathā– udāvarte pravāhaṇaṃ; ‘mantrauṣadhividhāraṇa…’ iti pā.| mantrauṣadhidhāraṇabalyupahāraniyamaprāyaścittahomagurudevaśuśrūṣādayo 'pi vyādhiviparītā vihārā iti vāpyacandraḥ| atha hetuvyādhiviparītāni– auṣadhaṃ yathā– vātaśothe daśamūlaṃ vātaharaṃ śothaharaṃ ca| yad uktaṃ carake ṣaḍvirecanaśatāśritīye 'dhyāye ‘pāṭalā’ ity ādi yāvat– “daśemāni śothaharāṇi” iti (ca. sū. a. 4) annaṃ yathā– vātakaphagrahaṇyāṃ takraṃ, śītavātotthe jvare peyā; sā hy uṣṇavīryatvād vātaṃ hanti prabhāvāj jvaraṃ ca| yad uktaṃ carake– “ ‘jvaraghno’ iti pā.| jvaraghnyo jvarasātmyatvāt” iti (ca. ci. a. 3); ‘suśrute ca’ iti pā.| suśrute 'pi– “jvare caivātisāre ca yavāgūḥ sarvadā hitā|” iti (su. u. taṃ. a. 40)| vihāro yathā– snigdhadivāsvapnaprajātāyāṃ tandrāyāṃ rūkṣaṃ tandrāviparītaṃ rātrijāgaraṇam iti| atha hetuviparītārthakārīṇi; auṣadhaṃ yathā– pittapradhāne ‘pacyamāne’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | pacyamāne vraṇaśothe pittakara uṣṇa upanāhaḥ| annaṃ yathā– ‘tatraiva’ iti pā.| pacyamāne vraṇaśothe 'nnaṃ vidāhi| vihāro yathā– vātonmāde trāsanam iti| atha vyādhiviparītārthakārīṇi; auṣadhaṃ yathā– chardyāṃ vamanakārakaṃ madanaphalādi| annaṃ yathā– atisāre ‘virecanārtham’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | virecanārthaṃ virecanaṃ kṣīram uktaṃ hi– “bahudoṣasya dīptāgneḥ saprāṇasya na tiṣṭhati| paittiko yadyatīsāraḥ payasā taṃ virecayet||” iti (ca. ci. a. 19)|| vihāro yathā– chardyāṃ vamanārthaṃ pravāhaṇam iti| atha hetuvyādhiviparītārthakārīṇi; auṣadhaṃ yathā– agnipluṣṭe uṣṇo 'gurvādilepaḥ, viṣe vā viṣam| annaṃ yathā– madyapānotthe madātyaye madakārakaṃ madyam| vihāro yathā– vyāyāmajanitasammūḍhavāte jalaprataraṇarūpo vyāyāma iti| nanu chardyāṃ bahuśleṣmajāyāṃ ‘saṃśamanayogyāyām’ iti pā., ‘saṃśamanayogyāyām’ iti ca pā.| vamanayogyāyāṃ yadi vamanaṃ na kriyate tadā ‘cirānuvṛttiḥ, rogānucchedo vā’ iti pā.; ‘vikārānuvṛttiḥ, rogānucchedo vā syād’ iti pā.; ‘vikārānuvartī doṣo rogānucchedo vā’ iti ca pā.| cirānuvartī rogo 'nucchedyo vā syāt, tataś ca vamanaṃ prayuktaṃ doṣapratyanīkam eva bhavati; yad uktaṃ suśrute– “chardiṣu bahudoṣāsu vamanaṃ hitam ucyate|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 49) iti, ‘tathā āmātisāre kṣīrasya virekitvenāmaniḥ saraṇāddhetupratyanīkameva bhavati|’ iti paṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tathā āmātisāre kṣīrasya virekitvenāmaniḥ saraṇād dhetupratyanīkam eva bhavati| evam agnipluṣṭe 'py uṣṇakriyayā raktasya vilayanena sthānāntaragamanāt ‘hetupratyanīkataiva’ iti pā.| hetupratyanīkam eva; ‘anyathā raktaṃ dāhaprakupitaṃ tatrastham’ iti pā.| anyathā dāhaprakupitaṃ raktaṃ tatrasthaṃ pākam ārabhet; yad uktaṃ suśrute–
“agninā kopitaṃ raktaṃ bhṛśaṃ jantoḥ ‘pradhāvati’ iti pā.| prakupyati|
tatas tenaiva vegena pittam asyāpy udīryate||” iti (su. sū. a. 12); śītakriyā ca tatra niṣiddhā, raktasya styānatvahetutvāt; yad āha suśrutaḥ–
“prakṛtyā hy udakaṃ śītaṃ ‘skandayatyapi śoṇitam’ iti pā.| skandayaty atiśoṇitam|
tasmāt sukhayati hy uṣṇaṃ na tu śītaṃ kathañcana||” iti (su. sū. a. 12)| skandayati styānīkaroti; tathā jaṅgamaviṣe ūrdhvagasvarūpe maulaviṣam adhogasvarūpaṃ hetuviparītam eva| yad uktaṃ carake–
“viṣaṃ viṣaghnam uktaṃ yat prabhāvas tatra kāraṇam|
ūrdhvānulomikaṃ yac ca ‘tat’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tat prabhāvaprabhāvitam||” iti (ca. sū. a. 26)| asyāyam arthaḥ– viṣatvāviśeṣe 'pi kuto gatibheda ity ata uktam– tat prabhāvaprabhāvitam iti; tathā madyakṛte madātyaye yan madyaṃ tad api mātuluṅgacukrādiyutaṃ suśrutādibhir vihitaṃ kevalāc ca dravyāntarasaṃyuktam anyad eva, athavā vātamadātyaye rūkṣamādhvīkādinā janite snigdhapaiṣṭikādimadyaṃ prayujyamānaṃ hetuviparītam eva; ‘yaduktam’ iti pā.| yac coktaṃ suśrute–
“yathā narendropahatasya kasyacid bhavet prasādas tata eva nānyataḥ|
dhruvaṃ tathā madyahatasya dehino bhavet prasādas tata eva nānyataḥ||” iti (su. u. taṃ. a. 47), tan madyajātīyābhiprāyeṇaiva; yac corustambhe jalaprataraṇaṃ, tatrāpi jalasya śaityena ‘bahirnirgacchan’ iti pā.| bahir agacchan dehoṣmā ‘liptakumbhakārapavananyāyenāntaḥpiṇḍitau’ iti pā.| kumbhakārapavananyāyenāntaḥpiṇḍitau medaḥśleṣmāṇau vilāyayati, vyāyāmaś ca tau śoṣayati, ‘tataśca’ iti pā.| tatas tu nirāvaraṇo vāyuḥ svamārgapratipanno bhavatīti hetupratyanīkataiva; ‘anenaiva’ iti pā.| anena nyāyena sarvam eva tadarthakāri yathāsambhavaṃ hetupratyanīkādāv evāntarbhavatīti| ucyate– yady apy evaṃ tathā'py avāntaravaidharmyapratipādanārtham ācāryaiḥ pṛthag darśitam asyāgre ‘yathā śālyarthaṃ pravṛttayā kulyayā kriyamāṇaṃ bījāntarādhānaṃ tannāntarīyakaṃ, tadubhayahetutvaṃ sādharmyodāharaṇavat’ iti kvacitpustake'dhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ|| tathā carake 'py uktam– “upaśayaḥ punar hetuvyādhiviparītānāṃ ‘viparītārthakāriṇāmauṣadhāhāravihārāṇāmupayogaḥ’ iti pā.| viparītārthakāriṇāṃ cauṣadhāhāravihārāṇām upayogaḥ sukhānubandhaḥ|” iti (ca. ni. a. 1)| ‘auṣadhādīnāṃ duḥkhavaidharmyam’ iti pā.| vaidharmyaṃ ca hetusamānadharmakatve 'pi rogapraśamakatvam iti| viparīto 'nupaśaya iti auṣadhādīnāṃ duḥkhakara upayogo 'nupaśaya ity arthaḥ| tatparyāyam āha– vyādhyasātmya iti| vyādhigrahaṇena doṣo 'pi bodhyaḥ| nanu, anupaśayaḥ kiṃ vyādhiviśeṣaṃ bodhayati no vā? neti cet, ‘tadupanyāso nidāne’ iti pā.| nidāne tadupanyāso vyarthaḥ; pratipādayatīti cet, ‘vijñānaṃ rogāṇāṃ pañcadhā ‘smṛtam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | smṛtam’ iti ‘vyāhanyeta’ iti pā.| vyāhanyate, tasya ṣaṣṭhatvāpatteḥ| naivaṃ, pratipādayaty eva; yad āha carakaḥ– “gūḍhaliṅgaṃ vyādhim upaśayānupaśayābhyāṃ parīkṣeta|” iti (ca. vi. a. 4)| kintu nidāne tasyāntarbhāvaḥ, doṣasya rogasya vā vardhakatvāt ( ( ) etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | ity anupaśayasya nidāne 'ntarbhāvān na ṣaṣṭhatvāpattiḥ, vakṣyati ca– ‘nidānoktānupaśayaḥ’ iti|)| ity upaśayalakṣaṇam||8-9||

athopaśayalakṣaṇam āha– hetuvyādhiviparyastety ādi| yugmam| upayujyata ity upayogaḥ| sukham āvahati samyag anubandhena sukham utpādayatīti sukhāvahaḥ| etena ‘sadāhatṛṣṇānvitasya’ iti pā.| dāhatṛṣṇānvitasya navajvariṇaḥ śītajalapānaṃ ‘vyādhikaram’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vyādhikaraṃ tadātvasukhakaram api nopaśaya iti tātparyārthaḥ| ‘īdṛśo ya’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | īdṛśo ya upayogaḥ sukhāvahas tam upaśayaṃ vidyāt jānīyāt| keṣām upayogaḥ? auṣadhānnavihārāṇām|– auṣadhaṃ harītakyādi, annaṃ raktaśālyādi, vihāro– ‘dehamanonirvartitaśceṣṭāviśeṣo’ iti pā.| vāgdehamanonirvartitaś ceṣṭāviśeṣo ‘vyāyāmo– jāgaraṇādhyayanādirūpaḥ’ iti pā.| vyāyāmajāgaraṇādhyayanādirūpaḥ; auṣadhaṃ ca annaṃ ca vihāraś ca auṣadhānnavihārās teṣām| kimbhūtānāṃ? hetuvyādhiviparyastaviparyastārthakāriṇām|– hetuś ca vyādhiś ca hetuvyādhī, tayor vyastasamastayor viparyastā nidānarogayor viparītāḥ; tathā viparyastānām artho viparyastārthaḥ, tayor vyastasamastayor eva viparītam arthaṃ kurvantīti viparyastārthakāriṇaḥ; hetuvyādhiviparyastāś ca viparyastārthakāriṇaś ca hetuvyādhiviparyastaviparyastārthakāriṇas teṣām| ‘keṣām’ iti pā.| teṣāṃ viparyastānām arthaṃ kurvantīti prakṛtatvāt hetuvyādhiviparyastānām| tadā'yam arthaḥ– nidānarogayor vyastasamastayor viparītā api kāraṇarūpā iva bhāsamānā vyādhirūpā iva bhāsamānā hetuvyādhiviparītānām arthaṃ vyādhyupaśamalakṣaṇaṃ kurvantīti| yathā hetuviparītair auṣadhānnavihārair vyādhyupaśamaḥ kriyate pratipakṣatvāt; evaṃ viparyastārthakāribhir apīty arthaḥ| tathā ca hetuviparītānāṃ, vyādhiviparītānāṃ, hetuvyādhiviparītānāṃ, hetuviparītārthakāriṇāṃ, vyādhiviparītārthakāriṇāṃ, hetuvyādhiviparītārthakāriṇām, auṣadhānnavihārāṇāṃ yaḥ sukhāvaha upayogaḥ sa upaśaya iti sampiṇḍārthaḥ| atha krameṇodāharaṇāni| hetuviparītam auṣadhaṃ yathā– śītahetuke kaphajvare śuṇṭhyādy uṣṇaṃ bheṣajaṃ; yad uktaṃ,
“śītenoṣṇakṛtān rogāñ chamayanti bhiṣagvidaḥ|
ye tu śītakṛtā rogās teṣām uṣṇaṃ hi bheṣajam||” ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| hetuviparītam annaṃ yathā– śramānilajvare rasaudanam| hetuviparīto vihāro yathā– divāsvapnotthe kaphe rātrau jāgaraṇam| atha vyādhiviparītam auṣadhaṃ yathā– atīsāre stambhanaṃ pāṭhādi| vyādhiviparītam annaṃ yathā– atīsāre stambhanaṃ masūrādi| vyādhiviparīto vihāro yathā– udāvarte pravāhaṇaṃ; saśabdaṃ hṛtkaṇṭhabalena vāyor adho 'dho nayanaṃ pravāhaṇam| ‘mantrauṣadhadhāraṇabalyupahārādiniyamaprāyaścittācaraṇahomadevaguruśuśrūṣādayo vyādhiviparītā vihārāḥ’ ‘iti vyomacandraḥ’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti vyomacandraḥ| atha hetuvyādhiviparītam auṣadhaṃ yathā– vātaśothe daśamūlaṃ vātaharaṃ śothaharaṃ ca| hetuvyādhiviparītam annaṃ yathā– vātakaphagrahaṇyāṃ takraṃ vātakaphaharaṃ grahaṇīharaṃ ca| hetuvyādhiviparīto vihāro yathā– snigdhāyāṃ divāsvapnajāyāṃ tandrāyāṃ tandrāviparītaṃ ‘snigdhatāharaṇam’ iti pā.| snigdhatāharaṃ ca rātrau jāgaraṇam iti| atha hetuviparītārthakāry auṣadhaṃ yathā– pittapradhāne pacyamāne vraṇaśothe pittakara uṣṇa upanāhaḥ| hetuviparītārthakāry annaṃ yathā– pittaśothe 'nnaṃ vidāhi| hetuviparītārthakārī vihāro yathā– vātonmāde trāsanam iti| atha vyādhiviparītārthakāry auṣadhaṃ yathā– kaphe vamanakārakaṃ madanaphalādi| vyādhiviparītārthakāry annaṃ yathā– atīsāre virekakṛt kṣīram| vyādhiviparītārthakārī vihāro yathā– chardyām aṅguṣṭhotpalanālādinā vamanam| vamanavirekābhyāṃ chardyatīsārayor vṛddhir eva kartuṃ yuktā, iha tu ‘samānakāritvāt’ iti pā.| śamanakaraṇād viparītārthakāritvam| atha hetuvyādhiviparītārthakāry auṣadhaṃ yathā– agnipluṣṭe uṣṇo 'gurvādilepaḥ, viṣe vā viṣam| hetuvyādhiviparītārthakāry annaṃ yathā– madyāpānotthe madātyaye madakaraṃ madyam| hetuvyādhiviparītārthakārī vihāro yathā– vyāyāmajanite ‘mūḍhavāte’ iti pā.| sammūḍhavāte jalaprataraṇarūpo vyāyāma iti| evam apare 'pi boddhavyāḥ| auṣadhānnavihārāṇām ity upalakṣaṇaṃ, tena deśakālāv api boddhavyau| hiśabdaḥ pādapūraṇe| sa upaśayo vyādher āmayasya sātmyam iti smṛtaḥ| evaṃvidhaguṇaviparīto ya āhāro vihāraś ca prāyeṇa ‘nidānaviparītaḥ’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | nidānaviparītaḥ sa vyādhisātmyaḥ| uktaṃ ca carake–
“deśānām āmayānāṃ ca viparītaguṇaṃ guṇaiḥ|
sātmyam icchanti sātmyajñāś ceṣṭitaṃ cādyam eva ca||” iti upaśayakathanaprastāvād anupaśayo 'pi vācya ity āha– viparīta ity ādi| ato yathānirdiṣṭalakṣaṇād upaśayākhyād yo viparītalakṣaṇaḥ ‘auṣadhānnavihārāṇāmupayogo'sukhāvahaḥ’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | auṣadhānnavihārāṇām upayogo 'sukhāvahaḥ so 'nupaśaya ity ucyate, sa eva vyādher asātmyam itisañjñitaḥ ābhimukhyena saṅketita iti||8-9||

div.ab:
yathāduṣṭena doṣeṇa yathā cānuvirsapatā |
nirvṛttir āmayasyāsau samprāptir jātir āgatiḥ ||10|| (vā. ni. a. 1) |

ab.seg: samprāptim āha– yathety ādi| nānāvidhā hi doṣāṇāṃ duṣṭiḥ ‘prākṛtā vaikṛtā vā’ iti pā.| prākṛtī vaikṛtī vā, anubandhyarūpā anubandharūpā vā, ekaśo dviśo vā samastā vā, ‘rūkṣādibhiḥ samastairbhāvairalpairvā’ iti pā.| raukṣyādibhiḥ sarvair bhāvair alpair vā, evamādiduṣṭiduṣṭena doṣeṇa ‘yā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yā āmayasya rogasya nirvṛttir utpattiḥ ‘asau’ iti pā.| sā samprāptir ucyate| yathā cānuvisarpateti anekadhā doṣāṇāṃ visarpaṇaṃ gatir ūrdhvādhastiryagādibhedena, tathā visarpatā saṃsarpatā| samprāptiparyāyāv āha śāstre vyavahārārthaṃ lakṣaṇārthaṃ ca– jātir āgatir iti| jātyādibhiḥ ‘śabdairyo'rtho'bhidhīyate’ iti pā.| śabdair yā'bhidhīyate sā samprāptir iti| “ ‘jātirāgatiriti’ iti pā.| jātir āgatir ity arthaḥ janmā'pi jñānakāraṇam, ajātasya jñānābhāvāt” ity āha haricandraḥ “atraike vyādhijanmamātramantyakāraṇavyāpārajanyaṃ samprāptimāhuḥ| iyaṃ ca samprāptiryadyapi nidānādivadvyādhibodhikā na bhavati, tathā'pi nānutpannasya vyādherliṅgaṃ bhavatīti kṛtvā utpattervyādhyupalambhakatvaṃ varṇayanti| etaccānye nānumanyante; yato naivaṃ sati samprāptitaḥ kaścidviśeṣo vyādheradhigamyate| na cāyaṃ niyamaḥ– yadutpanna eva paraṃ vyādhirupalabhyate, yato nidānapūrvarūpābhyāmanutpanno'pi vyādhirbhāvitvenopalabhyate; tasmādvyādhijanakadoṣavyāpāraviśeṣayuktaṃ vyādhijanmeha samprāptiśabdena vācyam, ata eva paryāye ‘āgatiḥ’ ityuktam| āgatirhi utpādakakāraṇasya vyādhijananaparyantaṃ gamanam| iyaṃ ca samprāptirvyādhiviśeṣaṃ bodhayatveva, yathā jvare “sa yadā prakupitaḥ praviśyāmāśayam” ityārabhya “tadā jvaramabhinirvartayati” ityantena yā samprāptirucyate, tathā jvarasyāmāśayadūṣakatvāgnyupaghātakatvarasadūṣakatvādayo dharmāḥ pratīyante| naca vācyam– doṣāṇāmayamāmāśayadūṣakatvādirdharmaḥ, tataśca kāraṇadharmāṇāṃ nidānagrahaṇenaiva grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti; yataḥ kāraṇadharmo'pyayaṃ vyādhijanakadoṣavyāpārarūpaḥ samprāptiśabdena viśeṣabodhanārthaṃ pṛthakkṛtvocyate; yathā– liṅgatvāviśeṣe'pi bhāvivyādhibodhakatvaviśeṣāt pūrvarūpaṃ pṛthagucyate| ata eva vāgbhaṭenāpyevameva samprāptilakṣaṇamuktam– “yathāduṣṭena doṣeṇa yathā cānuvisarpatā| nirvṛttirāmayasyāsau samprāptirjātirāgatiḥ||” iti carakaṭīkāyāṃ nidānasthāne (ca. ni. a. 1) samprāptivivaraṇe cakraḥ| bhaṭṭāraharicandraḥ| etenaitad uktaṃ bhavati– na hi nidānādivad bodhakatvena jñānakāraṇatvaṃ, kintu ‘viṣayatvena’ iti pā.| bodhaviṣayatvena| tan na ity anye, ālokacakṣurāder iva evaṃvidhasamprāpteś cikitsāyām anupayogāt| na cāsti niyamaḥ jātam eva ‘jñāyate’ iti pā.| vijñāyate iti, ‘ajātasyāpi’ iti pā.| ajātasya vyādher nidānapūrvarūpābhyāṃ vṛṣṭyāder iva meghādinā jñāyamānatvāt| atha jātam iti janmāvacchinnam ucyate, vṛṣṭyādikaṃ ca bhaviṣyajjanmāvacchinnam eva, yasya tu kālatraye 'pi janma nāsti tan na jñāyata eva; ‘tathā'pi na vyādhijanmasamprāptiḥ’ ityatra ‘na’ ityeva kvacitpustakeṣu pāṭhaḥ| tathā'pi na vyādhijanma samprāptiḥ; janmavad ālokacakṣurāder api ‘bādhyatvāpatteḥ’ iti pā.| vācyatvāpatteḥ, tair api vinā ‘jātamiti vijñānābhāvāt’ iti pā.| jñānābhāvāt| tasmāt ‘doṣetikartavyatopalakṣitaṃ vyādhijanmeha samprāptiḥ na tu kevalaṃ janma’ ‘iti bhaṭṭāraharicandrābhiprāyaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti bhaṭṭāraharicandrābhiprāyaḥ| vāgbhaṭenāpi ‘yathāduṣṭena’ (vā. ni. a. 1) ity ādi vadatā viśiṣṭam eva vyādhijanma samprāptir uktā; tathā ‘ca sati kriyāviśeṣo’ iti pā.| sati kriyāviśeṣo 'pi labhyate; yathā– jvare āmāśayadūṣaṇāgnihananādibodhe laṅghanapācanasvedādikaraṇam iti| samprāptiś caivaṃvidhā yady api doṣāṇām avāntaravyāpāratvena doṣagrahaṇenaiva prāpyate, tathā'pi cikitsāviśeṣārtham eva pṛthak kriyate; yathā– ‘jñāpakatvāviśeṣe'pi’ iti pā.| vyādher jñāpakatvāviśeṣe 'pi pūrvarūpam eva rūpāt pṛthag iti| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tasmāt “doṣetikartavyatopalakṣitaṃ vyādhijanma samprāptiḥ”, ity eva lakṣaṇam||10||

atha samprāptilakṣaṇam āha– ‘yathetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yathety ādi| yena prakāreṇa duṣṭaḥ kupito vātādyanyatamo doṣo yathāduṣṭas tena yathāduṣṭena doṣeṇa yathā cānuvisarpatā deham anudhāvatā sanniveśaviśeṣeṇa gacchatā pratyāmayaṃ yā nirvṛttir utpattir nirdiṣṭā sā samprāptiḥ| sā ca jātir āgatiś ca kathyate paryāyaśabdatvena| ‘vyādhijanyasamprāptirityeke’ iti pā.| vyādhijanma samprāptir ity eke| yathā– jvarasya ‘malamūtretyādilakṣaṇalakṣitā| tatra’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | malamūtrety ādilakṣaṇalakṣitā| tatra malānām āmāśayapraveśanena, tathā ‘cānugamanena’ iti pā.| cāmānugamanena, tathā srotonirodhena, tathā ca paktisthānāj jvalananirasanena, tathā ca tenaiva jāṭhareṇa vahninā tathā'bhisaraṇena ‘sakaladehatāpena’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sakaladehatāpena sakalaṃ gātram uṣṇaṃ kurvatā, ‘evaṃvidhayātmaprāptyā’ iti pā.| evaṃvidhayā samprāptyā jvaro 'yam iti niścīyate| evam atīsārādiṣv apy evaṃvidhaiva ‘cintyā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | cintyā samprāptiḥ||10||

div.ab:
saṅkhyāvikalpaprādhānyabalakālaviśeṣataḥ |
sā bhidyate yathā'traiva vakṣyante 'ṣṭau jvarā iti ||11||
doṣāṇāṃ samavetānāṃ vikalpoṃ'śāṃśakalpanā |
svātantryapāratantryābhyāṃ vyādheḥ prādhānyam ādiśet ||12||
hetvādikārtsnyāvayavair balābalaviśeṣaṇam |
naktandinartubhuktāṃśair vyādhikālo yathāmalam ||13|| (vā. ni. a. 1) |

ab.seg:
tasyā aupādhikabhedam āha– saṅkhyety ādinā, sā bhidyata ity antena| atra ca prādhānyopādānād aprādhānyaṃ ca tatpratiyogitayā boddhavyam| ata eva ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca vivaraṇe svātantryapāratantryābhyām iti vakṣyati| evaṃ bale 'pi vyākhyeyam| saṅkhyādikam eva vivṛṇoti– yathety ādi| aṣṭau jvarā iti saṅkhyāvivaraṇam| aṣṭatvaṃ ca vātādikāraṇabhedāt; ‘ekajā dvandvajāśca trayaḥ’ ityeva paṭhyate kvacitpustakeṣu| ekajās trayo, dvandvajās trayaḥ, ‘sannipātajaśceka’ iti pā.| sannipātaja eka, āgantujaś caika iti| yady api vṛddhair doṣaiḥ sannipātās trayodaśa, yad uktaṃ carake–
“dvyulbaṇaikolbaṇaiḥ ṣaṭ syur hīnamadhyādhikaiś ca ṣaṭ|
samaiś caiko vikārās te sannipātās trayodaśa||” (ca. sū. a. 17) iti; tathā'py atra tridoṣajatvasāmānyāt sānnipātika ekatvena gaṇitaḥ| evaṃ kāmaśokabhayādyanekakāraṇajo 'py āgantuja ‘āgantutvasāmānyādekatvena’ iti pā.| āgantujatvasāmānyād ekatvena nirdiṣṭa ity aṣṭau jvarā iti| vikalpaṃ vivṛṇoti– doṣāṇām ity ādi| doṣāṇāṃ samavetānāṃ parasparasambaddhānāṃ; tena dvandvasannipātayor grahaṇam| aṃśāṃśakalpaneti aṃśā vātādigataraukṣyādayaḥ, tair ekadvitryādibhiḥ samastair vā vātādikopāvadhāraṇaṃ vikalpanā| yad uktaṃ suśrute–
“sarvair bhāvais tribhir vā'pi dvābhyām ekena vā punaḥ|
saṃsarge kupitaḥ kruddhaṃ doṣaṃ doṣo 'nudhāvati||” iti (su. sū. a. 21)| evaṃvidhaś ca doṣakopo nidānavaicitryād bhavati| tad yathā– vātasya raukṣyaśaityalāghavavaiśadyādiguṇasya evaṅguṇaḥ kaṣāyarasaḥ kalāyaś ca ‘sarvairaṃśairvardhakaḥ’ iti pā.| sarvair bhāvair vardhakaḥ, atra ‘tathā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| raukṣyaśaityalāghavais taṇḍulīyakaḥ, raukṣyaśaityābhyāṃ kāṇḍekṣuḥ, raukṣyeṇa sīdhuḥ; ‘tathā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tathā ‘kaṭvamlatīkṣṇoṣṇaguṇasya pittasya’ ityātaṅkadarpaṇe| pittasya sarvair bhāvair vardhakaḥ kaṭuko raso madyaṃ ca, hiṅgu ‘kaṭutīkṣṇoṣṇatvaiḥ’ iti pā.| kaṭūṣṇatīkṣṇatvaiḥ, dīpyakas taikṣṇyauṣṇyābhyām, auṣṇyena tilāḥ; tathā ‘snehamādhuryaśaityaguṇasya śleṣmaṇaḥ’ ityātaṅkadarpaṇe| śleṣmaṇaḥ sarvair bhāvair vardhako ‘madhurarasaḥ’ iti pā.| madhuro raso māhiṣaṃ ca payaḥ, snehagauravamādhuryai rājādanaphalaṃ, kaśeruḥ śaityagauravābhyāṃ, ‘śaityenaikena mṛṇālam’ iti ātaṅkadarpaṇe| śaityena kṣīriṇāṃ phalānīti| aparaguṇodāharaṇaprakārā ‘jejjaṭādīnāṃ granthe jñātavyāḥ| “sarvairaṃśaiḥ kaṣāyaśca kalāyo vātavardhanaḥ| pittasya kaṭuko dīpyaḥ, śleṣmaṇo māhiṣaṃ payaḥ||”; viśeṣeṇa granthasya vistaratvāpatteratra na likhitāḥ|’ iti pā.| jejjaṭagadādharavāpyacandravyākhyāviśeṣāś ca vistaratvāpatter atra na likhitāḥ| prādhānyaṃ vivṛṇoti– svātantryapāratantryābhyām iti| anubandhyānubandhabhāvenety arthaḥ| atrāpi ‘doṣāṇāṃ samavetānām’ ity anuvartanīyam| ‘aprādhānyaṃ ca’ iti śeṣaḥ, gamyamānatvān nopadarśitam| tena svātantryāt prādhānyaṃ, pāratantryād aprādhānyam iti sidhyati| balaṃ vivṛṇoti– hetvādīty ādi| hetupūrvarūparūpāṇāṃ sākalyād vyādher balavattvaṃ, teṣām avayavenaikadeśenābalavattvam| kālaṃ vivṛṇoti– ‘naktamityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | naktam ity ādi| naktaṃ rātriḥ, dinam ahaḥ, ṛtavo vasantādayaḥ, bhuktam āhāraḥ, eṣām aṃśair ekadeśaiḥ; vyādhikālo vyādhivṛddhihānihetukālaḥ| atra, ‘ṛtvoraṃśāḥ’ iti pā.| ṛtor aṃśāḥ katipayāny ahorātrāṇi, yad āha vāgbhaṭaḥ– “ṛtvor antyādisaptāhāv ṛtusandhir iti smṛtaḥ|” iti (vā. sū. a. 3); ‘atha vā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | atha vā saṃvatsararūpasya kālasya ṛturūpoṃ'śa ṛtvaṃśa ity evam api yojyaṃ; ‘natu ṛturūpakālasyāṃśā vyādhyutpādakā na bhavanti, viśiṣṭasya vyādhihetutvāt; tatoṃ'śaśabdasya kathamṛtuśabdaprayogaḥ? ucyate– tanna, saṃvatsararūpasya ca kālasya ṛturūpoṃ'śaḥ ṛtvaṃśa iti yojyaṃ, natvekasya ṛtordināni madhyāntādyaṃśāḥ’ iti pā.| na tv ekasya ṛtor dinādivad ādimadhyāntā ṛtvaṃśāḥ, ṛtoḥ samuditasya tatra kāraṇatvenoktatvāt| yathāmalaṃ yathādoṣaṃ; tad yathā– rātrer ādau śleṣmā, madhye pittaṃ, śeṣe vāyuḥ; evaṃ dinasya; vasante kaphasya, śaradi pittasya, varṣāsu vāyoḥ atra ‘kopaḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| kopaḥ; evaṃ bhuktādau bhuktamātre kaphasya, madhye pacyamānāvasthāyāṃ pittasya, ‘ante samyakpariṇate vāyoḥ iti|’ iti pā.| ante samyak pariṇate bhukte vāyoḥ prakopa iti| tad uktaṃ vāgbhaṭenaiva–
“te vyāpino 'pi hṛnnābhyor adhomadhyordhvasaṃśrayāḥ|
vayo 'horātribhuktānāṃ te 'ntamadhyādigāḥ kramāt||” iti (vā. sū. a. 1)| atra te iti krameṇa vātapittaśleṣmāṇaḥ| nanu, samprāptibhede carakeṇa saṅkhyādivad vidhir apy uktaḥ; yathā– “dvividhā vyādhayo nijāgantubhedena” (ca. ni. a. 1), ‘dvividhaṃ raktapittam” (ca. ni. a. 2)’ iti pā.| “trividhaṃ raktapittam” (ca. sū. a. 11) ity ādi; tat kuto 'tra vidhir noktaḥ? ucyate, saṅkhyāgrahaṇena vidher avarodhaḥ, tasyāvyabhicaritasaṅkhyāyogitvāt| vidhisaṅkhyayoś cāyaṃ bhedaḥ– vidhir hi prakāraḥ, sa cābhinnajātīyānām eva kasyacid dharmāntarasyānvayād bhavati, yathā– raktapittatvāviśeṣe 'pi ūrdhvagādiprakāro bhavati; saṅkhyā tu bhinnatvamātre 'pi; yathā– catvāro ghaṭāḥ, aṣṭau jvarā iti| atraiva vidhir hi prakāraḥ, sa ca bhinneṣu na yuktaḥ, ataḥ kvacitpustake ‘saṅkhyādibhinneṣu vyādhiṣu’ etatsthāne ‘saṅkhyādibhinneṣvapi’ iti pā.| saṅkhyādibhinneṣu vyādhiṣu kāraṇadharmānugataḥ prakāro yujyate| tathā ca nyāyavido bruvate– “samānena dharmeṇa parigraho bhedānāṃ yatra kriyate sa vidhiḥ, saṅkhyā tu bhedamātram|” iti; vaiyākaraṇā api vyācakṣate– “anvayavān prakāro, niranvayo bhedaḥ” iti vāpyacandro likhitavān| nanu yathāṃ'śāṃśavikalpanādinā jvaro jñāyate na tathā saṅkhyayā| ucyate– saṅkhyābhedena vyādher doṣabhedo jñāyate, yato jvarādikaṃ svarūpato jñātvā cikitsārthaṃ viśeṣo jijñāsyaḥ, katamo 'yaṃ jvaraḥ? iti; ‘tasmin jñāte viśeṣo bhavatīti paramparayā kāraṇatvaṃ saṅkhyāyāḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tasmin jñāte viśeṣo bhavatīti paramparayā kāraṇatvaṃ saṅkhyāyāḥ| ‘tatra yadyutpadyamāna’ iti pā.| atra yad utpanna evāsau doṣabhedād bhinno jā(jñā)tas tato yuktam asya paryeṣaṇaṃ katamo 'yam iti| ‘kutaḥ? cikitsāviśeṣārtham| iti samprāptilakṣaṇam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kutaḥ? cikitsāviśeṣārtham| iti samprāptilakṣaṇam||11-13||

atha samprāpter bhedān āha– saṅkhyety ādi| sā ca samprāptiḥ saṅkhyādiviśeṣeṇa bhidyate| saṅkhyā ca vikalpaś ca prādhānyaṃ ca balaṃ ca kālaś ca ta evaṃ, teṣāṃ viśeṣaḥ saṅkhyāvikalpaprādhānyabalakālaviśeṣas tasmāt samprāptir bahudhā sampadyate| tatra saṅkhyāviśeṣo yathā– ihaivāsmin granthe ‘saṃvakṣyate’ iti pā.| vakṣyate– aṣṭau jvarā iti; evam api pañca kāsā iti pañca gulmā ity ādi, evamādayaḥ saṅkhyāviśeṣāḥ samprāptibhedāḥ| saṅkhyānantaraṃ vikalpaṃ vivṛṇoti– ‘doṣāṇāmityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | doṣāṇām ity ādi| doṣāṇāṃ vātādīnāṃ, samavetānām ekasmin vyādhau kvacitpustake ‘saṅghaṭṭitānāṃ, yā aṃśāṃśavibhāgena’ etatsthāne ‘saṅghaṭṭitānāmaṃśāṃśavibhāgena’ iti pā.| saṅghaṭṭitānāṃ, yā aṃśāṃśavibhāgena kāryānumeyenānumānena yathā– parvato 'yaṃ vahnimān dhūmavattvād itivan nirūpaṇaṃ sa vikalpaḥ| aṃśaś ca aṃśaś ca aṃśāṃśau, tābhyāṃ kalpanā anekavidho viśeṣo ‘vātādigatatvāt raukṣyādiko’ iti pā.| vātādigataraukṣyādikaḥ, yathā– kim ayaṃ vātaḥ sarvair guṇaiḥ kupitaḥ ‘kim’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kiṃ tribhiḥ kiṃ dvābhyāṃ kiṃ vaikena; kim idaṃ pittaṃ sarvair guṇaiḥ kupitaṃ, kiṃ tribhiḥ, kiṃ dvābhyāṃ, kim ekena| kim ayaṃ śleṣmā ‘sarvai rasaiḥ’ iti pā.| sarvair bhāvaiḥ kupitaḥ, kiṃ tribhiḥ, kiṃ dvābhyāṃ, kim ekenety ādikā kalpanā| tad yathā– vāyo raukṣyaśaityalāghavavaiśadyādiguṇasyaivaṅguṇaḥ kaṣāyo rasaḥ ‘kaṣāyarasaḥ kalāyaśca sarvairaṃśaiśca vāyorvardhakaḥ’ iti pā.| kalāyaś ca sarvair aṃśair vardhakaḥ, raukṣyaśaityalāghavais tribhis taṇḍulīyakaḥ, raukṣyaśaityābhyāṃ kāṇḍekṣuḥ raukṣyeṇaikena guṇena sīdhuḥ; tathā sarvair aṃśaiḥ ‘kaṭvamlatīkṣṇoṣṇaiḥ’ iti pā.| kaṭvamlatīkṣṇoṣṇaguṇasya pittasya kaṭuko raso madyaṃ ca, kaṭūṣṇatīkṣṇair hiṅgu, dīpyakaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇābhyām, uṣṇenaikena tilāḥ; evaṃ sarvair aṃśaiḥ snehagauravamādhuryaśaityaguṇasya śleṣmaṇo madhuro raso māhiṣaṃ payaś ca, snehagauravamādhuryai rājādanaphalaṃ, ‘kaseruḥ’ iti pā.| kaserukāḥ śaityagauravābhyāṃ, śaityenaikena mṛṇālaṃ śleṣmavardhakam| evam apare 'pi jñeyāḥ| doṣāṇām iti ‘bahutve pṛthaggrahaṇam’ iti pā.| bahutvaṃ pṛthaggrahaṇārtham| samavetānām iti dvandvasannipātayor grahaṇam| uktaṃ hi suśrute–
“sarvair aṃśais tribhir vā'pi dvābhyām ekena vā punaḥ|
saṃsarge kupitaḥ kruddhaṃ doṣaṃ doṣo 'nudhāvati||” iti| atha prādhānyaṃ vivṛṇoti– ‘svātantryetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | svātantryety ādi| svātantryaṃ ca pāratantryaṃ ca, tābhyāṃ prādhānyaṃ vyādher ādiśet| aprādhānyaṃ ceti śeṣaḥ| ‘tatra’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tatra svatantrasya vyādheḥ svanirdiṣṭopakramasādhyatvāt prādhānyaṃ, yathā jvarasya| atha balābalaṃ vivṛṇoti-kṛtsnasya bhāvaḥ ‘kārtsnyam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kārtsnyaṃ, kārtsnyaṃ ca avayavāś ca ‘kārtsnyāvayavāḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kārtsnyāvayavāḥ, taiḥ| balaṃ ca abalaṃ ca balābale vyādhisambandhinī, tayor viśeṣaṇaṃ viśiṣṭatā balābalaviśeṣaṇam| tad yathāsaṅkhyena kārtsnyāvayavair ādiśet| ādiśabdena prāgrūpādayo gṛhyante| teṣāṃ sākalyād vyādher balatvaṃ, ‘teṣāmavayavaikadeśenābalatvam’ iti pā.| teṣām evāvayavaikadeśenābalatvam| tatra pratirogaṃ yan nidānam uddiṣṭaṃ tat kiṃ kārtsnyenāsya vyādher utpādakam utaikadeśena?
