evaṃ prāgrūpam api kiṃ ‘tat’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tat samastavyādher lakṣyate utāvayavair ekena ca?, upaśayo 'py asya vyādhes tarpaṇātarpaṇarūpaḥ, sa kiṃ kārtsnyena sukhānubandhaṃ karoti utāvayavena?; tatra kārtsnyena yathā– raktaśālyādimāṃsaghṛtakṣīradadhivasāmajjātailādinā, avayavena yathā– raktaśālinā māṃsādyanyatamaikena vā; evam anyad api cintyam kālaṃ vivṛṇoti– naktam ity ādi| naktaṃ rātriḥ, dinam ahaḥ, ṛtavo vasantādayaḥ, bhuktam āhāraḥ, eṣām aṃśair ādimadhyāntalakṣaṇair ekadeśair vā; ‘tairyathāmalam’ iti pā.| yathāmalaṃ yathādoṣaṃ; vyādhikālaḥ vyādhivṛddhihānihetukālaḥ| yathā– rātrimukhe śleṣmā, madhye pittaṃ, śeṣe vāyuḥ; evaṃ dinasyāpi pūrvāhne śleṣmā, madhyāhne pittam, aparāhne vāyuḥ; evaṃ ṛtuṣu vasante śleṣmā, grīṣme pittaṃ, varṣāsu vāyuḥ kupyati; evaṃ bhuktamātre kaphasya, madhye pacyamānāvasthāyāṃ pittasya, samyakpariṇatau vāyoḥ kopaḥ| atra saṃvatsararūpasya kālasya kvacitpustake ‘ṛturūpā aṃśā ṛtvaṃśā’ etatsthāne ‘ṛtvaṃśa’ iti pā.| ṛturūpā aṃśā ṛtvaṃśā iti yojyaṃ, na tv ekasya ṛtor dinādivat| kecana ṛtvaṃśāḥ katipayāhorātrāṇi kathayanti| yad uktaṃ vāgbhaṭe– “ ‘ṛtvorantyādisaptāhānṛtusandhiriti’ iti pā.| ṛtvor antyādisaptāhāv ṛtusandhir iti smṛtaḥ|” iti||11-13||

div.ab: iti prokto kvacitpustake ‘nidānārthaḥ sa vyāsenopadekṣyate’ etatsthāne ‘nidānārthastadvyāsenopadekṣyate’ iti pā.| nidānārthaḥ sa vyāsenopadekṣyate |14| (vā. ni. a. 1) | ‘uktaṃ nidānapañcakamupasaṃharati– itītyādi|’ etatsthāne ‘uktanidānapañcakamupasaṃharati– iti prokto nidānārtha iti|’ iti pā.|

uktaṃ nidānapañcakam upasaṃharati– itīty ādi| itiśabdaḥ samāptau| nidānaśabdo 'tra sāmānyavacanaḥ, artho 'bhidheyaḥ| tan nidānaṃ saṅkṣepeṇa svarūpalakṣaṇamātreṇoktam, adhunā vyāsena vistareṇopadekṣyate kathayiṣyate; sakalena granthena pratirogaṃ nidānapūrvarūpādaya eva tattadviśeṣair vaktavyā ity arthaḥ|14|– ‘uktanidānaprapañcamupasaṃharati’ iti pā.|

uktanidānapañcakam upasaṃharati– ‘itītyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | itīty ādi| itiśabdaḥ prakāre, anena ‘saṅkṣepeṇa’ iti pā.| saṅkṣepākhyena prakāreṇa, ‘yathā nirdiṣṭena’ iti pā.| yathānirdiṣṭo nidānārtho nidānābhidheyaḥ, samāsataḥ saṅkṣepataḥ kathitaḥ| nidānaśabdo 'tra sāmānyaḥ prāgrūpādiṣu| ya eva nidānārthaḥ samāsena proktas tam eva ‘vyāsato’ iti pā.| vyāsena vistareṇa upadekṣyate kathayiṣyate| tena sakalena granthena pratirogaṃ nidānapūrvarūpādaya eva tattadviśeṣair vaktavyā ity arthaḥ|14|–

sarveṣām eva rogāṇāṃ nidānaṃ kupitā malāḥ ||14||
tatprakopasya tu proktaṃ vividhāhitasevanam |15| (vā. ni. a. 1) |

dvividhaṃ hi rogasya kāraṇaṃ viprakṛṣṭaṃ sannikṛṣṭaṃ ca; tatra viprakṛṣṭaṃ ‘āhārādi’ iti pā.| viruddhāhārādi, sannikṛṣṭaṃ vātādi, tasya vātādeḥ sarvarogeṣv avyabhicaritakāraṇatvam āha– sarveṣām ity ādi| yad āha suśrutaḥ–
“nāsti rogo vinā doṣair yasmāt tasmād vicakṣaṇaḥ
anuktam api doṣāṇāṃ liṅgair vyādhim upācaret|” (su. sū. a. 35/19) iti asyāgre kvacitpustake ‘nanu, āgantuke kathaṃ doṣapūrvakatvaṃ? yatastatprakopakāraṇamāhārādikaṃ nāsti? ucyate– abhicārābhighātādinā vyathotpadyate, tena doṣotpattiḥ, tathā ca vyādhiriti; tathā'bhicārādinā'dṛṣṭapreritadoṣotpattiḥ, evamprakāreṇa doṣapūrvakatvam’ ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate | (su. sū. a. 35)| āgantuvyādhiṣu yady apy utpattau doṣakopo nāsti, tathā'py utpattyanantaram avaśyambhāvī; utpannadravye guṇayogavat| yad uktaṃ carake– “āgantur hi vyathāpūrvasamutpanno jaghanyaṃ vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ vaiṣamyam āpādayati|” iti (ca. sū. a. 20)| nidānaṃ kāraṇam| malā doṣāḥ, malinīkaraṇāt| nanu, vātādīnāṃ kim idaṃ doṣatvam?; atrāhur eke– svātantryeṇa dūṣakatvaṃ doṣatvam ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti; rasādidūṣyavyavacchedārthaṃ ‘svātantryeṇa’ iti padaṃ, te hi vātādiduṣṭāḥ santo dūṣyāntaradūṣakāḥ| atrāhur anye– kim idaṃ svātantryaṃ? kiṃ doṣāntaranirapekṣatvaṃ? hetvantaranirapekṣatvaṃ vā? ādye vātasyaiva doṣatvaṃ syāt, na tu vātasāpekṣayoḥ kaphapittayoḥ; yad uktam–
“pittaṃ paṅgu kaphaḥ paṅguḥ paṅgavo maladhātavaḥ|
vāyunā yatra nīyante tatra gacchanti meghavat||” iti; dvitīye vātasyāpi na doṣatvaṃ, kaphapittayor iva nidānasāpekṣasyaiva tasya dūṣakatvāt; tasmāt “prakṛtyārambhakatve sati ‘duṣṭikāraṇatvam’ iti pā.| duṣṭikartṛtvaṃ doṣatvam” iti lakṣaṇam| rasaraktādinivṛttyarthaṃ ‘prakṛtyārambhakatvam’ iti viśeṣaṇam| na hi vātādiprakṛtivac chāstre ‘rasaraktādiprakṛtiruktaḥ puruṣaḥ, raktadūṣitaśukrāderasādhyatvena dehārambhakatvaṃ nāsti; raktasya dehārambhakatve satyapi prakṛtyārambhakatvaṃ nāsti, anabhidhānāt; śāstre na raktaprakṛtiruktaḥ puruṣaḥ’ iti pā.| rasaraktādiprakṛtir uktā; vātādiprakṛtitvaṃ ca śarīrasya vātādidūṣitaśukraśoṇitārabdhatvam asyāgre kvacitpustake ‘tatra vātādidūṣitatvaṃ nāma śukraśoṇitasaṃyogakāle śukraśoṇitayoradhikataradoṣādhikaraṇatvam, anyathā duṣṭayostayordehārambhakatvameva na syāt; uktaṃ ca– “vātapittakaphādiduṣṭaretasaḥ prajotpādane na samarthāḥ|” iti| tatrobhayorekādhikaraṇatvena ekadoṣajā prakṛtiḥ, bhinnādhikaraṇatvena dvandvajā tridoṣajā vā| vātādiprakṛtitvaṃ śarīrasya vātādidūṣitaśukraśoṇitārabdhatvāt’ ityadhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ upalabhyate || yad āha carakaḥ– “doṣānuśayitā hy eṣāṃ dehaprakṛtir ucyate|”; tathā– “vātalādyāḥ sadā''turāḥ|” iti (ca. sū. a. 7)| suśrutenāpi prakṛtilakṣaṇe “vātaprakṛtiḥ ‘sphuṭitacaraṇo jāgaruko'navasthitacittaḥ” (su. śā. a. 4) ityādi paṭhitam| prakṛtirogayoścāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ’ iti pā.| sphuṭitakaracaraṇo jāgaruko 'navasthitacittaḥ” (su. śā. a. 4) ity ādy uktam| prakṛtirogayoś cāyaṃ ‘viśeṣaḥ’ iti pā.| bhedaḥ– prakṛtir apathyasevayā nātyantaṃ bādhate, yad uktam–
“viṣajāto yathā kīṭo viṣeṇa na vipadyate|
tadvat prakṛtibhir dehas tajjātatvān na bādhyate||” (su. śā. a. 4) iti saṅkṣepaḥ| vistaras tu suśrutaślokavārtike ‘praśnasahasranidānākhye’ iti pā.| praśnavidhānākhye ṭīkāsu ca draṣṭavyaḥ| nanu, ‘prakṛtyārambhakatvaṃ doṣatvam’ ity evāstu| satyaṃ, vipakṣād vyāvṛttir bhavaty eva, kintu ‘doṣasvarūpatvam’ iti pā.| doṣasvarūpaṃ noktaṃ syād iti| suśrutādibhir vātāder iva prakopakālaprakopaṇanirharaṇasthānaviśeṣarogaviśeṣaliṅgaviśeṣa-cikitsāviśeṣāṇām abhidhānād raktasyāpi doṣatvaṃ ‘pūrvaṭīkākārairāṣāḍhadharmadāsādibhiḥ’ iti pā.| pūrvaṭīkākārair āṣāḍhadharmasvāmidāsādibhiḥ svīkṛtaṃ tad apy etena vyavacchinnam, adhunātanair asvīkriyamāṇatvāt| nanu, doṣāś cet kāraṇaṃ tarhi teṣāṃ sarvadā dehe sadbhāvāt sarvadā rogotpādakatvaprasaṅga ity ata āha– kupitā iti, vikṛtim āpannāḥ| nanu, tatprakopaḥ svabhāvāt, kāraṇāntarād vā? nādyaḥ, pūrvavat prasaṅgāt; atha kāraṇāntarād iti kiṃ tad ity āha– vividhāhitasevanam iti| vividhasya nānāvidhasya, ahitasya asātmyendriyārthasaṃyogaprajñāparādhapariṇāmalakṣaṇasya sevanam iti||14||-

sannikṛṣṭakāraṇatvena vātādīnāṃ sarvarogeṣv avyabhicaritakāraṇatvam āha– ‘sarveṣāmityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sarveṣām ity ādi| kupitatvena hi dhātūnāṃ ‘malinīkaraṇadoṣā’ iti pā.| malinīkaraṇād doṣā eva malā ity ucyante| kupitā vikṛtim āpannā vātapittakaphāḥ, ‘sarveṣāmeva’ iti pā.| sarveṣām api rogāṇāṃ, nidānaṃ kāraṇam| tatprakopasyeti tad ity anena vātādayaḥ parāmṛśyante; tasya tu vātādiprakopasya, nidānaṃ kāraṇaṃ, vividhaṃ nānāprakāram ahitasevanam ahitānuṣṭhānaṃ, proktaṃ ‘kathitam’ iti pā.| kathitam iti||14||–

ab.seg: nanu, kim etad eva nidānam, utānyad apy astīty ataś carakavacanam upanyasyati– nidānārthakara ity ādi| apiśabdo 'tra bhinnakrame| rogo 'pi nidānārthakaro rogasya| ‘ayamarthaḥ’ iti pā.| asyāyam arthaḥ– nidānena yo 'rthaḥ kriyate vyādhyākhyaḥ, sa rogeṇāpīti| rogo 'pi rogakara iti vācye yan nidānārthakara ity akarot, tenaivaṃ gamayati– rogo 'pi rogāntaraṃ kurvāṇo nidānāntaropabṛṃhitabala eva ‘karotīti’ iti pā.| karoti; evaṃ rogo rogasya nidānam upajāyate ity eva ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | yojanā||15||

nanu, kim etad eva nidānam anyad apy astīty āha– ‘nidānārthakara ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | nidānārthakara ity ādi| rogasya vyādheḥ rogo 'pi nidānārthakara upajāyate| nidānena yo 'rthaḥ kriyate vyādhyākhyaḥ sa rogeṇāpīty arthaḥ||15||

div.ab:
tad yathā jvarasantāpād raktapittam udīryate |
raktapittāj jvaras tābhyāṃ śoṣasyāpy upajāyate ||16||
plīhābhivṛddhyā jaṭharaṃ jaṭharāc chotha eva ca |
arśobhyo jāṭharaṃ duḥkhaṃ gulmaś cāpy upajāyate ||17||
(divāsvāpādidoṣaiś ca pratiśyāyaś ca jāyate) |
pratiśyāyād atho kāsaḥ kāsāt sañjāyate kṣayaḥ |
kṣayo rogasya hetutve śoṣasyāpy upajāyate ||18|| (ci. ni. a. 8) |

ab.seg: atraiva dṛṣṭāntam āha– tad yathety ādi| tābhyām iti raktapittāt jvarāc ca| duḥkham iti ‘duḥkhayatīti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | duḥkhayatīti duḥkhaṃ pīḍākaram| ayaṃ ca duḥkhaśabdo liṅgavipariṇāmena sarveṣv eva jvarādiṣu yojya iti vāpyacandraḥ| gulmaś cāpy upajāyata iti arśobhya eva| kāsāt sañjāyate kṣaya iti ‘ojaḥ prabhṛtīnām’ iti śeṣaḥ| sa ca kṣayo rogasya hetutve upajāyate| kasya rogasyety āha– śoṣasyeti, rājayakṣmaṇaḥ| atra kecit haricandrādibhir vyākhyātaṃ pāṭhāntaraṃ paṭhanti– “kṣayo rogasya hetutve śoṣaś cāpy upajāyate|” iti ‘asyāyamarthaḥ’ iti pā.| asyārthaḥ– kṣayo rājayakṣmā, uroga uraḥkṣataḥ, samāhāradvandvenaikavacanaṃ, tasya hetutve śoṣo dhātukṣaya upajāyata iti| nanu, carake sarvaṃ nidānaṃ traividhyena saṅgṛhītaṃ ‘asātmyendriyārthasaṃyoga’ (ca. sū. a. 11) ity ādinā, tataś ca rogasyāpi nidānatvam ācakṣāṇaḥ ‘traividhyaṃ katham’ iti pā.| svoktaṃ nidānatraividhyasaṅgrahaṃ kathaṃ na viruṇaddhi?; atraike samādhim abhidadhati– trividhaṃ yan nidānam uktaṃ tat sarvavyādhiviṣayam, idaṃ tu pratiniyataviṣayaṃ, yato na sarve rogā rogāj jāyante, kiṃ tarhi kaścid eva vyādhiḥ ‘kutaścidrogājjāyate’ iti pā.| kutaścid rogād iti caturtham evaitan nidānaṃ rogākhyam iti| anye tv āhuḥ– rogasya rogo 'pi nidānaṃ ‘bhavat’ iti pā.| bhavan trividhanidānavyatirekeṇa na bhavaty eva; yato yāvad ayaṃ jvaro 'sātmyendriyārthasaṃyogādibhir upabṛṃhitabalo na bhavati na tāvad raktapittam ārabhate, tasmād vyādhyutpāde trividha eva hetuḥ sākṣāt pāramparyeṇa veti||16-18||

atraiva dṛṣṭāntam āha– tad yathety ādi| kāraṇabhūtāt jvarasantāpāt raktapittam udīryate utpādyate, ‘kāraṇabhūtādraktapittājjvaraḥ samupajāyate’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kāraṇabhūtād raktapittāj jvaraḥ samupajāyate, tābhyāṃ raktapittajvarābhyāṃ śoṣaś ca upajāyate; plīhābhivṛddhyā jaṭharam udaravikāraḥ, tasmāt jaṭharāt śothaḥ, arśobhya eva jaṭharaṃ gulmaś cāpy upajāyate, duḥkham iti, duḥkhaṃ pīḍākaram| duḥkhaśabdo liṅgavipariṇāmena sarveṣv eva jvarādiṣu yojyaḥ, atha pratiśyāyāt kāso jāyate, kāsāt kṣayaḥ sañjāyate, ‘ojaḥprabhṛtīnām’ iti śeṣaḥ; sa ca kṣayaḥ rogasya hetutve upajāyate, kasya rogasyety āha– śoṣasyeti||16-18||

div.ab: te pūrvaṃ kevalā rogāḥ paścād dhetvarthakāriṇaḥ |19| (ca. ni. a. 8) |

nanu, ya ime rogā rogāntarasya nidānatvenoktās te kim utpannamātrā eva rogaṃ janayanti ‘utā'nantarakālaṃ vā ityata’ iti pā.| utānantarakālam ity ata āha– te pūrvam ity ādi| te vyādhaya upabṛṃhakahetvalābhāt prāk kevalāḥ svatantrāḥ kvacitpustake ‘santo rogā eva rujākartṛtvāt’ etatsthāne ‘rogā rujākartṛtvāt’ iti pā.| santo rogā eva rujākartṛtvāt; paścād upabṛṃhakahetulābhāt, hetor nidānasya yo 'rtho yat prayojanaṃ vyādhijananākhyaṃ tat kurvanti| yathā– ‘jvarāt’ iti pā.| jvaro raktapittam iti|19|–

te vyādhayaḥ prāk kevalāḥ svatantrāḥ santo rogā eva, rujākartṛtvāt; ūrdhvam upabṛṃhakahetulābhād dhetor nidānasya yo 'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ vyādhijananākhyaṃ ‘tat’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tat kurvanti, yathā jvaro raktapittam iti|19|–

kaścid dhi rogo rogasya hetur bhūtvā praśāmyati ||19||
na praśāmyati cāpy anyo hetutvaṃ kurute 'pi ca |
evaṃ kṛcchratamā nṝṇāṃ dṛśyante vyādhisaṅkarāḥ ||20|| (ca. ni. a. 8) |

ab.seg: tasyaiva rogajanakasya vyādher vaicitryam āha– kaścid ity ādi| evam uktaprakāreṇa; vyādhisaṅkarā vyādhimelakāḥ dṛśyante| yathā– pratiśyāyo na nivartate kāsaś ca jāyate, arśo na nivartate jaṭharagulmau syātām iti| kṛcchratamatvaṃ caiṣāṃ bahuvidhaduḥkhajanakatvāt, prāyo viruddhopakramāc ceti||19-20||

tasyaiva rogajanakavyādher vaicitryam āha– kaścid ity ādi| evam uktaprakāreṇa, vyādhisaṅkarā vyādhimelakāḥ, kṛcchratamā dṛśyante; evaṃ kaścid rogo rogāntarasya kāraṇaṃ bhūtvā svayaṃ praśāmyati, anyaś ca na praśāmyati; yathā pratiśyāyo na nivartate kāsaś cotpadyate, arśo na vyāvartate jaṭharagulmau syātām| kṛcchratamatvaṃ caiṣāṃ bahuvidhaduḥkhajanakatvāt prāyo viruddhopakramatvāc ca||19-20||

lg.l: tasmād yatnena sadvaidyair icchadbhiḥ siddhim uddhatām |

ab.seg:
uktanidānapañcakasya ‘roganivṛttilakṣaṇasiddhyādihetutvenāvaśyam’ iti pā.| roganivṛttilakṣaṇasiddhihetutvenāvaśyaṃ jñātavyatām āha– tasmād ity ādi| uddhatāṃ bahuviṣayatvena mahatīm| viniścayo nidānam iti| atha vakṣyamāṇavikāreṣu prakṛtisamasamavāyavikṛtiviṣamasamavāyādijñānārthaṃ carakoktā vātādiguṇāḥ likhyante–
“rūkṣaḥ śīto laghuḥ sūkṣmaś calo 'tha viśadaḥ kharaḥ|
viparītaguṇair dravyair mārutaḥ sampraśāmyati||
sasneham uṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ ca dravam amlaṃ saraṃ kaṭu|
viparītaguṇaiḥ pittaṃ dravyair āśu praśāmyati||
guruśītamṛdusnigdhamadhurasthirapicchilāḥ|
śleṣmaṇaḥ praśamaṃ yānti viparītaguṇair guṇāḥ||” iti (ca. sū. a. 1)||21||

uktanidānapañcakaṃ roganivṛttilakṣaṇasiddhyādihetutvenāvaśyaṃ jñātavyam āha– tasmād ity ādi| tasmāt kāraṇāt, uttamāṃ bahuviṣayatvena mahatīṃ, siddhim icchadbhir vaidyair yo 'yaṃ jvarādīnāṃ viniścayo vakṣyate kathyate sa yatnena jñātavyaḥ||21||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne ‘pañcalakṣaṇanidānam’ iti pā.| pañcanidānalakṣaṇaṃ samāptam ||1||
iti ‘śrīmān ... ’ iti pā.| śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ ‘pañcalakṣaṇanidānam’ iti pā.| pañcanidānalakṣaṇaṃ samāptam||1||
iti ‘śrīmān ... ’ iti pā.| śrīvaidyavācaspatikṛte ātaṅkadarpaṇe ‘nidānaṭīkāyām’ iti pā.| rugviniścayavyākhyāne sarvaroganidānādipañcakakathanam||1||

div.head: jvaranidānam

ab.seg:
atha jvaranidānam |
dakṣāpamānasaṅkruddharudraniḥśvāsasambhavaḥ |
jvaro 'ṣṭadhā pṛthagdvandvasaṅghātāgantujaḥ smṛtaḥ ||1||

atha sarvarogaprādhānyāt prathamaṃ jvaro vācyaḥ| prādhānyaṃ ca tasya śārīrarogeṣu prathamotpannatvāt, ‘balavattvācca, dehendriyamanastāpitvācca, janmanidhanayoravaśyambhāvitvācca,’ iti pā.| balavattvāt, dehendriyamanastāpitvāt, janmanidhanayor avaśyambhāvitvāt, sthāvarajaṅgamarūpasarvabhūtavyāpitvāc ca; naivam anye vikārāḥ| yad uktaṃ carake–
“dehendriyamanastāpī sarvarogāgrajo balī|
jvaraḥ pradhāno rogāṇām ukto bhagavatā purā|| tasya prāṇisapatnasya dhruvasya pralayodaye|” (ca. ci. a. 3) ity ādi; yāvad “bhagavan! vaktum arhasi” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| tathā– “jvareṇāviśatā bhūtaṃ na hi kiñcin na tapyate|” (ca. ci. a. 3) ity ādi| uktaṃ ca ‘vaidyake’ iti pā.|, pālakāpyaviracite hastyāyurvede mahārogasthāne navamādhyāye'yaṃ viṣayo gadyena paṭhyate| pālakāpye–
“pākalaḥ sa tu nāgānām abhitāpas tu vājinām|
gavām īśvarasañjñaś ca mānavānāṃ jvaro mataḥ||
ajāvīnāṃ pralāpākhyaḥ karabhe cālaso bhavet|
hāridro ‘mahiṣāṇām’ iti pā.| mahiṣīṇāṃ tu mṛgarogo mṛgeṣu ca|
pakṣiṇām abhighātas tu matsyeṣv indramado mataḥ|
pakṣapātaḥ pataṅgānāṃ vyāḍeṣv akṣikasañjñitaḥ||” ity ādi| tathā'nyatra– “jalasya nīlikā bhūmer ūṣaro vṛkṣasya koṭaraḥ|” ity ādi| tasya prāg utpattim āha– dakṣāpamānety ādi| dakṣāpamānena ‘dakṣaprayuktaparibhaveṇa’ iti pā.| dakṣaprayuktaparibhavena kruddhasya rudrasya niḥśvāsāt sambhava utpattir yasya sa tathā| niḥśvāso 'tra krodhaliṅgatvena nirdiṣṭaḥ, ata eva suśrutena “rudrakopāgnisambhūtaḥ” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) ity uktam| kruddhena rudreṇa lalāṭe tṛtīyam āgneyaṃ cakṣuḥ sṛṣṭvā tato 'py āgneyo ‘bāṇa’ iti pā., ‘bāṇe’ iti ca pā.| bāṇo nirmitaḥ| yad āha carakaḥ–
“sṛṣṭvā lalāṭe cakṣur vai dagdhvā tān asurān prabhuḥ
bāṇaṃ krodhāgnisantaptam asṛjac chatrunāśanam||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti; atra ‘atra satranāśanaṃ yajñanāśanam’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| atra satranāśanaṃ yajñanāśanam| eṣā ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca jvarotpattikathā carakacikitsite saviśeṣā ‘sāvaśeṣā’ iti pā.| śrotavyā| etena rudrakopasya viprakṛṣṭakāraṇatvam uktaṃ; yadi hi tato jvaro ‘nodapatat’ iti pā.| nodapatsyataṃ ‘nodapatsyate, utpannaśca tasmāt, tato rudrasantoṣārthaṃ japahomapūjāśivārcanādikaṃ kāryaṃ, tena sa na pīḍayiṣyati’ iti pā.| adhunā'py apacārān nodapatsyata iti bhaṭṭāraharicandraḥ| etadabhidhānasya cikitsānupayogitvenānye ṭīkākṛto 'nyathā vyācakṣate– kopodbhavatvena taijasatvaṃ prakāśyate; atra ‘krodho hyāgneyaḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| krodho hy āgneyaḥ; yad āha carakaḥ– “krodhāt pittaṃ” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| tena sarvajvare pittāvirodhinī kriyā kāryeti sidhyati| yad uktaṃ vāgbhaṭenaiva–
“ūṣmā pittād ṛte nāsti jvaro nāsty ūṣmaṇā vinā|
tasmāt pittaviruddhāni tyajet pittādhike 'dhikam||” (vā. ci. a. 1) iti| ata eva carake kaṭvamlalavaṇān pācanān parityajya taruṇajvare pācakatvena tiktako rasaḥ pittaghno nirdiṣṭaḥ| yad āha–
“laṅghanaṃ svedanaṃ kālo yavāgūs tiktako rasaḥ|
pācanāny avipakvānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ taruṇajvare||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| ( ( ) etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | kālo 'trāṣṭāha iti)| anye tv āhuḥ– rudrakopasambhavatvena devatātmakatvāt pūjārhatvam upadarśitam| yad āha videhaḥ– “jvaras tu pūjanair vā'pi sahasaivopaśāmyati||” iti| harivaṃśe 'pi–
“jvaras tripādas triśirāḥ ṣaḍbhujo navalocanaḥ|
‘mūrtimān harajo jñeyaḥ pāpināṃ nāśakārakaḥ|’ iti pā.| kvacitpustake uttarārdho na paṭhyate bhasmapraharaṇo raudraḥ kālāntakayamopamaḥ||” iti mūrtimān evoktaḥ| bahuvidham api jvaraṃ saṅkṣepeṇāha– jvaro 'ṣṭadhety ādi| aṣṭatvaṃ vivṛṇoti– pṛthag ity ādi| tac ca samprāptau vivṛtam||1||

atha sarvarogaprādhānyāt prathamaṃ jvaro vācyaḥ| prādhānyaṃ cāsya śārīrarogeṣu prathamotpannatvāt, balavattvād dehendriyamanastāpitvāc ca janmanidhanayor avaśyambhāvitvāc ca ‘sthāvarajaṅgamabhūtavyāpitvācca’ iti pā.| sthāvarajaṅgamarūpasarvabhūtavyāpitvāc ca, naivam anye vikārāḥ| uktaṃ ca carake–
“dehendriyamanastāpī sarvarogāgrajo balī|
jvaraḥ pradhāno rogāṇām ukto bhagavatā purā||” iti| tathā– “jvareṇāviśatā kvacitpustake ‘bhūtaṃ nahi kiñcinna tapyate’ etatsthāne ‘bhūtāni kāni na pacyanta’ iti pā.| bhūtaṃ na hi kiñcin na tapyate|” iti| uktaṃ ca gajavaidyake–
“pākalaḥ sa tu nāgānām abhitāpas tu vājinām|
gavām īśvarasañjñas tu mānavānāṃ jvaro mataḥ||
ajāvīnāṃ pralāpākhyaḥ karabheṣv alaso bhavet|
hāridro mahiṣāṇāṃ tu mṛgarogo mṛgeṣu ca||
pakṣiṇām abhighātas tu matsyeṣv indramado mataḥ|
pakṣaghātaḥ pataṅgānāṃ ‘sarpamāṃsātpaśūvyālau’ ityamaraḥ|, ‘vyāḍeṣvakṣikasañjñakaḥ’ iti pā.| vyāleṣv akṣikasañjñakaḥ||” ity ādi| tathā tantrāntare 'pi– “jalasya nīlikā, bhūmer ūṣaro, vṛkṣasya koṭaraḥ|” ity ādi| tasya prāg utpattim āha– ‘dakṣetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | dakṣety ādi| dakṣāpamānena dakṣaprayuktaparibhavena kruddhasya rudrasya niḥśvāsāt sambhava utpattir yasya sa tathā| niḥśvāso 'tra krodhaliṅgatvena nirdiṣṭaḥ| yathā suśrute– “rudrakopāgnisambhūtaḥ sarvabhūtapratāpanaḥ|” iti| kruddhena rudreṇa lalāṭe ‘tṛtīyamāgneyam’ iti pā.| tṛtīyakam āgneyaṃ cakṣuḥ spṛṣṭvā tato 'py āgneyo bāṇo nirmitaḥ| uktaṃ ca carake–
“ ‘spṛṣṭvā’ iti pā.| sṛṣṭvā lalāṭe cakṣur vai dagdhvā tān asurān prabhuḥ|
bāṇaṃ krodhāgnisantaptam asṛjac chatrutāpanam||” iti| etāvatā krodhodbhavatvena tasya taijasatvaṃ prakaśyate| tad uktaṃ carake– “krodhāt pittam” iti| tena sarvajvare pittāvirodhinī kriyā kāryeti sidhyati| yad uktaṃ vāgbhaṭe–
“ūṣmā pittād ṛte nāsti kvacitpustake ‘jvaro nāstyūṣmaṇā vinā’ etatsthāne ‘nātyūṣmāṇāṃ vinā jvaraḥ’ iti pā.| jvaro nāsty ūṣmaṇā vinā|
tasmāt pittaviruddhāni tyajet pittādhike 'dhikam||” iti| anye tv āhuḥ– rudrasambhavatvena devatātmakatvāt pūjārhatvam upadarśitam| yathāha videhaḥ– “jvaras tu pūjanair vā'pi sahasaivopaśāmyati|” iti| uktaṃ ca harivaṃśe 'pi–
“jvaras tripādas triśirāḥ ṣaḍbhujo navalocanaḥ|
bhasmapraharaṇo raudraḥ kālāntakayamopamaḥ||” iti mūrtimān evoktaḥ| bahuvidham api saṅkṣepeṇāha– jvaro 'ṣṭadheti| aṣṭadhātvaṃ vivṛṇoti pṛthak– vātikaḥ, paittikaḥ, ślaiṣmikaḥ, evaṃ trayaḥ; vātapaittikaḥ, vātaślaiṣmikaḥ, ‘śleṣmapaittikaḥ’ iti pā.| pittaślaiṣmikaḥ, evaṃ dvandvajās trayaḥ; sāṅghātikaḥ sānnipātika ekaḥ; āgantuja ekaḥ; evam aṣṭau jvarā iti||1||

lg.l: bahir nirasya koṣṭhāgniṃ jvaradāḥ syū rasānugāḥ ||2||

ab.seg:
samprāptim āha– mithyety ādi| āhārasya mithyātvaṃ prakṛtyādīnām āhāropayogahetūnāṃ viruddhatvenopayogaḥ| yad āha carakaḥ– "tatra khalv imāny aṣṭāv āhāravidhiviśeṣāyatanāni bhavanti; tad yathā– prakṛtikaraṇasaṃyogarāśideśakālopayogasaṃsthopayoktraṣṭamāni|" (ca. vi. a. 1) iti| atra prakṛtir dravyāṇāṃ svābhāvikagurutvalaghutvādiguṇayogaḥ, yathā– māṣamudgayoḥ; karaṇaṃ saṃskāraḥ, yathā– vrīher guror laghavo lājāḥ; saṃyogaḥ saṃhatībhāvaḥ, yathā– kṣīramatsyayoḥ; ‘rāśirāhāradravyasyāvayavena’ iti pā.| rāśir āhārasya dravādravasyāvayavena samudāyena vā parimāṇaṃ; deśo dravyotpattipracārādisthānaṃ; kālo nityagaś cāvasthikaś ca; upayogasaṃsthā upayoganiyamaḥ, yathā– jīrṇānna eva bhuñjīta; upayoktā svayaṃ nirūpitātmaprakṛtyādikaḥ puruṣa iti| vihārasya mithyātvam ayathābalam ārambhādi| āmāśayāśrayā ity anenāmāśayaprāptivyatirekeṇa doṣā jvaraṃ nārabhanta iti pratipādayanti| āmāśayaś ca “nābhistanāntaraṃ jantor āmāśaya iti smṛtaḥ|” (ca. vi. a. 2) iti carakeṇoktaḥ| bahir nirasya koṣṭhāgnim iti koṣṭhāgnir eva ‘doṣairākṣipto’ iti pā.| doṣotkṣipto bahir nirgata ūṣmatayā pratibhāti| koṣṭhāgnim iti ‘dhātvagninirāsārtham’ iti pā.| dhātvādyagninirāsārtham| jvaradā jvarakāriṇaḥ| rasānugā rasasambaddhāḥ, avaśyaṃ rasaṃ dūṣayitvā jvarotpādakā iti| ‘eṣā ca samprāptiḥ śārīrāṇām eva na tv āgantūnāṃ, teṣāṃ vyathāpūrvakatvaṃ tato vātādyanubandhaḥ,’ iti jejjaṭaḥ| ata eva suśrute āgantusamprāptiḥ pṛthag eva paṭhyate| yathā–
“śramakṣatābhighātebhyo dehināṃ kupito 'nilaḥ|
pūrayitvā'khilaṃ dehaṃ jvaram āpādayed bhṛśam||’ (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti| atra na āmāśayagata eva vāyuḥ, kintūrdhvādhastiryagrasavāhisrotaścaraḥ| carake 'py uktam–
“tatrābhighātajo vāyuḥ prāyo raktaṃ pradūṣayan|
savyathāśothavaivarṇyaṃ karoti sarujaṃ jvaram||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| nanu, āgantujvare 'py ūṣmopalabhyate, “ūṣmā ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca pittād ṛte nāsti” (vā. ci. a. 1) ity uktam, ata āgantur api śārīraḥ syāt| naivam, uttarakālaṃ tadutpatteḥ| yad uktam– “āgantur hi vyathāpūrvo jvaro 'ṣṭamo bhavati; sa kiñcitkālam āgantuḥ kevalo bhūtvā ‘āganturhi vyathāpūrvo jāyate, paścānnijairdoṣairanubadhyate’ iti pā.| paścād doṣair anubadhyate|” (ca. ni. a. 1); tathā– “āgantur anveti nijaṃ vikāraṃ nijas tathā''gantum api pravṛddhaḥ|” (ca. sū. a. 19) iti| nanu, mithyāhārety ādinā ekaiva samprāptir uktā; etac ca na yuktaṃ, yataḥ samprāptiḥ saṃyogabhedaḥ, saṃyogabhedaś ca saṃyogibhedanibandhanaḥ, saṃyoginaś cātra vātādayo nānāvidhāḥ, ‘ataḥ’ iti pā.| tataś ca samprāpter api nānātvaṃ syāt; na hi vātapittayor yaḥ saṃyogaḥ sa eva kaphapittayor iti| ucyate– anekaiva samprāptiḥ kintv ekajātīyā, āśayaduṣṭyādeḥ sarvatrāviśeṣeṇābhidhānāt; evam āgantusamprāptir api saṃyogabhedād bhinneti||2||

jvarasya samprāptim āha– mithyāhārety ādi|
“akāle cātimātraṃ ca asātmyaṃ yac ca bhojanam|
‘viṣamāśanaṃ ca yadbhuktam’ iti pā., viṣamāśanaṃ ca yaccoktam’ iti ca pā.| viṣamaṃ cāpi yad bhuktaṃ mithyāhāraḥ sa ucyate||” iti| mithyāhāro deśakālaprakṛtyādiviruddhaḥ, saṃyogaviruddhaś ca kṣīramatsyayor iva| ‘mithyāvihāro'yathābalamārambhaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | mithyāvihāro 'yathābalam ārambhaḥ|
“aśaktaḥ kurute karma śaktimātraṃ karoti yaḥ|
mithyāvihāra ity uktaḥ sadā ‘caiva vivarjayet’ iti pā.| taṃ parivarjayet||” iti| īdṛśasya puruṣasya āmāśayāśrayā doṣā vātapittaśleṣmāṇaḥ koṣṭhāgniṃ bahir nirasya jvaradāḥ syuḥ jvarakāriṇo bhaveyuḥ ‘āmāśayasthānamuktaṃ carake’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | āmāśayasthānam uktaṃ carake– “nābhistanāntaraṃ jantor āmāśaya iti smṛtaḥ||” iti| kiṃviśiṣṭāḥ? rasānugāḥ rasasambaddhāḥ rasaṃ dūṣayitvā jvarotpādakā iti| koṣṭhāgnim iti dhātvagninirāsārtham| eṣā ca samprāptiḥ śārīrāṇām eva na tv āgantūnām| teṣāṃ tu vyathāpūrvako vātādyanubandhaḥ| uktaṃ ca suśrute, yathā–
“ ‘śramaḥ kṣatābhighātebhyo’ iti pā.| śramakṣatābhighātebhyo dehinaḥ kupito 'nilaḥ|
pūrayitvā'khilaṃ dehaṃ jvaram āpādayed bhṛśam||” iti| uktaṃ ca carake–
“tatrābhighātajo vāyuḥ prāyo raktaṃ pradūṣayan|
savyathāśothavaivarṇyaṃ karoti sarujaṃ jvaram||” iti| nanv āgantur api śārīraḥ syāt, ‘yathā āgantujvare coṣmā upalabhyate’ iti pā.| yata āgantujvare 'py ūṣmopalabhyate, ūṣmā ca pittād ṛte nāstīty uktam| maivam, ‘āgantujvara’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | āgantujvara uttarakāle tadutpattiḥ| yad uktam– “āgantur hi vyathāpūrvo jāyate paścān nijair doṣair anubadhyate|” iti| ‘tathā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tathā “āgantur abhyeti nijaṃ vikāraṃ nijas tathā''gantum api pravṛddhaḥ|” iti||2||

lg.l: yugapad yatra roge ca sa jvaro vyapadiśyate ||3||

ab.seg: jvaralakṣaṇam āha– svedāvarodha ity ādi| svedāvarodho gharmānirgamaḥ| tāpa iti ‘kartavye’ iti pā.| vaktavye santāpagrahaṇād dehendriyamanasāṃ tāpaṃ lakṣayati| tad uktaṃ carake– “dehendriyamanastāpī” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti; agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | “indriyāṇāṃ ca vaikṛtyaṃ jñeyaṃ santāpalakṣaṇam|” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| tathā– “vaicittyam aratir glānir manaḥsantāpalakṣaṇam|” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| sarvāṅgagrahaṇaṃ sarvāṅgavedanā| yugapad iti militam etal lakṣaṇaṃ, pratyekaśo vyabhicārāt; svedāvarodho hi kuṣṭhapūrvarūpe, tathā santāpo dāhākhye ‘dāhākhyo rogaḥ’ iti pā.| roge, sarvāṅgagrahaṇaṃ sarvāṅgavātaroge iti| nanu, paittike svedāgamāt, vātike ‘viṣamārambhavisargitvena’ iti pā.| viṣamārambhavisargitvāt sarvāṅgagrahaṇāvyavasthiteś cāvyāpakaṃ lakṣaṇam iti| atra jejjaṭakārtikakuṇḍādayaḥ samādadhuḥ– utsargāpavādabhāvena vyavasthitir iti| tan na saṅgatam ity anye; vidhau ‘utsargāpavādabhāvo’ iti pā.| hy utsargāpavādabhāvo na tu lakṣaṇe, avyāptyativyāptyor lakṣaṇadoṣāt; tasmāt svedo 'gniḥ ‘svidyate 'nena’ iti vyutpattyā; tasyāvarodho doṣavyāptiḥ| vātajvare yady api vāyoś calatvenārambhavisargayor vaiṣamyaṃ, tathā'pi ‘sarvadehagatajvarārambhakadoṣadūṣyānuvṛtteḥranudbhūtasarvāṅgagrahaṇasya’ iti pā.| sarvadehagatajvarārambhakadoṣaduṣṭyanivṛtter anudbhūtasarvāṅgagrahaṇasya vidyamānataiveti na vyabhicāraḥ| carake tu jvaralakṣaṇaṃ “ ‘jvarapratyāyakam’ iti pā.| ‘jvarapratyātmakam’ iti ca pā.| jvarapratyātmikaṃ liṅgaṃ santāpo dehamānasaḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| nanu, “śārīro jāyate pūrvaṃ dehe manasi mānasaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| carakavacanād dehamanasor anyonyavyabhicārād alakṣaṇam iti cet; tan na, sūkṣmatarakālavyavahitasyānyatararūpasyāvaśyambhāvitvāt| yathā– ‘guṇavaddravyam’ iti pā.| guṇavad dravyam iti dravyalakṣaṇam iti||3||

jvaralakṣaṇam āha– (yatra yasmin roge, yugapad ekakāle, īdṛśalakṣaṇaṃ dṛśyate sa jvaraḥ kathyate|) svedāvarodhaḥ svedānirgamaḥ, anye paittike svedāvagamāl lakṣaṇe vyabhicāraḥ, tena svedo 'gniḥ ‘svidyate 'nena’ iti vyutpattyā, tasyāvarodho doṣavyāptiḥ| kvacitpustake ‘santāpetyatra saṃśabdo dehendriyamanasāṃ tāpaṃ’ etatsthāne ‘santāpaḥ saśabdāddehendriyamanasaḥ santāpaṃ’ iti pā.| santāpety atra saṃśabdo dehendriyamanasāṃ tāpaṃ lakṣayati| sarvāṅgagrahaṇaṃ sarvāṅgavedanety āhuḥ| svedāvarodha ity atra ‘vegoparodha’ ity anye paṭhanti| tatra vegoparodho vātamūtrapurīṣādīnām anirgamanaṃ; tad ayuktam, pittajvare purīṣādīnāṃ nirgamanena tatrā'vyāpteḥ||3||

div.ab:
śramo 'ratir vivarṇatvaṃ vairasyaṃ nayanaplavaḥ |
icchādveṣau muhuś cāpi śītavātātapādiṣu ||4||
jṛmbhā'ṅgamardo gurutā romaharṣo 'rucis tamaḥ |
apraharṣaś ca śītaṃ ca bhavaty utpatsyati jvare ||5||
(sāmānyato viśeṣāt tu jṛmbhā'tyarthaṃ samīraṇāt |
pittān nayanayor dāhaḥ ‘kaphānnānnābhinandanam’ ityātaṅkadarpaṇasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ kaphād annārucir bhavet ||6|| ‘dvayordvayostu rūpeṇa saṃsṛṣṭaṃ dvandvajaṃ viduḥ’ iti mudritasuśrutapustake pāṭhaḥ
rūpair anyatarābhyāṃ tu saṃsṛṣṭair dvandvajaṃ viduḥ |
sarvaliṅgasamavāyaḥ sarvadoṣaprakopaje) ||7|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

ab.seg: pūrvarūpam āha– śrama ity ādi| śramaḥ śrāntatvam iva| aratir anavasthitacittatvam, ‘aratiḥ krīḍābhāva iti’ ityasya sthāne ‘krīḍābhāvo'ratiriti’ iti pā.| aratiḥ krīḍābhāva iti kārtikaḥ| vivarṇatvaṃ mlānagātratvam| yat tu ‘‘duṣṭāḥ svahetubhir doṣāḥ’’ ity ārabhya “svakāleṣu jvarāgamam| janayanty atha ‘buddhim’ iti pā.| vṛddhiṃ ca svavarṇaṃ ca tvagādiṣu||” (su. ci. a. 39) iti samprāptau vṛddhasuśrutavacanaṃ, tad atyarthajṛmbhādivad viśiṣṭapūrvarūpābhiprāyeṇa, samprāptyavasthāpannadoṣajanyatvāt pūrvarūpasyeti| vairasyam iti ‘mukhasya viruddharasatā’ ityasya sthāne ‘viruddhamukharasatā’ iti pā.| mukhasya viruddharasatā| nayanaplavo 'śrupūrṇanetratvam| yad uktaṃ carake– " ‘gauravam’ iti pā.| ālasyaṃ nayane sāsre" (ca. ci. a. 3) ity ādi| ādiśabdād ambujvalanayor api aniścitecchādveṣayor grahaṇam| uktaṃ hi carake– ‘‘jvalanātapavāyvambubhaktidveṣāv aniścitau|’’ (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| anye tu śaityauṣṇyasādharmyāj jalānalau grāhayanti, ādiśabdena ‘tu śayanāsanādikam’ iti pā.| ca śayanādikam| tamo 'ndhakārapraviṣṭasyevāsaṃvittiḥ| apraharṣaḥ prītyabhāvaḥ| jvalanecchayā śīte labdhe śītaṃ ceti vacanaṃ ‘śītasya viśeṣeṇa bodhanārtham’ ityasya sthāne ‘viśeṣeṇa śītabodhanārtham’ iti pā.| śītasya viśeṣeṇa bodhanārtham| cakāreṇa ‘bālapradveṣādigrahaṇamityāhuḥ’ iti pā.| vātavidveṣādigrahaṇam ity āhuḥ| utpatsyatīti bhaviṣyati jvare| utpatsyatīti ātmanepadānityatvena; tac ca cakṣiṅa ikāreṇa ‘ ‘anudāttaṅita ātmanepadam’ ityasya sthāne ‘anudāttenātmanepade’ iti pā.| anudāttaṅita ātmanepadam’ (pā. a. 1/3/12) ity ātmanepade siddhe tadarthaṃ ṅitkaraṇena jñāpitam iti śābdikāḥ| gadādharas tu– ‘utpitsati’ iti paṭhitvā ‘pada gatau’ ‘ityasyaiva’ iti pā.| ity asya sannantasya ‘ ‘sanimimīmāghurabhalabhaśakapatapadām’ iti pā.| sani mīmāghurabhalabhaśakapatapadām|’ (a. 7 pā. 4 sū. 54) ity ādinā ‘is bhāve’ iti pā.| isi kṛte ‘pūrvavat ‘san’ iti pā.| sanaḥ’ (a. 1 pā. 3 sū. 62) ity atra bhinnavākyatayā parasmaipadam iti vyācaṣṭe iti||4-7||

pūrvarūpam āha– śrama ity ādi| śrāntatvam iva śramaḥ| aratir anavasthitacittatvam, aratiḥ krīḍābhāva ity apare| vivarṇatvaṃ malinagātratā| vairasyaṃ mukhasya, virasatā viruddharasatā| nayanaplavaḥ aśrupūrṇanetratvam| śītavātātapādiṣu viṣayeṣu icchādveṣau abhilāṣavidveṣau| ādiśabdād ambujvalanayor grahaṇam| uktaṃ hi carake– “jvalanātapavāyvambubhaktidveṣāv aniścitau” iti| anye tu śaityauṣṇyāsādharmyāj jalānalau gṛhṇanti| te tv ādiśabdena śayanādikaṃ manyante|| jṛmbheti jṛmbhā jṛmbhaṇam| aṅgamardo 'ṅgamoṭanam| gurutā gātrāṇām| romaharṣo romāñcaḥ| arucir bhojye| tamaḥ andhakārapraviṣṭasyevārthāsaṃvittiḥ| apraharṣaḥ ānandābhāvaḥ| śītam iti śītādau muhur icchādveṣāv iti siddhe punar api śītavacanaṃ viśeṣeṇa śītaprādurbhāvadarśanārtham| utpatsyati bhāvini jvare etāni lakṣaṇāni bhavanti| kvacitpustake ‘atra tu mādhavena sāmānyapūrvalakṣaṇaṃ suśrutoktaṃ likhitaṃ, natu viśiṣṭaṃ pūrvarūpalakṣaṇaṃ; taccāsmābhirihaiva likhyate– sāmānyata ityādi| sāmānyata iti pūrvapadyena sambadhyate|’ etatsthāne ‘sāmānyamiti’ iti pā.| atra tu mādhavena sāmānyapūrvalakṣaṇaṃ suśrutoktaṃ likhitaṃ, na tu viśiṣṭaṃ pūrvarūpalakṣaṇaṃ; tac cāsmābhir ihaiva likhyate– sāmānyata ity ādi| sāmānyata iti pūrvapadyena sambadhyate| bhāvini vātike jvare 'tyarthaṃ jṛmbhā, paittike nayanayor dāhaḥ, kaphaje nānnābhinandanam iti na annābhilāṣaḥ||4-7||

div.ab:
vepathur viṣamo vegaḥ kaṇṭhauṣṭhapariśoṣaṇam |
nidrānāśaḥ ‘kṣutaḥ stambhaḥ’ iti ḍalhaṇasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ kṣavastambho gātrāṇāṃ raukṣyam eva ca ||8|| ‘śiroruk gātraruk gātrarugvaktravairasyaṃ gāḍhaviṭkatā’ iti pā.; “śirasaḥ pṛthagupādānamatyarthaṃ śirasi sā bhavatīti jñāpanārtham, anyathā gātrarugityanenaiva tatprāpteḥ” iti suśrutaṭīkāyāṃ ḍalhaṇaḥ
śirohṛdgātrarug vaktravairasyaṃ gāḍhaviṭkatā |
śūlādhmāne jṛmbhaṇaṃ ca bhavanty anilaje jvare ||9|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

ab.seg:
vātapittakaphānāṃ yathāpūrvaṃ bhūridāruṇavikārakartṛtvena prādhānyaṃ, yad uktaṃ carake– ‘‘aśītir vātavikārāś catvāriṃśat pittavikārāḥ, viṃśatiḥ śleṣmavikārāḥ|’’ (ca. sū. a. 20) iti; tathā dāruṇāś ca vātavikārā ākṣepakapakṣāghātādayaḥ; ataḥ prādhānyāt prathamaṃ vātajvaralakṣaṇam āha– vepathur ity ādi| evam anyatrāpi vātādikramanirdeśena ‘boddhavyam’ iti pā.| veditavyam| viṣamo vega iti vego jvarasya pravṛttir vṛddhir vā, tasya vaiṣamyam aniyatakālatvam, aṅgeṣu cauṣṇyādyaniyatatvam| kṣavaś chikkā ‘ atra ‘hā~ṃci’ iti loke’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| hā~ṃci’ iti loke| stambho gātrāṇāṃ jaḍimā, raukṣyam api gātrāṇām eveti gadādharādayo vyācakṣate; tac cānavadhānād vyākhyātam iti lakṣyate; kṣavasya stambhaḥ kṣavastambha ity ekapadatā'tra yujyate| yad āha vāgbhaṭaḥ–
‘‘harṣo romāṅgadanteṣu vepathuḥ kṣavathor grahaḥ|
bhramaḥ pralāpo gharmecchā vilāpaś cānilajvare||’’(vā. ni. a. 2) iti| carake 'pi nidāne ‘‘kṣavathūdgāravinigrahaḥ’’ (ca. ni. a. 1) ‘ityeva’ iti pā.| iti paṭhitam| vinigrahaśabdas tu tatra nirodhārtha evācāryeṇa nirdiṣṭaḥ; yathā vātagulmanidāne– “rūkṣānnapānaṃ viṣamātimātraṃ viceṣṭitaṃ vegavinigrahaś ca|” (ca. ci. a. 5) iti; tathā'ntarvegajvaralakṣaṇe “doṣavarcovinigrahaḥ” (ca. ci. a. 3) ‘ityevaṃ paṭhitam’ iti pā.| iti| etena, jvaramuktilakṣaṇe kṣavasya ‘bhāvāt’ iti pā.| pāṭhāt ‘kathamatra lakṣaṇatvam’ iti pā.| katham etal lakṣaṇam iti yad āśaṅkitaṃ kārtikakuṇḍena tad api nirastam| ādhmānaṃ vāyunā savedanam udarapūrṇatvam| ‘śirohṛdgātrarugityatra’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śirohṛdgātrarug ity atra gātragrahaṇena śirohṛdgrahaṇe siddhe tadabhidhānaṃ viśeṣeṇa śirasi hṛdi ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca vedanārtham| etāni rūpāṇi prāyobhāvitvena nirdiṣṭāni suśrutena, tena cakāreṇānyāny api carakanidānoktāni boddhavyāni| tāny eva gadyenoktāni sukhagrahaṇārthaṃ ślokena mayā pradarśyante–
“bhavanti vividhā vātavedanāḥ pādasuptatā|
piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ karṇasvano vaktrakaṣāyatā||
ūrusādo hanustambho viśleṣaḥ sandhijānunoḥ|
śuṣkakāso vamir lomadantaharṣaḥ śramabhramau|| aruṇaṃ netramūtrādi tṛṭpralāpoṣṇakāmitāḥ|” iti||8-9||

vātapittakaphānāṃ yathāpūrvaṃ bhūridāruṇavikārakartṛtvena vāyoḥ prādhānyam atas tatprādhānyāt prathamaṃ vātajvaralakṣaṇam āha– ‘vepathurityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vepathur ity ādi| vepathuḥ kampaḥ| viṣamo vego jvarasya hīnādhikabhāvena, aṅgeṣu coṣmādyaniyatatvam| kaṇṭhauṣṭhapariśoṣaṇam iti sugamam| tathā kṣavastambhaḥ kṣavaḥ chikkā tasyāḥ stambho 'nirgamanam| kvacitpustake ‘kecittu ‘kṣavaḥ stambhaḥ’ iti bhinnaṃ padaṃ paṭhanti, tanmate kṣavaḥ chikkā, stambho gātrāṇāmiti vyākhyānayanti; tanna yuktam| yaduktaṃ vāgbhaṭe– “harṣo romāṅgadanteṣu vepathuḥ kṣavathorgrahaḥ| bhramaḥ pralāpo gharmecchā viramaścānilajvare” iti|’ etatsthāne ‘kecittu kṣava iti bhinnaṃ padaṃ paṭhanti, tanmate kṣavaḥ chikkā, stambho gātrāṇāṃ śarīre namanābhāvaḥ ityādilakṣaṇamanilajvare iti|’ iti pā.| kecit tu ‘kṣavaḥ stambhaḥ’ iti bhinnaṃ padaṃ paṭhanti, tanmate kṣavaḥ chikkā, stambho gātrāṇām iti vyākhyānayanti; tan na yuktam| yad uktaṃ vāgbhaṭe–
“harṣo romāṅgadanteṣu vepathuḥ kṣavathor grahaḥ|
bhramaḥ pralāpo gharmecchā viramaś cānilajvare||” iti| carake 'pi nidāne– “kṣavathūdgāravinigrahaḥ” iti| ‘nigrahaśabdastannirodhārtha’ iti pā.| vinigrahaśabdas tu nirodhārtha eva, yathā'ntarvegajvaralakṣaṇe “doṣavarcovinigrahaḥ” ity evaṃ paṭhitaḥ| raukṣyaṃ gātrāṇām eva| cakārāt kṛṣṇaviṇmūtranetratvaṃ samuccīyate| anye tu “raukṣyam eva ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca” ity atra sthāne “śyāvāṅgamalamūtratā” iti paṭhanti| ‘nanvatra’ iti pā.| atra gātragrahaṇena śirograhaṇe siddhe tadabhidhānaṃ viśeṣeṇa śirasi hṛdi vedanādarśanārthaṃ; śirasi hṛdi gātreṣu ruk pīḍā| vairasyaṃ virasatā| gāḍhaviṭkatā baddhamalatā| śūlādhmāne ‘udaraśūlam’ iti pā.| śūlam udaraśūlam, ādhmānaṃ vāyunā savedanam udarapūrṇatvam ity arthaḥ| jṛmbhaṇaṃ jṛmbhābāhulyam| anilaje jvare etāni lakṣaṇāni bhavanti| etāni ‘prakṛtisamavetāni’ iti pā.| prakṛtisamasamavetāni||8-9||

div.ab:
vegas tīkṣṇo 'tisāraś ca nidrālpatvaṃ tathā vamiḥ |
kaṇṭhauṣṭhamukhanāsānāṃ pākaḥ svedaś ca jāyate ||10||
pralāpo vaktrakaṭutā mūrchā dāho madas tṛṣā |
pītaviṇmūtranetratvaṃ paittike bhrama eva ca ||11|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

ab.seg:
pittajvaralakṣaṇam āha– vegas tīkṣṇa ity ādi| atisāraḥ pittasya saratvena sadravā pravṛttir na tv atisāra eva, tasya jvaropadravatvāt| nidrālpatvaṃ ‘alpanidrātvam’ iti pā.| svalpanidrātvam| uktaṃ hi suśrute– “nidrānāśo 'nilāt pittāt” (su. śā. a. 4) ity ādi| vamiḥ pittasya ‘kaphasthānagatatvāt’ iti pā.| kaphasthānagamanāt| svedo gharmāgamanaṃ, prāyeṇa sāmadoṣeṇa srotasāṃ nirodhāt sarvajvareṣu gharmanirodhaḥ, atra tu pittasya taikṣṇyāj jvaraprabhāvād vā sa na bhavatīti| pralāpo 'sambaddhabhāṣaṇam| vaktrakaṭutā mukhatiktatvaṃ, carake hi ‘paittikanānātmajacatvāriṃśadvikāramadhye’ iti pā.| paittikanānātmajacatvāriṃśadvikāreṣu tiktāsyatāyāḥ pāṭhād anubhavāc ca| kārtikas tv arocake “kaṭvamlamuṣṇaṃ virasaṃ ca pūti pittena vidyāl lavaṇaṃ ca vaktram|” (ca. ci. a. 26) iti vacanaṃ ‘paṭhitvā, tadupanyasya’ iti pā.| dṛṣṭāntam upanyasya kaṭumukhatvam apīcchati| tan na, tatrāpi sandehāt| yad uktam– “kaṭu syāt kaṭutiktayoḥ|” iti| tasmāt
“yo 'mlaṃ bhṛśoṣṇaṃ kaṭutiktavaktraḥ pītaṃ saraktaṃ haritaṃ vamed vā|
sadāhacoṣajvaravaktraśoṣaṃ sā pittakopaprabhavā hi chardiḥ||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 49) iti suśrutavacanāt kaṭumukhatvam apy eṣṭavyam iti| mūrcheti mūrchā rūpādyavijñānaṃ, tamaḥpraveśo vismṛtir ity āhuḥ| mado mattatvam iva, yathā– pūgakodravadhattūrabhakṣaṇādau| atra ‘bhrama iti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| bhrama iti bhramaś cakrasthitasyeva bhramadvastudarśanam ity āhuḥ; anye tu svadehabhramaṇajñānam| nanu, bhramasyāśītivātavikārapaṭhitasya vātanānātmajatvāt kathaṃ pittavikāre pāṭhaḥ? ucyate, “na rogo 'py ekadoṣajaḥ|” iti vacanāt ‘paittike'pi’ iti pā.| paittike vātānubandhāt bhramaḥ, iti jejjaṭaḥ samādhānam uktavān| athavā doṣadūṣyasammūrchanaprabhāvāt ‘kāraṇādṛṣṭadoṣasyāpi’ iti pā.| kāraṇādṛṣṭasyāpi rūpasya kārya upalambhaḥ; ‘yathā’ iti kvacitpustakeṣu na paṭhyate| yathā– arūpavātārabdhātisārādāv ivāruṇatvaṃ, ‘...saṃyogato yathā’ iti pā.| haridrācūrṇasaṃyoga iva lauhityam| yat tūktaṃ suśrute– “rajaḥpittānilād bhramaḥ|” (su. śā. a. 4) iti, tatrāpi vātānugatapittajatvam eva boddhavyam, anyathā bhramasya vātikanānātmajatvam eva na syād iti| apare tu pittadūṣitanetratvena viparyastajñānaṃ ‘bhramaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhramaḥ, ‘pītaḥ śaṅkha’ ity ādivat| cakāraḥ pūrvavad anuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tad yathā– tīvroṣmatā ‘raktakoṭhatā’ iti pā.| raktakoṭhāḥ śītecchatā'rucir iti||10-11||

paittikam āha– ‘vega ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vega ity ādi| vegas tīkṣṇas tīvravegaḥ| atīsāra iti pittasya ‘saratvena’ iti pā.| saratyena sadravā pravṛtir na tv atīsāraḥ, tasya jvaropadravatvāt| nidrālpatvaṃ svalpanidrātvam| vamiḥ pittasya kaphasthānagatatvāt| kaṇṭhauṣṭhamukhanāsānāṃ pāka iti sugamam| svedo gharmāmbunirgamanam| prāyeṇa sāmajvare svedanirodhaḥ, atra tu pittasya taikṣṇyāj jvaraprabhāvād vā sa na bhavati| pralāpo 'sambaddhabhāṣaṇam| vaktrakaṭutā mukhatiktatvam| yad uktam abhidhānāntare– “kaṭuḥ syāt kaṭutiktayoḥ|” iti| yad uktaṃ suśrute– “ ‘yo'mlam’ iti pā.| yo
'malaṃ ‘bhṛśaṃ vā’ iti pā.| bhṛśoṣṇaṃ kaṭutiktavaktraḥ pītaṃ saraktaṃ haritaṃ vamed vā|
sadāhaśoṣajvaravaktraśoṣaṃ sā pittakopaprabhavā hi chardiḥ||” iti suśrutavacanāt kaṭumukhatvam apy eṣṭavyam iti| mūrchā rūpādyaparijñānaṃ tamaḥpraveśo vismṛtir ity āhuḥ| mado mattatvam iva, yathā pūgaduṣṭakodravadhattūrabhakṣaṇādau| bhrama iti cakrasthitasyeva sambhramād vastudarśanam āhuḥ, anye tu svadehabhramaṇajñānam| nanu bhramasya aśītivātavikārapaṭhitasya ‘nānalajatvāt’ iti pā.| nānātmajatvāt kathaṃ pittavikāre pāṭhaḥ? ucyate– ‘na rogo 'py ekadoṣajaḥ’ iti vacanāt, athavā doṣadūṣyasammūrchanaprabhāvāt| yad uktaṃ suśrute– “rajaḥpittānilād bhramaḥ” iti| apare tu pittadūṣitanetratvena viparyastajñānaṃ bhramaḥ pītaḥ śaṅkha ity ādivat| ‘tṛṣāpītaviṇmūtranetratvam’ iti pā.| pītaviṇmūtranetratvam iti sugamam| paittike jvare etāni lakṣaṇāni bhavanti||10-11||

div.ab:
staimityaṃ stimito vega ālasyaṃ madhurāsyatā |
śuklamūtrapurīṣatvaṃ stambhas tṛptir athāpi ca ||12||
(nātyuṣṇagātratā chardir aṅgasādo 'vipākitā) |
gauravaṃ śītam utkledo romaharṣo 'tinidratā |
( ātaṅkadarpaṇasammato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ| srotorodho rugalpatvaṃ praseko lavaṇāsyatā |
nātyuṣṇagātratā, cchardir lālāsrāvo 'vipākatā) |
pratiśyāyo 'ruciḥ kāsaḥ kaphaje 'kṣṇoś ca śuklatā ||13|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

ab.seg: kaphajvaralakṣaṇam āha– staimityam ity ādi| staimityam aṅgānām ārdrapaṭāvaguṇṭhitatvam iva| stimito vego mando vegaḥ| ālasyam iti “samarthasyāpy anutsāhaḥ karmaṇy ālasyam ucyate|” (su. śā. a. 4) ity ālasyalakṣaṇam āhuḥ| stambho 'ṅgastabdhatā| tṛptis tṛptasyevānnānabhilāṣaḥ| utkledaḥ ‘upasthitavamanatvamiva’ iti pāṭh.| kaṇṭhopasthitavamanatvam iva| arucir atra ‘satyabhilāṣe’ iti pā.| saty apy abhilāṣe abhyavahārāsāmarthyam iti bhedaḥ| cakāraḥ pūrvavat| tena “tathā'ṅge pīḍakāḥ śītāḥ prasekaś charditandrike| hṛdupalepa uṣṇābhilāṣitā vahnimārdavam||” iti||12-13||

atha ślaiṣmikam āha– ‘staimityamityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | staimityam ity ādi| ‘staimityamaṅgānāmārdravastrāvaguṇṭhitamiva’ iti pā.| staimityam aṅgānām ārdravastrāvaguṇṭhitatvam iva| stimito vego mandavegaḥ| ālasyaṃ “yaḥ śaktasyāpy anutsāhaḥ karmaṇy ālasyam ucyate|” iti| madhurāsyatā madhuravaktratvam| mūtrapurīṣayoḥ śauklyam| ‘aṅgastabdhatā’ iti pā.| stambho 'ṅgastabdhatā| tṛptiḥ tṛptasevānnānabhilāṣaḥ| gauravaṃ gurugātratā| śītaṃ śītāvirbhāvaḥ| utkledaḥ upasthitavamanatvam iva, apare ‘śleṣmaniṣṭhīvanamiva’ iti pā.| śleṣmaniṣṭhīvanam| romaharṣo romāñcaḥ| atinidratā nidrādhikyam| pratiśyāyaḥ nāsāsravaṇam| aruciḥ astra saty apy abhilāṣe 'bhyavahārāsāmarthyam iti tṛptito bhedaḥ| srotorodho rasavāhināṃ srotasāṃ rodhaḥ| kāsaḥ prasiddhaḥ| avipākatā annāvipākaḥ| cakāraḥ pūrvavad anuktasamuccayārthaḥ, kaphaje jvare etāni lakṣaṇāni bhavanti||12-13||

div.ab:
tṛṣṇā mūrchā bhramo dāhaḥ svapnanāśaḥ śirorujā |
kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣo vamathū romaharṣo 'rucis tamaḥ ||14||
parvabhedaś ca jṛmbhā ca vātapittajvarākṛtiḥ |15| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

vātapittajvaralakṣaṇam āha– tṛṣṇety ādi| parvāṇi bhidyanta iva ‘parvabhedaḥ parvavedanā’ iti pā.| vedanā parvabhedaḥ| etāni ca liṅgāni vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhasya boddhavyāni| vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhatvaṃ caiṣāṃ kevalavātikapaittikajvaralakṣaṇānāṃ madhye keṣāñcid eva niyamena pāṭhāt tadatiriktalakṣaṇapāṭhāc ca boddhavyam| yathā– atraiva vātapaittike 'ruciromaharṣau, vakṣyamāṇavātaślaiṣmike ‘svedaḥ santāpaśca’ ityasya sthāne ‘santāpaḥ, iti kārtikaḥ’ iti pā.| svedaḥ santāpaś ca, evaṃ ‘kaphapittaje’ iti pā.| kaphapaittike anavasthitaśītadāhau, evaṃ sannipātaje sāsrakaluṣādinetratvaṃ ‘śirasoloṭhanādi’ iti pā.| śiroloṭhanādi| ‘prakṛtisamasamavete’ iti pā.| prakṛtisamavāyārabdhe tu vātajādijvaraliṅgāny eva samastāni katipayāni vā bhavanti| ata eva cikitsite carakaḥ vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhānāṃ dvandvasannipātajvarāṇāṃ lakṣaṇāni sākṣāt paṭhitvā nidānasthānoktavātādijvaraliṅgātideśena prakṛtisamasamavetānāṃ ‘dvandvasannipātajvarāṇām’ iti kvacitpustakeṣu na paṭhyate| dvandvasannipātajvarāṇāṃ lakṣaṇam uktavān| yad āha–
“nidāne trividhā proktā yā ‘pṛthaktve jvarākṛtiḥ’ iti pā.| pṛthagjajvarākṛtiḥ|
saṃsargasannipātānāṃ tathā coktaṃ svalakṣaṇam||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| evaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ dvandvasannipātalakṣaṇaṃ vyākhyeyam| prakṛtisamasamavāyavikṛtiviṣamasamavāyayoś cāyam arthaḥ– prakṛtyā hetubhūtayā samaḥ kāraṇānurūpaḥ samavāyaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvasambandhaḥ prakṛtisamasamavāyaḥ, kāraṇānurūpaṃ kāryam ity arthaḥ; yathā– śuklatantusamavāyārabdhasya paṭasya śuklatvam| vikṛtyā hetubhūtayā viṣamaḥ kāraṇānanurūpaḥ samavāyo vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyaḥ, yathā– ‘haridrācūrṇasaṃyoge’ iti pā.| haridrācūrṇasaṃyogajaṃ lauhityam iti||14||– ‘atha vāta ... tṛṣṇetyādi’ ityasya sthāne ‘idānīṃ dvandvajajvaramāha|’ iti pā.|

atha vātapittajajvaralakṣaṇam āha– tṛṣṇety ādi| tṛṣṇādyāḥ śirorujāntāḥ sugamāḥ| kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣaḥ kaṇṭhaśoṣo mukhaśoṣaś ca| vamathuś chardibhedaḥ thugathugīti loke| romaharṣaḥ romāñcaḥ| aruciḥ prasiddhā| tamaḥ andhakāre praviṣṭasyevārthāsaṃvittiḥ| parvabhedaḥ parvāṇi bhidyanta iti sandhiṣu vedanābhedaḥ| dvandvajeṣu sānnipātikeṣu ca kānicil lakṣaṇāni ‘vikṛtisamavāyārabdhāni’ iti pā.| vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhāni bhavanti, kānicit prakṛtisamasamavāyārabdhāni bhavanti| doṣāṇām eva lakṣaṇāni dṛśyante ‘prakṛtisamavāyārabdhāni’ iti pā.| prakṛtisamasamavāyārabdhāni, viparītāni tu ‘vikṛtisamavāyārabdhāni’ iti pā.| vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhāni| yathātraiva vātapaittike jvare aruciḥ, romaharṣaś ca; vakṣyamāṇavātaślaiṣmike santāpaḥ; evaṃ kaphapittaje liptatiktāsyatvaṃ sannipātaje sāsrakaluṣādinetratvaṃ śiroloṭhanādi, prakṛtisamasamavāyavikṛtiviṣamasamavāyayoś cāyam arthaḥ– prakṛtyā hetubhūtayā samaḥ kāraṇānurūpaḥ samavāyaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvasambandhaḥ prakṛtisamasamavāyaḥ, kāraṇānurūpaṃ kāryam ity arthaḥ; yathā śuklatantusamavāyārabdhasya śuklatvaṃ paṭasya; vikṛtyā hetubhūtayā viṣamaḥ kāraṇānanurūpaḥ samavāyo ‘vikṛtisamavāyaḥ’ iti pā.| vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyaḥ; yathā haridrācūrṇasaṃyogajaṃ lauhityam iti, yathā vātapittayor lakṣaṇeṣu aruciromaharṣau| imau tu vikṛtyārabdhau dṛśyete; vātaśleṣmaṇor lakṣaṇeṣu santāpo nāsti, sānnipātikajvaralakṣaṇe dṛśyate so 'pi vikṛtyārabdhaḥ| śiraso loṭhanaṃ vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ lakṣaṇeṣu na dṛśyate sānnipātikajvaralakṣaṇe dṛśyate tad api vikṛtyārabdham| evaṃ dvandvajasannipātajeṣu sarveṣv api rogeṣu boddhavyam||14||–

staimityaṃ parvaṇāṃ bhedo nidrā gauravam eva ca ||15||
śirograhaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ kāsaḥ svedāpravartanam |
santāpo madhyavegaś ca vātaśleṣmajvarākṛtiḥ ||16|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

ab.seg: vātaśleṣmajvaralakṣaṇam āha– ‘staimityamityādi’ iti pā.| staimityaṃ parvaṇāṃ bheda ity ādi| svedāpravartanaṃ svedasya ā ‘samantātprakāreṇa’ iti pā.| samantād akāraṇena ‘pravṛttiḥ’ iti pā.| pravartanaṃ vikṛtaviṣamasamasamavāyārabdhatvād iti kārtikaḥ| yuktaṃ caitat; yad āha hārītaḥ– “śirograhaḥ ‘svedabhavo jvarasya kāsaśca’ ityasya sthāne ‘svedabhavaśca kāso jvarasya’ iti pā.| svedabhavo jvarasya kāsaś ca liṅgaṃ kaphavātajasya|” iti| svedabhavaḥ svedotpattiḥ| madhyavego nātitīkṣṇo nātimṛdur iti||15-16||

vātaśleṣmajvaralakṣaṇam āha– ‘staimityamityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | staimityam ity ādi| staimityaṃ ārdravastrāvaguṇṭhitam iva, anye niścalatvaṃ jvaritasya| parvaṇāṃ bhedo vedanāviśeṣaḥ sandhiṣu| nidrā prasiddhā| gauravam aṅgānām| śirograhaḥ śirogṛhītam iva manyate| pratiśyāyo nāsāsrāvaḥ| svedāpravartanaṃ svedasya āsamantāt pravartanam| yad uktaṃ hārīte– “śirograhaḥ svedabhavaś ca kāso jvarasya liṅgaṃ kaphavātajasya|” iti| svedabhavaḥ svedotpattiḥ| idam api lakṣaṇaṃ ‘vikṛtisamavāyārabdham’ iti pā.| vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdham| santāpo 'pi ‘vikṛtisamavāyārabdhaḥ’ iti pā.| vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhaḥ| madhyavego nātitīkṣṇo nātimṛdur iti ||15-16||

div.ab:
liptatiktāsyatā tandrā mohaḥ kāso 'rucis tṛṣā |
muhur dāho muhuḥ śītaṃ ‘pittaśleṣmajvarākṛtiḥ’ iti pā.| śleṣmapittajvarākṛtiḥ ||17|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

ab.seg: pittaśleṣmajvaralakṣaṇam āha– liptety ādi| śleṣmaṇā liptaṃ atra ‘ca’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ca pittena tiktaṃ ca āsyaṃ mukhaṃ yasya, tasya bhāvo liptatiktāsyatā| tandrā ‘locanaklāntiḥ’ iti pā.| nidrāvat klāntiḥ| moho mūrchā| etāni liṅgāni prāyobhāvitvena ‘likhitāni’ iti pā.| nirdiṣṭāni, ‘anyānyapi’ iti pā.| tenānyāny api carakoktāni boddhavyāni| yathā– “tathā stambhaś ca saṃsvedaḥ kaphapittapravartanam|” iti||17||

śleṣmapittajvaram āha– ‘liptetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | liptety ādi| śleṣmaṇā liptaṃ pittena tiktaṃ ca mukhaṃ yasya, tasya bhāvo liptatiktāsyatā, liptāsyatā tiktāsyatā cety arthaḥ| tandrā nidrāvat klāntiḥ| tandrālakṣaṇam āha–
“ ‘indriyārtheṣvasamprāptirgauravaṃ’ iti pā.| indriyārtheṣv asaṃvittir gauravaṃ jṛmbhaṇaṃ klamaḥ|
nidrārtasyeva ‘yasyaite’ iti pā.| yasyehā tasya tandrāṃ vinirdiśet||” iti| moho mūrchā| anyat sugamam||17||

div.ab:
kṣaṇe dāhaḥ kṣaṇe śītam asthisandhiśirorujā |
sāsrāve kaluṣe rakte nirbhugne cāpi locane ||18||
sasvanau sarujau karṇau kaṇṭhaḥ śūkair ivāvṛtaḥ |
tandrā mohaḥ pralāpaś ca kāsaḥ śvāso 'rucir bhramaḥ ||19||
paridagdhā kharasparśā jihvā srastāṅgatā param |
ṣṭhīvanaṃ raktapittasya kaphenonmiśritasya ca ||20||
śiraso loṭhanaṃ tṛṣṇā nidrānāśo hṛdi vyathā |
svedamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ cirād darśanam alpaśaḥ ||21||
kṛśatvaṃ nātigātrāṇāṃ pratataṃ kaṇṭhakūjanam |
koṭhānāṃ śyāvaraktānāṃ maṇḍalānāṃ ca darśanam ||22||
mūkatvaṃ srotasāṃ pāko gurutvam udarasya ca |
cirāt pākaś ca doṣāṇāṃ sannipātajvarākṛtiḥ ||23|| (ca. ci. a. 3) |

ab.seg:
sānnipātikajvaralakṣaṇam āha– kṣaṇe dāha ity ādi| rujā śūlam, asthyādibhiḥ sambadhyate| sāsrāve sāśruṇī| kaluṣe āvilavarṇe| ‘nirgataṃ bhugnam’ ityasya sthāne ‘nirgatā bhugnatā’ iti pā.| nirgataṃ bhugnaṃ saṅkucitatā yayos te nirbhugne, “visphārite ity arthaḥ” iti jejjaṭaḥ; “antaḥpraviṣṭe” ity anye, “atikuṭile” iti cakraḥ| śūkaiḥ śūkaśimbi(mbā)dhānyādeḥ| paridagdhā dagdhavat kṛṣṇavarṇā| kharasparśā ‘kharo gojihvāvat sparśo yasyāṃ sā tathā’ ityasya sthāne ‘gojihvādivat’ iti pā.| kharo gojihvāvat sparśo yasyāṃ sā tathā| srastāṅgatā niḥsahāvayavatā| ṣṭhīvanaṃ raktasya pittasya vā mukhena svalpodgiraṇam| śiraso ‘loṭhanamiti itastataḥ śiraścālanam’ iti pā.| loṭhanam itastataś cālanam| kṛśatvaṃ nātigātrāṇāṃ doṣapūrṇatvena| pratataṃ nirantaram| koṭho bhālukitantre paṭhitaḥ| tad yathā– “varaṭīdaṣṭasaṅkāśaḥ kaṇḍūmāṃl lohito 'srakaphapittāt| kṣaṇikotpādavināśaḥ koṭha iti nigadyate tajjñaiḥ||” iti| mūkatvaṃ ‘mandavacanatvam’ iti pā.| mandavacanatā, avacanatā vā| gurutvam udarasya ‘ca udaragauravam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca udaragauravam, cirāt pākaś ca doṣāṇām iti ‘atisāmatvārabdhatvena’ iti pā.| atisāmatārabdhatvena| cakārād anyāny api ca boddhavyāni| yad āha vāgbhaṭaḥ–
“tadvac chītaṃ mahānidrā divā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi|
sadā vā naiva vā nidrā ‘mahān svedo'thavā na vā’ ityasya sthāne ‘mahāsvedo'ti naiva vā’ iti pā.| mahān svedo 'thavā na vā|| gītanartanahāsyādivikṛtehāpravartanam|” (vā. ni. a. 2) iti| etac ca lakṣaṇaṃ trayodaśasannipāteṣu madhye svamānād vṛddhair doṣais tulyair ārabdhasya jvarasya carakeṇa paṭhitaṃ; dvyulbaṇaikolbaṇādīnāṃ ca dvādaśānāṃ ‘lakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyam’ iti pā.| lakṣaṇaṃ tatraiva draṣṭavyam| tathā ca kāśmīrapāṭhe carakaḥ–
“bhramaḥ pipāsā dāhaś ca gauravaṃ śiraso 'tiruk|
vātapittolbaṇe vidyāl liṅgaṃ mandakaphe jvare||
śaityaṃ ‘...dāharuk tathā’ iti pā.| kāso 'rucis tandrāpipāsādāhahṛdvyathāḥ|
vātaśleṣmolbaṇe vyādhau liṅgaṃ pittāvare viduḥ||
chardiḥ śaityaṃ muhur dāhas tṛṣṇā moho 'sthivedanā|
mandavāte vyavasyanti liṅgaṃ pittakapholbaṇe||
‘sandhyasthiśirasām’ iti pā.| sandhyasthiśirasaḥ śūlaṃ pralāpo gauravaṃ bhramaḥ|
vātolbaṇe syād dvyanuge tṛṣṇā kaṇṭhāsyaśuṣkatā||
raktaviṇmūtratā dāhaḥ svedas tṛṣṇā balakṣayaḥ|
mūrchā ceti tridoṣe syāl liṅgaṃ pitte garīyasi|
ālasyārucihṛllāsadāhavamyaratibhramaiḥ|
kapholbaṇaṃ sannipātaṃ tandrā kāsena cādiśet||
pratiśyā cchardir ālasyaṃ tandrā'rucyagnimārdavam|
hīnavāte pittamadhye liṅgaṃ śleṣmādhike matam||
hāridramūtranetratvaṃ dāhas tṛṣṇā bhramo 'ruciḥ|
hīnavāte madhyakaphe liṅgaṃ pittādhike matam||
śirorugvepathuśvāsapralāpaś chardyarocakāḥ|
hīnapitte madhyakaphe liṅgaṃ vātādhike matam||
śītatā gauravaṃ tandrā pralāpo 'sthiśirotiruk|
hīnapitte vātamadhye liṅgaṃ śleṣmādhike viduḥ||
‘parvabhedo'gnidaurbalyam’ iti pā.| varcobhedo 'gnidaurbalyaṃ tṛṣṇā dāho 'rucir bhramaḥ|
kaphahīne vātamadhye liṅgaṃ pittādhike viduḥ||
śvāsaḥ kāsaḥ pratiśyāyo mukhaśoṣo 'tipārśvaruk|
kaphahīne pittamadhye liṅgaṃ vātādhike matam||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| vikṛtau niyamo nāsti; tena asyāgre kvacitpustake “prakṛtisamasamavāye tu sannipāte pṛthagvātādijvaralakṣaṇaṃ jñeyaṃ; hīnamadhyādhikakrameṇa sannipātā eva ṣaṭ, dvyulbaṇatvena trayaḥ, ekolbaṇatvena trayaḥ, samatvenaikaḥ, evaṃ trayodaśa prakṛtau” ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate | vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyā anekaprakārā bhavanti| ataḥ suśrutenāpy anyādṛśaḥ sannipātalakṣaṇaṃ paṭhitam–
“nātyuṣṇaśīto 'lpasañjño bhrāntaprekṣī hataprabhaḥ|
kharajihvaḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhaḥ svedaviṇmūtravarjitaḥ||
sāśrunirbhugnanayano bhaktadveṣī hatasvaraḥ|
śvasan nipatitaḥ śete pralāpopadravānvitaḥ||
abhinyāsaṃ tu taṃ prāhur hataujasam athāpare|
sannipātajvaraṃ kṛcchram asādhyam apare jaguḥ||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti| tathā bhālukitantre ‘dvyulbaṇādilakṣaṇamanyathā’ iti pā.| dvyulbaṇaikolbaṇādilakṣaṇam anyathā paṭhitam| asyāgre kvacitpustake “vātaḥ pittādhiko'yaṃ prathamamupacito hanti vahniṃ śarīre śleṣmatvaṃ yāti bhuktaṃ sakalamapi tato'sau kapho vāyuduṣṭaḥ| srotāṃsyāpūrya rundhyādanilamatha marut kopayet pittamantaḥ sammūrchyānyonyamete prabalamiti nṛṇāṃ kurvate sannipātam” ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate | tad yathā–
“vātapittādhiko yasya sannipātaḥ prakupyati|
tasya jvaro 'ṅgamardas tṛṭtāluśoṣapramīlakāḥ||
ādhmānatandrārucayaḥ śvāsakāsabhramaśramāḥ|
pittaśleṣmādhiko yasya sannipātaḥ prakupyati||
antardāho bahiḥ śītaṃ tasya tandrā ca bādhate|
tudyate dakṣiṇaṃ pārśvam uraḥśīrṣagalagrahāḥ||
niṣṭhīvet kaphapittaṃ ca tṛṣṇā ‘kaṇṭhaśca dūyate’ iti pā.| kaṇḍūś ca jāyate|
viḍbhedaśvāsahikkāś ca bādhante sapramīlakāḥ||
‘vibhuḥ phalguśca’ iti pā.| vibhuphalgū ca tau nāmnā sannipātāv udāhṛtau|
śleṣmānilādhiko yasya sannipātaḥ prakupyati||
tasya śītajvaro nidrā kṣuttṛṣṇā ‘pārśvasaṅgrahaḥ’ iti pā.| pārśvanigrahaḥ|
śirogauravam ālasyamanyāstambhapramīlakāḥ||
udaraṃ dahyate cāsya kaṭir bastiś ca dūyate|
sannipātaḥ sa vijñeyo makarīti sudāruṇaḥ||
vātolbaṇaḥ sannipāto yasya jantoḥ prakupyati|
tasya ‘cintājvaraglānipārśvarugdṛṣṭisaṅkṣayāḥ’ iti pā.| tṛṣṇājvaraglānipārśvarugdṛṣṭisaṅkṣayāḥ||
piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ dāha ūrusādo balakṣayaḥ|
saraktaṃ cāsya viṇmūtraṃ śūlaṃ nidrāviparyayaḥ||
nirbhidyate gudaṃ cāsya bastiś ca ‘parikṛṣyate’ iti pā.| parikṛtyate|
āyamyate bhidyate ca hikkate vilapaty api||
mūrchati sphāyate rauti nāmnā visphurakaḥ smṛtaḥ|
pittolbaṇaḥ sannipāto yasya jantoḥ prakupyati||
tasya dāho jvaro ghoro bahir antaś ca vardhate|
śītaṃ ca sevamānasya kupyataḥ kaphamārutau||
tataś cainaṃ pradhāvante hikkāśvāsapramīlakāḥ|
visūcikā parvabhedaḥ pralāpo gauravaṃ klamaḥ||
nābhipārśvarujā tasya svinnasyāśu vivardhate|
svidyamānasya raktaṃ ca srotobhyaḥ sampravartate||
śūlena pīḍyamānasya tṛṣṇā dāhaś ca vardhate|
asādhyaḥ sannipāto 'yaṃ ‘śīghrakarīti’ iti pā.| śīghrakārīti kathyate||
na hi ‘jīvatyahorātrametenāriṣṭavigrahaḥ’ iti pā.| jīvaty ahorātram etenāviṣṭavigrahaḥ|
kapholbaṇaḥ sannipāto yasya jantoḥ prakupyati||
tasya śītajvarasvapnagauravālasyatandrayaḥ|
chardimūrchātṛṣādāhatṛptyarocakahṛdgrahāḥ||
ṣṭhīvanaṃ mukhamādhuryaṃ śrotravāgdṛṣṭinigrahaḥ|
śleṣmaṇo nigrahaṃ cāsya yadā prakurute bhiṣak||
tadā tasya bhṛśaṃ pittaṃ kuryāt sopadravaṃ jvaram|
nigṛhīte tu pitte ca bhṛśaṃ vāyuḥ prakupyati||
nirāhārasya so 'tyarthaṃ medomajjāsthi ‘dhāvate’ iti pā.| bādhate|
athātra snāti bhuṅkte vā trirātraṃ na hi jīvati||
medogataḥ sannipātaḥ ‘phamphaṇaḥ’ iti pā.| kapphaṇaḥ sa udāhṛtaḥ|
kāmān mohāc ca lobhāc ca bhayāc cāyaṃ prapadyate||
madhyahīnādhikair doṣaiḥ sannipāto yadā bhavet|
tasya rogās ta evoktāḥ prāyo doṣabalāśrayāḥ||” ity ādi| nanu, vātādayaḥ parasparaṃ viruddhaguṇāḥ; viruddhaguṇānāṃ ca sambhūyaikakāryārambhakatvaṃ nopapadyate, parasparopaghātāt tuhinadahanayor iva; tat kathaṃ ‘sānnipātikavikārotpāda iti’ iti pā.| sānnipātikavikārotpattir iti atra ‘tadyathā– vātasya’ ityārabhya ‘sambhavatītyanupadamevoktam|’ ityantaḥ bṛhatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ‘tad yathā– vātasya śītarūkṣādiguṇayuktasya uṣṇasnigdhādiguṇayuktena pittena, tathā kaphasya gauravasnigdhātmakasyobhābhyāṃ virodhaḥ|
“tatra rūkṣo laghuḥ śītaḥ kharaḥ sūkṣmaś calo 'nilaḥ|
pittaṃ sasnehatīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ laghu visraṃ saraṃ dravam|
snigdhaḥ śīto gurur mandaḥ ślakṣṇo mṛtsnaḥ sthiraḥ kaphaḥ||
kaṭvamlalavaṇaṃ pittaṃ svādvamlalavaṇaḥ kaphaḥ|
kaṣāyatiktakaṭuko vāyur duṣṭo 'numānataḥ||” iti| kiñ ca, mithyāhāravihārābhyāṃ doṣā yugapad utpadyante āhosvit kālavyavadhānena? ādye samabalatvena tāratamyena vā? nādyaḥ, sarveṣāṃ samabalatvena parasparaghātakānāṃ yugapadutpattir na syāt| atha bhinnāśrayatayā sā'stu; tad api na, kupitānāṃ sarvadehavyāpitvena parasparasambandhāt| ‘uktaṃ ca’ iti pā.| tad uktam– “vyāpnoti sahasā deham āpādatalamastakam|” iti| kiñ ca jvarotpattau tāvat kupitānām āmāśayagatānāṃ rasadūṣakāṇāṃ jvarotpādakatvaṃ, tanmilitānām eva syād yathāduṣṭeneti| na dvitīyaḥ, ‘pūrvadoṣo'dhikaḥ syāt’ iti pā.| pūrvadoṣādhikatvāt| kiñ ca tāratamyenotpattau mūṣakamārjāravad virodhe prāg eva tena prabalena durbalāghātaḥ sukaraḥ; dṛśyate ca mātsyo nyāyaḥ| atha yugapadutpādakā āhārādayo na bhavanti; tatra yugapadutpādakadravyam ekam anekaṃ vā? tasya ( ( ) etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ekatve)pāñcabhautikatvena viruddhaguṇādhikāra(karaṇa)sya tridoṣotpādakatvaṃ na syāt| astu vā'vicāritaramaṇīyam| ‘sākamevābhyavahrīyata’ iti pā.| ekam evābhyavahrīyata iti katham? astu vā sādhakatvena sahakāriṇi dravyābhyavahāre tasya viruddhaguṇavattvena ‘... ghātakatvenānupapattiḥ;’ iti pā.| doṣāntaraghātakatvenānutpattiḥ; tadavasthatayaiva jāyamānaḥ kevalaikadoṣajo na saṃsargasannipātajo jvara iti| athādṛṣṭādhīnatvena sahakāriṇo bhāve (sambhave) ekābhyavahāre sannipātaḥ, tarhi sarveṣāṃ samabalatvenety atroktadoṣaḥ syāt| ‘atha tasyānekatve’ iti pā.| athānekadravyāṇām abhyavahāre tridoṣaprakopaṇaṃ na sambhavati| tatra tulyānām evābhyavahāraḥ kathaṃ? ‘yato bhinnarucitvāt’ iti pā.| yato 'bhinnarucitvāt| yathārucyabhyavahāre ‘tāratamyasambhavāt’ iti pā.| tāratamyasambandhāt| tāratamyenaiva bhavati prakopo na yugapad iti pratijñāhāniḥ| atrāpy adṛṣṭādhīnatvāt tulyābhyavahāre pratighātakatvābhāve 'pi yaugapadyaṃ; tarhi sa eva doṣaḥ| atha kālavyavadhānena, tatra pūrvasmād uttarasya bhinnaḥ kālo bhavet; samabalo vā ‘nyūno vā adhiko’ iti pā.| nyūnādhikabalo vā? nādyaḥ, upasañjātavirodhitvenotpattum eva na śaknoti| na dvitīyaḥ, nyūnabalatvena pūrvaprabalenaiva vināśitatvāt, akiñcitkaratvāc ca| na tṛtīyaḥ, vicārāsahatvāt| tatra vaktavyam adhikabalatvam utpatteḥ pūrvaṃ paścād vā? nādyaḥ, ‘anutpannotpannasyā ...’ iti pā.| anutpannasyādhikyābhāvāt| adhikatvaṃ dharmaḥ, sa tu atra ‘sati’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| sati dharmiṇi cintyaḥ| atha paścāt? tan na, utpattyadhike adhikena ghātasyopasañjātavirodhina utpattir eva na, kuto 'dhikatvam| atrāpy adhikatvaṃ na sambhavati| tasmād viruddhaguṇānāṃ sambhūya kartṛtvaṃ ghaṭaghaṭābhāvayor iva ghaṭaghaṭapradhvaṃsayor iva sahāvasthāyitvaṃ nāsti dahanatuhinavat| atrocyate– sarve vikalpā anaṅgīkārapāśahatāḥ, sannipātas tu syād eva; mithyāhārādinā kupitā doṣā yugapat kālavyavadhānena vā, samabalatvena tāratamyena vā parasparaviruddhā api svasthānād āmāśayam āgatya rasaṃ dūṣayitvā dvandvasannipātotpādakā bhavanti, uktaṃ ca– mithyāhārety ādi| kālavyavadhānenotpannānām api kālāntareṇa yaugapadyam eva bhavatīti na kadācid anupapattiḥ| nanu, katham ādipaścādbhāvenotpannānāṃ yaugapadyam iti cet? tan na, doṣād doṣāntarotpatteḥ| tad uktam–
“ekaḥ prakupito doṣaḥ sarvān eva prakopayet|
ekaḥ praśamito doṣaḥ sarvān doṣān nivārayet||” iti| tathā ca carakaḥ– “kaścid dhi rogo rogasya hetur bhūtvā praśāmyati||” iti| atra rujākaratvād doṣo 'pi roga iti ṭīkākṛto vyācakṣate, ‘vikṛto doṣo roga’ iti samudāyasamudāyinor abhedavādināṃ mataṃ pūrvam evoktam| anyac ca tathā– “vikṛtāvikṛtā dehaṃ ghnanti te vartayanti ca|” iti| vikṛtānāṃ ghātakatvaṃ rogarūpeṇaiva bhavati, yā vikṛtiḥ sa eva roga iti na doṣarogayor bhedaḥ| astu vā bhedaḥ, militair doṣaiḥ rogaḥ kriyata iti| kathañcid api ekānekadravyābhyavahāre sahakāriṇo daivāt trayāṇāṃ prakopo bhavaty eva| uktaṃ ca–
“dṛṣṭāparādhajaḥ kaścit kaścit pūrvāparādhajaḥ|
tatsaṅkarād bhavaty anyo vyādhir evaṃ tridhā ‘mataḥ’ iti pā.| smṛtaḥ||” iti| tathā–
“pittakṣobhe tilābhyaṅgo rātrau ca dadhibhojanam|
anidrā maithunaṃ yasya sannipāto bhaved dhruvam||” iti| nanu doṣāṇāṃ bādhyabādhakabhāvenādipaścādbhāvenotpattir doṣād doṣāntarotpattir vā na sambhavatīty anupadam evoktam|” atra samādhānam uktaṃ dṛḍhabalena, ‘yathā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yathā–
“viruddhair api na tv ete guṇair ghnanti parasparam|
doṣāḥ sahajasātmyatvād ghoraṃ viṣam ahīn iva||” iti (ca. ci. a. 26)| etac cānye dūṣayanti– sahajatvād ity anaikāntikaṃ, yataḥ sahajān api dhātūn doṣā upaghnanti; sātmyatvād ity api sādhyāviśiṣṭaṃ, yataḥ sātmyatvam abādhakatvaṃ, tad eva ca ‘doṣāṇāmiha sādhyam’ ityasya sthāne ‘doṣāṇāṃ parasparaṃ sādhyam’ iti pā., ‘doṣāṇāmiha parasparaṃ sādhyate’ iti ca. pā.| doṣāṇām iha sādhyam| atrocyate– doṣā nopaghnantīti ko 'yam anupaghātaḥ sādhyate? vikṛter akārakatvaṃ vā, avināśakatvaṃ vā? nādyaḥ, doṣāṇāṃ parasparaṃ vikṛtikartṛtvāt| yathoktaṃ carake–
“viśoṣayed vastigataṃ saśukraṃ mūtraṃ sapittaṃ pavanaḥ kaphaṃ vā|
yadā tadā'śmary upajāyate tu krameṇa ‘pittādiva’ iti pā.| pitteṣv iva rocanā goḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 26) iti; ‘tathā coktam’ ityasya sthāne ‘yathoktam’ iti pā.| tathā coktaṃ vāgbhaṭena–
“saśleṣmamedaḥ pavanaḥ sāmam atyarthasañcitam|
abhibhūyetaraṃ doṣam ūrū cet pratipadyate||
sakthyasthinī prapūryāntaḥ śleṣmaṇā stimitena ca|
tadā stabhnāti tenorū stabdhau śītāv acetanau||’ (vā. ni. a. 15) atra kvacitpustake– ‘na dvitīyaḥ, doṣāddoṣāntarotpattirdarśitaivānupadam, ‘ekaḥ prakupito doṣa’ ityādinā; ato doṣasya kāraṇatvādanya evānupaghātaḥ’ ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate | iti| avināśakatvaṃ tu vidyata eva, dhātudoṣayoḥ parasparaṃ ca doṣāṇāṃ sarvathocchedapratipādakāgamābhāvāt, atra kvacitpustake ‘ataḥ sātmyatvāt sahajatvādavirodhitvamiti yaduktamanaikāntikatvaṃ tanna, upaghātaśabdasya nyūnādhikaparyāyavirodhitvāt| āhāraṃ doṣā upaghnantīti dūṣyarasadhātudūṣakatvaṃ doṣāṇāṃ; tacca rasadūṣyaprakṛtyanyathāpādakatvameva nānyaditi kuto nāśaḥ sādhyāviśiṣṭatā tu nirastā spaṣṭatarā’ ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate | maraṇaprasaṅgāc ca ; doṣāṇām api ‘dehadhāraṇakāraṇatvāt’ iti pā.| dehadhārakatvāt; tasmāt sarvathocchedanirāsābhiprāyeṇaiva dṛḍhabalavacanam iha draṣṭavyaṃ; ‘tatkuto'naikāntikatā’ iti pā.| tataḥ kuto 'naikāntikatā| na caivaṃ sati viṣasya viṣādakartṛtvena dṛṣṭāntaviphalatvaṃ, viṣasya ‘viṣādāvavāntaravyāpārasya’ iti pā.| viṣādād avāntarakhyāpārasya prāṇavināśakatvāt; na ca sarvātmanā dṛṣṭānto bhavatīti| sātmyatvād ity asyāyam arthaḥ– sātmyatvena pratīyamānatvāt| doṣāḥ parasparaṃ nopaghnanti, anupaghātakatvena pratīyamānatvāt; yad yathā pratīyate tat tathā nirdiśyate, yathā'gnikāryo dhūmo 'gnikāryatveneti, ‘kutaḥ’ iti pā.| tat kutaḥ sādhyāviśiṣṭatvam iti| cakradattas tu sahajasātmyatvād ity ekam eva hetuṃ vyākhyātavān– sahajaṃ svābhāvikaṃ doṣāṇāṃ sātmyatvam iti| dṛḍhabaloktahetudvayāsvarasena gayadāsas tu hetvantaram uktavān–
“daivād doṣasvabhāvād vā doṣāṇāṃ sānnipātike|
‘viruddhaiḥ svaguṇaiḥ’ ityasya sthāne ‘viruddhaiśca guṇaiḥ’ iti pā.| viruddhaiḥ svaguṇaiḥ kaścin nopaghātaḥ parasparam||” iti saṅkṣepaḥ||18-23||

atha sānnipātikajvaralakṣaṇam āha– kṣaṇe 'dāhaḥ' iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | dāha ity ādi| 'rujā śūlam asthyādibhiḥ sambadhyate' iti pā.| rujāśabdo 'sthyādibhiḥ sambadhyate| 'locane' iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | locane sāsrāve sāśruṇī, kaluṣe āvile, rakte lohitavarṇe, nirbhugne visphārite iti jejjaṭaḥ, atikuṭile iti cakraḥ| karṇau sasvanau saśabdau, sarujau vedanāyuktau bhavataḥ| kaṇṭhaḥ śūkair dhānyāgrasūkṣmakaṇṭakākāraiḥ, anye kapikacchūśūkair ivāvṛtaḥ vyāpta iva| tandrā prasiddhā, moho 'caitanyaṃ bhavati, pralāpo 'sambaddhabhāṣaṇam| ‘bhramaścakrārūḍhastyeva, anye tu viparītapadārthajñānaṃ sthāṇau tuṣajñānavat’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhramaś cakrārūḍhastyeva, anye tu viparītapadārthajñānaṃ sthāṇau tuṣajñānavat| jihvā paridagdhā dagdhavat kṛṣṇavarṇā, kharasparśā kaṇṭakinī ca| srastāṅgatā niḥsahāvayavatā, anye vikalāṅgatvam āhuḥ| ṣṭhīvanaṃ mukhena raktapittasya| īṣatkaphamiśritasyodgiraṇam| śiraso loṭhanam itastataḥ śiraścālanam| tṛṣṇā pipāsā| ‘nidānāśaḥ hṛdi vyathā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | nidānāśaḥ hṛdi vyathā svedamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ cireṇālpaśo darśanaṃ cirāt srutiḥ| kṛśatvaṃ nātigātrāṇāṃ nātidaurbalyaṃ doṣapūrṇatvāt| pratataṃ nirantaraṃ, kaṇṭhakūjanaṃ avyaktaśabdaḥ| koṭhānāṃ śyāvaraktavarṇānāṃ kvacitpustake ‘maṇḍalānāṃ ca darśanaṃ’ etatsthāne ‘darśanaṃ maṇḍalānāṃ ca tathā’ iti pā.| maṇḍalānāṃ ca darśanaṃ; koṭhalakṣaṇaṃ kvacitpustake ‘bhālukitantre paṭhitam– “varaṭidaṣṭasaṅkāśaḥ’ etatsthāne ‘bhālukiḥ– “varaṭidaṃṣsaṅkāśaḥ’ iti pā.| bhālukitantre paṭhitam– “varaṭidaṣṭasaṅkāśaḥ kaṇḍūmāmँl lohito 'srakaphapittāt| kṣaṇikotpādavināśaḥ koṭha kvacitpustake ‘iti nigadyate tajjñaiḥ” iti’ etatsthāne ‘ityabhidhīyate sadbhiḥ’ iti pā.| iti nigadyate tajjñaiḥ” iti, athavā koṭhāḥ avyaktamukhāḥ piḍikāprāyāḥ, teṣāṃ ca śyāvaraktānāṃ darśanaṃ, śarīre maṇḍalānāṃ ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca sakalānāṃ ca darśanam| mūkatvaṃ mandavacanatā avacanatā vā| srotasāṃ mukhanāsādirandhrāṇāṃ pākaḥ| ‘gurutvamudarasya udaragauravam| cirātpākaśca doṣāṇāmiti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | gurutvam udarasya udaragauravam| cirāt pākaś ca doṣāṇām iti atisāmatvārabdhena doṣāṇām ekatra militānāṃ cirakālena pāko nirāmatā| cakārād anyāny api boddhavyāni| yad āha vāgbhaṭaḥ–
“tadvac chītaṃ mahānidrā divā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi|
sadā vā naiva vā nidrā mahān kvacitpustake ‘svedo'tha naiva ca’ etatsthāne ‘svedo'ti naiva vā’ iti pā.| svedo 'tha naiva ca|| gītanartanahāsyādivikṛtehāpravartanam|” iti| etac ca lakṣaṇaṃ trayodaśasannipāteṣu sāmānyaṃ vṛddhair doṣais tulyair ārabdhasya carakeṇa paṭhitam; evaṃ ‘ ‘dvyulbaṇaiḥ’ iti pā.| dvyulbaṇaikolbaṇaiḥ ṣaṭ syuḥ’ ity ādidvādaśasannipātānāṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyam| tathā ca kāśmīrapāṭhe ‘carakaḥ’ iti pā.| carakatantre–
“bhramaḥ pipāsā dāhaś ca gauravaṃ śiraso 'tiruk|
vātapittolbaṇe vidyāl liṅgaṃ mandakaphajvare||
śaityaṃ kāso 'rucis tandrā pipāsādāhahṛdvyathāḥ|
vātaśleṣmolbaṇe vyādhau liṅgaṃ pittāvare viduḥ||
chardiḥ ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śaityaṃ bahirdāhas tṛṣṇā moho 'sthivedanā
mande vāte vyavasyanti liṅgaṃ pittakapholbaṇe||
sandhyasthiśirasaḥ śūlaṃ pralāpo gauravaṃ bhramaḥ|
vātolbaṇe tridoṣe tu tṛṣṇā kaṇṭhāsyaśuṣkatā||
raktaviṇmūtranetratvaṃ ‘dāhastṛṭ ca balakṣayaḥ’ iti pā.| dāhatṛḍbalasaṅkṣayāḥ|
mūrchā ceti tridoṣe syāl liṅgaṃ pitte garīyasi||
ālasyārucihṛllāsadāhavamyaratibhramāḥ|
kapholbaṇe sannipāte tandrā kāso 'pi jāyate||
mūrchā cchardiḥ pratiśyāyas tandrā'rucyagnimārdavam|
hīnavāte madhyapitte liṅgaṃ śleṣmādhike matam||
hāridramūtranetratvaṃ dāhas tṛṣṇā'rucir bhramaḥ|
hīnavāte madhyakaphe liṅgaṃ pittādhike matam||
śirorug vepathuḥ śvāsapralāpaś cchardyarocakāḥ|
hīnapitte madhyakaphe liṅgaṃ vātādhike matam|| śītakaṃ gauravaṃ tandrā pralāpaḥ śiraso 'tiruk|| hīnapitte vātamadhye liṅgaṃ śleṣmādhike matam|| parvabhedo 'ṅgadaurbalyaṃ tṛṣṇā dāho 'rucir bhramaḥ|| kaphe hīne madhyavāte liṅgaṃ pittādhike viduḥ|| śvāsaḥ kāsaḥ pratiśyāyo mukhaśoṣo 'tipārśvaruk|| kaphe hīne madhyapitte liṅgaṃ vātādhike matam|” iti|| vikṛtau niyamo nāsti, tena ‘vikṛtiviṣamasamavā’ iti pā.| vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhā anekaprakārā bhavanti| ‘prakṛtisamasvāyastu’ iti pā.| prakṛtisamasamavāye sannipāte pṛthag vātādijvarasyaiva lakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam| hīnamadhyādhikakrameṇa sannipātāḥ ‘evaṃ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | evaṃ ṣaṭ, dvyulbaṇena trayaḥ, ekolbaṇena trayaḥ, samatvenaikaḥ, evaṃ trayodaśasannipātāḥ prakṛtau| atra suśrutas tu doṣotkarṣāpakarṣatāratamyena dhātvādyāvaraṇabhedena ca sannipātabhedānām ānantyāt pṛthag lakṣaṇaṃ noktavān; kintu tulyakupitair doṣair ekam eva sannipātalakṣaṇaṃ paṭhitavān| tad yathā– “nātyuṣṇaśīto 'lpasañjño bhrāntaprekṣī hataprabhaḥ|| kharajihvaḥ śūkakaṇṭhaḥ svedaviṇmūtravarjitaḥ|| sāśrunirbhugnanayano bhaktadveṣī hatasvaraḥ|| śvasan nipatitaḥ śete pralāpopadravair yutaḥ|| abhinyāsaṃ tu taṃ prāhur hataujasam athāpare|| sannipātajvaraṃ kṛcchram asādhyam apare viduḥ|| nidropetam abhinyāsaṃ kṣīṇam enaṃ hataujasam|| sannyastagātraṃ sannyāsaṃ vidyāt sarvātmakaṃ jvaram|” iti|| atha bhālukitantre dvyulbaṇaikolbaṇādilakṣaṇam anyathā paṭhitam| tad yathā–
“āmo hy āhāradoṣāt prathamam upacito hanti vahniṃ śarīre śleṣmatvaṃ yāti bhuktaṃ sakalam api tato 'sau kapho vāyuduṣṭaḥ|
srotāṃsy āpūrya rundhyād anilam atha marut kopayet pittam antaḥ sammūrchyānyonyam ete prabalam iti nṛṇāṃ kurvate sannipātam||
vātapittādhiko yasya sannipātaḥ prakupyati|
tasya jvaro 'ṅgamardas tṛṭ tāluśoṣapramīlakau||
ādhmānatandrārucayaḥ śvāsakāsabhramaśramāḥ|
pittaśleṣmādhiko yasya sannipātaḥ prakupyati||
antardāho bahiḥ śaityaṃ tasya tandrā ca vardhate|
tudyate dakṣiṇaṃ pārśvam uraḥśīrṣagalagrahaḥ||
niṣṭhīvet kaphapittaṃ ca kṛcchrāt kaṇḍūś ca jāyate|
viḍbhedaśvāsahikkāś ca vardhante sapramīlakāḥ||
vibhuḥ phalguś ca tau nāmnā sannipātāv udāhṛtau|
śleṣmānilādhiko yasya sannipātaḥ prakupyati||
tasya śītajvaro nidrā kṣut tṛṣṇā pārśvanigrahaḥ|
śirogauravam ālasyamanyāstambhapramīlakāḥ||
udaraṃ dahyate cāsya kaṭī bastiś ca dūyate|
sannipātaḥ sa vijñeyo makarīti sudāruṇaḥ||
vātolbaṇaḥ sannipāto yasya jantoḥ prakupyati|
‘tasya śītajvaro nidrā kṣuttṛṣṇāpārśvanigrahāḥ| śirogauravamālasyamanyāstambhapramīlakāḥ|| udaraṃ dahyate cāsya kaṭī bastiśca dūyate| sannipātaḥ sa vijñeyo makarīti sudāruṇaḥ|| vātolbaṇaḥ sannipāto yasya jantoḥ prakupyati|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tasya śītajvaro nidrā kṣuttṛṣṇāpārśvanigrahāḥ|
śirogauravam ālasyamanyāstambhapramīlakāḥ||
udaraṃ dahyate cāsya kaṭī bastiś ca dūyate|
sannipātaḥ sa vijñeyo makarīti sudāruṇaḥ||
vātolbaṇaḥ sannipāto yasya jantoḥ prakupyati|
tasya tṛṣṇā jvaro glāniḥ pārśvaruk dṛṣṭisaṅkṣayāḥ||
piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ dāha ūrusādo balakṣayaḥ|
saraktaṃ cāsya viṇmūtraṃ śūlaṃ nidrāviparyayaḥ||
nirbhidyate ‘gudaścāsya’ iti pā.| gudaṃ cāsya bastiś ca parigṛhyate|
āyamyate bhidyate ca hikkate vilapaty api||
mūrchate sphāryate rauti nāmnā ‘visphūrakaḥ’ iti pā.| visphārakaḥ smṛtaḥ|
pittolbaṇaḥ sannipāto yasya jantoḥ prakupyati||
tasya dāhajvaro ghoro bahir antaś ca vardhate|
śītaṃ ca sevamānasya kupyataḥ kaphamārutau|
tataś cainaṃ prabādhante hikkāśvāsapramīlikāḥ||
‘viṣūcika’ iti pā.| visūcikā parvabhedaḥ pralāpo gauravaṃ klamaḥ|
nābhipārśvarujā tasya ‘svinnasyāśu’ iti pā.| svinnaty āśu vivardhate||
svidyamānasya raktaṃ ca srotobhyaḥ sampravartate|
śūlena pīḍyamānasya tṛṣṇā śvāsaḥ prabādhate||
asādhyaḥ sannipāto 'yaṃ śīghrakārīti kathyate|
na hi jīvaty ahorātram anenāviṣṭavigrahaḥ||
kapholbaṇaḥ sannipāto yasya jantoḥ prakupyati|
tasya śītajvaraḥ svapnagauravālasyatandrikāḥ|
chardimūrchātṛṣādāhatṛṣṇārocakahṛdgrahāḥ|
ṣṭhīvanaṃ mukhamādhuryaṃ śrotravāgdṛṣṭinigrahaḥ||
athātra snāti bhuṅkte vā trirātraṃ naiva jīvati|
medogataḥ sannipāto ‘dyulbaṇaḥ’ iti pā.| hy ulbaṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ||
kāmān mohāc ca ‘lomaśca’ iti pā.| lobhāc ca bhayāc cāpi prapadyate|
madhyahīnādhikair doṣaiḥ sannipāto yadā bhavet|| tasya rogās ta evoktāḥ prāyo doṣabalāśrayāḥ|” iti|| nanu vātādayaḥ parasparaṃ viruddhaguṇāḥ, parasparaṃ viruddhaguṇānāṃ ca ‘teṣāṃ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | teṣāṃ sambhūyaikakāryārambhakatvaṃ nopapadyate, parasparopaghātakatvād dahanatuhinayor iva, tat kathaṃ sānnipātikavikārotpattiḥ? ‘ityatra’ iti pā.| atra samādhānam uktaṃ dṛḍhabalena, yathā
“viruddhair api na tv ete guṇair ghnanti parasparam|
doṣāḥ sahajasātmyatvād ghoraṃ viṣam ahīn iva||” iti| ‘dṛḍhabaloktahetudvayāt’ iti pā.| dṛḍhabaloktahetudvayād anyad dhetudvayaṃ gayadāsaś coktavān–
“daivād doṣasvabhāvād vā doṣāṇāṃ sānnipātike|
viruddhaiś ca guṇaiḥ ‘kaścinnopapātaḥ’ iti pā.| kaścin nopaghātaḥ parasparam||” iti||18-23||

div.ab:
doṣe vibaddhe naṣṭe 'gnau sarvasampūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ |
sannipātajvaro 'sādhyaḥ, kṛcchrasādhyas tato 'nyathā ||24|| (ca. ci. a. 3) |
( imau ślokau kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | saptame divase prāpte daśame dvādaśe 'pi vā |
punar ghorataro bhūtvā praśamaṃ yāti hanti vā |1|
saptamī dviguṇā caiva navamy ekādaśī tathā |
eṣā tridoṣamaryādā mokṣāya ca vadhāya ca) |2|

ab.seg: tasya sannipātajvarasyāsādhyalakṣaṇam āha– doṣe vibaddha ity ādi| doṣo malaṃ ‘pittādiśca’ iti pā.| vātādiś ca; jejjaṭas tu ‘malaṃ purīṣamāha’ iti ā. da.| malam evāha, vibaddha iti vacanāt| ‘āhārāpācakatvam’ iti pā.| naṣṭāgnitvam āhārāpākagamyam| yad uktaṃ carake– “agniṃ jaraṇaśaktyā” (ca. vi. a. 4) iti| asādhyakṛcchrasādhyābhidhānena sukhasādhyo na bhavatīti darśitam| uktaṃ ‘ca’ iti pā.| hi carake– “sannipāto duścikitsyānām” (ca. sū. a. 25) iti| tathā bhālukiḥ– “mṛtyunā saha yoddhavyaṃ sannipātaṃ cikitsatā||” iti| sarvasampūrṇalakṣaṇa iti sarvāṇi samagrāṇi, sampūrṇāni balīyāṃsi lakṣaṇāni yasya sa tathā||24||

saṅkṣepataḥ ‘tasya’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tasya sannipātajvarasyāsādhyalakṣaṇam āha– ‘doṣe ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | doṣe ity ādi| doṣo malaṃ vātādiś ca| jejjaṭas tu malaṃ purīṣam āha, vibaddha iti vacanāt| naṣṭāgnitvam iti annāvipākād avagantavyam| sarvāṇi sampūrṇāni lakṣaṇāni yasya sa tathā| īdṛśo 'sādhyaḥ, tato 'nyathā visadṛśaḥ avibaddhadoṣo 'lpalakṣaṇaḥ kṛcchrasādhyaḥ| asādhyatvakṛcchrasādhyatvābhidhānena sukhasādhyo na bhavatīti darśitam| uktaṃ ca bhālukinā–
“mṛtyunā saha yoddhavyaṃ sannipātaṃ cikitsatā|
yas tu tatra bhavej jetā sa jetā''mayasaṅkule||
sannipātārṇave magnaṃ yo 'bhyuddharati mānavam|
kas tena na kṛto dharmaḥ kāṃ vā pūjāṃ na so 'rhati||” iti| suśrute 'pi sannipātajvarasya mokṣavadhayor avadhikālo darśitaḥ–
“saptame divase prāpte daśame dvādaśe 'pi vā|
punar ghorataro bhūtvā praśamaṃ yāti hanti vā||” iti| bhālukinā'py uktam–
“saptamī dviguṇā yāvan navamy ekādaśī tathā|
eṣā tridoṣamaryādā mokṣāya ca vadhāya ca||” iti| uktaṃ ca– “pittakaphānilavṛddhyā daśadivasadvādaśāhasaptāhāt| hanti vimuñcati vā'pi tridoṣajo dhātumalapākāt||” iti| vātādhikaḥ saptame dine, pittādhiko daśame, śleṣmādhiko dvādaśe, malapākād vimuñcati, dhātupākād dhanti| dhātupākalakṣaṇaṃ tantrāntaroktam–
“sambādhyamāno hṛdi nābhideśe ‘netreṣu’ iti pā.| gātreṣu vā pākarujānviteṣu|
pakveṣu ‘vāteṣu’ iti pā.| vā teṣu rujā jvarārtaḥ sa dhātupākī kathito bhiṣagbhiḥ||” iti| tantrāntare 'py uktam–
“daśadvādaśasaptāhaiḥ pittaśleṣmānilādhikaḥ|
‘dagdhvoṣmaṇā’ iti pā., ‘dehoṣmaṇā’ iti capā.| paktvoṣmaṇā dhātumalān hanti muñcati vā jvaraḥ||” iti||24||

lg.l: śothaḥ sañjāyate tena kaścid eva pramucyate ||25||

ab.seg:
(ca. ci. a. 3) |
(trayaḥ prakupitā doṣā uraḥsroto 'nugāminaḥ |
āmābhivṛddhyā grathitā buddhīndriyamanogatāḥ ||1||

lg.l: śrutau netre prasuptiḥ syān na ceṣṭāṃ kāñcid īhate ||2||
na ca dṛṣṭir bhavet tasya samarthā rūpadarśane |
na ghrāṇaṃ na saṃsparśaṃ śabdaṃ vā naiva budhyate ||3||
alpaṃ prabhāṣate kiñcid abhinyāsaḥ sa ucyate |
pratyākhyātaḥ sa bhūyiṣṭhaḥ kaścid evātra sidhyati) ||5||

ab.seg: sannipātajvaropadravam āha– sannipātety ādi||25||

sannipātopadravam āha– ‘sannipātajvarasyetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sannipātajvarasyety ādi| sannipātajvarasya ante avasāne sannipātakṣapitaśarīrasya puṃsaḥ karṇamūle karṇaparyante sudāruṇaḥ kaṣṭatamaḥ śophaḥ samprāptiviśeṣāt karmavaicitryāt sañjāyate, tena śophena kaścid evāturo vimucyate, prāyo mārayatīty arthaḥ||25||

div.ab:
abhighātābhicārābhyām abhiśāpābhiṣaṅgataḥ |
āgantur jāyate doṣair yathāsvaṃ taṃ vibhāvayet ||26||
śyāvāsyatā viṣakṛte ‘śotho'tīsāra eva ca’ iti pā. | tathā'tīsāra eva ca |
bhaktāruciḥ pipāsā ca todaś ca saha mūrchayā ||27|| ‘auṣadhigandhaje’ iti pā.|
oṣadhigandhaje mūrchā śirorug vamathuḥ kṣavaḥ |
kāmaje cittavibhraṃśas tandrā''lasyam abhojanam ||28||
(hṛdaye vedanā cāsya gātraṃ ca ‘prakṛtikarmavaśādityarthaḥ’ iti pā. | pariśuṣyati) |
bhayāt pralāpaḥ śokāc ca bhavet kopāc ca vepathuḥ |
abhicārābhiśāpābhyāṃ mohas tṛṣṇā ca jāyate ||29||
bhūtābhiṣaṅgād udvego hāsyarodanakampanam |30| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

āgantujvaram āha– abhighātety ādi| abhighāto 'bhihananaṃ ‘śastraloṣṭramuṣṭilaguḍādibhiḥ’ iti pā.| śastraloṣṭamuṣṭilaguḍādibhiḥ; abhicāraḥ śyenādiyāgakṛtaḥ, ‘athavā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | athavā viparītair mantrair lohasrucā sarṣapādihoma ity āhuḥ| abhiṣaṅgaḥ kāmādīnāṃ bhūtānāṃ ca sambandhaḥ; yad uktaṃ carake–
“kāmaśokabhayakrodhair abhiṣaktasya yo jvaraḥ|
so 'bhiṣaṅgajvaro jñeyo yaś ca bhūtābhiṣaṅgajaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| abhiśāpo brāhmaṇaguruvṛddhasiddhānām aniṣṭābhiśaṃsanam| taṃ cāgantujvaraṃ yathāsvaṃ doṣair jānīyāt| yad uktam– “kāmaśokabhayād vāyuḥ” ity ādi| ayaṃ ca doṣasambandhaḥ paścādbhāvī na tv ārambhaka iti samprāptyavasare nirūpitam| śyāvāsyatety ādi| śyāvaḥ śuklānuviddhaḥ kṛṣṇo varṇaḥ; ‘śākavarṇaḥ’ iti pā.| śyāmavarṇa ‘ityeke’ iti pā.| ity anye| viṣakṛte ‘sthāvaraviṣabhakṣaṇakṛte’ iti pā.| sthāvaraviṣabhakṣaṇādikṛte; atīsāraḥ tadviṣasyādhogatvāt| oṣadhigandhaja iti ‘auṣadhigandhaghrāṇaje’ iti pā., ‘tīvrauṣadhighrāṇaje’ iti ca pā.| tīvrauṣadhigandhaghrāṇaje, “puṣpebhyo gandharajasī ‘oṣadhībhyaḥ’ iti pā.| ojasvibhyo yadā'nilaḥ|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) ity ādinā vṛddhasuśrutena paṭhitaṃ tṛṇapuṣpākhyaṃ jvaram atraivāntarbhāvayanti| kāmaja ity ādi abhimatakāminyādyaprāptinimitte| cittavibhraṃśo bhramādiḥ| yad āha vāgbhaṭaḥ– “kāmād bhramo 'rucir dāho hrīnidrādhīdhṛtikṣayaḥ|” (vā. ni. a. 2) iti| bhayād iti bhayāj jāte jvare| evaṃ ‘śokāt’ iti pā.| śokāc ca kopād ity etayor boddhavyaṃ; ‘śokācca’ iti pā.| śokāt pralāpa iti sambandhaḥ; pralāpaś cātra vātakāryaḥ, tasya ‘vātakopitapittakāryatvāt’ iti pā.| vātapittakāryatvāt| ( ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | viśeṣaniścayas tu nidānāt, nidānam api lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati|) uktaṃ ca– “kāmaśokabhayād vāyuḥ, krodhāt pittaṃ, trayo malāḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 3) ity ādi| yady evaṃ tat kutaḥ krodhaje vepathuḥ? tasya vātakāryatvāt| ucyate– “ekaḥ prakupito doṣaḥ sarvān eva prakopayet|” iti vacanāt pittakopitavātajanya evātra vepathuḥ, ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | athavā kruddhaś ca vepamāno dṛśyate iti na hi ‘ dṛṣṭeranupapannaṃ nāmeti’ ityasya sthāne ‘dṛṣṭeranupapannamiti’ iti pā.| dṛṣṭer anupapannaṃ nāmeti jejjaṭaḥ| krodhaḥ ‘pittamatha’ iti pā.| pittam iva vātaṃ ca kopayatīti, tad yuktam| yad āha videhaḥ– “krodhaśokau smṛtau vātaraktapittaprakopaṇau|” iti| kopāc ceti cakāreṇa śirorujaṃ samuccinoti| yad āha vāgbhaṭaḥ– “krodhāt kampaḥ śiroruk ca, pralāpo bhayaśokajaḥ|” (vā. ni. a. 2) iti| mānasatvāviśeṣe 'pi bhayajādīnāṃ ‘pṛthagupapādo’ iti pā.| pṛthag upādānaṃ hetubhedāt; ‘hetubhedābhidhānaṃ ca’ iti pā.| hetubhedāc ca bhedābhidhānaṃ hetupratyanīkacikitsārtham iti| abhicārety ādi| tṛṣṇā ceti cakāreṇābhicāraje dāhādikaṃ samuccinoti| yad uktaṃ ‘hārītadarśinā’ iti pā.| hārītārthānuvādinā vāgbhaṭena–
“tatrābhicārikair mantrair hūyamānasya tapyate|
pūrvaṃ cetas tato dehas tato visphoṭatṛḍbhramaiḥ|| ‘sadāhamūrchāgrastasya’ iti pā.| sadāhamūrchair grastasya pratyahaṃ vardhate jvaraḥ|” (vā. ni. a. 2) iti| bhūtābhiṣaṅgād iti ‘bhūtāni’ iti pā.| bhūtā devagrahādaya unmādanidāne vakṣyamāṇāḥ, teṣām abhiṣaṅgaḥ sambandhaḥ| udvega udvignacittatā||26-29||–

ab.seg:
athāgantukajvaralakṣaṇam āha– ‘abhighātetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | abhighātety ādi| abhighāto lohaśastrakāṣṭhādinā, abhicāraḥ viparītair mantraiḥ lohasrucā sarṣapādihomaḥ, abhiṣaṅgaḥ kāmādīnāṃ bhūtādīnāṃ ca sambandhaḥ, abhiśāpaḥ brāhmaṇaguruvṛddhasiddhānām ākrośo 'niṣṭāpādanam abhiśapanam| taṃ cāgantukajvaraṃ ‘yathāsvairdoṣairjānīyāt’ iti pāṭha.| yathāsvadoṣair jānīyāt| yad uktaṃ “kāmaśokabhayād vāyuḥ” ity ādi| ayaṃ ca doṣasambandhaḥ paścādbhāvī na tv ārambhaka iti samprāptyavasare nirūpitam| āgantujvarāṇāṃ vaicitryam āha– ‘śyāvetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śyāvety ādi| śyāvaḥ śuklānuviddhaḥ kṛṣṇo varṇaḥ, śyāvavarṇa ity anye| viṣakṛte sthāvarādiviṣabhakṣaṇādikṛte, viṣasya tridoṣakartṛtve 'pi atyantapittakaratvāt śyāvamukhatvam| atisāraḥ sthāvaraviṣayasyādhogatvāt| todo vyathā| śeṣaṃ sugamam| tīvrauṣadhigandhaghrāṇaje vamathuḥ chardiḥ, kṣavaḥ chikkā| śeṣaṃ sugamam| kāmaje abhimatakāminyādyaprāptinimittaje| cittavibhraṃśaḥ kiṅkartavyatāmūḍhatvam| yad uktaṃ vāgbhaṭe–
“kāmād bhramo 'ratir dāho hrīnidrādhīdhṛtikṣayaḥ|
dhyānaniḥśvāsabahulaṃ liṅgaṃ kāmajvare smṛtam||” iti| śeṣaṃ subodham| bhayaśokakopābhiṣaṅgajvaram āha– kvacitpustake ‘bhayādityādi| bhayāditi bhayājjāte jvare’ etatsthāne ‘bhayāditi’ iti pā.| bhayād ity ādi| bhayād iti bhayāj jāte jvare, evaṃ śokāt kopād ity atrāpi boddhavyam| pralāpaḥ asambaddhabhāṣaṇaṃ, vepathuḥ kampaḥ, ‘bhayājjāte jvare tathā śokāt kopādityetayorboddhavyam|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhayāj jāte jvare tathā śokāt kopād ity etayor boddhavyam| śokāt pralāpa iti sambandhaḥ| kvacitpustake ‘pralāpaścātra vātakāryaḥ, sarvadaiva tasya vātakāryatvāt, viśeṣaniścayaśca nidānāt; nidānamapi kvacillakṣaṇaṃ bhavati| yadyevaṃ tatkathaṃ krodhādvepathuḥ, tasyāpi vātakāryatvāt|’ etatsthāne ‘viśeṣaniścayaśca nidānāt; anye nidānamapi kvacillakṣaṇaṃ bhavati| pralāpaścātra vātakāryaḥ, sarvadaiva tasya vātakāryatvāt, yadyevaṃ tatkathaṃ krodhādvepathuḥ, tasya api vātakāryatvāt|’ iti pā.| pralāpaś cātra vātakāryaḥ, sarvadaiva tasya vātakāryatvāt, viśeṣaniścayaś ca nidānāt; nidānam api kvacil lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati| yady evaṃ tat kathaṃ krodhād vepathuḥ, tasyāpi vātakāryatvāt| ucyate– “ekaḥ prakupito doṣaḥ sarvān eva prakopaye|t” iti pittakopitavātajanya evātra vepathuḥ, kruddhaś ca vepamāno dṛśyate kvacitpustake ‘iti na hi’ etatsthāne ‘na hīdṛśam’ iti pā.| iti na hi dṛṣṭer anupapannaṃ nāmeti jejjaṭaḥ| krodhaḥ pittam iva vātaṃ ca kopayatīti yuktaṃ; yad āha videhaḥ– “krodhaśokau smṛtau vātaraktapittaprakopaṇau|” iti| kopāc ceti cakāreṇa śirorogaṃ samuccinoti| yad āha vāgbhaṭaḥ– “krodhāt kampaḥ śiroruk ca pralāpo bhayaśokaje|” iti| mānasatvāviśeṣe 'pi bhayajādīnāṃ pṛthag upādānaṃ hetubhedāt, hetubhedāc ca bhedābhidhānaṃ ‘na tupratyanīkacikitsārthamiti’ iti pā.| hetupratyanīkacikitsārtham iti| abhicārābhiśāpābhyāṃ jāte jvare ‘mohaḥ acaitanyaṃ ca’ iti pā.| moho 'caitanyaṃ jāyate; abhicāro mantrādibhir māraṇaprayogaḥ, abhiśāpo brahmarṣigurusiddhādīnām abhiśapanam ākrośaḥ| tṛṣṇā ceti cakāreṇābhicāraje dāhādikaṃ samuccinoti| yad uktaṃ hārītamatānuvādinā vāgbhaṭena–
“tantrābhicārikair mantrair hūyamānasya tapyate|
pūrvaṃ cetas tato dehas tato visphoṭatṛḍbhramaiḥ|| sadāhamūrchāgrastasya pratyahaṃ vardhate jvaraḥ|” iti| bhūtā devagrahādaya unmādanidāne vakṣyamāṇāḥ, teṣām abhisamantāt saṅgas tasmāt| udvega udvignacittatā||26-29||

lg.l: kāmaśokabhayād vāyuḥ, krodhāt pittaṃ, trayo malāḥ ||30||
