div.ab: āgantujvareṣv api pratiniyatadoṣānubandhapradarśanārtham āha– kāmaśokety ādi| trayo malā bhūtābhiṣaṅgāt kupyantīti bhūtaprabhāvāt| yac ca carakeṇa nidānasthāne ‘abhiṣaṅgajaḥ punar vātapittābhyāṃ’ (ca. ni. a. 1) ity uktaṃ, tat prāyikaṃ mantavyam iti jejjaṭaḥ| cakras tv āha– “abhiṣaṅgaja ity anena kāmādyabhiṣaṅgaja ucyate, na tu bhūtābhiṣaṅgajaḥ|” iti| bhūtasāmānyalakṣaṇā iti yasya bhūtasya devagrahāder abhiṣaṅgāt kupyanti tasya yal lakṣaṇaṃ rodanādi tena ‘saha’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | saha sāmānyaṃ ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sadṛśa lakṣaṇaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathā, iti vyācakṣate jejjaṭādayaḥ; doṣalakṣaṇāni bhūtalakṣaṇāni ca bhavantīty arthaḥ||30||–

āgantujeṣu pratiniyatadoṣānubandhān pradarśayann āha– ‘kāmetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kāmety ādi| kāmaśokabhayair vāyuḥ kupyati, krodhena pittaṃ, bhūtābhiṣaṅgāt trayo doṣāḥ kupyanti| bhūtasāmānyalakṣaṇā iti yasya bhūtasya devagrahāder abhiṣaṅgāt prakupyanti tasya yal lakṣaṇaṃ rodanādi tena saha sāmānyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathā iti vyācakṣate jejjaṭādayaḥ| doṣalakṣaṇāni bhūtalakṣaṇāni ca bhavantīty arthaḥ; ‘tacca vakṣyamāṇe unmādanidāne draṣṭavyam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tac ca vakṣyamāṇe unmādanidāne draṣṭavyam||30||–

ab.seg:
dhātum anyatamaṃ prāpya karoti viṣamajvaram |32| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |
(santataḥ satato 'nyedyus tṛtīyakacaturthakau) ||2||

div.ab:
atha viṣamajvarasamprāptim āha– doṣo 'lpa ity ādi| alpa ‘ityanenānatibalatvāt’ iti pā.| ity anenābalatvāt kālaviśeṣam avāpya labdhabalo jvarayati, yas tu balavān sa nityajvaram eva karoti| ahitasambhūta iti ‘...cārādijanitaḥ’ iti pā.| ahitāhārācārādisambhūto vṛddhaḥ| jvarotsṛṣṭasya sahasā nivṛttajvarasya| vāśabdena prathamato 'pi viṣamajvaro bhavatīti darśayati| yad uktam– “ārambhād viṣamo yas tu” ity ādi| dhātum anyatamaṃ rasaraktādikam| viṣamajvaraṃ tṛtīyakādikam| viṣamajvarasāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ ca bhālukinā paṭhitam–
“yaḥ syād aniyatāt kālāc chītoṣṇābhyāṃ tathaiva ca|
vegataś cāpi viṣamo jvaraḥ sa viṣamaḥ smṛtaḥ||” iti||31||–

atha viṣamajvarasamprāptim āha– ‘doṣa ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | doṣa ity ādi| jvarotsṛṣṭasya puṃso 'lpo doṣaḥ punar ahitasambhūtaḥ san anyatamaṃ dhātuṃ prāpya viṣamajvaraṃ karoti| alpa ity anenābalatvāt kālaviśeṣam avāpya labdhabalo jvarayati, yas tu balavān sa nityam eva jvaraṃ karoti| ahitasambhūta iti ahitāhārācārādijanitaḥ| jvarotsṛṣṭasya sahasā nivṛttajvarasya| vāśabdena prathamato 'pi viṣamajvaro bhavatīti ‘darśayati’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | darśayati| yad uktam– “ārambhād viṣamau yas tu” iti| dhātum anyatamaṃ rasaraktādikam| viṣamajvaraṃ tṛtīyādikam| viṣamajvarasāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ ca bhālukinā paṭhitaṃ; tad yathā–
“yaḥ syād aniyatāt kālāc chītoṣṇābhyāṃ tathaiva ca|
vegataś cāpi viṣamo jvaraḥ sa viṣamaḥ smṛtaḥ||” iti| ‘ete dhātugatāḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ete dhātugatāḥ||31||–

santataṃ rasaraktasthaḥ, so 'nyedyuḥ piśitāśritaḥ ||32||
medogatas tṛtīye 'hni ‘asthimajjagataḥ’ iti pā.| tv asthimajjagataḥ punaḥ |
kuryāc caturthakaṃ ghoram antakaṃ rogasaṅkaram ||33|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 31) |

ab.seg: santatādijvarāṇāṃ pratiniyatadūṣyān dhātūn āha– santatam ity ādi| santataśabdaḥ ‘upalakṣaṇam’ iti pā.| satatasyopalakṣaṇaḥ| tenaitad uktaṃ bhavati– rasasthaḥ santataṃ, raktasthaḥ ‘satatamiti’ iti pā.| satatakam iti; yad uktaṃ carake– “ ‘raktadhātvāśrito doṣaḥ kuryāt’ iti pā.| raktadhātvāśrayaḥ prāyo doṣaḥ satatakaṃ jvaram|” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti ( ( ) etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | prāyograhaṇāt satatako raktavyatiriktaṃ rasadhātum āśrayate)| rasagrahaṇaṃ cātra viśeṣaparaṃ, sarvajvareṣu rasasyāvaśyadūṣyatvāt| anye tu satatagrahaṇārthaṃ ‘santatau rasaraktasthau’ iti paṭhanti| tan nātiyuktam, atra hi santatasatataśabdau sañjñāparau, na tu sātatyavacanau; tena santataśabdena satatakasyānabhidhānāt katham ekaśeṣa iti doṣaḥ| anyedyur iti anyedyuṣkam| ghoraṃ duḥsaham| antakaṃ yamam iva, mārakatvāt| rogasaṅkaram anekarogasaṅkulam||32-33||

santatādijvarāṇāṃ pratiniyatadūṣyān dhātūn āha– rasaraktastho doṣaḥ santataṃ kuryād ity adhyāhāryamāṇena sambandhaḥ| ‘yo doṣo rasaraktāśrayaḥ sa santataṃ jvaraṃ karoti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yo doṣo rasaraktāśrayaḥ sa santataṃ jvaraṃ karoti| santataśabdaḥ satatasyopalakṣaṇaḥ| tenaitad uktaṃ bhavati– rasasthaḥ santataṃ, raktasthaḥ satatakam iti yad uktaṃ carake– “raktadhātvāśrayaḥ prāyo doṣaḥ satatakaṃ jvaram|” iti| rasagrahaṇaṃ cātra viśeṣaparaṃ, sarvajvareṣu rasasyāvaśyaṃ duṣṭatvāt| anye tu kvacitpustake ‘satataṃ sātatyārthakaṃ manyamānāḥ’ etatsthāne ‘satatagrahaṇārtham’ iti pā.| satataṃ sātatyārthakaṃ manyamānāḥ “santatau rasaraktasthau” iti paṭhanti| tan na yuktam| atra hetuḥ– santatasatataśabdau cātra sañjñāparau na tu sātatyavacanau, tena santataśabdena satatakasyānabhidhānāt katham ekaśeṣaḥ? bhinnarūpayoḥ samānārthayor eva ekaśeṣavidhānāt| tathā ca vārtikam– “virūpāṇām api samānārthānām” iti| kecit tu “satataṃ rasaraktasthaḥ” iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhitvā rasaraktastho doṣaḥ satatakaṃ jvaraṃ karotīti| anye tv atra santatam iti luptaṃ varṇayitvā santataṃ rasasthaḥ satataṃ raktasthaḥ kuryād ity ācakṣate| so 'nyedyur iti sa iti doṣaḥ, piśitāśrito māṃsāśritaḥ, anyedyur iti anyedyuṣkam| doṣo 'sthimajjagataś caturthe 'hni cāturthakaṃ kuryāt| kīdṛśaṃ cāturthakaṃ? ‘ghorasuduḥsaham’ iti pā.| ghoraṃ suduḥsaham| antakaṃ yamam iva mārakatvāt| rogasaṅkaram anekarogasaṅkulaṃ, yato gambhīrasthānatvāc cirakleśanatvāc ca rogān anyān apy āvahati||32-33||

div.ab:
(srotobhir visṛtā doṣā guravo rasavāhibhiḥ |
kvacitpustake ‘sarvadehānugāḥ stabdhā jvaraṃ kurvanti santatam’ etatsthāne ‘sarvadehānugāḥ sarve kurvate santataṃ jvaraṃ’ iti pā.| sarvadehānugāḥ stabdhā jvaraṃ kurvanti santatam) |
saptāhaṃ vā daśāhaṃ vā dvādaśāham athāpi vā |
santatyā yo 'visargī syāt santataḥ sa nigadyate ||34||
ahorātre satatako dvau kālāv anuvartate |
anyedyuṣkas tv ahorātra ekakālaṃ pravartate ||35||
tṛtīyakas tṛtīye 'hni, caturthe 'hni caturthakaḥ |36| (su. u. taṃ. a. 31) |

athaiṣāṃ lakṣaṇāny āha– saptāham ity ādi| ete vikalpā yathākramaṃ vātapittakapholbaṇatvena jñeyāḥ| yathoktam– “pittakaphānilavṛddhyā daśadivasadvādaśāhasaptāhāt| hanti vimuñcati vā''śu tridoṣajo dhātumalapākāt||” iti| ayaṃ ca santatas tridoṣaja eva ‘dvādaśāhāśrayatvena’ iti pā.| dvādaśāśrayatvena| yad uktaṃ carakeṇa–
“yathā dhātūṃs tathā mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ cānilādayaḥ|
yugapac cānupadyante niyamāt santate jvare||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| santatyā avicchedena saptāhādīn vyāpya avisargī aparityāgī, atyantasaṃyoge dvitīyā| nanu, yady evaṃ katham asya ‘viṣamajvaraprakaraṇe’ iti pā.| viṣamajvare pāṭhaḥ? muktānubandhitvaṃ viṣamatvaṃ, tac cātra nāsti| naivam, asyāpi tathābhāvāt| tathā ca tallakṣaṇe carakaḥ–
“visargaṃ dvādaśe kṛtvā ‘divase vyaktalakṣaṇaḥ’ iti pā.| divase 'vyaktalakṣaṇaḥ|
durlabhopaśamaḥ kālaṃ dīrgham apy anuvartate||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| ‘yaduktam’ iti pā.| yat tūktaṃ kharanādena–
“jvarāḥ pūrvaṃ mayoktā ye pañca santatakādayaḥ|
catvāraḥ santataṃ hitvā jñeyās te viṣamajvarāḥ||” iti; tat santate muktānubandhitvasyaikadā bhāvitvenālpatvān na tadvyapadeśaḥ, ekataṇḍulābhyavahāre 'naśanaśabdasya vyapadeśavat; na hi tṛtīyakādivad āvṛttyā muktānubandhitvam asyety abhiprāyeṇa draṣṭavyam| athavā yā ‘viṣamajvarollekhenoktā’ iti pā.| viṣamajvarollekhena ‘cikitsā’ iti pā.| cikitsoktā sā ‘santate varjyā’ iti pā.| santatavarjaṃ satatādiṣu kāryeti pratipādanārtham| haricandreṇāpi ‘kila’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kila| “karma sādhāraṇaṃ jahyāt tṛtīyakacaturthakau|” iti (ca. ci. a. 3) carakavacanād viṣamajvaroktacikitsā tṛtīyakacaturthakayor eva, anyeṣu doṣapratyanīkacikitsā ‘kāryetyabhidhāya vyākhyātam’ iti pā.| kāryeti vyākhyātam| asyāṃ haricandravyākhyāyāṃ karma sādhāraṇaṃ sarvatraiva viṣamajvare kāryaṃ, viśeṣeṇa tṛtīyakacaturthakayor iti draṣṭavyam; anyathā uktatantrāntaravirodhaḥ| ahorātre satatako dvau kālāv anuvartata iti ahni dvau kālau rātrau atra ‘dvau’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| dvau kālau vā; ahni ekakālaṃ rātrāv ekakālam evaṃ vā; dvau kālau itīśānadevaḥ, niyamānabhidhānāt ‘tṛtīyamānānabhidhānāt’ iti pā.| tathā darśanāc ca| anuvartate vegaṃ karoti| tṛtīye 'hni tṛtīyaka iti vegadināpekṣayā tṛtīye 'hni yo bhavati sa tṛtīyako ‘bhavati’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhavati, evaṃ caturthake 'pi vācyam||34-35||– kvacitpustake ‘idānīmekadoṣadvidoṣajasya santatajvarasya visargakālāvadhidvāreṇa lakṣaṇamāha– srotobhirityādi|’ etatsthāne ‘santatasamprāptimāha-’ iti pā.|

idānīm ekadoṣadvidoṣajasya santatajvarasya visargakālāvadhidvāreṇa lakṣaṇam āha– srotobhir ity ādi| sarvagātrānugāḥ sarve doṣā vātādayaḥ santatam avichinnaṃ kvacitpustake ‘jvaraṃ santāpaṃ’ etatsthāne ‘santāpaṃ jvaraṃ’ iti pā.| jvaraṃ santāpaṃ kurvanti| kimbhūtāḥ rasavāhibhiḥ srotobhiḥ atra ‘vistṛtāḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā., ‘vivṛtāḥ’ iti ca pā.| vistṛtāḥ vistṛtiṃ prāptāḥ, guravo duḥsahāḥ, sarvagātrānugāḥ santāpādinā samagraṃ gātraṃ ‘vyāpnuvate’ iti pā.| vyāpnuvanti| santatyā nairantaryeṇa saptāhādīn vyāpya avisargī atyāgaśīlaḥ sa jvaraḥ santataḥ| ayaṃ sukhasādhyaḥ; tad
uktaṃ tantrāntare “santatajvara evānyaḥ ‘svalpo durbalakārakaḥ’ iti pā.| svalpadurbalakāraṇaḥ|
ekadoṣo dvidoṣo vā sukhasādhyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ||” iti| tathā ca– “vātikaḥ saptarātreṇa daśarātreṇa paittikaḥ| ślaiṣmiko dvādaśāhena jvaraḥ pākaṃ ‘niyacchati’ iti pā.| pragacchati” iti, prakṛtisamasamavetatvāt| nanu katham asya viṣamajvare pāṭhaḥ? yad uktaṃ kharanādena–
“jvarāḥ pañca mayoktā ye pūrvaṃ santatakādayaḥ|
catvāraḥ santataṃ hitvā jñeyās te viṣamajvarāḥ||” iti; muktānubandhitvād viṣamatvaṃ, vimucyānubadhnātīti, tac cātra nāsti| naivam, asyāpi tathābhāvāt| tathā ca tallakṣaṇe carakaḥ–
“visargaṃ dvādaśe kṛtvā divase 'vyaktalakṣaṇam|
durlabhopaśamaḥ kālaṃ dīrgham apy anuvartate||” iti| satatakādīnāṃ kālānuvartanatvena lakṣaṇam āha– ‘ahorātra ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ahorātra ity ādi| kālāḥ ṣaṭ pūrvāhṇamadhyāhnāparāhṇakapradoṣārdharātrapratyūṣāḥ; pūrvāhṇapradoṣayoḥ kaphasya kālaḥ, madhyāhnārdharātrayoḥ pittasya, aparāhṇapratyūṣayor vātasya| pūrvāhṇādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ kālānāṃ madhye ‘kāladvayamapyanuvartate’ iti pā.| kāladvayam anuvartate, vegaṃ karoti ‘sa’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sa satataḥ; ‘ahni ekakālaṃ rātrāvekakālaṃ vā, ahni dvau kālau rātrau dvau kālau vā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ahni ekakālaṃ rātrāv ekakālaṃ vā, ahni dvau kālau rātrau dvau kālau vā, kvacitpustake ‘evaṃ dvau kālāviti īśāno yaduktavān tatra doṣotkarṣāpakarṣābhyāmadhikakālatvaṃ hīnakālatvamapi jñātavyaṃ na tu niyamaḥ| anyedyuṣko jvara ekakālamanuvartate vegaṃ karoti ahorātrādanyasminnahorātre ekakālamāgacchatītyarthaḥ| tṛtīyakaḥ tṛtīye'hni ekakālamiti sambadhyate| cāturthakaścaturthe'hnītyatrāpyekaṃ kālamiti|’ etatsthāne ‘anyedyuṣko jvara ekakālamanuvartate vegaṃ karoti ahorātrādanyasminnahorātre ekakālamāgacchatītyarthaḥ| tṛtīyakaḥ tṛtīye'hni ekakālamiti sambadhyate| cāturthakaścaturthe'hnītyatrāpyekaṃ kālamiti| evaṃ dvau kālāviti īśāno yaduktavān tatra doṣotkarṣāpakarṣābhyāmadhikakālatvaṃ hīnakālatvamapi jñātavyaṃ na tu niyamaḥ|’ iti pā.| evaṃ dvau kālāv iti īśāno yad uktavān tatra doṣotkarṣāpakarṣābhyām adhikakālatvaṃ hīnakālatvam api jñātavyaṃ na tu niyamaḥ| anyedyuṣko jvara ekakālam anuvartate vegaṃ karoti ahorātrād anyasminn ahorātre ekakālam āgacchatīty arthaḥ| tṛtīyakaḥ tṛtīye 'hni ekakālam iti sambadhyate| cāturthakaś caturthe 'hnīty atrāpy ekaṃ kālam iti| ete catvāro viṣamajvarāḥ| yad uktaṃ kharanādena– “jvarāḥ pañca mayoktāḥ” ity ādinā| eṣāṃ cotpattikramo vṛddhasuśrutād avagantavyaḥ, sa ‘tadāha’ iti pā.| yad āha–
“ ‘ahorātrādahorātraṃ sthānātsthānaṃ’ iti pā.| ahorātrād ahorātrāt sthānāt sthāne prapadyate|
tataś cāmāśayaṃ prāpya karoti viṣamajvaram||
tathā pralepako jñeyaḥ śoṣiṇāṃ prāṇanāśanaḥ|
duścikitsyatamo mandaḥ sa kaṣṭo dhātuśoṣakṛt||
kṛśānāṃ jvaramuktānāṃ mithyāhāravihāriṇām|
doṣaḥ svalpo 'pi saṃvṛddho dehinām anileritaḥ||
kaphasthānavibhāgena yathāsaṅkhyaṃ karoti hi|
satatānyedyuṣkatryākhyacaturthān sapralepakān||” iti| asyāyam arthaḥ– āmāśayahṛdayakaṇṭhaśiraḥsandhaya iti pañca kaphasthānāni, eṣu sthitair doṣair yathāsaṅkhyam ahorātrāt sthānaṃ prapadya āmāśayaṃ gatvā satatādayaḥ kriyante| tatrāmāśayasthitena doṣeṇa satataḥ kriyate parantu dvikālaṃ na ca sarvadā; na cāmāśayaprāptyā sarvadā'sya ‘sambhavaprasaṅge'pi’ iti pā.| sambhavaprasaṅgaḥ, ahorātre svaprakopakālāpekṣayā jvarotpatteḥ| hṛdayasthitena doṣeṇa ekasmin dine āmāśayam āgatyānyedyuḥ kriyate, ‘satatārambhakadoṣāpekṣayā asya’ iti pā.| satatārambhakadoṣāpekṣayāsya vyavahitatvāt| kaṇṭhasthitena doṣeṇaikasmin dine hṛdayam āgamyate, anyasmin dine āmāśayam āgatya ‘jvaramārabhyate sa’ iti pā.| jvara ārabhyate tṛtīyakaḥ| evaṃ śirasi sthitena doṣeṇa kaṇṭhahṛdayāmāśayān tribhir dinaiḥ krameṇa prāpya caturthe 'hni cāturthakaḥ kriyate| punaḥ svasthānagamanaṃ tu doṣāṇāṃ hṛtavegatvena lāghavād vegadina eva bhavati| sandhisthitena doṣeṇa pralepakaḥ, sandhayaś cāmāśaye 'pi santīti sa sarvadā bhavati| aviṣamo 'py ayaṃ viṣamasahacaritaḥ paṭhitaḥ, ‘kaphasthānotpādakānurodhāt’ iti pā.| kaphasthānotpādānurodhāt| uktaṃ hi suśrute– “ ‘pralepakastu viṣamaḥ’ iti pā.| pralepakas tv aviṣamaḥ prāyaḥ kleśāya śoṣiṇām|” iti| viṣamajvara evānyaś cāturthakaviparyayaḥ, iti| atra tantrāntare–
“asthimajjobhayagate cāturthikaviparyayaḥ|
madhye 'hani jvarayati hy ādāv ante ca muñcati||” iti| ādāv ekadinaṃ na bhūtvā madhye dinadvayaṃ bhūtvā ante ekadinaṃ na bhavatīti vyācakṣate jejjaṭādayaḥ|
“asthimajjobhayagate cāturthakaviparyayaḥ|
tryahād dvyahaṃ jvarayati hy ādāv ante vimuñcati||” iti ‘tantrāntaram’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tantrāntaram| ‘cāturthikaviparyayo’ iti pā.| cāturthakaviparyayo nāmnā jvaraḥ| asthi ca majjā ca asthimajjānau asthimajjñor ubhayaṃ tatra gato yo malo 'sthiṣu majjasu vā gatas tasmin ‘triprakāro jāyate’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | triprakāro jāyate||34-35||–
kecid bhūtābhiṣaṅgotthaṃ bruvate viṣamajvaram ||36|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

ab.seg:
viṣamajvarasyaikīyamatena bhūtābhiṣaṅgajatvam āha– kecid ity ādi| paravacanam apratiṣiddham anumataṃ suśrutena; ata eva viṣamajvare daivavyapāśrayaṃ balihomādi bhūtocitaṃ, yuktivyapāśrayaṃ kaṣāyapānādi doṣocitaṃ ca vidhīyate| yad āha carakaḥ–
“karma sādhāraṇaṃ jahyāt tṛtīyakacaturthakau|
āgantur anubandho hi prāyaśo viṣamajvare||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| atra sādhāraṇam iti daivayuktivyapāśrayam iti vyācakṣate iti||36||

parakīyamatam āha– kecid ity ādi| kecana ācāryā viṣamajvaraṃ bhūtābhiṣaṅgotthaṃ kathayanti| ata eva viṣamajvare daivavyapāśrayaṃ balimaṅgalahomādibhūtocitaṃ yuktivyapāśrayaṃ kaṣāyapānādikaṃ kvacitpustake ‘doṣocitaṃ ca’ etatsthāne ‘doṣocite’ iti pā.| doṣocitaṃ ca vidhīyate| yad āha carakaḥ–
“karma sādhāraṇaṃ jahyāt tṛtīyakacaturthakau|
āgantur anubandho hi prāyaśo ‘viṣamajvaraḥ’ iti pā.| viṣamajvare||” iti| atra sādhāraṇam iti daivayuktivyapāśrayam iti vyācakṣate||36||

div.ab:
kaphapittāt trikagrāhī pṛṣṭhād vātakaphātmakaḥ |
vātapittāc chirogrāhī trividhaḥ syāt tṛtīyakaḥ ||37||
caturthako darśayati prabhāvaṃ dvividhaṃ jvaraḥ |
jaṅghābhyāṃ ślaiṣmikaḥ pūrvaṃ śirasto 'nilasambhavaḥ ||38|| (ca. ci. a. 3) |

ab.seg:
ulbaṇadoṣabhedena tṛtīyakacaturthakayor lakṣaṇāntaram āha– kaphapittād ity ādi| trikagrāhī vedanayā trikavyāpī, trikasya vātasthānatvena tadgatau pittakaphāv anyasthānagatatvena durbalau ‘tṛtīye dine’ iti pā.| tṛtīyadine vegaṃ kurutaḥ, yadi tu svasthānasthitau syātāṃ tadā ‘santatameva’ iti pā.| santatajvaram eva kuryātām iti jejjaṭaḥ| evaṃ śirasi kaphasthāne, pṛṣṭhe ca pittasthāne boddhavyam| pṛṣṭhād iti lyablope karmaṇi pañcamī, pṛṣṭhaṃ vedanayā vyāpyety arthaḥ| na ca vācyaṃ yadi trikaṃ vātasthānaṃ tat kathaṃ tatra pittakaphāv iti; prakṛtisthānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ sthānaniyamo na tu prakupitānāṃ, teṣāṃ sarvadehagatatvāt| yad āha suśrutaḥ–
“kupitānāṃ hi doṣāṇāṃ śarīre paridhāvatām|
yatra saṅgaḥ khavaiguṇyād vyādhis tatropajāyate||” (su. sū. a. 24) iti| evam anyasthānagatatvena doṣadaurbalyādi caturthake 'pi vācyam| prabhāvaṃ ‘rujārūpaśaktim’ iti pā.| rujārūpāṃ śaktim| ‘dvaividhyam’ iti pā.| dvividhaṃ vivṛṇoti– ‘jaṅghābhyāmityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | jaṅghābhyām ity ādi| jaṅghābhyāṃ śirasta iti| etac ca pañcamīdvayaṃ pūrvavat| pūrvam iti prathamaṃ, tatra bhūtvā ‘sarvadeham’ iti pā.| nikhilaṃ dehaṃ vyāpnoti| ślaiṣmika iti śleṣmolbaṇaḥ, santatasatatakānyedyuṣkatṛtīyakacaturthakānāṃ pañcānāṃ ‘sannipātajatvāt’ iti pā.| sānnipātikatvāt| yad uktaṃ carake–
“prāyaśaḥ sannipātena dṛṣṭaḥ pañcavidho jvaraḥ|
sannipāte tu yo bhūyān sa doṣaḥ parikīrtitaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| athavā ‘prāyograhaṇena ekadoṣajā’ iti pā.| prāyograhaṇād ekadoṣajā dvidoṣajā api bhavanti| anye tv āhuḥ– vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhāḥ santatādayaḥ sannipātajāḥ, teṣām evodbhūtadoṣeṇa vyapadeśaḥ; prakṛtisamasamavāyārabdhās te ‘tvekadoṣajā’ iti pā.| ekadoṣajadvidoṣajā api bhavantīti jejjaṭaḥ| ‘caturthakastu’ iti pā.| prakṛtisamasamavāyārabdhaś caturthakas tu pittena na kriyata eva, vyādhisvabhāvāt; pittajagalagaṇḍavat| nanu, asti paittiko 'pi caturthakaḥ; tathā ca ‘hārīto’ iti pā.| hārītācāryo vyāharati–
“caturthako nāma gado dāruṇo viṣamajvaraḥ|
śoṣaṇaḥ sarvadhātūnāṃ balavarṇāgnināśanaḥ||
tridoṣajo vikāraḥ syād asthimajjagato 'nilaḥ|
kupitaṃ pittam evaṃ tu kaphaś caivaṃ ‘svakālataḥ’ iti pā.| svabhāvataḥ||
śītadāhakaras tīvras trikālaṃ cānuvartate|
‘sa sannipātasambhūto’ iti pā.| sannipātasamudbhūto viṣamo viṣamajvaraḥ||
ūrdhvaṃ kāyasya gṛhṇāti yaḥ pūrvaṃ so 'nilātmakaḥ|
pūrvaṃ gṛhṇāty adhaḥkāyaṃ ‘śleṣmapūrvajvaraśca saḥ’ iti pā.| śleṣmavṛddhaś caturthakaḥ||” iti| atrāhuḥ– anubandharūpam atra pittaṃ, na tv ārambhakaṃ; katham eṣā pratītir iti cet, sthānaviśeṣānabhidhānāt; ata eva hārītenāpi sthānaṃ nodāhṛtam eva jaṅghādivad iti carakaṭīkākṛto vyācakṣate| kintv eṣā vyākhyā tadā saṅgacchate yadi pittaliṅgaṃ kvacitpustake ‘nodbhūtaṃ dṛśyate, dṛśyate ca;’ etatsthāne ‘samudbhūtaṃ na dṛśyate|’ iti pā.| nodbhūtaṃ dṛśyate, dṛśyate ca; ‘tathā’ iti pā.| tathā hi kathyate– bheḍe 'pi paittikaḥ paṭhyate–
“āmāśayasthaḥ pavano hy asthimajjagato 'pi vā|
kupitaḥ kopayaty āśu śleṣmāṇaṃ pittam eva ca||” iti| kiñ ca nāgabhartṛtantre sthānam apy uktam eva–
“ūrdhvakāyaṃ tu yaḥ pūrvaṃ gṛhṇāti so 'nilātmakaḥ|
madhyakāyaṃ tu gṛhṇāti pūrvaṃ yas tu sa pittajaḥ|| pūrvaṃ gṛhṇāty adhaḥkāyaṃ śleṣmavṛddhaś caturthakaḥ||” iti| tasmāt prāyeṇa kaphavātābhyāṃ bhavatīti paittikaś caturthakaś carakādibhir nodāhṛtaḥ, ‘ prāyo'sambhavāt’ iti pā.| na tv asambhavād iti mantavyam| eṣāṃ cotpattikramo vṛddhasuśrutād avagantavyaḥ| sa yad āha–
“ahorātrād ahorātrāt sthānāt sthānaṃ prapadyate|
tataś cāmāśayaṃ prāpya karoti viṣamajvaram||
kaphasthānavibhāgena yathāsaṅkhyaṃ karoti hi|
satatānyedyuṣkatryākhyacaturthān sapralepakān||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti| ‘asyārthaḥ’ iti pā.| asyāyam arthaḥ– āmāśayahṛdayakaṇṭhaśiraḥsandhayaḥ pañca kaphasthānāni, eṣu sthitair doṣair yathāsaṅkhyaṃ satatādayaḥ kriyante| tatrāmāśayasthitena doṣeṇa satatakaḥ kriyate dvikālaṃ ‘na ca sarvadā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | na ca sarvadā; na ‘cāmāśayaprāptau’ iti pā.| cāmāśayaprāptyā sarvadā prasaṅgaḥ, ‘ahorātre’ iti pā.| ahorātreṣu ‘prakopakālāpekṣayā’ iti pā.| kāleṣu svaprakopakālāpekṣayā jvarotpatteḥ| hṛdayasthitena doṣeṇāmāśayam āgatyānyedyuṣkaḥ kriyate ekakālaṃ, atra ‘naca sarvadā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| na ca sarvadā, satatārambhakadoṣāpekṣayā'sya vyavahitatvāt| kaṇṭhasthitena doṣeṇaikasmin dine hṛdayam āgamyate, aparasminn āmāśayam āgatya jvara ārabhyate tṛtīyakaḥ| evaṃ śiraḥsthitena doṣeṇa kaṇṭhahṛdayāmāśayān atra ‘trīn’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| trīn tribhir dinaiḥ krameṇa prāpya caturthakaḥ kriyate| punaḥ svasthānagamanaṃ tu doṣāṇāṃ hṛtavegatvena lāghavād vegadina eva bhavati| sandhisthitena doṣeṇa pralepakaḥ kriyate, sandhayaś cāmāśaye 'pi santīti atra ‘sa’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| sa “sarveṣu kaphasthāneṣu vyavasthito doṣaḥ santataṃ karotīti jñeyaṃ, tantrāntaroktatvāt” iti vṛndaṭīkāyāṃ śrīkaṇṭhadattaḥ| sarvadā bhavati| ayaṃ cāviṣamo 'pi viṣamasahacaritaḥ paṭhitaḥ kaphasthānotpādānurodhāt| uktaṃ hi suśrute– “ ‘pralepakastu viṣamaḥ’ iti pā.| pralepakas tv aviṣamaḥ prāyaḥ kleśāya śoṣiṇām||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti||37-38||

ulbaṇadoṣabhedena tṛtīyakacaturthakayor lakṣaṇāntaram āha– ‘tṛtīyaka ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tṛtīyaka ity ādi| tṛtīyako jvaras trividho bhavati| kaphapittāt trikagrāhī vedanayā trikavyāpī| trikasya ‘vātasthānatvena tadgatau’ iti pā.| vātasthānatvāt tadgatau kaphapittau anyasthānagatatvena durbalau tṛtīyadine vegaṃ kurutaḥ, yadi tu svasthānasthitau syātāṃ tadā santatam eva kuryātām iti jejjaṭaḥ| evaṃ śirasi kaphasthāne pṛṣṭhe ca pittasthāne boddhavyam| na ca vācyaṃ yadi trikaṃ vātasthānaṃ tat kathaṃ tatra pitta kaphāv iti? ucyate– prakṛtisthānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ ‘sthānaniyamāt,’ iti pā.| sthānaniyamo na tu kupitānāṃ, teṣāṃ sarvagatatvāt| yad āha suśrutaḥ–
“kupitānāṃ hi doṣāṇāṃ śarīre paridhāvatām|
yatra saṅgaḥ khavaiguṇyād vyādhis tatropajāyate||” iti| evam anyasthānagatatvena doṣadaurbalyādi caturthake 'pi vācyam| ‘vātakaphātmako jvaro vedanayā pṛṣṭhagrāhī, vātapittātmako vedanayā śirogrāhī, evaṃ traividhyam| iti pāṭhaḥ’ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vātakaphātmako jvaro vedanayā pṛṣṭhagrāhī, vātapittātmako vedanayā śirogrāhī, evaṃ traividhyam| cāturthiko dviprakārāṃ śaktiṃ darśayati– jaṅghābhyāṃ ślaiṣmikaḥ, anilasambhavaḥ śirasaḥ, vedanayety arthaḥ| cāturthikaḥ pittena atra ‘na’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| na kriyate ity eke, vyādhisvabhāvāt pittajagalagaṇḍavat| hārītas tu cāturthiko 'pi paittiko 'stīti vadati–
“cāturthiko nāma gado dāruṇo viṣamajvaraḥ|
śoṣaṇaḥ sarvadhātūnāṃ balavarṇāgnināśanaḥ||
tridoṣajo vikāraḥ syād asthimajjāgato 'nilaḥ|
‘kurvanti’ iti pā.| karoti pittam evaṃ tu kaphaś caivaṃ svabhāvataḥ||” ity ādi| atrāhuḥ– ‘anubandharūpamātram’ iti pā.| anubandharūpam atra pittaṃ na tv ārambhakaṃ, katham eṣā pratītir iti cet, sthānaviśeṣānabhidhānāt; ata eva hārītenāpi sthānaṃ nodāhṛtaṃ jaṅghādivad iti carakaṭīkākṛto vyācakṣate| kiṃ tv eṣā vyākhyā tadā saṅgacchate yadi pittaliṅgaṃ nodbhūtaṃ ‘dṛśyate’ iti pā.| dṛśyeta, dṛśyate ca| tathā ca bheḍe 'pi paṭhitam–
“āmāśayasthaḥ pavano hy asthimajjagato 'pi vā|
kupitaḥ kopayaty āśu śleṣmāṇaṃ pittam eva vā||” iti| kiñ ca vāgbhaṭatantre sthānam apy uktam eva
“ūrdhvakāyaṃ tu yaḥ pūrvaṃ gṛhṇīte so 'nilātmakaḥ|
madhyakāyaṃ tu gṛhṇāti pūrvaṃ yas tu sa pittajaḥ|| pūrvaṃ gṛhṇāty adhaḥkāyaṃ śleṣmā vṛddhaś caturthakāḥ|” iti| tasmāt prāyeṇa kaphavātābhyāṃ bhavatīti paittikaś cāturthakaś carakādibhi nodāhṛta eva, ‘prāyosambhavāditi’ iti pā.| na tv asambhavād iti mantavyam||37-38||

div.ab:
viṣamajvara evānyaś caturthakaviparyayaḥ |
‘sa madhye jvarayatyahnī ādāvante ca muñcati’ iti pā., ‘tryahād dvayaham’ ityasya sthāne ‘madhye'hani’ iti pā. tryahād dvayahaṃ jvarayati hy ādāv ante ca muñcati ||39|| (ca. ci. a. 3) |

ab.seg:
caturthakaviparyayam āha– viṣamety ādi| atra tantrāntaram–
“asthimajjobhayagate caturthakaviparyayaḥ|
‘tryahād dvayahaṃ jvarayati’ ityasya sthāne ‘madhye'hani jvarayati’ iti pā., ‘sa madhye jvarayatyahnī’ iti ca pā.| tryahād dvyahaṃ jvarayati hy ādāv ante ca muñcati||” iti| ādāv ekadinaṃ ‘na bhūtvā’ iti pā.| muktvā, madhye dinadvayaṃ bhūtvā, ante ekadinaṃ na bhavatīti vyācakṣate jejjaṭādayaḥ| “asthimajjobhayagate caturthakaviparyayaḥ| tryahād dvyahaṃ jvarayaty ādāv ante ca muñcati||” iti parāśaravacanasyāpi sa evārthaḥ; tryahād iti tryahasyādidinaṃ vimuñcati, dinadvayaṃ jvarayati, tryahasyānte ‘caturthadine’ iti pā.| caturthadinaṃ muñcatīti ‘tātparyato’ iti pā.| tātparyārthaṃ vyācakṣate| haricandras tv āha-dve ahanī nirantaraṃ jvarayitvā uparamyaikam ahaḥ punar jvarayatīty eṣaś caturthakaviparyaya iti| ‘ādidinābhāvaścottarottarapālidivaseṣvavadhāryaḥ’ iti pā.| ādidinābhāvaś cottarottarapātidivaseṣv avadhāryaḥ| caturthakaviparyayasyopalakṣaṇatvena tṛtīyakādiviparyayo 'py ūhyaḥ ity āhuḥ| tad yathā– madhye ekadinaṃ jvarayati, ādyantayor muñcatīti tṛtīyakaviparyayaḥ; kvacitpustake ‘ekakālaṃ vimucya sarvamahorātraṃ vyāpnotītyanyedyuṣkaviparyayaḥ; kāladvaye muñcati, sarvamahorātraṃ jvarayatīti satatakaviparyayaḥ|’ etatsthāne ‘kāladvaye muñcati, sarvamahorātraṃ jvarayatīti satatakaviparyayaḥ; ekakālaṃ vimucya sarvamahorātraṃ vyāpnotītyanyedyuṣkaviparyayaḥ|’ iti pā.| ekakālaṃ vimucya sarvam ahorātraṃ vyāpnotīty anyedyuṣkaviparyayaḥ; ( ( ) etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kāladvaye muñcati, sarvam ahorātraṃ jvarayatīti satatakaviparyayaḥ)| atra doṣavikṛtir eva nānāvidhā hetur iti|
“kaphasthāneṣu vā tiṣṭan doṣo dvitricaturṣu ca|
viparyayākhyān kurute viṣamān kṛcchrasādhanān||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti vṛddhasuśrutavākyaṃ vyācakṣāṇo jejjaṭaḥ– anyedyuṣkatṛtīyacaturthakamātrasya viparyayam udāharati, tad yathā– āmāśayahṛdayasthadoṣeṇa yathodāhṛta evānyedyuṣkaviparyayaḥ; āmāśayahṛdayakaṇṭhasthitena tṛtīyakaviparyayaḥ; tatraikasmin dine hṛdayastho doṣa āmāśayam āgatya tatsthena saha jvarayati, taddine ‘kaṇṭhastho’ iti pā.| kaṇṭhasthitaś ca hṛdayam āyāti, aparadine so 'py āmāśayam āgatya jvarayati, evaṃ ‘dinadvaye’ iti pā.| dinadvayaṃ bhūtvā paścād ekadinaṃ na bhavatīti tṛtīyakaviparyayaḥ; āmāśayahṛdayakaṇṭhaśiraḥsthena doṣeṇa caturthakaviparyaya kriyate tatra yasmin dine hṛdayastho doṣa āmāśayam āgatya jvarayati ‘tasmin dine’ ityasya sthāne ‘tasminneva’ iti pā.| tasmin dine kaṇṭhastho hṛdayaṃ śirasthaḥ kaṇṭham āyāti, aparadine ‘hṛdistha’ iti pā.| hṛdayastha āmāśayam āgatya jvarayati kaṇṭhasthitaś ca hṛdayam āyāti, aparadine hṛdistha ‘āmāśayamāgatya’ iti pā.| evāmāśayam āgatya jvarayati, evaṃ dinatraye bhūtvā paścād ekadinaṃ na bhavatīti caturthakaviparyaya iti| ete ca sarva eva ‘pakṣā’ iti pā.| jvarā na viruddhāḥ, sarveṣām eva munipraṇītatvāt| yathoktaṃ smṛtiśāstre– “smṛtidvaidhaṃ tu yatra syāt tatra dharmāv ubhau matau||” (manu. smṛ. a. 2/14) iti| dṛśyante ca nānāvidhā eva viṣamajvarāḥ; eṣa ‘ca’ iti pā.| eva nyāyaś carakasuśrutayoḥ ‘kaṇṭhavaiṣamye’ iti pā., ‘kuṣṭhavaidharmye’ iti ca. pā.| kuṣṭhavaiṣamye vāpyacandreṇa darśitaḥ; na vā cikitsābhedo 'py eṣām uktaḥ; yaiva tṛtīyakādau cikitsā saiva tadviparyaye 'pīti||39||

cāturthikaviparyayam āha– ‘viṣametyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | viṣamety ādi| cāturthakaviparyayo 'nyo viṣamajvaraḥ| ‘tryahāttryahamiti tryahāttryahaṃ tridinam’ iti pā.| tryahād dvyaham iti tryahād dvyahaṃ dvidinaṃ jvarayati ekaṃ dinaṃ vimuñcati, evaṃ ‘tṛtīyakaviparyayo’ ityasya sthāne ‘dvitīyatṛtīyake viparyayo’ iti pā.| tṛtīyakaviparyayo vācyaḥ| atra doṣavikṛtir eva hetur iti| pūrvokteṣu kaphasthānavibhāgeṣu kvacitpustake ‘dvitricaturṣu tiṣṭhan doṣo’ etatsthāne ‘tiṣṭhan doṣo dvitricaturṣu’ iti pā.| dvitricaturṣu tiṣṭhan doṣo viparyayaṃ kurute| uktaṃ ca– “kaphasthāneṣu vā tiṣṭhan doṣo dvitricaturṣu vā| viparyayākhyān kurute viṣamān kṛcchrasādhanān” iti| nānāvidhā eva viṣamajvarā dṛśyante| eṣa nyāyaś carakasuśrutayoḥ kuṣṭhavaidharmye vāpyacandreṇa darśitaḥ| suśrute viṣamajvarāṇām upaśāntavegānām api ‘dehe sthānam’ iti pā.| dehe 'vasthānaṃ darśitam| tad yathā–
“sa cāpi viṣamo dehaṃ na kadācid vimuñcati|
‘yasmādgauravavaivarṇyakārśyebhyo’ iti pā.| yasmād gauravavairasyakārśyebhyo na vimucyate||
vege tu samatikrānte gato 'yam iti lakṣyate|
gauravaṃ śiraso glānir nātiśraddhā ca bhojane||
mādhuryam atha vairasyaṃ tiktatvam athavā punaḥ|
vaktrasya jāyate yasmāt pravege 'pi gate sati| tasmāt tu niyato ‘kuṣṭhaḥ’ iti pā., ‘puṣṭaḥ’ iti ca pā.| juṣṭaḥ śarīre viṣamajvaraḥ” iti||39||

div.ab:
nityaṃ mandajvaro rūkṣaḥ śūnakas tena sīdati |
stabdhāṅgaḥ śleṣmabhūyiṣṭho ‘naro vātabalāsakī’ iti pā. bhaved vātabalāsakī ||40|| (a. saṃ. ni. a. 2) |

ab.seg: uktasaṅgatyā pralepakād anūpadravatvena ‘tatsamadharmiṇi’ iti pā.| tatsadharmiṇi vātabalāsake vācye pratilomatantrayuktyā vātabalāsakam evāha– nityam ity ādi| vātabalāsakākhyo jvaro 'syāstīti vātabalāsakī naraḥ, tena jvareṇa, śūnakaḥ śothī, sīdati avasanno bhavati; śothinaḥ sa upadrava ity arthaḥ| ‘śūnaḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhyati’ iti pāṭhāntare ‘tena’ iti śeṣaḥ| vātabalāsakam eke kumbhāhvayapāṇḍurogaviṣayam āhur iti ‘gayadāsaḥ’ iti pā.| gadādharaḥ| vātabalāsakārabdhatvād vātabalāsakaḥ; balāsakaḥ śleṣmā, pittam apy atra boddhavyam| ‘tantrāntare yaduktam’ iti pā.| yad uktaṃ tantrāntare– “vāyuḥ prakupito doṣāv udīryobhau vidhāvati| sa śirasthaḥ śiraḥśūlam||” ity ādi| yac coktaṃ suśrutena– “pralepakaṃ vātabalāsakaṃ vā kaphādhikatvāt pravadanti tajjñāḥ||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti, tat tu śleṣmaṇo nityānuṣaktatveneti jejjaṭaḥ| rūkṣatvaṃ cāsya vātapittābhibhūtatvāt kaphasnehasya vyādhiprabhāvād veti||40||

vātabalāsakajvaram āha– vātabalāsako jvaro 'syāstīti vātabalāsakī naraḥ, tena jvareṇa, śūnakaḥ śothī, sīdati avasanno bhavati, ‘śothitaḥ’ iti pā.| śothinaḥ sa upadrava ity arthaḥ| kvacitpustake ‘kīdṛśaḥ? nityaṃ mandajvaro nityaṃ satataṃ, mandajvaro mandavegaḥ,’ etatsthāne ‘kīdṛśo, nityaṃ mandajvaro mandavegaḥ, nityaṃ satatam,’ iti pā.| kīdṛśaḥ? nityaṃ mandajvaro nityaṃ satataṃ, mandajvaro mandavegaḥ, vātabalāsakārabdhatvād vātabalāsakaḥ| balāsaḥ śleṣmā| ‘pittamatrāpi’ iti pā.| pittam apy atra boddhavyam| yad uktaṃ tantrāntare– “vāyuḥ prakupito doṣāv udīryobhau vidhāvati| sa śirasthaḥ śiraḥśūlam” ity ādi| yad uktaṃ suśrutena– “pralepakaṃ vātabalāsakaṃ vā kaphādhikatvāt pravadanti tajjñāḥ” iti| ‘tataḥ śleṣmaṇā pittānuṣaktatveneti’ iti pā.| tat tu śleṣmaṇo nityānuṣaktatveneti jejjaṭaḥ| rūkṣatvaṃ cāsya vātapittābhibhūtatvāt kaphasya vyādhiprabhāvād vā| stabdhāṅgaśleṣmabhūyiṣṭha iti stabdhāṅgaś ca śleṣmabhūyiṣṭhaś ca; tad uktaṃ suśrute– “pralepakaṃ vātabalāsakaṃ vā kaphādhikatvena vadanti tajjñāḥ” iti| anyatra tu vātādhikatvena darśitaḥ, tat katham atra ‘śleṣmabhūyiṣṭhamuktam’ iti pā.| śleṣmabhūyiṣṭhatvam uktam| atrocyate– vāteritasarvasandhirūpakaphārabdhatvāt, vātabalāsakas tu yathārthanāmā ‘vāterita iti’ iti pā.| vāterito balāsaka ārambhako yasyeti| śūnaḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhyatīti pāṭhāntaram| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tena vātabalāsakam eke kumbhāhvayapāṇḍurogaviṣayam āhur iti gayādāsaḥ||40||

div.ab:
pralimpann iva gātrāṇi gharmeṇa gauraveṇa ca |
mandajvaravilepī ca saśītaḥ syāt pralepakaḥ ||41|| (a. saṃ. ni. a. 2) |

ab.seg: pralepakam āha– pralimpann ity ādi| mandajvaraś cāsau vilepī ceti ‘mandajvaratvam’ iti pā.| mandajvaravilepī, vilepitvaṃ cāsya yasmād gharmagauravābhyāṃ limpati sambadhnātīty arthaḥ| ayaṃ ca kaphapittajaḥ| yad uktaṃ suśrutena “pralepakaṃ vātabalāsakaṃ vā” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) ity ādi| tathā yakṣmaṇi “jvaro dāho 'tisāraś ca pittād raktasya cāgamaḥ||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 41) ity uktaṃ, yakṣmaṇi cāyaṃ bhavatīti| anye tu tridoṣajayakṣmajanitatvena tridoṣaja evāyam, udbhūtatvena tu kaphapittavyapadeśaḥ||41||

mandajvaraś cāsau vilepī ca kvacitpustake ‘mandajvaravilepī, vilepitvaṃ’ etatsthāne ‘mandajvaravilepitvaṃ’ iti pā.| mandajvaravilepī, vilepitvaṃ cāsya gharmeṇeti ātapeneva gauraveṇa ‘gurutvena vā’ iti pā.| gurutveneva limpati sambadhnāti sa pralepakākhyo jvaraḥ| ‘saśītaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | saśītaḥ śītayuktaḥ| ayaṃ ca kaphapittajaḥ| yad uktaṃ suśrutena yakṣmaṇi– “jvaro dāho 'tisāraś ca pittād raktasya cāgamaḥ|” ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| yakṣmaṇi cāyaṃ ‘bhavatīti’ iti pā.| bhavati| anye tu tridoṣajanitatvena tridoṣaja evāyam, ‘tadbhūtatvena’ iti pā.| udbhūtatvena tu kaphapittavyapadeśaḥ| gātrāṇi ‘pralampatīva’ iti pā.| pralimpatīveti pralepako 'nvarthasañjñaḥ||41||

div.ab:
vidagdhe 'nnarase dehe śleṣmapitte vyavasthite |
tenārdhaṃ śītalaṃ ‘dehe cārdhaṃ coṣṇam’ iti pā. deham ardham uṣṇaṃ prajāyate ||42||
kāye duṣṭaṃ yadā pittaṃ śleṣmā cānte vyavasthitaḥ |
tenoṣṇatvaṃ śarīrasya śītatvaṃ hastapādayoḥ ||43||
kāye śleṣmā yadā duṣṭaḥ ‘pitte’ iti pā. pittaṃ cānte vyavasthitam |
śītatvaṃ tena gātrāṇām uṣṇatvaṃ hastapādayoḥ ||44|| (a. saṃ. ni. a. 2) |
tvaksthau śleṣmānilau śītam ādau janayato jvare |
tayoḥ praśāntayoḥ pittam ante dāhaṃ karoti ca ||45||
karoty ādau tathā pittaṃ tvaksthaṃ dāham atīva ca |
tasmin praśānte tv itarau kurutaḥ śītam antataḥ ||46||
dvāv etau dāhaśītādijvarau saṃsargajau smṛtau |
dāhapūrvas tayoḥ kaṣṭaḥ kṛcchrasādhyatamaś ca saḥ ||47|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

ab.seg:
viṣamajvaraviśeṣān āha– vidagdha ity ādi| vidagdhe 'nnarase duṣṭe āhārarase tathā duṣṭe pitte duṣṭe śleṣmaṇi kvacitpustake ‘dehe’ etatsthāne ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ, kvacitpustake ‘dehe’ iti pāṭho nopalabhyate ca| dehe vyavasthite ‘sati’ iti pā.| bhavataḥ, ‘tena hetunā ‘ dehe'rdham’ iti pā.| deham ardhaṃ śītalaṃ kaphenārdhaṃ coṣṇaṃ pittena prajāyate| ardhatvaṃ cārdhanārīśvarākāreṇa narasiṃhākāreṇa vā, yathādoṣaṃ vyavasthānaniyamahetor abhāvād iti| kāya ity ādi| kāye antaragnau, koṣṭha iti yāvat| ante ‘hastapāde’ iti pā.| hastapādayoḥ| uktārthasya viparyayeṇa jvarāntaram āha– kāye śleṣmety ādi| tvaksthāv ity ādi|– tvakśabdena tvakstho rasa ucyate, ‘tātsthyāt’ iti pā.| tatsthasya tadupacāreṇeti gadādharaḥ; jejjaṭas tu tvacam evāha| etadabhiprāyeṇaiva carakeṇa jvare 'bhyaṅgārthaṃ ‘... dīnabhidhā ...’ iti pā.| tailādīny abhidhāyoktam– “tair āśu prathamaṃ yāti bahirmārgagato jvaraḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| tayoḥ śleṣmānilayoḥ| praśāntayor iti ‘praśāntavegayoḥ’ iti pā.| praśāntavegayor ity arthaḥ; na hi viṣameṣu doṣasya praśāntir bhavati, punarvegāgamāt| yad āha suśrutaḥ–
“sa cāpi viṣamo dehaṃ na kadācid vimuñcati|
glānigauravakārśyebhyaḥ sa yasmān na ‘vimucyate’ iti pā.| pramucyate||
vege tu samatikrānte gato 'yam iti lakṣyate|
dhātvantarastho līnatvāt saukṣmyān naivopalabhyate [ |” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti| itarau vātakaphau| dāhaśītādīti eko dāhādiḥ, aparaḥ śītādiḥ| nanu, etayoḥ samprāptau tridoṣajatvam uktaṃ; tat kathaṃ saṃsargajāv ity uktaṃ, saṃsargo hi dvayor bhavati trayāṇāṃ sannipāta iti sthitiḥ| ucyate– saṃsargaḥ sambandhaḥ, sa ca dvayor bahūnāṃ ca bhavati, atra ‘trayāṇāmāhuḥ’ iti pā.| trayāṇām uktaḥ, na caivaṃ sarvatra; athavā ‘saṃsargaḥ sāmyāt’ iti pā.| saṃsargaḥ ‘saumyāgneyadoṣakoṭidvayamelakaḥ’ iti pā.| saumyāgneyadoṣakoṭidvayamelāpaḥ| tatra śītādau jvare pittam anubandhaḥ, dāhādau vātakaphāv anubandhau; anubandhyaś ca prādhānyena cikitsyo 'nubandhāvirodheneti prayojanam etasya| tayor dāhaśītādijvarayor madhye dāhapūrvo dāhādiḥ kaṣṭa iti duḥkhapradaḥ| dāhādeḥ kaṣṭasādhyatvābhidhānena śītāder arthato 'kaṣṭatvam iti| uktaviṣamajvarāṇām upalakṣaṇatvād anye 'pi viṣamajvarā rātrijvarādayo boddhavyā iti jejjaṭaḥ| uktaṃ ca tantrāntare–
“samau vātakaphau yasya ‘hīnapittasya’ iti pā.| kṣīṇapittasya dehinaḥ|
prāyo rātrau jvaras tasya divā hīnakaphasya tu||” iti| sarveṣu ca viṣamajvareṣv avaśyambhāvī vāyuḥ| yad āha ‘suśrutaḥ’ iti pā.| vṛddhasuśrutaḥ–
“narte 'nilād vai viṣamajvaraḥ samupajāyate|
kaphapitte hi niśceṣṭe ceṣṭayaty anilaḥ sadā||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti| tathā videhe 'pi– “pavano gativaiṣamyād viṣamajvarakāraṇam|” iti| eṣāṃ ca jvarāṇām ṛtvādihetvantaralābhād anyathābhāvo 'pi dṛśyate| tad yathā– santataḥ svarūpaṃ tyaktvā satatādīnām anyatamatvaṃ ‘prapadyate’ iti pā.| pratipadyate, tathā ‘tṛtīyakacaturthakādirūpatvam’ iti pā.| caturthakas tṛtīyakādirūpatvam| yad āha carakaḥ–
“ṛtvahorātradoṣāṇāṃ manasaś ca balābalāt|
kālam arthavaśāc caiva jvaras taṃ taṃ prapadyate||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| asyārthaḥ– balābalād iti ṛtvādimano 'ntena sambadhyate, balaṃ cābalaṃ ca balābalam| ‘arthaśabdaḥ’ iti pā.| arthaśabdo 'tra prāktanakarmavācī| taṃ taṃ kālaṃ satatakādyuktaṃ, jvaraḥ pratipadyate iti yojanā| udāharaṇaṃ ca ṛtvahorātrabalābalād yathā– yadā nidāghotpanno vātapradhānaś caturthako varṣāsamayam āpnoti tadā ‘tenartunā''pyāyitabalastṛtīyakādīnāmanyatamatvam’ iti pā.| tenartunā''pyāyitabalas tṛtīyakāntānāṃ ‘santatakādīnāmanyatamatvaṃ’ iti pā.| satatakādīnām anyatamatvaṃ prāpnoty utkarṣāt| evaṃ ‘varṣāsu samutpannaḥ’ iti pā.| varṣāsamutpannaḥ santataḥ śaradaṃ prāpyāpakṛṣṭabalaḥ satatādīnām anyatamatvam ety apakarṣāt| evaṃ pittakaphayor api utkarṣāpakarṣau ṛtukṛtau vyākhyeyau| ahorātraśabdena katipayāny ahorātrāṇi gṛhyante, na hi ekasminn ahorātre ‘santatādīnāmutkarṣāpakarṣābhyāmanyathābhāva’ iti pā.| satatādīnām utkarṣāpakarṣābhyām anyathābhāva upapadyate; kintu katipayair eva| yadā varṣāśaradvasantaprārambhe vātādayo jvaraṃ caturthakam ārabhante tadā madhyāni katipayadināny avāpya sa eva ‘tṛtīyakatvena’ iti pā.| tṛtīyakapūrvakatvena vipariṇamate utkarṣāt; apakarṣāt tu ‘anyāni’ iti pā.| yadā'ntyāni dināny āpnoti tadā santato (vātārabdhaḥ ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | prāvṛṣaḥ,) pittārabdhaḥ ‘śarado’ iti pā.| śārado, vasantasya ca śleṣmārabdhaḥ, pratanukatvād doṣasya satatādīnām anyatamatvena vipariṇamata iti| doṣabalābalād yathā– yadā satatādīnām anyatamakārī doṣaḥ śleṣmā madhurasnigdhādīn divāsvapnādīṃś ca hetūn āpnoti tadā ‘santatam’ iti pā.| santatakādīn karoti| evaṃ ‘vātapittayorapyudāhāryam’ iti pā.| vātapittayor apy ūhyam| manobalābalād yathā– yadā santatajvarī sattvaguṇodrekāt praharṣāvaṣṭambhabahulo bhavati tadā satatādīnām anyatamatvaṃ prāpnoti; yadā caturthakajvarī tamoguṇabhūyiṣṭhatvād viṣādādibhir abhibhūyate tadā tṛtīyakādīnām anyatamo bhavati, “viṣādo rogavardhanānām” (ca. sū. a. 25) ity āgamāt| anye tu manaḥśabdena buddhiṃ vyākhyānayanti, kāraṇe kāryopacārāt| tasyāś ca balābalaṃ yathā– yadā caturthakajvarī ‘prajñāparādhāddevatādīnabhibhūyāhitānyācarati’ iti pā.| prajñāparādhād devādīn abhibhūyāhitāny ācarati tadā tṛtīyakapūrveṣām anyatamatvam āpnoti; yadā tu śuddhasattvotkarṣād vivekinyā buddhyā yuktaḥ syāt tadā śubhāni devatārādhaneṣṭibalyupahārādīny ācarati tadā santatajvarī satatādīnām anyatamatvaṃ prāpnoti| arthavaśād yathā– santatajvariṇo 'pi yadi caturthakavedanīyaṃ karma syāt tadā santato 'pi caturthakatvena vipariṇamate; atha ‘caturthakādijvarāviṣṭasya’ iti pā.| caturthakajvarāviṣṭasya yadi tatkālaparipāki karma balīyo bhavati tadā santatatvena pariṇamate| etac ca karmavaśatvam ṛtvahorātradoṣabalābaleṣv api boddhavyaṃ, tadanantaraṃ tannirdeśād iti||42-47||

viṣamajvaraviśeṣān āha– dehe vidagdhe annarase duṣṭe āhāre rase tathā śleṣmapitte duṣṭaṃ vyavasthite sati tena hetunā ‘dehe’ iti pā.| dehe 'rdhe śītatvaṃ kaphena, ardhe ‘cauṣṇatvam’ iti pā.| coṣṇatvaṃ pittena prajāyate; ardhatvaṃ cārdhanārīśvarākāreṇa narasiṃhākāreṇa vā, yathādoṣavyavasthānaniyamahetor abhāvād iti| kāya ity ādi kāye 'ntaragnau koṣṭhe ‘iti yāvat’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti yāvat| yadā pittaṃ duṣṭaṃ bhavati śleṣmā cānte duṣṭo ‘cāvyavasthito’ iti pā.| vyavasthito bhavati tena hetunā śarīrasya uṣṇatvaṃ hastapādayoḥ śītatvam| atra ‘viparyayeṇa jvarāntaramāha– kāye ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| viparyayeṇa jvarāntaram āha– kāye ity ādi| viparītatve tu pūrvavad vyākhyeyam| ataḥ paraṃ santatādīnāṃ śītadāhapūrvakatvena bhedam āha– atra ‘tvaksthāvityādi| yadā śleṣmānilau tvaci kupitau bhavatastadā jvarasyādau tvaci śītaṃ janayataḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate pā.| tvaksthāv ity ādi| yadā śleṣmānilau tvaci kupitau bhavatas tadā jvarasyādau tvaci śītaṃ janayataḥ| dvāv etau dāhaśītādijvarau saṃsargajau smṛtau kathitau ‘munīndraiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| etau kau? jvare ādau pūrva kaphavātau tvaksthau santau śītam utpādayataḥ, tayoḥ śleṣmānilayoḥ praśāntayoḥ sator ante pittaṃ dāhaṃ karoti; tathā tenaiva prakāreṇa ādau pittaṃ tvaksthaṃ sad atīva dāhaṃ karoti, tasmiṃs tu pitte praśānte sati itarau vātakaphau śītaṃ kurutaḥ| tvakśabdena tvakstho rasa ucyate, tātsthyāt tadupacāreṇeti gadādharaḥ; jejjaṭas tvacam evāha| tayoḥ śleṣmānilayoḥ praśāntavegayoḥ svakālāpagamāt pratyanīkaprāptyā vā viṣameṣu doṣasya praśāntir bhavati paraṃ vegopagamāt| yad uktaṃ suśrutena– “sa cāpi viṣamo dehaṃ na kadācid vimuñcati|” ‘iti| pūrvamevoktaṃ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| pūrvam evoktaṃ yadā tau praśāntavegau bhavatas tadā pittam antardāhaṃ karoti, ‘cakārānmūrchādi’ iti pā.| cakārān mūrchādīn| yadā tu pittaṃ tvaksthaṃ bhavati tadā tvaci atīva dāhaṃ karoti, tvagdāhakārake pitte ‘praśānte gatavege’ ityasya sthāne ‘praśāntavege’ iti pā.| praśānte gatavege sati tāv api itarau śleṣmānilau antataḥ śītaṃ kurutaḥ| ‘ādiśabdādvamathutandrādayaḥ’ iti pā.| ādiśabdād vamathutandrādīn| dvāv etau dāhaśītādī saṃsargajau kathitau, eko dāhādiḥ, aparaḥ śītādiḥ| tayor dāhaśītapūrvakayor jvarayor madhye dāhapūrvakaḥ kaṣṭo 'tyantaduḥkhapradaḥ, kaṣṭaḥ kṛcchrasādhyatama iti viśeṣaṇadvayopādānād atyarthaṃ duḥsādhyatvaṃ darśitaṃ, ‘śītapūrvasya sukhasādhyatvam’ ityasya sthāne ‘śītāderarthato'kaṣṭatvamiti’ iti pā.| śītapūrvasya sukhasādhyatvaṃ; kutaḥ? rogaśakter acintyatvāt| nanv etayos tridoṣajatvam uktaṃ tat kathaṃ saṃsargajāv ity uktam| ucyate– saṃsargaḥ sambandhaḥ sa ca dvayor bahūnāṃ ca bhavati, ato 'tra trayāṇām uktaḥ, na caivaṃ sarvatra| athavā saṃsargaḥ saumyāgneyadoṣadvayamelakaḥ| tatra śītādau jvare pittānubandhaḥ, dāhādau jvare ‘vātakaphānubandhaḥ| anu uparyadhaśca’ ityasya sthāne ‘vātakaphānubandhaśca| saṃsarge’ iti pā.| vātakaphānubandhaḥ| anu uparyadhaś ca prādhānyena cikitsyata ity anubandhāt saṃsargajāv ity uktam iti na virodhaḥ| uktaviṣamajvarāṇām upalakṣaṇatvād anye 'pi viṣamajvarā rātrijvarādayo boddhavyā iti jejjaṭādayaḥ| uktaṃ ca tantrāntare– “samau vātakaphau yasya hīnapittasya dehinaḥ| rātrau prāyo jvaras tasya divā hīnakaphasya tu” iti| sarveṣu viṣamajvareṣv aśyambhāvī vāyuḥ| yad āha vṛddhasuśrutaḥ–
“narte 'nilād vai viṣamo jvaraḥ samupajāyate|
kaphapitte tu niśceṣṭe ceṣṭayaty anilo balī||” ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| tathā videhe 'pi– “pavano gativaiṣamyād viṣamajvarakāraṇam||” ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti||42-47||

div.ab:
gurutā hṛdayotkleśaḥ sadanaṃ chardyarocakau |
rasasthe tu jvare liṅgaṃ dainyaṃ cāsyopajāyate ||48||
raktaniṣṭhīvanaṃ dāho mohaś chardanavibhramau |
pralāpaḥ ‘piḍikā’ iti pā. piḍakā tṛṣṇā raktaprāpte jvare nṛṇām ||49||
piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ tṛṣṇā sṛṣṭamūtrapurīṣatā |
ūṣmā'ntardāhavikṣepau glāniḥ syān māṃsage jvare ||50||
bhṛśaṃ svedas tṛṣā mūrchā pralāpaś chardir eva ca |
daurgandhyārocakau glānir medaḥsthe cāsahiṣṇutā ||51||
bhedo 'sthnāṃ kūjanaṃ śvāso virekaś chardir eva ca |
vikṣepaṇaṃ ca gātrāṇām etad asthigate jvare ||52||
tamaḥpraveśanaṃ hikkā kāsaḥ śaityaṃ vamis tathā |
antarndāho mahāśvāso marmacchedaś ca majjage ||53||
maraṇaṃ prāpnuyāt tatra śukrasthānagate jvare |
śephasaḥ stabdhatā mokṣaḥ śukrasya tu viśeṣataḥ ||54|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |
(rasaraktāśritaḥ sādhyo māṃsamedogataś ca yaḥ |
asthimajjagataḥ kṛcchro śukrasthas tu na sidhyati) ||1|| (ca. ci. a. 3) |

ab.seg:
uktavātādijvarāṇāṃ dhātuviśeṣadūṣyatayā'dhikalakṣaṇāni bhavanti; yad uktam–
‘vātapittakaphotthānāṃ jvarāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yathā|
tathā teṣāṃ bhiṣag brūyād rasādiṣv api buddhimān||’ (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti; etad abhidhānaṃ ca rasādidhātvavirodhena vātādicikitsākaraṇārtham; atas tān āha– gurutety ādi| hṛdayotkleśaḥ hṛdayasthitasya doṣasyopasthitavamanatvam iva, rasasya hṛdayasthatvāt| rasastha ity anena viśeṣeṇātra raso dūṣyaḥ, sarveṣām eva jvarāṇāṃ ‘rasānugatatvāt’ iti pā.| rasānugatvāt| dainyaṃ klāntacittatvam| piṇḍikety ādi| piṇḍikā jānvadho jaṅghāmāṃsapiṇḍaḥ, tasyā udveṣṭanaṃ daṇḍādinā pīḍaneneva vedanā piṇḍikodveṣṭanam; evam anyatrāpi| sṛṣṭamūtrapurīṣatā asyāgre ‘rogaprabhāvāt’ ityadhikamātaṅkadarpaṇe| pravartamānamūtrapurīṣatā| ūṣmā bahiḥ, etac ca viśeṣaparaṃ, prāyaḥ sarvajvareṣu tathābhāvāt| ‘ūṣmā'ntarmohavikṣepau’ iti pāṭhāntare ūṣmā'ntaḥ antardāha ity arthaḥ, vikṣepo hastādicālanam| bhṛśaṃ sveda iti gharmasya medomalatvāt; tadvikṛtyaiva daurgandhyaṃ gātre| asahiṣṇutā vedanāyā ‘asahiṣṇutvam’ iti pā.| asahatvaṃ, krodhanatvam iti kārtikaḥ| bhedo 'sthnām iti bheda iva bhedaḥ bhaṅgavat pīḍety arthaḥ, ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | (parapadārtheṣu prayujyamānāḥ śabdā vṛtti(vati)m antareṇāpi vṛttya(vatya)rthaṃ gamayanti) yathā– agnir māṇavakaḥ| evam anyatrāpi bhedādau draṣṭavyam| kūjanaṃ ‘asphuṭadhvaniḥ’ iti pā.| kunthanaṃ; ‘kuñcanam’ iti pāṭhāntare 'sthnām eva saṅkoca ity arthaḥ| tamaḥpraveśanam andhakārapraviṣṭasyevāsaṃvittiḥ| mahāśvāsaḥ śvāsādhikāre vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇaḥ| marmaśabdena hṛdayam ucyate, prādhānyād iti kārtikaḥ; tasya cheda iva marmacchedaḥ| maraṇam ity ādi ‘śukragatasya’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śukragatasya| tatraiteṣu rasādidhātugatajvareṣu madhye śukrasthānagate maraṇaṃ prāpnuyād iti yojyam| śukraṃ ca tat sthānaṃ ceti śukrasthānaṃ; ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | (na tu śukrasya sthānaṃ śukrasthānaṃ) śukrasya sarvadehagatvena niyatasthānāsambhavād iti kārtikaḥ| ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | (yad uktam–
“yathā payasi sarpis tu ‘gūḍhaścekṣau raso’ iti pā.| guḍaś cekṣurase yathā|
śarīreṣu tathā nṝṇāṃ śukraṃ vidyād bhiṣagvaraḥ||” (su. śā. a. 4) iti|) viśeṣata iti padena śukrasya bāhulyena visargaḥ, anyasyāpi raktāder iti vadanti||48-54||

atha ‘... jvaramāha’ iti pā.| rasādidhātugatajvarān āha– gurutety ādi| gurutā gātrāṇāṃ, hṛdayotkleśaḥ hṛdayasthasya doṣasyopasthitavamanatvam iva, rasasya hṛdayasthitatvāt| sadanam aṅgaglāniḥ, dainyaṃ klāntacittatā, rasasthe rasadhātugate jvare| yady api rasaikadhātuprāptyā santata evāyaṃ tathā'py anukramadhātugatakathanārtham atra nirdeśaḥ| raktagaṃ jvaram āha– moho vigatacittatā| asyānantaraṃ kvacitpustake ‘piḍikātṛṣṇeti|’ iti adhikaḥ pā.| piḍikātṛṣṇeti| māṃsagatam āha– ‘piṇḍiketyādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | piṇḍikety ādi| piṇḍikā jānvadhobhāge māṃsapiṇḍaḥ, tasyā udveṣṭanaṃ daṇḍādinipīḍaneneva vedanāviśeṣaḥ| sṛṣṭamūtrapurīṣatā pravartamānamūtrapurīṣatvam| ūṣmāntardāhavikṣepau tatra ūṣmā bahiḥ, antardāhaḥ; etac ca viśeṣaparaṃ, prāyaḥ sarvajvareṣu tathābhāvāt; anye “ūṣmāntarmohavikṣepau” iti paṭhanti| tatra– ūṣmā antardāhaḥ, vikṣepo hastādicālanam| ‘medogatamāha’ iti pā.| medogate bhṛśaṃ sveda iti medomalatvāt, tadvikṛtyaiva daurgandhyaṃ gātre, asahiṣṇutā vedanāsahatvaṃ, krodhanatvam iti kārtikaḥ| ‘asthigatamāha’ iti pā.| asthigate bhedo 'sthnām iti bheda iva bhedaḥ, bhaṅgavat pīḍety arthaḥ parapadārtheṣu prayujyamānāḥ śabdā ivāntareṇāpi iva ity arthaṃ gamayanti, yathā agnir māṇavakaḥ; evam anyatrāpi| kūjanaṃ kunthanaṃ, kuñcanam iti kecana paṭhanti; tac ca sānnidhyād asthnām ity anena sambadhyate| ‘majjagatamāha’ iti pā.| majjagate– tamaḥpraveśanam andhakārapraviṣṭasyevārthāsaṃvittiḥ| mahāśvāsa iti śvāsanidāne vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇaḥ| marmaśabdena hṛdayam ucyate prādhānyād iti kārtikaḥ, tasya cheda iva marmacchedaḥ| śukragatalakṣaṇam āha– ‘maraṇamityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | maraṇam ity ādi| tatra teṣu rasādidhātugatajvareṣu madhye śukrasthānagate maraṇaṃ prāpnuyād iti yojyam| nanu śukrage jvare maraṇam ity uktaṃ, tac ca śukraṃ sarvadehagaṃ, tataś ca rasādidhātvabhibhave 'pi śukraprāpteḥ tad ṛte 'pi maraṇam iti| naivam– sarvaśarīrasthasyāpi śukrasya kalāntaritatvena krameṇa tvaci prāpteḥ| krameṇāpi śukraṃ jvareṇa kathaṃ prāpyam iti cet, dhātvantarād atikramya śukragamanād iti| viśeṣata iti padena śukrasya bāhulyena visargaḥ, anyasyāpi raktāder iti vadantīty uktam| suśrute– “dagdhendhano yathā vahnir dhātūn hatvā yathā viṣam| kṛtakṛtyo vrajec chāntiṃ dehaṃ hatvā tathā jvaraḥ”iti| granthāntare 'pi– “rasaraktāśritaḥ sādhyo māṃsamedogatas tathā| ‘... majjāgataḥ’ iti pā.| asthimajjagataḥ kṛcchraḥ śukrasthāne na jīvati” iti||48-54||

div.ab:
varṣāśaradvasanteṣu vātādyaiḥ prākṛtaḥ kramāt |
vaikṛto 'nyaḥ sa duḥsādhyaḥ prākṛtaś cānilodbhavaḥ ||55|| (vā. ni. a. 2) |

ab.seg:
uktavātādijvarāṇāṃ kālaprakṛtim uddiśya prākṛtatvaṃ vaikṛtatvaṃ cāha– varṣety ādi| varṣādiṣu vātādyaiḥ kramād yo jvaraḥ sa prākṛtaḥ; varṣāsu vātikaḥ, śaradi paittikaḥ, vasante ślaiṣmikaḥ| asmād anyo vaikṛtaḥ, yathā– varṣāsu paittika ity ādi| sa iti vaikṛto duḥsādhyaḥ, arthāt ‘prākṛtaḥ sukhasādhya’ ityasya sthāne ‘sukhasādhyaḥ prākṛtaḥ’ iti pā.| prākṛtaḥ sukhasādhya iti| yad uktam– “prākṛtaḥ sukhasādhyas tu vasantaśaradudbhavaḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| atra vāgbhaṭena vātajasya prākṛtatvapraṇayanaṃ yat kṛtaṃ tad anye nānumanyante, duḥsādhyatvena vaikṛtād abhinnatvāt| jatūkarṇenāpy asau na paṭhitaḥ| yad āha– “vasantaśaradoḥ ‘prāyaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | prāyaḥ prākṛto 'nyatra vaikṛtaḥ|” iti| atrocyate– na prākṛtatvaṃ sukhasādhyatvakhyāpanaparā sañjñā, kintu kumbhakārādivad yaugikatvaṃ; yato ‘yathartukupito’ iti pā.| yathartuprakupito doṣaḥ prakṛtir ucyate, ‘tata udbhūtaḥ’ ityasya sthāne ‘tathābhūtaḥ’ iti pā.| tata udbhūtaḥ prākṛtaḥ; tena prākṛtatve 'pi ‘doṣaprabhā ...’ iti pā.| doṣasvabhāvād vātikasya duḥkhasādhyatvaṃ vaikṛtavad iti duḥkhasādhyatvena vaikṛtasādharmyāt tu carakajatūkarṇābhyāṃ noktaḥ, na tu prākṛtatvābhāvād ity abhiprāyo vāgbhaṭasyeti| anyarogeṣu prākṛtatvena ‘duḥkhasādhyatvam’ iti pā.| duḥsādhyatvaṃ, jvarasya tu vyādhiprabhāvāt sukhasādhyatvam| tantrāntaraṃ hi–
“jvare tulyartudoṣatvaṃ pramehe tulyadūṣyatā|
raktagulme purāṇatvaṃ sukhasādhyasya lakṣaṇam||” iti||55||

atha kālabhedena jvarasya sādhyāsādhyalakṣaṇam āha– varṣety ādi| varṣādiṣu ṛtuṣu vātādyaiḥ kramād yo jvaraḥ sa prākṛtaḥ, varṣāsu vātikaḥ, śaradi paittikaḥ, vasante ślaiṣmikaḥ| asmād anyo vaikṛtaḥ, kramād yathā– varṣāsu paittikaḥ, śaradi ślaiṣmiko, vasante vātikaḥ atra kvacitpustake ‘sa’ iti adhikaḥ pā.| sa iti| vaikṛto duḥsādhyaḥ arthāt sukhasādhyaḥ prākṛta iti| yad uktam– “prākṛtaḥ sukhasādhyas tu vasantaśaradudbhavaḥ” iti| anilodbhavaś ca prākṛto duḥsādhyaḥ||55||

div.ab:
varṣāsu māruto duṣṭaḥ pittaśleṣmānvito jvaram |
kuryāt pittaṃ ca śaradi tasya cānubalaḥ kaphaḥ ||56||
tatprakṛtyā visargāc ca tatra nānaśanād bhayam |
kapho vasante tam api vātapittaṃ bhaved anu ||57|| (vā. ni. a. 2) |

ab.seg:
teṣām eva prākṛtajvarāṇāṃ cikitsāviśeṣārtham utpattikramam āha– varṣāsv ity ādi| duṣṭa iti kupitaḥ, grīṣme sañcitatvāt| pittaśleṣmānvita iti tatkālocitapittakaphānubandhaḥ| yad uktam–
“bhūbāṣpān meghaniṣyandāt pākād amlāj jalasya ca|
varṣāsv agnibale kṣīṇe kupyanti pavanādayaḥ|” (ca. sū. a. 6) iti| kuryād iti chedaḥ| atra kvacitpustake ‘pittamityādi’ iti adhikaḥ pā.| pittam ity ādi pittaṃ ca ‘śaradīti’ iti pā.| śaradi duṣṭaṃ jvaraṃ kuryād iti pūrvoktena sambadhyate; evaṃ kapho vasante ‘ityapi’ iti pā.| ity atrāpi yojyam| pittaduṣṭiś ca śaradi varṣāsu ‘sañcitatvena’ iti pā.| sañcitatvāt| anubalo 'nubandhaḥ, tasya ca hetur vārṣikakledānuvṛttir eva| tatprakṛtyeti tayoḥ pitta śleṣmaṇoḥ prakṛtyā svabhāvena, tatkṛtayor jvarayor anaśanāl laṅghanān na bhayaṃ bhavati| yad uktam–
“kaphapitte drave dhātū sahete laṅghanaṃ mahat|
‘āmakṣayādūrdhvamato vāyurna sahate kṣaṇam||” iti|’ iti pāṭhaḥ, kvacitpustake nopalabhyate |, ‘... mapi’ iti pā.| āmakṣayād ūrdhvam ato vāyur na sahate kṣaṇam||” iti| visargāc ca hetor nānaśanād bhayam| varṣāśaraddhemantā visargaḥ, tatropacitabalāḥ prāṇino bhavanti, ‘somasya balavattvāt’ ityasya sthāne ‘somabalattvāt’ iti pā.| somasya balavattvāt; śiśiravasantagrīṣmās tv ādānaṃ, tatrāpacitabalāḥ prāṇinaḥ, ‘sūryasya balavattvāt’ ityasya sthāne ‘sūryabalattvāt ’ iti pā.| sūryasya balavattvāt iti vyutpāditaṃ śāstre| ‘tatprakṛtyā visargasya’ iti pāṭhāntare tatprakṛtyā ‘kaphapittaprakṛtyā’ iti pā.| kaphavātapittaprakṛtyā, visargasya ca prakṛtyeti yojyam| kapha ity ādi| taṃ kapham anu vātapitte bhavataḥ, anubandharūpe bhavata ity arthaḥ| hetuś cātra vasantasyādānamadhyatvenāgneyarūkṣatvāt vātapittaprakopakatvam| yad uktaṃ carake– ‘ādānamadhye tasyāpi vātapittaṃ bhaved anu (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| atra kaphapittaprakṛtyā laṅghanaṃ yuktam eva, kintv ādānamadhyatvena ‘na nirbhayaṃ tat’ ityasya sthāne ‘nirbhayaṃ tanna’ iti pā.| na nirbhayaṃ tat kāryam| ata eva ‘tatra nānaśanād bhayam’ ity etasmāt pūrvam eva paṭhitam, anyathā sarvaśeṣe paṭhitaṃ syād iti||56-57||

teṣām eva prākṛtajvarāṇāṃ cikitsāviśeṣārtham utpattikramam āha– ‘varṣāsvityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | varṣāsv ity ādi| grīṣme sañcitatvāt varṣāsu duṣṭaḥ kupito vāyuḥ pittaśleṣmānvita iti tatkālocitapittakaphānubandhaḥ jvaraṃ kuryāt| yad uktam–
“ ‘bhūvāṣpā ...’ iti pā.| bhūbāṣpān meghaniṣyandāt pākād amlāj jalasya ca|
varṣāsv agnibale hīne kupyanti pavanādayaḥ||” iti| asyānantaraṃ kvacitpustake ‘kupitaṃ pittam’ iti adhikaḥ pā.| kupitaṃ pittaṃ ca śaradi duṣṭaṃ sat jvaraṃ kuryād iti pūrvoktena sambadhyate| evaṃ kapho vasanta ity atrāpi yojyam| pittaṃ duṣṭaṃ ca śaradi varṣāsu sañcitatveneti| etasya ca pittajvaraṃ kartum udyatasya śaradi anubalo anubandhī kapho bhavati| tasya ca hetur vārṣikakledānuvṛttir eva| anubalam ivānubalaṃ yathā svatantrasya kasyacid rājño gajarathaturagapuruṣādibalavato vairibhiḥ saha yudhyamānasya paścād anyabalaṃ ‘... balobṛṃhaṇā ...’ iti pā.| tacchakter anubalopabṛṃhaṇārtham āgacchati, evaṃ svatantrasya pittasya jvaraṃ kurvato balopabṛṃhaṇaṃ śaradi kaphaḥ karoti| tayoḥ pittaśleṣmaṇoḥ, prakṛtyā svabhāvena, tatkṛtayor jvarayor anaśanāl laṅghanād bhayaṃ na bhavati| yad uktam– “kaphapitte drave dhātū sahete laṅghanaṃ mahat|” iti| ‘kasmāvisargācca’ iti pā.| tasmād visargāc ca hetor nānaśanāl laṅghanād bhayam| varṣāśaraddhemantā visargakālāḥ, tatropacitabalāḥ prāṇino bhavanti, somabalatvāt; śiśiravasantagrīṣmās tv ādānakālaḥ, tatrāpacitabalāḥ prāṇino bhavanti, sūryabalatvāt| “tatprakṛtyā visargasya” iti pāṭhāntare tatprakṛtyā pittakaphayoḥ ‘prakṛtyā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | prakṛtyā visargasya ca prakṛtyeti yojyam| candranandanas tv evaṃ vyācaṣṭe– tatra śaradi pittajvare 'naśanāl laṅghanād bhayaṃ na bhavati, kena kāraṇena! tatprakṛtyā, tayoḥ pittakaphajvarayoḥ laṅghanasādhyatvena; tathā visargāc ca kālasya visargākhyabhāvāt tatra laṅghanāt pratyavāyaśaṅkā notpadyate, jvarasyāmāśayasamutthatvāt| ‘... sādhyatvāt’ iti pā.| pittaśleṣmaṇor laṅghanasādhyatve| ‘uktam’ iti pā.| vacanaṃ ca– “kaphapitte dravatvāc ca sahete laṅghanaṃ mahat| āmakṣayād ūrdhvam api vāyur na sahate kṣaṇam” iti| aruṇadattas tv evaṃ vyācaṣṭe– tacchabdena varṣāśaradudbhūtau vātajvarapittajvarau parāmṛṣyete, tayoḥ ‘prakṛtistathā’ iti pā.| prakṛtis tayā tatprakṛtyā tatsvabhāvena tatra prākṛte jvare 'naśanād bhayaṃ na ‘bhavati’ iti śeṣaḥ; visargāc ca varṣāśaradupalakṣito hi kālo visargaḥ saumyasvabhāvaḥ, asmāc ca kāraṇāt tasmin kāle jvarotpatter laṅghanān mṛtyupratyavāyaśaṅkā na tathā bhavati yathā'nyasmin jvare ādānakālasvabhāvād vātapittānubalatvāc cānaśanād bhayaṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ| vasante kāle kapho duṣṭo jvaraṃ kuryād iti, taṃ kapham anu vātapittaṃ bhaved iti anubandharūpe bhavata ity arthaḥ| hetuś cātra vasantasyādānamadhyatve 'gner uṣṇatvād vātapittaprakopanam| yad uktaṃ carake– “ādānamadhye tasyāpi vātapittaṃ bhaved anu” iti| ataḥ kaphapittaprakṛtyā ca laṅghanaṃ yuktam eva kintv ādānamadhyatvena nirbhayaṃ tan na kāryam| ata eva tatra ‘... dbhayamititasmā ...’ iti pā.| nānaśanād bhayam ity etasmāt pūrvam eva paṭhitam, anyathā sarvaśeṣe paṭhitaṃ syād iti ||56-57||

div.ab: kāle yathāsvaṃ sarveṣāṃ pravṛttir vṛddhir eva vā |58| (vā. ni. a. 2) |

kālo 'pi doṣaviśeṣasya lakṣaṇam ity āha– kāla ity ādi| yathāsvaṃ kāle yasya vātāder yaḥ prakopakālas tatra ‘tajjasyajvarasya’ iti pā.| tajjanyajvarasya pravṛttir utpādo vṛddhir vā bhavati; athavā pravṛttir nityajvarasya, vṛddhir viṣamajvarasyeti|58|–
yathāsvaṃ kāle vātāder yaḥ prakopakālas tatra tajjanyasya jvarasya pravṛttir utpādaḥ abhivṛddhir vā bhavati| athavā pravṛttir nityajvarasya vṛddhir viṣamajvarasyeti| kālo 'pi doṣaviśeṣalakṣaṇam|58|–
nidānoktānupaśayo viparītopaśāyitā ||58|| (vā. ni. a. 2) | ‘(yathā kālo doṣaviśeṣasya lakṣaṇaṃ)’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate |

ab.seg: (yathā kālo doṣaviśeṣasya lakṣaṇaṃ) tathopaśayānupaśayāv api lakṣaṇam ity āha– nidānety ādi| nidānatvena ye uktā āhārācārādayas tair anupaśayo duḥkhaṃ nidānoktānupaśayaḥ| ‘... doṣāhārācārādyaiḥ’ iti pā.| viparītair doṣādiviparītāhārācārair upaśāyitā sukhajananaśīlatvaṃ viparītopaśāyiteti||58||

tathopaśayānupaśayāv apīty āha– nidānety ādi| nidānatvena ye uktā āhārācārādayas tair anupaśayo duḥkhaṃ nidānokto 'nupaśayaḥ, viparītair doṣāhārācārair upaśāyitā ‘janana’ ityasya sthāne ‘janaka’ iti pā.| sukhajananaśīlatvaṃ viparītopaśāyiteti; nidānatvenopayukta āhārācārādiḥ ‘sadoṣasya’ iti pā.| doṣasya atra ‘duḥkha’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| duḥkhajanakatvenānupaśayo ‘upaśaya’ ityasya sthāne ‘upaśāyitopaśayaśceci’ iti pā.| viparītas tv āhārācārādir doṣānutpādakatvād upaśaya iti piṇḍārthaḥ||58||

div.ab:
antardāho 'dhikas tṛṣṇā pralāpaḥ śvasanaṃ bhramaḥ |
sandhyasthiśūlam asvedo doṣavarcovinigrahaḥ ||59||
antarvegasya liṅgāni jvarasyaitāni lakṣayet |
santāpo hy adhiko bāhyas tṛṣṇādīnāṃ ca mārdavam ||60||
bahirvegasya liṅgāni sukhasādhyatvam eva ca |61| (ca. ci. a. 3) |

uktajvarāṇāṃ madhye samprāptivaśāt kaścid antarvego bhavati kaścid bahirvegas tayor lakṣaṇam āha– antardāha ity ādi| śvasanaṃ śvāsaḥ; ‘sadanam’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, tan na yuktam iti jejjaṭaḥ; yato 'ntarvega eva suśrute gambhīrākhyaḥ paṭhitaḥ, tatra ca śvāsa ‘eva’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | eva paṭhita iti| vinigraho 'pravṛttiḥ| asyānantaraṃ kvacitpustake ‘santāpa ityādi|’ iti adhikaḥ pā.| santāpa ity ādi| tṛṣṇādīnām ity ādiśabdenoktapralāpādīnāṃ grahaṇam| mārdavaṃ svalpatvam| asya sukhasādhyatvābhidhānenāntarvegasya kṛcchrasādhyatāṃ sūcayati, asādhyatāṃ vā, “gambhīratīkṣṇavegārtaṃ jvaritaṃ parivarjayet|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti suśrutavacanād iti||59-60||–

uktajvarāṇāṃ madhye ‘kaścit’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | samprāptivaśāt kaścid antarvego bhavati, kaścid bahirvegas tayor lakṣaṇam āha– antar ity ādi| etair liṅgair antarvegajvaraṃ lakṣayet| śvasanaṃ śvāsaḥ, anye ‘sadanam’ iti paṭhanti| doṣasya vāyor varcasaḥ purīṣasya ca vinigraho 'pravṛttiḥ| bahirvegasya lakṣaṇam āha– ‘santāpa ityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | santāpa ity ādi| etair liṅgair bahirvegaṃ lakṣayet| tṛṣṇādīnām ity ādiśabdena pralāpādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ, mārdavaṃ svalpatvam| asya tu sukhasādhyatvābhidhānenāntarvegasya kṛcchrasādhyatvaṃ darśitam asādhyatvaṃ vā| suśrute antarvego gambhīrākhyayā paṭhitaḥ– “gambhīratīkṣṇavegārtaṃ jvaritaṃ parivarjayet” iti||59-60||–

lālāpraseko hṛllāsahṛdayāśuddhyarocakāḥ ||61||
tandrālasyāvipākāsyavairasyaṃ gurugātratā |
kṣunnāśo bahumūtratvaṃ stabdhatā balavān jvaraḥ ||62||
āmajvarasya liṅgāni na dadyāt tatra bheṣajam |
bheṣajaṃ hy āmadoṣasya bhūyo jvalayati jvaram ||63||
( ātaṅkadarpaṇasammato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ śodhanaṃ śamanīyaṃ ca karoti viṣamajvaram) |
jvaravego 'dhikas tṛṣṇā pralāpaḥ śvasanaṃ bhramaḥ |
malapravṛttir utkleśaḥ pacyamānasya lakṣaṇam ||64||
kṣut kṣāmatā laghutvaṃ ca gātrāṇāṃ jvaramārdavam |
‘doṣapravṛttirutsāha’ ityātaṅkadarpaṇasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ doṣapravṛttir aṣṭāho nirāmajvaralakṣaṇam ||65|| (ca. ci. a. 3) |

ab.seg:
cikitsāviśeṣārtham āmapacyamānapakvalakṣaṇāny āha– lālety ādi| nanu, na dadyāt tatra bheṣajam iti viruddhaṃ, dvividhaṃ hi bheṣajam uktaṃ carakeṇa dravyabhūtam adravyabhūtaṃ ceti; tatra dravyabhūtaṃ kaṣāyādi, adravyabhūtaṃ laṅghanasvedādi; atra laṅghanādikaṃ ṣaḍaṅgārdhaśṛtaṃ ca prayujyate| ucyate– ‘annapāna’ ityasya sthāne ‘anupāna’ iti pā.| bheṣajaśabdenātrānnapānasādhanavyatiriktā kalpanocyate, ‘na’ iti pā.| ca tu sāmānyenauṣadhamātraṃ; katham eṣā pratītir iti cet, taruṇajvare ‘bheṣajaniṣedhe'pi’ iti pā.| bheṣajapānaniṣedhe 'pi ‘teṣāṃ vidhānadarśanāt’ iti pā.| bheṣajavidhānadarśanāt| evaṃ pacyamāne 'pi boddhavyaṃ, tatrāpi sāmatāyāḥ sadbhāvāt| kṣud ity ādi| asamāsakaraṇāt kṣudādayo vyastāḥ samastāś ca bhoddhavyāḥ| aṣṭāhaḥ ‘lakṣaṇamiti’ iti pā.| pakvalakṣaṇam iti jejjaṭaḥ| haricandras tv āha– asaty apy aṣṭāhe kṣudādibhir nirāmatvaṃ doṣapravṛttyā vā kṣudhādyabhāve 'py aṣṭāhenaiva śiṣyahitaiṣitayā kālaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ca nirdiṣṭavān iti| dvividhā hi sāmatā– ekā rasasya, aparā doṣasya; rasasāmatā tu mukhavairasyādilakṣaṇā, doṣasāmatā taruṇatvarūpā, sā'ṣṭāhenaivāpaiti| atra ca haricandreṇa hetur uktaḥ–
(‘ ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | saptāhenaiva pacyante saptadhātugatā malāḥ|
nirāmaś cāpy ataḥ prokto jvaraḥ prāyo 'ṣṭame 'hani||’ iti|) saptānāṃ dhātūnāṃ dhātvagninā saptāhenāmapākād aṣṭāhenaiva ‘nairāmyamiti|’ iti pā.| nirāmatvam iti| rasasāmatā tv aṣṭāhāt parato 'py anuvartate| enam artha jejjaṭo 'pīcchati, yad evaṃ likhati carakasuśrutaṭīkāyām– ‘taruṇā sāmatā'ṣṭāhād apaiti, rasasāmatā tu ‘pareṇāpi’ iti pā.| parato 'py anuvartate’| iti etat prayojanaṃ ca taruṇasāmatāyām auṣadhaṃ nopayujyate, rasasāmatāyāṃ tu pācanaṃ dīyate| ata evāha carakaḥ
‘jvaritaṃ ṣaḍahe 'tīte laghvannapratibhojitam|
pācanaṃ śamanīyaṃ vā kaṣāyaṃ pāyayet tu tam||’ (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| tathā–
‘mṛdau jvare laghau dehe pracaleṣu maleṣu ca|
pakvaṃ doṣaṃ vijānīyāj jvare deyaṃ tad auṣadham||’ (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) ity abhidhāyāpi yat suśrute na paṭhitam–
‘saptarātrāt paraṃ kecin manyante deyam auṣadham|
daśarātrāt paraṃ kecid dātavyam iti niścitāḥ| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti, tenaivaṃ jñāpayati– saptāhād arvāk pācanam api na dīyata iti kārtikakuṇḍenāpi vyākhyātam iti| nanu ‘jvaritaṃ ṣaḍahe 'tīte’ (ca. ci. a. 3) iti carakavacanasya ‘saptarātrāt paraṃ’ (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) ity ādinā suśrutavacanena virodhaḥ, yataḥ ṣaḍahe 'tīte saptamadinaṃ bhavati, tatra kaṣāyaṃ vidhatta iti| ucyate, ṣaḍahe 'tīte saptame laghvannapratibhojitam aṣṭame kaṣāyaṃ ‘padalopāt’ iti pā.| pāyayed ity aṣṭamapadalopād yojyaṃ rasaudanavad iti cakraḥ, ‘bheṣajaṃ hy āmadoṣasya bhūyo jvalayati jvaram|’ (ca. ci. a. 3) iti doṣaśruter uktasuśrutavirodhāc ca| prakārāntareṇainam arthaṃ kārtikakuṇḍo 'py āha, tad yathā– ṣaḍahe 'tīte iti jvarotpādadinaṃ parityajya gaṇanā, ‘bastikālaparihāreṇa kālagaṇanāvat’ iti pā.| bastidānadinaparihāreṇa ‘yathā suśrutoktatryahaparihārakāla eva bastidānadinaṃ tyaktvā carakeṇa dviguṇaḥ parihārakāla ukta iti vṛndaṭīkāyāṃ śrīkaṇṭhadattaḥ|’ iti pā.| parihārakālagaṇanāvat evaṃ
‘pāyayed āturaṃ sāmam auṣadhaṃ saptame dine|
śamanenāthavā dṛṣṭvā nirāmaṃ tam upācaret||’ ity etad api vacanaṃ vyākhyeyam| bhaṭṭāraharicandreṇāpi saptamadine kaṣāyapānaṃ yad vyākhyātaṃ tasyāyam evābhiprāyo gaveṣaṇīyaḥ, suśrutadivirodhāt| candrikākāreṇāpi vyākhyātam– “akṣiroge dinacatuṣṭayavaj jvarasya saptāhaṃ sāmatākālaḥ, tatra na pācanaṃ na vā śamanaṃ śodhanam” iti| yat tu peyādyanantaraṃ hārītenoktam–
“etāṃ kriyāṃ prayuñjīta ṣaḍrātraṃ saptame 'hani|
pibet kaṣāyasaṃyogān jvaraghnān sādhusādhitān||” iti; tathā–
“iti ṣaḍrātrikaḥ prokto navajvarahito vidhiḥ|
ataḥ paraṃ pācanīyaṃ śamanaṃ vā jvare hitam|” iti kharanādavacanaṃ ca pūrvavad aṣṭāhapratipādakaṃ draṣṭavyam| atha vā pittajvarābhiprāyeṇaiva tadvacanadvayam| yad āha suśrutaḥ– ‘saptarātrāt param’ ity ārabhya, yāvat
‘paittike vā jvare deyam alpakālasamutthite|
acirajvaritasyāpi ‘bhaiṣajyam’ iti pā.| bheṣajyaṃ ‘doṣapācanam’ iti pā.| doṣapākataḥ||’ (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti| ‘saptāhāt parato'pi’ iti pā.| saptāhād arvāg api yad etat pācanaṃ kaṣāyapānam uktaṃ ‘tadanubhūta ...’ iti pā.| tan nātyudbhūtasāmatāyāṃ draṣṭavyam| yad āha vāgbhaṭaḥ–
‘saptāhād auṣadhaṃ kecid āhur anye daśāhataḥ|
kecil laghvannabhuktasya yojyam āmolbaṇe na tu|| tīvrajvaraparītasya doṣavegodayo yataḥ| doṣe athavā atinicite tandrāstaimityakāriṇi|| apacyamānaṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ bhūyo jvalayati jvaram||’ (vā. ci. a. 1) iti|
‘ayam artho 'bhiyuktaiś ca kaiścid uktaś cikitsakaiḥ|
saptāhāt parato 'stabdhe sāme syāt pācanaṃ jvare|| nirāme śamanaṃ, stabdhe sāme nauṣadham ācaret|’ iti saṅkṣepaḥ| vistaras tu kaṣāyanirṇayaprakaraṇe draṣṭavyaḥ| pakvajvaralakṣaṇena jīrṇajvaralakṣaṇam api cikitsocitaṃ boddhavyam| yad uktaṃ tantrāntare– ‘āsaptarātram’ ity ādi| jatūkarṇenāpy uktam– ‘jīrṇas trayodaśadivasaḥ’ iti|
‘trisaptāhe vyatīte tu jvaro yas tanutāṃ gataḥ|
plīhāgnisādaṃ kurute sa jīrṇajvara ucyate||’ iti tu ‘tantrāntaravacanaṃ purāṇābhiprāyeṇa’ iti pā.| tantrāntaram atipurāṇābhiprāyeṇa draṣṭavyam||61-65||

div.ab: cikitsāviśeṣadarśanārtham āmajvaralakṣaṇam āha– lālety ādi| lālāprasekaḥ lālāsrāvaḥ, hṛllāsaḥ upasthitavamanatvam iva, hṛdayāśuddhiḥ hṛdayaṃ pūrṇam iva, guru iva cāpare| kṣunnāśaḥ chikkāyā aniḥsaraṇam, athavā kṣut kṣudhā tasyā nāśaḥ| atra ‘balavān jvaro balādhikaḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| balavān jvaro balādhikaḥ etāni lakṣaṇāni āmajvare bhavanti, tatra bheṣajaṃ pācanādi na deyaṃ, yadi dattaṃ bheṣajaṃ bhūyo jvaraṃ vardhayati śodhanaṃ yat, yac ca śamanīyaṃ tad viṣamajvaraṃ kuryāt| tatra sāmatā dvidhā– ekā rasasyāparā doṣasya, doṣasāmatā taruṇatvarūpā, rasasāmatā'ṣṭāhāt parato nivartate, taruṇasāmatāyām auṣadhaṃ nopayujyate| uktaṃ ca suśrute– “saptarātrāt paraṃ kecit manyante deyam auṣadham| daśarātrāt paraṃ kecid dātavyam iti niścitāḥ” iti| etac ca madhukośe bahu vistṛtam| pacyamānajvaralakṣaṇam āha– ‘jvaretyādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | jvarety ādi| jvaravego 'dhiko bhavati, yathā nirvāṇāvasthāyāṃ dīpaḥ prajvalati tadvat pacyamānāvasthāyāṃ jvarasya vegādhikyaṃ bhavati, malapravṛttiś ca bhavatīti pacyamānasya doṣasya lakṣaṇaṃ jānīyāt| atha nirāmajvaralakṣaṇam āha– ‘kṣudityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kṣud ity ādi| kṣuc chikkā tasyāḥ prādurbhāvaḥ| anye kṣut kṣudhā| kṣāmatā kṛśatvaṃ, jvaramārdavaṃ jvarālpatvaṃ, doṣapravṛttiḥ vāyoḥ pravartanaṃ ‘gudena’ iti śeṣaḥ| ‘utsāha’ ity atra ‘ ‘aṣṭāhāt’ iti pā.| aṣṭāha’ iti paṭhanti, aṣṭadinebhyaḥ parataḥ| etan nirāmajvaralakṣaṇaṃ, tatrauṣadhaṃ deyaṃ jvarasya|| 61-65||
balavatsv alpadoṣeṣu jvaraḥ sādhyo 'nupadravaḥ |66| (ca. ci. a. 3) |

jvarasya sādhyalakṣaṇam āha– balavatsv ity ādi| balavatsu puruṣeṣu sādhyaḥ, yad uktam– ‘balādhiṣṭhānām ārogyam’ (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| alpadoṣeṣu nātiprabaladoṣeṣu| anupadrava iti jvarasyopadravāḥ kāsādayaḥ| yad uktaṃ tantrāntare–
“kāso mūrchā'ruciś chardistṛṣṇātīsāraviḍgrahāḥ|
hikkāśvāsāṅgabhedāś ca jvarasyopadravā daśa||” iti|66|–

sādhyajvaralakṣaṇam āha– ‘balavatsvityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | balavatsv ity ādi| balavatsu balayukteṣu puruṣeṣu jvaraḥ sādhyo bhavati| yad uktam– “balādhiṣṭhānam ārogyam” iti| svalpadoṣeṣu nātibaladoṣeṣu puruṣeṣu| anupadravaḥ jvarasyopadravā ‘hikkādayaḥ’ iti pā.| kāsādayaḥ| yad uktaṃ tantrāntare– “kāso mūrchā'ruciś chardistṛṣṇātīsāraviḍgrahāḥ| hikkā śvāso 'ṅgabhedaś ca jvarasyopadravā daśa” iti|66|–

hetubhir bahubhir jāto balibhir bahulakṣaṇaḥ ||66||
jvaraḥ prāṇāntakṛd yaś ca śīghram indriyanāśanaḥ |
jvaraḥ kṣīṇasya śūnasya gambhīro dairgharātrikaḥ ||67||
asādhyo balavān yaś ca keśasīmantakṛj jvaraḥ | (ca. ci. a. 3) |
gambhīras tu jvaro jñeyo hy antardāhena tṛṣṇayā ||68||
ānaddhatvena cātyarthaṃ śvāsakāsodgamena ca | (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |
ārambhād viṣamo yas tu yaś ca vā dairgharātrikaḥ ||69||
kṣīṇasya cātirūkṣasya gambhīro yasya ‘hanti mānavam’ iti pā. | hanti tam |
visañjñas tāmyate yas tu śete nipatito 'pi vā ||70||
śītārdito 'ntaruṣṇaś ca jvareṇa mriyate naraḥ |
yo hṛṣṭaromā raktākṣo hṛdi saṅghātaśūlavān ||71||
vaktreṇa caivocchvasiti taṃ jvaro hanti mānavam |
hikkāśvāsatṛṣāyuktaṃ mūḍhaṃ vibhrāntalocanam ||72||
santatocchvāsinaṃ kṣīṇaṃ naraṃ kṣapayati jvaraḥ |
hataprabhendriyaṃ ‘kṣāmaṃ ...’ iti pā. | kṣīṇam arocakanipīḍitam ||73||
gambhīratīkṣṇavegārtaṃ jvaritaṃ parivarjayet | (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

ab.seg:
jvarasyāsādhyalakṣaṇāny āha– hetubhir ity ādi| nanu, yo ‘... rbahubhirjā ...’ iti pā.| hetubhir balibhir bahubhiś copajāyate sa bahulakṣaṇa eva ‘utpadyate’ iti pā.| bhavati, tat kiṃ bahulakṣaṇavacanena? ucyate– yathā svahetukupitā doṣāḥ sarvasyaiva rogasya hetavo bhavanti, prāktanakarmāpekṣayā tu yadā viśiṣṭāṃ sāmagrīṃ samprāptilakṣaṇām āsādayanti tadā jvaram āpādayanti, tathā dūṣyādisahakārikāraṇasānnidhyāsānnidhyābhyāṃ bahulakṣaṇatām alpalakṣaṇatāṃ ca kurvanti| tathā hi tantrāntaram–
ekaṃ dvau trīn bahūn vā'pi dehe dhātvādiyogataḥ|
darśayanti ‘vikārāśca’ iti pā.| vikārāṃs te kupitāḥ pavanādayaḥ||’ iti| ‘api ca’ iti pā.| athavā vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyād bahuhetuko 'py alpalakṣaṇo 'lpahetuko 'pi bahulakṣaṇa iti| prāṇāntakṛd iti chedaḥ| śīghram indriyanāśana iti utpannamātra eva cikitsyamāno 'pīndriyaśaktiṃ rūpādigrahaṇalakṣaṇām upahanti so 'py asādhyo na tūpekṣayā; anye 'pi hi rogā upekṣyamāṇā indriyaśaktim upaghnanti asādhyatāṃ cādhirohanti| evaṃ bahulakṣaṇo 'py ādāv eva cikitsyamāna eva boddhavyaḥ| indriyāṇy atra ekādaśa boddhavyāni sāṅkhyasiddhāntena, tathā carakasuśrutanirdiṣṭatvāt; ‘cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ ghrāṇaṃ rasanaṃ sparśanaṃ ceti ‘dhīndriyāṇi’ iti pā.| buddhīndriyāṇi, hastapādagudopasthajihvāḥ karmendriyāṇi atra ‘ceti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ceti, ubhayātmakaṃ manaḥ||’; evam anyatrāpi draṣṭavyam| jvaraḥ kṣīṇasya śūnasyeti aparam asādhyalakṣaṇam| gambhīro dairgharātrika iti gambhīro 'ntardhātusthaḥ; athavā gambhīra iva gambhīraḥ, yatra vātādīnāṃ niścayaḥ kartuṃ na śakyate; anye tv āhuḥ– gambhīro 'ntarvegaḥ| dairgharātrika iti ‘dīrgharātrānubandhī’ iti jejjaṭaḥ, “dīrghāṃ maraṇarūpāṃ rātrim anuvartate iti dairgharātrikaḥ” iti cakraḥ, asādhya ity arthaḥ| atra pakṣe dairgharātrika iti pūrveṇa sambadhyate, asādhya iti pareṇa| keśasīmantakṛd iti akasmāt keśeṣu sīmantān yaḥ karoti| uktaṃ hi tantrāntare
“keśāḥ sīmantino yasya saṅkṣipte vinate bhruvau|
‘calanti’ iti pā.| lunanti cākṣipakṣmāṇi so 'cirād yāti mṛtyave||” iti| gambhīrārthā ye jejjaṭādibhir vyākhyātās teṣu madhye atra gambhīro 'ntarvega ity ayam artho mādhavakarasyābhimataḥ; ‘ata evāsau’ ityasya sthāne ‘yata’ iti pā.| ata evāsau etadanantaraṃ sauśrutaṃ gambhīralakṣaṇaṃ likhati– gambhīra ity ādi| ‘yastu’ iti pā.| ya eva carake 'ntarvegaḥ sa eva suśrute gambhīraḥ paṭhitaḥ; samalakṣaṇatvāt, pṛthakpāṭhābhāvāc ceti| ānaddhatvena ceti ‘vibaddhamalatvena’ iti pā.| baddhadoṣatvena| ārambhād ity ādi| ārambhād utpādāt prabhṛti ‘yo’ iti pā.| yasya viṣamajvaraḥ so 'sādhyaḥ, yasya tu nityajvariṇo jvarotsṛṣṭasya vā'pacārādinā viṣamaḥ sa sādhya eva| etac ca viṣamatvaṃ satatādirūpaṃ boddhavyaṃ, na tu viṣamatvamātreṇa, vātikajvare 'pi prasaṅgād iti| dairgharātriko vyāhṛta eva; na cāsya punaruktatvaṃ, tantrāntarīyavākyatvāt; adhikārthapratipādanārthaṃ ‘tadvākhyam’ iti pā.| buddhvā'pi likhitam; evaṃ gambhīre 'pi vācyam| ‘atirūkṣasya’ ity atra ‘animiṣākṣasya’ iti pāṭhāntare sadā sphāritanetrasyety arthaḥ| visañjñaḥ vihvalaḥ, tāmyate muhyati| śete nipatita iti śayito nipatita evāste na ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca utthātuṃ samarthaḥ| śītārdito 'ntaruṣṇaś ceti śītārdito bahiḥ, ‘antaruṣṇordāhavān’ iti pā.| antaruṣṇo 'ntardāhavān| hṛṣṭaromā romāñcitagātraḥ| hṛdi saṅghātaśūlavān iti saṅghātarūpeṇa vastunā aṣṭhīlikādinā''krāntam iva hṛdayaṃ manyate yaḥ ‘sa tathā;’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sa tathā; anye tv āhuḥ– nānāprakāraśūlavān iti| vaktreṇa caivocchvasitīty evakāreṇa nāsikāṃ vyavacchinatti ‘vyāpāditasya’ iti pā.| vyāditāsyapratipādanārthaṃ, kharaśvāsa ity arthaḥ| hikkety ādi| hikkādibhir militair ekenāpy atibalavatā'sādhyatvam| mūḍhaṃ mohayuktam| vibhrāntalocanaṃ bhrāntaprekṣaṇaṃ, calitanetraṃ vā| santatocchvāsinaṃ ‘nirantarocchvāsinam’ iti pā.| nirantarakharaśvāsayuktam| hataprabhety ādi| hataprabhāṇi hataśaktīni svaviṣayāgrāhīṇi cakṣurādīni yasya sa tathā; athavā hatā prabhā dīptir indriyāṇi ca yasya sa tathā| ‘arocakanipīḍitam’ ity atra sthāne jejjaṭaḥ pāṭhāntaradvayaṃ paṭhati– ‘durātmānam upadrutam’ iti, vyācaṣṭe ca– “durātmānaṃ duṣṭāntaḥkaraṇam, upadrutam iti śvāsādibhir upadravair upadrutam; durātmabhir upadrutam” iti pāṭhāntare tu rākṣasādibhir juṣṭam ity arthaḥ| eṣām asādhyalakṣaṇānām upalakṣaṇatvād anyāny api tantrāntareṣu draṣṭavyāni| tad yathā–
‘pretaiḥ saha piben madyaṃ svapne yaḥ kṛṣyate śunā|
sughoraṃ jvaram āsādya ‘na jīvenna ca mucyate’ iti pā.| sa jīvam apasṛjyate||
jvaraḥ paurvāhṇiko yasya śuṣkakāsaś ca dāruṇaḥ|
balamāṃsavihīnasya yathā pretas tathaiva saḥ||
jvaro yasyāparāhṇe tu śleṣmakāsaś ca dāruṇaḥ|
balamāṃsavihīnasya yathā pretas tathaiva saḥ||
sahasā jvarasantāpas tṛṣṇā mūrchā balakṣayaḥ|
viśleṣaṇaṃ ca sandhīnāṃ mumūrṣor upajāyate||
gosarge pratyūṣe| gosarge ‘vedanādyasya’ iti pā.| vadanād yasya svedaḥ pracyavate bhṛśam|
lepajvaropasṛṣṭasya durlabhaṃ tasya jīvitam||
mṛtyuś ca tasmin bahupicchilatvāc chītasya jantoḥ paritaḥ saratvāt|
svedo lalāṭe himavan narasya śītārditasyaiti supicchilaś ca|| kaṇṭhe sthito yasya na yāti vakṣo nūnaṃ yamasyaiti gṛhaṃ sa martyaḥ||
srutasvedo lalāṭād yaḥ ślathasandhānabandhanaḥ|
muhyed utthāpyamānas tu sa sthūlo 'pi na jīvati||
yasya svedo 'tibahulaḥ picchilo yāti sarvataḥ|
rogiṇaḥ śītagātrasya tadā maraṇam ādiśet||’ iti|
‘nidhanaṃ janmataḥ saptamaṃ, pratyaraṃ pañcamaṃ, vipatkaraṃ tṛtīyam’ ityaṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahavyākhyāyāminduḥ| ādhānajanmanidhane pratyayākhye vipatkare|
nakṣatre vyādhir utpannaḥ kleśāya maraṇāya vā|
jvaras tu jātaḥ ṣaḍrātrād aśvinīṣu nivartate||’ (vṛ. vā. ni. a. 1) ity ādinā granthena nakṣatrabhedena jvarasya sādhyatvāsādhyatvaṃ yad abhihitaṃ, tad dhārītavṛddhavāgbhaṭayor draṣṭavyam, iha tu vistarabhayān na likhitam| sannipātā sādhyaprakaraṇaṃ yathā– ‘pittakaphānilavṛddhyā daśadivasa dvādaśāha– saptāhāt| hanti vimuñcati vā''śu tridoṣajo dhātumalapākāt||’ iti| saptāhād vātādhikaḥ, daśāhāt pittādhikaḥ, dvādaśāhāt kaphādhikaḥ; pittādhikavad vātapittādhikaḥ, kaphādhikavad vātakaphādhikaḥ, yogavāhitvād vāyoḥ| ( ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | yad āha carakaḥ–
‘yogavāhī paraṃ vāyuḥ saṃyogād ubhayārthakṛt|
dāhakṛt tejasā yuktaḥ śītakṛt somasaṃśrayāt||’ iti (ca. ci. a. 3)| dhātupākād dhanti, malapākād vimuñcatīti vyavasthitavikalpaḥ; ‘dhātumalapākabhede’ iti pā.| dhātumalapākavikalpe ca daivam eva hetuḥ| uttarottararogavṛddhibalahānibhyāṃ śukrādidhātusahitamūtrādinā ca dhātupāko jñeyaḥ, atra kvacitpustake ‘anyathā tu malapākaḥ;’ iti adhikaḥ pā.| anyathā tu malapākaḥ| yad uktam–
‘nidrānāśo hṛdi stambho viṣṭambho gauravārucī|
aratir balahāniś ca dhātūnāṃ pākalakṣaṇam|| iti; anyatā ca malapākaḥ–
‘... vaicitryam’ iti pā.| doṣaprakṛtivaikṛtyaṃ laghutā jvaradehayoḥ|
indriyāṇāṃ ca vaimalyaṃ doṣāṇāṃ pākalakṣaṇam||’ iti| nanu, ‘taratamabhāvāt’ iti pā.| taratamādibhāvavyavasthitaśīghramadhyamandaśaktitvāt asyānantaraṃ kvacitpustake ‘sthiraśīghramadhyamaśaktitvāt’ iti adhikaḥ pā.| sthiraśīghramadhyamaśaktitvāt doṣāṇāṃ kathaṃ saptāhādiniyama iti cet| na, tathā– svabhāvād vyādheḥ, vicitrā hi pratirogaṃ svabhāvāḥ; yathā'gnirohiṇī saptāhena hanti na tathā'nye ‘rogā’ iti pā.| vikārā iti| ‘tatra’ iti pā.| athaḥ
‘saptamī dviguṇā ‘yātu’ iti pā.| yāvat navamy ekādaśī tathā|
eṣā ‘dvidoṣa’ iti pā.| tridoṣamaryādā mokṣāya ca vadhāya ca||’ (vā. ni. a. 2) iti hārītavacanasaṃvādārtham evaṃ vyācakṣate– daśamīpratyāsattyā navamī, dvādaśīpratyāsattyā ekādaśī ca gṛhyate; ‘tatra’ iti pā.| tato vṛddhyeti padam āvartya sarvatra dvaiguṇyaṃ kāryam| evaṃ,
‘saptame divase prāpte daśame dvādaśe 'pi vā|
punar ghorataro bhūtvā praśamaṃ yāti hanti vā||’ (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) ity atra suśrutavākye punaḥśabdena dvaiguṇyam iti kārtikakuṇḍo vyākhyātavān| evaṃ
daśadvādaśasaptāhaiḥ pittaśleṣmānilādhikaḥ|
dagdhoṣmaṇā dhātumalān hanti muñcati vā jvaraḥ||’ (vā. ni. a. 2) ity atrādhikaśabdam āvartya kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā dvaiguṇyaṃ ‘boddhavyam’ iti pā.| vyākhyātam| tathā
vātapittakaphaiḥ saptadaśadvādaśavāsarān|
prāyo 'nuyāti maryādā mokṣāya ca vadhāya ca||’ (vā. ni. a. 2) ity atrāgniveśamate prāyograhaṇena dvaiguṇyam iti| nanu, saptamīty ādau kathaṃ tarhi daśaviṃśatidvādaśacaturviṃśatīnāṃ grahaṇam iti cet| ucyate– ekādaśīty atra eketi padam āvartanīyaṃ, tena navamī eketi daśamī labhyate, ekādaśī eketi dvādaśī asyānantaraṃ kvacitpustake ‘labhyate’ iti adhikaḥ pā.|, tataḥ sarvatra dvaiguṇyam| tu śabdaḥ samuccaye, tena saptamī gṛhyate sā dviguṇā ca| evaṃ navamyādiṣu yojyam| caturviṃśatyadhikas tu maryādādivaso nāsti, tatpratipādakāgamādarśanāt||66-73||

div.ab:
jvarasyāsādhyalakṣaṇam āha– hetubhir ity ādi| yo jvaro balibhiḥ prabalair hetubhiḥ kāraṇair jāto 'ta eva bahulakṣaṇaḥ sampūrṇalakṣaṇa ity arthaḥ sa tv asādhyaḥ; yaś ca śīghram indriyanāśano bhavati so 'pi jvaraḥ prāṇāntakṛt maraṇātmaka ity arthaḥ| utpannamātra eva cikitsitamātro 'pi indriyaśaktiṃ ‘... ghnanti’ iti pā.| rasarūpādigrahaṇalakṣaṇām upaharati ‘so'pyasādhyo na tūpekṣayā| anye'ti hi rogā upekṣyamāṇā indriyaśaktimupaghnanti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | so 'py asādhyo na tūpekṣayā| anye 'ti hi rogā upekṣyamāṇā indriyaśaktim upaghnanti asādhyatāṃ cādhirohanti; evam uktalakṣaṇo 'py ādāv evācikitsyamāna eva bodhyaḥ| indriyāṇi cātra cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ ghrāṇaṃ rasanaṃ sparśanaṃ ceti pañca buddhīndriyāṇi hastapādagudopasthajihvāḥ pañca karmendriyāṇi ubhayātmakaṃ mana evam ekādaśendriyāṇi| aparam asādhyalakṣaṇam āha– śūnasya śothayuktasya puruṣasya, ‘kṣīṇasya jvareṇa ’ ityasya sthāne ‘jvarakṣīṇasya jvareṇakṣīṇasya’ iti pā.| kṣīṇasya jvareṇa, gambhīro dairghyarātrikaḥ, gambhīro 'ntardhātusthaḥ, athavā gambhīra iva gambhīraḥ, yatra vātādīnāṃ niścayaḥ kartuṃ na śakyate, anye gambhīro 'ntarvegaḥ| ‘dairgharātrika’ iti pā.| dairghyarātrika iti dīrgharātrānubandhīti jejjaṭaḥ, dīrghāṃ maraṇarūpāṃ rātrim anuvartata iti cakraḥ, asādhya ity arthaḥ| keśasīmantakṛd iti akasmāt keśeṣu sīmantān karoti yaḥ| uktaṃ ca tantrāntare– “keśāḥ sīmantino yasya saṅkṣipte vitate bhruvau| ‘lulanti’ iti pā.| lunanti cākṣipakṣmāṇi so 'cirād yāti mṛtyave” iti| suśrutoktaṃ sādhyagambhīrajvaralakṣaṇam āha– gambhīras tv ity ādi| ānaddhatveneti ‘... vibandhaneti’ iti pā.| doṣapurīṣavibandhena| ‘gambhīrasyāmasādhya ...’ iti pā.| aparam asādhyalakṣaṇam āha– ‘ārambhādityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ārambhād ity ādi| ārambhāt prabhṛti yasya viṣamo jvaraḥ so 'sādhyaḥ| tac ca viṣamatvaṃ ‘... rūpatvam’ iti pā.| satatādirūpatyena boddhavyaṃ na tu viṣamatvaṃ vegādinā| ‘dairghyarātrikaḥ’ iti pā.| dairgharātrikaḥ pūrvam eva vyākhyāto 'pi na ‘paunaruktaḥ’ iti pā.| punaruktaḥ, tantrāntarīyavākyatvāt ‘adhikārtha ...’ iti pā.| adhikāryapratipādanārthaṃ tad vākyaṃ ‘paṭhanti’ iti pā.| paṭhitam| ‘atirūkṣasya’ ity atra ‘animiṣākṣasya’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanty anye| tatra sarvadā sphāritanetrasyety arthaḥ| anyad apy asādhyalakṣaṇam āha– visañjño vihvalaḥ, tāmyati pramuhyati, ‘śete nipatata iva’ ityasya sthāne ‘śete nipatata iti| kṣayito'pi nipatita’’ iti pā.| śete nipatata iva āste naivotthātuṃ samarthaḥ| śītārdito bahir antardāhavān| anyad apy asādhyalakṣaṇam āha– ‘ya ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ya ity ādi| hṛṣṭaromā romāñcitaḥ| hṛdi saṅghātaśūlavān iti saṅghātarūpeṇa vastunā aṣṭhīlakādinā ‘... ntameva’ iti pā.| ākrāntam iva hṛdayaṃ manyate yaḥ, aṣṭhīlā pāṣāṇaloṣṭikā, anena prakāreṇa śūlavān iti| anye tv āhuḥ– nānāprakāraśūlavān iti| vaktreṇa caivocchvasitīti ‘evaṃ prakāreṇa’ iti pā.| evakāreṇa nāsikābhyāṃ vyavacchinatti| hikkety ādibhir militair ekena ‘... sādhyatm’ iti pā.| vā'py atibalavatā'sādhyatvam| mūḍhaṃ mohayuktaṃ, vibhrāntalocanaṃ bhrāntaprekṣaṇaṃ calitanetraṃ vā, santatocchvāsinaṃ nirantarocchvāsinam| lakṣaṇāntaram āha– ‘hatetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | hatety ādi| hataprabhāṇi hataśaktīni svaviṣayāgrāhīṇi ca indriyāṇi cakṣurādīni yasya sa tathā; athavā hatā prabhā dīptir indriyāṇi ca yasya sa tathā| arocakanipīḍitam ity atra jejjaṭaḥ pāṭhadvayaṃ paṭhati ‘durātmānamudrupatam’ iti pā.| ‘durātmānam upadrutaṃ iti| durātmānaṃ duṣṭāntaḥkaraṇam| upadrutam upadravayuktam| ‘durātmabhir upadrutam’ iti pāṭhāntare rākṣasādibhir juṣṭam ity arthaḥ| gambhīro 'ntarvegaḥ, tīkṣṇo 'tiduḥsaho bahir antaś ca, tābhyām anyonyam ārtaṃ pīḍitaṃ, ‘kṣāmaṃ kṣīṇam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kṣāmaṃ kṣīṇaṃ, tam itthambhūtaṃ jvaritaṃ svārthavidyāyaśohānibhayād asādhyatvāt parivarjayet| eṣām asādhyalakṣaṇānām upalakṣaṇatvād anyāny api tantrāntareṣu draṣṭavyāni| tad yathā–
“pretaiḥ saha piben madyaṃ svapne yaḥ kṛṣyate śunā|
sa ghoraṃ jvaram āsādya naro jīvād vimucyate||
jvaraḥ pūrvāhṇiko yasya śuṣkakāsaś ca dāruṇaḥ|
‘... vihīnasya’ iti pā.| balamāṃsavihīnaś ca yathā pretas tathaiva saḥ|| gosarge ‘vedanā yasya’ iti pā.| varanād yasya svedaḥ pracyavate bhṛśam| lepajvaropasṛṣṭasya durlabhaṃ tasya jīvitam” iti| atra ‘atra’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| atra gosarge pratyūṣe|
“mṛtyuś ca tasmin bahupicchilatvāc chītasya jantoḥ paritaḥ saratvāt|
svedo lalāṭe himavan narasya ‘... tasyāpi’ iti pā.| śītārditasyaiti supicchilaś ca|| kaṇṭhe sthito yasya na yāti vakṣo nūnaṃ yamasyaiti gṛhaṃ sa martyaḥ” iti| tathā'nyatrāpi–
“āvilākṣaṃ pratāmyantaṃ nidrāyuktam atīva ca|
kṣīṇaśoṇitamāṃsaṃ ca naraṃ kṣapayati jvaraḥ||
srutasvedo lalāṭād yaḥ ślathasandhānabandhanaḥ|
‘guhyatyutthā...’ iti pā.| muhyaty utthāpyamānas tu sa sthūlo 'pi na jīvati||
yasya svedo 'tibahulaḥ picchilo yāti sarvataḥ|
rogiṇaḥ śītagātrasya tadā maraṇam ādiśet|| yas tāmyati svapiti śītalagātrayaṣṭir antarvidāhasahitaṃ ‘smaraṇādupetam’ iti pā.| smaraṇād apetam| socchvāsinaṃ ‘dūṣitaroma ...’ iti pā.| kupitaromacayaṃ saśūlaṃ taṃ varjayed bhiṣag iha jvaritaṃ vidhijñaḥ” iti “jvaras tu jātaḥ ṣaḍrātrād aśvinīṣu nivartate” ity ādi nakṣatrabhedena jvarasyāsādhyatvam| yad uktaṃ ‘taddhārītavāgbhaṭayo ...’ iti pā.| tad dhārītavṛddhavāgbhaṭayor draṣṭavyam||66-73||–

lg.l: dāhaḥ svedo bhramas tṛṣṇā ‘... sañjñitā’ iti pā. | kampaviḍbhid asañjñatā |

ab.seg:
jvaravimuktipūrvarūpam āha– dāha ity ādi viḍbhid iti viḍbhedaḥ; sampadādipāṭhāt ‘bhāve’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhāve kvip| asañjñitā sañjñānāśaḥ| kūjanam ‘kunthanam’ iti pā.| asphuṭadhvaniḥ| yad uktam– ‘jvarapramokṣe puruṣaḥ ‘kūjanvamati’ iti pā.| kūjed vamati ceṣṭate||’(ca. ci. a. 3) iti| vāgbhaṭo 'py āha–
‘dhātūn prakṣobhayan doṣo mokṣakāle balīyate|
tato naraḥ śvasan svidyan kūjan vamati ceṣṭate|| (vā. ni. a. 2) iti| vaigandhyaṃ durgandhatā gātre| jvaramokṣaṇe bhaviṣyati ākṛtir lakṣaṇaṃ ‘bhavati’ iti śeṣaḥ| nanu, doṣakṣayaṃ vinā na vyādhinivṛttiḥ, kṣīṇaś ca doṣaḥ katham evaṃvidhaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kuryāt? ucyate– kaścid bhāvaḥ kṣīṇo 'pi vināśakāle svaśaktiṃ darśayati, yathā– nirvāṇāvastho dīpo viśeṣāt prajvalati| athavā doṣābhibhūtānāṃ dhātūnāṃ doṣāpagamena kṣobhād dāhādayaḥ taralataravānaraparihīyamānataruṇataruvallarīśikharakampavad iti||74||
