arocakaḥ sa vijñeyo, bhaktadveṣam ataḥ śṛṇu||
cintayitvā tu manasā dṛṣṭvā śrutvā'pi bhojanam|
dveṣam āyāti yo jantur bhaktadveṣaḥ sa ucyate|| kupitasya bhayārtasya yaś ca bhaktanirodhajaḥ” atra ‘abhicārahatasya ca| yasya nānne bhavecchraddhā so'bhaktacchanda ucyate||’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| iti||4||

vātādibhedena mukhe vikṛtim abhidhāyānyadeśavikṛtim āha– hṛcchūlety ādi| hṛdi śūlena pīḍanaṃ hṝcchūlapīḍanaṃ tena yuktaṃ, coṣaḥ cūṣaṇavat pīḍā| arocakam iti śeṣaḥ| śleṣmātmakaṃ sakaphaprasekaṃ syāt| bahubhir iti tridoṣaiḥ, bahurujam anekapīḍākaram| vaiguṇyamohajaḍatābhir athāparaṃ ceti upalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā, vaiguṇyaṃ manaso vyākulatvam, aparam iti ‘doṣādanyat’ iti pā.| doṣajād anyat āgantujam ity arthaḥ| arocakalakṣaṇam– satyāṃ bubhukṣāyām abhyavahārāsāmarthyam iti aruciḥ, abhilaṣitam apy annaṃ dīyamānaṃ nābhyavaharatīti nānnābhinandanam, annasya śravaṇasmaraṇadarśanasparśanagandhair yatrodvijate sa bhaktadveṣaḥ| evaṃ trividho 'pi rogaś carakasuśrutābhyām arocakaśabdena saṅgṛhītaḥ| uktaṃ hi vṛddhabhojena–
“prakṣiptaṃ tu mukhe cānnaṃ jantor na svadate muhuḥ|
arocakaḥ sa vijñeyo bhaktadveṣam ataḥ śṛṇu||
cintayitvā tu manasā dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca bhojanam|
dveṣam āyāti yo jantur bhaktadveṣaḥ sa ucyate|| kupitasya bhayārtasya abhicārābhibhūtaye| yasyānne na bhavec chraddhā sa bhaktadveṣa ucyate” iti||4||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne arocakanidānaṃ samāptam ||14||
iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyām arocakanidānaṃ samāptam||14||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānaṭīkāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyām arocakanidānam||14||

div.head: chardinidānam
div.ab:
atha chardinidānam |
duṣṭair doṣaiḥ pṛthak sarvair bībhatsālocanādibhiḥ |
chardayaḥ pañca vijñeyās tāsāṃ lakṣaṇam ucyate ||1||
atidravair atisnigdhair ahṛdyair lavaṇair ati |
akāle cātimātraiś ca tathā'sātmyaiś ca bhojanaiḥ ||2||
śramād bhayāt tathodvegād ajīrṇāt krimidoṣataḥ |
nāryāś cāpannasattvāyās tathā'tidrutam aśnataḥ ||3||
bībhatsair hetubhiś cānyair drutam utkleśito balāt |
chādayann ānanaṃ vegair ardayenn aṅgabhañjanaiḥ |
agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate atyantam aparītasya ccharder vai sambhavo dhruvam |
nirucyate chardir iti doṣo vaktraṃ pradhāvitaḥ ||4|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 49) |

ab.seg: chardyām apy arucer bhāvāt tathā'rocakavat pañcavidhatvād arocakānantaraṃ chardiḥ, tasyā nidānaṃ niruktiṃ cāha– duṣṭair ity ādi| bībhatsālocanaṃ vikṛtidarśanam; ādigrahaṇenāniṣṭagandhabhakṣaṇādīnāṃ grahaṇam| nāryāś cāpannasattvāyā iti garbhiṇyāḥ, tasyā garbhotpīḍanena vātavaiguṇyāc chardiḥ| chādayann ānanam ity ādi vegair mukhaṃ chādayan pūrayan, ardayan pīḍayan, aṅgabhañjanaiḥ aṅgabhedaiḥ| chādayati mukham, ardayati cāṅgānīti chardiḥ; ‘chada apavāraṇe’, ‘arda hiṃsāyāṃ’, anayoḥ pṛṣodarāditvena rūpasiddhiḥ||1-4||

chardyām arucer bhāvād arocakānantaraṃ chardir ucyate, tasyā nidānaṃ niruktiṃ cāha– duṣṭair ity ādi| etaiḥ kāraṇair vakṣyamāṇair duṣṭair doṣaiḥ chardayaḥ pañca bhavanti| vātādibhis trayaḥ, tridoṣeṇaikā, bībhatsādibhir ekā, evaṃ pañca| bībhatsaṃ vikṛtadarśanam, ādiśabdenāniṣṭagandhabhakṣaṇādīnāṃ grahaṇam| nidānapūrvāṃ samprāptim āha-atīty ādi| nāryāś cāpannasattvāyā iti gurviṇyāḥ, tasyā garbhotpīḍanena vātavaiguṇyāc chardiḥ| bībhatsair hetubhiś cānyair iti pūyāmedhyādidarśanagandhāsvādanair ghṛṇākāribhiḥ| chādayann ānanam iti doṣavegena mukhaṃ pūrayan, ardayan aṅgabhañjanair aṅgabhedaiḥ; chādayati mukham ardayati ca aṅgāni sa chardir iti nirucyate, vegair mukhaṃ prati pradhāvito doṣa udāno vāyuḥ chardiṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ||1-4||

div.ab:
hṛllāsodgārarodhau ca praseko lavaṇas tanuḥ |
dveṣo 'nnapāne ca bhṛśaṃ vamīnāṃ pūrvalakṣaṇam ||5|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 49) |

ab.seg: pūrvarūpam āha– hṛllāsety ādi| udgārarodha udgārāpravṛttiḥ| praseko mukhaprasekaḥ, tasya lavaṇatvaṃ prabhāvāt, āmāśayotkleśabhavatvena kaphavidāhād vā; tanur aghano 'lpo vā||5||

tasyāḥ pūrvarūpam āha– hṛd ity ādi| chardīnām idaṃ pūrvarūpam| udgārarodha udgārāpravṛttiḥ, praseko mukhaprasekaḥ udakasrāvaḥ, tasya lavaṇatvaṃ prabhāvād āmāśayotkleśabhavatvena kaphavidāhād vā, tanuḥ aghanaḥ alpo vā||5||

div.ab:
hṛtpārśvapīḍāmukhaśoṣaśīrṣanābhyartikāsasvarabhedatodaiḥ |
udgāraśabdaprabalaṃ saphenaṃ vicchinnakṛṣṇaṃ tanukaṃ kaṣāyam |
kṛcchreṇa cālpaṃ mahatā ca vegenārto 'nilāc chardayatīha duḥkham ||6|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: vātajāyā lakṣaṇam āha– hṛtpārśvety ādi| śīrṣanābhyartiḥ mastake nābhau ca śūlaṃ; todair ity anantaraṃ ‘yukta’ iti śeṣaḥ, upalakṣaṇe vā tṛtīyā| ārto naraś chardayatīti yojyam| kimbhūtaṃ chardayatīty āha– udgārety ādi| udgāraśabdābhyāṃ prabalam udgāraśabdaprabalam| vicchinnaṃ sāntaravegam alpadravaṃ vā, vātasya ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | svato dravatvābhāvāt| tanukam aghanam| kaṣāyaṃ kaṣāyarasaṃ, kaṣāyasya vātakṛtatvāt||6||

vātajām āha– hṛd ity ādi| śīrṣanābhyartir iti mastake nābhau ca śūlam| todair ity anantaraṃ ‘yukta’ iti śeṣaḥ, upalakṣaṇe vā tṛtīyā| atra ‘udgāreti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| vātān naraś chardayatīti yojyam| kimbhūtaṃ chardayatīty āha– udgāraśabdābhyāṃ prabalam udgāraśabdaprabalam| vicchinnaṃ viralavegaṃ alpadravaṃ vā, ‘tasya dravyatvābhāvāt’ iti pā.| vātasya dravatvābhāvāt| tanukam aghanam| kaṣāyaṃ kaṣāyarasaṃ, kaṣāyarasasya vātakṛtatvāt| kṛcchreṇa kaṣṭena, alpaṃ stokaṃ, mahatā vegena||6||

div.ab:
mūrchāpipāsāmukhaśoṣamūrdhatālvakṣisantāpatamobhramārtaḥ |
pītaṃ bhṛśoṣṇaṃ haritaṃ satiktaṃ dhūmraṃ ca pittena vamet sadāham ||7|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: pittajām āha– mūrchety ādi| tamo 'ndhakāradarśanam iva| dhrūmraṃ kṛṣṇalohitavarṇam||7||

pittajām āha– mūrchety ādi| mūrdhni śirasi tālvakṣṇoś ca santāpavān| tamo 'ndhakāradarśanam iva, bhramaś cakrārūḍhasyeva, padārthasya anyathājñānaṃ vā, tair ārtaḥ| kīdṛśaṃ vamed ity āha– pītam ity ādi| bhṛśoṣṇam atyuṣṇaṃ, haritaṃ śākavarṇaṃ, dhūmraṃ kṛṣṇalohitavarṇaṃ, pitteneti yojyam||7||

div.ab:
tandrāsyamādhuryakaphaprasekasantoṣanidrārucigauravārtaḥ |
snigdhaṃ ghanaṃ svādu kaphād viśuddhaṃ saromaharṣo 'lparujaṃ vamet tu ||8|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: kaphajām āha– tandrety ādi| āsyamādhuryaṃ mukhasya madhurarasatvam| santoṣa iti santoṣa iva santoṣaḥ, annānabhilāṣa ity arthaḥ; tṛpto hi nānnam abhilaṣati| arucir abhyavahārāsāmarthyam| svādu madhuram| viśuddham atiśubhraṃ, suśrute “śuklaṃ himaṃ sāndrakaphaṃ kaphena|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 49) iti pāṭhāt||8||

kaphajām āha– tandrety ādi| etair upadravair ārtaḥ snigdhādikaṃ vamet| āsyamādhuryaṃ mukhasya madhurarasatvam| santoṣa iva santoṣaḥ annānabhilāṣa ity arthaḥ, tṛpto hi nānnam abhilaṣati| arucir abhyavahārāsāmarthyam| svādu madhuram| viśuddham iti viśuddhaṃ kevalaṃ kaphaṃ; yad uktaṃ suśrute– “śuklaṃ himaṃ ‘sāndram’ iti pā.| sāndrakaphaṃ kaphena|” iti| alparujam iti kaphasya dravarūpatvāt mukhena niḥsaraṇam ity arthaḥ||8||

div.ab:
śūlāvipākārucidāhatṛṣṇāśvāsapramohaprabalā prasaktam |
chardis tridoṣāl lavaṇāmlanīlasāndroṣṇaraktaṃ vamatāṃ nṛṇāṃ syāt ||9|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: tridoṣajām āha– śūlety ādi| śūlādibhiḥ pramohāntaiḥ prabalā śūlādiprabalā| prasaktaṃ nirantaram| tridoṣād ity atra ‘tridoṣā’ iti pāṭhāntare tridoṣajety arthaḥ||9||

tridoṣajām āha– śūlety ādi| tridoṣāt yā chardiḥ tayā vamatāṃ nṛṇām ity arthaḥ| śūlādibhiḥ pramohāntaiḥ prabalā, prasaktaṃ nirantaraṃ, tridoṣād ity atra ‘tridoṣā’ iti pāṭhas tatra tridoṣajety arthaḥ||9||

div.ab:
viṭsvedamūtrāmbuvahāni vāyuḥ srotāṃsi saṃrudhya yadordhvam eti |
utsannadoṣasya samācitaṃ taṃ doṣaṃ samuddhūya narasya koṣṭhāt ||10||
viṇmūtrayos tatsamagandhavarṇaṃ tṛṭśvāsahikkārtiyutaṃ prasaktam |
pracchardayed duṣṭam ihātivegāt tayā'rditaś cāśu vināśam eti ||11|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: asādhyām āha– viḍ ity ādi| utsannadoṣasya udgatadoṣasya | doṣam iti pittaṃ kaphaṃ vā, svedādikān vā tadduṣṭān dhātumalān| tad iti yasmād viḍādivāhisrotoduṣṭis tato hetor viṇmūtrayoḥ samagandhavarṇaṃ chardayatīti yojyam| iyaṃ tu chardir vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhā tridoṣajeti kecit, anye tv āhuḥ– sarvā eva chardayaḥ prabalā evaṃvidhāḥ satyo 'sādhyāḥ syur iti||10-11||

asādhyām āha– viḍ ity ādi| etacca– ‘utpannadoṣasyeti’ iti pā.| utpannadoṣasya udgatadoṣasya pittaṃ kaphaṃ vā, agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake ‘ ... chardayatīti yojyam|’ etatpāṭhapaścādupalabhyate | vāyuḥ koṣṭhād uddhūya ūrdhvaṃ nītveti| svedādikān atra ‘vāyu’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| doṣān dhātumalān vā ‘samasthānāt’ iti pā.| svasthānāt sañcālya ūrdhvam ety āgacchati| tad iti ‘tasmād ... ’ iti pā.| yasmād viḍādivāhisrotoduṣṭis tato viṇmūtrayoḥ samagandhavarṇaṃ chardayatīti yojyam| atra ‘yadā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| iyaṃ tu chardis tridoṣajety eke| anye tu sarvā eva chardayaḥ prabalāḥ evaṃvidhāḥ satyaḥ asādhyā ity arthaḥ||10-11||

div.ab:
bībhatsajā daurhṛdajā''majā ca ‘asātmyajā’ iti pā. | hy asātmajā ca krimijā ca yā hi |
sā pañcamī tāṃ ca vibhāvayec ca doṣocchrayeṇaiva yathoktam ādau ||12|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 49) |

ab.seg: āgantujām āha– bībhatsajety ādi| daurhṛdajā daurhṛdālābhajā, āmajā ajīrṇajā, asātmyajā ‘ ... bhojanajā’ iti pā.| asātmyabhakṣaṇādisambhūtā, krimijā koṣṭhakrimisambhavā; bībhatsajety ādinā krimijāntenaikatvenaiva gaṇanīyā, āgantujatvasāmānyāt| atra ‘āgantujvaravat|’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| sā pañcamīti tridoṣajāpekṣayā sāmānyenāgantujaiva, āgantujvaravat; yadi tu bībhatsajāpekṣayā krimijā pañcamīti gaṇyate, tadā tāṃ ca vibhāvayet| doṣocchrayeṇaivety anena krimijāyā eva doṣasambandhaḥ syāt, tataś ca bībhatsajādīnāṃ cikitsopayogidoṣasambandho na labhyate| anye tu taddoṣaparihārārthaṃ’ ‘sā pañcamī tāś ca’ iti bahuvacanāntaṃ paṭhanti, evaṃ ‘sati antargaṇanamaprayojanamiti antargaṇanayā’ iti pā.| saty antargaṇanayā na prayojanam ity antargaṇanāṃ nādriyante| katham atra doṣocchrayo vibhāvanīya ity āha– yathoktam ādāv iti| ādau vātādilakṣaṇe ity arthaḥ||12||

āgantujām āha– bībhatsajety ādi| bībhatsajā pūyāmedhyādidarśanagandhasvādajā, āpannasattvāyā striyā daurhṛdālābhajā, āmajā ajīrṇajā, asātmyajā asātmyabhojanajā, krimijā koṣṭhakrimisambhavā, bībhatsajety ādinā krimijāntā ekaiva gaṇanīyā| evaṃ ‘sarvātirekai ... ’ iti pā.| sarvābhir ekaivāgantujatvasāmānyāt, āgantujvaravat| pañcamīti tridoṣajāpekṣayā| āgantujāṃ doṣocchrayeṇaiva jānīyāt| yathoktam ādāv iti yathā vātādilakṣaṇena ādāv iti pūrvoktena||12||

div.ab:
śūlahṛllāsabahulā krimijā ca viśeṣataḥ |
krimihṛdrogatulyena lakṣaṇena ca lakṣitā ||13|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 49) |

ab.seg: krimijāyā lakṣaṇam āha– śūlety ādi| krimihṛdrogatulyena lakṣaṇena lakṣiteti krimihṛdroge ‘krimilakṣaṇavatt’ iti pā.| krimilakṣaṇāt yat pīḍādikaṃ tad asyāṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ||13||

krimijāyā viśeṣalakṣaṇam āha– śūlety ādi| kṛmijāyā ayaṃ viśeṣaḥ– hṛcchūlahṛllāsādhikā ‘krimijā ... ’ iti pā.| krimijahṛdrogatulyalakṣaṇena ca lakṣiteti; yathā–
“utkledaḥ ṣṭhīvanaṃ todaḥ śūlaṃ hṛllāsakas tamaḥ|
aruciḥ śyāvanetratvaṃ śoṣaś ca krimije bhavet|” iti||13||

div.ab:
kṣīṇasya yā chardir atiprasaktā sopadravā śoṇitapūyayuktā |
sacandrikāṃ tāṃ pravaded asādhyāṃ sādhyāṃ cikitsen nirupadravāṃ ca ||14|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg:
asādhyalakṣaṇam āha– kṣīṇasyety ādi| sacandrikām iti medaḥprabhṛtidhātūnāṃ snehaḥ pravartamāno ‘ ... candravat’ iti pā.| mayūrapicchacandrikāvat pratibhāti| nirupadravām iti kāsādyupadravarahitām| tad uktam–
“kāsaḥ śvāso jvaro hikkā tṛṣṇā vaicittyam eva ca|
hṛdrogas tamakaś caiva jñeyāś charder upadravāḥ||” iti||14||

asādhyāṃ sādhyāṃ cāha– atiprasaktā atiśayena nirantarā, sopadravā vakṣyamāṇopadravayuktā| sacandrikam iti| medaḥprabhṛtidhātūnāṃ snehaḥ pravartamāno mayūrapicchacandrikāvat pratibhāti| itthaṃ pañcavidhām api chardim asādhyāṃ pravadet varjayed ity arthaḥ| nirupadravāṃ kāsādyupadravarahitāṃ sādhyāṃ cikitset ‘bhiṣak’ iti śeṣaḥ||14||

lg.l: pūrvāṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti tāsām utpattikāle tu viśeṣato hi |
kāsaḥ ‘śvāso'jvaro’ iti pā. | śvāso jvaro hikkā tṛṣṇā vaicittyam eva ca |
hṛdrogas tamakaś caiva jñeyāś charder upadravāḥ ||15||

ab.seg: tasyā upadravam āha– kāsa ity ādi| vaicittyaṃ vimatacittatā||15||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne chardinidānaṃ samāptam ||15||
iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ chardinidānaṃ samāptam||15||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānaṭīkāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ chardinidānam||15||

div.head: tṛṣṇānidānam
div.ab:
atha tṛṣṇānidānam |
bhayaśramābhyāṃ balasaṅkṣayād vā ‘ūrdhvam’ iti pā. | hy ūrdhvaṃ citaṃ pittavivardhanaiś ca |
pittaṃ savātaṃ kupitaṃ narāṇāṃ tāluprapannaṃ janayet pipāsām |
srotassv apāṃvāhiṣu dūṣiteṣu doṣaiś ca tṛṭ sambhavatīha jantoḥ ||1||
tisraḥ smṛtās tāḥ kṣatajā caturthī kṣayāt tathā hy āmasamudbhavā ca |
bhaktodbhavā saptamiketi tāsāṃ nibodha liṅgāny anupūrvaśas tu ||2|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 48) |

ab.seg: chardes tṛṣṇopadravatvāc chardyanantaraṃ tṛṣṇānidānam| tasyāḥ samprāptim āha– bhayety ādi| pittavivardhanair iti kaṭvamloṣṇādibhiḥ krodhopavāsādibhiś ca svasthāna eva sañcitaṃ kupitaṃ ca pittaṃ, vātaś ca bhayaśramabalakṣayaiḥ kupitaḥ, ūrdhvaṃ prasarat pipāsāṃ janayati| tālv ity upalakṣaṇaṃ; tena klomādy api bodhyaṃ, tasya pipāsāsthānatvenoktatvāt| carake 'py uktam– “rasavāhinīś ca ‘ ... tāluklomnaḥ’ iti pā.| dhamanīr jihvāmūlagalatālukaklomnaḥ| saṃśoṣya nṝṇāṃ dehe ‘ ... balām’ iti pā.| kurutas tṛṣām atibalau tau tu||” (ca. ci. a. 22) iti| annakaphāmajānāṃ samprāptim āha– srotaḥsv ity ādi| nanu, apāṃvāhiṣv iti bahuvacanaṃ viruddhaṃ, ‘dve udakavahe’ (su. śā. a. 9) iti suśrutenoktatvāt| naivaṃ, tayor evānekapratānayogād iti| doṣair iti annakaphāmaiḥ, duṣṭikartṛtvād duṣṭadoṣasambandhād vā'nnāmayor api doṣatvam iti gadādharaḥ ‘gayadāsaḥ’ iti pā.|| tisra iti vātādibhiḥ pratyekam| kṣatajeti ‘ ... nimittavraṇinām’ iti pā.| kṣatanimittā vraṇināṃ yā ‘bhavatīti’ iti pā.| bhavati| caturthīty anenoktānāṃ catasṛṇāṃ sukhasādhyatvaṃ bodhayati, anyāsāṃ tu kaṣṭasādhyatvam||1-2||

chardes tṛṣṇopadravatvāc chardyanantaraṃ tṛṣṇānidānaṃ, tasyāḥ samprāptim āha– atra ‘bhayaśramabalakṣayaiḥ kupito vāyuḥ’ iti pā.| bhayaśramābhyām ity ādi| pittavivardhanaiḥ kaṭvamloṣṇādibhiḥ krodhopavāsādibhiś ca svasthāne hṛdi sañcitaṃ pittaṃ, vātaś ca bhayaśramabalakṣayaiḥ kupitaḥ, ūrdhvaṃ prasaran pipāsāṃ janayet| tāluprapannam iti savātaṃ pittaṃ tālugatam ity arthaḥ| tālv ity upalakṣaṇam; tena klomagatam api boddhavyaṃ, ‘tasyāḥ’ iti pā.| tasya pipāsāsthānatvāt| uktaṃ ca carake– “rasavāhinīś ca dhamanīr jihvāmūlagalatālukaklomnaḥ| saṃśoṣya nṛṇāṃ dehe kurutas tṛṣām atibalau tau tu” iti| annakaphajāmajānāṃ samprāptim āha– srotaḥsv ity ādi| nanu srotaḥsv iti bahuvacanaṃ viruddhaṃ yad uktaṃ suśrute– “dve udakavahe” iti| maivaṃ, tayor evānekapratānayogād iti| atra ‘doṣairiti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| annakaphāmaiḥ, duṣṭikartṛtvād duṣṭadoṣasambandhād annāmayor api doṣatvam iti gayadāsaḥ| tisra iti vātādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ, kṣatajeti kṣatanimittā vraṇināṃ yā bhavati, caturthīty anena coktānāṃ tisṛṇāṃ ‘sukhasādhyatvam’ iti pā.| sādhyatvaṃ bodhayati, anyāsāṃ tu kaṣṭasādhyatvam iti| kṣayād anyā pañcamī, āmasamudbhavā ṣaṣṭhī, bhaktodbhavā saptamiketi, krameṇa tāsāṃ lakṣaṇāni jānīhi||1-2||

div.ab:
kṣāmāsyatā mārutasambhavāyāṃ todas tathā śaṅkhaśiraḥsu cāpi |
srotonirodho virasaṃ ca vaktraṃ śītābhir adbhiś ca vivṛddhim eti ||3|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 48) |

ab.seg: vātajām āha– kṣāmāsyatety ādi| kṣāmāsyatā śuṣkadīnamukhatvam| srotonirodho atra ‘iti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| rasāmbuvāhidhamanīnirodhaḥ| śītābhir adbhir ity anena vāyoḥ śītasya śītāmbunā vṛddhir ity anupaśayanidarśanam| cakārāc carakoktanidrānāśasya grahaṇam| yad āha carakaḥ– “nidrānāśaḥ śiraso bhramas tathā śuṣkagalatāluḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 22) iti||3||

vātajāṃ tṛṣṇām āha– kṣāmety ādi| kṣāmāsyatā śuṣkadīnamukhatvaṃ, vaktuṃ carvituṃ vā'sāmarthyam ity eke| śaṅkhaśiraḥsv iti śaṅkhayoḥ śirasi vā, todo vyathāviśeṣaḥ; śaṅkhayor dvitvena bahuvacanatvam| srotonirodhaḥ rasāmbuvāhidhamanīnirodhaḥ; anye śabdāśravaṇam iti| śītābhir adbhir ity anena vāyoḥ śītaḥ sparśaḥ, tena vṛddhir ity anupaśayasya nidarśanaṃ; cakārāc carakoktanidrānāśasya grahaṇam||3||

div.ab:
mūrchānnavidveṣavilāpadāhā raktekṣaṇatvaṃ pratataś ca śoṣaḥ |
śītābhinandā mukhatiktatā ca pittātmikāyāṃ paridūyanaṃ ca ||4|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 48) |

ab.seg: pittajām āha– mūrchety ādinā| ‘vilāpaḥ ’ iti pā.| vilāpo 'tra pralāpaḥ| pratataś ca śoṣaḥ atīva mahatī tṛṣṇā| śītābhinandā śītecchā, ‘guroś ca halaḥ’ ity akārapratyayaḥ| ‘paridūyanamanutāpaḥ’ iti pā.| paridūyanam upatāpaḥ, ‘paridhūmanam’ iti pāṭhe 'ntaḥkṣobhaṇaṃ, dhūmanirgama iva vā| cakārāt pītaviṇmūtranetratvādayo grāhyāḥ||4||

pittajām āha– mūrchety ādi| vilāpo vividhaprakāreṇa bhāṣaṇaṃ, raktekṣaṇatvaṃ raktanetratvaṃ, pratataś ca śoṣa iti atimahatī tṛṣṇā, śītābhinandā śītecchā, paridūyanam upatāpaḥ, ‘paridhūpanam’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, tatrāntaḥkṣobhaṇaṃ dhūmasyodgiraṇam iva atra ‘vā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.|,cakārāt pītaviṇmūtranetrādayo grāhyāḥ||4||

div.ab:
bāṣpāvarodhāt kaphasaṃvṛte 'gnau tṛṣṇā balāsena bhavet tathā tu |
nidrā gurutvaṃ madhurāsyatā ca tṛṣṇārditaḥ śuṣyati cātimātram ||5|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 48) |

ab.seg:
śleṣmajām āha– bāṣpety ādi| svakāraṇakupitena kaphenopariṣṭād ācchādite 'ntaragnau kaphāvaruddhabāṣpeṇa pāvakoṣmaṇā'dhogatenāmbuvahasrotaḥśoṣaṇāt atra ‘kaphajatṛṣṇā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| kaphajā tṛṣṇā bhavati| nanu, kaphajā tṛṣṇā'nupapannā? kaphasya vṛddhasya kevaladravasya pipāsākartṛtvāyogāt, vātapittayor eva tṛṣṇākartṛtvenoktatvāt| yad uktam– “pittaṃ savātaṃ kupitaṃ narāṇāṃ” ity ādi| carake 'py uktam– “nāgner vinā tarṣaḥ pavanād vā, tau hi śoṣaṇe hetū|” (ca. ci. a. 22) iti| suśrute 'py uktam–
“madyasyāgneyavāyavyaguṇāv ambuvahāni tu|
srotāṃsi śoṣayeyātāṃ tatas tṛṣṇā prajāyate||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) iti| ata āha– tatheti| uktaprakāreṇa kaphād agner bāṣpāvarodhādinā, na tu svaguṇena; ata eva carake kaphajā tṛṣṇā na paṭhitaiva, suśrutena tu cikitsābhedārthaṃ paṭhitā, hārītenāpi sapittenaiva śleṣmaṇā tṛṣṇā paṭhitā na tu kevalena| yad āha–
“svādvamlalavaṇājīrṇaiḥ kruddhaḥ śleṣmā sahoṣmaṇā|
prapadyāmbuvahaṃ srotas tṛṣṇāṃ sañjanayen nṛṇām||
śiraso gauravaṃ tandrā mādhuryaṃ vadanasya ca|
bhaktadveṣaḥ prasekaś ca nidrādhikyaṃ tathaiva ca|| etair liṅgair vijānīyāt tṛṣṇāṃ kaphasamudbhavām|” iti||5||

śleṣmajām āha– bāṣpety ādi| svakāraṇakupitena kaphena saṃvṛte ‘uparicchādite ... ’ iti pā.| upariṣṭādācchādite 'ntaragnau kaphāvaruddhabāṣpeṇa atra ‘pāvakoṣmaṇā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| adhogatānām ambuvāhasrotasāṃ śoṣaṇāt kaphajā tṛṣṇā bhavati| nanu kaphena tṛṣṇā'nupapannā? kaphasya vṛddhasya kevaladravabhūtasya pipāsākartṛtvāsambhavāt, vātapittayor eva tṛṣṇākartṛtvenoktatvāt; yad uktam– “pittaṃ savātaṃ kupitaṃ narāṇām” ity ādi| carake 'py uktam– “nāgner vinā hi tarṣaḥ pavanād vā tau hi śoṣaṇe hetū” iti| suśrute 'py uktaṃ “madyasyāgneyavāyavyau guṇāv ambuvahāni ca| srotāṃsi śoṣayeyātāṃ tatas tṛṣṇā pravartate” iti| ata evāha– tatheti| uktaprakāreṇa kaphād agner bāṣpāvarodhādinā na tu svaguṇena, ata eva carakeṇa kaphajā tṛṣṇā na paṭhitaiva, suśrute tu cikitsābhedārthaṃ paṭhitā, hārītenāpi sapittena śleṣmaṇaiva tṛṣṇā paṭhitā na tu kevalā|
“svādvamlalavaṇājīrṇaiḥ kruddhaḥ śleṣmā sahoṣmaṇā|
prapadyāmbuvahaṃ srotas tṛṣṇāṃ sañjanayen nṛṇām||
śiraso gauravaṃ tandrā mādhuryaṃ vadanasya ca|
bhaktadveṣaḥ prasekaś ca nidrādhikyaṃ tathaiva ca|| liṅgair etair vijānīyāt tṛṣṇāṃ kaphasamudbhavām” atra ‘iti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.|| tayā tṛṣṇayā pīḍito manuṣyo 'titarāṃ kṛśo bhavati, dhātūnām anupacayāt||5||

div.ab: kṣatasya rukśoṇitanirgamābhyāṃ tṛṣṇā caturthī kṣatajā matā tu |6| (su. u. taṃ. a. 48) |
kṣatajām āha– kṣatasyety ādi| śastrādikṣatayuktasya|6|–
kṣatajām āha– atra ‘kṣatasyeti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| śastrādikṣatayuktasya narasya rukpīḍanāc choṇitasrāvāc ca tṛṣṇā jāyate| sā kṣatasambhavā caturthī|6|–

rasakṣayād yā kṣayasambhavā sā tayā'bhibhūtaś ca niśādineṣu ||6||
pepīyate 'mbhaḥ sa sukhaṃ na yāti tāṃ sannipātād iti kecid āhuḥ |
etaccātaṅkadarpaṇakāro mūle nāṅgīkaroti rasakṣayoktāni ca lakṣaṇāni tasyām aśeṣeṇa bhiṣag vyavasyet ||7|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 48) |

ab.seg:
kṣayaśabdasyānekaviṣayatvāt kṣayajāṃ viśeṣayann āha– rasakṣayād ity ādi| pepīyate punaḥ punaḥ pibati; etac ca viśeṣaparaṃ, sarvatṛṣṇāsu tathābhūtatvāt| yad āha suśrutaḥ–
“satataṃ yaḥ pibed vāri na tṛptim adhigacchati|
punaḥ kāṅkṣati toyaṃ ca taṃ tṛṣṇārditam ādiśet||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 58) iti| rasakṣayoktāni ca lakṣaṇāni suśrutoktāni| tad yathā– “rasakṣaye hṛtpīḍā kampaḥ atra ‘śoṣaḥ’ iti kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śoṣaḥ śūnyatā tṛṣṇā ca|” (su. sū. a. 15) iti| tasyāṃ kṣayajāyām| aśeṣeṇa kārtsnyena||6-7||

kṣayaśabdasyānekaviṣayatvāt kṣayajāṃ viśeṣayann āha– rasakṣayād ity ādi| rasakṣayoktāni ca lakṣaṇāni tasyām aśeṣeṇa bhiṣag vyavasyet| rasakṣayāt tṛṣṇā bhavati, sā kṣayajā jñeyā| tayā vyāptaḥ pumān jalaṃ pepīyate punaḥ punaḥ pibati, paraṃ sukhaṃ na labhate, jalena tṛpto na bhavatīty arthaḥ| etac ca viśeṣaparaṃ, sarvatṛṣṇāsu tathābhūtatvāt| tāṃ kecana sannipātāt kathayanti| yad uktaṃ suśrute– “satataṃ yaḥ pibet toyaṃ na tṛptim adhigacchati| punaḥ kāṅkṣati toyaṃ ca taṃ tṛṣṇārditam ādiśet” iti| rasakṣayoktāni tu lakṣaṇāni suśrutoktāni– tathā ca “rasakṣaye hṛtpīḍā kampaḥ śoṣaḥ śuṣkatā tṛṣṇā ca” iti| etāni samastāny api bhavanti||6-7||

div.ab: tridoṣaliṅgā''masamudbhavā ca hṛcchūlaniṣṭhīvanasādakartrī |8| (su. u. taṃ. a. 48) |
āmajām āha– tridoṣety ādi| tridoṣaliṅgā tridoṣaliṅgayuktā| ‘āme hi ajīrṇe'jīrṇāt ... ’ iti pā.| āmād ajīrṇāt tridoṣakopaḥ syād iti|8|–

āmajām āha– tridoṣety ādi| tridoṣaliṅgā tridoṣaliṅgayuktā| sādo 'ṅgānām| etān upadravān karoti| āme hi ajīrṇāt tridoṣakopaḥ syād iti| uktaṃ ca suśrute– “ajīrṇāt pavanādīnāṃ vibhramo balavān bhavet” iti|8|–
snigdhaṃ tathā'mlaṃ lavaṇaṃ ca bhuktaṃ gurv annam evāśu tṛṣāṃ karoti ||8|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 48) |

ab.seg: bhuktodbhavām āha– snigdham ity ādi| cakārāt kaṭu ca, ‘na ca’ iti pā.| na tu tiktakaṣāyamadhurāṇīty arthaḥ| guruśabdena mātrāguru dravyaguru ca gṛhyate| dṛḍhabalena tu pañca tṛṣṇāḥ paṭhitāḥ, vātapittakṣayāmopasargajāḥ (ca. ci. a. 22) iti; tatra, kaphajā āmajāyām evāvaruddhā; kṣatajā vātajāyāṃ; bhaktajā ca vātajāyāṃ, bhaktāvaraṇena vātaprakopāt; pittajāyāṃ vā, vidāhena ‘pittaprakopaṇāt’ iti pā.| pittaprakopāt| suśrute copasargajā yathāsvaṃ doṣajāsu| nanu, madyajā'pi suśrutena madātyaye (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) paṭhitā, tat kathaṃ saptety ucyate? satyaṃ, tasyā vātapittajāyām avarodhaḥ, evaṃ dṛḍhabalamate 'pi||8||

bhaktodbhavām āha– snigdham ity ādi| cakārāt kaṭu ca, na tu tiktakaṣāyamadhurāṇīty arthaḥ| guruśabdena mātrāguru dravyaguru ca gṛhyate| dṛḍhabalena tu pañca tṛṣṇā uktāḥ vātapittakṣayāmopasargajanitā iti| tatra kaphajāyām āmajā'ntarbhūtā, vātājāyāṃ kṣatajā; bhaktajā'pi vātajāyāṃ, bhaktāvaraṇena vātakopāt, pittajāyāṃ vā vidāhena pittakopāt| suśrute ‘ca upasargāt’ iti pā.| copasargajā ‘yathā’ iti pā.| yathāsvaṃ doṣajāsu| nanu, madyajā'pi suśrute madātyaye paṭhitā, tat kathaṃ saptety ucyate? tasyā vātajāyām antarbhāvāt; evaṃ dṛḍhabalamate 'pi||8||

lg.l: bhavati khalu yopasargāt tṛṣṇā sā śoṣiṇī kaṣṭā ||9||

ab.seg: tatropasargajām āha– dīnety ādi| dīnasvaraḥ kṣāmavacanaḥ, pratāmyan muhyan, dīnaḥ klāntaḥ| upasargād iti ‘upadravāt’ iti pā.| upadravād rogāt; upadravaśabdaś ca sāmānyena rogamātre 'pi vartate, yathā– “nirūhopadravacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ|” (su. ci. a. 38) ity atra| kaṣṭā kaṣṭasādhyā, vyādhikarṣitadehatvāt||9||

tatropasargajām āha– dīnety ādi| dīnasvaraḥ kṣāmavacanaḥ, pratāmyan muhyan, dīnaḥ klāntaḥ, upasargād iti upadravāt rogāt, upadravaśabdas tu sāmānyena rogamātre 'pi vartate| yathā– “nirūhopadravacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ” iti| śoṣiṇī dhātuśoṣaṇātmikā| sā kaṣṭā kaṣṭasādhyā, vyādhikarṣitadehatvāt||9||

div.ab: jvaramohakṣayakāsaśvāsādyupasṛṣṭadehānām |10| (ca. ci. a. 22) |
tān evopasargān āha– jvarety ādi| ādiśabdenātīsārādīnāṃ grahaṇam|10|–
tān evopasargān āha– jvarety ādi| ādiśabdenātīsārādīnāṃ grahaṇam| etair vyādhibhir gṛhītadehānāṃ nṛṇām; atra pūrvalakṣaṇānurodhaḥ|10|–

sarvās tv atiprasaktā rogakṛśānāṃ vamiprayuktānām |
ghoropadravayuktās tṛṣṇā maraṇāya vijñeyāḥ ||10|| (ca. ci. a. 22) |

ab.seg: asādhyānāṃ lakṣaṇam āha– sarvās tv ity ādi| sarvā vātajādayaḥ, atiprasaktā atipravṛddhāḥ| ghoropadravayuktā mukhaśoṣādibhir balavadbhir upadravaiḥ samanvitā iti jejjaṭaḥ||10||

asādhyalakṣaṇam āha– sarva ity ādi| atiprasaktā atipravṛddhā, etacca– ‘vamiprasaktānām’ iti pā.| vamiprasaktānām iti śarīraśleṣmaśodhanāya vamanaśīlānām, ghoropadravayuktāḥ śvāsaśoṣādibhir balavadbhir upadravair yuktā iti jejjaṭaḥ| tā maraṇakārikā ity arthaḥ||10||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne tṛṣṇānidānaṃ samāptam ||16||
iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ tṛṣṇānidānaṃ samāptam||16||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānaṭīkāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ tṛṣṇānidānam||16||

div.head: mūrchābhramanidrātandrāsannyāsanidānam
div.ab:
atha mūrchā-bhrama-nidrā-tandrā-sannyāsanidānam |
kṣīṇasya bahudoṣasya viruddhāhārasevinaḥ |
vegāghātād abhighātād dhīnasattvasya vā punaḥ ||1||
karaṇāyataneṣūgrā bāhyeṣv ābhyantareṣu ca |
niviśante yadā doṣās tadā mūrchanti mānavāḥ ||2||
sañjñāvahāsu nāḍīṣu pihitāsv anilādibhiḥ |
tamo 'bhyupaiti sahasā sukhaduḥkhavyapohakṛt ||3||
sukhaduḥkhavyapohāc ca naraḥ patati kāṣṭhavat |
moho mūrcheti tām āhuḥ ṣaḍvidhā sā prakīrtitā ||4||
vātādibhiḥ śoṇitena madyena ca viṣeṇa ca |
ṣaṭsv apy etāsu pittaṃ tu prabhutvenāvatiṣṭhate ||5|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 46) |

ab.seg: tṛṣṇāyāṃ moho bhavatīti tṛṣṇānantaraṃ mūrchā, uktaṃ hi– ‘tṛṣito moham āyāti’ iti| nidānaṃ samprāptiṃ cāha– kṣīṇasyety ādi| bahudoṣasyeti vipuladoṣasya, na tv anekadoṣasya; tathā saty ekadoṣajāyāḥ samprāptir noktā syāt| vegāghātāt malādivegadhāraṇāt| ‘abhighātāt laguḍādibhiḥ’ iti pā.| abhighātāl laguḍādeḥ| hīnasattvasya hīnasattvaguṇasya| karaṇaṃ manaḥ, tasyāyatanāni bāhyāni cakṣurādīni, ābhyantarāṇi manovahāni srotāṃsi, yair āgatya manaś cakṣurādīny adhitiṣṭhati; athavā bāhyāni karmendriyāṇi, ābhyantarāṇi dhīndriyāṇi; teṣu yadā ugrā doṣā niviśante tadā mūrchantīti yojyam| punaḥ kayā samprāptyā ity ata āha– sañjñāvahāsv ity ādi| sañjñāvahanāḍīśabdena sirādhamanīsrotasāṃ grahaṇam ity āhuḥ, yatas tair mana ‘indriyādideśam’ iti pā.| indriyadeśaṃ prāpnoti| pihitāsu āvṛtāsu| tamo manoguṇo 'jñānahetuḥ, abhyupaiti vardhate, sahasā jhaṭiti| anyeṣu tamobahuleṣu rogeṣu madātyayādiṣu sattvarajasī atra ‘dṛśyete’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| na tathā līyete, yathā mūrchāyām ity ata āha– sukhaduḥkhavyapohakṛd iti| sukhaduḥkhayor asaṃvittikaram| etat tu prāyikatvenoktaṃ, (trividhaṃ jñānaṃ bhavati heyopādeyopekṣaṇīyabhedāt,) tenopekṣaṇīyajñānābhāvo 'pi jñeyaḥ| vyavahārārthaṃ tatparyāyām āha– moho mūrcheti| vātādibhis tisraḥ, śoṇitamadyaviṣaiś ca tisraḥ, evaṃ ṣaṭ| prabhutveneti vyāpakatvena, tena vātajādiṣv api jvaravad rogamahimnā'vaśyaṃ pittasambandhaḥ, ata eva vakṣyati– “mūrchā pittatamaḥprāyā” iti, cikitsāyāṃ ca śītakriyāvidhānam iti||1-5||

tṛṣṇāyāṃ moho bhavatīty atas tṛṣṇānantaraṃ mūrchārambhaḥ, tasyā nidānapūrvā samprāptim āha– kṣīṇasyeti puruṣasya| bahudoṣasyeti vipuladoṣasya vegāghātāt malādivegavidhāraṇāt| abhighātāl laguḍādeḥ| viruddhāhārasevinaḥ viruddha āhāraḥ kṣīramatsyādiḥ| hīnasattvasya kṣīṇasattvaguṇasya| karaṇaṃ manas tasyāyatanāni bāhyāni cakṣurādīni, ābhyantarāṇi manovāhīni srotāṃsi vair āgatya manaś cakṣurādīny adhitiṣṭhati; athavā bāhyāni karmendriyāṇi ābhyantarāṇi ‘buddhīndriyāṇi’ iti pā.| dhīndriyāṇi| teṣu yadā ugrā atiprasṛtā doṣā niviśante avatiṣṭhante, tadā mānavā mūrchanti, iti yojyam| samprāptim āha– sañjñāvahāsv iti| atra ‘“sukhaduḥkhavyapohācca naraḥ patatīkāṣṭhavat”’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| sañjñāvahanāḍīśabdena ‘śirā ... ’ iti pā.| sirādhamanīsrotasāṃ grahaṇaṃ, yatas tair indriyadeśaṃ manaḥ prāpnoti| pihitāsu ruddhāsu| tamo manoguṇaḥ ajñānahetuḥ, tasyāvaraṇātmakatvāt| abhyupaiti vardhate, sahasā jhaṭiti| anyeṣu tamobahuleṣu rogeṣu madātyayādiṣu na tathā sattvarajasī līyete yathā mūrchāsv ity ata āha– agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sukhaduḥkhavyapohakṛd iti; sukhaduḥkhayor vyapohas tiraskāras tayor asaṃvittir ity arthaḥ; athavā sukhaṃ sattvaṃ, duḥkhaṃ rajaḥ, tayor vyapohakṛt, tamasā tayor āvṛtatvāt; ataḥ ‘kāṣṭhavanniṣpatati ... ’ iti pā.| kāṣṭhavan nipatatīty arthaḥ| vyavahārārthaṃ tatparyāyān āha– moho mūrcheti tasyāḥ paryāyau| uktaṃ cābhidhānāntare– “sañjñopaghāte mūrchāyo mūrchā syān mūrchanaṃ tathā| kaśmalaṃ pralayo mohaḥ sannyāsas tu mṛtopamaḥ” ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| sā ca mūrchā ṣaḍvidhā ṣaṭprakārā bhavati| vātādibhiḥ śoṇitamadyaviṣaiś ca tisraḥ, evaṃ ṣaḍvidhatvam āha– vātādibhir iti| prabhutveneti vātādiṣv api vyāpakatvena pittam evāvatiṣṭhate ‘jvarahṛroga ... ’ iti pā.| jvaravad rogamahimnā'vaśyaṃ pittasambandhaḥ; ihaiva vakṣyaty agre– “mūrchā pittatamaḥprāyā” iti, cikitsāyāṃ ca śītakriyāvidhānam iti ||1-5||

div.ab:
hṛtpīḍā jṛmbhaṇaṃ glāniḥ sañjñādaurbalyam eva ca |
sarvāsāṃ pūrvarūpāṇi, yathāsvaṃ tā vibhāvayet ||6|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 46) |

ab.seg: tasyāḥ pūrvarūpam āha– hṛtpīḍety ādi| sañjñādaurbalyam asamyagjñānatā| sarvāsāṃ pūrvarūpāṇīti chedaḥ| yathāsvaṃ vibhāvayed iti ‘tāṃ mūrchām’ iti pā.| tāḥ mūrchāḥ vātādibhedena jānīyāt vyaktarūpāvasthāyāṃ, na tu pūrvarūpāvasthāyām iti jejjaṭaḥ||6||

tasyāḥ pūrvarūpam āha– hṛd ity ādi| sañjñādaurbalyam asamyagjñānatā| pūrvarūpāṇīti pādatrayeṇa chedaḥ| yathāsvaṃ atra ‘ca’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| vibhāvayed iti tāṃ mūrchāṃ vātādibhedena jānīyād ity arthaḥ; vyaktarūpāvasthāyāṃ na tu pūrvarūpāvasthāyām iti jejjaṭaḥ||6||

div.ab:
nīlaṃ vā yadi vā kṛṣṇam ākāśam athavā'ruṇam |
paśyaṃs tamaḥ praviśati śīghraṃ ca pratibudhyate ||7||
vepathuś cāṅgamardaś ca prapīḍā hṛdayasya ca |
kārśyaṃ śyāvā'ruṇā chāyā mūrchāye vātasambhave ||8|| (ca. sū. a. 24) |

ab.seg: tā evāha (vātajām āha)– nīlam ity ādi| nīlaṃ snigdhakṛṣṇaṃ, kṛṣṇaṃ rūkṣakṛṣṇam, aruṇam īṣallohitam| tamaḥ praviśaty andhakāram iva praviśati mūrchatīty arthaḥ| śīghraṃ ca pratibudhyata iti vāyoḥ śīghrakāritvāt| kārśyaṃ śyāvā'ruṇā chāyā, ‘gātrasyeti’ iti pā.| ‘gātre’ iti śeṣaḥ| mūrchāyaśabdo mūrchāparyāyaḥ||7-8||

vātajām āha– nīlam ity ādi| nīlaṃ snigdhakṛṣṇam, aruṇam īṣallohitam īdṛśaṃ gaganaṃ paśyan tamaḥ praviśati andhakāram iva praviśati mūrchatīty arthaḥ| śīghraṃ ca pratibuddhyate vāyoḥ śīghrakāritvāt| kārśyaṃ śyāvā'ruṇā chāyā gātrasyeti śeṣaḥ| mūrchāyaśabdo mūrchāparyāyaḥ||7-8||

div.ab:
raktaṃ haritavarṇaṃ vā viyat pītam athāpi vā |
paśyaṃs tamaḥ praviśati sasvedaś ca prabudhyate ||9||
(sapipāsaḥ sasantāpo raktapītākulekṣaṇaḥ) |
agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate jātamātre patati ca śīghraṃ ca pratibudhyate |
sambhinnavarcāḥ pītābho mūrchāye pittasambhave ||10|| (ca. sū. a. 24) |

ab.seg: pittajamūrchāyam āha– raktam ity ādi| viyad ākāśam| atra “sapipāsaḥ sasantāpo raktapītākulekṣaṇaḥ|” iti kvacid adhikaḥ pāṭha||9-10||

pittajām āha– raktam ity ādi| viyad ākāśaṃ, raktaṃ, haritavarṇaṃ śākavarṇaṃ, pītaṃ vā paśyan tamaḥ praviśatīti mūrchatīty arthaḥ| yadā prabudhyate tadā svedo bhavati, sapipāsaḥ tṛṣṇānvitaḥ, santāpavāṃś ca bhavati| rakte pīte ākule traste iva īkṣaṇe locane yasya sa tathā| ‘anye raktapittākulekṣaṇaḥ’ iti paṭhanti| tatra raktapitto vikāraḥ| (jātamātre utpannamātre, patati śīghraṃ ca pratibudhyate|) pītābhaḥ pītaśarīracchaviḥ||9-10||

div.ab:
meghasaṅkāśam ākāśam āvṛtaṃ vā tamoghanaiḥ |
paśyaṃs tamaḥ praviśati cirāc ca pratibudhyate ||11||
gurubhiḥ prāvṛtair aṅgair yathaivārdreṇa carmaṇā |
saprasekaḥ sahṛllāso mūrchāye kaphasambhave ||12|| (ca. sū. a. 24) |

ab.seg: kaphajamūrchāyam āha– meghety ādi| tamoghanair iti tamobhir ghanaiś ca; tamo 'ndhakāraḥ, ghano 'tra meghavācī||11-12||
śleṣmajām āha– meghasaṅkāśam ity ādi| ārdreṇa carmaṇā iva prāvṛtair veṣṭitair aṅgair upalakṣitaḥ| praseko mukhasrāvaḥ, upasthitavamanatvam iva||11-12||
ab.note: atra ‘yathā catvāro'pasmārā vātena pittena śleṣmaṇā sannipātena, tadvanmūrchā apītyarthaḥ’ ityadhikamātaṅkadarpaṇe

div.ab:
sarvākṛtiḥ sannipātād apasmāra ivāgataḥ |
sa jantuṃ pātayaty āśu vinā bībhatsaceṣṭitaiḥ ||13|| (ca. sū. a. 24) |

ab.seg: sānnipātikam āha– sarvety ādi| nanu, sarvākṛtir iti viruddham, uddeśe “ṣaḍvidhā sā prakīrtitā” ity abhihitatvāt; sannipātajayā atra ‘ca’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| saha ‘saptatvaṃ prasajyeta’ iti pā.| sapta prasajyeran? ucyate– uddeśaḥ suśrutagranthena, carakagranthena ca vivaraṇam| carake ‘hi ekajāḥ tridoṣajā’ iti pā.| hy ekajās tisras tridoṣajā ‘caiketi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | caiketi catasraḥ paṭhyante| yad uktam aṣṭodarīya– “catvāro mūrchāyā iti apasmārair vyākhyātāḥ|” (ca. sū. a. 18) iti| raktamadyaviṣajānāṃ yathādoṣam etāsv antarbhāvaḥ; suśrute caitā raktādijā lakṣaṇacikitsābhedakhyāpanārthaṃ sākṣāt paṭhitāḥ, tridoṣajāyāḥ doṣajāsv antarbhāvaḥ ity abhiprāyeṇa bheda ācāryayoḥ; saṅgrahe cātra sarvatantrasvīkārād ubhayam api likhitam ity adoṣaḥ| apasmāra iveti ‘yathā'pasmārī’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yathā'pasmārī mahatā'bhighātena patati cireṇa pratibudhyate| apasmāre phenavāmitvadantaghaṭṭanākṣivaikṛtādikam adhikam iti bhedaḥ| bībhatsaceṣṭitair iti phenavāmitvādibhir eva||13||

sannipātajām āha– sarvākṛtir ity ādi| nanu sarvākṛtir iti viruddham? pūrvam uddeśe ‘ṣaḍvidhā sā prakīrtitā’ ity uktaṃ, sannipātajayā saha saptasaṅkhyātvaṃ syāt| ucyate– uddeśaḥ suśrutena vivaraṇaṃ carakeṇa, yatas tatra paṭhitā ‘vātādibhistrayaḥ’ iti pā.| vātādibhis tisraḥ, tridoṣajā caturthā| yad uktam aṣṭodarīyādhyāye– “catasro mūrchāyā iti apasmāraiḥ vyākhyātāḥ” iti; agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yathā catvāro 'pasmārāḥ vātena pittena śleṣmaṇā sannipātena, tadvan mūrchā apīty arthaḥ| raktamadyaviṣajānāṃ yathāsvaṃ doṣajāsv antarbhāvaḥ suśrute etac ca lakṣaṇañcikitsābhedakhyāpanārthaṃ sākṣāt paṭhitam| tridoṣajāyāś ca doṣajāsv antarbhāvaḥ ity abhiprāyeṇa mādhavena saṅgṛhīteyam iti sarvatantrasvīkārād ubhayam api likhitam ity adoṣaḥ| apasmāra ivāgata iti āgatasyāpasmārasya vegavat sā mūrchā jantuṃ prāṇinaṃ śīghraṃ pātayati cirāc ca pratibudhyate, vinā bībhatsaceṣṭitair iti apasmāre phenāgamanaṃ dantāvaghaṭṭanākṣivaikṛtasattvādidarśanam asti, tridoṣajāyāṃ mūrchāyāṃ tu na tathā, ayam eva bhedaḥ; ata eva vinā bībhatsaceṣṭitair iti||13||

div.ab:
pṛthivyāpas tamorūpaṃ raktagandhas tadanvayaḥ |
tasmād raktasya gandhena mūrchanti bhuvimānavāḥ ||14||
dravyasvabhāva ity eke dṛṣṭvā yad abhimuhyati | (su. u. taṃ. a. 46) |

ab.seg:
raktajamūrchāsamprāptim āha– pṛthivyāpa ity ādi| pṛthivī āpaś ca etad dvayaṃ tamorūpaṃ tamobahulam, uktaṃ hi– “tamobahulā pṛthivī, sattvatamobahulā āpaḥ|” (su. śā. a. 1) iti| ‘pṛthivyambha’ iti pāṭhe ayam evārthaḥ| tadanvayaḥ pṛthivyambho 'nvayaḥ; ‘tanmayaḥ’ iti pāṭhe pṛthivījalamayaḥ, prakṛtivikārabhāve mayaṭ| tasmād iti yasmāt pṛthivyāpas tamorūpaṃ raktagandhaś ca tadanvayaḥ, mūrchā ca tamaḥprāyā, tasmād ity arthaḥ| bhuvimānavāḥ iti pāñcabhautikatve 'pi śarīrasyodbhūtabhūmiguṇā ye te bhuvimānavāḥ pārthivāḥ, tāmasā ity arthaḥ; na tu rājasāḥ, sāttvikā vā| nanu campakādigandhenāpi mūrchā prasajyeta? tatrāpi gandhasya pārthivatvāt pṛthivyāś ca tamorūpatvād ity ata āha– dravyasvabhāva ity ādi| raktasyāyaṃ svabhāvaḥ, tena tadgata eva gandho mūrchayatīti| svabhāvam eva draḍhayati– dṛṣṭvā yad abhimuhyatīti| ‘yac ca dṛṣṭvā'pi muhyati’ iti pāṭhāntaram| anye tu gandhāsambandhe 'pi darśanamātrān mūrchopalambhād anaikāntikatvaṃ gandhasya manyamānāḥ svabhāvam eva hetvantaram āhuḥ; etena gandhasya prāyikatvam uktam| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | anye tu gandhasya hetutvam apāsya darśanasyaiva hetutvaṃ manyanteḥ; tan na, ‘yadāha bheḍaḥ’ iti pā.| yad āha bhojaḥ–
“stabdhāṅgadṛṣṭir bhavati gūḍhocchvāsas tathaiva ca
darśanād asṛjas tajjād gandhāc caiva pramuhyati||” iti| “pṛthivyā yat tamorūpam iti” pāṭhāntaraṃ sugamam| ‘pṛthivyāpastamorūpā’ iti pā.| “pṛthivyambhastamorūpaṃ raktagandhena tat trayam|” iti pāṭhāntarasya jejjaṭalikhitasyāyam arthaḥ– raktagandhena tu yad uktam avyabhicaritaṃ prakṛtivikārayos tādarthyāt kiṃ tat trayam ity ata uktam– pṛthivyambhastamorūpam iti; pṛthivyambhastamasāṃ rūpam ity arthaḥ, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| dṛṣṭveti raktam iti śeṣaḥ||14||

pṛthvīty ādi| pṛthivī āpa etad ubhayaṃ tamorūpaṃ tamobahulam| uktaṃ hi suśrute– “tamobahulā pṛthvī sattvatamobahulā āpaḥ” iti tadanvayaḥ| ‘pṛthivyambha ... ’ iti pā.| “pṛthivyāpas tamorūpaṃ raktagandhaś ca tanmayaḥ” iti pāṭhe tanmaya iti pṛthivījalamayas tadanvayāt| gandhe 'pi tamastvaṃ siddhaṃ; mūrchā ca tamaḥprāyā, tasmād ity arthaḥ| anye ‘pṛthivyambhā’ iti paṭhanti| tatra pṛthivī cāmbhaś ca pṛthivyambhasī tayoḥ sambandhi yat tamaḥ tadrūpaṃ tadbahulaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ raktam iti; rūpaśabdo 'tra bāhulye svalakṣaṇe vā vartate, yataḥ sattvarajastamasāṃ paramaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭipathaṃ nopagacchati kintu viśeṣeṣv abhivyajyate, sarva eva viśeṣās tamomayā ity uktatvāt| bhuvimānavā iti pāñcabhautikatve 'pi śarīrasyodbhūtabhūmiguṇāḥ, etai bhuvimānavāḥ pārthivās tāmasā ity arthaḥ| tasmād ye mānavās tāmasā bhavanti ta eva raktagandhena mūrchanti na tu rājasāḥ sāttvikā vā raktagandhena mūrchantīti bhāvaḥ| nanu, campakādigandhenāpi mūrchā prasajyeta tatrāpi gandhasya pārthivatvāt, pṛthivyāś ca tamorūpatvād ity atrāha– dravyasvabhāva ity eke dṛṣṭvā yad abhimuhyatīti; raktasyāyaṃ svabhāvo yena ‘tadvadgatagandho’ iti pā.| tadgatagandho mūrchayatīti| prabhāvam eva draḍhayati– dṛṣṭvā'pi yan mūrchayatīti ‘raktam’ iti śeṣaḥ| yad āha bhojaḥ– “stabdhāṅgadṛṣṭir bhavati gūḍhocchvāsas tathaiva ca| darśanād asṛjas tajjād gandhāc caiva pramuhyati” iti||14||

div.ab:
guṇās tīvrataratvena sthitās tu viṣamadyayoḥ ||15||
ta eva tasmāt tābhyāṃ tu mohau syātāṃ yatheritau | (su. u. taṃ. a. 46) |

ab.seg:
viṣamadyaje prāha– guṇā ity ādi| guṇā daśa; yad uktaṃ dṛḍhabalena– “laghu rūkṣam āśu viśadaṃ vyavāyi tīkṣṇaṃ vikāśi sūkṣmaṃ ca| uṣṇam anirdeśyarasaṃ daśaguṇam uktaṃ viṣaṃ tajjñaiḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 23) iti| te tailādau vyastās tīvrāḥ santi, viṣamadyayos tu tīvratarāḥ, atas tailādibhir na mohaḥ, kintu viṣamadyābhyām iti| ta eveti guṇā laghutvādayaḥ| yatheritāv iti viṣajo moho na svayaṃ nivartate viṣasyāpākitvāt, madyajas tu ‘madyapariṇāmāt’ iti pā.| madyapariṇāmād eva śāmyati, ayaṃ ca bhedo viṣamadyayoḥ prabhāvāt| uktaṃ hi tantrāntare–
“ye viṣasya guṇāḥ proktāḥ sannipātaprakopaṇāḥ|
ta eva madye dṛśyante viṣe ‘ca’ iti pā.| tu balavattarāḥ||” iti||15||

div.ab: viṣamadyaje prāha– guṇā ity ādi| tatra guṇā daśa, yad uktaṃ dṛḍhabalena– “laghu rūkṣam āśu viśadaṃ vyavāyi tīkṣṇaṃ vikāśi sūkṣmaṃ ca| uṣṇam anirdeśyarasaṃ daśaguṇam uktaṃ viṣaṃ tajjñaiḥ” iti| te guṇās tailādau vyastās tīvrāḥ santi, viṣamadyayos tu tīvratarāḥ, atas tailādibhir na mohaḥ, kintu viṣamadyābhyāṃ moha eveti; guṇā laghutvādayaḥ ta eva guṇā atra ‘viguṇā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| viṣamadyayos tīvrataratvena sthitāḥ| tatrāpi bhedaḥ– viṣe tīvratamāḥ, madye tīvratarāḥ, tailādiṣu tīvrā vyastāḥ| yatheritāv iti tābhyāṃ viṣamadyābhyāṃ yatheritau taratamādibhedena yathoktau mohau syātām| viṣeṇa tīvratamaḥ, madyena tīvratara ity arthaḥ| viṣajo mohaḥ svayaṃ na nivartate, viṣasyāpākitvāt; madyajas tu madyapariṇāmād eva śāmyati, viṣajo mohaḥ svayaṃ na nivartate, viṣasyāpākitvāt; madyajas tu madyapariṇāmād eva śāmyati, viṣamadyayos tv ayam eva bhedaḥ prabhāvāt, uktaṃ hi tantrāntare– “ye viṣasya guṇāḥ proktā sannipātaprakopiṇaḥ| ta eva madye dṛśyante viṣe tu balavattarāḥ” iti|15|

stabdhāṅgadṛṣṭis tv asṛjā gūḍhocchvāsaś ca mūrchitaḥ ||16||
madyena vilapaṃś chete naṣṭavibhrāntamānasaḥ |
gātrāṇi vikṣipan bhūmau jarāṃ yāvan na yāti tat ||17||
vepathusvapnatṛṣṇāḥ syus tamaś ca viṣamūrchite |
veditavyaṃ tīvrataraṃ yathāsvaṃ viṣalakṣaṇaiḥ ||18|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 46) |

ab.seg: raktajādimūrchātrayasya rūpāṇy āha– stabdhāṅgety ādi mūrchita ity antaṃ raktajāyāḥ gūḍhocchvāsaś cāspaṣṭocchvāsaḥ| ‘mūḍha’ iti pāṭhe sanniruddha ity arthaḥ iti jejjaṭaḥ| madyenety ādi tad ity antaṃ madyajāyāḥ| ‘naṣṭavibhrāntamānasa’ ity atra niṣṭalan bhrāntamānasaḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare niṣṭanan śabdaṃ kurvan| vepathvādinā viṣajāyāḥ| yathāsvaṃ viṣalakṣaṇair iti viṣasya mūlapatrakṣīrādibhedena prātisvikaṃ yal lakṣaṇam uktaṃ sauśrutakalpasthāna (su. ka. a. 2) tallakṣaṇayuktā mūrchā bhavatīty arthaḥ||16-18||

raktajāyā rūpam āha– stabdhāṅgety ādinā mūrchita ity antena| gūḍhocchvāsaḥ ity atra mūḍheti pāṭhe atra ‘tatra’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| sanniruddhocchvāsaḥ atra ‘ca sphuratītyarthaḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.|| madyajām āha vilapan pralapan| naṣṭavibhrāntamānasa iti naṣṭaṃ smṛtirahitaṃ vibhrāntaṃ vikṣiptaṃ mānasaṃ cittaṃ yasya sa tathā| jarāṃ yāvan na yāti tad iti yāvaj jarāṃ paripākaṃ na gacchati tāvad gātrāṇi bhūmau vinikṣipan tāḍayan mūrchitas tiṣṭhatīty arthaḥ| viṣajām āha– vepathv ity ādi| vepathuḥ kampaḥ; svapno nidrā| tamo 'ndhakārapraviṣṭasyevārthāsaṃvittiḥ| yathāsvaṃ viṣalakṣaṇair iti viṣasya mūlakandapatrakṣīrādibhedena yal lakṣaṇaṃ suśrute kalpasthāne uktaṃ teṣāṃ lakṣaṇair eva tīvrataratvena yuktā mūrchā bhavatīty arthaḥ||16-18||

div.ab:
mūrchā pittatamaḥprāyā rajaḥpittānilād bhramaḥ |
tamovātakaphāt tandrā nidrā śleṣmatamobhavā ||19|| (su. śā. a. 4) |
(cakravad bhramato gātraṃ bhūmau patati sarvadā |
bhramaroga iti jñeyo rajaḥpittānilātmakaḥ) |

ab.seg: sañjñānāśasādharmye 'pi mūrchādīnāṃ ko bhedaḥ? ity āha– mūrchā pittatamaḥprāyety ādi| tamovātakaphād iti samāhāradvandvaḥ| nidrātandrayoś caitāni kāraṇāni vyastasamastāni; tena suśrutena yad atilaṅghitalakṣaṇe nidrātandre paṭhite ‘te naiva kaphāt’ iti pā.| vinaiva kaphāt atra ‘iti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| atilaṅghanasya śleṣmakṣayahetutvāt||19||

sañjñānāśasādharmyān mūrchāyā bhedān āha– tatra mūrchāhetum āha– mūrchā pittatamaḥprāyā tamoguṇayuktena pittena mūrchā bhavati| bhramahetum āha– raja iti| rajoguṇena pittānilābhyāṃ yuktena bhramo bhavati, tatra bhramaḥ sthāṇau puruṣajñānaṃ, puruṣe viparītasattvajñānādikam; anye cakrasthitasyeva sambhrāmadvastudarśanam iti| atra ‘samāhāra dvandvaikavacanam|’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| tandrāhetum āha– tama iti| tamoguṇena yuktābhyāṃ vātakaphābhyāṃ tandrā bhavati, ‘samāhāradvandvenaikavacanam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | samāhāradvandvenaikavacanam| nidrāhetum āha– śleṣmaṇā militena tamoguṇena nidrā bhavati; tasyā lakṣaṇam– arativiklāntamanasaḥ sarvendriyāṇāṃ svaviṣayanivṛttiḥ| carake 'pi “yadā tu manasi klānte karmātmānaḥ klamānvitāḥ| viṣayebhyo nivartante tadā svapiti mānavaḥ” iti| atra karmātmānaḥ indriyāṇi, nirindriyapradeśe manaso 'vasthitir nidrety arthaḥ| suśrutenātilaṅghitalakṣaṇe nidrātandre paṭhite, atilaṅghitasya śleṣmakṣayatvān nidrātandrayos tūktakāraṇatvād bhedaḥ| tathā ca nidrāyām indriyamanomohaḥ, tandrāyām indriyamohaḥ||19||

div.ab:
indriyārtheṣv asaṃvittir gauravaṃ jṛmbhaṇaṃ klamaḥ |
nidrārtasyeva yasyehā tasya tandrāṃ vinirdiśet ||20|| (su. śā. a. 24) |

ab.seg:
tandrālakṣaṇam āha– indriyārtheṣv ity ādi| nidrābhramayos tu lakṣaṇaṃ noktam iha, atiprasiddhatvāt| ‘nidrā'tividrutamanasaḥ’ iti ka. nidrā hi viplutamanasaḥ sarvendriyāṇāṃ svaviṣayanivṛttiḥ| yad āha carake–
“yadā tu manasi klānte karmātmānaḥ klamānvitāḥ|
viṣayebhyo nivartante tadā svapiti mānavaḥ||” (ca. sū. a. 21) iti| atra karmātmāna indriyāṇi; nirindriyapradeśe manaso 'vasthitir nidreti mate 'py ayam evārthaḥ| nidrātandrayos tūktakāraṇabhedād bhedaḥ, udbhūtajṛmbhādeś cānubhavasiddhatvād iti; tathā atra ‘ca’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| nidrāyām indriyamanomohaḥ; ‘tandrāyāṃ manomohaḥ’ iti pā.| tandrāyām indriyamohaḥ| bhramalakṣaṇaṃ tu cakrasthitasyeva bhramadvastudarśanam iti||20||

tandrālakṣaṇam āha– indriyārtheṣv ity ādi| atra ‘indriyārtheṣviti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| indriyārtheṣu viṣayeṣu, asamprāptir agrahaṇam| gauravam aṅgānām| nidrārtasyeva utpannanidrasyeva| asyāgre klamalakṣaṇaṃ ‘yo'nāyāsaḥ śramo dehe pravṛddhaḥ śvāsavarjitaḥ| klamaḥ sa iti vijñeya indriyārthaprabādhakaḥ||’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | paṭhanti– ‘ya ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ya ity ādi| yaḥ śarīre āyāsavarjitaḥ śramaḥ pravṛddho bhavati paraṃ śvāsavarjitaḥ sa klama iti kathitaḥ| indriyārthaprabādhakaḥ viṣayagrahaṇe 'samarthaḥ| ayaṃ pāṭho mādhavena na likhitaḥ||20||

div.ab:
doṣeṣu madamūrchāyāḥ kṛtavegeṣviti vegaṃ kṛtvā kṣīṇabaleṣu, vego hi doṣāṇāṃ balakṣayakāraṇaṃ bhavati yaduktaṃ viṣamajvare– “kṛtvā vegaṃ gatabalāḥ” ityādi ‘hṛtavegeṣu’ iti pā. | kṛtavegeṣu dehinām |
svayam evopaśāmyanti sannyāso nauṣadhair vinā ||21|| (ca. sū. a. 24) |

ab.seg: sannyāsasya mūrchādibhyo bhedam āha– doṣeṣv ity ādi atra ‘(kṛtavegeṣviti vegaṃ kṛtvā'lpabaleṣu yaduktaṃ, viṣamajvare, “vegaṃ kṛtvā gatabalāḥ” ityādi)’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.|||21||

sannyāsasya mūrchādibhyo bhedam āha– doṣeṣv ity ādi| ādiśabdo 'tra lupto draṣṭavyaḥ| āviṣṭavegeṣu atra ‘rogeṣu’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| doṣeṣu yā madādibhir mūrchā bhavati sā upaśāntavegeṣu svayam evopaśamaṃ yāti, bhiṣakpratīkāraṃ vinety arthaḥ; sannyāsas tu cikitsakajanasānubhāvauṣadhair vinā na śāmyatīty arthaḥ||21||

div.ab:
vāgdehamanasāṃ ceṣṭām ākṣipyātibalā malāḥ |
sannyasyanty abalaṃ jantuṃ prāṇāyatanam āśritāḥ ||22||
sa nā sannyāsasannyastaḥ kāṣṭhībhūto mṛtopamaḥ |
prāṇair vimucyate śīghraṃ muktvā sadyaḥphalāṃ kriyām ||23|| (ca. sū. a. 24) |

ab.seg: tallakṣaṇam āha– vāg ity ādi| atibalā ity anena mūrchādyārambhakadoṣebhyo 'dhikatvena pravṛddhā doṣās tamaś ceti bodhayati| sannyasyanti mohayanti| sa nā puruṣaḥ, sannyāsasannyastaḥ sannyāsapīḍitaḥ, kāṣṭhībhūtaḥ iti atyantaniṣkriyatvena akāṣṭham eva kāṣṭhavad bhūtaḥ, atra ‘amṛta eva mṛtopama iti’ etat kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ata eva mṛtopama iti| muktvā sadyaḥphalāṃ kriyām iti sūcīvyadhanāñjanāvapīḍanaśūkaśimbīphalāvagharṣaṇādirūpā ‘na’ iti pā.| kriyā yadi kriyate tadā prāṇair na vimucyate, anyathā tu mriyate iti||22-23||

tallakṣaṇam āha– vāg ity ādi| atibalā iti mūrchādyārambhakadoṣebhyo 'dhikatvena pravṛddhāḥ, prāṇāyatanaṃ cetanāsthānaṃ hṛdayam āśritāḥ, vāgdehamanasāṃ ceṣṭām ākṣipya vināśya, abalaṃ hīnasattvaṃ puruṣaṃ, sannyasyanti| tadā sa nā puruṣaḥ, sannyāsasannyastaḥ sannyāsapīḍitaḥ, kāṣṭhībhūta ity atiniṣkriyatvādat akāṣṭham eva kāṣṭhavad bhūtaḥ, ata eva mṛtopamaḥ| muktvā sadyaḥphalāṃ kriyām iti sadyaḥ phalaṃ yasyās tāṃ kriyāṃ tyaktvā ity arthaḥ| tatra sadyaḥphalā kriyā sūcīvyadhanaṃ ‘tīkṣṇāñjanamiva ... ’ iti pā.| tīkṣṇāñjanāvapīḍanakapikacchūphalāvagharṣaṇādirūpā yadā na kriyate tadā prāṇair vimucyate, anyathā tu jīvati||22-23||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne mūrchābhramanidrātandrāsannyāsanidānaṃ samāptam ||17||
iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ mūrchābhramanidrātandrāsanyāsanidānaṃ samāptam||17||
iti śrīvaidyavācaspatikṛte ātaṅkadarpaṇe rugviniścayavyākhyāne mūrchādinidānam||17||

div.head: pānātyayaparamadapānājīrṇapānavibhramanidānam

ab.seg:
atha pānātyaya-paramada-pānājīrṇa-pānavibhramanidānam |
ye viṣasya guṇāḥ proktās te 'pi madye pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
tena mithyopayuktena bhavaty ugro madātyayaḥ ||1||

‘mūrchā madyena ca viṣeṇa ca’ iti vacanān mūrchānantaraṃ madyavikārān madātyayādīn āha| nanu, kathaṃ madyaṃ mohayatīty āha– ye viṣasyety ādi| te ca viṣaguṇā mūrchādhyāye nidarśitāḥ| mithyopayukteneti ayathāvidhipītena, vidhiś cāyaṃ, tad yathā– asyāgre kvacitpustake “śuddhakāyaḥ pibet prātaḥ sopadaṃśaṃ paladvayam| madhyāhne dviguṇaṃ tacca snigdhāhāreṇa pāyayet| pradoṣe'ṣṭapalaṃ tadvanmātrā madyarasāyane|| vāme rāmā ramaṇakuśalā dakṣiṇe pānapātraṃ cāgre dhṛtvā maricalavaṇaiśchāgalaṃ bhṛṣṭamāṃsam| vīṇānādaiḥ parabhṛtakṛtaiḥ kākalīgītayuktaiḥ so'yaṃ dhanyaḥ pibati madirāṃ bhairavo yasya tuṣṭaḥ||” ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate | | kusumitalatopagūḍhaiḥ prarūḍhanirantaranavāṅkuranikararomāñcair madhukaramadhurajhaṅkārasītkārair muktakaṇṭhakalakaṇṭhakūjitair dakṣiṇasamīraṇasamullasitapallavakarapracāraiḥ taruṇatarubhiḥ ‘upakrāntaratibhi ... ’ iti pā.| upakrāntalatābhir atiśobhaneṣu tuṣārakarakiraṇarājiparājitāśeṣatāpadoṣeṣu ‘pradoṣeṣu’ iti pā.| pradeśeṣu ‘śṛṅgārasamucitā ... ’ iti pā.| śṛṅgārarasasamucitālaṅkṛtikamanīyakāminīsevitaṃ lalitalalanopanīyamānaṃ surabhirucirarūparasopadaṃśaṃ kaṃ nāma parimitaṃ ‘parārdhya ... ’ iti pā.| parārdhamadhupānaṃ na sukhayati? carake tu vistareṇaitad uktam||1||

‘mūrchā madyena viṣeṇa ca’ iti vacanān mūrchānantaraṃ madyavikārān ācaṣṭe, nanu kathaṃ ‘viṣaṃ ’ iti pā.| madyaṃ mohayatīty āha– ya ity ādi| ye viṣasya guṇāḥ proktāḥ, te ca viṣaguṇā mūrchādhyāye nidarśitāḥ, te guṇā madye 'pi kīrtitāḥ, tena madyena mithyopayuktena ayathāvidhipītenogro madātyayo bhavati| vidhiś cāyaṃ; tad yathā– kusumitalatopagūḍhaiḥ ‘ ... navāṅkuravikāra ... ’ iti pā.| prakaṭanirantaranavāṅkuranikararomāñcaiḥ madhukaramadhurajhaṅkārasītkārair muktakaṇṭha-kalakaṇṭhakūjitair dakṣiṇasamīraṇodvījitasamullasitapallavakara-pracārais taruṇatarubhir upakrāntataralalatābhir atiśobhaneṣu vanopavaneṣu tuṣārakarakiraṇārañjitapradeśeṣu ‘śṛṅgārasamucitā ... ’ iti pā.| śṛṅgārasarasamucitālaṅkṛtikamanīyakāminīsammitaṃ lalitalalanopanīyamānaṃ surabhirucirarasopadaṃśaṃ kaṃ nāma parimitaṃ madhupānaṃ na sukhayati| carakeṇa tu vistareṇaitad uktam| vidhiḥ prakāraḥ||1||

div.ab:
kintu madyaṃ svabhāvena yathaivānnaṃ tathā smṛtam |
ayuktiyuktaṃ rogāya yuktiyuktaṃ yathā'mṛtam ||2||
prāṇāḥ prāṇabhṛtām annaṃ tad ayuktyā hinasty asūn |
viṣaṃ prāṇaharaṃ tac ca yuktiyuktaṃ rasāyanam ||3|| (ca. ci. a. 24) |

ab.seg: nanu, viṣasya ye guṇās te cen madye 'pi santi, tarhi viṣavan madyam anupayojyaṃ prasajyeta? ata āha– kintv ity ādi| yathaivānnam iti dehadhārakasvabhāvaṃ, tad evāyuktiyuktam avidhiyuktaṃ rogāya; tasmād ahitam api viśiṣṭavidhinopayuktaṃ hitaṃ, hitam apy avidhinopayuktam anarthāya bhavatīti| atraiva dṛṣṭāntam āha– prāṇā ity ādi| tad ayuktyeti atimātratvādinā visūcyādikaṃ kṛtvā mārayatīty arthaḥ| yuktiyuktam iti yathā carakarasāyanaprayoge uktam– “dvau yavāv atra hemnas tu tilaṃ dadyād viṣasya ca|” (ca. ci. a. 1) iti| atra tilam iti tilapramāṇam||2-3||

nanu viṣasya ye guṇās te cen madye 'pi santi tarhi viṣavan madyam anupayojyaṃ syād ity ata āha– kintv ity ādi| madyaṃ svabhāvena prakṛtyā annavat jñeyaṃ dehadhāraṇasvabhāvaṃ, tad evānnaṃ madyaṃ vā ayuktiyuktam avidhiprayuktaṃ rogāya bhavati, yuktiyuktam amṛtavad bhavatīty arthaḥ| tasmād ahitam api viśiṣṭavidhinopayuktaṃ hitaṃ, hitam apy avidhinopayuktam anarthāya bhavati| atraiva dṛṣṭāntam āha– prāṇā iti| annaṃ prāṇabhṛtāṃ śarīriṇāṃ prāṇāḥ, śarīradhāraṇātmakatvāt| tad evānnam ayuktyā atimātratvādinā visūcyādīn kṛtvā mārayatīty arthaḥ| atra ‘dṛṣṭāntamāha’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| prāṇaharam api tadvad viṣaṃ yuktiyuktaṃ rasāyanaṃ bhavati, śarīraṃ dhārayatīty arthaḥ||2-3||

div.ab:
vidhinā mātrayā kāle hitair annair yathābalam |
prahṛṣṭo yaḥ piben madyaṃ tasya syād amṛtopamam ||4|| (ca. ci. a. 24) |
snigdhais tadannair māṃsaiś ca bhakṣyaiś ca saha sevitam |
bhaved āyuḥprakarṣāya balāyopacayāya ca ||5||
kāmyatā manasas tuṣṭis tejo vikrama eva ca |
vidhivat sevyamāne tu madye sannihitā guṇāḥ ||6|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

ab.seg:
vidhinopayuktasya phalam āha– vidhinety ādi| kāla iti nityage cāvasthike ca; tad yathā– grīṣme śītamadhuraṃ mādhvīkādi, śīte uṣṇatīkṣṇaṃ gauḍikapaiṣṭikādi; tathā vāte snigdhādi; evaṃ vayasy udāhāryam| hitair annair iti vakṣyamāṇasnigdhādibhir madyaviparītaguṇaiḥ| snigdhair ity upalakṣaṇaṃ, tenānyair api madyaviparītaguṇair iti boddhavyam| yad uktaṃ suśrutena
“madyam amlaṃ tathā tīkṣṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ viśadam eva ca|
rūkṣam āśukaraṃ caiva vyavāyi ca vikāśi ca||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) iti| amlarasatvaṃ ‘ ... udbhūtatvenoktam’ iti pā.| cāsyodbhūtarasatvenoktaṃ; yad uktam anyatra– “sarveṣām amlajātīnāṃ madyaṃ mūrdhni vyavasthitam||” iti| mūrdhni vyavasthitam utkṛṣṭam| anye 'py atra rasāḥ santi| yad āha bhojaḥ–
“maireyaṃ madirā sīdhu caturthaṃ madhu cocyate|
ekaikaṃ ṣaḍrasaṃ tatra ‘rasataścāmlamiṣyate’ iti pā.| rasato madyam īritam||” iti| annabhakṣyaśabdayor upādānena prāyo lehyaṃ dravāntarapānaṃ ca madyapānocitaṃ na bhavatīti darśayati| annabhakṣyābhyāṃ labdhe 'pi māṃse māṃsagrahaṇaṃ viśeṣeṇa hitatvopadarśanārtham| balaṃ śaktiḥ, upacayaḥ sthaulyam| aparam api vidhisevāguṇam āha– kāmyatety ādi| kāmyatā kamanīyamūrtitā, manasas tuṣṭiḥ santoṣaḥ| ‘athavā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | athavā kāmyatā manasa iti kamanīyavastuni manovṛttiḥ, tuṣṭiś ca manasa eveti yojyam| teja utsāhaḥ| vikramaḥ parābhibhavārthaṃ balavatī śarīraceṣṭā||4-6||

vidhinopayuktasya phalam āha– vidhinety ādi| vidhiḥ pūrvoktaḥ, tantrāntaroktaś ca–
“śuddhakāyaḥ pibet prātaḥ sopadaṃśaṃ paladvayam|
madhyāhne dviguṇaṃ tac ca snigdhāhāreṇa vai pibet,
pradoṣe 'ṣṭapalaṃ tadvan mātrā madye rasāyanam|
ārogyaṃ dhātusāmyaṃ ca vahnikāntibalapradam|| anena vidhinā sevyaṃ madyaṃ nityam atandritaiḥ|” ‘iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| anye,
“buddhyādayo guṇā yāvad ullasanti niratyayāḥ|
mātreyaṃ vihitā madye pāne rogāya cāparāḥ||” ‘iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kāla iti tatra kālo dvividho nityagaḥ, āvasthikaś ca; tatra nityage ṛtusambandhini, yathā– grīṣme śītamadhuraṃ mādhvīkādi, śīte uṣṇatīkṣṇaṃ gauḍikapaiṣṭikādi; āvasthike kāle vāte snigdhādi, evaṃ vayasy apy udāhāryam| hitair annair iti vakṣyamāṇasnigdhatvādibhir madyaviparītaguṇaiḥ| yathābalaṃ svaśaktyā| evaṃ hṛṣṭo harṣayukto yo madyaṃ pibet tasyāmṛtopamaṃ syāt| kaiḥ saha pītaṃ balopacayāya bhavati tān āha– snigdhair ity ādi| etair vastubhiḥ sevyamānaṃ madyam āyuḥprakarṣāya bhavati tathā balavardhakam iti| snigdhair ity upalakṣaṇaṃ, tenānyair madyaviparītaguṇair api boddhavyaṃ, tena tīkṣṇādidaśaguṇaviparītair mṛdvādiguṇaiḥ saha madyaṃ sevyam iti| yad uktaṃ tantrāntare– “laghutīkṣṇoṣṇasūkṣmāmlavyavāyyāśugam eva ca| rukṣaṃ vikāśi viśadaṃ madyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ smṛtam” iti| tathā ca suśrute– madyam amlaṃ tathā tīkṣṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ viśadam eva ca| rūkṣam āśukaraṃ caiva vyavāyi ca vikāśi ca” iti| amlarasatvaṃ cāsyodbhūtarasatvenoktam| yad uktam anyatra “sarveṣām amlajātīnāṃ madyaṃ mūrdhni vyavasthitam” iti| mūrdhni vyavasthitam utkṛṣṭam| anye 'py atra rasāḥ santi| yad uktaṃ tantrāntare– “madyasyāmlasvabhāvasya catvāro 'nurasāḥ smṛtāḥ| madhuraś ca kaṣāyaś ca kaṭukas tikta eva ca” iti| yad āha bhojaḥ– ṣaḍrasā iti”madirāyā rasā vyaktā madhuroṣaṇatiktakāḥ| lavaṇāmlakaṣāyāś ca trayaḥ sūkṣmatarāḥ smṛtāḥ||
‘viparyayeṇaitat’ iti pā.| viparyayeṇaitad evaṃ maireye kathitā rasāḥ|
mādhvīke sīdhusañjñe ca vyaktau cāmlakaṭū rasau| vyaktā hi śeṣāś catvāro rasā bhojena kīrtitāḥ” iti| annair iti godhūmādibhiḥ| annabhakṣyābhyāṃ labdhe 'pi ‘māṃse'pi’ iti pā.| māṃse māṃsagrahaṇaṃ viśeṣeṇa hitatvopadarśanārtham| balaṃ śaktiḥ, upacayaḥ sthaulyam| aparam api vidhisevāguṇam āha– kāmyatety ādi| kāmyatā kamanīyamūrtitā, manasas tuṣṭiḥ santoṣaḥ, teja utsāhaḥ, vikramaḥ parābhibhavārthaṃ balavatī śarīraceṣṭā||4-6||

lg.l: sampāṭhagītasvaravardhanaś ca prokto 'tiramyaḥ prathamo mado hi ||7||

ab.seg: uktavidhiviparyayeṇa sevyamānaṃ madyaṃ madātyayāya sampadyate; sa ca trividho bhavati– pūrvo, madhyamo 'ntimaś ceti; teṣāṃ krameṇa lakṣaṇam āha– buddhīty ādi| buddhir anubhavaḥ, smṛtir anubhūtārthānusandhānam| pānānnanidrārativardhanaś ceti pānādiṣu ratir anurāgas tadvardhanaḥ| sampāṭhaḥ samyak pāṭhaḥ| gayadāsas tu ‘sampāṭhya’ iti paṭhitvā gītanṛtyavādyāni militāni sampāṭhyam ucyate, gītaṃ tu kevalam eveti vyācaṣṭe| svaro dhvaniḥ| prokto 'tiramya iti| nanu manovikārakāritvāt katham asyātiramyatā? ucyate– ‘manovikārakāratve'pi tadātvena duḥkhāpahatvāt’ iti pā.| manovikārakāritve 'pi tadātvena na duḥkhāvahatvāt ata eva suśrutena mānasavikāreṣu harṣaḥ paṭhitaḥ||7||

uktavidhiviparyayeṇa sevyamānaṃ madyaṃ madātyayāya bhavati| sa ca tridhā bhavati madātyayaḥ pūrvo madhyo 'ntima iti| teṣāṃ krameṇa lakṣaṇam āha– tatra prathamo yathā– buddhīty ādi| buddhir anubhavaḥ, smṛtiḥ pūrvānubhūtasmaraṇaṃ, prītiḥ pareṇa maitrī| sukha iti śokādyasmaraṇena manasaḥ prasādād anupahatendriyavṛttitvāt| pānānnanidrārativardhana iti pānādiṣu viṣaye ratir anurāgaḥ, tadvardhanaḥ| sampāṭhaḥ samyakpāṭhaḥ, gītaṃ gānaṃ, svaro dhvaniḥ| prokto 'tiramya iti| nanu manovikārakaratvāt katham asyātiramyatā? ucyate– manovikārakāritve 'pi ‘tadanena’ iti pā.| tadātvena duḥkhāvahatvāt| ata eva suśrutena mānasavikāreṣu harṣaḥ paṭhita iti||7||

lg.l: ālasyanidrābhihato muhuś ca madhyena mattaḥ puruṣo madena ||8||

ab.seg: dvitīyamadam āha– avyaktety ādi| viceṣṭo viruddhaceṣṭaḥ| unmattasya līlākṛtibhyāṃ saha vartate iti sonmattalīlākṛtiḥ; unmattaprāya ity arthaḥ| apraśāntaḥ pracaṇḍaḥ||8||

madhyamadam āha– avyaktety ādi| unmattasya līlākṛtibhyāṃ saha vartata iti sonmattalīlākṛtiḥ unmattaprāya ity arthaḥ| apraśāntaḥ pracaṇḍaḥ| muhur vāraṃ vāram, ālasyanidrābhyām abhihataḥ pīḍitaḥ, sa caivaṃvidho 'tyanupahatendriyavṛttitvāt||8||

lg.l: gacched agamyān na gurūṃś ca manyet khāded abhakṣyāṇi ca naṣṭasañjñaḥ |
brūyāc ca guhyāni hṛdi sthitāni made tṛtīye puruṣo 'svatantraḥ ||9||

ab.seg:
tṛtīyamadam āha– gacched ity ādi| nanu carake dvitīyatṛtīyayor madhye madāntaraṃ paṭhitaṃ, yad āha–
“madhyamaṃ madam utkramya madam aprāpya cottamam|
na kiñcid aśubhaṃ kuryur narā rājasatāmasāḥ|| ko madaṃ tādṛśaṃ gacched unmādam iva cāparam|” (ca. ci. a. 24) iti; tat kuto 'tra na paṭhitam? ucyate– dvitīyamadānte tṛtīyamadasya pūrvāvasthaivātinindanīyā, sutarāṃ tṛtīyo mada iti pratipādanārthaṃ tat paṭhitaṃ, na tu tayoḥ paramārthato 'ntarāle pṛthaṅ madāntaram asti, yathā–
“kumbhamīnarkṣayor madhye yadā carati candramāḥ|
nāharet tṛṇakāṣṭhāni na gacched dakṣiṇāṃ diśam||” iti| atra hi kumbhasya śeṣāṃśo mīnasya prathamāṃśa etad dvayaṃ madhyaśabdenocyate ity āhuḥ jejjaṭādayaḥ, haricandravyākhyānaṃ tu vistaratvān na likhitam| agamyān gurudārādīn duṣṭayānādīṃś ca| naṣṭasañjña iti sañjñā nāmollekhena ‘sañjñājñānaṃ ’ iti pā.| jñānaṃ, tan naṣṭaṃ yasya sa tathā| guhyāni gopyāni| asvatantro madaparavaśaḥ||9||

tṛtīyaṃ madam āha– gacched ity ādi| agamyān gurudārādīn| gurūn jyeṣṭhān, na manyeta avagaṇayed ity arthaḥ| abhakṣyāṇi śāstraniṣiddhāni, cakārād duṣṭapānādīṃś ca| sañjñā nāmollakhena sañjñājñānaṃ tan naṣṭaṃ yasya sa tathā| hṛdi sthitāni guhyāni gopyāni, brūyāt| tathā asvatantro madaparavaśaḥ| sa caivaṃvidho 'tīvopahatendriyatvād bhavati||9||

lg.l: caturthe tu made mūḍho bhagnadārv iva niṣkriyaḥ |
ko madaṃ tādṛśaṃ gacched unmādam iva cāparam |

ab.seg:
caturthamadam āha– caturthe tv ity ādi| kāryākāryavibhāgajñaḥ kāryam akāryam iti buddhyā jānāti| ‘kāryākāryavibhāgajñaḥ’ iti pāṭhe kāryākāryavibhāgayor ajña ity arthaḥ| mṛtād apy aparo mṛta iti mṛtam apekṣyāparo 'yaṃ mṛta iva, atyantājñānasādharmyāt| ‘adhama’ iti pā.| ‘avaraḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare mṛtād apy adhama ity arthaḥ, tathāvidhāvasthāyāḥ svayaṃ kṛtatvāt| ka ity ādi| kaḥ kṛtī agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kuśalaḥ, sukṛtī vā, kṛtakṛtyo vā; svavaśo 'parādhīnaḥ, tādṛśam uktaprakāreṇa ninditaṃ madaṃ gacchet prāpnuyāt; na kaścid evaṃvidhaṃ prāpnuyād ity arthaḥ| kam ivety āha– bahudoṣam ivāmūḍhaḥ kāntāram iti bahudoṣaṃ hiṃsrādiyuktaṃ, kāntāraṃ dūraśūnyam adhvanam| yad uktaṃ carake– “gacched adhvānam asvantaṃ bahudoṣam ivā'dhvagaḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 24) iti; evaṃ videhe 'pi paṭhitam iti| atrāsvantam aśobhamānam aniṣṭaphalatvena| nanu, carakavidehavāgbhaṭādibhiś caturtho mado na paṭhitas tat kathaṃ suśrutena paṭhitaḥ? ucyate– carake yā dvitīyatṛtīyayor antarālāvasthā paṭhitā, saiva suśrutena tṛtīyo mada iti kṛtvā paṭhitaḥ, yas tu carake tṛtīyaḥ sa ca suśrute caturthaḥ paṭhita ity āvirodhaḥ| vastugatyā tu traya eva madā ‘ityupapātam’ iti pā.| ity upapāditam| nanu, kiṅkāraṇam etat traividhyam iti cet? ucyate– madyaṃ hi vahnitulyaṃ, yathā hy agniḥ suvarṇānām uttamamadhyamādhamānām abhivyañjakas tathā madyam api prāṇināṃ sattvarajastamobhūyiṣṭhānāṃ ‘krameṇābhi ... ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | krameṇābhivyañjakam iti| tathā hi carakaḥ–
“pradhānādhamamadhyānāṃ rukmāṇāṃ vyaktidarśakaḥ|
‘yathā'gnirevaṃ satvādyairmadyaṃ prakṛtidarśakam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yathā'gnir evaṃ satvādyair madyaṃ prakṛtidarśakam| tasmāt prathamadvitīyatṛtīyamadāḥ sattvarajastamobhūyiṣṭhānāṃ krameṇa bhavantīty arthaḥ||10-11||

caturthamadam āha-caturthe made puruṣo mūḍho 'jñaḥ, bhagnadārv iva niṣkriyo bhavati bhagnavṛkṣa iva kriyārahitaḥ, tathā kāryākāryavibhāgajñaḥ kāryam akāryaṃ buddhyā jānāti| ‘kāryākāryavibhāgajñaḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare kāryākāryavibhāgayor anabhijña ity arthaḥ| mṛtād apy aparo mṛta iti mṛtam apekṣyāparo 'yaṃ mṛta iva, atyantājñānasādharmyāt| ‘avaraḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare mṛtād apy avara ity arthaḥ, tathāvidhāvasthāyāḥ svayaṃ kṛtatvāt| ka iti kaḥ kṛtī sukṛtī kṛtakṛtyo vā svavaśo 'parādhīnas tādṛśam uktaprakāreṇa ninditaṃ madaṃ gacchet prāpnuyāt na kaścid evaṃvidhaṃ prāpnuyād ity arthaḥ| kam ivety āha– bahudoṣam ivāmūḍhaḥ kāntāram iti; bahudoṣaṃ hiṃsrā iti yuktaṃ kāntāraṃ śūnyam adhvānaṃ ko mūḍho gacched api tu na ko 'pi| yad uktaṃ carake “gacched adhvānam asvantaṃ bahudoṣam ivādhvagaḥ” iti| asvantam aśobhanam aniṣṭaphalatvena| nanu carakavidehavāgbhaṭadibhiś caturtho mado na paṭhitaḥ, tat kathaṃ na virodhaḥ? ucyate; carake yā dvitīyatṛtīyayor antarālāvasthā paṭhitā, saiva suśrutena tṛtīyo mada iti kṛtvā paṭhitaḥ| keyam antarālāvasthā? yathoktaṃ jyotiḥśāstre– “kumbhamīnarkṣayor madhye yadā carati candramāḥ| nāharet tṛṇakāṣṭhāni na gacched dakṣiṇāṃ diśam” iti| atra kumbhasya śeṣāṃśo mīnasya prathamāṃśa etad dvayaṃ madhyaśabdenocyate iti saivāntarālāvasthā| yas tu carake tṛtīyaḥ suśrute sa caturthaḥ paṭhita ity avirodhaḥ| vastugatyā traya eva madā ity upapāditam| nanu, kiṃ kāraṇakam idaṃ traividhyam iti cet? ucyate– madyaṃ hi vahnitulyaṃ, yathā vahniḥ suvarṇānām adhamamadhyamottamānām abhivyañjakaḥ, tathā madyam api prāṇināṃ sattvarajastamobhūyiṣṭhānām abhivyañjakam| tathā hi carakaḥ– “pradhānādhamamadhyānāṃ rukmāṇāṃ vyaktidarśakaḥ| yathā'gnir evaṃ sattvānāṃ madyaṃ prakṛtidarśakam” iti| tasmāt prathamadvitīyatṛtīyamadāḥ sattvarajastamobhūyiṣṭhānāṃ krameṇa bhavantīty arthaḥ||10-11||

div.ab:
nirbhaktam ekāntata eva madyaṃ niṣevyamāṇaṃ manujena nityam |
āpādayet kaṣṭatamān vikārān āpādayec cāpi śarīrabhedam ||12|| (sa. u. a. 47) |

ab.seg: avidhimadyapānasya vikārāntarahetutvam āha– nirbhaktam ity ādi| nanu, ayam arthaḥ snigdhais tadannair ity ādinā yad uktaṃ tadviparyayeṇaiva labdhaḥ, tat kathaṃ punar ucyate? naivaṃ, pūrvaṃ madyapānaguṇābhidhānārtham uktam, idaṃ tu kṛcchratamavyādhikartṛtvābhidhānārtham iti bhedaḥ| yatparaḥ śabdaḥ sa śabdārtha ity abhiprāyaḥ| kaṣṭatamān vikārān iti vakṣyamāṇapānātyayādīn| bhedaṃ vināśaṃ śarīrasya||12||

avidhimadyapānasya vikārāntarahetutvam āha– nirbhaktam ity ādi| nirbhaktam āhārarahitam, ekāntato nairantaryeṇa sevyamānaṃ, kaṣṭatamān vakṣyamāṇān pānātyayādīn janayet| śarīrabhedaṃ śarīravināśam| nanu ‘snigdhaistadannaiḥ’ ity ādīnāṃ viparyayeṇaivāyam artho labdhas tat kiṃ punaḥ kathanaṃ? naivaṃ, pūrvaṃ madyapānaguṇābhidhānārtham uktam, idaṃ tu kṛcchratamavyādhikartṛtvābhidhānārtham uktam iti bhedaḥ||12||

div.ab:
kruddhena bhītena pipāsitena śokābhitaptena bubhukṣitena |
vyāyāmabhārādhvaparikṣatena vegāvarodhābhihatena cāpi ||13||
atyambubhakṣāvatatodareṇa sājīrṇabhuktena tathā'balena |
uṣṇābhitaptena ca sevyamānaṃ karoti madyaṃ vividhān vikārān ||14|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

ab.seg: annasahitasyāpi madyasya kruddhatvādikāraṇasahitasya vikārakāritvapradarśanārtham āha– kruddhenety ādi| parikṣatena kṣīṇena| avatataṃ vyāptam| vividhān vikārān pānātyayādīn iti||13-14||

annasahitasyāpi madyasya kruddhatvādikāraṇasahitasya vikārakāritvapradarśanārtham āha– kruddhenety ādi| vyāyāmabhārādhvabhiḥ parikṣatena kṣīṇena vegāvarodhābhihatena mūtrādīnāṃ vegābhighātapīḍitena| atyambubhakṣaiḥ avatatodareṇa ‘vyāmodareṇa’ iti pā.| vyāptodareṇa| sājīrṇabhuktena sājīrṇaṃ bhuktaṃ yasya sa tathā tena| abalena balarahitena, balam ojaḥ| uṣṇābhitaptena gharmasantaptena| īdṛśena puruṣeṇa sevyamānaṃ vividhān nānāvidhān, vikārān pānātyayādīn karoti||13-14||

div.ab:
pānātyayaṃ paramadaṃ pānājīrṇam athāpi vā |
pānavibhramam ugraṃ ca teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ||15|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

ab.seg: tān eva vivṛṇoti– pānātyayam ity ādi| nanu, ayam arthaḥ ‘āpādayet kaṣṭatamān vikārān’ ity anenaivoktatvāt kathaṃ punar uktaḥ? ucyate– pūrveṇa kaṣṭatamavikārakāritvam uktam, anena tu nānāvidhavikārakāritvam iti bhedaḥ||15||
tān atra vikārān vivṛṇoti– pānātyayam ity ādi| pānātyayam ity eko vikāraḥ, pānājīrṇam ity ekaḥ, ‘pānavibhramamapi vānyaḥ’ iti pā.| pānavibhramam iti cānyaḥ| teṣāṃ krameṇa lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyāmi||15||

div.ab:
hikkāśvāsaśiraḥkampapārśvaśūlaprajāgaraiḥ |
vidyād bahupralāpasya vātaprāyaṃ madātyayam ||16||
tṛṣṇādāhajvarasvedamohātīsāravibhramaiḥ |
vidyād dharitavarṇasya pittaprāyaṃ madātyayam ||17||
chardyarocakahṛllāsatandrāstaimityagauravaiḥ |
vidyāc chītaparītasya kaphaprāyaṃ madātyayam |
jñeyastridoṣajaś cāpi sarvaliṅgair madātyayaḥ ||18|| (ca. ci. a. 24) |

ab.seg: teṣām uddiṣṭānāṃ lakṣaṇam āha– hikkety ādi| prajāgaro nidrāvicchedaḥ| vātaprāyam ity anena sarve ‘vātādiprāyā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vātādiprāyā madātyayās tridoṣajāḥ, udbhūtatvena vyapadeśa iti carake darśitam| yad āha– “ye viṣasya guṇāḥ proktāḥ sarvadoṣaprakopaṇāḥ|” ity ārabhya yāvat “sarvaṃ madātyayaṃ vidyāt tridoṣaṃ” (ca. ci. a. 24) iti| evaṃ carakasaṃvādāt suśrute 'pi bodhyam| vibhramo bhramaḥ| haritavarṇasyety anena haritavarṇatā'pi lakṣaṇam||16-18||

tatra vātikamadātyayam āha– hikkety ādi| sarve madātyayās tridoṣajāḥ, ‘kiṃ tu’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kiṃ tu auddhatyena vyapadeśaḥ| yad uktaṃ carakeṇa– “ye viṣasya guṇāḥ proktāḥ sarvadoṣaprakopaṇāḥ” iti| tathā ca– “sarvaṃ madātyayaṃ vidyāt tridoṣajam” iti| prajāgaro nidrānāśaḥ, śeṣaṃ sugamam| paittikam āha– tṛṣṇety ādi| vibhramo vastuviparītajñānam| haritavarṇasya puruṣasyeti haritavarṇatā pittalakṣaṇaṃ, śeṣaṃ sugamam| ślaiṣmikam āha– chardīty ādi| staimityaṃ niścalatā| śītaparītasya śītayuktasya| tridoṣajam āha– jñeya ity ādi| sarvaliṅgaiḥ sarvadoṣalakṣaṇaiḥ||16-18||

div.ab:
śleṣmocchrayo 'ṅgagurutā virasāsyatā ca viṇmūtrasaktir atha tandrir arocakaś ca |
liṅgaṃ parasya ca madasya vadanti tajjñās tṛṣṇā rujā śirasi sandhiṣu cāpi bhedaḥ ||19|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

ab.seg: paramadam āha– śleṣmocchraya ity ādi| śleṣmocchrayaś cātra nāsāsrāvādinā jñeyaḥ| saktiḥ saṅgaḥ, apravṛttir iti yāvat| tandris tandrā| parasya madasyeti paramadasya; chando 'nurodhād asamāsanirdeśaḥ||19||

paramadam āha– śleṣmety ādi| śleṣmocchrayo nāsāsrāvādinā jñeyaḥ| aṅgagurutā śarīragauravam| virasāsyatā mukhasya vairasyam| viṇmūtrasaktiḥ viṇmūtrayor apravṛttiḥ| tandris tandrā| parasyeti ‘chandonirodhā ... ’ iti pā.| chandonurodhād asamāsanirdeśaḥ, paramadasyeti jñeyam| śirasi rujā pīḍā, sandhiṣu bhedaḥ sphuṭanam iva||19||

div.ab: ādhmānam ugram atha codgiraṇaṃ vidāhaḥ pāne 'jarāṃ samupagacchati lakṣaṇāni |20| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

pānājīrṇam āha– ādhmānam ity ādi| udgiraṇaṃ vāntiḥ, udgāro vā| pāne madye, ‘ajarām’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ajarām ajīrṇam upagacchati apakvatvam upagacchatīti pānājīrṇavikāra ity arthaḥ|20|–
pānājīrṇam āha– ādhmānam ity ādi| udgiraṇaṃ vāntir udgāro vā| pāne madye, ajarām ajīrṇaṃ, samupagacchati prāptavati, pānājīrṇaṃ ity arthaḥ|20|–

hṛdgātratodakaphasaṃsravakaṇṭhadhūmā mūrchāvamijvaraśirorujanapradāhāḥ ||20||
dveṣaḥ surānnavikṛteṣv api teṣu teṣu taṃ pānavibhramam uśanty akhilena dhīrāḥ | (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

pānavibhramam āha– hṛd ity ādi| kaṇṭhadhūmaḥ kaṇṭhād dhūmanirgamavat pīḍā| śirorujanaṃ śiraḥśūlam| surānnavikṛteṣv iti surāvikṛteṣu annavikṛteṣu ca; bhāve ktaḥ| teṣu teṣv iti nānāvikāreṣu surāmaireyapiṣṭakalaḍḍukādiṣu| uśanti icchanti| ete ca paramadādayas trayo na carake paṭhitāḥ, sannipātaje 'ntarbhūtatvāt; suśrutena tūktatridoṣajamadātyayāt pṛthag ete paṭhitāḥ, vikṛtyā pūrvalakṣaṇavailakṣaṇyābhidhānārtham ity āhuḥ||20||–

pānavibhramam āha– hṛd ity ādi| hṛd ity ādi| hṛdgātrayos todaḥ vyathāviśeṣaḥ, kaṇṭhadhūmaḥ kaṇṭhād dhūmanirgamavat pīḍā, śirorujanaṃ śiraḥśūlaṃ, etacca– ‘śirorujanapradehāḥ’ iti pā.| pradehaḥ śleṣmaliptam iva mukham| surāvikṛteṣu annavikṛteṣu ca bhāveṣu dveṣaḥ| teṣu teṣv iti nānāprakāreṣu surāmaireyapiṣṭakādiṣu| akhilena lakṣaṇena pānavibhramaṃ uśanti kathayanti| ete paramadādayas trayo na carake paṭhitāḥ, sannipātaje 'ntarbhūtatvāt, suśrutena tūktatridoṣajamadātyayāḥ pṛthag eva paṭhitāḥ, pūrvoktalakṣaṇavailakṣaṇyāt||20||–

hīnottarauṣṭham atiśītam amandadāhaṃ tailaprabhāsyam api pānahataṃ tyajet tu ||21||
jihvauṣṭhadantam asitaṃ tv athavā'pi nīlaṃ pīte ca yasya nayane rudhiraprabhe vā | (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |
asādhyalakṣaṇam āha– hīnety ādi| hīnottarauṣṭhaṃ pralambamānoparitanauṣṭham| atiśītaṃ bahiḥ, ‘amandadāhamantare|’ iti pā.| amandadāham abhyantare| tailaprabhāsyaṃ tailāktamukham iva||21||–

asādhyalakṣaṇam āha– hīnety ādi| hīnottarauṣṭhaṃ pralambamānoparitanauṣṭham| atiśītaṃ bahiḥ, amandadāham abhyantare; athavā atiśītam amandadāham iti vikalpena pratyetavyam, ekadaikatra viruddhadharmadvayāsambhavāt; kadācid atiśītaṃ, kadācit tīvradāham| ‘ulbaṇamiti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ulbaṇam iti| tailaprabhāsyam iti tailāktamukham iva||21||–
hikkājvarau vamathuvepathupārśvaśūlāḥ kāsabhramāv api ca pānahataṃ bhajante ||22|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

ab.seg:
upadravān āha– hikkety ādi| etaiḥ kṛcchrasādhyaṃ bhavati, na tv asādhyam; asādhyalakṣaṇebhyaḥ pṛthakpāṭhād iti jejjaṭaḥ| ‘dhvaṃsakavikṣepakāvapi’ iti pā.| dhvaṃsakavikṣepakākhyau madyavikārau carake ‘pṛthak’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | pṛthak paṭhitau; tad yathā–
“vicchinnamadyaḥ sahasā yo 'timadyaṃ niṣevate|
dhvaṃso vikṣepakaś caiva rogas tasyopajāyate||
śleṣmaprasekaḥ kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣaḥ śabdāsahiṣṇutā|
tandrānidrābhiyogaś ca jñeyaṃ dhvaṃsakalakṣaṇam||
hṛtkaṇṭharodhaḥ sammohaś chardir aṅgarujā jvaraḥ|
tṛṣṇā kāsaḥ śiraḥśūlam etad vikṣepalakṣaṇam||” (ca. ci. a. 24) iti; tau ca suśrutena
“vicchinnamadyaḥ sahasā yo 'timadyaṃ niṣevate|
tasya pānātyayoddiṣṭā vikārāḥ sambhavanti hi||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) ity anena ‘saṅgrahītau’ iti pā.| saṅgṛhītau boddhavyau| na vā cikitsābhedas tayor uktaḥ; yataś caraka evoktavān– “tayoḥ karma cikitsā ca vātike yan madātyaye|” (ca. ci. a. 24) iti||22||

upadravān āha– jihvety ādi| ete upadravāḥ pānahatān puruṣān bhajante| asitaṃ kṛṣṇam, athavā nīlaṃ cāṣapakṣapratimam| rudhiraprabhe atīvarakte| ‘hikketyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | hikkety ādi| vamathuś chardiḥ, vepathuḥ kampaḥ| bhramaś cakrārūḍhasyeva| etaiś ca kṛcchrasādhyatvaṃ bhavati na tv asādhyatvam, asādhyalakṣaṇebhyaḥ pṛthakpāṭhād iti jejjaṭaḥ| dhvaṃsakavikṣepakākhyau madyavikārau carake paṭhitau| tad yathā–
“vicchinnamadyaḥ sahasā yo 'ti madyaṃ niṣevate|
dhvaṃso vikṣepakaś caiva rogas tasyopajāyate|| śleṣmaprasekaḥ ‘kaṇṭharodhaḥ sammohaśchardiraṅgarujā jvaraḥ|’ etatsthāne ‘kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣaḥ sarvāsahiṣṇutā| nidrātandrātiyogaśca jñeyaṃ dhvaṃsakalakṣaṇam|| hṛtkaṇṭharodhaḥ sammohaḥ chardiraṅgarujā jvaraḥ|’ iti pā.| kaṇṭharodhaḥ sammohaś chardir aṅgarujā jvaraḥ| tṛṣṇākāsaḥ śiraḥśūlam etad vikṣepalakṣaṇam” iti| na vā tayoś cikitsābheda uktaḥ, yataś caraka evoktavān– “tayoḥ karma cikitsā ca vātike yan madātyaye” iti||22||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne pānātyayaparamadapānājīrṇapānavibhramanidānaṃ samāptam ||18||
iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ pānātyayaparamadapānājīrṇapānavibhramanidānaṃ samāptam||18||
iti śrīvaidyavācaspatikṛte ātaṅkadarpaṇākhye rugviniścayavyākhyāne pānātyaparamadapānājīrṇapānavibhramanidānam||18||

div.head: dāhanidānam

ab.seg:
atha dāhanidānam|
tvacaṃ prāptaḥ sa pānoṣmā pittaraktābhimūrchitaḥ |
‘pittaprakopadhānādi hetubhirjāyate gadaḥ ūṣmātmako'pi dāhākhyaḥ sa ca saptavidho mataḥ’ iti pā. | dāhaṃ prakurute ghoraṃ pittavat tatra bheṣajam ||1||

madātyaye 'pi dāho bhavaty ataḥ saptaprakāraṃ dāham āha; tatra madyajam āha– tvacam ity ādi| atra ‘sa’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| pānoṣmā atra ‘sa’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| pā.| madyapānakupitapittasyauṣṇyaṃ; samānoṣmeti pāṭhāntaram ayuktaṃ, suśrute pānātyaye ślokasyāsya pāṭhāt| ‘pittaja evāyam’ iti pā.| pittajo 'py ayaṃ hetubhedāt pṛthak paṭhitaḥ||1||

madātyaye dāho bhavatīty ato madātyayānantaraṃ dāhanidānārambhaḥ| madyajadāham āha– tvacam ity ādi| pānoṣmā madyapānakupitapittoṣmā, sa tvacaṃ prāpto ghoraṃ dāhaṃ prakarṣeṇa kuruta ity arthaḥ| kīdṛśaḥ pittaraktābhyām abhivardhitaḥ| anye ‘samānoṣmā’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ paṭhanti| tan na yuktaṃ, suśrute pānātyaye ślokasyāsya pāṭhāt| pittajo 'py ayaṃ hetubhedāt pṛthak paṭhitaḥ||1||

div.ab:
kṛtsnadehānugaṃ raktam udriktaṃ dahati dhruvam |
sa uṣyate tṛṣyate ca tāmrābhas tāmralocanaḥ ||2||
lohagandhāṅgavadano vahninevāvakīryate | (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

raktajam āha– kṛtsnety ādi| sa uṣyate samīpastheneva vahninā tapyate, ‘sañcūṣyata’ iti pā.| ‘sandhūpyata’ iti pāṭhāntare ‘ācūṣaṇa ... ’ iti pā.| sandhūpanavad vedanām anubhavati| tāmrābha iti gātre| lohagandhāṅgavadana iti lohasyeva gandho 'ṅge vadane ca yasya sa tathā||2-3||–

raktajam āha– kṛtsnety ādi| udriktaṃ vṛddhaṃ raktaṃ kṛtsnadehānugaṃ sat dhruvaṃ ‘sa dahati’ iti pā.| sandahati, puruṣas tena ‘ucyate tathā tṛṣyate’ iti pā.| ūṣyate samīpasthena ‘vahninā’ iti pā.| vahnineva tapyate| sañcūṣyate iti pāṭhāntare ācūṣaṇavad vedanām anubhavati| tāmrābha iti ‘tāmrābhamātraḥ’ iti pā.| tāmrābhagātraḥ| lohasyeva gandho 'ṅge vadane ca yasya sa tathā|2-3|–
pittajvarasamaḥ pittāt sa cāpy asya vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||3|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

ab.seg: pittajam āha– pittety ādi| pittajvarasamaḥ pittajvaraliṅgayuktaḥ, ‘pittajvare'ratyāmāśaya ... ’ iti pā.| pittajvare tv āmāśayaduṣṭyādayo 'dhikā iti bhedaḥ| sa cāpy asya vidhir iti pittajvaracikitsā||3||
pittajam āha– pittajvarety ādi| pittajvare aratyāmāśayaduṣṭyādayo 'dhikā iti bhedaḥ, anyāni samānalakṣaṇāni| sa cāpy asya vidhir iti pittajvaroktacikitsety arthaḥ||3||

div.ab:
tṛṣṇānirodhād abdhātau kṣīṇe tejaḥ samuddhatam |
sabāhyābhyantaraṃ dehaṃ pradahen mandacetasaḥ ||4||
saṃśuṣkagalatālvoṣṭho jihvāṃ niṣkṛṣya vepate | (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |
tṛṣṇānirodhajam āha– tṛṣṇety ādi| tejaḥsamuddhataṃ pittoṣmā vṛddha ity arthaḥ| niṣkṛṣya niḥsārya||4||–

tṛṣṇānirodhajam āha– tṛṣṇety ādi| tṛṣṇāvidhāraṇād abdhātau rase kṣīṇe sati, tejaḥ samutthitaṃ pittoṣmā vṛddha ity arthaḥ| sa ‘bāhyābhyantare’ iti pā.| bāhyābhyantaraṃ dehaṃ pradahet| mandacetasaḥ visañjñasya| niṣkṛṣya niḥsārya kampate||4||–
asṛjaḥ pūrṇakoṣṭhasya dāho 'nyaḥ syāt ‘sudustaraḥ’ iti pā. | suduḥsahaḥ ||5|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

ab.seg:
avagāḍhaśastraprahārajanitaraktapūrṇakoṣṭhajam āha– asṛja ity ādi| na coktaraktajenāsya paunaruktyaṃ, kṛtsnadehānugam iti vacanāt kāraṇabhedāc ca| asṛjaḥ pūrṇakoṣṭhasyeti ‘pūraṇaguṇasuhitārtha’ ity ādinā jñāpakena kartari ṣaṣṭhī, raktena pūritakoṣṭhasyety arthaḥ| koṣṭhaśabdena hṛdayādayo gṛhyante| yad āha suśrutaḥ–
“sthānāny āmāgnipakvānāṃ mūtrasya rudhirasya ca|
hṛduṇḍukaḥ phupphusaś ca koṣṭha ity abhidhīyate||” (su. ci. a. 2) iti||5||

avagāḍhaśastraprahārajanitaraktapūrṇakoṣṭhajam āha– asṛja ity ādi| asṛjaḥ rudhirasyeti “pūraṇaguṇasahita” ity ādinā jñāpakena kartari ṣaṣṭhī; raktena pūritakoṣṭhasyety arthaḥ| koṣṭhaśabdena hṛdayādayo gṛhyante| yad āha suśrutaḥ–
“sthānāny āmāgnipākvānāṃ mūtrasya rudhirasya ca|
hṛduṇḍukaḥ phupphusaś ca koṣṭha ity abhidhīyate||” iti| na coktaraktaje nāsya paunaruktyaṃ, ‘kṛtsnadehānugam’ iti vacanāt, kāraṇabhedāc ceti||5||

div.ab:
dhātukṣayottho yo dāhastena mūrchātṛḍarditaḥ |
kṣāmasvaraḥ kriyāhīnaḥ sa sīded bhṛśapīḍitaḥ ||6|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

ab.seg: dhātukṣayajam āha– dhātv ity ādi| dhātavo rasādayaḥ| kriyāhīno niśceṣṭaḥ; kiṃ vā bhṛśapīḍito dāhena kriyāhīnaś cikitsāhīno yadi bhavet tadā sīden mriyeta ity arthaḥ||6||

dhātukṣayajam āha– ‘dhātvityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | dhātv ity ādi| dhātavo rasādayaḥ, teṣāṃ kṣayeṇa yo dāho bhavati tena dhātukṣayajadāhena| kṣāmasvaro durbalasvaraḥ, kriyāhīno niśceṣṭaḥ, atra ‘kiṃvā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| bhṛśapīḍito dāhena cikitsāhīno yadi bhavet tadā sīden mriyata ity arthaḥ||6||

div.ab:
kṣatajo 'naśnataś cānnaṃ śocato vā'py anekadhā |
tenāntardahyate 'tyarthaṃ tṛṣṇāmūrchāpralāpavān ||7||
marmābhighātajo 'py asti so 'sādhyaḥ saptamo mataḥ |
sarva eva ca varjyāḥ syuḥ śītagātrasya dehinaḥ ||8|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

ab.seg:
kṣatajam āha– kṣataja ity ādi| marmābhighātajam āha– marmety ādi| marmāṇi śirohṛdayabastyādīni| jejjaṭas tu saptatvam anyathā gaṇayati– ‘tvacaṃ prāpta’ ity ādinā prathamaḥ, ‘kṛtsnadehānugaṃ raktam’ ity atra raktasthāne pittaṃ paṭhitvā etadādinā ‘sa cāpy asya vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ’ ity antena ‘paittiko’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | paittiko dvitīyaḥ, tṛṣṇānirodhajas tṛtīyaḥ, ‘asṛjaḥ ‘pūrṇakoṣṭhajaścaturthaḥ’ iti pā.| pūrṇakoṣṭhasya’ iti caturthaḥ, dhātukṣayajaḥ pañcamaḥ, ṣaṣṭhasya tu kṣatajasya lakṣaṇaṃ paṭhati–
“kṣatajo 'naśnataś cānnaṃ śocataś cāpy anekadhā|
tenāntardahyate 'tyarthaṃ ‘tṛṣṇāmūrchāpralāpavān’ pā.| tṛṣṇādāhapralāpavān|” iti, marmābhighātajas tu saptama iti||7-8||

marmābhighātajam āha– marmety ādi| marmāṇi hṛdayaśirobastyādīni| ‘sa cāsādhyatamaḥ smṛtaḥ’ ity atrānye ‘so 'sādhyaḥ saptamo mataḥ’ iti paṭhanti| jejjaṭas tu saptatvam anyathā gaṇayati– tvacaṃ prāpta ity ādinā prathamaḥ, ‘kṛtsnadehānugaṃ raktam’ ity atra raktasthāne pittaṃ paṭhitvā etadādinā ‘sa cāpy asya vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ’ ity antena paittiko dvitīyaḥ, tṛṣṇānirodhajas tṛtīyaḥ, ‘asṛjaḥ pūrṇakoṣṭhasya’ iti caturthaḥ, dhātukṣayajaḥ pañcamaḥ, ṣaṣṭhasya kṣatajasya lakṣaṇaṃ paṭhati–
“kṣatajenāśnataś cānnaṃ śocato vā'py anekadhā|
tenāṅgaṃ dahyate 'tyarthaṃ tṛṣṇādāhapralāpavān||” iti| asyārthaḥ– pūrvam asṛjaḥ pūrṇakoṣṭhasyety ādinā koṣṭhasthena raktena dāham abhidhāyedānīṃ prakārāntareṇāha– kṣatajena raktena, anaśnato bhojanaṃ kurvataḥ, śokaṃ kurvato vā'pi narasyānyo dāho raktena bhavatīti sambandhaḥ, tena dāhenābhyantaraṃ dahyate, tṛṣṇāmūrchāpralāpavān ‘naro bhavati’ iti śeṣaḥ| marmābhighātajas tu saptamaḥ| sarveṣām api dāhānām avasthāyāṃ ‘varjayannāha’ iti pā.| varjanīyatvam āha– sarva iti| sarva eva hi ‘dāhā’ iti śeṣaḥ| śeṣaṃ sugamam||7-8||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne dāhanidānaṃ samāptam ||19||
iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ dāhanidānaṃ samāptam||19||
iti śrīvaidyavācaspatikṛte ātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāne dāhanidānam||19||

div.head: unmādanidānam
div.ab:
athonmādanidānam |
madayanty udgatā doṣā ‘ ... unmārgamāśritāḥ’ iti pā. | yasmād unmārgam āgatāḥ |
mānaso 'yam ato vyādhir unmāda iti kīrtitaḥ ||1|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 62) |

ab.seg: madātyaye ‘unmādam iva cāparam’ ity anena unmādasaṅkīrtanam unmādasādṛśyaṃ coktaṃ, tathā madātyaye 'pi dāho bhavatīti ‘alpavaktavyatayā’ iti pā.| svalpavaktavyatayā dāham abhidhāyonmādārambhaḥ, tasya niruktim āha– madayantīty ādi| madayanti manovibhramaṃ kurvanti, ‘manovahādhamanīranuprāptāḥ unmārgamāgatā vimārgamāgatā|’ iti pā.| unmārgam āgatā vimārgam āgatā manovahādhamanīr anuprāptāḥ| udgatā vṛddhāḥ, athavā ūrdhvaṃ hṛdayaṃ gatāḥ, ‘tena tataḥ pūrveṇaiva’ iti pā.| etenotpūrveṇaiva doṣāṇāṃ vṛddhatvaṃ vimārgagatvaṃ ca darśitam||1||

madātyaye ‘unmādam iva cāparam’ ‘ityanyenonmāda ... ’ iti pā.| ity anenonmādasaṅkīrtanam unmādasādṛśyaṃ coktaṃ, tathā madātyaye dāho bhavatīti tulyalakṣaṇatayā dāham abhidhāyonmādārambhaḥ, tasya niruktim āha– madayantīty ādi| yasmād doṣā madayanti manovibhramaṃ kurvanti, ato 'yaṃ mānaso vyādhir unmāda iti kīrtyata iti sambandhaḥ| kīdṛśāḥ? udgatā vṛddhāḥ, athavā ūrdhvaṃ hṛdayaṃ gatāḥ, unmārgam āgatā vimārgagāḥ, manovahadhamanīr anuprāptāḥ, tena tataḥ pūrveṇaiva doṣāṇāṃ vṛddhatvaṃ vimārgagatvaṃ ca darśitam||1||

div.ab:
ekaikaśaḥ sarvaśaś ca doṣair atyarthamūrchitaiḥ |
mānasena ca duḥkhena sa ca pañcavidho mataḥ ||2||
viṣād bhavati ṣaṣṭhaś ca yathāsvaṃ tatra bheṣajam |
sa cāpravṛddhas taruṇo madasañjñāṃ bibharti ca ||3|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 62) |

ab.seg: prakārabhedam āha– ekaikaśa ity ādi| mānasena ca duḥkheneti śokādinā| sa ceti ṣaḍvidho 'pi| atrāpravṛddhapadam upādāyāpi taruṇapadaprayogaṃ kurvatā suśrutena svatantro 'pi doṣajanito mado bhavatīti darśitam| ata eva carake vidhiśoṇitīyādhyāye (ca. sū. a. 24) unmādāt pṛthag eva paṭhitaḥ sanidānacikitsita iti||2-3||

tasya saṅkhyām āha– ekaikaśa ity ādi| vātena pittena śleṣmaṇā sarvaśa iti sannipātena, atyarthamūrchitaiḥ atipravṛddhaiḥ, mānasena tu duḥkheneti śokādinā, viṣāt ṣaṣṭho bhavati| sa cāpravṛddha iti sa ca vikāraḥ, yāvat pravṛddho vṛddhiṃ gato na bhavati, yāvac ca taruṇas tāvan mada iti sañjñāṃ bibharti, mada iti kathyata ity arthaḥ| suśrute svatantro 'pi doṣajanito mado bhavatīti vyākhyātam| ata eva carake vidhiśoṇitīyādhyāye unmādāt pṛthag eva paṭhitaḥ sa nidānacikitsita iti||2-3||

div.ab:
viruddhaduṣṭāśucibhojanani pradharṣaṇaṃ devagurudvijānām |
unmādahetur bhayaharṣapūrvo mano 'bhighāto viṣamāś ca ceṣṭāḥ ||4|| (ca. ci. a. 9) |

ab.seg: sāmānyahetum āha– viruddhety ādi| duṣṭaṃ garasahitam annādi| pradharṣaṇaṃ ‘dhṛṣa’ pradharṣaṇe, ity asmāt pradharṣaṇam abhibhavaḥ| bhayaharṣapūrvo mano 'bhighāta iti bhayaharṣābhyāṃ manaso 'bhibhavaḥ; bhayaharṣapūrva iti bhayaṃ harṣo atra ‘dvau’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| dvau vā pūrvaṃ yasya sa tathā; pūrvaśabdo 'tra kāraṇavācī, cakāro 'tra luptanirdiṣṭo draṣṭavyaḥ, tena kāmakrodhalobhādayo 'pi kāraṇam iti jejjaṭaḥ; anye tv āhuḥ– krodhādibhir api bhayaharṣapūrvaka eva bhavatīti tena tau nirdiṣṭau| viṣamāś ca ceṣṭā iti viṣamāṅganyāsabalavadvigrahādaya unmādahetava iti yojyam||4||

tasya sāmānyahetum āha– viruddhety ādi| duṣṭaṃ garaduṣṭam annādi, aśuci bhojanaṃ cāṇḍālādispṛṣṭaṃ, pradharṣaṇaṃ nindādyabhibhavanaṃ, manobhighāta iti bhayaharṣābhyāṃ manobhibhavaḥ, bhayaharṣapūrva iti bhayaharṣau pūrvau yasva sa tathā| pūrvaśabdo 'tra kāraṇavācī, cakāro 'tra luptanirdiṣṭo draṣṭavyaḥ, tena kāmakrodhalobhādayo 'pi kāraṇam iti jejjaṭaḥ| anye tv āhuḥ– krodhādibhir api bhayaharṣapūrvaka eva bhavatīti, tena tau nirdiṣṭāv iti| viṣamāś ceṣṭā iti viṣamāṅganyāsabalavadvigrahādayaḥ, unmādahetur iti yojyam||4||

div.ab:
tair alpasattvasya malāḥ praduṣṭā buddher nivāsaṃ hṛdayaṃ pradūṣya |
