vidāhi bhuktam anyad vā tasyāpy annaṃ vidahyate||” iti| sa cāmatulyatvād āma ity ucyate| tasyātivṛddhāṃ śaktim āha– medasety ādi| anye dhātavo rasādayaḥ śukrāntāḥ na puṣyanti, medaś cīyate vṛddhiṃ gacchati| tasyāpi pravṛddhasyopadravān āha– kṣudrety ādi| śvāsanidānoktaḥ kṣudraśvāsaḥ, svapnaḥ nidrā, krathanam akasmāt śvāsāvarodhaḥ, anye– krathanaṃ tasya kaṇṭhe ghurghuraravaḥ, sādanaṃ śarīrasya, kṣut chikkā, alpaprāṇo hīnabalaḥ, alpamaithunaḥ śukrasyāvṛddhitvāt| tasya sthānasaṃśrayam āha– meda ity ādi| sugamam| tasyātivṛddhasya vahner dīptitām āha– medasety ādi| medoruddhamārgatvāt yadi ‘kumbhakakarmakṛtyapavana ... ’ iti pā.| kumbhakārapavananyāyenāntarbalavān atipravṛddho vāyur viśeṣād agniṃ dīpayati, dīptāgnitvād āhāram abhilaṣati| atipravṛddhas tu vāyur agnivaiṣamyakṛt syāt| kāṃścid vikārān vātavikārāṇām anyatamān, ghorān dāruṇān| kālavyatikramād iti bhojanakālavyatikramāt, pramehapiḍakājvarabhagandaravidradhivātarogāṇām anyatamān| ‘koṣṭhāntāruddhamārgatvāt’ iti pā.| koṣṭhāntaḥruddhamārgatvāt pravṛddhau vināśāya bhavata ity ata āha– etāv ity ādi| viśeṣāt pravṛddhāv etau rogotpādakau bhavataḥ| etau hi sthūlaṃ naraṃ nāśayataḥ, yathā dāvāgnir vanam| punar atipravṛddhasya medaso viśeṣahetum āha– medasīty ādi| vikārān pūrvoktān eva| sthūlalakṣaṇam āha– sphik ūrvor uparitano bhāgaḥ, ayathāvan māṃsopacaya utsāhaś ca yasya sa tathā||1-9||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne medonidānaṃ samāptam ||34||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ medonidānaṃ samāptam||34||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ medonidānam||34||

div.head: udaranidānam
div.ab:
athodaranidānam |
rogāḥ sarve 'pi mande 'gnau sutarām udarāṇi ca |
ajīrṇān malinaiś cānnair jāyante malasañcayāt ||1|| (vā. ni. a. 12) |

ab.seg:
udarotsedhasādharmyād udaranidānam| udarasya viśeṣeṇa vahniduṣṭijanyatvam āha– ‘rogāḥ sarve'pi mande'gnāvityādi|’ iti pā.| rogā ity ādi| agnimāndyaṃ ca doṣatrayajanakam| yad uktam– “varṣāsv agnibale hīne kupyanti pavanādayaḥ|” (ca. sū. a. 6) iti| malinair iti atyarthadoṣajanakair viruddhādhyaśanādibhiḥ| malasañcayād iti malā doṣāḥ purīṣādayaś ca, teṣām ativṛddhatvāt| tantrāntaraṃ ca–
“atisañcitadoṣāṇāṃ pāpaṃ karma ca kurvatām|
udarāṇy upajāyante mandāgnīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ||” iti| yady api mandāgnitvamalinānnatvayoḥ pratyekam api doṣatrayajanakatvam asti, tathā'py atrobhayahetujanakatvena doṣaduṣṭiprakarṣaḥ khyāpyate, ata eva duṣṭiprakarṣakhyāpanārthaṃ ‘malasañcayāt’ ity atra sampūrvaṃ kṛtavān||1||

udarotsedhasādharmyād udaranidānam| udarasya viśeṣeṇa vahnijanyaduṣṭitvam āha– rogā ity ādi| atrodarastho rogo 'py udaraśabdenocyate| uktañ ca–
“ ‘tatsthyataddharmatābhyām’ iti pā.| tātsthyataddharmatābhyāṃ ca tatsamīpatayā'pi ca|
tatsāhacaryāc chabdānāṃ vṛttir eṣā caturvidhā||” iti| agnimāndyaṃ doṣatrayajanakam| yad uktam– “teṣām agnibale hīne kupyanti pavanādayaḥ|” iti| malinair iti ajīrṇād atyarthadoṣajanakair viruddhādhyaśanādibhiḥ| malasañcayād iti| malā doṣāḥ purīṣādayaś ca, teṣām ativṛddhatvāt| uktaṃ ca tantrāntare–
“atisañcitadoṣāṇāṃ pāpaṃ karma ca kurvatām|
udarāṇy upajāyante mandāgnīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ||” iti| yady apy atra mandāgnitvamalinānnatvayoḥ pratyekam api doṣatrayajanakatvam asti, tathā'py atrobhayahetujanakatvena duṣṭiprakarṣaḥ khyāpyate||1||

div.ab:
ruddhvā svedāmbuvāhīni doṣāḥ srotāṃsi sañcitāḥ |
prāṇāgnyapānān sandūṣya janayanty udaraṃ nṛṇām ||2|| (ca. ci. a. 13) |

ab.seg:
samprāptim āha– ruddhvety ādi| svedāmbuvāhīnīti svedavahāni ambuvahāni ca| anayoś ca bhedaḥ, “udakavahānāṃ srotasāṃ tālumūlaṃ kloma ca; svedavahānāṃ srotasāṃ medo mūlaṃ lomakūpāś ca|” (ca. vi. a. 5) ity anenokto jñeyaḥ| srotorodhaś cātra bahir eva na punar antaḥ| yad uktaṃ carake– “svedas tu bāhyeṣu srotaḥsu pratihatagatis tiryag avatiṣṭhamānas tad evodakam āpyāyayati|” (ca. ci. a. 13) iti| ata evodarapūrṇatā annarasena| prāṇāgnīti punar agnidūṣaṇābhidhānena mandasyāpy agneḥ punar doṣakṛtaṃ sutarāṃ māndyaṃ bodhayati| doṣasañcayagatenāpi vāyunā prāṇāpānayor dūṣaṇaṃ na viruddhaṃ, yato vāyunā vāyvantaraduṣṭiḥ kriyata eva| suśrute tu pūrvarūpam asyoktaṃ; tad yathā–
“tatpūrvarūpaṃ balavarṇakāṅkṣāvalīvināśo jaṭhare hi rājyaḥ|
jīrṇāparijñānavidāhavatyo bastau rujaḥ pādagataś ca śothaḥ||” (su. ni. a. 7) iti||2||

tasyāḥ samprāptim āha– ruddhety ādi| doṣāḥ svedāmbuvāhīni srotāṃsi ruddhvā prāṇāgnyapānān sandūṣya udaram utpādayanti| ‘svedavāhīni udakavāhīni’ iti pā.| svedāmbuvāhīnīti, anayoś ca bhedaḥ– udakavahānāṃ srotasāṃ tālumūlaṃ kloma ca, svedavahānāṃ medomūlaṃ romakūpāś cety anena prokto jñeyaḥ| srotonirodhaś ca bahir eva na punar antaḥ| yad uktaṃ carake– “svedaś ca bāhyeṣu mārgeṣv abhihatagatis tiryag avatiṣṭhamānas tad evodakam āpyāyati” iti| ata evodarapūrṇatā'nnarasena| prāṇā'gnīti prāṇo vāyur agniś ca, apāno vāyuḥ, etān; punar agniṃ sandūṣyety abhidhānena mandasyāgneḥ punar doṣakṛtaṃ sutarāṃ māndyaṃ bodhayati| doṣasañcayagatenāpi vāyunā prāṇāpānayor dūṣaṇaṃ na viruddhaṃ, yato duṣṭena vāyunā'duṣṭasyāntarvāyor duṣṭiḥ kriyata eva| asya tu pūrvarūpaṃ suśrute paṭhitaṃ, tad yathā–
“tatpūrvarūpaṃ balavarṇakāṅkṣāvalīvināśo jaṭhare ca rājyaḥ|
jīrṇāparijñānavidāhavatyo bastau rujaḥ pādagataś ca śothaḥ||” iti||2||

dāhas tandrā ca sarveṣu jaṭhareṣu bhavanti hi | (su. ni. a. 7) |
pṛthag doṣaiḥ samastaiś ca plīhabaddhakṣatodakaiḥ ||4||

lg.l: sambhavanty udarāṇy aṣṭau teṣāṃ liṅgaṃ pṛthak śṛṇu |5|

div.ab: udarāṇāṃ sāmānyarūpam āha– ādhmānam ity ādi| durbalāgniteti mando 'gnir yady apy atra hetus tathā'py agner atiśayadaurbalyaṃ liṅgatvena jñeyam| udarāṇy aṣṭāv iti yakṛddālyudarasya plīhodareṇa sārdhaṃ samānacikitsyatayā tathotpattiviśiṣṭadakodarāt krameṇa bhūtadakodarasyāpi samānaliṅgacikitsitatvenābhinnatvāt aṣṭāv evodarāṇi bhavanti| plīhodarādīni ca yady api catvāri doṣajāni, tathā'pi hetuliṅgacikitsābhedāt pṛthag uktāni||3-4||–

sarveṣām udarāṇāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇam āha– ādhmānam ity ādi| mandāgnir yady apy atra hetuḥ, tathā'py agner atiśayadaurbalyaṃ liṅgatvena jñeyam| sadanaṃ sādaḥ| vātapurīṣayoḥ saṅga iti apravṛttiḥ| teṣāṃ saṅkhyām āha– pṛthag ity ādi| vātapittakaphais trayaḥ, tribhir ekaḥ, plīhnā baddhena kṣatena ‘udakena’ ityeva pā.| udakenaikaikaḥ, evam aṣṭāv evodarāṇi| yakṛddālyudarasya plīhodareṇa saha samānacikitsitatayā samānaliṅgatvenābhinnatvāt aṣṭāv evodarāṇi bhavanti, na tu yakṛddālyudaraṃ pṛthak| plīhodarādīni ca yady api catvāri doṣajāni, tathā'pi hetuliṅgacikitsābhedāt pṛthag uktāni; teṣāṃ liṅgāni pṛthak śṛṇu||3-4||–

tatra vātodare śothaḥ pāṇipānnābhikukṣiṣu ||5||
kukṣipārśvodarakaṭīpṛṣṭharuk parvabhedanam |
śuṣkakāso 'ṅgamardo 'dhogurutā malasaṅgrahaḥ ||6||
śyāvāruṇatvagāditvam akasmād vṛddhihrāsavat |
satodabhedam udaraṃ ‘ ... śirātatam’ iti pā. | tanukṛṣṇasirātatam ||7||
ādhmātadṛtivac chabdam āhataṃ prakaroti ca |
vāyuś cātra sarukśabdo vicaret sarvato gatiḥ ||8|| (vā. ni. a. 12) |

ab.seg: vātodaralakṣaṇam āha– tatrety ādi| akasmād vṛddhihrāsavad iti aniyatavṛddhihrāsayuktam udaram| ādhmātadṛtivad iti vātapūrṇacarmapuṭavad iti||5-8||

tatra vātodaralakṣaṇam āha– tatrety ādi| hastapādādiṣu śvayathuḥ| kukṣyādiṣu ca pīḍā, udarasya vāmadakṣiṇabhāge kukṣiḥ, parvabhedanaṃ sandhisphuṭanam, adho nābher adhaḥ pakvāśaye gurutā, malasaṅgrahaḥ purīṣasyāpravṛttiḥ| tvagādiṣu śyāvāruṇatvam, ādiśabdena nakhanetragrahaṇam| ayamevameva pāṭhamūrīkaroti| akasmād dṛtihāsavad iti dṛtiś carmakhallī, hastāhatavātapūrṇadṛtivat śabdaṃ karoti, udaram iti śeṣaḥ| sarvatogatiḥ sarvakoṣṭhagato vāyuḥ sarukśabdo dhāvati||5-8||

div.ab:
pittodare jvaro mūrchā dāhas tṛṭ kaṭukāsyatā |
‘ ... 'tīsāraḥ’ iti pā. | bhramo 'tisāraḥ pītatvaṃ tvagādāv udaraṃ harit ||9||
pītatāmrasirānaddhaṃ sasvedaṃ soṣma dahyate |
dhūmāyate mṛdusparśaṃ kṣiprapākaṃ pradūyate ||10|| (vā. ni. a. 12) |

ab.seg: paittikam āha– pittety ādi| dahyata iti udaramātraṃ dahyate| dāhas tu sakaladehasyaiva boddhavyaḥ| dhūmāyate dhūma ivordhvam eti| kṣiprapākam iti kṣiprapākāj jalodaratāṃ yātīty arthaḥ| pradūyate vyathate||9-10||

paittikam āha– pittodarety ādi| tiktāsyatā tiktamukhatvaṃ, ‘ ‘kaṭudrāvasyābhidhānāt’ iti pā.| kaṭukāsyatā iti pāṭhāntaram| bhramo 'tra śaṅkhādau pītajñānam iti, harit śākavarṇanam| dahyata iti udaram eva dahyate, ‘dāhastatra’ iti pā.| dāhas tv atra sakaladehasyaiva boddhavyaḥ| dhūmāyate dhūmam ivordhvam eti| ‘kṣiprapākaṃ jalodaratām’ iti pā.| kṣiprapākāj jalodaratāṃ yātīty arthaḥ| pradūyate vyathate||9-10||

div.ab:
śleṣmodare 'ṅgasadanaṃ svāpaśvayathugauravam |
nidrotkleśo 'ruciḥ śvāsaḥ kāsaḥ śuklatvagāditā ||11||
udaraṃ stimitaṃ snigdhaṃ śuklarājītataṃ mahat |
cirābhivṛddhaṃ kaṭhinaṃ śītasparśaṃ guru sthiram ||12|| (vā. ni. a. 12) |
striyo 'nnapānaṃ nakhalomamūtraviḍārtavair yuktam asādhuvṛttāḥ |
yasmai prayacchanty arayo garāṃś ca duṣṭāmbudūṣīviṣasevanād vā ||13||
tenāśu raktaṃ kupitāś ca doṣāḥ kuryuḥ sughoraṃ jaṭharaṃ triliṅgam |
tac chītavāte bhṛśadurdine ca viśeṣataḥ kupyati dahyate ca ||14||
sa cāturo muhyati hi prasaktaṃ pāṇḍuḥ kṛśaḥ śuṣyati tṛṣṇayā ca | dūṣyodaraṃ kīrtitam etad eva ...|| (su. ni. a. 7) |

sannipātodaram āha– striya ity ādi| strīgrahaṇam avivekisannihitajanopalakṣaṇam| garaṃ saṃyogajaṃ viṣam| duṣṭam ambu sagaraprāṇitṛṇaparṇādikothayutaṃ, viṣam evāgnyādyupahataṃ mandaprabhāvaṃ vā dūṣīviṣam ucyate| yad uktam–
“jīrṇaṃ viṣaghnauṣadhibhir hataṃ vā dāvāgnivātātapaśoṣitaṃ vā|
svabhāvato vā guṇaviprahīnaṃ viṣaṃ hi dūṣīviṣatām upaiti||” (su. ka. a. 2) iti| tenāśu raktam iti viṣasyāgneyatvena raktaduṣṭiḥ| kupitāś ca doṣā iti svabhāvāt doṣatrayaprakopakaṃ viṣaṃ bhavati| tac chītavātādiṣu ‘dūṣīviṣasya tatraiva kopāt| mūrchati viṣayogāt| prasaktaṃ nirantaram|’ iti pā.| kupyatīti| dūṣyodaraṃ kīrtitam etad eveti etad eva sannipātodaraṃ dūṣyodaraṃ kīrtitaṃ, na punar adhikam ity arthaḥ| raktaṃ dūṣyaṃ dūṣayitvā bhavatīti dūṣyodaraṃ; kiṃ vā parasparaṃ dūṣayantīti doṣā eva dūṣyās taiḥ kṛtam udaram iti||11-14||–

ślaiṣmikam āha– śleṣmety ādi| aṅgasadanam aṅgasādaḥ, svāpaḥ aṅgānām eva, anye āsīnapracalāyitam| gauravam aṅgānām| ‘nidrā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | nidrā nidrābāhulyam| utkleśo hṛllāsaḥ| stimitaṃ niścalam, ‘ ... śirānaddham’ iti pā.| śuklasirānaddham| etacca– ‘cirābhivṛddhiḥ kaṭhinam’ iti pā.| cirābhivṛddhir iti cirapāka ity arthaḥ| guru gauravayuktam| sthiraṃ guḍaguḍāśabdarahitam| sānnipātikam āha– striya ity ādi| strīgrahaṇam avivekijanopalakṣaṇaṃ, striyo nakharomādibhir yuktaṃ yasmai annapānaṃ prayacchanti, asādhuvṛttāḥ saubhāgyam icchantyaḥ kāryākāryavicāravimukhāḥ, ārtavaṃ rajaḥ| śatravo vā yasmai garaṃ saṃyogajaṃ viṣam| duṣṭam ambu ‘saviṣamanuṣyatṛṇa ... ’ iti pā.| saviṣakīṭatṛṇaparṇādikothayuktam| dūṣīviṣaṃ viṣam eva vāyvagnyādyupahataṃ yad alpaprabhāvaṃ, viṣapītasya vā viṇmūtraṃ, tad dūṣīviṣam ucyate; ‘dūṣyambudūṣīviṣayoḥ’ iti pā.| duṣṭāmbudūṣīviṣayoḥ sevanād vā| tenāśu raktaṃ duṣṭaṃ bhavati, viṣasyāgneyatvena raktasya duṣṭiḥ| kupitāś ca doṣā iti svabhāvād doṣatrayaprakopakaṃ viṣaṃ bhavati| sughoraṃ bhṛśaṃ kaṣṭakāri| jaṭharam ity udaravikāram| tac chītavātādiṣu kupyati kopaṃ gacchati, dūṣīviṣasya tatraiva kopāt| dahyate santapyate| ‘muhyati’ ityatra ‘mūrchati’ iti pā.| mūrchati viṣayogāt| prasaktaṃ nirantaram| dūṣyodaraṃ kīrtitam etad eveti etad eva sānnipātodaraṃ kīrtitaṃ, na punar adhikam ity arthaḥ| raktaṃ dūṣyaṃ dūṣayitvā bhavatīti dūṣyodaram, athavā parasparaṃ dūṣayantīti doṣā eva dūṣyās taiḥ kṛtam udaraṃ dūṣyodaram||11-14||-

... plīhodaraṃ kīrtayato nibodha ||15||
vidāhyabhiṣyandiratasya jantoḥ praduṣṭam atyartham asṛk kaphaś ca |
plīhābhivṛddhiṃ kurutaḥ pravṛddhau plīhottham etaj jaṭharaṃ vadanti ||16||
tad vāmapārśve parivṛddhim eti viśeṣataḥ sīdati cāturo 'tra |
mandajvarāgniḥ kaphapittaliṅgair upadrutaḥ kṣīṇabalo 'tipāṇḍuḥ |
savyānyapārśve yakṛti pravṛddhe jñeyaṃ yakṛddālyudaraṃ tad eva ||17|| (su. ni. a. 7) |

ab.seg: plīhodaram āha– plīhety ādi| asṛkkaphaś cety asṛgduṣṭyaiva tattulyakāraṇatayā pittaduṣṭir apy ucyate, vidāhinā raktaṃ pittaṃ ca dūṣyate; ata eva paścāt vakṣyati– “kaphapittaliṅgair upadrutaḥ” iti| atra pittasya liṅgaṃ mandajvaraḥ, kaphasya liṅgaṃ mandāgnitvam iti gadādharaḥ| plīhodara eva yakṛddālyudarasyāvarodhaṃ darśayann āha– savyānyapārśva ity ādi| savyānyapārśve dakṣiṇapārśve| tad eveti tādṛśam eva, plīhodarasamam eva; na vilakṣaṇam ity arthaḥ| yakṛddālayati doṣair bhedayatīti yakṛddālyudaram||15-17||

plīhodaram āha– abhiṣyandīty ādi| doṣadhātumalasrotasāṃ kledaprāptijananam| asṛkkaphaś ceti asṛkkaphajaiva tulyakāraṇatayā pittaduṣṭir ucyate| vidāhinā raktaṃ pittaṃ ca dūṣyati| ata eva vakṣyati– ‘kaphapittaliṅgair upadrutaḥ’ iti| tatra pittasya liṅgaṃ mando jvaraḥ, kaphasya liṅgaṃ mandāgnitvam iti gadādharaḥ| plīhodara eva yakṛddālyudarasyāvarodhaṃ darśayann āha– savyety ādi| savyānyapārśve dakṣiṇe, tad eveti tādṛśam eva, tena plīhodareṇa samam eva, na vilakṣaṇam ity arthaḥ| yakṛddālayati doṣair bhedayatīti yakṛddālyudaram||15-17||

div.ab:
udāvartarujānāhair mohatṛḍdahanajvaraiḥ |
gauravārucikāṭhinyair vidyāt tatra malān kramāt ||18|| (vā. ni. a. 12) |

ab.seg: tatra doṣasambandham āha– udāvartety ādi| udāvartarujānāhair vātaṃ, mohatṛḍdahanajvaraiḥ pittaṃ, gauravārucikāṭhinyaiḥ kaphaṃ jānīyāt||18||

tatra doṣasambandham āha– udāvartety ādi| tatra plīhodarayakṛddālyudarayoḥ pṛthaglakṣaṇalakṣitān malān vātādīn krameṇodāvartādibhir liṅgair vidyāt| tatra udāvartarujānāhair vātaṃ, mohatṛḍdahanajvaraiḥ pittaṃ, gauravārucikāṭhinyaiḥ kaphaṃ jānīyāt||18||

div.ab:
yasyāntram annair upalepibhir vā bālāśmabhir vā pihitaṃ yathāvat |
sañcīyate tasya malaḥ sadoṣaḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ saṅkaravac ca nāḍyām ||19||
nirudhyate tasya gude purīṣaṃ nireti kṛcchrād api cālpam alpam |
hṛnnābhimadhye parivṛddhim eti tasyodaraṃ baddhagudaṃ vadanti ||20|| (su. ni. a. 7) |

ab.seg: baddhagudam āha– yasyāntram annair ity ādi| upalepibhiḥ picchilair annaiḥ śākaśālukādibhiḥ| pihitaṃ vibaddham| yathāvad iti yathārham| malaḥ purīṣam| sadoṣa iti doṣatrayasahitaḥ| nāḍyām ity antranāḍyām| saṅkaravad iti sammārjanīkṣipyamāṇatṛṇādyavakaro yathā cīyate krameṇa tathety arthaḥ| baddhagudam iti gudopari antrasya baddhatvād baddhagudam| yad uktaṃ carake– “pakṣmabālaiḥ sahānnena bhuktair baddhāyane gude|” (ca. ci. a. 13) iti| purīṣāyatanasya ‘baddhatvāt’ iti pā.| ruddhatvāt hṛnnābhimadhye 'nnapākasthāne vṛddhiḥ; gudamātranirodhe tu maladoṣair gudād ūrdhvam evodaravṛddhiḥ syāt||19-20||

baddhagudam āha– yasyety ādi| yasya puṃso 'ntram upalepibhiḥ picchilair annaiḥ śākādibhir vā, yathāvad iti yathārhaṃ pihitaṃ baddhaṃ bhavati| ‘atra vāntre’ iti pā.| athavā'nne malaḥ purīṣaḥ, sadoṣaḥ doṣatrayasahitaḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ sañcīyate sammārjanīkṣipyamāṇatṛṇādyavakaro yathā vṛddhiṃ nīyate krameṇa tathaivety arthaḥ| tasya gude purīṣaṃ nirudhyate kṛcchrāc cālpam alpaṃ nireti niḥsarati| baddhagudam iti gudopari antrasya baddhatvād baddhagudam| yad uktaṃ carake– “pakṣmabālaiḥ sahānnena bhuktair baddhāyane gude|” iti| purīṣāyatanasya ruddhatvāt| hṛnnābhimadhya iti annapākasthāne vṛddhiḥ, gudamātranirodhe tu maladoṣair gudād ūrdhvam evodare vṛddhiḥ syāt||19-20||

div.ab:
śalyaṃ tathā'nnopahitaṃ yad antraṃ bhuktaṃ bhinatty āgatam anyathā vā |
tasmāt sruto 'ntrāt salilaprakāśaḥ srāvaḥ sraved vai gudatas tu bhūyaḥ ||21||
nābher adhaś codaram eti vṛddhiṃ nistudyate dālyati cātimātram | etat parisrāvyudaraṃ pradiṣṭaṃ ... |22| (su. ni. a. 7) |

kṣatodaram āha– ‘śalyaṃ tathā'nnopahitamityādi’ iti pā.| śalyam ity ādi| śalyaṃ kaṇṭakaśarkarādi| annopahitam annayuktam| bhuktam āgatam iti arthataḥ pākāśayāt; vilomenāgatam antraṃ bhinatti, ṛjvāgataṃ hi śalyam api nāntrabhedakam| anyathā veti jṛmbhaṇātyaśanābhyām antraṃ bhidyate| yad uktaṃ carake–
“śarkarātṛṇaloṣṭāsthikaṇṭakair annasaṃyutaiḥ|
bhidyetāntraṃ yadā bhuktair jṛmbhayā'tyaśanena vā||” (ca. ci. a. 13) iti| sruta iti galitaḥ| ‘srāvaḥ sraved vai gudatas tu bhūyaḥ’ iti ‘bhūyo’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhūyo bahu yathā bhavati tathā'ntrāt srutaḥ; doṣajeṣu punar upasnehanyāyenālpa eva srāvo bhūyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ gudataś ca sravet| tuśabdaś cārthe, bhūyaḥśabdo 'trāvartanīyaḥ; tenoktā vyākhyā sādhvī bhavati| nanu, bhinnāntrāt tiryag atra srāvanirgamaḥ; tat kathaṃ “srāvaḥ sraved vai gudatas tu bhūya” ity upapadyate? naivaṃ, sacchidrāntramārgeṇa bahirgatasyātivṛddhasya punarāgamanāt upasnehanyāyād vā gudataḥ srāva upapanna eva| carake 'py uktam– “pūrayan gudam antraṃ ca janayaty udaraṃ nṛṇām|” (ca. ci. a. 13) iti| ‘tena’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tena srāveṇa dravasya nimnagatvān nābher adho jaṭharaṃ vṛddhim eti; etac chidrodaraṃ jalodaram iti bhaṇyate iti gadādharaḥ| yataś carakeṇoktam– “tad adho nābheḥ prāyo 'bhinirvartamānaṃ jalodaraṃ syāt|” (ca. ci. a. 13) iti| tad anye nānumanyante, yataś chidrodaraṃ śīghraṃ jalodaratāṃ yātīty abhiprāyeṇa carakeṇoktam, anyathā dakodaraṃ pṛthaṅ na syāt||21||–

ab.seg:
kṣatodaram āha– śalyam ity ādi| śalyaṃ kaṇṭakaśarkarāsthikāṣṭhādikam| annopahitam annayuktaṃ, bhuktam āgatam ity arthataḥ pakvāśayāt, vilomena nirgatam antraṃ bhinatti vidārayati, ṛjvāgataṃ śalyam api nāntrabhedakam| anyathā veti jṛmbhaṇenātyaśitasyāntraṃ bhidyate| yad uktaṃ carake–
“śarkarātṛṇaloṣṭāsthikaṇṭakair annasaṃyutaiḥ|
bhidyate 'ntraṃ yadā bhuktair jṛmbhayā'tyaśanena ca||” iti| sruta iti galitaḥ| srāvaḥ sraved vai gudatas tu bhūya iti bhūyo bahu yathā bhavati tathā'ntrāt sruta iti nanu, bhinnāntrāt tiryag atra srāvo yuktaḥ, tat kathaṃ srāvaḥ sraved vai gudatas tu bhūya ity upapadyate? naivaṃ, sacchidrāntramārgeṇa srāvasya nirgamatvād bahiṣkṛtasyātivṛddhasya punargamanād upasnehanyāyād vā gudataḥ srāva upapadyata eva| carake 'py uktam– “pūrayan gudam antraṃ ca janayaty udaraṃ nṛṇām|” iti| tena srāveṇa dravasya nimnagatvān nābher adho jaṭharaṃ vṛddhim eti, nistudyate śūlena dālyata iva| etat parisrāvyudaram anye ‘etasyeva’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | etasyeva chidrodaram āhuḥ||21||

div.ab:
... dakodaraṃ kīrtayato nibodha ||22||
yaḥ snehapīto 'py anuvāsito vā vānto virikto 'py athavā nirūḍhaḥ |
pibej jalaṃ śītalam āśu tasya srotāṃsi dūṣyanti hi tadvahāni ||23||
snehopalipteṣv athavā'pi teṣu dakodaraṃ pūrvavad abhyupaiti |
snigdhaṃ mahat tat parivṛttanābhi samātataṃ pūrṇam ivāmbunā ca |
yathā dṛtiḥ kṣubhyati kampate ca śabdāyate cāpi dakodaraṃ tat ||24|| (su. ni. a. 7) |

ab.seg: utpattiviśiṣṭaṃ dakodaram āha– yaḥ snehapīta ity ādi| snehapīta iti kartari ktaḥ, tena snehaṃ pītavān ity arthaḥ| dūṣyantīti svakarmasu duṣṭāni ‘bhavantīti’ iti pā.| bhavanti| tadvahāni udakavahāni| teṣv iti udakavahasrotaḥsu| pūrvavad iti yathā pūrvam uktam| annarasa upasnehanyāyena bahir niḥsṛtyodaraṃ janayatīty artha iti jejjaṭaḥ| gadādharas tv āha– kṣatāntrodare yathā adho nābher udarābhivṛddhir gudasrāvaś ca tathā jalodare 'pi bhavatīti| nanu, sarveṣām eva upasnehanyāyena bahirniḥsṛtānnarasamūlatvāt katham anudakatvaṃ? naivaṃ, teṣu hi prathamato nātimandatvād agner annarasasyālpatvāc cānudakatvam, alpatvena tadvyapadeśāt; atra tu prāg eva bhūrijalotpattir iti viśeṣaḥ| samātataṃ vedanayā vistāryamāṇam ivodaraṃ bhavati| yathā dṛtiḥ kṣubhyatīti dṛtir iva jalapūrṇā kṣubhyatīti, antarjalacalanam iva dhatte| śabdāyate guḍaguḍāyate||22-24||

dakodaram āha– dakodaram ity ādi| snehapīta iti kartari ktaḥ; tena ‘snehapītavānityarthaḥ|’ iti pā.| snehaṃ pītavān ity arthaḥ| tasya tadvahāni srotāṃsi dūṣyantīti svakarmaṇy asamarthāni ‘bhavantīti’ iti pā.| bhavanti| tadvahānīti udakavahāni| athavā snehopalipteṣu teṣv eva udakavahasrotaḥsu, pūrvavad iti kṣatāntrodare yathā nābher adhaḥ udarābhivṛddhiḥ, gudasrāvas tathā jalodare bhavatīti| nanu sarveṣām eva bahirniḥsṛtānnarasamūlatvāt katham anudakatvaṃ? ucyate– teṣu hi prathamato nātimandatvād agner annarasasyālpatvāc cānudakatvaṃ, svalpatvenāvyapadeśāt; atra tu prāg eva jalaṃ bhavatīti viśeṣaḥ| tad udaraṃ snigdhaṃ bhavati, tathā mahat, tathā parivṛttanābhi ucchalitanābhi, samātataṃ vedanayā vistīrṇam ivodaraṃ bhavati| yathā dṛtiḥ kṣubhyatīti dṛtir iva jalapūrṇā kṣubhyatīti, antarjalacālanam iva dhatte, kampate veti kampanam atiśayena calanaṃ, śabdāyate guḍaguḍāyate||22-24||

div.ab:
janmanaivodaraṃ sarvaṃ prāyaḥ kṛcchratamaṃ matam |
balinas tad ajātāmbu yatnasādhyaṃ navotthitam ||25||
pakṣād baddhagudaṃ tūrdhvaṃ sarvaṃ jātodakaṃ tathā |
prāyo bhavaty abhāvāya chidrāntraṃ codaraṃ nṛṇām ||26|| (ca. ci. a. 13)0 |27|

ab.seg:
udararogasya sādhyatvādilakṣaṇam āha– janmanaivety ādi| janmanaivodaram iti ‘utpattimātreṇaiva’ iti pā.| utpannamātreṇaiva| ajātodakasyodarasya lakṣaṇaṃ carake 'vagantavyaṃ; tad yathā–
“aśotham aruṇābhāsaṃ saśabdaṃ nātibhārikam|
sadā guḍaguḍāyantaṃ ‘śirājālagavākṣitam’ iti pā.| sirājālagavākṣitam||
nābhiṃ viṣṭabhya pāyau tu vegaṃ kṛtvā praṇaśyati|
hṛdvaṅkṣaṇakaṭīnābhigudapratyekaśūlinaḥ||
karkaśaṃ sṛjato vātaṃ nātimande ca pāvake|
lālayā virase cāsye mūtre 'lpe saṃhate viśi|| ajātodakam ity etair yuktaṃ vijñāya lakṣaṇaiḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 13) iti| atra karkaśam iti vegavantam| jātodakalakṣaṇaṃ ca carake yathā– “kukṣer atimātraṃ vṛddhiḥ sirāntardhānagamanam udakapūrṇadṛtisamānakṣobhasparśanaṃ ca bhavati|” (ca. ci. a. 13) iti| pakṣād ity ādi| baddhagudam udaraṃ pakṣād ūrdhvaṃ vināśāya bhavatīti| jātodakaṃ pakṣāt| prāyograhaṇena kadācit pakṣād ūrdhvam api na vināśāya, tathā śalyaśāstrābhimatayā cikitsayā kadācij jātodakaṃ chidrāntraṃ baddhagudaṃ ca sidhyatīti darśayati| jātodakaṃ chidrāntraṃ ca vināśāya pakṣād ūrdhvam iti sambandha iti kecit||25-26||

udarasyāsādhyatvam āha– janmanety ādi| utpattimātreṇaiva kaṣṭasādhyaṃ tad udaraṃ balinaḥ puruṣasya ajātāmbu ajātodakaṃ sat yatnataḥ sādhyaṃ kṛcchratvād iti| udarāṇāṃ viśeṣeṇāsādhyatvam āha– pakṣād ity ādi| baddhagudam udaraṃ pakṣād ūrdhvaṃ vināśāya bhavati| jātodakaṃ pakṣāt, ‘jātodakaṃ lakṣaṇam’ iti pā.| jātodakalakṣaṇaṃ carake– “kukṣer atimātraṃ vṛddhiḥ ‘śirāntardhāna ... ’ iti pā.| sirāntardhānam udakapūrṇaṃ sakṣobhasparśanaṃ bhavati” iti| prāyograhaṇena kadācit pakṣād ūrdhvam api chidrāntraṃ baddhagudaṃ ca siddhyatīti||25-26||

div.ab:
śūnākṣaṃ kuṭilopastham upaklinnatanutvacam |
balaśoṇitamāṃsāgniparikṣīṇaṃ ca varjayet ||27|| (ca. ci. a. 13) |
pārśvabhaṅgānnavidveṣaśothātīsārapīḍitam |
viriktaṃ cāpy udariṇaṃ pūryamāṇaṃ vivarjayet ||28|| (su. sū. a. 33) |

ab.seg: sādhyatayā'bhihitānām apy avasthāviśeṣeṇāsādhyatām āha– śūnākṣam ity ādi| ‘udariṇam’ iti śeṣaḥ| kuṭilopastham iti vakramehanam| upaklinnatanutvacam iti upaklinnā tanvī tvak yasya tam| agniparikṣīṇam iti agnikṣayaś ca yady apy udare pūrvam eva bhavati, tathā'py atra viśeṣeṇāgnikṣayo lakṣaṇāntarayuktaś cāsādhyatāliṅgaṃ sambhavatīti jñeyam||27-28||

punar apy asādhyam āha– śūnety ādi| atrodareṇeti śeṣaḥ| kuṭilopasthaṃ kuṭilamehanam| upaklinnatanutvacam iti upaklinnā tanvī tvag yasya tam| tathā'gniparikṣīṇam agnikṣayaś cāpy udare pūrvam eva bhavati, tathā'py atra ‘viśeṣeṇāgnikṣayopalakṣaṇāntarayuktamasādhyatāliṅgam’ iti pā.| viśeṣeṇāgnikṣayo lakṣaṇāntarayuktaś cāsādhyatāliṅgaṃ bhavatīti jñeyam| punar apy asādhyalakṣaṇam āha– pārśvety ādi| ‘bhagnapārśve’ iti pā.| bhagnaṃ pārśve| viriktam api pūryamāṇodaram ity arthaḥ||27-28||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne udaranidānaṃ samāptam ||35||
iti ‘śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyām’ iti pā.| śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyām udaranidānaṃ samāptam||35||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyām udaranidānam||35||

div.head: śothanidānam
div.ab:
atha śothanidānam |
raktapittakaphān vāyur duṣṭo duṣṭān bahiḥsirāḥ |
nītvā ruddhagatis tair hi kuryāt tvaṅmāṃsasaṃśrayam ||1||
utsedhaṃ saṃhataṃ śothaṃ tam āhur nicayād ataḥ |
sarvaṃ hetuviśeṣais tu rūpabhedān navātmakam ||2||
doṣaiḥ pṛthag dvayaiḥ sarvair abhighātād viṣād api |3| (vā. ni. a. 13) |

udare śothasyopadravatvenoktatvāt tadanantaraṃ śothanidānam| tasya samprāptim āha– raktapittakaphān ity ādi| raktapittakaphān svahetubhiḥ svātantryeṇa duṣṭān kupitān, duṣṭaḥ svahetukupito vāyur bahiḥsirā bāhyā agambhīrāḥ sirā nītvā gamayitvā, taiḥ raktapittakaphaiḥ ruddhagatir āvṛtamārgo vāyur utsedham ucchrāyaṃ kuryād iti yojanā| bahiḥsirāśabdenātrāgambhīratayoktānāṃ srotasām api grahaṇam| tvaṅmāṃsasaṃśrayam ity anena vraṇaśothād bhedaṃ darśayati, aṣṭasu vraṇavāstuṣu vraṇaśothasya sambhavāt| yad uktaṃ suśrutena– “tvaṅmāṃsasirāsnāyvasthisandhikoṣṭhamarmāṇīty aṣṭau vraṇavāstūni bhavanti|” (su. sū. a. 22) iti| saṃhataṃ saṃhatātmakam| kutaḥ saṃhatātmakam ity ata āha– nicayād ata iti| ato 'smāt pūrvoktāt raktasahitadoṣatrayasamudāyāt; etena raktasahitatridoṣajanyatvam asyoktaṃ bhavati| sarvam ity ādi sarvam iti pūrveṇa sambadhyate, sarvam utsedhaṃ śotham āhur ity arthaḥ| hetuviśeṣair iti doṣatrayābhighātaprabhṛtibhiḥ kāraṇabhedair yo rūpabhedas tasmāt sarvaṃ navātmakam āhur iti pūrvakriyayā sambandhaḥ| ‘sarvahetuviśeṣaiḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare sarveṣāṃ hetuviśeṣair ity arthaḥ| dvayair iti dvandvaiḥ, sarvais tribhiḥ||1-2||–

ab.seg: udare ‘śothasya upadravatvena’ iti pā.| śothasyopadravatvenoktatvāt tadanantaraṃ śothanidānam| asya samprāptim āha– raktety ādi| svahetubhiḥ svātantryeṇa duṣṭān kupitān raktapittakaphān svahetuduṣṭaḥ kupito vāyur bahiḥsirāḥ bāhyā agambhīrāḥ sirāḥ nītvā gamayitvā taiḥ raktapittakaphaiḥ ruddhagatir āvṛtamārgo vāyur utsedham ucchrāyaṃ kuryād iti yojanā| bahiḥsirāśabdena agambhīratayā uttānasrotasām api grahaṇam| tvaṅmāṃsasaṃśrayam ity anena vraṇaśothād bhedaṃ darśayati, ‘pāṭhato’ iti pā.| pacyato vraṇasya vāstūny aṣṭau, śothasya tvaṅmāṃse, iti bhedaḥ; tad uktam– “tvaṅmāṃsasirāsnāyvasthisandhikoṣṭhamarmāṇīty aṣṭau vraṇavāstūni bhavanti|” iti| aṣṭasu vraṇavāstuṣu vraṇaśothasya sambhavāt| saṃhataṃ saṃhatātmakaṃ, kutaḥ saṃhatātmakam ity āha– nicayāt| ataḥ pūrvoktāt raktasahitadoṣatrayasamudāyāt; etena doṣatrayajanyatvam asyoktam| tasya saṅkhyām āha– sarvam iti pūrveṇa sambadhyate, sarvam utsedhaṃ śopham ity āhur ity arthaḥ| ‘ ... prabhūtakāraṇabhedairyo’ iti pā.| hetuviśeṣair doṣatrayābhighātaprabhṛtikāraṇabhedair yo rūpabhedaḥ tasmān navātmakam āhur iti pūrvakriyayā sambandhaḥ, ‘sarvahetuviśeṣaiḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare sarveṣāṃ śothānāṃ hetuviśeṣair ity arthaḥ| doṣair iti pṛthak tribhir doṣais trayaḥ, ‘militairekadvayaistrayaḥ’ iti pā.| militair dvayais trayaḥ, abhighātenaikaḥ, viṣeṇa caikaḥ||1-2||

div.ab: tat pūrvarūpaṃ davathuḥ sirāyāmo 'ṅgagauravam ||3|| (vā. ni. a. 13) |

ab.seg: pūrvarūpam āha– tad ity ādi| davathur upatāpaḥ| sirāyāmaḥ sirāprasaraṇavat pīḍā||3||
pūrvarūpam āha– tad ity ādi| davathuś cakṣurādiṣu tīvradāhaḥ, yad uktaṃ carake– “davathuś cakṣurādibhyas tīvra ūṣmā pravartate”| sirāyāmaḥ sirāprasāraṇavat pīḍā||3||

div.ab:
śuddhyāmayābhuktakṛśābalānāṃ ‘kṣīrāmla...’ iti pā. | kṣārāmlatīkṣṇoṣṇagurūpasevā |
dadhyāmamṛcchākavirodhiduṣṭagaropasṛṣṭānnaniṣevaṇaṃ ca ||4||
arśāṃsy aceṣṭā na ca dehaśuddhir marmopaghāto viṣamā prasūtiḥ |
mithyopacāraḥ pratikarmaṇāṃ ca nijasya hetuḥ śvayathoḥ pradiṣṭaḥ ||5|| (ca. ci. a. 12) |

ab.seg: pūrvarūpānantaraṃ kāmacārān nidānam āha– śuddhyāmayety ādi| śuddhir vamanavirecanādiḥ, āmayā jvarādayaḥ; abhuktam abhojanaṃ viguṇaṃ ca bhojanaṃ, taiḥ kṛśānām abalānāṃ ca kṣārādisevā nijasya śvayathor hetuḥ| dadhyādayaḥ svatantrā eva hetavaḥ, āmam apakvaṃ, duṣṭaṃ doṣajanakaṃ ‘maṇḍakanavodakādi’ iti pā.| mandakanavodakādi, garaṃ saṃyogajaṃ viṣam| aceṣṭā niṣkriyatvam| na ca dehaśuddhir iti śodhanārhe 'pi doṣe dehāśuddhiḥ| marmopaghāta iha doṣakṛta eva jñeyaḥ, bāhyahetujas tu marmopaghāta āgantuśothahetur eva| viṣamā prasūtir āmagarbhapatanādikā| mithyopacāro 'samyakkaraṇam asamyagupacāraḥ| pratikarmaṇāṃ vamanādīnām||4-5||

atha kāraṇam āha– śuddhīty ādi| śuddhir vamanādiḥ, āmayā jvarādayaḥ, abhuktam abhojanam, etair ye kṛśās tathā abalāś ca, teṣāṃ etacca– kṣīrāmleti pāṭha.| kṣīrādisevanaṃ nijasya śvayathoḥ kāraṇaṃ; ‘dadhyādiṣu’ iti pā.| dadhyādi tu svatantram eva kāraṇam| āmam apakvaṃ, duṣṭaṃ doṣajanakaṃ maṇḍakanavodakādi, garaṃ saṃyogajaṃ viṣam, aceṣṭā niṣkriyatvaṃ, na ca dehaśuddhir iti śodhanārhe 'pi doṣe tatra dehāśuddhiḥ| marmopaghāta iha doṣakṛta eva jñeyaḥ, bāhyahetujaś ca marmopaghāta āgantuśophahetur eva| viṣamā prasūtir iti āmagarbhapatanādikā| pratikarmaṇāṃ vamanādīnāṃ, mithyopacāraḥ asamyagupacāraḥ||4-5||

lg.l: sagauravaṃ syād anavasthitatvaṃ sotsedham ūṣmā'tha sirātanutvam |
salomaharṣaś ca vivarṇatā ca sāmānyaliṅgaṃ śvayathoḥ pradiṣṭam ||6||

ab.seg: sāmānyaliṅgam āha– ‘setyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sety ādi| sagauravam iti anavasthitatvaviśeṣaṇaṃ, tathā sotsedham iti ca||6||
tasya sāmānyalakṣaṇam āha– sagauravam ity ādi| ūṣmasantāpayuktaṃ sirākṛśatvaṃ tāsām alābhāt||6||

div.ab:
calas tanutvak paruṣo 'ruṇo 'sitaḥ suṣuptiharṣārtiyuto 'nimittataḥ |
praśāmyati pronnamati prapīḍito divābalī ca śvayathuḥ samīraṇāt ||7|| (ca. ci. a. 12) |

ab.seg: atha vātaśothalakṣaṇam āha– calety ādi| calaḥ sthānāt sthānāntaragatiḥ, tanutvak ‘abalatvak’ iti pā.| abahalatvak, paruṣaḥ karkaśaḥ, aruṇaḥ raktavarṇaḥ, asitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ, suṣuptiḥ sparśājñānaṃ, harṣo lomaharṣaḥ, atra ‘atiratiḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake upalabhyate | animittataḥ praśāmyatīti vāyoś calatvena ca kadācin nimittaṃ vinā'pi vilīno bhavati, pronnamati prapīḍita iti prapīḍitaḥ sann anantaram unnamatīty arthaḥ| divābalī divābalavān, yad uktaṃ carake– “yaś cāpy aruṇavarṇābhaḥ śopho naktaṃ praśāmyati|” iti||7||

div.ab:
mṛduḥ sagandho 'sitapītarāgavān bhramajvarasvedatṛṣāmadānvitaḥ |
ya uṣyate spaṣṭarug akṣirāgakṛt sa pittaśotho bhṛśadāhapākavān ||8|| (ca. ci. a. 12) |

ab.seg: paittikam āha– mṛdur ity ādi| uṣyate iti dahyate||8||
paittikam āha– mṛdur ity ādi| mṛdusparśaḥ, gandhayuktaḥ, akṣṇo rogakṛt, atiśayadāhapākavān||8||

div.ab:
guruḥ sthiraḥ pāṇḍur arocakānvitaḥ prasekanidrāvamivahnimāndyakṛt |
sa kṛcchrajanmapraśamo nipīḍito na connamed rātribalī kaphātmakaḥ ||9|| (ca. ci. a. 12) |

ab.seg: kaphajam āha– gurur ity ādi| arocakānvita iti arocakavyādhisahacārī| kṛcchrajanmapraśama iti cirotpattivināśaḥ| rātribalīti rātrau sroto 'varodhajena dehakledenāceṣṭayā ca kaphasya vṛddhatvāt tajjaḥ śotho balavān bhavati; divā tu sphuṭasrotasi śarīre saceṣṭe ca na kapho balī bhavati, kiṃ tarhi vāyuḥ, tena tajjaḥ śotho divābalī bhavati||9||

kaphajam āha– gurur ity ādi| sthiraḥ acalaḥ, praseko lālāsrāvaḥ, sa kṛcchrajanmapraśama iti rātrau sroto 'varodhajena dehakledena ceṣṭayā ca kaphasya vṛddhyā tajjaḥ śotho balavān bhavati| divā sphuṭasrotasi śarīre ceṣṭāyukte ca kapho na balī vāyus tena balī, tajjaḥ śotho divābalī bhavati||9||

div.ab:
nidānākṛtisaṃsargāc chvayathuḥ syād dvidoṣajaḥ |
sarvākṛtiḥ sannipātāc chotho vyāmiśralakṣaṇaḥ ||10|| (ca. sū. a. 18) |

ab.seg: vyāmiśrauṣadhavidhānārthaṃ kvāpi kvāpi prakṛtisamasamavetā api śiṣyahitaiṣitayā dvandvasannipātā atideśena ‘gaṇyante’ iti pā.| paṭhyante, ye tu vikṛtiviṣamasamavetās tān kaṇṭharaveṇa ‘paṭhati’ iti pā.| paṭhanti; ato 'tideśena dvandvatrayasannipātān āha– nidānākṛtisaṃsargād ity ādi| vyāmiśralakṣaṇa iti militavātāditrayaliṅgaḥ| anenaiva sarvākṛtir ity asyārthe siddhe tadabhidhānaṃ vātādipratyekaṃ kṛtsnaliṅganiyamārtham||10||
dvandvajatrayasannipātajam āha– nidānety ādi| dvidoṣayor nidānalakṣaṇasaṃsargayoḥ dvidoṣajā jñeyāḥ| sannipātāt sarvākṛtiḥ, vyāmiśralakṣaṇaḥ militavātāditrayaliṅgaḥ||10||

div.ab:
abhighātena śastrādicchedabhedakṣatādibhiḥ |
himānilodadhyanilair bhallātakapikacchujaiḥ ||11||
rasaiḥ śūkaiś ca saṃsparśāc chvayathuḥ syād visarpavān |
bhṛśoṣmā lohitābhāsaḥ prāyaśaḥ pittalakṣaṇaḥ ||12|| (vā. ni. a. 13) |

ab.seg: abhighātajaṃ śvayathum āha– abhighātenety ādi| abhighātena yaḥ śothaḥ sa śastrādibhir bhavati| himānilodadhyanilair iti ‘himānilairudadhyanilaiḥ’ iti pā.| himānilair udadhyanilaiś ca; udadhiḥ samudraḥ| bhallātakapikacchujai rasaiḥ śūkair iti bhallātakarasaiḥ, kapikacchvā śūkaiś ca; kapikacchuḥ śūkaśimbī||11-12||

abhighātajaśotham āha– abhighātenety ādi| ‘śvayathuḥ saśastrādibhiḥ’ iti pā.| sa śvayathuḥ śastrādibhiḥ kṛto bhavati| himānilaḥ śītavāyuḥ, udadhyanilaḥ samudravātaḥ, bhallātakarasaiḥ kapikacchuśūkaiḥ kapikacchuḥ śūkaśimbī, eteṣāṃ sparśāt; prasaraṇaśīlaḥ, bhṛśoṣmā atiśayasantāpakṛt, pittaśvayathulakṣaṇaḥ||11-12||

div.ab:
viṣajaḥ saviṣaprāṇiparisarpaṇamūtraṇāt |
daṃṣṭrādantanakhāghātād aviṣaprāṇinām api ||13||
viṇmūtraśukropahatamalavadvastrasaṅkarāt |
viṣavṛkṣānilasparśād garayogāvacūrṇanāt ||14||
mṛduś calo 'valambī ca śīghro dāharujākaraḥ |15| (vā. ni. a. 13) |

viṣajam āha– ‘viṣajaḥ saviṣaprāṇītyādi’ iti pā.| viṣaja ity ādi| saviṣaprāṇinaḥ sarpādayas teṣāṃ parisarpaṇaṃ bhramaṇaṃ tasmāt, saviṣaprāṇināṃ mūtraṇāc ca| daṃṣṭrādanteti daṃṣṭrā kuṭilā ‘dāḍha’ iti khyātā, tadviparītaś ca danto gobalīvardanyāyāt| viṇmūtraśukropahatamalavadvastrasaṅkarād iti saviṣaprāṇināṃ viṇmūtrādyupahataṃ malavac ca vastraṃ yat tasya saṃsparśāt| avalambī adhogamanaśīlaḥ| śīghraḥ śīghrotpattiḥ| ayaṃ cāgantur api viśiṣṭaliṅgacikitsopayogāt pṛthak paṭhitaḥ||13-14||– ‘viṣe śothalakṣaṇamāha’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: viṣajaśothalakṣaṇam āha– viṣajety ādi| saviṣaprāṇinaḥ saviṣā ye jantavaḥ śatapadīlūtādayaḥ, teṣāṃ śarīropari sarpaṇaṃ ‘mūtraṇam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | mūtraṇaṃ ca dvayam api śvayathor hetuḥ| daṃṣṭrādanteti daṃṣṭrā kuṭilākārā ‘dāḍha’ iti loke, dantā agrebhavāḥ, anye daṃṣṭridantanakheti paṭhanti, tatra daṃṣṭriṇo vyāghrādayaḥ, nakhāḥ prasiddhāḥ| aviṣaprāṇināṃ manuṣyādīnām apy abhighātaḥ śothahetuḥ| viṇmūtrety ādi saviṣaprāṇināṃ viṇmūtrādyupahatamalavadvastrasya saṃsparśāt; anye ‘malavadvastu’ iti paṭhanti, tatra saviṣaprāṇināṃ viṇmūtraśukropahatatvenaitad yan malavadvastu tasya samparkād ity arthaḥ| saviṣā ye vṛkṣās teṣāṃ yo 'nilaḥ, tasya sparśād api| ‘garakṛtrimaviṣam’ iti pā.| garaḥ kṛtrimaviṣaṃ tasyāvacūrṇanāt, tasya śarīrasparśād ity arthaḥ| ‘mṛduḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | mṛduḥ mṛdusparśaḥ, calaḥ sthānāntaragatiḥ, avalambī adhogamanaśīlaḥ, śīghraḥ śīghrotpattiḥ||13-14||

div.ab:
doṣāḥ śvayathum ūrdhvaṃ hi kurvanty āmāśayasthitāḥ ||15||
pakvāśayasthā madhye tu varcaḥsthānagatās tv adhaḥ |
kṛtsnadeham anuprāptāḥ kuryuḥ sarvasaraṃ tathā ||16|| (su. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: yatrasthā doṣā yatra deśe śothaṃ kurvanti tam āha– ‘doṣāḥ śvayathumūrdhvamityādi’ iti pā.| doṣā ity ādi| ūrdhvam iti uraḥprabhṛtyūrdhvadehe| madhya iti uraḥpakvāśayamadhye| adha iti pakvāśayād adhaḥ| sarvasaraṃ sarvaśarīrasaraṇaśīlam||15-16||

yasmin deśe doṣāḥ śophaṃ kurvanti tam āha– doṣā ity ādi| ūrdhvam iti uraḥprabhṛtyūrdhvadehe| madhya iti uraḥpakvāśayamadhye, adha iti pakvāśayād adho varcaḥsthānaṃ purīṣāśayaḥ, sarvaśarīrasaraṇaśīlam||15-16||

lg.l: yo madhyadeśe śvayathuḥ sa kaṣṭaḥ sarvagaś ca yaḥ |
‘adhāṅga’ iti aśuddhaḥ pā. | ardhāṅge riṣṭabhūtaḥ syād yaś cordhvaṃ parisarpati ||17||
śvāsaḥ pipāsā chardiś ca daurbalyaṃ jvara eva ca |
yasya cānne rucir nāsti śvayathuṃ taṃ vivarjayet ||18||

ab.seg:
(su. ci. a. 23) |
ananyopadravakṛtaḥ śothaḥ pādasamutthitaḥ |
puruṣaṃ hanti nārīṃ ca mukhajo guhyajo dvayam |
navo 'nupadravaḥ śothaḥ sādhyo 'sādhyaḥ pureritaḥ ||19||

(vā. ni. a. 13) |
vivarjayet kukṣyudarāśritaṃ ca tathā gale marmaṇi saṃśritaṃ ca |
sthūlaḥ kharaś cāpi bhaved vivarjyo yaś cāpi bālasthavirābalānām ||20||

ataḥ paraṃ kṛcchrādibhedam āha– yo madhyadeśa ity ādi| madhyadehagasya kaṣṭatvaṃ taddeśagaśothaprabhāvāt| sarvaga iti sarvadehagāmī| sarvaja iti pāṭhāntare sarvajaḥ sānnipātikaḥ| riṣṭabhūta iti riṣṭatulyaḥ, bhūtaśabda upamāne; yathā– mātṛbhūtaḥ, pitṛbhūta iti| vyādher evātra riṣṭabhūtatvaṃ, tasya ca nimittakṛtatvāt bhūtaśabda upātta iti kārtikaḥ| anye tu bhūtaśabdaṃ svarūpavacanam āhuḥ| yaś cordhvaṃ parisarpatīti puruṣaviṣayakam etat; cakārāt striyāś ca uparijo yo 'dho yāti sa gṛhyate, tathā guhyajo yaḥ sarvagaḥ| vacanaṃ hi–
“yas tu pādābhinirvṛttaḥ śothaḥ sarvāṅgago bhavet|
puruṣaṃ hanti, nārīṃ ca mukhajo, guhyajo dvayam||” (ca. sū. a. 18) iti| ananyopadravakṛta iti anyasya upadravā anyopadravās tadviparītā ananyopadravāḥ; etenāyam arthaḥ– śothasyaiva ye upadravās taiḥ kṛtaḥ| te ca–
“śvāsaḥ pipāsā daurbalyaṃ jvaraś chardir arocakaḥ|
hikkātīsārakāsāś ca śothinaṃ kṣapayanti hi||” (su. ci. a. 23) iti suśrutoktāḥ| carake 'py uktam–
“chardis tṛṣṇā'ruciḥ śvāso jvaro 'tīsāra eva ca|
saptako 'yaṃ sadaurbalyaḥ śothopadravasaṅgrahaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 18) iti| athavā anyam upadravaṃ karotīti anyopadravakṛn nidānam| nānyopadravakṛd ananyopadravakṛt, tataḥ svanidānāt ‘jātaḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ; tena śothajanakanidānād eva utpanna ity arthaḥ| pāṇḍurogādau tu yaḥ śothaḥ pādasamutthitaḥ so 'nyopadravakṛto nidānāntarāj jātaḥ sādhya eva| ‘ānanopadravagata’ iti pāṭhāntare ayam arthaḥ– pādayor utthitaḥ pūrvaṃ paścād ānanam upadraveṇa prasāreṇa upadravatvena vā gataḥ| tathā ca tantrāntaram–
“ ‘pādapravṛttaśvayathurnṛṇām’ iti pā.| pādapravṛttaḥ śvayathur nṛṇāṃ yaḥ prāpnuyān mukham|
strīṇāṃ vaktrād adho yāti, bastijaś ca na sidhyati||” iti| ‘kṣīrapāṇinā ... ’ iti pā.| kṣārapāṇinā'py uktam–
“ūrdhvagāmī naraṃ padbhyām adhogāmī mukhāt striyam|
ubhayaṃ bastisañjātaḥ śotho hanti na saṃśayaḥ||” iti| guhyaja iti bastijātaḥ| dvayam iti naraṃ nārīṃ ca| asādhyaḥ purerita iti “ardhāṅge riṣṭabhūta” ity ādinā||17-20||

ataḥ sthānāśrayatve kṛcchrādibhedam āha– ya ity ādi| madhyagaśvayathoḥ kaṣṭasādhyatvaṃ taddeśaprabhāvāt| sarvaga iti sarvadehagāmī, ‘sarvaja’ iti ‘pāṭhāntare’ iti pā.| pāṭhāntaraṃ, tatra sānnipātikaḥ| riṣṭabhūta iti riṣṭatulyaḥ; bhūtaśabdo hy upamāne, yathā mātṛbhūtaḥ pitṛbhūta iti| yaś cordhvaṃ parisarpatīti puruṣaviṣayam etat, cakārāt striyāś coparijo yo 'dho yāti sa gṛhyate, tathā guhyajo yaḥ sa sarvagaḥ| upadravaviśeṣasyāsādhyatvam āha– śvāsa iti| yasyaitāni santi śvayathau sati, taṃ parivarjayet| sthānabhedenāsādhyatvam āha– ananyety ādi| na anyopadravāḥ ananyopadravāḥ śophasyopadravās taiḥ kṛtaḥ, te ca suśrutoktāḥ–
“śvāsaḥ pipāsā daurbalyaṃ jvaraś chardir arocakaḥ|
hikkātīsārakāsāś ca śothinaṃ kṣapayanti hi|” iti| carake 'py uktam–
“chardiḥ śvāso 'rucis tṛṣṇā jvaro 'tīsāra eva ca|
‘saptakopam’ iti pā.| saptako 'yaṃ sadaurbalyaḥ śothopadravasaṅgraha||” iti| athavā anyam upadravaṃ karotīti anyopadravakṛt nidānaṃ, na anyopadravakṛt ananyopadravakṛt, tato nidānāj jāta ity anena śophajanakanidānād evotpanna ity arthaḥ| pāṇḍurogādau tu yaḥ śophaḥ so 'nyopadravakṛto nidānāj jātaḥ sādhya eva| pādasamutthitaḥ puruṣaṃ hanti nārīṃ tu mukhajo hanti, guhyajo bastisañjātaḥ, atra ‘sarpan’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| dvayam iti naraṃ nārīṃ ca| yad uktaṃ tantrāntare–
“pādapravṛttaḥ śvayathur nṛṇāṃ yaḥ prāpnuyān mukham|
vakrād adhastād yo yāti bastijaś ca na siddhyati|” kṣīrapāṇinā'py uktam–
“ūrdhvagāmī naraṃ padbhyām adhogāmī mukhāt striyam|
ubhayor bastisañjātaḥ śotho hanti na saṃśayaḥ||” ‘iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| sādhyāsādhyalakṣaṇam āha– nava iti| navo navotthānaḥ, upadravarahitaḥ, upadravāḥ pūrvoktāḥ śvāsādayaḥ, tair muktaḥ sa sādhyaḥ, asādhyaḥ ‘pūrverita ūrdhvāṅge iti bhūtaḥ’ iti pā.| pūrvairita ūrdhvāṅge riṣṭabhūtaḥ||17-20||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne śothanidānaṃ samāptam ||36||
iti ‘śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyām’ iti pā.| śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ śothanidānaṃ samāptam||36||
ity ātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ śothanidānam||36||

div.head: vṛddhinidānam
div.ab:
atha vṛddhinidānam |
kruddho 'nūrdhvagatir vāyuḥ śothaśūlakaraś caran |
muṣkau vaṅkṣaṇataḥ prāpya phalakoṣābhivāhinīḥ ||1||
prapīḍya dhamanīr vṛddhiṃ karoti phalakoṣayoḥ |
doṣāsramedomūtrāntraiḥ sa vṛddhiḥ saptadhā gadaḥ ||2||
mūtrāntrajāv apy anilād dhetubhedas tu kevalam |3| (vā. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg: śothatvasāmānyāt śothānantaraṃ vṛddhir abhidhīyate| vṛddheḥ samprāptim āha– kruddho 'nūrdhvagatir vāyur ity ādi| anūrdhvagatir adhogatir vāyuḥ muṣkau prāpya caran gacchan vaṅkṣaṇato meḍhrorusandherityarthaḥ| meḍhrajaṅghāsandheḥ sakāśāt; phalakoṣābhivāhinīr iti phalaṃ ca koṣaś ca phalakoṣau, athavā phalayoḥ koṣau, tadvahā dhamanīś ca prapīḍya sandūṣya, vṛddhiṃ karoti| phalakoṣayor iti dvivacanam upalakṣaṇaṃ, tenaikakoṣe 'pi dṛśyamānā vṛddhiḥ saṅgatā| sa vṛddhir iti “kticktau ca sañjñāyām” ity anena ktijanto vṛddhiśabdaḥ puṃliṅgaḥ, ktinnantas tu strīliṅgaḥ| vṛddhiḥ kuraṇḍo 'bhidhīyate| saṅkhyeyanirdeśād eva saṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāṃ saptadheti vacanaṃ nyūnādhikasaṅkhyānirāsārthaṃ, tena dvandvajādivṛddher adhikāyā nirāsaḥ, asambhavas tu tasyā vyādhisvabhāvāt; mūtrāntravṛddhyor vātavṛddhyantarbhāvāt nyūnasaṅkhyānirāsārtham anayor vātajatve 'pi nimittacikitsābhedāt pṛthag abhidhānaṃ, nimittabhedanibandhana eva vyādhibhedaḥ| yad uktam– “doṣadūṣyasaṃsargād āyatanaviśeṣān nimittataś caiṣāṃ vyādhīnāṃ bhedaḥ|” (su. sū. a. 24) iti| ata āha– mūtrāntrajāv apy anilād dhetubhedas tu kevalam iti||1-2||

śothādhikārāt vṛddhir abhidhīyate| vṛddheḥ samprāptim āha– kruddha ity ādi| anūrdhvagatir vāyuḥ adhogatirvāto muṣkau prāpya caran gacchan, vaṅkṣaṇato meḍhrajaṅghāsandheḥ sakāśāt, phalakoṣābhivāhinīr iti phalaṃ ca kośaś ca phalakośau, athavā phalayoḥ kośau phalakośau, tadvahā dhamanīḥ prapīḍya sandūṣya vṛddhiṃ karoti, phalakoṣayor iti dvivacanam upalakṣaṇaṃ, tenaikaphalakoṣe 'pi dṛśyamānā vṛddhiḥ sammatā| vṛddhiḥ ‘kuraṇḍa’ iti loke| vṛddheḥ saṅkhyām āha– doṣety ādi| doṣatrayais trayaḥ, raktenaikaḥ, medasā caikaḥ, mūtreṇaikaḥ, evaṃ ‘sapta saṅkhyeyaiva nirdeśādeva’ iti pā.| sapta| saṅkhyeyanirdeśād eva saṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāṃ punaḥ saptadheti vacanaṃ nyūnādhikasaṅkhyānirāsārthaṃ, dvandvajāyā api vṛddher nirāsaḥ, dvandvajāyās tv asambhavo vyādhisvabhāvāt; mūtrāntravṛddhyor vātavṛddhyantarbhāvāt nyūnasaṅkhyānirāsaḥ, anayor vātajatve 'pi nidānacikitsābhedāt pṛthag abhidhānaṃ, nidānabhedanibandhana eva vyādhibhedaḥ| uktaṃ ca– “doṣadūṣyasaṃsargād āyatanaviśeṣān nimittataś caiṣāṃ vyādhīnāṃ bhedaḥ” iti| ata eva mūtrāntrajāv api vātāt, tatra hetubhedata eva bhedaḥ kevala iti| vṛddhiśabdaḥ pulliṅgo vā||1-2||

div.ab:
vātapūrṇadṛtisparśo rūkṣo vātād aheturuk ||3||
pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaḥ pittād dāhoṣmapākavān
kaphāc chīto guruḥ snigdhaḥ kaṇḍūmān kaṭhino 'lparuk ||4||
kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtaḥ pittavṛddhiliṅgaś ca raktajaḥ |
kaphavanmedasā vṛddhir mṛdus tālaphalopamaḥ ||5||
mūtradhāraṇaśīlasya mūtrajaḥ sa tu gacchataḥ |
ambhobhiḥ pūrṇadṛtivat kṣobhaṃ yāti saruṅ mṛduḥ ||6||
mūtrakṛcchram adhaḥ syāc ca cālayan phalakoṣayoḥ |7| (vā. ni. a. 11) |

vātajādīnāṃ mūtrajāntānāṃ vṛddhīnāṃ krameṇa lakṣaṇāny āha– vātety ādi| aheturug iti animittato dāhādiruk| raktaje ‘kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛta’ iti pittajavṛddhiliṅgād adhikaṃ; tena hetuliṅgacikitsābhedād raktajavṛddhiḥ pṛthag gaṇyate| medoje tālaphalopama iti pakvatālaphalam iva nīlavartulaḥ| mūtraje mūtrakṛcchram iti mūtrakṛcchravat vedanā| cālayan phalakoṣayor iti phalakoṣayoś cālayan calo bhavann itastato gacchan so 'dhaḥ syāt| cālayann iti svārthiko ṇic||3-6||–

vātajam āha– vātety ādi| dṛtiś carmakhalliḥ| animittato bhedatodādiruk| pittajam āha– pakvety ādi| pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaḥ pakvodumbaraphalābhaḥ, tathā dāhādiyuktaḥ| kaphavṛddhim āha– kaphād ity ādi| kaphād vṛddhiḥ śītaḥ śītasparśaḥ, tathā guruḥ snigdhaḥ kaṇḍūmān kaṭhino 'śmavat, alparuk mandavedanaḥ| raktajam āha– raktety ādi| raktajo vṛddhiḥ, atra tu kṛṣṇasphoṭaiś citaḥ pittavṛddhiliṅgaiś ca pakvodumbarasaṅkāśādibhir yuto bhavet| atra tu kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛta iti pittavṛddhiliṅgād adhikaṃ, tena hetubhedacikitsābhedād raktajo vṛddhiḥ pṛthag gaṇyate| medojam āha– ‘ ... lakṣaṇaḥ’ iti pā.| kaphavat kaphavṛddhilakṣaṇaṃ tālaphalopama iti pakvatālavan nīlavartulaḥ| mūtrajam āha– mūtrety ādi| mūtradhāraṇaśīlasya mūtrajo bhavati, gacchataḥ puṃsaḥ jalapūrṇadṛtivat kṣobhaṃ yāti pūrito bhavati, saruk savyathaḥ, mṛduḥ mṛdusparśaḥ| mūtrakṛcchram iti mūtrakṛcchravedanaḥ| phalakośayor iti phalakośayoś cālayan calo bhavann itastato gacchan so 'dhaḥ syāt| cālayann iti svārthiko ṇic| ‘valayaṃ phalakośayoḥ’ iti pāṭhe phalakośayor adhastād valayaṃ kaṅkaṇaṃ syāt||3-6||–

vātakopibhir āhāraiḥ śītatoyāvagāhanaiḥ ||7||
dhāraṇeraṇabhārādhvaviṣamāṅgapravartanaiḥ |
kṣobhaṇaiḥ kṣobhito 'nyaiś ca kṣudrāntrāvayavaṃ yadā ||8||
pavano viguṇīkṛtya svaniveśād adho nayet |
kuryād vaṅkṣaṇasandhistho granthyābhaṃ śvayathuṃ tadā ||9||
upekṣyamāṇasya ca muṣkavṛddhim ādhmānarukstambhavatīṃ sa vāyuḥ |
‘pīḍito ... ’ iti pā. | prapīḍito 'ntaḥsvanavān prayāti pradhmāpayann eti punaś ca muktaḥ ||10|| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate
yasyāntrāvayavāśleṣān muṣkayor vātasambhavāt |
antravṛddhir asādhyo 'yaṃ vātavṛddhisamākṛtiḥ ||11|| (vā. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg:
antravṛddhim āha– vātakopibhir ity ādi| dhāraṇaṃ vegasyopasthitasya, īraṇam aprāptasya| kṣobhaṇaiḥ kṣubhito 'nyair iti balavadvigrahadhanurākarṣaṇādibhiḥ| kṣudrāntrāvayavam iti bṛhadantravyudāsārtham| viguṇīkṛtyeti saṅkucīkṛtya| dviguṇīkṛtyeti pāṭhāntare saṅkocena dviguṇīkṛtya| svaniveśāt svasthānāt| tadā vaṅkṣaṇasandhisthaḥ san vaṅkṣaṇasandhau granthirūpaṃ sādhyaṃ śvayathuṃ karoti, tatra granthirūpeṇa sthitvā kālāntareṇa phalakoṣaṃ gacchatīti| tāṃ muṣkavṛddhim ādhmānarukstambhavatīm upekṣyamāṇasya ‘acikitsitaḥ puruṣasya’ iti pā.| acikitsitapuruṣasya| atra bhojaḥ–
“antraṃ dviguṇam ādāya jantor nayati vaṅkṣaṇam|
vaṅkṣaṇāt tadrujāyuktaṃ phalakoṣaṃ prapadyate||” iti| pradhmāpayann iti ucchūnayan| asādhyo 'yam iti kathaṃ? yato 'sya cikitsā'bhihitā; naivam, aprāptaphalakoṣāyām ayaṃ cikitsāvidhiḥ; prāptaphalakoṣā tv asādhyā; yāpyāyāṃ vā tasyāṃ cikitsāvidhiḥ| yad uktaṃ bhoje– “yāpyāṃ tām antrajāṃ viduḥ|” iti| bradhnanidānaṃ tu tantrāntare paṭhyate| tad yathā–
“atyabhiṣyandigurvannasevanān nicayaṃ gataḥ|
karoti granthivac chothaṃ doṣo vaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu|| jvaraśūlāṅgasādāḍhyaṃ taṃ bradhnam iti nirdiśet||” iti||7-10||

antravṛddhim āha– vātety ādi| vātakopibhir āhārai rūkṣatiktakaṣāyādibhir āsevitais tathā śītatoyāvagāhanais tathā dhāraṇeraṇabhārādibhir anyaiś ca kṣobhaṇaiḥ kṣobhitaḥ kupitaḥ pavano vāyur yadā yasmin kāle kṣudrāntrāvayavaṃ (mūtraśakṛdgātraikadeśaṃ?) svaniveśāt svasthānāt, dviguṇīkṛtyā'dho nayed iti piṇḍārthaḥ| kvacitpustake agrimapaṅktiḥ ekapaṅktipaścāt upalabhyate | anye viguṇīkṛtyeti paṭhanti| dhāraṇam upasthitavegasya atra ‘iti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.|, īraṇam aprāptavegasya, kṣobhaṇaiḥ pūrvoktaiḥ, anyair iti balavadvigrahaiḥ dhanurākarṣaṇādibhiḥ, viṣamāṅgapravartanaiḥ viṣamatvena śarīramoṭanaiḥ| kvacitpustake ‘anye viguṇīkṛtyeti paṭhanti|’ iti paṅktiḥ atra upalabhyate | pavano vaṅkṣaṇasandhisthaḥ san, vaṅkṣaṇasandhau granthirūpamasādhyaṃ śvayathuṃ karoti| tatra granthirūpeṇa sthitvā kālāntareṇa phalakośaṃ gacchati| tāṃ muṣkavṛddhim ādhmānarukstambhavatīṃ tadopekṣamāṇasyācikitsataḥ puruṣasya| yad āha bhojaḥ–
“antraṃ dviguṇam ādāya jantor nayati vaṅkṣaṇam|
vaṅkṣaṇāt tadrujāyuktaṃ phalakośaṃ prapadyate||” iti| sa ca śvayathuḥ kareṇa pīḍitaḥ saśabdaṃ prayāti, muktaḥ sann ādhmāpayan pūrayan punar āyāti| asādhyam āha– yasyety ādi| āśleṣāt saṃyogāt, vātasañcayāt muṣkayor antravṛddhir bhavati| ayam asādhyaḥ, kathaṃ tarhi cikitsā? aprāptaphalakośayoś cikitsāvidhiḥ, prāptaphalakoṣā tv asādhyā| yāpyāyāṃ ‘vā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vā cikitsāvidhiḥ| yad uktaṃ bhoje– ‘yāpyāṃ tām antrajāṃ viduḥ’ iti| bradhnanidānaṃ tu tantrāntare paṭhyate, tad yathā–
“atyabhiṣyandigurvannasevanān nicayaṃ gataḥ|
karoti granthivac chothaṃ doṣo vaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu|
jvaraśūlāgnisādāḍhyaṃ taṃ bradhnam iti nirdiśet||” iti||7-10||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne vṛddhinidānaṃ samāptam ||37||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ vṛddhinidānaṃ samāptam||37||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyakṛtāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ vṛddhinidānam||37||

div.head: galagaṇḍagaṇḍamālāpacīgranthyarbudanidānam
div.ab:
atha galagaṇḍa-gaṇḍamālāpacī-granthyarbudanidānam |
nibaddhaḥ śvayathur yasya muṣkaval lambate gale |
mahān vā yadi vā hrasvo galagaṇḍaṃ tam ādiśet ||1|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg:
vṛddhiyuktamuṣkasamānaliṅgatvāt tadanantaraṃ galagaṇḍanidānam| tasya sāmānyaliṅgam āha– nibaddhaḥ śvayathur ity ādi| nibaddho 'nubandhavān| muṣkavad aṇḍavat| bhoje 'py uktam–
“mahāntaṃ śotham alpaṃ vā hanumanyāgalāśrayam|
lambantaṃ muṣkavad dṛṣṭvā galagaṇḍaṃ vinirdiśet||” iti||1||

vṛddhiyuktamuṣkasādharmyāt tadanantaraṃ galagaṇḍanidānam| tasya sāmānyaliṅgam āha– nibaddha ity ādi| nibaddho 'nubandhavān, muṣkavat aṇḍavat| yad uktaṃ bhojena–
“mahāntaṃ śotham alpaṃ vā hanumanyāgalāśrayam|
lambantaṃ muṣkavad dṛṣṭvā galagaṇḍaṃ vinirdiśet||” iti||1||

div.ab:
vātaḥ kaphaś cāpi gale praduṣṭo manye ca saṃśritya tathaiva medaḥ |
kurvanti gaṇḍaṃ kramaśaḥ svaliṅgaiḥ samanvitaṃ taṃ galagaṇḍam āhuḥ ||2|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg:
tasya samprāptim āha– vāta ity ādi| vātakaphamedāṃsi pṛthak galagaṇḍakāraṇāni, tena traya eva galagaṇḍāḥ; paittikas tu na bhavaty eva, vyādhisvabhāvāt; cāturthakajvaravat| cāturthake hi vacanam–
“cāturthako darśayati prabhāvaṃ dvividhaṃ jvaraḥ|
jaṅghābhyāṃ ślaiṣmikaḥ pūrvaṃ śirasto 'nilasambhavaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| kramaśa ity anena śanair eva vardhanaṃ darśayati| svaliṅgaiḥ samanvitam iti “nibaddhaḥ śvayathuḥ” ity ādinā uktagalagaṇḍaliṅgair anvitam||2||

tasya samprāptim āha– vāta ity ādi| vātakaphamedāṃsi pṛthag galagaṇḍakāraṇāni, tena traya eva galagaṇḍāḥ paittikas tu na bhavaty eva, vyādhisvabhāvāt| manye ubhe ‘kaṇṭhasandhī’ iti pā.| kaṇṭhasandhau| kramaśa iti śanair vṛddhir darśitā| svaliṅgaiḥ ‘samanvitamiti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | samanvitam iti vātakaphamedolakṣaṇaiḥ samanvitam iti||2||

div.ab:
todānvitaḥ kṛṣṇasirāvanaddhaḥ śyāvo 'ruṇo vā pavanātmakas tu |
pāruṣyayuktaś ciravṛddhyapāko yadṛcchayā pākam iyāt kadācit ||3||
kvacitpustake agrimapaṅktiḥ ekaślokapūrvaṃ upalabhyate vairasyam āsyasya ca tasya jantor bhavet tathā tālugalapraśoṣaḥ |4| (su. ni. a. 11) |

vātajam āha– todānvite ity ādi| ciravṛddhir iti vikāraprabhāvāt vātajo 'pi cireṇa vardhate| yadṛcchayā pākam iyād iti kāraṇāpratiniyamena kadācit pākaṃ yāti, kāraṇāpratiniyamaś ca bāhyo 'bhipretaḥ, ābhyantaras tu pākakāraṇaṃ pittaṃ raktaṃ ca niyatam eva| kadācid iti na sarvakālam| “yadṛcchayā caiva bhavet kadācit” iti pāṭhāntare ‘pāka’ iti śeṣaḥ||3||–

vātikam āha– todānvita ity ādi| todaḥ pīḍāviśeṣaḥ, kṛṣṇasirāvṛtaḥ, pāruṣyayuktaḥ sparśanakarkaśaḥ| ciravṛddhir iti vyādhiprabhāvāt vātajo 'pi cireṇa vardhate| kāraṇāpratiniyamena kadācit pākaṃ gacchati| kāraṇāpratiniyamaś ca bāhyo 'bhimataḥ, ‘ābhyantaraśca’ iti pā.| ābhyantaraṃ tu pākakāraṇaṃ pittaṃ raktaṃ ca niyatam eva| kadācid iti na sarvakālam| ‘yadṛcchayā ‘caiṣa’ iti pā.| caiva bhavet’ iti pāṭhāntaram| tatra ‘pāka’ iti śeṣaḥ||3||–

sthiraḥ savarṇo gurur ugrakaṇḍūḥ śīto mahāṃś cāpi kaphātmakas tu ||4||
cirābhivṛddhiṃ bhajate cirād vā prapacyate mandarujaḥ kadācit |
mādhuryam āsyasya ca tasya jantor bhavet tathā tālugalapralepaḥ ||5|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg: śleṣmajam āha– sthira ity ādi| savarṇa iti prakṛtisamavarṇaḥ||4-5||

ślaiṣmikam āha– sthira ity ādi| sthiro niścalaḥ, ‘savarṇaṃ prakṛtiḥ samavarṇaḥ’ iti pā.| savarṇaḥ prakṛtivarṇaḥ, mahān sthūlaḥ| mandaruja ity ādi kadācid yadā prapacyate tadā mandaruja eva prapacyate, pākakāle pīḍā na bhavatīty arthaḥ| pralepa iti śleṣmaṇā lipta iva||4-5||

div.ab:
snigdho guruḥ pāṇḍur aniṣṭagandho medobhavaḥ kaṇḍuyuto 'lparuk ca |
pralambate 'lābuvad alpamūlo dehānurūpakṣayavṛddhiyuktaḥ ||6||
snigdhāsyatā tasya bhavec ca jantor gale 'nuśabdaṃ kurute ca nityam |7| (su. ni. a. 11) |
medojam āha– snigdha ity ādi| dehānurūpakṣayavṛddhiyukta iti dehakṣaye kṣayaṃ, dehavṛddhau ca vṛddhiṃ yātīty arthaḥ| gale 'nuśabdam iti anunādaṃ karoti| ‘gale tu śabdam’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ sugamam||6||–

medojam āha– snigdha ity ādi| ‘aniṣṭagandhī’ iti pā.| aniṣṭagandho, alābuvat tumbīphalavat, alpamūlas tanumūlaḥ| dehānurūpakṣayavṛddhiḥ– dehakṣaye kṣayaṃ kārśyaṃ, dehavṛddhau vṛddhiṃ, yātīty arthaḥ| gale 'nuśabdam iti anunādaṃ pratiśabdaṃ karoti; “galena śabdam” iti pāṭhāntaraṃ sugamam||6||–

kṛcchrāc chvasantaṃ mṛdusarvagātraṃ saṃvatsarātītam arocakārtam ||7||
kṣīṇaṃ ca vaidyo galagaṇḍayuktaṃ bhinnasvaraṃ cāpi vivarjayec ca |8| (su. ni. a. 11) |
asādhyatām āha– kṛcchrāc chvasantam ity ādi| kṛcchrāc chvasantaṃ duḥkhena śvāsavimokṣakāriṇam| bhinnasvaraṃ svarabhedavantam||7||–
asādhyam āha– kṛcchrād ity ādi| duḥkhena śvāsavimokṣakārakaṃ, mṛdusarvagātraṃ śithilasarvagātram, atikrāntavatsaraṃ, bhinnasvaraṃ svarabhedavantam||7||–

karkandhukolāmalakapramāṇaiḥ kakṣāṃsamanyāgalavaṅkṣaṇeṣu ||8||
medaḥkaphābhyāṃ ciramandapākaiḥ syād gaṇḍamālā bahubhiś ca gaṇḍaiḥ |9| (su. ni. a. 11) |

sthānatulyatayā gaṇḍamālām ihaivāha– karkandhukolāmalakapramāṇair ity ādi| karkandhuḥ śṛgālakoliḥ, kolaṃ bṛhadbadaram| medaḥkaphābhyām iti medo dūṣyaṃ, kapho doṣo 'trārambhakaḥ, medaḥkaphau prādhānyenoktau; tena vātapittasambandho 'py atra draṣṭavyaḥ| yad āha bhojaḥ–
“vātapittakaphā vṛddhā medaś cāpi samācitam|
jaṅghayoḥ kaṇḍarāḥ prāpya matsyāṇḍasadṛśān bahūn||
kurvanti ‘granthayastebhyaḥ’ iti pā.| granthitāṃs tebhyaḥ punaḥ prakupito 'nilaḥ|
tān doṣān ūrdhvago vakṣaḥkakṣamanyāgalāśritaḥ||
nānāprakārān kurute granthīn sā tv apacī matā|
‘apacīkaṇṭhamanyāsu kakṣavaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu||’ iti pā.| tāṃ tu mālākṛtiṃ vidyāt kaṇṭhahṛddhanusandhiṣu|| gaṇḍamālāṃ vijānīyād apacītulyalakṣaṇām|” iti| syād gaṇḍamāleti mālātulyagaṇḍayogāt gaṇḍamālā| galamātra eva gaṇḍamālā carake paṭhitā| yathā– “medaḥkaphāc choṇitasañcayottho galasya madhye galagaṇḍa ekaḥ syād gaṇḍamālā bahubhiś ca gaṇḍaiḥ” (ca. ci. a. 12) iti||8||–

sthānatulyatayā ‘galagaṇḍamālāmihaivāha’ iti pā.| gaṇḍamālām ihaivāha– karkandhv ity ādi| karkandhur laghubadaraṃ, kolaṃ bṛhadbadaram| aṃsau bāhumūle, manyā ‘śirodhiḥ’ iti pā.| śirodhaḥ, vaṅkṣaṇaṃ jānūrusandhiḥ| medaḥkaphābhyām ity ādi| medo dūṣyaṃ, kapho doṣo 'trārambhakaḥ, medaḥkaphau ca prādhānyenoktau, tena ‘vātapittasañcayo'pyevam’ iti pā.| vātapittasañcayo 'py atra draṣṭavyaḥ| yad āha bhojaḥ–
“vātapittakaphā vṛddhā medaś cāpi samācitam|
jaṅghayoḥ kaṇḍarāḥ prāpya matsyāṇḍasadṛśān bahūn||
kurvanti granthitāṃs tebhyaḥ punaḥ prakupito 'nilaḥ|
tān doṣān ūrdhvago vakṣaḥkakṣamanyāgalāśritaḥ|
nānāprakārān kurute granthīn sā tv apacī matā|
vyāmiśradoṣasañjātā kṛcchrasādhyā prakīrtitā||
tāsāṃ vātottarā rūkṣā vātavedanayā'nvitā|
kṣiprapākasamutthānā dāhayuktā ca paittikī|| gūḍhapākā ca kaṭhinā kaphāt snigdhā'lparukkarā| medovikārā ślaiṣmikī ca viśeṣād atimārdavā||
apacī kaṇṭhamanyāsu kakṣavaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu|
tāṃ tu mālākṛtisamāṃ kaṇṭhahṛddantasandhiṣu|
kaṇṭhamālāṃ vijānīyād apacītulyalakṣaṇam||” iti| syād gaṇḍamāleti mālātulyagaṇḍāśrayā gaṇḍamālā| galamātra eva carake gaṇḍamālā paṭhitā, yathā– “medaḥkaphāc choṇitasañcayottho galasya ‘manye’ iti pā.| pārśve galagaṇḍa ekaḥ| syād gaṇḍamālā bahubhiś ca gaṇḍaiḥ” iti||8||–

lg.l: te granthayaḥ kecid avāptapākāḥ sravanti naśyanti bhavanti cānye ||9||
kālānubandhaṃ ciram ādadhāti saivāpacīti pravadanti tajjñāḥ |

ab.seg:
gaṇḍamālātulyatayā apacīm āha– te granthaya ity ādi| te iti gaṇḍamālārambhakadoṣadūṣyakṛtā ye granthayas ta evety arthaḥ| kālānubandhaṃ ciram iti carakalānubandham| saivāpacīti tādṛśī ‘analparūpā’ iti pā.| amālārūpā apacī bhaṇyate| saivāpacīti itiśabdenābhihitatvāt pravadantīti kriyāyoge 'pi na dvitīyā| apacīniruktiś cāparāparopacīyamānatayā| ata eva “cayaprakarṣād apacīṃ vadanti|” (su. ni. a. 11) iti suśrutaḥ| cayaprakarṣaś cāparāparabhavanenaiva, sādhutvaṃ ca nairuktyena vidhinā| yad uktam–
“varṇāgamo varṇaviparyayaś ca dvau cāparau varṇavikāranāśau|
dhātos tadarthātiśayena yogas tad ucyate pañcavidhaṃ niruktam||” iti| ata evoktam– naśyanti bhavanti cānya iti| sādhyāḥ smṛtā iti chedaḥ| pīnasādibhir upadravair asādhyāḥ| ayaṃ tu granthiḥ carake gaṇḍamālāyām asti; saṅgrahakāreṇa tu gaṇḍamālayā saha tulyatvād apacyā apacyām eva granthiḥ paṭhitaḥ||9-10||

gaṇḍamālātulyatayā'pacīm āha– ta ity ādi| gaṇḍamālārambhakadoṣadūṣyakṛtā ye granthayas ta evety arthaḥ| avāptapākāḥ labdhapākāḥ, kālānubandham iti carakalasambandham| saivāpacīti tādṛśī āmalakarūpā apacī bhaṇyate| saivāpacīti– itiśabdenābhihitatvāt pravadantīty ādikriyāyoge 'pi na dvitīyā| tasya sādhyatvam āha– sādhyety ādi| sādhyāḥ smṛtā iti pūrvagranthena sambandhaḥ, ‘sravanti naśyanti atra ‘bhavanti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhavanti cānye’ ity ādipīnasādibhir upadravair yutā asādhyāḥ||9-10||

div.ab:
vātādayo māṃsam asṛk praduṣṭāḥ sandūṣya medaś ca tathā sirāś ca |
vṛttonnataṃ vigrathitaṃ ca śothaṃ kurvanty ato granthir iti pradiṣṭaḥ ||11|| (su. ni. a. 11) | ‘ ... gaṇḍakatulyatayā’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: anantaram apacīguḍakatulyatayā granthim āha– vātādaya ity ādi| vātapittakaphāḥ pratyekaṃ duṣṭāḥ; duṣṭiś cātra vṛddhir eva na kṣayaḥ, kṣīṇānāṃ vikārakaraṇākṣamatvāt| yady evaṃ tarhi kathaṃ vātādikṣaye mandaceṣṭādayaḥ? ucyate– tatkṣaye virodhidoṣakopāt; yathā– madhurasnigdhādibhir vāte kṣīṇe tatsamānatvāt śleṣmā prakupyati| vacanaṃ hi– “vṛddhiś cāpi virodhinām|” iti| sandūṣya medaś ca māṃsam asṛk sirāś cety anena medojaḥ kaphasambandhād yo bhavati tathā sirājo 'pi vāyunā sirāduṣṭyā yo janyate sa ucyate| evaṃ pañca granthayaḥ| tatheti sandūṣya| māṃsam asṛg iti atrāsṛjaḥ kramollaṅghanena pāṭho 'prādhānyapratipādanārthaḥ, visarpe tu śoṇitam eva pradhānam| ata eva kvacit cakāram aprādhānyasūcakaṃ niveśya ‘asṛk ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ| carake tu granthiḥ vātakaphaja eva granthivisarpaśabdenoktaḥ| vṛttonnatam iti vṛttaṃ vartulam, unnatam ucchūnam| vigrathitaṃ kaṭhinaṃ, ‘karkaśam’ iti pā.| kakakhaṭaṃ vā; vigrathitatvād eva granthir iti sañjñā||11||

apacīgaṇḍakarūpatayā granthikām āha– vātādayety ādi| vātādayo vātapittakaphāḥ, pratyekaṃ duṣṭāḥ māṃsam asṛk sandūṣya śophaṃ kurvantīti sambandhaḥ| etena trayo granthaya uktāḥ, duṣṭiś cātra vṛddhir eva, na kṣayaḥ, kṣīṇānāṃ vikārakaraṇākṣamatvāt, sandūṣya medaś ca tathā sirāś cety anena medojaḥ sirājaś caivaṃ dvau, sandūṣya māṃsam asṛg ity atrāsṛjaḥ kramollaṅghanena pāṭho 'prādhānyapratipādanārthaṃ, vṛttaṃ vartulam, unnataṃ ucchūnaṃ, vigrathitaṃ vicchidya grathitam, ato vigrathitatvād eva granthisañjñā||11||

div.ab:
āyamyate vṛścyati tudyate ca pratyasyate mathyati bhidyate ca |
kṛṣṇo mṛdur bastir ivātataś ca bhinnaḥ sravec cānilajo 'sram accham ||12|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg: anilagranthim āha– āyamyata ity ādi| āyamyate ākṛṣya dīrghīkriyate| vṛścyatīti chinattīva, atra divāder ākṛtigaṇatvāt ‘śyan’ pratyayaḥ| pratyasyate kṣipyate| mathyati āloḍayatīva, atrāpi pūrvavat samādhānam| bhidyate vidīryata iva| asraṃ srāvam||12||
vātikam āha– āyamyata ity ādi| ākṛṣya dīrghīkriyata iva, vṛścyati chinattīva, tudyate śūleneva, pratyasyate kṣipyate, mathyati āloḍayatīva, bhidyate vidāryata iva||12||

div.ab:
dandahyate dhūpyati vṛścyate ca pāpacyate prajvalatīva cāpi |
raktaḥ sapīto 'py athavā'pi pittād bhinnaḥ sraved uṣṇam atīva cāsram ||13|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg: pittagranthim āha– dandahyata ity ādi| dandahyate atyarthaṃ dahyate agnineva| pāpacyate bhṛśaṃ pacyata iva kṣāreṇa, kiṃ vā utkvathyata iva| prajvalatīva jvalan bhasmībhavatīva||13||

paittikam āha– dandahyata ity ādi| agninā ‘atyarthaṃ dahyata iva’ iti pā.| dahyata eva, dhūpyati dhūmāyata iva, ‘vṛścyate’ ityatra ‘cūṣyate’ iti pā.| cūṣyate śṛṅgeṇeva, pāpacyate bhṛśaṃ pacyata iva kṣāreṇa, ‘kiñca’ iti pā.| kiṃ vā utkvathyata iva| jvalatīva jvalaneneva bhasmībhavati, varṇena raktaḥ athavā pītaḥ, bhinnaḥ san atīvātiśayena etacca– ‘bhinnaḥ sravedduṣṭamatīva cāsram’ iti pā.| duṣṭaṃ raktaṃ sravati||13||

div.ab:
śīto 'vivarṇo 'lparujo 'tikaṇḍuḥ pāṣāṇavat saṃhananopapannaḥ |
cirābhivṛddhaś ca kaphaprakopād bhinnaḥ sravec chuklaghanaṃ ca pūyam ||14|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg: kaphagranthim āha– śīta ity ādi| avivarṇaḥ prakṛtivarṇaḥ, īṣadvivarṇa iti kaścit| pāṣāṇavat saṃhananopapanna iti pāṣāṇavat kaṭhina ity arthaḥ; kiṃ vā pāṣāṇavat bhavati, saṃhananopapanna iti ‘saṅghātānvito’ iti pā.| saṃhatānvito mahān ity arthaḥ||14||
ślaiṣmikam āha– śīta ity ādi| avivarṇaḥ prakṛtivarṇaḥ, pāṣāṇavat saṅghātānvito mahān ity arthaḥ| bhinnaḥ san śuklaṃ ghanaṃ pūyaṃ sravet ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca||14||

div.ab:
śarīravṛddhikṣayavṛddhihāniḥ snigdho mahān kaṇḍuyuto 'rujaś ca |
medaḥkṛto gacchati cātra bhinne piṇyākasarpiḥpratimaṃ tu medaḥ ||15|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg:
medojagranthim āha– śarīrety ādi| śarīravṛddhikṣayavṛddhihānir iti śarīravṛddhikṣayābhyāṃ yathākramaṃ vṛddhihānī yasya sa tathā| medojeṣv evaṃ yuktiḥ dhātusvabhāvāt cirasthāyitvād vā| gacchati cātra bhinne piṇyākasarpiḥpratimaṃ tu meda iti bhinne sati piṇyākas tilakalkaḥ, sarpir atra styānaṃ, tatsadṛśaṃ medaḥ sravati| bhojena tu medograntheḥ samprāptiḥ paṭhyate| yathā–
“medo vāyur yadā māṃse nikṣiped athavā tvaci|
tatra medobhavagranthiḥ śyāvo bhavati pāṇḍuraḥ||
kṛśaḥ kṛśe, mahān sthūle, granthir bhinnaś ca pīḍitaḥ|
tilakalkanibhaḥ srāvo ghṛtavac cāsya jāyate||” iti||15||

medojam āha– śarīravṛddhikṣayābhyāṃ yathākramaṃ vṛddhihānī yasya sa tathā| bhinne sati piṇyākasarpiḥsadṛśaṃ medo gacchati sravatīty arthaḥ| piṇyākas tilakalkaḥ, sarpir atra styānam, tatsadṛśaṃ medo gacchati| uktañ ca bhoje–
“medo vāyur yadā māṃse nikṣiped atha vā tvaci|
tatra medobhavo granthiḥ śyāvo bhavati pāṇḍuraḥ||
kṛśaḥ kṛśe mahān sthūle granthiś chinnaś ca pīḍitaḥ|
tilakalkanibhaḥ srāvo ghṛtavac cāsya jāyate||” iti||15||

div.ab:
vyāyāmajātair abalasya tais tair ākṣipya vāyus tu sirāpratānam |
saṅkucya ‘sampīḍya’ iti pā. | sampiṇḍya viśoṣya cāpi granthiṃ karoty unnatam āśu vṛttam ||16||
granthiḥ sirājaḥ sa tu kṛcchrasādhyo bhaved yadi syāt sarujaś calaś ca |
‘aruk sa evāpyacalo’ iti pā. | sa cāruja ścāpy acalo mahāṃś ca marmotthitaś cāpi vivarjanīyaḥ ||17|| (su. ni. a. 11) | ‘śirāja ... ’ iti pā.|

ab.seg:
sirājagrantheḥ samprāptim āha– vyāyāmajātair ity ādi| saṅkucyeti ‘ ... 'tra’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | antarbhāvito 'tra ṇyarthaḥ, tena saṅkocyety arthaḥ| sampiṇḍyeti saṃhatīkṛtya| unnatam āśu vṛttam iti asya sāmānyalakṣaṇenaiva siddhe punas taduktir atiśayārtham| sa ca sirājo granthir yadi sarujaś calaś ca syāt tadā kṛcchrasādhyaḥ| sa cārujaś cāpīty ādinā na sādhyaḥ| sa ceti cakāreṇārujatvādidharmayogād apare 'pi granthayo 'sādhyā iti sūcayati| yad uktaṃ bhoje–
“pañcaitān arujo granthīn marmajān acalāṃs tyajet|
kapolagalamanyāsu duścikitsyāś ca sandhiṣu||” iti| anye tu māṃsāsṛgbhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ granthiṃ vadanta evaṃ paṭhanti– “ ‘māṃsāsrajam’ iti pā.| māṃsāsṛjaṃ cārbudalakṣaṇena tulyaṃ hi dṛṣṭaṃ tv atha lakṣaṇajñaiḥ|” iti kintv anārṣo 'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ, bhojādisamānatantreṣv adṛṣṭatvāt||16-17||

sirājagrantheḥ samprāptim āha– vyāyāmety ādi| tais tair iti balavadvigrahādibhiḥ ‘śirāpratānaṃ ... ’ iti pā.| sirāpratānaṃ ‘śirābhyo’ iti pā.| sirābhyo nirgataṃ ‘ ... śirājālam’ iti pā.| sūkṣmasirājālam| saṅkucyeti antarbhāvito 'tra ṇyarthaḥ, tena saṅkocyety arthaḥ| sampīḍya saṃhatīkṛtya, unnatam uccaṃ, vṛttaṃ vartulam| sa tu ‘śirājo’ iti pā.| sirājo granthiḥ yadi sarujaś calaḥ syāt tadā kṛcchrasādhyaḥ| tasyāsādhyatvam āha– sa iti| cakāreṇārujādidharmayogād apare 'pi granthayaḥ asādhyā iti sūcayanti| yad uktaṃ bhojena–
“pañcaitān arujo granthīn marmajāṃś ca calāṃs tyajet|
kapolagalamanyāsu duścikitsyāś ca sandhiṣu||” iti||16-17||

div.ab:
gātrapradeśe kvacid eva doṣāḥ sammūrchitā māṃsam asṛk pradūṣya |
etacca– ‘vṛttaṃ mṛduṃ mandarujam’ iti pā. | vṛttaṃ sthiraṃ mandarujaṃ mahāntam analpamūlaṃ ciravṛddhyapākam ||18||
kurvanti māṃsocchrayam atyagādhaṃ tad arbudaṃ śāstravido vadanti |
vātena pittena kaphena cāpi raktena māṃsena ca medasā vā ||19||
taj jāyate tasya ca lakṣaṇāni grantheḥ samānāni ‘sadā’ iti pā. | tadā bhavanti |20| (su. ni. a. 11) |

māṃsaśoṇitadūṣyasāmyād arbudābhidhānam| tasya samprāptim āha– gātrapradeśe kvacid ity ādi| kvacid evety anenāniyatadeśe, na punar apacīvan niyatadeśe| “sammūrchitā” iti pāṭhāntare sammūrchitā vṛddhāḥ, dūṣyasaṃsṛṣṭā iti kārtikaḥ| māṃsam asṛk pradūṣyeti sarvārbudasādhāraṇaṃ dūṣyaṃ, māṃsārbudamedo 'rbudayos tu viśeṣeṇa māṃsaduṣṭiḥ; māṃsārbudamedo 'rbudayor api taddūṣako doṣo 'sti, tena tatrāpi doṣakartṛtayā samprāptir iyaṃ bhavati| māṃsocchrayam iti māṃsocchrayatayā pratīyamānam| medoje 'pi māṃsam udgataṃ bhavati| atyagādham iti dūrānupraviṣṭam; ata evānalpamūlam ity uktam| vātādibhis tad arbudaṃ jāyate ‘bhavati’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhavati, tena ṣaḍarbudāni bhavanti| grantheḥ samānānīti vātapittakaphamedogranthibhir vātapittakaphamedo 'rbudānāṃ lakṣaṇāni samānāni, śoṇitajamāṃsajayos tu lakṣaṇaṃ pṛthak vakṣyati||18-19||–

athārbudāny āha| tasya samprāptim āha– gātrety ādi| kvacid eveti aniyatadeśe na punar apacīvat niyatapradeśe| sammūrchitā iti pāṭhāntare vṛddhāḥ| māṃsam asṛk pradūṣyeti sarvārbudeṣu sādhāraṇaṃ dūṣyaṃ, māṃsārbudamedo 'rbudayoś ca viśeṣeṇa māṃsamedoduṣṭiḥ, etacca– ‘vṛttaṃ mṛduṃ mandarujam’ iti pā.| vṛttaṃ vartulaṃ, mṛduṃ mṛdusparśaṃ, māṃsamedaāśrayatvāt| atyagādhaṃ dūrānupraviṣṭam, ata evānalpamūlam ity uktam| tasya saṅkhyām āha– vātenety ādi| vātādibhis tad arbudaṃ jāyate bhavati; tena ṣaḍarbudāni bhavanti| grantheḥ samānānīti vātapittakaphamedojagranthibhir vātapittakaphamedojārbudānāṃ lakṣaṇāni samānāni| śoṇitajamāṃsajayos tu lakṣaṇaṃ pṛthak paṭhyate||18-19||–

doṣaḥ praduṣṭo rudhiraṃ sirāś ca saṅkucya sampiṇḍya tatas tv apākam ||20||
sāsrāvam unnahyati māṃsapiṇḍaṃ māṃsāṅkurair ācitam āśuvṛddham |
karoty ajasraṃ rudhirapravṛttim asādhyam etad rudhirātmakaṃ tu ||21||
raktakṣayopadravapīḍitatvāt pāṇḍur bhaved arbudapīḍitas tu | (su. ni. a. 11) |

raktārbudam āha– doṣaḥ praduṣṭa ity ādi| saṅkucyeti antarbhāvito 'tra ṇyarthaḥ| apākam īṣatpākaṃ, tena sāsrāvam ity upapannaṃ bhavati| doṣa unnahyati ucchrito bhavati| sāsrāvam īṣatsrāvam| māṃsapiṇḍam āśuvṛddhaṃ śīghravardhanaṃ, māṃsāṅkurair ācitaṃ karoti, tathā ajasraṃ rudhirapravṛttim api karoti; rudhiraṃ ‘cātrādhiṣṭhānapūrvabhūtaśirāgatam’ iti pā.| cātrādhiṣṭhānabhūtaṃ sirāgataṃ pravartate na tu pākāt, īṣad eva srāvasya kledarūpasyoktatvāt| kiṃ vā unnahyatīty antarbhāvitaṇyarthaḥ, tena māṃsapiṇḍam unnāhayati udgataṃ karoti| “doṣāḥ praduṣṭā” iti atra ‘vā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| pāṭhapakṣe “ ‘sāsrāvamunnahyati’ iti pā.| sāsrāvam unnahya hi” iti pāṭhaḥ| unnahya unnāhya, antarbhāvitaṇyarthatvāt| hi pādapūraṇe||20-21||–

raktārbudam āha– doṣa ity ādi| saṅkucyeti antarbhāvito 'tra ṇyarthaḥ| apākam iti īṣatpākaṃ, tena sāsrāvam ity upapannaṃ bhavati| doṣaḥ praduṣṭaḥ unnahyati ucchrito bhavati| ajasraṃ rudhirapravṛttim atirudhiraṃ cādhiṣṭhānabhūtaṃ pravartate, na tu pākāt, īṣad eva srāvasya kledarūpasyoktatvāt| suśrutoktaiḥ raktakṣayopadravaiḥ pāṇḍuḥ syāt||20-21||–

muṣṭiprahārādibhir ardite 'ṅge māṃsaṃ praduṣṭaṃ janayed dhi śotham ||22||
avedanaṃ snigdham ananyavarṇam apākam aśmopamam apracālyam |
praduṣṭamāṃsasya narasya gāḍham etad bhaven māṃsaparāyaṇasya ||23|| māṃsārbudaṃ tv etad asādhyam uktaṃ... | (su. ni. a. 11) |

māṃsajanyasamprāptim āha– muṣṭiprahārādibhir ity ādi| aśmopamaṃ pāṣāṇavat kaṭhinam| apracālyaṃ sthiram| yady api ‘raktamāṃsārbude'pyatiraktamāṃsayorhetu ... ’ iti pā.| raktamāṃsārbudayo raktamāṃsayor hetutvenoktis tathā'pi raktaje pittaṃ, māṃsaje vāyur ārambhakaḥ, evam api tābhyāṃ ghṛtadugdhanyānena vyapadeśaḥ| māṃsaparāyaṇasya māṃsāśanaśīlasya| tasya cātimātraṃ māṃsavṛddhiḥ, “māṃsaṃ māṃsena vardhate” ity abhidhānāt||22-23||–

māṃsajasya samprāptim āha– muṣṭīty ādi| muṣṭiprahārādibhir ardite 'ṅgapradeśe, ananyavarṇam, apākaṃ pākarahitam, aśmopamaṃ pāṣāṇavat kaṭhinam, apracālyaṃ sthiram| yady api raktamāṃsārbudayoḥ raktamāṃsayor hetutvenoktiḥ, tathā'pi raktaje pittaṃ, māṃsaje vāyur ārambhakaḥ, evam api tābhyāṃ ghṛtadugdhanyāyena vyapadeśaḥ| māṃsaparāyaṇasya māṃsabhakṣaṇaśīlasya, tasya cātimātraṃ māṃsavṛddhiḥ “māṃsaṃ māṃsena vardhate” iti vacanāt| etan māṃsārbudam asādhyam||22-23||–

...sādhyeṣv apīmāni tu varjayec ca |
‘saprasrutam’ iti pā. | samprasrutaṃ marmaṇi yac ca jātaṃ srotaḥsu vā yac ca bhaved acālyam ||24|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg: sādhyeṣv apy asādhyaprakārān āha– sādhyeṣv apīty ādi| samprasrutaṃ srāvayuktaṃ, srāvaś cātrāpākitve 'pi tvagavadaraṇāt manāg avagantavyaḥ| srotaḥsu nāsādiṣu| acālyaṃ sthiram||24||

sādhyeṣv apy asādhyaprakārān āha– sādhyeṣv ity ādi| sādhyeṣv api imāni arbudāni varjayet| ‘samprastutam’ iti pā.| samprasrutaṃ srāvayuktam| srāvaś cātrāpākitve 'pi tvagdāraṇāt manāg avagantavyaḥ| srotassu sirādiṣu, acālyaṃ sthiram||24||

div.ab:
yaj jāyate 'nyat khalu pūrvajāte jñeyaṃ ‘tadadhyarbuda ... ’ iti pā. | tad addhyarbudam arbudajñaiḥ |
yad dvandvajātaṃ yugapat kramād vā dvirarbudaṃ tac ca bhaved asādhyam ||25|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg:
adhyarbudam āha– yaj jāyata ity ādinā| adhikam arbudam adhyarbudam, etad dvirarbudam eva| yad dvandvajātaṃ yugapat kramād veti dvandvajātaṃ yugmena jātaṃ, yugapad ekadā krameṇa vā, tad dvirarbudaṃ na sādhyam| tathā ca bhojaḥ–
“arbude tv arbudaṃ jātaṃ dvandvajaṃ cānujaṃ ca yat|
‘taddvirarbudamiti’ iti pā.| dvirarbudam iti jñeyaṃ tac cāsādhyaṃ vinirdiśet||” iti||25||

adhyarbudam āha– yad ity ādi| adhikam arbudam adhyarbudaṃ, ‘etaddvirbudameva|’ iti pā.| etad dvirarbudam eva| yad dvandvajātaṃ yugapad ekadā krameṇa vā tat dvirarbudaṃ na sādhyam| tathā ca bhojaḥ–
“arbudaṃ tv arbude jātaṃ dvandvajaṃ cānujaṃ ca yat|
dvirarbudam iti jñeyaṃ tac cāsādhyaṃ vinirdiśet||” iti||25||

div.ab:
na pākam āyānti kaphādhikatvān medobahutvāc ca viśeṣatas tu |
doṣasthiratvād grathanāc ca teṣāṃ sarvārbudāny eva nisargatas tu ||26|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg: arbudānāṃ pākābhāve hetum āha– na pākam āyāntīty ādi| sarvārbudāni pittaraktajāny api na pākam āyānti, kutaḥ ity ata āha– ‘kaphādhikatvāt medobahutvācca’ iti pā.| kaphādhikatvān medobahutvāc ca| nanu, apacyām api viśeṣataḥ kaphamedasī adhike, atha ca tasyāḥ pāko 'sty eva, ity ata āha– doṣasthiratvād iti| apacyāṃ kālāntareṇa hi raktapittam adhikaṃ pākam ārabhate, tac ceha doṣasthiratvāt sadā sadṛśadoṣatvāt grathitatvāc ca na pākārambhakam| anye tu doṣasthiratvād iti doṣocchrāyarūpaśothakāṭhinyād ity āhuḥ; tad aprayojanakam, anyatra doṣocchrāyaśothakāṭhinye 'pi pākadarśanāt| atha kuto yathoktahetusampad ity āha– nisargatas tv iti| nisargato vyādhisvabhāvāt| bhoje 'py uktam– “na pacyate sthiratvāc ca grathitatvāt svabhāvataḥ|” iti||26||

arbudānāṃ pākābhāve hetum āha– nety ādi| sarvārbudāni pittaraktajāny api na pākam āyānti, kuta ity āha– kaphādhikatvān medobahutvāc ca| nanu, apacyām api kaphamedasī adhike, atha ca tasyāḥ pākaḥ kālato 'sty evety āha– doṣasthiratvād iti kālāntareṇa hi raktapittam adhikaṃ pākam ārabhate| nanu, iha doṣasthiratvāt sadṛśadoṣatvāt granthitatvāc ca na pākārambhakatvam, atha kuto yathoktahetusampad ity āha– nisargatas tv iti| nisargato vyādhisvabhāvāt| bhoje 'py uktam– “na pacyate sthiratvāc ca grathitatvāt svabhāvataḥ” iti| teṣām arbudānām iti||26||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne galagaṇḍagaṇḍamālāpacīgranthyarbudanidānaṃ samāptam ||38||
iti ‘ ... kṛtāyām’ iti pā.| śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ galagaṇḍagaṇḍamālāpacīgranthyarbudanidānaṃ samāptam||38||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ galagaṇḍagaṇḍamālā'pacīgranthyarbudanidānam||38||

div.head: ślīpadanidānam

ab.seg:
atha ślīpadanidānam |
yaḥ sajvaro vaṅkṣaṇajo bhṛśārtiḥ śotho nṛṇāṃ pādagataḥ krameṇa |
tac chlīpadaṃ syāt karakarṇanetraśiśnauṣṭhanāsāsv api kecid āhuḥ ||1||

lg.l: animittarujaṃ tasya bahuśo jvara eva ca ||2||
ślaiṣmikaṃ snigdhavarṇaṃ ca śvetaṃ pāṇḍu guru sthiram ||3||

ab.seg: utsedhasādharmyād arbudena saha kaphasambandhāvyabhicārasāmyāc cātha ślīpadanidānam| tasya samprāptim āha– ‘yaḥ sajvara’ iti pā.| ya ity ādi| vaṅkṣaṇāvasthānam evāsya pūrvarūpam| krameṇeti śanaiḥ śanaiḥ| tat ślīpadaṃ syād ity anena nirupādhir eveyaṃ sañjñeti darśayati; anye śilāvat padaṃ ślīpadam iti vadanti, nairuktyena ca vidhinā sādhutvam| karakarṇādigataślīpadānāṃ yathoktasamprāptyabhāvāt kecid āhur iti paramatenoktiḥ||1-3||

utsedhasādharmyād arbudena saha ‘kaphasambandhasaṃvādatvādavyabhicārasāmyāccātha’ iti pā.| kaphasambandhāvyabhicārasādharmyāc ca ślīpadanidānam| tasya samprāptim āha– ya ity ādi| vaṅkṣaṇādyavasthānam evāsya pūrvarūpam| krameṇeti śanaiḥ| vaṅkṣaṇam ūrumeḍhrasandhiḥ, vaṅkṣaṇasthaḥ śvayathuḥ bhṛśārtisahitaḥ caraṇaṃ gacchatīty arthaḥ, tat ślīpadaṃ syād ity anena pāribhāṣikī nirupādhir eveyaṃ sañjñeti| anye śilāvat ‘padaṃ ślīpadamiti vadanti|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | padaṃ ślīpadam iti vadanti| kecid āhur iti paramatenoktiḥ| vātajam āha– animittam ity ādi| akāraṇenaivaṃ pīḍā| bahuśo vāraṃ vāraṃ jvaraḥ, śeṣaṃ sugamam| pittajam āha– pītasaṅkāśaṃ pītāvabhāsaṃ, mṛdu mṛdusparśam| śleṣmajam āha– snigdhavarṇam iti| ‘snigdhavad varṇam’ iti pā.| snigdhavad varṇo yasya, cikkaṇam ity arthaḥ| pāṇḍu pītaśvetam||1-3||

lg.l: abdātmakaṃ mahat tac ca varjanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||4||

ab.seg: eṣām asādhyatām āha– ‘valmīkamiva sañjātaṃ kaṇṭakairupacīyate iti|’ iti pā.| valmīkam ivety ādi| sañjātaṃ pravṛddhaṃ sat valmīkavad bahuśikharākāraṃ granthibhir upacitaṃ yad bhavati tad asādhyam| anye tu punar amuṃ granthiṃ kaphajalakṣaṇatvena varṇayanti; tan na mano dhinoti, suśrute valmīkavaj jātasyāsādhyatvenābhidhānāt| tad yathā– “tatra saṃvatsarātītam atimahad valmīkam iva sañjātaṃ samprasrutam iti varjanīyāni bhavanti|” (su. ni. a. 12) iti| abdātmakam ity ādi| abdātmakaṃ saṃvatsarātītam, abdam ekam iti pāṭhe tu ‘atikrāntam’ iti śeṣaḥ| mahad iti atyantam ucchūnam| varjanīyaṃ viśeṣata iti pratyākhyeyam||4||

eṣām asādhyatām āha– valmīkam ity ādi| valmīkavad bahuśikharākāragranthibhir upacitaṃ yad bhavati tad asādhyam| anye punar amuṃ granthiṃ kaphajalakṣaṇatvena varṇayanti; tan na mano dhinoti, suśrute valmīkavaj jātasyāsādhyatvenābhidhānāt| tad yathā– “tatra ‘ ... valmīkajātam’ iti pā.| saṃvatsarātītam atimahad valmīkavaj jātaṃ ‘prasṛtamiti’ iti pā.| samprasrutam iti varjanīyāni bhavanti” iti| sarvātmakaṃ tridoṣajam| anye abdātmakam iti paṭhanti, tatrātikrāntavatsaram ity arthaḥ| mahat atyantam ucchūnam| varjanīyaṃ viśeṣata iti pratyākhyeyam||4||

div.ab:
trīṇy apy etāni jānīyāc chlīpadāni kaphocchrayāt |
gurutvaṃ ca mahattvaṃ ca yasmān nāsti kaphaṃ vinā ||5|| (su. ni. a. 12) |

ab.seg: ślīpadeṣu kaphasyāvyabhicāreṇa prādhānyam āha– trīṇy apy etānīty ādi| nanu, yady avyabhicārī sarvatra kaphaḥ kathaṃ tarhi ekadoṣajatvavyapadeśaḥ, sarvasya dvidoṣajatvaprasaṅgāt? ucyate– anubandho 'tra kaphaḥ, na tv anubandhyaḥ; etenātra na dvidoṣajaprasaṅga ity abhiprāyaḥ||5||

ślīpadeṣu kaphasyāvyabhicāreṇa prādhānyam āha– ‘trīṇi trīṇi vātajādīni vātajādīni’ iti pā.| trīṇīty ādi| trīṇi vātajādīni, yato gurutvaṃ ca śleṣmaṇā vinā na syāt| nanu, yady evaṃ tarhi katham ekadoṣajavyapadeśaḥ, sarvasya ‘dvidoṣajatvaprasaṅgāt’ iti pā.| dvidoṣatvaprasaṅgāt; ucyate– kapho 'trānubandharūpaḥ, na tv anubandhyaḥ| tena, na dvidoṣajatvaprasaṅga ity abhiprāyaḥ||5||

div.ab:
purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhāḥ sarvartuṣu ca śītalāḥ |
ye deśās teṣu jāyante ślīpadāni viśeṣataḥ ||6|| (su. ni. a. 12) |

ab.seg: ślīpadasambhavahetuṃ deśam āha– purāṇodakety ādi| ‘ānūpadeśe’ iti pā.| anūpadeśe hi salilaṃ patitaṃ bahūdakaṃ nimnatayā na śoṣam upayāti; jāṅgale tu āgneyonnatabhūbhāgatvāt na purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhatā| stimitasyānūpasya mandātapatvenoṣṇartāv api śītateti ata uktam– “sarvartuṣu ca śītalāḥ” iti| karakarṇādigataślīpadasandehe kopadvāreṇa jvareṇa ślīpadāvadhāraṇaṃ karaṇīyam||6||

ślīpadasambhave hetunirdeśam āha– purāṇodakety ādi| purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhā iti anūpadeśe salilaṃ patitaṃ bahūdakaṃ nimnabhūbhāgatayā na śoṣam upayāti, ato 'nūpadeśasya purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhatā; jāṅgale tv āgneyonnatabhūbhāgatayā salilaṃ patitaṃ na tiṣṭhati, sthitam api rūkṣoṣṇaśuṣkadeśasya śoṣam upayāti, iti jāṅgaladeśasya na purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhatā| sarveṣv api ṛtuṣu śītalā ye deśāḥ himavatpradeśāḥ||6||

aparam asādhyalakṣaṇam āha– ‘sāsrāvamityādi|’ iti pā.| yad ity ādi| atyunnatasarvaliṅgam iti yena doṣeṇārabdhaṃ ślīpadaṃ tasyātyunnatāni ativṛddhāni sarvāṇi liṅgāni yatra tat tathā| sakaṇḍuram iti atyantakaṇḍumat| śleṣmayutam iti śleṣmānugam||7||

punar asādhyatām āha– yad ity ādi| śleṣmalāhāro madhurādiḥ, vihāro divāsvapnādiḥ, kaphaprakṛtikasya sāsrāvam āsrāvayutam| atyunnatasarvaliṅgaṃ yena doṣeṇārabdhaṃ ślīpadaṃ, tasyātyunnatāni imāny atipravṛddhāni sarvāṇi tridoṣaliṅgāni yatra tat, sakaṇḍuraṃ kaṇḍūyutaṃ, śleṣmayutaṃ śleṣmaṇopagatam||7||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne ślīpadanidānaṃ samāptam ||39||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ ślīpadanidānaṃ samāptam||39||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ ślīpadanidānam||39||

div.head: vidradhinidānam
div.ab:
atha vidradhinidānam |
tvagraktamāṃsamedāṃsi sandūṣyāsthisamāśritāḥ |
doṣāḥ śothaṃ śanair ghoraṃ janayanty ucchritā bhṛśam ||1||
mahāmūlaṃ rujāvantaṃ vṛttaṃ vā'py athavā''yatam |
sa vidradhir iti khyāto vijñeyaḥ ṣaḍvidhaś ca saḥ ||2||
pṛthag doṣaiḥ samastaiś ca kṣatenāpy asṛjā tathā |
ṣaṇṇām api hi teṣāṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ sampravakṣyate ||3|| (su. ni. a. 9) |

ab.seg: śothatvasāmānyāt vidradhinidānam| tasya samprāptim āha– tvagraktamāṃsamedāṃsīty ādi| ghoram ity anyebhyo 'pi śothasamutthānebhyo granthyādibhya āśukāritvād dāruṇam| ucchritā bhṛśam iti atyarthaṃ vṛddhāḥ| asthisamāśritā ity anena sthānasaṃśrayo 'bhihitaḥ| ucchritā bhṛśam ity anena prakopa āviṣkṛtaḥ, etenaivāntarīyakatayā cayaprasarāv apy ākṣiptau mantavyau| mahāmūlam asthyādisamāśrayaṇād gambhīramūlam| rujāvantam iti utpattāv eva rujāprakarṣavantam, atiśāyane matup| vṛttam ity ādi vṛttaṃ vartulam| āyataṃ dīrgham| vṛttāyatābhyāṃ granthyādivilakṣaṇatā| vidradhir iti khyāta iti, itiśabdena nirupādhisaṅketamātrā vidradhisañjñeti darśayati| carake tu vidāhaprakarṣād vidradhisañjñā| yad uktam– “sa vai śīghravidāhitvād vidradhīty abhidhīyate|” (ca. sū. a. 17) iti||1-3||

śothasāmānyād vidradhinidānam| tasya samprāptim āha– tvag ity ādi| ghoram anyebhyaḥ śothasamutthānebhyo granthyādibhyaḥ āśukāritvād dāruṇam| ucchritā bhṛśam iti atyarthaṃ vṛddhāḥ, asthisamāśritā iti sthānasaṃśrayo 'rtho 'bhihitaḥ| ucchritā bhṛśam ity anena prakopa āviṣkṛtaḥ| mahāmūlam asthyādisamāśrayaṇād gambhīramūlam| rujāvantam utpattāv eva rujāprakarṣavantam| vṛttaṃ vartulaṃ, ‘āyatanadīrghavṛttatvāyatatvābhyām’ iti pā.| āyataṃ dīrghaṃ vṛttatvāyatatvābhyāṃ granthyādivilakṣaṇatā kathitā, vidradhir iti khyāta iti| itiśabdena nirupādhisaṅketamātrā vidradhir iti sañjñeti darśayati, carake tu vidāhaprakarṣād vidradhisañjñā| yad uktam– “sarvaiḥ ‘ ... vidradhiriti’ iti pā.| śīghravidāhitvād vidradhīti nirūpyate|” iti| sa atra ‘ca’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ṣaṭprakāraḥ; tribhir doṣais trayaḥ, sannipātenaikaḥ, kṣatenaikaḥ, asṛjā'py eka iti ṣaṭ| ṣaṇṇām api lakṣaṇaṃ kathyate||1-3||

div.ab:
kṛṣṇo 'ruṇo vā viṣamo bhṛśam atyarthavedanaḥ |
citrotthānaprapākaś ca vidradhir vātasambhavaḥ ||4|| (su. ni. a. 9) |

ab.seg: vātikam āha– kṛṣṇa ity ādi| viṣamo bhṛśam iti kadācid alpaḥ, kadācin mahān| citrotthānaprapāka iti| citrau nānāvidhau vāyor viṣamakriyatvāt udgamaprapākau yasya sa tathā||4||

vātikavidradhilakṣaṇam āha– kṛṣṇa ity ādi| viṣamo bhṛśam iti kadācid alpaḥ, kadācin mahān, bhṛśam atiśayena| citrotthānaprapāka iti citrau nānāvidhau vāyor viṣamakriyatvād udgamaprapākau yasya sa tathā||4||
paittikam āha– pakvety ādi| jvaradāhāv utthānakāla eva, pākakāle tu prakarṣavantau tāv iti viśeṣaḥ||5||
paittikam āha– pakvety ādi| pakvodumbarasadṛśaḥ, śyāvaḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ, jvaradāhau utthānakāla eva syātāṃ, pākakāle tu tāv eva prakarṣavantau, kṣipram utthānaprapākau yasya sa tathā||5||

div.ab:
śarāvasadṛśaḥ pāṇḍuḥ śītaḥ snigdho 'lpavedanaḥ |
cirotthānaprapākaś ca vidradhiḥ kaphasambhavaḥ ||6|| (su. ni. a. 9) |

ab.seg: kaphajam āha– śarāvety ādi| śarāvasadṛśa iti mahattvasūcanaparam||6||
śleṣmajam āha– śarāvety ādi| śarāvasadṛśa iti ‘mahattvasūcanam’ iti pā.| mahattvasūcanaparam| ciram utthānaprapākau yasya sa tathā||6||

div.ab: pākānantaraṃ sambhūtāsrāvaliṅgam āha– tanupītasitāś caiṣām ity ādi| kramaśa iti yathākramaṃ; tena vātena tanuḥ, pittena pītaḥ, kaphena sitaḥ; tanusrāve vātānurūpo varṇo jñeyaḥ|7|–
teṣāṃ doṣabhedena srāvān āha– tanv ity ādi| kramaśa iti krameṇa; vātena tanuḥ, pittena pītaḥ, śleṣmaṇā sitaḥ, tanusrāve vātānurūpo varṇo jñeyaḥ|7|–

nānāvarṇarujāsrāvo ghāṭālo viṣamo mahān ||7||
viṣamaṃ pacyate cāpi vidradhiḥ sānnipātikaḥ | (su. ni. a. 9) |

sannipātajam āha– nānety ādi| nānāvarṇarujāsrāva iti nānāśabdo ‘varṇādibhiḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | varṇādibhiḥ pratyekam abhisambadhyate; nānā bahuvidhā varṇāḥ kṛṣṇapītaśuklavarṇāḥ, rujāḥ todadāhakaṇḍvādikāḥ, tanupītasitā āsrāvāś ca yasya sa tathā| anyatra śothe pākakāle nānārujā, atra tu sarvadā| ghāṭāla iti ghāṭā asyāsti sa ghāṭāla iti matvarthīyo lac, atyucchritāgratvena ghāṭāla iva| viṣamo 'sādhyatvāt| viṣamaṃ pacyate iti cirāciragambhīrottānordhvānūrdhvabhedena viṣamaṃ yathā bhavati tathā pacyata iti; viṣamam asamam| nanu, viṣamapākitvaṃ vātike vidradhāv uktaṃ, tathā'nupakrānte ca śothe; yathā–
“yo 'bhyutthito 'lpo yadi vā mahān syāt kriyāṃ vinā pākam upaiti śothaḥ|
viśālamūlo viṣamo vidagdhaḥ sa kṛcchratāṃ yāty avagāḍhadoṣaḥ||” (su. sū. a. 17) iti| ataḥ saṃśaye kathaṃ mitho bhedapratītiḥ? ucyate– vātike apratīkāreṇaiva viṣamapākitvam, ‘pratīkāreṇaiva bheditam|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | pratīkāreṇaiva bheditam| iha punaḥ pratīkāre 'pi vaiṣamyaṃ; vātike tu pākamātravaiṣamyaṃ, na tu gāmbhīryādinā; ‘ata evāyaṃ sādhyaḥ’ iti pā.| ato vātikaḥ sādhyaḥ||7||–

ab.seg: sānnipātikam āha– nānety ādi| nānā bahuvidhāḥ ‘kṛṣṇapītaśuklavarṇāḥ’ iti pā.| kṛṣṇapītaśuklā varṇāḥ, todadāhakaṇḍvādirujāḥ, tanupītasitāḥ srāvā yasya sa tathā| anyatra śothe pākakāle nānārujāḥ, atra tu sarvadā| ghāṭāla iti ghāṭā asyāstīti ghāṭālaḥ, matvarthīyo lac, atyucchritākṛtitvena ghāṭāla iva| viṣamo 'sādhyatvāt| viṣamaṃ pacyata iti cirāciragambhīrottānordhvānūrdhvabhedena viṣamaṃ yathā bhavati tathā pacyate||7||

div.ab:
tais tair bhāvair abhihate kṣate vā'pathyakāriṇaḥ ||8||
kṣatoṣmā vāyuvisṛtaḥ saraktaṃ pittam īrayet |
jvaras tṛṣṇā ca dāhaś ca jāyate tasya dehinaḥ ||9||
āgantur vidradhir hy eṣa pittavidradhilakṣaṇaḥ |10| (su. ni. a. 9) |
