abhighātajasyāgantoḥ samprāptim āha– tais tair ity ādi| tais tair iti kāṣṭhaloṣṭapāṣāṇādibhiḥ| abhihata iti asrutaraktasya mathitapiccitāder upalakṣaṇaṃ, kṣata iti srutaraktasya chinnabhinnādeḥ; dvayor abhihatayor apathyakāriṇa iti viśeṣaṇam| kṣatoṣmeti kṣataśabdasya hiṃsāmātraparigrahāt kṣatābhihatayor apy ūṣmā kṣatoṣmaśabdenocyate| vāyuvisṛta iti kṣate raktakṣayāt abhihate abhighātād eva vātakopaḥ, kupitena vātena hetubhūtena visṛtaḥ prasṛto vāyuvisṛtaḥ| yady apy ayaṃ vātapittaraktajas tathā'pi prāgabhighātasambhavatvenāgantuḥ, vātapittaraktajānāṃ janakatvenaiva vilakṣaṇā'sya samprāptiḥ| pittavidradhilakṣaṇa iti atroktajvarādivyatiriktasaṃsthānavarṇavedanādipittavidradhiliṅgayukta ity arthaḥ||8-9||–

ab.seg: abhighātajasyāgantor vidradheḥ samprāptim āha– tais tair ity ādi| kāṣṭhalaguḍapāṣāṇādibhiḥ, mūlaśloke ‘abhihata’ iti pā.| abhihita iti asrutaraktasya mathitapiccitāder upalakṣaṇam| dvayor abhihatakṣatayor apathyakāriṇa iti yojyam| kṣatoṣmety ādi kṣatasya hiṃsātvamātraparigrahāt kṣatābhihatayor apy ūṣmā kṣatoṣmaśabdenocyate| vāyuvisṛta ity ādi| vātena vistāritaḥ kṣatena raktakṣayāt, abhihate abhighātād eva vātakopaḥ, kupitena ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca vātena hetubhūtena visṛtaḥ prasṛtaḥ raktaṃ pittaṃ īrayet kopayet| yady apy ayaṃ vātapittaraktajas tathā'pi prāgabhighātasambhavatvenāgantuḥ| pittavidradhilakṣaṇa iti atra jvaradāhavyatiriktasaṃsthānavarṇavedanādipittalakṣaṇa ity arthaḥ||8-9||

div.ab:
kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtaḥ śyāvas tīvradāharujākaraḥ ||10||
pittavidradhiliṅgas tu raktavidradhir ucyate |11| (su. ni. a. 9) |

raktajam āha– kṛṣṇety ādi| pittavidradhiliṅgātideśena labdhāv api dāhajvarau tīvratāviśeṣārtham uktau| śyāva iti pittavidradhiliṅgātideśena prasaktasya pakvodumbarasaṅkāśasyāpavādaḥ| bhojaprabhṛtayas tu dhāturaktajaṃ vidradhiṃ parityajya makkallasañjñayā''rtavalakṣaṇaraktajaṃ paṭhanti| teṣāṃ mate ārtavajena saha ṣaḍ vidradhayaḥ, suśrute tu dhāturaktajo 'pi tathā makkallasañjñako 'pi vidradhiḥ sāmānyena raktaja eveti ṣaḍ vidradhaya iti boddhavyam||10||–

raktajavidradhim āha– kṛṣṇety ādi| kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ, sphoṭāvṛtaḥ piḍakāyuktaḥ, śyāvaḥ śyāvavarṇaḥ; anye ‘kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtaḥ’ iti paṭhanti, tatra kṛṣṇaiḥ sphoṭair āvṛtaḥ pittavidradhilakṣaṇanirdeśena yady api dāhajvarau labdhau, tathā'py atrātidāhajvarakhyāpanārtham uktam| bhojaprabhṛtayas tu dhāturaktajaṃ vidradhiṃ parityajya ‘makkallasañjñārtavalakṣaṇaṃ raktajam’ iti pā.| makkallasañjñam ārtavalakṣaṇaraktajaṃ paṭhanti| teṣāṃ mate ārtavajena saha ṣaḍ vidradhayaḥ, suśrute tu dhāturaktajo 'pi tathā makkallajo 'pi vidradhiḥ sāmānyena raktaja eveti ṣaḍ vidradhaya iti boddhavyam||10||–

pṛthak sambhūya vā doṣāḥ kupitā gulmarūpiṇam ||11||
valmīkavat samunnaddham antaḥ kurvanti vidradhim |
gude bastimukhe nābhyāṃ kukṣau vaṅkṣaṇayos tathā ||12||
vṛkkayoḥ plīhni yakṛti hṛdi vā klomni vā'py atha |
teṣām uktāni liṅgāni bāhyavidradhilakṣaṇaiḥ ||13||
adhiṣṭhānaviśeṣeṇa liṅgaṃ śṛṇu viśeṣataḥ |
gude vātanirodhaś ca bastau kṛcchrālpamūtratā ||14||
nābhyāṃ hikkā tathā''ṭopaḥ kukṣau mārutakopanam |
kaṭīpṛṣṭhagrahas tīvro vaṅkṣaṇotthe tu vidradhau ||15||
vṛkkayoḥ pārśvasaṅkocaḥ plīhny ucchvāsāvarodhanam |
sarvāṅgapragrahas tīvro hṛdi kāsaś ca jāyate |
śvāso yakṛti hikkā ca klomni pepīyate payaḥ ||16|| (su. ni. a. 9) |

ab.seg: adhiṣṭhānaviśeṣeṇa liṅgaviśeṣaṃ sādhyatām asādhyatāṃ ca pratipādayitum ābhyantaravidradhim āha– ‘pṛthak sambhūya vā ityādi’ iti pā.| pṛthag ity ādi| iyam adhikavidhānārtham uktā'pi samprāptir vidradheḥ punar ucyate| ābhyantarasya raktajasya tathā''gantoś ca vidradher doṣeṇa vyapadeśād iyam eva tatrāpi samprāptir jñeyeti kaścit| bāhyāgantuvad ābhyantarāgantusamprāptir ity arthaḥ| ‘kṣatasyāntarabhāvānna’ iti pā.| kṣatajasyābhyantarābhāvān na nirdiṣṭaḥ kṣataja iti tu jejjaṭaḥ| gulmarūpiṇam iti gulmavat saṃhatam| etad ābhyantaravidradhīnāṃ sāmānyarūpaṃ; viśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ tu bāhyavidradhilakṣaṇair eva jñeyam| valmīkavat atra ‘iti valmīka “uyeraḍipi” tadvat’ iti adhikaḥ pā., ‘unchūnattvaṃ,’ iti vā kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| samunnaddhaṃ samantād unnatam; etad api pacyamānāvasthāyāṃ sarveṣāṃ samānam| bastimukha iti bastimukha eva, vidradhyādhārabhūtamāṃsādisambhavāt; na bastau, tasya tanutvāt| āṭopo rujāpūrvakakṣobhaḥ| mārutakopanam iti mārgāvarodhād vāyoḥ kopaḥ| vṛkkayor iti vṛkkam agramāṃsam| sarvāṅgapragrahaḥ pratyaṅgavyathā, ‘sarvaśirādhiṣṭhānatvāt’ iti pā.| sarvasirādhiṣṭhānatvāt hṛdayasya| klomnīti kloma vṛkkād ūrdhvaṃ pipāsāsthānam| pepīyate payaḥ iti punaḥ punar jalaṃ pātum icchatīty arthaḥ||11-16||

adhiṣṭhānaviśeṣeṇa liṅgaviśeṣaṃ ‘sādhyatām’ iti pā.| sādhyāsādhyatāṃ ca jñāpayitum antaravidradhīn āha– pṛthag ity ādi| doṣā vātādayaḥ, pṛthag bhinnāḥ, sambhūya militvā vā, antar madhye, gulmarūpiṇaṃ gulmavat saṃhataṃ, valmīkavat samunnataṃ, valmīkaṃ bhūmau kṛmiviśeṣaiḥ kṛtaṃ, tadvat samantāt unnatam| sthānasaṃśrayam āha– guda ity ādi| bastimukha iti bastimukhāśritamāṃsādau; na ca bastau, tanutvāt| kukṣau pārśvayor adhobhāge, vaṅkṣaṇayoḥ ūrumeḍhrasandhyoḥ| vṛkkau māṃsapiṇḍadvayam, eko vāmapārśve sthitaḥ, dvitīyo dakṣiṇapārśve sthitaḥ, plīhā udarasya vāmapārśve sthitaḥ, yakṛt kālakhaṇḍaṃ dakṣiṇapārśvasthaṃ, hṛdayaṃ kamalamukulākāram adhomukhaṃ, kloma kālakhaṇḍādhastāt sthitaṃ dakṣiṇapārśvasthaṃ tilakaṃ prasiddham| teṣām ābhyantarāṇāṃ vidradhīnāṃ liṅgāni ‘bāhyavidradhīnāṃ liṅgāni’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bāhyavidradhīnāṃ liṅgāni bāhyavidradhilakṣaṇair uktāni| pratyekaṃ sthānasaṃśrayatvena rūpam āha– guda ity ādi| gudenārte vidradhau vātanirodho bhavati, tathā bastau kṛcchramūtratā alpamūtratā ca| tābhyāṃ hikkā tathā āṭopo rujāpūrvakaḥ kṣobhaḥ, kukṣau mārutakopanam iti mārgarodhāt vāyoḥ prakopaḥ, vaṅkṣaṇotthe vidradhau tīvraḥ kaṭīpṛṣṭhagraho bhavati vṛkkayor ity ādi| vṛkkam agramāṃsaṃ, pārśvasaṅkocaḥ pārśvotpāṭanam iva, plīhni ucchvāsāvarodhanaṃ bhavati| tathā hṛdīti hṛdayotthe vidradhau sarvāṅgapragrahādaya upadravā bhavantīty arthaḥ| tīvro duḥsahaḥ, sarveṣām aṅgānāṃ prakarṣeṇa grahaṇam iva sarvāṅgapragrahaḥ pratyaṅgavyathā, sarvādhiṣṭhānatvāt hṛdayasya, yakṛti jāte vidradhau śvāsas tathā hikkā ca bhavati| klomnīty ādi| vṛkkād ūrdhvaṃ pipāsāsthānaṃ kloma, pepīyate paya iti punaḥ punar jalaṃ pātum icchati||11-16||

div.ab: nābher uparijāḥ pakvā yānty ūrdhvam itare tv adhaḥ |17| (su. ni. a. 9) |

srāvanirgamamārgam āha– ‘nābheruparijā ityādi|’ iti pā.| nābher ity ādi| uparijā vṛkkaplīhādijāḥ| yānti sravanti| nābhijas tūbhayamārgasrāvī, ūrdhvādhaḥsrāvaś ca tathāgatitvāt vātasya| yad āha hārītaḥ–
“ūrdhvaṃ prabhinneṣu mukhān narāṇāṃ pravartate 'sṛksahito 'pi pūyaḥ|
adhaḥprabhinneṣu ca pāyumārgāt, dvābhyāṃ pravṛttis tv iha nābhijeṣu||” iti| itara iti nābhibastivaṅkṣaṇajāḥ|17|–

srāvanirgamam āha– nābher ity ādi| uparijātāḥ vṛkkaplīhādijāḥ pakvāḥ santa ūrdhvaṃ yānti sravanti, nābhijas tūbhayamārgasrāvī, ūrdhvādhaḥsrāvaś ca tathā gatitvād vātasya| tathā ca hārītaḥ–
“ūrdhvaṃ prabhinneṣu mukhān narāṇāṃ pravartate 'sṛksahitaś ca pūyaḥ|
adhaḥprabhinneṣu tu pāyumārgād dvābhyāṃ pravṛttis tv iha nābhijeṣu||” iti| ‘itare nābhibastivaṅkṣaṇajāḥ sravanti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | itare nābhibastivaṅkṣaṇajāḥ sravanti|17|–

adhaḥsruteṣu jīvet tu sruteṣūrdhvaṃ na jīvati ||17||
hṛnnābhibastivarjyā ye teṣu bhinneṣu bāhyataḥ |
jīvet kadācit puruṣo netareṣu kadācana ||18|| (su. ni. a. 9) |
sādhyā vidradhayaḥ pañca vivarjyaḥ sānnipātikaḥ |
āmapakvavidagdhatvaṃ teṣāṃ śothavad ādiśet ||19|| (vā. ni. a. 11) |
ādhmātaṃ baddhaniṣyandaṃ chardihikkātṛṣānvitam |
rujāśvāsasamāyuktaṃ vidradhir nāśayen naram ||20|| (su. sū. a. 33) |

ab.seg:
sādhyatvādikam āha– adha ity ādi| adhaḥsruteṣv iti svayam eva yadā nābhyādijā bhinnā adhaḥ sravanti tadā jīvati| sruteṣūrdhvaṃ na jīvatīti ūrdhvaṃ pūyasyāsamyaṅnirgamān na jīvanam| hṛnnābhibastivarjyā iti plīhaklomādijāḥ| bhinneṣu bāhyata iti vaidyavyāpāreṇa bhinneṣu; anye marmādyāśayajeṣu svayam eva bhinneṣv iti vyācakṣate, antarbhinneṣv apy adhaḥsrāviṣu jīvanokteḥ| netareṣv iti hṛnnābhibastijeṣu bhinneṣu teṣāṃ marmatvād bāhyā ābhyantarā vā varjyāḥ| kadācaneti pāke apāke vā| tathā ca bhojaḥ–
“asādhyo marmajo jñeyaḥ pakvo 'pakvaś ca vidradhiḥ|
sannipātotthito 'py evaṃ pakva eva tu bastijaḥ||
tvagjo nābher adho yaś ca sādhyo marmasamīpajaḥ|
apakvaś caiva pakvaś ca sādhyo nopari nābhijaḥ||” iti| atra marmajaśabdena hṛdayanābhijāv ucyete| baddhaniṣyandam iti baddhamūtram| etad bastije prāyaḥ||17-20||

srāvaviṣayasādhyāsādhyatvam āha– ‘svayameva yadā nābhyādijā bhinnā adhaḥ sravantīti tadā jīvati, sruteṣūrdhvamityādi, ūrdhvasruteṣu na jīvati| ūrdhvapūyasyāsamyaṅnirgamānna jīvanam||’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | svayam eva yadā nābhyādijā bhinnā adhaḥ sravantīti tadā jīvati, sruteṣūrdhvam ity ādi, ūrdhvasruteṣu na jīvati| ūrdhvapūyasyāsamyaṅnirgamān na jīvanam|| hṛd ity ādi| bhinneṣu bāhyata iti vaidyavyāpāreṇa bhinneṣu kadācid daivavaśāt puruṣo jīvet| anye marmādyāśayajeṣu svayam eva bhinneṣv iti vyācakṣate| antarbhinneṣv apy adhaḥsrāviṣu jīvanokteḥ| netareṣv iti hṛnnābhibastijeṣu bhinneṣu, teṣāṃ marmatvāt bāhyā ābhyantarā vā varjyāḥ| kadācaneti pāke apāke ca| tathā ca bhojaḥ–
“asādhyo marmajo jñeyaḥ pakvo 'pakvaś ca vidradhiḥ|
sannipātotthito 'py evaṃ pakva eva tu bastijaḥ||
tvagjo nābher adho yaś ca sādhyo marmasamīpajaḥ|
apakvaś caiva pakvaś ca sādhyo nopari nābhijaḥ||” iti| atra marmaśabdena hṛdayanābhijāv ucyete| sādhyāsādhyatvam āha– pañca iti| vātikapaittikaślaiṣmikāganturaktajā iti| ayaṃ bāhyeṣu viṣayaḥ tridoṣajas tv asādhyaḥ| ‘teṣāṃ viṣayamāha– āmeti|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | teṣāṃ viṣayam āha– āmeti| teṣāṃ vidradhīnām ābhyantareṣv asādhyatvam āha– ādhmātam ity ādi| mūlaśloke ‘baddhaniṣyandam’ iti pā.| baddhaniṣpandaṃ baddhamūtram, etad bastije prāyaḥ| śeṣaṃ sugamam| atra kecit tantrāntaroktaṃ stanavidradhilakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti, tad yathā–
“evam eva ‘stanaśirā’ iti pā.| stanasirā vikṛtāḥ prāpya yoṣitām|
sūtānāṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ ca sambhavec chvayathur ghanaḥ||
stane sadugdhe cāptāsṛgbāhyavidradhilakṣaṇaḥ|
nāḍīnāṃ sūkṣmarandhratvāt sa kanyānāṃ na jāyate||17-20||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne vidradhinidānaṃ samāptam ||40||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ vidradhinidānaṃ samāptam||40||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ vidradhinidānam||40||

div.head: vraṇaśothanidānam

ab.seg:
atha vraṇaśothanidānam |
ekadeśotthitaḥ śotho vraṇānāṃ pūrvalakṣaṇam |
ṣaḍvidhaḥ syāt pṛthaksarvaraktāgantunimittajaḥ ||1||

lg.l: śothāḥ ṣaḍ ete vijñeyāḥ prāguktaiḥ śothalakṣaṇaiḥ |

ab.seg: prāyeṇa cikitsāsādharmyād bhāvivraṇatvasambandhatulyatvāc ca vraṇaśothanidānam āha– ekadeśotthita ity ādi| ṣaḍvidha iti saṅkhyākathanaṃ dvandvajaniṣedhārtham| prāguktair iti āmapakvaiṣaṇīyoktaiḥ; tatra hi “vātaśvayathur aruṇaḥ kṛṣṇo vā paruṣo mṛdur anavasthitaḥ” (su. sū. a. 17) ity ādinā ṣaṭśothalakṣaṇāny uktāni| viśeṣaḥ kathyate caiṣām iti tatrānukto viśeṣaḥ kathyata ity arthaḥ| pakvāpakvādiniścaya iti atrādiśabdena pacyamānasya parigrahaḥ||1-2||

vraṇacikitsāsāmānyād bhāvivraṇatvasambandhatulyatvāc ca vraṇaśothanidānārambhaḥ| teṣāṃ prāgrūpeṇa saṅkhyām āha– ekety ādi| ekadeśe śothaḥ etad vraṇapūrvarūpaṃ; sa ca ṣaḍvidhaḥ– tribhir doṣais trayaḥ, sannipātenaikaḥ, ‘raktenaikaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | raktenaikaḥ, anya āgantukaḥ abhighātajaḥ, evaṃ ṣaṭ, ṣaḍvidha iti saṅkhyākathanaṃ dvandvajaniṣedhārtham| teṣāṃ lakṣaṇanirdeśaṃ darśayann āha– ‘śothā iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śothā iti| prāguktair iti| śothanidānoktaiś ca, ‘rasastanutvakparuṣāruṇādikaiḥ’ ity ādi| sāmprataṃ pakvāpakvādiniścaya ‘iti atrādiśabdena pacyamānasya parigrahaḥ’ iti pā.| ity atrādiśabdena pacyamānāvasthāyāḥ ‘grahaṇam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | grahaṇam||1-2||

lg.l: viṣamaṃ pacyate vātāt pittotthaś cācirāc ciram |

ab.seg: vātādibhedena viśeṣalakṣaṇam āha– viṣamam ity ādi| pittavad iti pittaśothavad aciraṃ pacyate||3||
tam eva viśeṣam āha– viṣamam ity ādi| śvayathor ekadeśe ardhe vā, pittottho 'ciraṃ śīghraṃ, kaphajaś ciraṃ carakalaṃ, raktāgantujayoḥ pittavat pittaśophavad aciraṃ pacyate||3||
āmaśothalakṣaṇam āha– mandeti| mandoṣmatā īṣaduṣṇatā, tvaksavarṇatā tvaksadṛśa eva varṇaḥ||4||

lg.l: bhidyate caiva śastreṇa daṇḍeneva ca tāḍyate |
na gacched ātataḥ śotho bhaved ādhmātabastivat |

ab.seg: pacyamānalakṣaṇam āha– dahyata ity ādi| pacyamānaśothe pittaliṅgāny eva bhūyasā bhavanti, vidāhasya pittaprakopajatvāt; vidāhaś cātra doṣādīnām eva| tena jvaratṛṣṇārucyādayo 'tra pittaliṅgāni| chidyata iti dvidhā kriyata iva| bhidyata iti vidāryate| soṣācoṣa iti uṣā dāhaḥ, coṣaḥ pārśvasthāgnisantāpavad vyathā, tābhyāṃ saha vartate yaḥ sa tathā||5-8||

vraṇaśophasya pacyamānāvasthām āha– dahyata ity ādi| pacyamānaśophe pittaliṅgāny eva bhūyasā bhavanti, vidāhaḥ pittaprakopāt, jvaratṛṣṇārucyādayo 'pi pittaliṅgāni, agninā dahyata iva, kṣāreṇa pacyata iva, pipīlikābhir daśyata iva, chidyate dvidhākriyata iva śastreṇa, bhidyata iva, daṇḍena tāḍyata iva, antar madhye, hastena pīḍyata iva, sūcībhir vidhyata iva| uṣā ekadeśiko dāhaḥ, coṣaḥ pārśvasthitāgnisantāpavad vyathā, tābhyāṃ saha vartate yaḥ sa tathā, vivarṇaḥ mlānaḥ, aṅgulyā ivāvaghaṭyate cālyate| āsane tathā śayane tathā sthāne ūrdhvabhavane vṛścikaviddhavat śāntiṃ na gacchet| ādhmātabastivat ‘vāyupūrṇabastyādisūtrakośavat’ iti pā.| vāyupūrṇabastyākhyamūtrakośavat, śvayathuḥ satato bhavati, tvaksaṅkocarahita ity arthaḥ| jvaratṛṣṇādayaś copadravā bhavanti pacyamānavraṇaśophe||5-8||

lg.l: vedanopaśamaḥ ‘śotho lohito'lpo’ iti pā. | śotho 'lohito 'lpo na connataḥ |
prādurbhāvo valīnāṃ ca todaḥ kaṇḍūr muhur muhuḥ ||9||
pūyasya pīḍayaty ekam antam ante ca pīḍīte |

ab.seg: pakvalakṣaṇam āha– vedanopaśama ity ādi| dāhādivedanopaśāntiḥ, vidāhopaśamena pittasyābalavattvāt| todaḥ kaṇḍūś cātra vātakaphaliṅgam| prādurbhāvo valīnām iti māṃsaśaithilyād valīsambhavaḥ| upadravāṇāṃ praśama iti pittakopajanitā uṣācoṣatṛṣṇārucyādayo rogā eva upadravās teṣāṃ praśamaḥ| nimnatā svarūpataḥ, aṅgulipīḍanād vā| sphuṭanaṃ tvacām iti ‘kiñcittvagavadāraṇam’ iti pā.| kiñcittvagavadaraṇam| bastāvivety ādi| bastiś carmapuṭakam, pūyasyety atra ‘sañcāra’ iti śeṣaḥ| ayam arthaḥ– bastau yathā'mbusañcāras tathā ‘śothe'ṅgulīpīḍite’ iti pā.| śothe 'ṅgulipīḍite sati pūyasya sañcāraḥ| pīḍayaty ekam antam ante ca pīḍita iti ekam antaṃ deśam, ante avayave pīḍite pīḍayati avagāhate, ‘pūya’ iti śeṣaḥ||9-11||

pakvāvasthasya śophasya lakṣaṇam āha– vedanopaśama ity ādi| vidāhopaśamena pittasyābalatvāt| alohitaḥ pāṇḍuḥ dhūsaro vā, yad uktaṃ suśrute– “ ‘pāṇḍutā'lpaśothā’ iti pā.| pāṇḍutā'lpaśothatā” iti ‘alpavedanayā iti īṣat pīḍā vedanopaśamaḥ, iti| yaduktam– uktaḥ vedanāpekṣayā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | alpavedanayā iti īṣat pīḍā vedanopaśamaḥ, iti| yad uktam– uktaḥ vedanāpekṣayā prādurbhāvo valīnām iti māṃsaśaithilyād valīsambhava iti| todaḥ kaṇḍuś cātra vātakaphaliṅgam| upadravāṇām ity ādi| pittakopajanitā uṣācoṣatṛṣṇā'rucyādaya upadravās teṣām upaśamaḥ| nimnatā svarūpato 'ṅgulinipīḍanād vā| sphuṭanaṃ tvacām iti kiñcittvagavadaraṇam| bastāvivety ādi– bastiś carmapuṭakam| pūyasyety atra ‘sañcāra’ iti śeṣaḥ| ayam arthaḥ– bastau yathā'mbusañcāraḥ, tathā'ṅgulipīḍite śothe 'pi pūyasya sañcāraḥ| ekam antaṃ deśam, ante avayave pīḍite pīḍayati avagāhate ‘pūya’ iti śeṣaḥ| bhaktākāṅkṣeti vedanāpagamād eva||9-11||

div.ab:
narte 'nilād ruṅ na vinā ca pittaṃ pākaḥ kaphaṃ cāpi vinā na pūyaḥ |
tasmād dhi sarve paripākakāle pacanti ‘śothāstribhireva doṣaiḥ’ iti pā. | śothāṃs traya eva doṣāḥ ||12|| (su. sū. a. 17) |

ab.seg:
ekadoṣārabdhe 'pi śothe pākakāle sarvadoṣasambandham āha– narte 'nilād rug ity ādi| rug rujā todādirūpā| suśrute– “tribhir etaiḥ śoṇitacaturthaiś ca śarīram idaṃ dhāryate” (su. sū. a. 21) iti dvitīyaṃ darśanaṃ śoṇitaprādhānyākhyāpakam āśrityoktam–
“kālāntareṇābhyuditaṃ tu pittaṃ kṛtvā vaśe vātakaphau prasahya|
pacaty ataḥ śoṇitam eṣa pāko mataḥ pareṣāṃ viduṣāṃ dvitīyaḥ||” (su. sū. a. 17) iti| atra darśane pittaṃ vidāhakupitaṃ śoṇitaṃ dūṣyaṃ karmabhūtaṃ pacati, vātakaphau vaśe kṛtvā kroḍīkṛtya; hīnārtho vā vaśeśabdaḥ, vātakaphau hīnau kṛtvety arthaḥ; śoṇitaṃ kartṛbhūtaṃ vā, tena paktyanukūlatvād vivakṣitaṃ; pūrvadarśane kaphāt pūyaḥ, atra darśane śoṇitāt pūya iti viśeṣaḥ| gambhīrapāke śothe sakalāmapacyamānalakṣaṇānudayād ajñāyamāne lakṣaṇāntaram uktaṃ suśrutena| tad yathā– “kaphajeṣu khalu śotheṣu gambhīragatitvād abhighātajeṣu vā keṣucid asamastaṃ pakvalakṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā pakvam apakvam iti bhiṣaṅ moham upaiti, yatra hi tvaksavarṇatā śītaśothatā alparujatā aśmavad ghanatā ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca, na tatra moham upeyāt|” (su. sū. a. 17) iti| asyārthaḥ– yadā rāgadāhādivedanāsamudāyānantaraṃ tvaksavarṇatādīni bhavanti tadā na moham ajñānatām upeyāt pakvam eveti niścinuyāt| gadādhareṇa tu tvaksavarṇatādīni saṃśayahetūny uktāni; yatas tena “gambhīrapākitvād antaḥ pāko bahiḥ punas tvaksāvarṇyaṃ, gambhīrapākitvād eva bahiḥ śītatā, kaphārabdhatvān mandarujatā'śmavac ca ghanatā” ity abhidhāya “śeṣaṃ pakvalakṣaṇair jānīyāt” ity uktam||12||

ekadoṣārabdhe 'pi śothe pākakāle sarvadoṣasambandham āha– nety ādi| anilād vātād ṛte ruṅ na bhavati, pittaṃ vinā pāko na bhavati, kaphaṃ vinā pūyo na bhavati, tasmād dhetoḥ sarve śophāḥ paripākakāle tribhir eva doṣaiḥ pākaṃ gacchanti, ruk rujā todādirūpā, śeṣaṃ sugamam| suśrute– ‘tribhir etaiḥ śoṇitacaturthaiḥ śarīram idaṃ dhāryate|’ iti dvitīyaṃ nidarśanaṃ śoṇitaprādhānyākhyāpakam āśrityoktaṃ matāntaram āha– kālāntareṇety ādi| pittaprakopaprasarasthānasaṅgrahakālāvadhinā abhi samantato bhāvenābhyuditaṃ kupitaṃ pittaṃ, pittam atra doṣo jñeyaḥ, śoṇitaṃ dūṣyaṃ, tuśabdo 'tra punararthe, vātakaphau vaśe kṛtvā ātmasāt kṛtvā, pākakriyāyāṃ pittasya prādhānyāt| pūrvamate kaphāt pūyaḥ, atra tu ‘śoṇitādibhistātparyārthaḥ’ iti pā.| śoṇitādibhir iti tātparyārthaḥ||12||

div.ab:
kālāntareṇābhyuditaṃ tu pittaṃ kṛtvā vaśe vātakaphau prasahya |
pacaty ataḥ śoṇitam eṣa pāko mataḥ pareṣāṃ viduṣāṃ dvitīyaḥ ||13||
kakṣaṃ samāsādya yathaiva vahnir vāyvīritaḥ sandahati prasahya |
tathaiva pūyo hy aviniḥsṛto hi māṃsaṃ ‘śirāḥ’ iti pā. | sirāḥ snāyu ca khādatīha ||14|| (su. sū. a. 17) |

ab.seg: aviniḥsṛtasya pūyasya doṣam āha– kakṣam ity ādi| kakṣaṃ samāsādyeti kakṣaṃ tṛṇādigahanam||13-14||
ab.note: ‘anirhṛtya pūyasya doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā darśayannāha’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: anirhṛtasya pūyasya doṣaṃ darśayann āha– kakṣam ity ādi| kakṣaṃ tṛṇādīnāṃ samūhaṃ, snāyumūlāḥ ‘śirāḥ’ iti pā.| sirāḥ, vāyvīritaḥ vāyupreritaḥ||13-14||

div.ab:
āmaṃ vidahyamānaṃ ca samyak pakvaṃ ca yo bhiṣak |
jānīyāt sa bhaved vaidyaḥ śeṣās taskaravṛttayaḥ ||15||
yaś chinatty āmam ajñānād yo vā pakvam upekṣate |
śvapacāviva mantavyau tāv aniścitakāriṇau ||16|| (su. sū. a. 17) |

ab.seg: śvapacāviva caṇḍālāviva, mantavyau jñātavyau| śeṣās taskaravṛttaya iti lobhamātraprayuktatvāt taskarā iva śeṣāḥ||15-16||

āmādilakṣaṇajñāne guṇam ajñāne ca doṣaṃ darśayann āha– āmam ity ādi| āmam apakvaṃ, vidahyamānaṃ pacyamānaṃ, samyak pakvaṃ ca, yo bhiṣak jānīyāt, sa vaidyo bhavet āyurvedavit syāt, śeṣā anye āmādijñānavarjitāḥ lobhamātraprayuktatvāt taskarā eva| pakvāpakvayoś chedanāchedanena vaidyadoṣam āha– ya ity ādi| śvapacaś cāṇḍālaḥ, sa hi sarvabhakṣitvāt śvānam api pacati| śeṣaṃ sugamam||15-16||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne vraṇaśothanidānaṃ samāptam ||41||
iti ‘śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyām’ iti pā.| śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ vraṇaśothanidānaṃ samāptam||41||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ vraṇaśothanidānam||41||

div.head: śārīravraṇanidānam
div.ab:
atha śārīravraṇanidānam |
dvidhā vraṇaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ śārīrāgantubhedataḥ |
doṣair ādyas tayor anyaḥ śastrādikṣatasambhavaḥ ||1||
stabdhaḥ kaṭhinasaṃsparśo mandasrāvo mahārujaḥ |
tudyate sphurati śyāvo vraṇo mārutasambhavaḥ ||2||
tṛṣṇāmohajvarakledadāhaduṣṭyavadāraṇaiḥ |
vraṇaṃ pittakṛtaṃ vidyād gandhaiḥ srāvaiś ca pūtikaiḥ ||3||
bahupiccho guruḥ snigdhaḥ stimito mandavedanaḥ |
pāṇḍuvarṇo 'lpasaṅkledaś cirapākī kaphavraṇaḥ ||4|| (ca. ci. a. 25) |
rakto raktasrutī raktād dvitrijaḥ syāt tadanvayaiḥ |5|

śothānām anupakrāntānāṃ vraṇabhāvāpatter vraṇanidānam āha– dvidhety ādi| ‘vraṇa gātravicūrṇane’ ity asmād dhātor vraṇasya sādhutvam uktam| vraṇaniruktiś ca suśrutena kṛtā| yathā–
“vṛṇoti yasmād rūḍhe 'pi vraṇavāstu na naśyati|
ādehadhāraṇāj jantor vraṇas tasmān nirucyate||” (su. sū. a. 21) iti| anya ity āgantuḥ| āgantuvraṇe yady api doṣas tatkālaṃ tadātvena sañcayakopaprasaraṇaśālī vikārakaraṇasamarthaḥ kalpayituṃ śakyate, tathā'pi saptarātraṃ kṣatoṣmanirvāpaṇāya madhusarpirupayogāt śītakriyāvidhānāc ca nijavraṇavilakṣaṇacikitsārthaṃ vyapadiśyate| raktasyaikaikasmin doṣe dvandve ca prasaram āha– dvitrijaḥ syāt tadanvayair ity ādi| raktānvayaiḥ ekaikadoṣair dvandvaiś ca; raktānvitair ekaikadoṣair dvijo vraṇaḥ, raktānvitair dvandvatrayais trijaḥ; evaṃ doṣatraye 'pi raktasambandha ūhanīyaḥ; evaṃ pañcadaśadhā prasaro doṣāṇām upagṛhīto bhavati| athavā'yam arthaḥ– tadanvayair doṣadvandvatrayānvayaiḥ, tena doṣadvayānvayena dvijo dvandvajo vraṇaḥ, doṣatrayānvayena trijaḥ sannipātajaḥ||1-4||–

vraṇaśophānām anupakrāntānāṃ vraṇabhāvāpatter vraṇanidānam| teṣāṃ bhedam āha– dvidhety ādi| ‘vraṇa gātravicūrṇane’ ity asmād dhātoḥ vraṇasya niruktiḥ| vraṇaniruktiś ca suśrute kṛtā| yathā–
“vṛṇoti yasmād rūḍhe 'pi vraṇavāstu na naśyati|
ādehadhāraṇāj jantor vraṇas tasmān nirucyate||” iti| śārīrāgantubhedato vraṇo dvidhā jñeyaḥ, tayor dvayor madhye ādyaḥ śārīraḥ, sa ca doṣaiḥ pavanakaphapittaśoṇitasannipātaiḥ syāt, anya ity āgantuḥ śastrādikṣatasambhavo bhavati| vātikam āha– stabdha ity ādi| stabdhaḥ acalaḥ, tudyate śūleneva, śyāvaḥ śāvavarṇaḥ| paittikam āha– tṛṣṇety ādi| etair liṅgaiḥ pittakṛtaṃ jānīyāt| kleda ārdratā, dāhaduṣṭiḥ dāhavān, avadāraṇaṃ tvaksphoṭanaṃ, pūtikair durgandhaiḥ| kaphajam āha– bahv ity ādi| bahupicchaḥ ‘bhūyaḥ picchaḥ picchilaḥ’ iti pā.| bhūyaḥ picchilaḥ, stimito niścalaḥ, alpasaṅkledaḥ īṣadārdraḥ| raktasyaikasmin doṣe dvandve ca prasaram āha– rakta ity ādi| raktavarṇo bhavati, raktasrāvo vā| dvitrijaḥ syāt tadanvayair iti raktānugaiḥ pṛthagdoṣaiḥ dvandvaiś ca, tena pṛthagdoṣaiḥ saraktaiḥ dvijaḥ, dvandvajaiḥ saraktais trijaḥ, evaṃ tridoṣaje 'pi raktaḥ sambandhanīyaḥ| tad yathā– vātajaḥ, pittajaḥ, śleṣmajaḥ, saṅghātajaḥ, raktajaḥ, vātapittajaḥ, vātaśleṣmajaḥ, pittaśleṣmajaḥ, evam aṣṭau; śoṇitasambandhāt sapta, vātaśoṇitasambandhāt tajjaḥ, ‘śleṣmaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śleṣmaḥ pittaśoṇitajaḥ, śleṣmaśoṇitajaḥ, vātapittaśoṇitajaḥ, vātaśleṣmaśoṇitajaḥ, ‘vātapittaśleṣmaśoṇitajaḥ’ iti pā.| pittaśleṣmaśoṇitajaḥ, sannipātakṣatajaḥ iti; evaṃ doṣāṇāṃ bhedena pañcadaśadhā prasara uktaḥ| athavā tadanvayaiḥ doṣatrayānvayaiḥ, tena doṣadvayānvayena dvijaḥ dvandvajo vraṇaḥ, doṣatrayānvayena trijaḥ sānnipātiko vraṇa ity arthaḥ||1-4||–

tvaṅmāṃsajaḥ sukhe deśe taruṇasyānupadravaḥ ||5||
dhīmato 'bhinavaḥ kāle sukhe sādhyaḥ sukhaṃ vraṇaḥ |
guṇair anyatamair hīnas tataḥ kṛcchro vraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||6||
sarvair vihīno vijñeyas tv asādhyo bhūryupadravaḥ | (ca. ci. a. 25) |

sādhyatvādikam āha– tvag ity ādi| sukhe deśa iti marmarahite dehāvayave| anupadrava iti jvaratṛṣṇādyupadravarahitaḥ| dhīmata iti hitāhitajñasya| kāle sukhe iti hemante śiśire ca| anyatamair iti uktānāṃ guṇānāṃ madhye ekatamair guṇaiḥ||5-6||–

vraṇasya sukhasādhyatvam āha– tvag ity ādi| tvaṅmāṃsajaḥ, sukhe deśe marmarahite dehāvayave, anupadravaḥ jvaratṛṣṇādyupadravarahitaḥ, dhīmataḥ ataralabuddheḥ, sukhe kāle hemante śiśire ca| vraṇasya ‘kaṣṭasādhyatvamāha’ iti pā.| kaṣṭasādhyam āha– guṇair ity ādi| prāguktānāṃ guṇānāṃ madhye anyatamair guṇair hīnaḥ rahitaḥ, tvaṅmāṃsajādīnām ity arthaḥ| sa vraṇaḥ kaṣṭasādhyaḥ| asādhyam āha– sarvair ity ādi| sarvais tvagmāṃsajādikair guṇaiḥ rahitaḥ, ‘bhūryupadravaḥ’ ityatra ‘nirupakramaḥ’ iti pā.| ‘sarvairvihīno'sādhyastu tathaivopadravānvitaḥ’ iti ca pā.| nirupakramaḥ anupakrāntaḥ||5-6||–

duṣṭavraṇaliṅgam āha– pūtir ity ādi| pūyātiduṣṭāsṛksrāvīti pūyayuktam atiduṣṭaṃ raktaṃ satataṃ sravatīty arthaḥ| utsaṅgī koṭaravān| cirasthitir ity anena bahuladoṣasambandhaṃ darśayati| tathā coktam– “anātmavatām ajñaiś copakrāntā vraṇāḥ pradūṣyanti, vṛddhatvād doṣāṇām||” (su. sū. a. 22) iti| duṣṭavraṇa ity atra ‘paribhāṣita’ iti śeṣaḥ| atigandhādir iti ādiśabdena varṇasrāvavedanākṛtayo gṛhītāḥ, atiśabdena ca viśiṣyante| śuddhaliṅgaviparyaya iti vakṣyamāṇaśuddhaliṅgaviparītaḥ pūtitvādiyogād eva| ‘pūtipūyātiduṣṭāsṛksrāvi’ iti kvacit pāṭhe pūtiśabdaḥ pūyaduṣṭāsṛgviśeṣaṇam||7||–

duṣṭavraṇalakṣaṇam āha– pūtir ity ādi| pūtiḥ śaṭitaḥ, “pūtipūyātiduṣṭāsṛksrāvī” iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ, tatra pūtiśabdaḥ pūyaduṣṭāsṛgviśeṣaṇaṃ, pūyayuktam atiduṣṭaraktaṃ satataṃ sravatīty arthaḥ| cirasthitir ity anena bahudoṣasambandhaṃ darśayati| tathā coktam– “anātmavatām ajñaiś copakrāntā vraṇā vṛddhatvād doṣāṇāṃ praduṣyanti” ‘iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| ‘duṣṭe’ iti pā.| duṣṭo vraṇa iti kathitaḥ atigandhādiḥ, ādiśabdena varṇāsrāvavedanākṛtayo gṛhyante| śuddhaliṅgaviparyaya iti vakṣyamāṇaśuddhalakṣaṇaviparītaḥ||7||–

lg.l: suvyavastho nirāsrāvaḥ śuddho vraṇa iti smṛtaḥ |9|

div.ab:
śuddhavraṇalakṣaṇam āha– jihvety ādi| jihvātalābha iti jihvātalavad ābhā prabhā yasya sa tathā; talaśabdaḥ svarūpavacanaḥ| jihvātalābhaśabdaś cātra mṛduślakṣṇasnigdhaśabdaiḥ pratyekam abhisambadhyate; tena jihvātalābho mṛduḥ ślakṣṇaḥ snigdhaś cety āhuḥ| ‘suvyavasthita’ iti pā.| suvyavastha iti utsannotsaṅgitvarahitaḥ| nirāsrāva iti doṣakṛtasrāvarahitaḥ| carake tu paṭhyate–
“nātirakto nātipāṇḍur nātisrāvo na cātiruk|
na cotsanno na cotsaṅgī śuddho ropyaḥ paraṃ vraṇaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 25) iti, taddarśanād atra nirāsrāvatvaṃ doṣakṛtasrāvahīnatvaṃ, vigatavedanatvaṃ ca vātādyuktavedanārahitatvam| vraṇasrāvakṛtavedanāyuktatvaṃ punar asty eva, ata eva rūḍhaliṅge arujam ity uktam||8||–

śuddhavraṇalakṣaṇam āha– jihvety ādi| jihvātalavad ābhā prabhā yasya sa tathā| talaśabdaḥ svarūpavacanaḥ, ‘jihvātalaśabdaścātra’ iti pā.| jihvātalābhaśabdaś cātra mṛduślakṣṇasnigdhaśabdaiḥ saha pratyekam abhisambadhyate; tena jihvātalābho mṛduḥ ślakṣṇaḥ snigdhaś ceti prāhuḥ| suvyavastha iti śobhanākṛtiḥ, tena utsannotsaṅgitvarahitaḥ, kintu sama ity arthaḥ| nirāsrāva iti doṣakṛtāsrāvahīnaḥ| yad uktaṃ carake–
“nātirakto nātipāṇḍur nātisrāvo na cātiruk|
na cotsanno na cotsaṅgī śuddho ropyaḥ paraṃ vraṇaḥ||” ‘iti darśanāt’ iti pā.| iti||8||–

kapotavarṇapratimā yasyāntāḥ kledavarjitāḥ ||9||
sthirāś ca piḍakāvanto rohatīti tam ādiśet | (su. sū. a. 23) | ‘ruhyamāna ... ’ iti pā.|
ruhyamāṇalakṣaṇam āha– kapotety ādi| kapotavarṇapratimā iti pāṇḍudhūsarāḥ, sthirāḥ adaraṇāḥ| ‘cipiṭikāvarṇa’ iti pāṭhāntare cipiṭikā māṃsacelī, tadvarṇaḥ||9||–

rohaṇonmukhavraṇalakṣaṇam āha– kapotety ādi| yasya vraṇasyāntāḥ prāntāḥ kapotavarṇapratimāḥ, pāṇḍudhūsarā ity arthaḥ| kledena varjitāḥ| sthirā acalāḥ kaṭhinā ity arthaḥ| “cipiṭikāvantaḥ” iti pāṭhe cipiṭikā māṃsacelī carmavalīti yāvat, ‘karocaḍī’ iti loke, tā vidyante yeṣāṃ te cipiṭikāvantaḥ||9||–

rūḍhavartmānam agranthim aśūnam arujaṃ vraṇam ||10||
tvaksavarṇaṃ samatalaṃ samyag rūḍhaṃ vinirdiśet | (su. sū. a. 23) |

samyagrūḍhalakṣaṇam āha– rūḍhavartmānam ity ādi| rūḍhavartmānam iti vartma vraṇamārgo vraṇavāstu rūḍho yasya tam| antaḥpūyābhāvād aśūnam arujaṃ ca| tvaksavarṇaṃ tvacāsamānavarṇam| samatalam iti samaṃ talena jihvātalena karatalena vā| agranthim ity anena upari ucchūnatāyā niṣedhaḥ, samatalena tv adhonimnatāyā niṣedhaḥ||10||–

rūḍhavraṇalakṣaṇam āha– rūḍhavartmānam ity ādi| vartma vraṇamārgo vraṇavāstu sa rūḍho yasya tam, agranthiṃ granthirahitam, etena upari utsannatāyā niṣedhaḥ| aśūnaṃ śvayathurahitam, arujaṃ pīḍārahitaṃ, tvaksavarṇaṃ tvacāsamānavarṇam| samatalam iti samaṃ talena jihvātalena karatalena vā, samatalaśabdena tv adho nimnatāyā niṣedhaḥ||10||–

kuṣṭhināṃ viṣajuṣṭānāṃ śoṣiṇāṃ madhumehinām ||11||
vraṇāḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhyanti yeṣāṃ cāpi vraṇe vraṇāḥ |
vasāṃ medo 'tha majjānaṃ mastuluṅgaṃ ca yaḥ sravet ||12||
āgantujo vraṇaḥ siddhyen na siddhyed doṣasambhavaḥ | (su. sū. a. 23) |

ab.seg: vyādhiviśeṣeṇa vraṇasya kṛcchrasādhyatvam āha– kuṣṭhinām ity ādi| kuṣṭhaviśeṣeṇātyantadoṣadūṣitaraktādidūṣyatvena sarvadā duṣṭir adhiketi kṛcchrasādhyatvam| viṣajuṣṭānām iti dūṣīviṣārtānām| śoṣe madhumehe ca dhātukṣayāt, vraṇe ca ‘raktasrāvāccāhāra ... ’ iti pā.| raktasrāvād āhārasaṃyamanād adhikā duṣṭiḥ| vasāṃ medo 'tha majjānaṃ mastuluṅgaṃ ca yaḥ sraved iti majjā asthisnehaḥ, mastuluṅgaṃ ghṛtikā| na sidhyed doṣasambhava iti doṣair atidūṣitānāṃ vasādīnāṃ srāvasya bahuvyāpattikaratvāt||11-12||

div.ab: vyādhiviśeṣeṇa vraṇasya kṛcchrasādhyatvam āha– kuṣṭhinām ity ādi| kuṣṭhaviśeṣeṇātyantadoṣadūṣitaraktādidūṣyatvena sarvadā duṣṭir adhiketi kṛcchratvam| viṣajuṣṭānāṃ dūṣīviṣārtānāṃ, śoṣe madhumehe ca dhātukṣayād vraṇe raktasrāvāc cāhārasaṃyamāc cādhikaduṣṭiḥ| punaḥ kṛcchrasādhyatvam āha– vasety ādi| vasā māṃsasnehaḥ, majjā'sthisnehaḥ, mastuluṅgo mastakābhyantarasnehaḥ, vasādīnāṃ srāvād āgantuje vraṇe kṛcchratvaṃ vā, kintu doṣaje ‘vraṇe'kṛcchratvam’ iti pā.| vraṇe 'sādhyatvaṃ, doṣair atiśayadūṣitānāṃ vasādīnāṃ srāvasya bahuvyāpattikaratvāt||11-12||– ubhayoḥ vyākhyayoḥ ‘ ... sumanā ... ’ iti pā. |

madyāgurvājyasumanaḥpadmacandanacampakaiḥ ||13||
sagandhā divyagandhāś ca mumūrṣūṇāṃ vraṇāḥ smṛtāḥ | (su. sū. a. 28) |
riṣṭarūpāṃ gandhavikṛtim āha– madyāgurvājyety ādi| sumanā jātī, sagandhāḥ samānagandhāḥ, divyagandhā aparikalpitādbhutapārijātādigandhāḥ||13||–
riṣṭarūpāṃ gandhavikṛtim āha– madyety ādi| madyaṃ prasiddham, aguru gandhadravyam, ājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ, sumanā jātī, padmaṃ kamalaṃ, madyādibhiḥ samānagandhāḥ||13||–

ye ca marmasv asambhūtā bhavanty atyarthavedanāḥ ||14||
dahyante cāntar atyarthaṃ bahiḥ śītāś ca ye vraṇāḥ |
dahyante bahir atyarthaṃ bhavanty antaś ca śītalāḥ ||15||
prāṇamāṃsakṣayaśvāsakāsārocakapīḍitāḥ |
pravṛddhapūyarudhirā vraṇā yeṣāṃ ca marmasu ||16||
kriyābhiḥ samyag ārabdhā na sidhyanti ca ye vraṇāḥ |
asyāgre “vraṇe śvayathurāyāsāt sa ca rāgaśca jāgarāt tau ca rukca divāsvāpāt, tāśca mṛtyuśca maithunāt” iti kvacitpustake'dhikaṃ paṭhyate varjayed api tān vaidyaḥ saṃrakṣann ātmano yaśaḥ ||17|| (su. sū. a. 28) |

ab.seg: ye ca marmasv asambhūtā iti| marmasu na jātā api bhṛśavedanāḥ, marmajātatvena hi bhṛśavedanāvattvaṃ yuktam| prāṇamāṃsakṣaya iti prāṇakṣayeṇa śaktikṣayaḥ, māṃsakṣayeṇa copacayakṣayaḥ| anuktam apy aśeṣaṃ riṣṭaṃ saṅgṛhṇann āha– kriyābhir ity ādi||14-17||

punaś cāsādhyatvam āha– ya ity ādi| marmasu na jātā api bhṛśavedanāḥ syuḥ, ‘marmajā tattvena hi bhṛśavedanatvayuktam|’ iti pā.| marmajātatvena hi bhṛśavedanatvaṃ yuktam| ye bahiḥ śītalāḥ, ‘antarmadhyam’ iti pā.| antar madhye atyarthaṃ dahyante| punaś cāsādhyaliṅgatvam āha– prāṇety ādi| prāṇakṣayaḥ śaktikṣayaḥ, māṃsakṣayaḥ upacayakṣayaḥ, marmasu pāyunābhihṛdayādiṣu| punaś cāsādhyatvam āha– kriyābhir ity ādi| pādacatuṣṭayānvitābhiḥ||14-17||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne śārīravraṇanidānaṃ samāptam ||42||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ śārīravraṇanidānaṃ samāptam||42||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ śārīravraṇanidānam||42||

div.head: sadyovraṇanidānam
div.ab:
nānādhāramukhaiḥ śastrair nānāsthānanipātitaiḥ |
bhavanti nānākṛtayo vraṇās tāṃs tān nibodha me ||1||
chinnaṃ bhinnaṃ tathā viddhaṃ kṣataṃ piccitam eva ca |
ghṛṣṭam āhus tathā ṣaṣṭhaṃ teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ||2|| (su. ci. a. 2) |

ab.seg: śārīravraṇam abhidhāyāgantuvraṇam āha– nānādhāramukhair ity ādi| nānā dhārā mukhāni ca yeṣāṃ tāni tathā| sthānaviśeṣo 'pi śastranipātatulyatvenākṛtiviśeṣe hetur ity ata uktaṃ– nānāsthānanipātitair iti||1-2||

atha śārīravraṇam abhidhāyāgantum āha– nānety ādi| nānādhārāmukhaiḥ śastraiḥ, nānāsthānanipātitaiḥ, ebhir nānākṛtayo vraṇā bhavanti, me matsakāśāt tān vraṇān nibodha jānīhi| tatṣāḍvidhyam āha– chinnam ity ādi| evaṃ chinnādibhedena āgantavaḥ ṣaḍvidhā bhavanti||1-2||

div.ab:
tiryak chinna ṛjur vā'pi yo vraṇas tv āyato bhavet |
gātrasya pātanaṃ tad dhi chinnam ity abhidhīyate ||3|| (su. ci. a. 2) |

ab.seg: chinnalakṣaṇam āha– tiryag ity ādi| tiryag iti tiryagvyavasthitaḥ| chinnaḥ chedasampannaḥ| ṛjur avakraḥ| gātrasya pātanam iti gātrāvayavasya tadekadeśarūpasya vā gātrasya pātanam||3||

tatra chinnalakṣaṇam āha– tiryag ity ādi| yo vraṇas tiryak chinno 'thavā ṛjuś chinnaḥ sann āyato bhavet, tiryag iti tiryagvyavasthitaḥ, chinnaḥ chedasampannaḥ| ‘tiraścīnaḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare sa evārthaḥ, ṛjur avakraḥ, anayor dvayor apy āyata iti viśeṣaṇam| ‘atra pātanaṃ nirdiśannāha-’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate| atra pātanaṃ nirdiśann āha– gātrasya pātanam iti gātrasyāvayavasya tadekadeśarūpasya vā gātrasya pātanam| ḍallanas tu vyācaṣṭe– śastrādiprahāreṇa gātrasya hastādeḥ pātanaṃ, cakārād apātanaṃ ca||3||

div.ab:
śaktidanteṣu khaḍgāgraviṣāṇair āśayo hataḥ |
yat kiñcit prasravet tad dhi bhinnalakṣaṇam ucyate ||4|| (su. ci. a. 2) |

ab.seg: bhinnalakṣaṇam āha– śaktīty ādi| viṣāṇaṃ dantaḥ śṛṅgaṃ ca| etad bhinnalakṣaṇaṃ pāribhāṣikaṃ; tena vyadha evāśayadeśe bheda ucyate, āśayadeśarahite tu vyadhaḥ| yat kiñcid ity ādi| yasya mūtrarudhirāder ya āśayo bhinnaḥ sa tat prasravet; tena bastir bhinno mūtraṃ, rudhirāśayo rudhiram ity ādi||4||

bhinnalakṣaṇam āha– śaktīty ādi| śaktyādibhir āśayo hataḥ san yat kiñcit prasravet, tad bhinnalakṣaṇam ucyate| kunto bhallaḥ, viṣāṇaṃ dantaḥ śṛṅgaṃ ca, etad bhinnalakṣaṇaṃ pāribhāṣikaṃ, tena vyadha evāśayadeśe bheda ucyate, āśayarahite tu deśe vyadhaḥ| yat kiñcit prasraved iti kim api nirdeṣṭavyam ity arthaḥ| yasya mūtrarudhirāder yaś cāśayo bhinnaḥ sa tat prasravet; tena bastir bhinno mūtraṃ, udaraṃ medaḥ, purīṣāśayaḥ purīṣaṃ, rudhirāśayo rudhiram iti||4||

div.ab:
sthānāny āmāgnipakvānāṃ mūtrasya rudhirasya ca |
hṛd uṇḍukaḥ phupphusaś ca koṣṭha ity abhidhīyate ||5||
tasmin bhinne raktapūrṇe jvaro dāhaś ca jāyate |
mūtramārgagudāsyebhyo raktaṃ ghrāṇāc ca gacchati ||6||
mūrchā śvāsas tṛṣā''dhmānam abhaktacchanda eva ca |
viṇmūtravātasaṅgaś ca svedāsrāvo 'kṣiraktatā ||7||
lohagandhitvam āsyasya gātradaurgandhyam eva ca |
hṛcchūlaṃ pārśvayoś cāpi viśeṣaṃ cātra me śṛṇu ||8||
āmāśayasthe rudhire rudhiraṃ chardayaty api |
ādhmānam atimātraṃ ca śūlaṃ ca bhṛśadāruṇam ||9||
pakvāśayagate cāpi rujā gauravam eva ca |
adhaḥkāye viśeṣeṇa śītatā ca bhaved iha ||10|| (su. ci. a. 2) |

ab.seg: yatra bhūyasā''māśayānāṃ sthāne bhedavyapadeśas tam āha– sthānānīty ādi| āmasya sthānam āmāśayaḥ agneḥ pacyamānāśayaḥ, ‘pakvasya’ iti pā.| malasya pakvāśayaḥ, mūtrasya bastiḥ, rudhirasya yakṛtplīhānau, hṛt hṛdayaṃ, uṇḍuka ikṣurasapākamalavad yaḥ śoṇitamalas tajja uṇḍukaḥ, sa cāntradeśe vyavasthitaḥ purīṣādhānam iti, phupphusa iti hṛdayasya vāmapārśve raktādhāraḥ ‘phupphusa’ iti khyātaḥ| mūtramārgagudāsyebhyo raktaṃ ghrāṇāc ca gacchatīti bastyādau bhinne mehanagudābhyāṃ raktaṃ niḥsarati, āmāśayādibhede tu mukhaghrāṇābhyāṃ raktanirgamaḥ| svedāsrāva iti svedasyātyantasrutiḥ| pārśvayoś cāpīti śūlam iti sambandhaḥ| me ity avyayaṃ matta ity arthaḥ| āmāśayastha ity ādi ādhmānaṃ raktāvatatatvād vāyoḥ| rujā śūlam| gauravaṃ raktabahutvāt| adhaḥkāye viśeṣeṇa śītateti vyādhiprabhāvāt||5-10||

yatra bhūyasāmāśayānāṃ ‘sthānabhedavyapadeśastamāha’ iti pā.| sthāne bhedavyapadeśas tam āha– sthānānīty ādi| sthānaśabdaḥ āmādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate, āmasya sthānam āmāśayaḥ, agneḥ pacyamānāśayaḥ, pakvasya pakvāśayaḥ, mūtrasya bastiḥ, rudhirasya yakṛtplīhānau, hṛt hṛdayaṃ, uṇḍuka ikṣurasapākamalavac choṇitamalaḥ, tajja uṇḍukaḥ, sa cāntradeśe vyavasthitaḥ purīṣādhānaṃ, phupphusa iti hṛdayasya vāmapārśve ‘phusphusa’ iti pā.| phupphusa iti khyātaḥ| āmādīnāṃ sthānāni koṣṭha ity abhidhīyate| bhinnakoṣṭhasya sāmānyaliṅgam āha– tasminn ity ādi| tatra bastyādau bhinne mehanagudābhyāṃ raktaṃ niḥsarati, āmāśayādibhede tu mukhaghrāṇābhyāṃ raktanirgamaḥ, jvaramūrchādaya upadravā bhavanti, viṇmūtravātānāṃ saṅgo 'pravṛtiḥ, svedāsrāvaḥ svedasyāsrutiḥ| mukhasya lohagandhatā, hṛtpārśvayoḥ śūlam iti sambandhaḥ| atrāpi me matto viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu| raktapūrṇabhedalakṣaṇam āha– āmāśayastha ity ādi| atimātram ādhmānaṃ ādhmātabastir ivodarapūrṇatā, dāruṇaṃ māraṇātmakam| pakvāśayasthitasya raktasya lakṣaṇam āha– pakvety ādi| rujā śūlam| gauravam iti nābher adho boddhavyam| adhaḥkāye viśeṣeṇa śītateti vyādhiprabhāvāt||5-10||

div.ab:
sūkṣmāsyaśalyābhihataṃ yad aṅgaṃ tv āśayaṃ vinā |
uttuṇḍitaṃ nirgataṃ vā tad viddham iti nirdiśet ||11|| (su. ci. a. 2) |

ab.seg: viddhalakṣaṇam āha– sūkṣmāsyaśalyety ādi| āśayaṃ vineti uktāmādyāśayaṃ vinā| uttuṇḍitam anirgataśalyopalakṣaṇaṃ, tenānuttuṇḍitam uttuṇḍitaṃ ca viddhaṃ gṛhyate| nirgatena ca nirgatamukhaṃ viddhaṃ sarvathā nirgataṃ ca gṛhyate; tena tantrāntare “viddham uttuṇḍitam anuttuṇḍitaṃ bhinnaṃ nirbhinnam” iti ‘yaccatuḥprakāramabhihitaṃ’ iti pā.| yac catuṣprakāram abhihitaṃ tat sarvaṃ saṅgṛhītam||11||

viddhalakṣaṇam āha– sūkṣmety ādi| āśayaṃ vinā sūkṣmāsyena śalyena yad aṅgam abhihatam uttuṇḍitaṃ unnamitatvaṅmāṃsam īṣaddṛṣṭamukhaṃ vā, nirgataṃ nirgataśalyam, uttuṇḍitam anirgataśalyopalakṣaṇam| tenānuttuṇḍitaṃ ca viddhaṃ gṛhyate, nirgatena ca vinirgatamukhaṃ viddhaṃ sarvadā nirgataṃ ca gṛhyate, tena tantrāntare viddham uttuṇḍitam anuttuṇḍitaṃ bhinnaṃ nirbhinnam iti catuḥprakāram abhihitaṃ tat saṅgṛhītam||11||

div.ab:
nāticchinnaṃ nātibhinnam ubhayor lakṣaṇānvitam |
viṣamaṃ vraṇam aṅge yat tat kṣataṃ tv abhidhīyate ||12|| (su. ci. a. 2) |

ab.seg: kṣatam āha– nāticchinnam ity ādi| ‘nāticchinnamiti’ iti pā.| nāticchinnaṃ nāvagāḍhacchedam| nātibhinnam iti nātividīrṇāśayam| ubhayor lakṣaṇānvitam iti stokacchedastokāvadaraṇayogād ubhayalakṣaṇayuktam| viṣamaṃ vraṇam aṅge yad iti aṅgavaiṣamyakaraṃ vraṇaṃ yat tat kṣatam||12||

kṣatalakṣaṇam āha– nety ādi| nāticchinnam iti nāvagāḍhacchinnaṃ, nātibhinnam iti nātividīrṇāśayam| ubhayor iti chinnabhinnayor ity arthaḥ| tena stokacchedastokāvadaraṇayogād ubhayalakṣaṇayuktam| viṣamaṃ vraṇam aṅge iti aṅge vaiṣamyakaraṃ vraṇaṃ yat tat kṣatam iti||12||

div.ab:
prahārapīḍanābhyāṃ tu yad aṅgaṃ pṛthutāṃ gatam |
sāsthi tat piccitaṃ vidyān majjaraktapariplutam ||13|| (su. ci. a. 2) |

ab.seg: piccitalakṣaṇam āha– prahārety ādinā| prahāro mudgarādinā, pīḍanaṃ kapāṭādinā| pṛthutām iti cippiṭatām| majjaraktapariplutam ity anena vraṇabhāvāt majjaraktāgamaṃ darśayati| tena yat vraṇaṃ piccitaṃ, tad bhagnasya tathā sadyovraṇasya ca cikitsāviṣayam||13||

piccitalakṣaṇam āha– ‘prahāretyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate| prahārety ādi| prahāro mudgarādinā, pīḍanaṃ karādinā, pṛthutāṃ vipulatāṃ, sāsthi asthikhaṇḍānvitaṃ, majjaraktapariplutam ity anena vraṇabhāvān majjaraktāgamaṃ darśayati, tena yad vraṇaṃ piccitaṃ tad bhagnasya tathā sadyovraṇasya cikitsāviṣayam||13||

div.ab:
gharṣaṇād abhighātād vā yad aṅgaṃ vigatatvacam |
uṣāsrāvānvitaṃ tac ca ghṛṣṭam ity abhidhīyate ||14|| (su. ci. a. 2) |

ab.seg: ghṛṣṭalakṣaṇam āha– gharṣaṇād ity ādi| gharṣaṇāt karkaśavastrādinā| vigatatvacam iti pāṭhaṃ tyaktvā ‘vigatatvacā’ iti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ, vigatatvacopalakṣitam aṅgam| uṣā ‘ūṣmānirgamavadvyathā’ iti pā.| ūṣmanirgamavad vyathā||14||

ghṛṣṭalakṣaṇam āha– gharṣaṇād ity ādi| yad aṅgaṃ gharṣaṇāt karṣaṇāt karkaśavastrādinā abhighātād vā vigatatvacaṃ bhavati, anye ‘vigatatvacā’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti, vigatatvacā lakṣitam aṅgam| uṣā ūṣmānirgamavad vyathā||14||

div.ab:
śyāvaṃ saśothaṃ piḍakācitaṃ ca muhur muhuḥ śoṇitavāhinaṃ ca |
mṛdūdgataṃ budbudatulyamāṃsaṃ vraṇaṃ saśalyaṃ sarujaṃ vadanti ||15||
tvaco 'tītya ‘śirādīni’ iti pā. sirādīni bhittvā vā parihṛtya vā |
koṣṭhe pratiṣṭhitaṃ śalyaṃ kuryād uktān upadravān ||16|| (su. ci. a. 2) |

ab.seg: koṣṭhabhedam āha– tvaca ity ādi| tvaca iti sapta tvacaḥ| ‘śirādīnīti’ iti pā.| sirādīnīti māṃsasnāyvasthisandhīni| parihṛtya veti parihārapakṣe 'pi koṣṭhabhedasya saṅgatatvāt; ‘śirāvyadhaliṅgaṃ’ iti pā.| sirāvyadhaliṅgaṃ cātraiva ‘surendragopapratimaṃ’ ity ādinā vyaktībhaviṣyati| uktān iti pranaṣṭaśalyavijñānīye| tatra hy uktaṃ– “koṣṭhagate tv āṭopānāhau mūtrapurīṣāhāradarśanaṃ ca vraṇamukhād bhavati|” (su. sū. a. 26) iti||15-16||

saśalyavraṇalakṣaṇam āha– śyāvam ity ādi| śyāvaṃ śāvavarṇam| muhur vāraṃ vāraṃ, śoṇitasrāvayuktaṃ, mṛdu komalaṃ, udgataṃ tumbyākārāvasthitabudbudena sadṛśaṃ māṃsaṃ yasya taṃ, sarujaṃ pīḍāyuktam| koṣṭhabhedam āha– tvaca ity ādi| sapta tvacaḥ, sirādīni ‘śirāmāṃsasnāyvasthisandhīni’ iti pā.| sirāmāṃsasnāyvasthisandhīni bhittvā, parihṛtya veti santyajya vā| uktān iti pranaṣṭaśalyavijñānīye| tatra hy uktaṃ, “koṣṭhagate tv āṭopānāhau mūtrapurīṣāhāradarśanaṃ ca vraṇamukhād bhavati” iti||15-16||
asādhyakoṣṭhabhedaliṅgam āha– tatrety ādi| tatra koṣṭhe| antarlohitam iti abhyantarasthitaraktam, aniḥsṛtaraktam iti yāvat| ānaddham ity ānāhavantam||17||
asādhyakoṣṭhāntarbhedaliṅgam āha– tatrety ādi| koṣṭhe antarlohitam abhyantarasthitaraktam, aniḥsṛtaraktam iti| pāṇḍūni śītāni pādakarānanāni yasya taṃ, tathā| ānaddhaṃ ānāhayuktam||17||

div.ab:
bhramaḥ pralāpaḥ patanaṃ pramoho viceṣṭanaṃ glānir athoṣṇatā ca |
srastāṅgatā mūrchanam ūrdhvavātas tīvrā rujā vātakṛtāś ca tās tāḥ ||18||
māṃsodakābhaṃ rudhiraṃ ca gacchet sarvendriyārthoparamas tathaiva |
daśārdhasaṅkhyeṣv atha vikṣateṣu sāmānyato marmasu liṅgam uktam ||19|| (su. sū. a. 25) |

ab.seg: māṃsasirāsnāyvasthisandhimarmasu pañcasu kṣateṣu sāmānyaliṅgam āha– bhrama ity ādi| viceṣṭanaṃ viruddhaceṣṭanaṃ karacaraṇādikṣepādikam| glānir balakṣayaḥ| srastāṅgatā aṅgasandhivisraṃsavad vyathā| mūrchanam indriyamohaḥ| indriyārthoparama indriyāṇāṃ svaviṣayeṣu rūpādiṣu uparamo grahaṇāśaktiḥ| daśārdhasaṅkhyeṣu pañcasu||18-19||

māṃsasandhisirāsnāyvasthimarmasu pañcasu kṣateṣu sāmānyaliṅgam āha– bhrama ity ādi| bhramaś cakrārūḍhasyeva, patanaṃ bhūmau, pramohaḥ manomohaḥ, viceṣṭanaṃ viruddhaceṣṭanaṃ caraṇakṣepaṇādikaṃ, glāniḥ balakṣayaḥ, srastāṅgatā aṅgasandhivisraṃsavad vyathā, śarīraśaithilyaṃ vā, mūrchanam indriyasammohaḥ, pramohas tu manomohaḥ, ūrdhvavāta iti udgārabāhulyaṃ, vātakṛtā rujas tās tā daṇḍāpatānakākṣepakādyāḥ| sarvendriyārthoparamaḥ svaviṣayeṣu rūpādiṣu uparamo grahaṇe 'śaktiḥ, daśārdhasaṅkhyeṣu pañcasu||18-19||

div.ab:
surendragopapratimaṃ prabhūtaṃ raktaṃ ‘sravettatkṣatajaśca’ iti pā. sravet tatkṣayajaś ca vāyuḥ |
karoti rogān vividhān ‘yathoktāñchirāsu’ iti pā. yathoktān sirāsu viddhāsv atha vā kṣatāsu ||20||
kaubjyaṃ śarīrāvayavāvasādaḥ kriyāsv aśaktis tumulā rujaś ca |
cirād vraṇo rohati yasya cāpi taṃ snāyuviddhaṃ puruṣaṃ vyavasyet ||21|| ‘śoṣābhivṛddhistumulā’ iti pā.
śophābhivṛddhis tumulā rujaś ca balakṣayaḥ sarvata eva śothaḥ |
kṣateṣu sandhiṣv acalācaleṣu syāt sarvakarmoparamaś ca liṅgam ||22||
ghorā rujo yasya niśādineṣu sarvāsv avasthāsu ca naiti śāntim |
bhiṣag vipaścid viditārthasūtras tam asthividdhaṃ puruṣaṃ vyavasyet ||23|| (su. sū. a. 25) | ‘śirādayo’ iti pā.|

ab.seg:
sirādayo marmarūpā amarmarūpāś ca santi, tatra pūrvaṃ marmarahitānāṃ ‘śirādīnāṃ’ iti pā.| sirādīnāṃ viddhaliṅgam āha– surendragopety ādi| yathoktān iti śoṇitavarṇanīyoktān| tatra coktaṃ– “tad atipravṛttaṃ śirobhitāpam āndhyam ākṣepādīṃś ca karoti|” iti| viddhāsu bāṇādinā| kṣatāsu khaḍgādinā| kaubjyaṃ kubjatā| tumulā gahanāḥ| sandhiṣv acalācaleṣv iti acaleṣu niśceṣṭeṣu, ‘ācaleṣu’ iti pā.| caleṣu ceṣṭāvatsu; sandhayaś calācalabhedena dvividhāḥ| tathā ca suśrutaḥ–
“śākhāsu hanvoḥ kaṭyāṃ ca ceṣṭāvantaś ca sandhayaḥ|
śeṣās tu sandhayaḥ sarve vijñātavyāḥ sthirā budhaiḥ||” (su. śā. a. 5) iti||20-23||

sirādayo marmarūpā amarmarūpāś ca santi, tatra ‘marmarahitaśirādividdhaliṅgamāha’ iti pā.| marmarahitasirādividdhaliṅgam āha– surendrety ādi| indragopo vārṣikaḥ kīṭaḥ, ‘tatkṣatajaḥ’ iti pā.| tatkṣayajaḥ tasya rudhirasya kṣayāj jāto vāyuḥ, yathoktān iti śoṇitavarṇanīyoktān, tathā coktam– “tad atipravṛttaṃ śirobhitāpam āndhyam ākṣepakādīṃś ca karoti” iti| viddhāsu bāṇādinā, kṣatāsu khaḍgādinā| snāyuviddham āha– kaubjyam ity ādi| yasya kaubjyādicihnaṃ bhavati, taṃ puruṣaṃ snāyuviddhaṃ vyavasyet jānīyāt| kaubjyaṃ kubjatā, tac ca antarbahirāyāmajaṃ dvidhā, avayavāvasādaḥ avayavānāṃ svakarmaṇy asāmarthyaṃ, kriyāsv aśaktiḥ sarvaśarīrasyotkṣepaṇāpakṣepaṇaprasāraṇākuñcanakriyāṇām aśaktiḥ| tumulā gahanāḥ, anye tu vātapittakaphajanitā ekatra vyākulībhūtavedanās tumulā ucyante iti vadanti| sandhividdham āha– śophety ādi| acalācaleṣu sandhiṣu kṣateṣu satsu śophātivṛddhyādiliṅgaṃ syāt| sandhayas tu calācalabhedāt dvividhāḥ| tathā coktaṃ suśrute– “śākhāsu hanvoḥ kaṭyāṃ ca ceṣṭāvantaś ca sandhayaḥ| śeṣās tu sandhayaḥ sarve vijñātavyāḥ sthirā budhaiḥ” iti| karmoparamaḥ karmoparatiḥ| asthividdham āha– ghorā ity ādi| tam asthividdhaṃ jānīyāt, sarvāsv avasthāsu ‘upaśayanāsanādikāsu’ iti pā.| śayanāsanādikāsu, viditārthasūtraḥ adhigataśalyatantraḥ||20-23||

div.ab: yathāsvam etāni vibhāvayec ca liṅgāni marmasv abhitāḍiteṣu |24| (su. sū. a. 25) |

marmarahitānāṃ ‘śirādīnāṃ’ iti pā.| sirādīnāṃ viddhalakṣaṇam abhidhāya ‘śirādimarmaviddhaliṅgamatideśayannāha’ iti pā.| sirādimarmaviddhaliṅgam atideśayann āha– yathāsvam etānīty ādi| vibhāvayec ceti cakāro bhinnakrame; tena etāni liṅgāni tathā sāmānyaliṅgāni ca jānīyād ity arthaḥ|24|–

marmarahitānāṃ ‘śirādīnāṃ’ iti pā.| sirādīnāṃ viddhaliṅgam abhidhāya ‘śirādimarmaliṅgamatideśenāha’ iti pā.| sirādimarmaviddhaliṅgam atideśenāha– yathāsvam ity ādi| vibhāvayec ceti cakāro 'tra bhinnakrame, tenaitāni ‘marmaviddhaśirāliṅgāni’ iti pā.| marmaviddhasirāliṅgāni tathā sāmānyaliṅgāni bhramapralāpādīni pūrvoktāni ca yathāsvaṃ jānīyād ity arthaḥ|24|–
pāṇḍur vivarṇaḥ spṛśitaṃ na vetti yo māṃsamarmaṇy abhipīḍitaḥ syāt ||24|| (su. sū. a. 25) |

ab.seg: anuktamāṃsamarmaṇo viddhasya liṅgam āha– pāṇḍur vivarṇa ity ādi| nanu, ‘śirādividdhaliṅgavat’ iti pā.| sirādividdhaliṅgavat māṃsaviddhaliṅgam api pūrvaṃ kuto nopadiṣṭam? ucyate– kevalamāṃsaviddhasyābahuvyāpatkaratvāt pūrvam anupādānam||24||

māṃsamarmaviddhaliṅgam āha– pāṇḍur ity ādi| vivarṇo vicchāyaḥ| nanu, ‘śirādividdhaliṅgavanmāṃsaviddhaliṅgamapi’ iti pā.| sirādividdhaliṅgavan māṃsaviddhaliṅgam api pūrvaṃ kuto nopadiṣṭaṃ? ucyate– kevalamāṃsaviddhasyābahuvyāpatkaratvāt pūrvam anupādānam||24||

div.ab:
visarpaḥ pakṣaghātaś ca ‘śirāstambho'patānakaḥ’ iti pā. sirāstambho 'patānakaḥ |
mohonmādavraṇarujo jvaras tṛṣṇā hanugrahaḥ ||25||
kāsaś chardir atīsāro hikkā śvāsaḥ savepathuḥ |
ṣoḍaśopadravāḥ proktā vraṇānāṃ vraṇacintakaiḥ ||26|| (ca. ci. a. 25) |

ab.seg: sarvavraṇānām upadravān āha– visarpa ity ādi||25-26||
sarvavraṇānām upadravān āha– visarpa ity ādi| vraṇarujo vraṇapīḍāḥ, vepathuḥ kampaḥ||25-26||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne sadyovraṇanidānaṃ samāptam ||43||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ sadyovraṇanidānaṃ samāptam||43||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ sadyovraṇanidānam||43||

div.head: bhagnanidānam

ab.seg:
atha bhagnanidānam |
bhagnaṃ samāsād dvividhaṃ hutāśa kāṇḍe ca sandhau ca hi tatra sandhau |
utpiṣṭaviśliṣṭavivartitaṃ ca tiryaggataṃ kṣiptam adhaś ca ‘ṣoḍhā’ iti pā. | ṣaṭ ca ||1||

āgantusāmānyāt bhagnanidānam| dvividhaṃ hi bhagnaṃ savraṇam avraṇaṃ ca, tatra savraṇam abhidhāyāvraṇam āha– bhagnaṃ samāsād ity ādi| hutāśa iti agniveśasambodhanaṃ, sampratyupalabhyamāne carakatantre bhagnanidānaṃ na paṭhyate| carake hutāśaśabdenāgniveśo 'bhidhīyate, ekadeśenāpi samudāyapratīteḥ| kāṇḍe ca sandhau ceti sandhivicchinnam ekaṃ, ‘dvitīyaṃ kāṇḍabhagnaṃ;’ iti pā. kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | dvitīyaṃ kāṇḍabhagnaṃ; kāṇḍam asthikāṇḍaḥ, kāṇḍena ca nalakakapālavalayataruṇarucakānāṃ ‘grahaṇam’ iti pā.| grahaḥ, tatra bhagnaṃ kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ; dvayor asthnoḥ, sandhānaṃ sandhiḥ, tadviśleṣaḥ sandhimuktam| tatra sandhāv iti sandhau mukte ‘liṅgam abhidhīyate’ iti śeṣaḥ| nanu kathaṃ sandhimuktaṃ bhagnam ucyate? asthnāṃ hi bhaṅgo yuktaḥ| ucyate– asthiviśleṣo 'tra bhagno 'bhipretaḥ, sa ca kāṇḍabhagne sandhimukte cāstīti na doṣaḥ||1||

āgantutvasāmānyād bhagnam āha– bhagnam ity ādi| taṃ cāgantuvraṇaṃ samāsāt dvividham āhuḥ, katham ity āha– kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ tathā sandhau ceti; sandhivicchinnam ekaṃ, kāṇḍam asthikāṇḍaḥ, kāṇḍena ca nalakakapālavalayataruṇarucakānāṃ grahaṇaṃ, tatra bhagnaṃ kāṇḍe bhagnam| dvayor asthnoḥ sandhānaṃ sandhiḥ, tadviśleṣaḥ sandhimuktam| sandhimuktasya ṣāḍvidhyam āha– utpiṣṭety ādi| tatra sandhāv iti tatra tayoḥ kāṇḍabhagnasandhibhagnayor madhye, sandhau mukte 'pi ‘liṅgam abhidhīyata’ iti śeṣaḥ| utpiṣṭādibhedena ṣoḍhā bhavati| nanu, kathaṃ sandhimuktaṃ bhagnam ucyate? asthnāṃ bhaṅgo yuktaḥ; ucyate asthiviśleṣo 'tra bhagno 'bhipretaḥ, sa ca kāṇḍabhagne sandhimukte cāstīti na doṣaḥ||1||

div.ab: prasāraṇākuñcanavartanogrā ruk sparśavidveṣaṇam etad uktam | sāmānyataḥ sandhigatasya liṅgam... |2|
sandhibhagnasya sāmānyaliṅgam āha– prasāraṇety ādi| prasāraṇākuñcanavartanogrā rug iti prasāraṇādiṣu ugrā ruk| vartanaṃ niṣkriyatayā'vasthānam|1|–
tatra sandhimuktasya sāmānyalakṣaṇam āha– prasāraṇety ādi| prasāraṇādiṣu ugrā ruk vyathā, vartanam iti niṣkriyatayā'vasthānam| etat sāmānyaliṅgam|1|–

ab.seg: ...utpiṣṭasandheḥ śvayathuḥ samantāt ||2||

lg.l: viśeṣato rātribhavā rujā ca, viśliṣṭaje tau ca rujā ca nityam |
vivartite pārśvarujaś ca tīvrās tiryaggate tīvrarujo bhavanti ||3||
kṣipte 'tiśūlaṃ ‘viṣamā rugasthnoḥ’ iti pā. | viṣamatvam asthnoḥ kṣipte tv adho rug vighaṭaś ca sandheḥ |

div.ab: utpiṣṭādiliṅgam āha– utpiṣṭasandher ity ādi| utpiṣṭaṃ dvābhyām asthibhyāṃ sandhau gharṣaṇam| śvayathuḥ samantād iti ubhayabhāge śothaḥ, ubhayataḥ sandhyasthnor gharṣitatvāt| viśeṣato rātribhavā rujā ceti abhighātakupita eva rātrau śaityenātyantaṃ vṛddho vāyuḥ rujāṃ karoti| ‘rātrighūrṇitatvena’ iti pā.| atra cūrṇitatvena mārgāvaraṇāt vātakopa ity arthaḥ| viśliṣṭaje iti viśliṣṭajāte sandhimukte, viśliṣṭaṃ manāk sandhiviśleṣaḥ śithilatāmātraṃ, viśliṣṭam iti bhāve ktaḥ| tau ceti viśliṣṭe rātrirujāsamantācchothau; samantācchotho 'py atrālpo bodhyaḥ, sandher anabhighātāt| sandhivikriyayā asthnor apasṛtatvāt madhyanimnatvaṃ, “utpiṣṭam atha viśliṣṭaṃ sandhiṃ vaidyo ‘vighaṭṭayet’ iti pā.| na ghaṭṭayet|” (su. ci. a. 2) iti vacanāt; manāg vikriyayā vā| rujā ca nityam iti sarvadā rujā balavatī bhavatīty utpiṣṭād viśeṣaḥ| vivartite iti ‘sandhau’ iti śeṣaḥ, vivartite viparītaṃ vartite; vivartanaṃ sandhau ‘ ... rvibhramaṇamārjavatā’ iti pā.| dvayor asthnor vivṛtir vibhramaṇam anārjavatā| pārśvarujaś ca tīvrā iti ‘atyaktasandhisthānayoḥ’ iti pā.| ābhyantarasandhisthānayoḥ pārśvasandhyasthnoḥ ‘pārśvagatatvāttīvrāḥ’ iti pā.| pārśvagamanāt tīvrāḥ pārśvarujaḥ| tiryaggata iti tiryak kṣipte| atra hy ekaṃ sandhyasthi sandhisthānaṃ tyaktvā tiryag yāti| kṣipte 'tīti atikṣipte; ‘ūrdhvam’ iti śeṣaḥ| atra hy ekāsthivikriyayā ubhayāsthivikriyayā vā dvayor apy asthnoḥ parasparātikramaṇaṃ dūragamanaṃ vā; viśliṣṭe tu manāk śithilatāmātram; adhaḥkṣipte tu kiñcidadhogamanam iti viśeṣaḥ| “viṣamāś ca sakthnoḥ” iti pāṭhe tu ‘ruja’ iti śeṣaḥ| kṣipte tv adho rug vighaṭaś ca sandher iti adhaḥkṣipte ruk rujā, sandher vighaṭaś ca vighaṭanam| ‘viruddhaceṣṭā vighaṭasya’ iti pāṭhāntare vighaṭitasya sandher ity arthaḥ| atra adho 'sthigamanam| adhaḥ kṣiptavad ūrdhvaṃ kṣiptasyāpy abhidhāne prāpte anuktir atikṣipte 'varodhāt||2-3||–

viśiṣṭaliṅgam āha– utpiṣṭasandher ity ādi| utpiṣṭaṃ dvābhyām asthibhyāṃ sandhau gharṣaṇaṃ, śvayathuḥ samantād iti ubhayabhāge śophaḥ, ubhayataḥ ‘sandhyasthnorgharṣaṇatvāt|’ iti pā.| sandhyasthnor gharṣaṇāt| viśeṣata ity ādy abhighātakupita eva rātrau śaityenātyantaṃ vṛddho vāyuḥ rujaṃ karoti, atra cūrṇitatvena mārgāvaraṇād vātaprakopa ity arthaḥ| viśliṣṭam āha– viśliṣṭaja ity ādi| viśliṣṭe sandhimukte tau ca nityaṃ ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca rujā ca bhavati| viśliṣṭaṃ manāk sandhiviśleṣaḥ, śithilatāmātraṃ; viśliṣṭam iti bhāve ktaḥ| tenālpaḥ śopho boddhavyaḥ| tau ceti ‘viśliṣṭarātrirujāsamantācchothau’ iti pā.| rātrirujāsamantācchothau, samantācchotho 'py atrālpo bodhyaḥ, sandher anabhighātāt| sandhivikriyayā asthnor apasṛtatvān madhyanimnatvam|
“utpiṣṭam atha viśliṣṭaṃ sandhimuktaṃ tathā cyutam|
‘saghanam’ iti pā.| jaghanaṃ pratipiṣṭaṃ ca bhagnaṃ yat tad vivarjayet||” iti| manāk vikriyayā vā| rujā ca nityam iti sarvadā rujā balavatī bhavatīty utpiṣṭād viśeṣaḥ| vivartitam iti, sandhāv iti śeṣaḥ| vivartite viparītaṃ vartite, vivartanaṃ sandhau dvayor asthnor vivṛtir vibhramaṇam anārjavatā| pārśve rujāś ca tīvrāḥ santi, atyantasandhisthānayoḥ pārśvasandhyasthnoḥ pārśvagatatvāt tīvrāḥ pārśvarujaḥ, cakārāt sandhisaṃśrayayor apy asthnor vyāvartanena pārśvopagamanād viṣamāṅgateti ḍallaṇaḥ| tiryag ity ādi– tiryak kṣipte, sandhāv iti śeṣaḥ| atra hy ekasandhyasthi sandhisthānaṃ tyaktvā tiryag yāti| atikṣiptam āha– kṣipta ity ādi| kṣipte ūrdhvam iti śeṣaḥ| atra tu dvayor api ‘śakthnoḥ’ iti pā.| asthnoḥ parasparātikramaṇaṃ, dūragamanaṃ vā, viśliṣṭe tu manāk śithilatāmātram iti bhedaḥ| adhaḥkṣipte tu kiñcidadhogamanam iti viśeṣaḥ| ayaṃ paṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sakthnor ūrukaṭisandhyor viṣamam iti| ‘śūlaviṣamamiti’ iti pā.| śūlaṃ viṣamam iti kadācid dhīnaṃ kadācid vivṛddham| ‘viṣamāś ca sakthnoḥ’ iti pāṭhāntaram| atra ‘tatra’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| tatra rujā iti śeṣaḥ| adhaḥkṣiptam āha– kṣipte tv ity ādi| adhaḥkṣipte 'dhogate sandhau ruk rujā, sandher vighaṭaś ca, vighaṭo vighaṭanam| ‘viruddhaceṣṭā vighaṭasya’ iti pāṭhāntare vighaṭitasya sandher ity arthaḥ| atrādho 'sthigamanam| adhaḥkṣiptavad ūrdhvakṣiptasyāpy abhidhāne ‘prāpte'nuktamapi ūrdhvakṣiptābhidhānam’ iti pā.| prāpte 'nuktir atikṣipte 'varodhāt||2-3||–

ab.seg: kāṇḍe tv ataḥ karkaṭakāśvakarṇavicūrṇitaṃ piccitam asthichallikā ||4||

lg.l: kāṇḍeṣu bhagnaṃ hy atipātitaṃ ca majjāgataṃ ca sphuṭitaṃ ca vakram |
chinnaṃ dvidhā dvādaśadhā'pi kāṇḍe srastāṅgatā śotharujātivṛddhiḥ ||5||
sarvāsv avasthāsu na śarmalābho bhagnasya kāṇḍe khalu cihnam etat ||6||

ab.seg: ataḥ paraṃ kāṇḍe bhagnam abhidhīyate– kāṇḍe tv ata ity ādi| kāṇḍe ity atra bhagnam iti śeṣaḥ| ata iti ataḥ param| karkaṭaketi ubhayoḥ pārśvayor nipīḍanenāvanatam, ata eva madhye granthir ivonnataṃ karkaṭatulyatvāt karkaṭakam| aśvakarṇeti aśvakarṇavat vipulāsthinirgamād aśvakarṇam| vicūrṇitam iti kṣuṇṇam asthi, tac ca śabdasparśābhyām avagantavyam| piccitam iti yantritaṃ bahuśotham| asthichalliketi challaṃ valkalaṃ tad atrāstīti asthichallikā, atra ‘matvarthīyaṣṭikaṇ’ iti pā.| matvarthīyaṣ ṭhikan| atra tu ā na bhavati, vṛddher anityatvāt| eṣā ‘pārśvagatastokāsthyavayavaviśleṣādbhavati’ iti pā.| pārśvagatastokāsthiviśleṣād bhavati| ‘asthichallitam’ iti vā pāṭhaḥ, challam asya ‘jātam’ iti pā.| sañjātam iti challitam| kāṇḍeṣu bhagnam ity anena kāṇḍabhagnam abhidhīyate, prasāraṇe kampamānaṃ kāṇḍabhagnam| yady api ‘kāṇḍabhagnam’ iti pā.| kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ sarvam eva karkaṭādi, tathā'pi viśiṣṭe kāṇḍabhagne kāṇḍabhagnasañjñeyaṃ boddhavyā| yathā– jāṅgalaśabdo ‘bileśayādau’ iti pā. ‘jāṅgalādyaṣṭavidhamāṃsavarge’ iti vā pā.| jaṅghālādyaṣṭavidhamāṃsavarge ‘sāmānye'pi ṣaḍvidhamāṃsavarge bileśayādau, punareṇādāveva viśeṣe ca vartate|’ iti pā.| sāmānye, viśeṣe punar eṇādāv eva ca vartate| atipātitam iti ‘asthiniḥśeṣitacchinna ... ’ iti pā.| asthi niḥśeṣataś chinnam atipātitam| majjāgatam iti asthyavayavo 'sthimadhyam anupraviśya majjānaṃ niḥsārayatīti majjāgatam| sphuṭitaṃ stokaṃ ‘bahudhā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bahudhā vidīrṇaṃ śūkapūrṇam iva vedanāvat| vakram iti avimuktāsthi kubjībhūtaṃ vakram| vakratā'pi bhagnatvaṃ jñeyam| chinnaṃ dvidheti ekam aṇuvidīrṇaṃ, bahuvidīrṇam anyat; ‘ekatarapārśvalagnamekam’ iti pā.| ekaṃ vidīrṇaṃ, saṃlagnam aparaṃ vidīrṇaṃ dvidhābhūtam; anyas tu vipulaikavidaraṇam ity āha; suśrute etat pāṭitasañjñam| kāṇḍe bhagnasya dvādaśavidhatvaṃ niyamayati– kāṇḍa iti| atra bhagnam iti śeṣaḥ| apiśabdo 'tra bhinnakramaḥ, sa cāvadhāraṇārthaṃ, tena chinnam ity atra sambadhyate| chinnam eva dvidhā, na karkaṭādi||4-6||

div.ab: ataḥ paraṃ kāṇḍe bhagnam āha– kāṇḍe tv ity ādi| chinnaṃ dvidhā kāṇḍe ity atra bhagnam iti śeṣaḥ| ata iti ataḥ param| karkaṭaketi ubhayoḥ pārśvayoḥ nipīḍanenāvanatam, ata eva madhye granthir ivonnataṃ karkaṭatulyatvāt karkaṭakam| aśvakarṇeti aśvakarṇavad vipulāsthinirgamād aśvakarṇam| vicūrṇitam iti kṣuṇṇam asthi, tac ca śabdasparśābhyām avagantavyam| piccitam iti yantritaṃ bahuśotham| asthicchalliketi– challaṃ valkalaṃ, tad atrāstīti asthicchallikā, eṣā ‘pārśvagatastokāsthyavayavaviśeṣādbhavati’ iti pā.| pārśvagatastokāsthyavayavaviśleṣād bhavati| “asthicchallitam” iti vā pāṭhaḥ| challam asya jātaṃ challitam| kāṇḍeṣu bhagnam ity ādi| anena kāṇḍabhagnam ity abhidhīyate| prasāraṇe kampamānaṃ kāṇḍabhagnam| yady api kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ sarvam eva karkaṭakādi, tathā'pi viśiṣṭe kāṇḍe bhagne sañjñeyaṃ boddhavyā| atipātitam iti ‘asthiniḥśeṣitacchinnamatipātitam’ iti pā.| asthi niḥśeṣataś chinnam atipātitam| majjāgatam iti asthyavayavo 'sthimadhyam anupraviśya majjānaṃ niḥsārayatīti majjāgatam| ‘sphuṭitastokam’ iti pā.| sphuṭitaṃ stokaṃ bahudhā vidīrṇaṃ śūkapūrṇam iva vedanāvat| vakram iti avimuktāsthi ‘kubjībhūtavakram’ iti pā.| kubjībhūtaṃ vakraṃ, vakratā'pi bhagnatvaṃ jñeyam| chinnaṃ dvidheti ekam aṇuvidīrṇaṃ, bahuvidīrṇam anyat| kaścid ekatarapārśvalagnam aparatra vidīrṇam ity āha, ‘anyacca’ iti pā.| anyaś ca vipulaikavidaraṇam, etac ca suśrute pāṭitasañjñam| kāṇḍe bhagnasya dvādaśavidhatvaṃ niyamayati– dvādaśadhā'pi kāṇḍa iti kāṇḍe; ity atra bhagnam iti śeṣaḥ| apiśabdo 'tra bhinnakramaḥ, sa cāvadhāraṇārthaḥ, tena chinnam ity atra sambadhyate, chinnam eva dvidhā na karkaṭakādi| sāmānyena kāṇḍabhagnalakṣaṇam āha– srastāṅgatety ādi| ‘kāṇḍabhagnasya etaccihnam’ iti pā.| kāṇḍe bhagnasyaitac cihnaṃ srastāṅgatā śopharujayor ativṛddhiḥ| sampīḍyamāne hastādinā mṛdite sati śabdaḥ, sparśāsahaś ca, tathā spandanatodaśūlā bhavanti| sarvāsu śayanāsanādikāsv avasthāsu śarmalābho na bhavati||4-6||–

lg.l: bhagnaṃ tu kāṇḍe bahudhā prayāti samāsato nāmabhir eva tulyam ||7||

ab.seg: kāṇḍe bhagnasya dvādaśaprakārād apy adhikatvam āha– bhagnam ity ādi| samāsato nāmabhir eva tulyam iti saṅkṣepato nāmānurūpam etad avagantavyam ity arthaḥ||7||
kāṇḍe bhagnasya dvādaśaprakārād apy adhikatvam āha– bhagnam ity ādi| saṅkṣepato nāmānurūpam etad evāvagantavyaṃ, yasyedṛśāsthi bhagnaṃ tasyaiva nāmety arthaḥ||7||

div.ab:
alpāśino 'nātmavato jantor vātātmakasya ca |
upadravair vā juṣṭasya bhagnaṃ kṛcchreṇa sidhyati ||8|| (su. ci. a. 3) |

ab.seg: kaṣṭasādhyatām āha– alpety ādi| vātātmakasyeti vātaprakṛteḥ| upadravair iti upadravā jvarādhmānamūtrapurīṣasaṅgādayaḥ||8||
bhagnasya kṛcchrasādhyatvam āha– alpāśina iti| āhārarahitasya, anātmavato 'pathyāśinaḥ, vātātmakasya vātaprakṛteḥ| upadravair ity ādi upadravā jvaramohamūtrapurīṣasaṅgādayaḥ||8||

div.ab:
bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ kaṭyāṃ tu sandhimuktaṃ tathā cyutam |
jaghanaṃ pratipiṣṭaṃ ca varjayed dhi vicakṣaṇaḥ ||9||
asaṃśliṣṭakapālaṃ ca lalāṭe cūrṇitaṃ ca yat |
bhagnaṃ stanāntare pṛṣṭhe śaṅkhe mūrdhni ca varjayet ||10|| (su. ni. a. 15) |

ab.seg: asādhyatām āha– bhinnaṃ kapālam ity ādi| bhagnam iti vācye bhinnam iti yat kṛtaṃ, tat kapālānāṃ prāyaśo bhedāt| ata evoktam– “kapālāni vibhajyante” (su. śā. a. 5) iti| nanu, kaṭyasthnaḥ kapālasañjñāyā abhāvāt katham ucyate bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ kaṭyām iti? ‘yaduktam’ iti pā.| tad uktaṃ suśrute– “jānunitambāṃsagaṇḍatāluśaṅkhavaṅkṣaṇaśiraḥsu kapālāni|” (su. śā. a. 5) iti; ucyate– nitambagrahaṇena tatra kaṭīgrahaṇād adoṣaḥ; athavā sarvaṃ kapālasañjñitam asthibhinnaṃ, tathā kaṭyāṃ cāsthibhinnaṃ varjayet| asaṃśliṣṭakapālaṃ ceti tu niyamārthaṃ; tena lalāṭe kapālasyāsaṃśliṣṭasyāsādhyatvaṃ, nānyathā bhinnasyeti| bhinnaṃ kapālam iti kāṇḍabhagnam etat| sandhimuktam iti nānāvidham api sandhimuktaṃ kaṭyāṃ na sidhyatīti| cyutam iti adhaḥkṣiptam, anyas tu viśliṣṭam āha; athavā kaṭyāṃ sandhimuktaṃ cyutalakṣaṇaṃ na sarvam| jaghanaṃ pratipiṣṭaṃ ceti jaghanasthāne piṣṭam utpiṣṭam etat tathā cyutam iti ca| sandhimuktaṃ punar viśeṣārtham uktaṃ, viśeṣābhidhānād anyasya kaṭīsandhimuktasya kadācit sādhyatā sūcyate, ata eva cikitsite “tataḥ sthānasthite sandhau” (su. ci. a. 3) iti vakṣyati| asaṃśliṣṭakapālaṃ ca lalāṭe cūrṇitaṃ ca yad iti yathā avidyamānasaṃśleṣaṃ yat kapālaṃ, tathā lalāṭe cūrṇitaṃ ca yat vighaṭitasandhi tad asādhyam| bhagnam iti sāmānyena sandhimuktaṃ kāṇḍabhagnaṃ ca gṛhyate| anye tu bhagnam ity anena kāṇḍabhagnaviśeṣaṃ ‘prasāraṇe kampamānam’ ity anenoktaṃ vadanti| uktaṃ ca bhālukinā– “śaṅkhe mūrdhni stanāntare vā kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ maraṇāya|” iti| stanāntare urasi, mūrdhni cūḍāsthāne||9-10||

asādhyatām āha– bhinnam ity ādi| bhagnam iti vācye bhinnam iti yat kṛtaṃ, tat kapālānāṃ prāyaśo bhedāt| yad uktam ihaiva– ‘kapālāni vibhidyante’ ity ādi| nanu, ‘kaṭyasthikapālasañjñāyā’ iti pā.| kaṭyasthnaḥ kapālasañjñāyā abhāvāt katham ucyate bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ kaṭyām iti? yad uktaṃ suśrute– “jānunitambāṃsagaṇḍatāluśaṅkhavaṅkṣaṇaśirassu kapālāni” iti| ucyate– nitambagrahaṇena tatra kaṭīgrahaṇād adoṣaḥ, athavā sarvaṃ kapālasañjñitam asthibhinnaṃ, chedāt tathā kaṭyāṃ cāsthibhinnaṃ ca varjayet| sandhimuktam ity ādi nānāvidham api sandhimuktaṃ kaṭyāṃ na siddhyati| tathā kaṭyāṃ cyutam iti adhaḥkṣiptaṃ, sañjñeyam| piṣṭam utpiṣṭam asañjñaṃ ca, jaghanaṃ ‘prati’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | prati lakṣīkṛtaṃ na siddhyati| punar varjyaṃ bhagnam āha– asaṃśliṣṭam ity ādi| yathā tathā avidyamānasaṃśleṣaṃ yat kapālaṃ tathā lalāṭe cūrṇitaṃ yat vighaṭitasandhi tad asādhyam| bhagnam iti sāmānyena sandhimuktaṃ kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ ca gṛhyate, anye tu bhagnam iti kāṇḍe bhagnam āhuḥ| yad uktaṃ bhālukinā– “śaṅkhe mūrdhni stanāntare vā kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ maraṇāya|” iti| ‘adhastanāntare’ iti pā.| stanāntare urasi, stanagrahaṇena stanāntaraṃ boddhavyam||9-10||

div.ab:
samyak sandhitam apy asthi durnikṣepanibandhanāt |
saṅkṣobhād vā'pi yad gacched vikriyāṃ tac ca varjayet ||11|| (su. ni. a. 15) |

ab.seg: sarveṣām anavadhānato 'sādhyatvam āha– samyag ity ādi| sandhitaṃ saṃyamitam| durnikṣepanibandhanād iti duḥsthāpanāt tathā duṣṭabandhanāt| saṅkṣobhād veti abhighātabhayādisaṅkṣobhāt| ayam arthaḥ– samyak saṃyamitam api duḥsthāpanāt, sunyastam api duṣṭabandhanāt, sunyastaṃ ‘subandhamapi’ iti pā.| subaddham api saṅkṣobhād vikṛtam asādhyam||11||

sarveṣām anavadhānato 'sādhyatvam āha– samyag ity ādi| durnikṣepanibandhanāt duḥsthāpanāt ‘tathā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tathā duṣṭabandhanāt| saṅkṣobhād veti abhighātabhayādisaṅkṣobhāt| ayam arthaḥ– samyak saṃyamitam api duṣṭabandhanāt tathā sunyastaṃ subaddham api saṅkṣobhāt vikṛtam asādhyam||11||

div.ab:
taruṇāsthīni namyante bhidyante nalakāni ca |
kapālāni vibhajyante sphuṭanti rucakāni ca ||12|| (su. ni. a. 15) |

ab.seg: asthiviśeṣeṇa bhagnaviśeṣam āha– taruṇāsthīnīty ādi| namyante vakrībhavanti, tenātra vakralakṣaṇaṃ bhagnam| ghrāṇakarṇākṣipuṭeṣu taruṇaṃ komalam asthi| bhidyante nalakāni ceti asthyantarānupraveśād bhidyante, atipātitalakṣaṇena ca bhagnena nalakāni yujyante; anye tu dvādaśavidhamapi bhagnam atrecchanti| kapālāni vibhajyanta iti kapāleṣu vidaraṇalakṣaṇo bhagnaḥ| ‘vibhidyante’ iti pāṭhāntaram, arthas tu sa eva| rucakāni dantāḥ, teṣu sphuṭitalakṣaṇo bhagnaḥ| asthīni pañcavidhāni taruṇanalakakapālavalayarucakabhedāt| rucakāni ceti cakārāt valayāny api sphuṭitāni bhavantīti| etat suśrute sphuṭitaṃ bhagnam||12||

asthiviśeṣeṇa bhagnaviśeṣam āha– taruṇety ādi| ghrāṇakarṇākṣikūṭeṣu taruṇāsthīni komalāsthīni, namyante vakrībhavanti| atra vakralakṣaṇaṃ bhagnam| bhidyante nalakānīty ādi| asthyantarānupraveśād bhidyante, atipātitalakṣaṇena ca bhagnena nalakāni yujyante| anye tu dvādaśavidhamapi bhagnamātram icchanti| kapāleṣu vidaraṇalakṣaṇo bhagnaḥ| rucakāni dantāḥ, teṣu sphuṭitalakṣaṇo bhaṅgaḥ| asthīni pañcavidhāni, taruṇanalakakapālavalayarucakabhedāt| cakārād valayāny api sphuṭantīti jñeyam| etac ca suśrute sphuṭitaṃ bhagnam||12||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne bhagnanidānaṃ samāptam ||44||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ bhagnanidānaṃ samāptam||44||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ bhagnanidānam||44||

div.head: nāḍīvraṇanidānam
div.ab:
atha nāḍīvraṇanidānam |
yaḥ śotham āmam atipakvam upekṣate 'jño yo vā vraṇaṃ pracurapūyam asādhuvṛttaḥ |
abhyantaraṃ praviśati pravidārya tasya sthānāni pūrvavihitāni tataḥ sapūyaḥ ||1|| (su. ni. a. 10) |

ab.seg: bhagnasyāpi vraṇasyopekṣayā nāḍī bhavati, ato 'nantaraṃ nāḍīm āha– yaḥ śotham ity ādi| upekṣata iti pīḍanaśodhanādikaṃ na karoti| pracurapūya ity anena gambhīrapākitvam uktam| asādhuvṛttaḥ ahitāhārācāraḥ| sthānāni pūrvavihitānīti vraṇāsrāvavijñānīyoktāni ‘tvaṅmāṃsaśirā ... ’ iti pā.| tvaṅmāṃsasirāsnāyusandhyasthikoṣṭhamarmāṇi||1||

bhagnasyāpi vraṇasyopekṣayā ‘nāḍībhavā ... ’ iti pā.| nāḍīsambhavāt tadanantaraṃ nāḍīm āha– ya ity ādi| ‘yo'jñaḥ pakvam’ iti pā.| yo 'pakvaṃ śopham āmam ity upekṣate pīḍanaśodhanādīni na karoti, athavā yaḥ yuruṣaḥ pracurapūyaṃ vraṇam upekṣate iti sambandhaḥ| pracurapūyam ity anena gambhīrapākitvaṃ darśayati| asādhuvṛttaḥ ahitāhārācāraḥ| sapūyaḥ tasya pūrvoktāni ‘vraṇasrāva ... ’ iti pā.| vraṇāsrāvavijñānīyoktāni ‘tvaṅmāṃsaśirā ... ’ iti pā.| tvaṅmāṃsasirāsnāyusandhyasthikoṣṭhamarmāṇi sthānāni vidāryāntaḥ praviśati||1||

div.ab: tasyātimātragamanād gatir iṣyate ‘ca’ iti pā. | tu nāḍīva yad vahati tena matā tu nāḍī |2| (su. ni. a. 10) |
tasyeti pūyasya| nāḍīveti antaḥśuṣiralatādināḍīvat|2|–

tasyety ādi| pūyasyātimātragamanād gatir iṣyate, iṣyate ceti caśabdo nāḍīniruktipakṣāntarasamuccaye, tām eva nāḍīniruktim āha– nāḍīty ādi| yena hetunā nāḍīva ‘praṇālī vodvahati’ iti pā.| praṇālīva yad vahati, tena hetunā nāḍī matety arthaḥ| ‘ataḥ śuṣiranālā’ iti pā.| antaḥśuṣiranālā nāḍī|2|–
doṣais tribhir bhavati ‘sa’ iti pā. | sā pṛthag ekaśaś ca sammūrchitair api ca śalyanimittato 'nyā ||2|| (su. ni. a. 10) |

ab.seg: tāsāṃ kālāntarasambhavena doṣānubandhena saṅkhyām āha– doṣais tribhir ity ādi| doṣaiḥ pṛthak tisraḥ| ekaśaś ca sammūrchitair iti pratyekaṃ vṛddhyā miśrībhūtais tribhiś caturthī; kārtikas tu sannipatitair ity adhyāhārya ekaśaś ca sannipatitair anyā| sammūrchitaiḥ saṃśliṣṭair aparās tisraḥ| ata evoktaṃ ‘cikitsite’ iti pā.| suśrute– “doṣadvayābhihitalakṣaṇadarśanena tisro gatīr vyatikaraprabhavās tu vidyāt|” (su. ni. a. 10) iti| vyatikaraprabhavā dvandvaprabhavāḥ; api cakārau sārthakāv ity āhuḥ| na coktapañcasaṅkhyāhāniḥ, asmin pakṣe 'tideśenoktayor dvandvasannipātayoḥ sarvatrāgaṇanāt| śalyanimittato 'nyeti āgantur aparety arthaḥ| iti pañca nāḍyaḥ||2||
tāsāṃ kālāntarasambhavena doṣānubandhena saṅkhyām āha– doṣair ity ādi| tribhir doṣais tisraḥ, śalyanimittato 'nyeti āgantur ity arthaḥ| evaṃ pañca nāḍyaḥ||2||

div.ab: tatrānilāt paruṣasūkṣmamukhī saśūlā phenānuviddham adhikaṃ sravati kṣapāsu |3| (su. ni. a. 10) |
vātajām āha– tatrety ādi| adhikaṃ sravati kṣapāsviti ‘śaityādvātavṛddhau’ iti pā.| śaityena vātavṛddhe rātrāv adhikaṃ sravaṇam|3|–
tatra vātajām āha– tatrety ādi| paruṣaṃ karkaśaṃ sūkṣmaṃ mukhaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathā, śaityena vātavṛddhir ato rātrāv adhikaṃ sravati|3|–
pittāt tṛṣājvarakarī paridāhayuktā pītaṃ sravaty adhikam uṣṇam ahaḥsu cāpi ||3|| (su. ni. a. 10) |

ab.seg: pittajām āha– pittād ity ādi| adhikam uṣṇam ahaḥsu ceti divā auṣṇyena pittakopāt||3||
pittajām āha– pittād ity ādi| paridāhaḥ samantāddāhaḥ, adhikam uṣṇam, ahaḥsv iti divaseṣu, auṣṇyena pittaprakopāt||3||

div.ab: jñeyā kaphād bahughanārjunapicchilāsrā stabdhā sakaṇḍur arujā rajanīpravṛddhā |4| (su. ni. a. 10) |

kaphajām āha– jñeyety ādi| bahughanārjunapicchilāsrā iti atrārjunaḥ śvetaḥ, ghanaḥ sāndraḥ, āsraśabda āsrāvaśabdaikadeśapāṭhaḥ, pade 'pi padaikadeśaprayogāt| yathā “je proṣṭhapadānām” ity atra je ity anenaiva jāta ity ucyate| picchilāsrur iti pāṭhe 'py ayam evārthaḥ| āsruśabdaḥ sampadādiṣu pāṭhāt kvibantaḥ, tugabhāvas tv āgamānityatvāt|4|–

śleṣmajām āha– jñeyā ity ādi| bahur adhikaḥ, ghanaḥ sāndraḥ, arjunaḥ śvetaḥ, picchilaḥ āsraḥ āsrāvo yasyāṃ sā tathā| āsraśabdena āsrāva ucyate| anye ‘picchilāsruḥ’ iti paṭhanti| atrāpy ayam evārthaḥ| āsruśabdaḥ sampadāditvāt kvibantaḥ, tugabhāvas tv āgamānityatvāt| rajanīpravṛddheti śaityena śleṣmaṇaḥ prakopāt|4|–

dāhajvaraśvasanamūrchanavaktraśoṣā yasyāṃ bhavanty abhihitāni ca lakṣaṇāni ||4||
tām ādiśet pavanapittakaphaprakopād ghorām asukṣayakarīm iva kālārātrim | (su. ni. a. 10) |
tridoṣajām āha– dāhety ādi| abhihitānīti pratyekaṃ vātādijanāḍīkathitāni| asukṣayakarīm iti māraṇātmikāṃ, kālarātriṃ maraṇakāriṇīṃ yamabhaginīm iva| ‘gatiṃ tv asuharām’ iti pāṭhāntaram||4||–
tridoṣajām āha– dāhety ādi| abhihitānīti pūrvoktadoṣatrayalakṣaṇāni asukṣayakarīm iti māraṇātmikām| kālarātrim iveti mṛtyurūpām iva||4||–

naṣṭaṃ kathañcid anumārgam udīriteṣu sthāneṣu śalyam acireṇa gatiṃ karoti ||5||
sā phenilaṃ mathitam uṣṇam asṛgvimiśraṃ srāvaṃ karoti sahasā sarujā ca nityam | (su. ni. a. 10) |

ab.seg: śalyanimittām āha– naṣṭam ity ādi| naṣṭam adṛśyamānam| kathañcid iti vegakṣayādikāraṇānām aniyamārtham uktam| anumārgaṃ mārgaṃ lakṣīkṛtya| kecit ‘aṇumārgam’ iti paṭhitvā śalyaviśeṣaṇatayā yojayanti| kintv asmin pakṣe 'ṇumārgatvenaiva śalyasyādarśane prayukte kathañcid iti nirarthakaṃ syāt| udīriteṣv iti tvagādiṣu| phenilaṃ phenavantam| mathitam unmathitam| uṣṇam uṣṇasparśam| ete ca dharmāḥ prasāraṇākuñcanādau calatā śalyena māṃsādikṣobheṇa bhavanti||5||

div.ab: śalyanimittām āha– naṣṭam ity ādi| ‘naṣṭam adṛśyamānam’ iti pā.| naṣṭadṛśyamānaṃ, kathañcit pramādāt, anumārgaṃ ‘mārgam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | mārgaṃ lakṣīkṛtya| kecid ‘aṇumārgam’ iti paṭhanti| tatra śalyaviśeṣaṇatayā yojayanti| udīriteṣv iti tvaṅmāṃsādiṣu pūrvokteṣu| sā nāḍī, phenilaṃ phenavarṇam, unmathitam, uṣṇam uṣṇasparśam, ete ca dharmāḥ prasāraṇādau calatā śalyena māṃsādikṣobheṇa bhavanti||5||–
nāḍī tridoṣaprabhavā na sidhyec cheṣāś catasraḥ khalu yatnasādhyāḥ ||6|| (su. ci. a. 17) |

ab.seg: asādhyatvādikam āha– nāḍīty ādi| nanu, nāḍī tridoṣaprabhavā na sidhyed iti punaruktam, asukṣayakarīm ity anenaivāsādhyatvasyoktatvāt| naivam, ayaṃ granthaḥ suśrutena nidānasthānoktam eva tridoṣanāḍyā asādhyatvam anūdya tadanyāsāṃ śeṣatvaniścayena yatnasādhyatvapratipādanāya cikitsite paṭhitaḥ, sa evātra mādhavakareṇa likhita ity adoṣaḥ||6||
asādhyām āha– nāḍīty ādi| śeṣā vātapittakaphaśalyajā iti||6||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne nāḍīvraṇanidānaṃ samāptam ||45||
iti ‘śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyām’ iti pā.| śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ nāḍīvraṇanidānaṃ samāptam||45||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ nāḍīvraṇanidānaṃ samāptam||45||

div.head: bhagandaranidānam

ab.seg:
atha bhagandaranidānam |
gudasya dvyaṅgule kṣetre pārśvataḥ piḍakā''rtikṛt |
bhinnā bhagandaro jñeyaḥ sa ca pañcavidho mataḥ etacchlokānantaraṃ “kaṭīkapālanistodadāhakaṇḍūrujādayaḥ bhavanti pūrvarūpāṇi bhaviṣyati bhagandare” iti kvacitpustake'dhikaṃ paṭhyate|||1||

nāḍīviśeṣatvāt saṅkhyāsāmyāc ca bhagandaranidānam| bhagandarapūrvarūpapiḍakām āha– gudasyety ādi| kṣetre deśe| “saiva bhinnā bhagandaraḥ|” niruktir asya suśrutena kṛtā| tad yathā– “gudabhagabastipradeśadāraṇāt ‘bhagandaraḥ’ iti pā.| bhagandarāḥ|” (su. ni. a. 4) iti| bhagaśabdo gudādyupalakṣaṇam| bhoje 'py uktam–
“bhagaṃ parisamantāc ca gudaṃ bastiṃ tathaiva ca|
bhagavad dārayed yasmāt tasmāj jñeyo bhagandaraḥ||” iti| pūrvarūpaṃ tv asya suśrute paṭhyate; yathā– “kaṭīkapālavedanā gudakaṇḍur dāhaḥ śothaś ca gudasya bhavati|” (su. ni. a. 4) iti| etat sāmānyaṃ pūrvarūpam| kaṭīkapālam atra kaṭīphalakam| pañcavidha iti saṅkhyākathanaṃ raktajadvandvajabhagandarasambhāvanānirāsārtham||1||

nāḍīviśeṣasaṅkhyāsāmānyād vraṇavad upakramād vā'to 'nantaraṃ bhagandaranidānam| tasyāvasthānasaṃśrayatvena lakṣaṇam āha– gudasyety ādi| kṣetre deśe, pārśvataḥ samīpataḥ, piḍakā, saiva bhinnā bhagandarārtikṛt, tasya ca niruktiḥ suśrutena kṛtā– “gudabhagabastipradeśadāraṇād bhagandaraḥ” iti| bhagandaraśabde bhagaśabdo gudādyupalakṣaṇaḥ, bhoje 'py uktam–
“bhagaṃ parisamantāc ca gudaṃ basti tathaiva ca|
bhagavad dārayed yasmāt tasmāj jñeyo bhagandaraḥ||” iti| pūrvarūpaṃ tv asya suśrute paṭhitam, yathā– “kaṭīkapālavedanā gudakaṇḍur dāhaḥ śothaś ca gudasya bhavati” iti| etat sāmānyaṃ pūrvarūpam iti| kaṭīkapālam atra kaṭīphalakam| sa ca pañcavidhaḥ– doṣais trayaḥ, sannipātenaikaḥ, śalyena cāparaḥ, evaṃ pañcavidhasaṅkhyākathanaṃ raktajadvandvajabhagandarasambhāvanānirāsārtham||1||

lg.l: kaṣāyarūkṣais tv atikopito 'nilas tv apānadeśe piḍakāṃ karoti yām |
upekṣaṇāt pākam upaiti dāruṇaṃ rujā ca bhinnā'ruṇaphenavāhinī ||2||
tatrāgamo mūtrapurīṣaretasāṃ vraṇair anekaiḥ śataponakaṃ vadet |3|

ab.seg: śataponakam āha– kaṣāyety ādi| apānadeśa iti gudadeśe| upekṣaṇād iti vimlāpanādyakaraṇāt| rujā ca bhinneti rujā rujānvitā, arśaāder ākṛtigaṇatvād ac, bhinnā vidīrṇā| vraṇair anekaiḥ śataponakaṃ vaded iti śataponakatulyatvāt śataponakaḥ; śataponakaś cālanikā, sahasradhārā ity anye; kiṃ vā śataponakaḥ śūkadoṣe paṭhito vikāraḥ ‘chidrair aṇumukhaiḥ’ ity ādinā, kintu yadi śūkadoṣapaṭhitaśataponakatulyatvam asya tadā ‘chidrairaṇḍamukhai ... ’ iti pā.| chidrair aṇumukhair ity ādinimittasyobhayatra paṭhitatvāt kiṃ tatsādṛśyapravṛtteyaṃ sañjñā, sā vā etatsādṛśyapravṛtteti durvijñānāt tatrāpi cālanikātulyatvam eva pravṛttinimittam iti manyamānena jejjaṭena cālanikātulyatvam atra varṇitam| śataponakavad anekamukhatve vātikabhagandarasvabhāva eva hetuḥ||2||

div.ab: vātikaśataponakam āha– kaṣāyety ādi| upekṣaṇād iti vimlāpanādyakaraṇāt| rujā ca bhinneti rujā rujānvitā, bhinnā vidīrṇā| śataponakatulyatvāc chataponakaḥ śūkadoṣapaṭhito vikāraḥ, cālanikātulyatvam asya śataponakavad anekamukhatvena| tatra ca vātikabhagandarasvabhāva eva hetuḥ, śataponako 'sya nāma||2||–

lg.l: prakopaṇaiḥ pittam atiprakopitaṃ karoti raktāṃ piḍakāṃ gudāśritām ||3||

ab.seg: uṣṭragrīvalakṣaṇam āha– prakopaṇair ity ādi| tadāśupākāhimapūtivāhinīm iti tadeti tatkāle, pittajatvenāśupākā ca sā ahimapūtivāhinī uṣṇapūtivāhinī ca sā āśupākāhimapūtivāhinī tām| atra piḍakāvasthāgatagalavakratvena uṣṭragrīvākāratvaṃ, tenoṣṭragrīvasañjñā||3-4||
pittajam uṣṭragrīvam āha– prakopaṇair ity ādi| uṣṇapūtidurgandhavāhinīm| atrāpi piḍakāvasthāgatagalavakratve uṣṭragrīvākāratvaṃ, tenoṣṭragrīvasañjñā||3-4||
parisrāviṇam āha– kaṇḍūyana ity ādi| parisrāvī kaphajaḥ, sa ca ghanasrāvayogāt parisrāvī||5||
parisrāvisañjñaṃ kaphajaṃ bhagandaram āha– kaṇḍūyana ity ādi| parisrāvī bhagandaraḥ kaphajaḥ, sa ca ghanaparisrāvayogāt parisrāvī| kaṇḍūyanaḥ kaṇḍubahulaḥ||5||

sannipātajaṃ śambūkāvartam āha– bahuvarṇarujāsrāvety ādi| pratyekadoṣajabhagandarapaṭhitavarṇavedanāḥ ‘srāvāśca’ iti pā.| srāvaś ca| śambūkāvartavat pūrṇanadyāḥ ‘śambūkāvartavadāvartena’ iti pā.| śambūkāvartavad āvartanaṃ vedanā doṣagativiśeṣād bhavatīti śambūkāvartaḥ| tathā ca bhojaḥ–
“nadīnāṃ paripūrṇānāṃ śambūkāvartakā yathā|
samuttiṣṭhanti vegena toyavegasamīritāḥ||” iti||6||

sannipātajaṃ śambūkāvartam āha– bahv ity ādi| bahuvarṇeti pratyekadoṣajabhagandarapaṭhitavarṇavedanāsrāvī, śambūkāvartavat laghuśaṅkhavat, pūrṇanadyāḥ śambūkāvarto yathā āvartena ca vedanā doṣagativiśeṣād bhavatīti śambūkāvartaḥ| tathā ca bhojaḥ–
“nadīnāṃ paripūrṇānāṃ śambūkāvartakā yathā|
abhyuttiṣṭhanti vegena toyavegasamīritāḥ||” iti||6||

lg.l: kṣatād gatiḥ pāyugatā vivardhate hy upekṣaṇāt syuḥ krimayo vidārya te |
prakurvate mārgam anekadhā mukhair vraṇais tad unmārgibhagandaraṃ vadet ||7||

ab.seg:
unmārgibhagandaram āgantum āha– kṣatād gatir ity ādi| kṣatād iti kaṇṭakādighātāt| vidārya ta iti te krimayo vidārya mārgaṃ kurvata iti yojanā| anekadhā mukhair anekamukhaiḥ| atronmārgeṇa krimikṛtavimārgeṇa purīṣādigamanād unmārgisañjñā jñeyā| tantrāntare tv arśobhagandaraḥ paṭhitaḥ| tad yathā–
“kaphapitte tu pūrvotthe durnāmāśritya kupyataḥ|
arśomūle tataḥ śothaḥ kaṇḍūdāhārtimān bhavet||
sa śīghraṃ pakvabhinno 'sya kledayan mūlam arśasaḥ|
sravaty ajasraṃ gatibhir ayam arśobhagandaraḥ||” iti| ayam anyatamasmin śataponakādīnāṃ doṣalakṣaṇadarśanād antarbhāvyaḥ||7||

unmārgibhagandaram āgantum āha– kṣatād ity ādi| kṣatāt kaṇṭakādighātāt, ye kṛmayo vidārya mārgaṃ prakurvata iti yojanā| anekadhā mukhair anekamukhair vraṇaiḥ| atronmārgeṇa kṛmikṛtavimārgeṇa purīṣādinirgamād unmārgisañjñā pratītā| tantrāntare tv arśobhagandaraḥ paṭhitaḥ, yathā–
“kaphapitte tu pūrvotthe durnāmāśritya kupyataḥ|
arśomūle tataḥ śophaḥ kaṇḍudāhārtimān bhavet||
sa śīghraṃ pakvabhinno 'sya kledayan mūlam arśasaḥ|
sravaty ajasraṃ gatibhir ayam arśobhagandaraḥ||” iti| ayaṃ śataponakādīnāṃ ‘doṣalakṣaṇadarśanādabhāvaḥ’ iti pā.| doṣalakṣaṇadarśanād antarbhāvyaḥ||7||

div.ab:
ghorāḥ sādhayituṃ duḥkhāḥ sarva eva bhagandarāḥ |
teṣv asādhyas tridoṣotthaḥ kṣatajaś ca viśeṣataḥ ||8|| (su. ni. a. 4) | ‘pratīkāraprayatnopāyamāha’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: pratīkāraprayatnāyāha– ghorā ity ādi| duḥkhā iti duḥkhapradāḥ| kṣatajaś ca viśeṣata iti kṣatajo 'pi ‘...vraṇayogāt’ iti pā.| viśeṣam anekavraṇayogaṃ krimisambhavādikaṃ ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca vīkṣyāsādhyaḥ, ata eva cikitsite asādhyatāṃ pratijñāya kriyāṃ vakṣyati| viśeṣata iti lyablope pañcamī; viśeṣato 'tiśayād asādhya ity arthaḥ, yāpanārthaṃ kriyāvidhir iti| kvacit “kṣatajaś ca bhagandaraḥ” iti pāṭhaḥ| kṣatajo viśeṣataḥ sādhayituṃ ghoraḥ asādhya eva, srāvarūpaviśeṣasya yuktatvād iti gadādharaḥ||8||
asādhyalakṣaṇam āha– ghorā ity ādi| kṣatajo 'pi viśeṣam anekavraṇayogyaṃ krimisambhavādikaṃ vīkṣyāsādhyaḥ||8||

div.ab:
vātamūtrapurīṣāṇi krimayaḥ śukram eva ca |
bhagandarāt sravantas tu nāśayanti tam āturam ||9|| (su. sū. a. 33) |

ab.seg: avasthāyām asādhyatām āha– vātamūtrapurīṣāṇīty ādi| bhagandarāt sravanta ity atra ‘amī viśeṣā’ iti śeṣaḥ||9||
avasthāyām asādhyatām āha– vātety ādi| bhagandarāt sravanta ity atra ‘amī viśeṣā’ iti śeṣaḥ| amī vātādyā viśeṣā bhagandarāt sravantas tam āturaṃ vināśayanti||9||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne bhagandaranidānaṃ samāptam ||46||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ bhagandaranidānaṃ samāptam||46||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ bhagandaranidānam||46||

div.head: upadaṃśanidānam

ab.seg:
athopadaṃśanidānam |
‘ ... dhāvanādatyupasevanādvā’ iti pā. | hastābhighātān nakhadantapātād adhāvanād ratyatisevanād vā |
yonipradoṣāc ca bhavanti śiśne pañcopadaṃśā vividhāpacāraiḥ ||1||

sthānapratyāsatter upadaṃśanidānam āha– hastety ādi| nakhadantapātād iti balavadanurāgodayāt nakhadantacchedasthānatvenānukte 'pi mehane nakhadantapātaḥ; yad uktaṃ kāmaśāstre–
“śāstrasya viṣayas tāvad yāvan mandarasā narāḥ|
pravṛtte raticakre tu na śāstraṃ nāpi ca kramaḥ||” (kā. sū. sāṃ. a. 2) iti| kalahādivaśād vā mehane nakhadantapātaḥ| adhāvanād aprakṣālanāt| ratyatisevanād iti vyavāyasyātyantasevanāt| yonipradoṣād iti dīrghakarkaśaromādiyogād yoniduṣṭeḥ| śiśne mehane| vividhāpacārair iti aśuddhasalilaprakṣālanabrahmacāriṇīgamanādibhiḥ| upadaṃśasañjñā ca daṃśanopādhim antareṇāpi rūḍhā boddhavyā| yady apy abhighātakṣate mehane upadaṃśa āgantuḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ sambhāvyate, tathā'pi tasya doṣaliṅgayuktatayā doṣaja evāntarbhāvaḥ||1||

vraṇatvasāmānyāt sthānapratyāsannatvād upadaṃśanidānam| tasya hetum āha– hastety ādi| nakhadantapātād iti balavadanurāgodayāt prabalakāmarāgavaśāt kāmināṃ mehane dantanakhapāto bhavati| yad uktaṃ kāmaśāstre–
“śāstrasya viṣayas tāvad yāvan mandarasā narāḥ|
raticakre pravṛtte ca na śāstraṃ nāpi ca kramaḥ||” iti| kalahādivaśād vā mehane nakhadantapātaḥ| adhāvanād aprakṣālanāt, atyupasevanād iti vyavāyasyātyantasevanāt, yonipradoṣāt alpamahādvāradīrghakarkaśaromasaṅkīrṇadeśatvādiyonidoṣāt, rogaprabhṛter vā yoniduṣṭeḥ| vividhopacārair iti kṣāroṣṇamalināmbhaḥprakṣālanabrahmacāriṇīgamanādibhiḥ| pañcopadaṃśā iti vātena, pittena, śoṇitena, kaphena, sannipātena; evaṃ pañca| yady apy abhighātakṣate mehane upadaṃśa āgantuḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ sambhavati, tathā'pi tasya doṣaliṅgayuktatayā doṣaja evāntarbhāvaḥ||1||

lg.l: satodabhedaiḥ sphuraṇaiḥ sakṛṣṇaiḥ sphoṭair vyavasyet pavanopadaṃśam |

div.ab: paittikam āha– pītair ity ādi| ‘ ... ṣañjanīyam’ iti pā.| sphoṭair ity anusañjanīyam| evam uttaratrāpi|2|–

vātajopadaṃśalakṣaṇam āha– satodety ādi| ‘bhedo’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhedo dvidhā kriyata iva| vyavasyet jānīyāt| pittajam āha– pītair ity ādi| pittai raktair veti vikalpaḥ, pittena bahukledayutaiḥ ārdratābahulaiḥ, sphoṭair iti śeṣaḥ|2|

lg.l: sphoṭaiḥ sakṛṣṇai rudhiraṃ sravantaṃ raktātmakaṃ pittasamānaliṅgam |
sakaṇḍuraiḥ śothayutair mahadbhiḥ śuklair ghanaiḥ srāvayutaiḥ kaphena ||3||

ab.seg: raktajam āha– raktād ity ādi| raktāt piśitāvabhāsair iti māṃsavat tāmraiḥ sphoṭaiḥ raktāc choṇitāt upadaṃśaṃ vyavasyet| ‘raktaiḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare raktaiḥ śoṇitaiḥ||2-3||

raktajam āha– piśitāvabhāsair ity ādi| māṃsavat tāmraiḥ sphoṭaiḥ raktāt śoṇitāt upadaṃśaṃ vyavasyet| ‘raktaiḥ’ iti pāṭhāntaram, tatra raktaiḥ śoṇitaiḥ| kaphajam āha– sakaṇḍuraiḥ kaṇḍūyutaiḥ, mahadbhiḥ mahatparigrahaiḥ, ghanair nibiḍaiḥ, sphoṭair iti śeṣaḥ||2-3||

div.ab: sannipātajam āha– nānāvidhety ādi| nānāvidhasrāvarujopapannam iti pratyekadoṣoktasrāvavedanāyuktam| trimalopadaṃśam iti tridoṣopadaṃśam|4|–
sannipātajam āha– nānety ādi| pratyekadoṣoktasrāvavedanāyuktam| trimalopadaṃśam iti tridoṣopadaṃśam asādhyam āhuḥ|4|–

lg.l: viśīrṇamāṃsaṃ krimibhiḥ prajagdhaṃ muṣkāvaśeṣaṃ parivarjayec ca ||4||

ab.seg: asādhyatām āha– viśīrṇety ādi| muṣkāvaśeṣam iti viśīrṇasamastamehanamāṃsatvenāvaśiṣṭaphalakoṣamātram||4||

varjyam āha– viśīrṇety ādi| viśīrṇamāṃsaṃ śaṭitamāṃsaṃ, kṛmibhiḥ prajagdhaṃ bhakṣitaṃ, muṣkāvaśeṣam iti śīrṇasamastamehanamāṃsatvenāvaśiṣṭaphalakośamātraṃ, ‘ ... lakṣaṇamupadaṃśam’ iti pā.| evam uktalakṣaṇopadaṃśaṃ parivarjayet||4||

lg.l: sañjātamātre na karoti mūḍhaḥ kriyāṃ naro yo viṣaye prasaktaḥ |
