kālena śothakrimidāhapākair viśīrṇaśiśno mriyate sa tena ||5||

ab.seg: upakrame cikitsākaraṇārtham āha– sañjātety ādi| viṣaye prasakta iti ‘ativyavāyādirataḥ’ iti pā.| ativyavāyarataḥ| kālena cirakālena||5||
upakrame cikitsākaraṇārtham āha– sañjātety ādi| yo mūḍho viṣaye prasaktaḥ vyavāyāditatparaḥ, sa tenopadaṃśena kālena kālāntareṇa mriyate śothādibhir upadravaiḥ praśīrṇaśiśnaḥ galitamehanaḥ||5||

ekasthānatvenātra liṅgārśa āha– aṅkurair ity ādi| aṅkurair aṅkurasadṛśair īṣaddīrghaiḥ, ‘saṅghātairmāṃsasampratānaiḥ’ iti pā.| saṅghātair māṃsapratānaiḥ, ‘sañjātaiḥ’ iti pāṭhe ‘māṃsaiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| tāmracūḍaśikhopamā iti tāmracūḍaḥ, kukkuṭaḥ, taccūḍātulyā| sandhāv iti meḍhrarandhrasandhau, sarvasandhigatety anena sarvasandher uktatvāt| eṣā tridoṣajā, ‘vartiriti yojyam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vartir iti yojyam; ata eva ‘savedanā picchilā ca duścikitsyā tridoṣajā|’ iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ| suśrute kvacit strīṇām apy upadaṃśaḥ paṭhyate| yathā–
“meḍhrasandhau vraṇāḥ kecit kecit sarvāśrayās tathā|
kulatthākṛtayaḥ kecit kecit padmadalopamāḥ||
rujādāhārtibahulāḥ kṛṣṇās todasamanvitāḥ|
śīghraṃ kecid visarpanti śanaiḥ kecit tathā'pare|
strīṇāṃ puṃsāṃ ca jāyante upadaṃśāḥ sudāruṇāḥ||” iti| kintu samānatantreṣv adarśanād etad anārṣam āhuḥ||6-7||

ekasthānatvenātra liṅgārśa āha– aṅkurair ity ādi| aṅkurasadṛśair īṣaddīrghasaṅghātaiḥ māṃsapratānaiḥ| anye sandhāv iti ‘randhrasandhau’ iti pā.| meḍhrarandhrasandhau, sarvasandhigatety anena sarvasandher uktatvāt, eṣā tridoṣajā, ata eva “savedanā picchilā ca duścikitsyā tridoṣajā” iti kvacit paṭhyate| suśrute tu kvacit strīṇām apy upadaṃśāḥ paṭhyante| tad yathā–
“meḍhrasandhau vraṇāḥ kecit kecit sarvāśrayās tathā|
kulatthākṛtayaḥ kecit kecit padmadalopamāḥ||
rujādāhārtibahulāḥ kṛṣṇās todasamanvitāḥ|
strīṇāṃ puṃsāṃ ca jāyante upadaṃśāḥ sudāruṇāḥ||” iti| kintu samānatantreṣv adarśanād etad anārṣam āhuḥ||6-7||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne upadaṃśanidānaṃ samāptam ||47||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyām upadaṃśanidānaṃ samāptam||47||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyakṛtāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyām upadaṃśanidānam||47||

div.head: śūkadoṣanidānam

ab.seg:
atha śūkadoṣanidānam |
akramāc chephaso vṛddhiṃ yo 'bhivāñchati mūḍhadhīḥ |
vyādhayas tasya jāyante daśa cāṣṭau ca śūkajāḥ ||1||

samānasthānatvāc chūkadoṣanidānam āha– akramād ity ādi| śūko jalaśūkaḥ, sa tu viṣajantur jalamalodbhavaḥ saśūkaḥ, tathā śūkapradhāno liṅgavṛddhikaro vātsyāyanādyukto yogaḥ śūka ucyate; tasya doṣo vaikṛtam asamyakkaraṇāt, tato vā doṣo vātādiḥ, tatkṛto vā vikāraḥ, “doṣā api vyādhyākhyāṃ labhante” ity āgamāt; ata eva śūkadoṣavivaraṇe śūkadoṣanimittā vyādhaya eva boddhavyāḥ| evaṃ ca ‘yatra kumbhikādau raktapittotthetyādi ... ’ iti pā.| yad atra ‘kumbhikā raktapittotthā’ ity ādikāraṇāntaropavarṇanaṃ tat śūkakṛtaraktapittādirūpaṃ jñeyam| anye ‘tvādiśabdalābhāt’ iti pā.| tv ādiśabdalopāt śūkādidoṣanidānam āhuḥ| ādiśabdena duṣṭayonigūḍhāntarlomadurbhagāgamanādi gṛhyate; tan na manoharaṃ, “vṛddhiṃ yo 'bhivāñchati” ity anena viśeṣaṇena ‘duṣṭayonyāderayogasya’ iti pā.| duṣṭayonyāder ayogyasya grahītum anarhatvāt| anye tu duṣṭayonyādīny upadaṃśahetutvenoktatvāt nānumanyante; tad anaikāntikam, ekajātīyahetūnām anekarogakaraṇadarśanāt| akramād ity anucitavṛddhikramāt; anucitā ca ‘ ... śūkayogānāmavacāraṇāt’ iti pā.| vṛddhir bhūrivikārakarajalaśūkayogānām ācāraṇāt, jalaśūkayogānāṃ vātsyāyanādau vistaraḥ| yathā–
“bhallātakāsthijalaśūkam athābjapatram antarvidahya matimān saha saindhavena|
etad virūḍhabṛhatīphalatoyapiṣṭam ālepanaṃ ‘mahiṣaviḍimalīkṛte'ṅge’ iti pā.| mahiṣaviḍvimalīkṛte 'ṅge|| sthūlaṃ mahattaraturaṅgamatulyam āśu ‘śephaḥ’ iti pā.| śephaṃ karoty abhimataṃ na hi saṃśayo 'sti||” ity ādi| yac ca jalaśūkarahitam aśvagandhāditailaṃ tad ucitam eva liṅgavardhanam| yad uktam–
“aśvagandhāvarīkuṣṭhamāṃsīsiṃhīphalānvitam|
caturguṇena dugdhena tilatailaṃ vipācayet|| stanaliṅgakarṇapālivardhanaṃ mrakṣaṇād idam||” iti| gadādharas tv āha– liṅgavṛddhir eva kāmaparāyaṇaninditapuruṣaiḥ kriyamāṇā akramaḥ| daśa cāṣṭau ceti aṣṭādaśa; saṅkhyeyanirdeśād eva labdhāyāṃ saṅkhyāyāṃ punas taduktiḥ sammūḍhapiḍakādau dvitvaśaṅkānirāsārtham||1||

samānasthānatvāc chūkadoṣanidānārambhaḥ| tasya samprāptim āha– akramād ity ādi| śūko jalaśūkaḥ, sa tu ‘viṣajanturjalamalodbhavaḥ saśūkaḥ,’ iti pā.| viṣajantur jalamalodbhavo jīvaviśeṣaḥ saśūkaḥ, tatpradhāno liṅgavṛddhau vātsyāyanādiśāstrokto yogaḥ ‘śūka’ iti pā.| śūkadoṣa ucyate, tanmukhyatvāt liṅgavṛddhau anye 'pi yogāḥ śūkāḥ kathyante, tasya doṣo vikāraḥ, śūkasya kāraṇatvāt “kvacid doṣā api vyādhyākhyāṃ labhante” ity āgamāt, ata eva śūkadoṣavivaraṇe śūkadoṣanimittatvāt vyādhaya eva vaktavyāḥ| atra śūkajā iti śūkadoṣajā vyādhayaḥ| akramād iti anucitavṛddhikramāt, anucitā vṛddhiḥ ‘bhūrivikārajalaśūkayogānāmācaraṇāt’ iti pā.| bhūrivikārakarajalaśūkayogānām ācaraṇāt, jalaśūkayogānāṃ vātsyāyanādau vistaraḥ| yathā–
“bhallātakāsthijalaśūkam athābjapatram antarvidahya matimān saha saindhavena|
‘etadvirūḍhabṛhatīphalatoyapiṣṭamālepanam’ iti pā.| etad virūḍhabṛhatīphalajopapiṣṭam ālepanaṃ mahiṣaviḍvimalīkṛte 'ṅge|| sthūlaṃ mahattaraturaṅgamatulyam āśu śephaṃ karoty abhimataṃ na hi saṃśayo 'sti|” ity ādi| yac ca jalaśūkarahitam aśvagandhāditailaṃ, tad ucitam eva liṅgavardhanam| yad uktam–
“ ‘ ... siṃhīda(pha)lānvitam’ iti pā.| aśvagandhāvacākuṣṭhamāṃsīsiṃhīphalānvitam|
caturguṇena dugdhena tilatailaṃ vipācayet| stanaliṅgakarṇapālivardhanaṃ mrakṣaṇād idam||” iti| śephaso liṅgasya| gadādharas tv āha– liṅgavṛddhir eva kāmaparāyaṇaninditapuruṣaiḥ kriyamāṇā akramaḥ| daśa ca aṣṭau ceti aṣṭādaśa, saṅkhyeyanirdeśād eva labdhāyāṃ saṅkhyāyāṃ punas taduktiḥ sammūḍhapiḍakādau dvitvasaṅkhyānirāsārtham||1||

div.ab:
gaurasarṣapasaṃsthānā śūkadurbhugnahetukā |
piḍakā śleṣmavātābhyāṃ jñeyā sarṣapikā tu sā ||2|| (su. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: sarṣapikām āha– gaurety ādi| śūkadurbhugnahetuketi durbhugnaśūkahetukety arthaḥ| piḍakādiṣu ubhayavacanam iti(?) paranipātaḥ durbhugno duravacāritaḥ| ‘śūkadurbhagahetukā’ iti pāṭhāntare śūkanimittā, duṣṭayoninimittā cety arthaḥ||2||

vātaśleṣmajanitāṃ sarṣapikām āha– gaurety ādi| gaurasarṣapatulyā| śūkadurbhugnahetuketi durbhugnaśūkahetukety arthaḥ| ‘piḍakādiṣu ubhayavacanam’ iti paranipātaḥ| durbhugno duravacāritaḥ| “śūkadurbhagahetukī” iti pāṭhāntaram| tatra śūkanimittā duṣṭayoninimittā cety arthaḥ||2||

div.ab: kaṭhinā viṣamair bhugnair vāyunā'ṣṭhīlikā bhavet |3| (su. ni. a. 14) |
aṣṭhīlikām āha– kaṭhinety ādi| viṣamair bhugnair iti vakṣyamāṇaśūkair ity anena sambadhyate| viṣamair iti apraśastaiḥ| aṣṭhīlikā lauhakārasya bhāṇḍīviśeṣa, tattulyatvād aṣṭhīlikā|3|–

aṣṭīlikām āha– kaṭhinety ādi| viṣamair bhugnair iti vakṣyamāṇaśūkair ity anena sambadhyate| viṣamaiḥ apraśastaiḥ, bhugnair vakraiḥ| aṣṭhīlikā lohakārabhāṇḍaviśeṣaḥ, tattulyatvād aṣṭhīlikā; sā ca vātena|3|–

lg.l: śūkair yat pūritaṃ śaśvad grathitaṃ nāma tat kaphāt ||3||

ab.seg: grathitam āha– śūkair ity ādi| śūkair yat pūritaṃ śaśvad grathitam iti śūkaiḥ sarvadā pūritaṃ liṅgaṃ yat granthilaṃ tat grathitam ity arthaḥ; granthitulyatvāt grathitasañjñā||3||

kaphād grathitam āha– śūkair ity ādi| śūkaiḥ sarvadā pūritaṃ liṅgaṃ yat tad grathitam ity arthaḥ| grathitatvād grathitasañjñā| śaśvad iti ahar ahaḥ| śūkapūraṇaṃ śephasi, etenaikadināntarapūraṇaṃ praśastam icchanti kāmatantrācāryāḥ| nityapūraṇād grathitanāmno rogasyotpattiḥ||3||

div.ab: kumbhikā raktapittotthā jāmbavāsthinibhā'śubhā |4| (su. ni. a. 14) |

kumbhikām āha– kumbhikety ādi| kumbhī ‘kumbhīḍulatā’ iti pā., ‘kumbhāḍulatā’ iti ca pā.| kumbhīlatā, tasyāḥ phalaṃ kumbhī; taddhitasya luk; ‘ive pratikṛtau’ ‘iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti kan kumbhīphalavat kumbhikā| aśubheti śubhaṃ śuklaṃ tadvirodhe nañ, kṛṣṇety arthaḥ| ‘āśujā’ iti pāṭhāntaram|4|–

raktapittābhyāṃ kumbhikām āha– kumbhikety ādi| kumbhikā kumbhakārī, tasyāḥ phalaṃ kumbhī, taddhitasya luk “ive pratikṛtau” ‘iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti kan, kumbhīphalavat kumbhikā, tathā jāmbavāsthirūpā jambūphalāsthisadṛśī, aśubhā śubhaṃ śuklaṃ na ‘śubham aśubham’ iti pā.| śubhā aśubhā kṛṣṇety arthaḥ| sā ca raktapittajanitā| ‘āśujā’ iti pāṭhāntaram|4|–
tulyajāṃ tv alajīṃ vidyād yathāproktāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ||4|| (su. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: alajīm āha– tulyajām ity ādi| tulyajām iti pramehapiḍakā alajī tattulyasambhavā, sā ca raktā'sitā sphoṭacitā| tulyatvam eva vivṛṇoti– yathāproktām iti| alajī yathāproktā yādṛśalakṣaṇā tatheyam apīty arthaḥ| eṣā ca kāraṇacikitsābhedāt pramehaṃ vinā liṅga eva sambhavāc ca tataḥ pṛthagbhūtā jñeyā||4||

alajīm āha– tulyajām ity ādi| vicakṣaṇaḥ alajīpiḍakāṃ vidyāt| kimbhūtāṃ? tulyajām iti| pramehapiḍakā alajī, tattulyasambhavā| sā ca raktāsitasphoṭacitā| tulyatvam eva vivṛṇoti– yathāproktām ity ādi| sā alajī yathāproktā yādṛśalakṣaṇā tatheyam apīty arthaḥ| eṣā ca kāraṇacikitsābhedāt pramehaṃ vinā liṅga eva sambhavāc ca tataḥ pṛthagbhūtā jñeyā| iyam api ‘duṣṭaśūkāvadhāraṇājjñeyā’ iti pā.| duṣṭaśūkāvacāraṇāj jñeyā||4||

div.ab: mṛditaṃ pīḍitaṃ yac ca saṃrabdhaṃ vātakopataḥ |5| (su. ni. a. 14) |
mṛditam āha– mṛditam ity ādi| pīḍitam iti adhikṛtatvāt śūkapātānantaraṃ pīḍitam iti jñeyaṃ, pīḍitaṃ ‘liṅgam’ iti śeṣaḥ| saṃrabdhaṃ saśotham|5|–
mṛditam āha– mṛditam ity ādi| saṃrabdhaṃ saśophaṃ tan mṛditaṃ mṛditākhyaṃ rogākrāntaṃ jñeyaṃ, pīḍitam ity adhikṛtatvāt śūkapātānantaraṃ pīḍitam iti jñeyam|5|–
pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasammūḍhe sammūḍhapiḍakā bhavet ||5|| (su. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: sammūḍhapiḍakām āha– pāṇibhyām ity ādi| pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasammūḍhe ity adhikārāt pātitaśūke liṅge pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasammūḍhe piccitāvanate, atrāpi ‘vātakopāt’ ity anuvartate||5||

sammūḍhapiḍakām āha– pāṇibhyām ity ādi| pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasammūḍhe ity atrādhikārāt ‘pīḍitaśūkaliṅge’ iti pā.| pātitaśūke liṅge pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasammūḍhe atyarthaṃ piccitāvanate sammūḍhapiḍakā syāt, atrāpi vātaprakopa ity anuvartate||5||

div.ab:
dīrghā bahvyaś ca piḍakā dīryante madhyatas tu yāḥ |
so 'dhimanthaḥ kaphāsṛgbhyāṃ vedanāromaharṣakṛt ||6|| (su. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: adhimantham āha– dīrghā ity ādi| kaphāsṛgbhyām iti śūkapātakṛtābhyām| evam anyatrāpi sāmānyena śūkadoṣābhihite śūkapāto 'nukto 'pi jñeyaḥ| vedanāromaharṣakṛd iti vedanayā romaharṣaṃ karoti||6||

avamantham āha– dīrghā ity ādi| dīrghā vistīrṇāḥ, bahvyaḥ bahulāḥ| kaphāsṛgbhyām iti śūkapātakṛtābhyām| evam anyatra sarveṣv api sāmānyena śūkadoṣeṣu śūkapāto 'nukto 'pi jñeyaḥ| vedanayā romaharṣaṃ karoti iti vedanāromaharṣakṛt| adhimantha iti sañjñā||6||

div.ab:
piḍakā piḍakāvyāptā pittaśoṇitasambhavā |
padmakarṇikasaṃsthānā jñeyā puṣkarikā tu sā ||7|| (su. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: puṣkarikām āha– piḍekety ādi||7||

puṣkarikām āha– etacca– ‘piḍakāmiśritā yā ca’ iti pā.| piḍakābhiś citety ādi| yā piḍakaiva piḍakābhiś citā vyāptā| padmakarṇikasaṃsthāneti kamalakośatulyā, puṣkariketi sañjñā pittaśoṇitād vijñeyā||7||

div.ab: sparśahāniṃ tu janayec choṇitaṃ śūkadūṣitam |8| (su. ni. a. 14) |
sparśahānim āha– sparśahāniṃ tv ity ādi|8|–
sparśahānim āha– sparśahānim ity ādi| sparśahānināmānaṃ vyādhiviśeṣaṃ, śūkadūṣitaṃ śūkena duṣṭiṃ nītaṃ raktaṃ janayet|8|–

mudgamāṣopamā raktā raktapittodbhavā tu yā ||8||
vyādhir eṣottamā nāma ‘śūkājīrṇanimittataḥ’ iti pā. | śūkājīrṇanimittajā | (su. ni. a. 14) |

uttamām āha– mudgamāṣety ādinā| eṣottamā vyādhiḥ śūkājīrṇanimittajā bhavati, śūkājīrṇaṃ punaḥ punar duravacāritaśūkavikṛtirūpam eva| “vyādhir eṣottamo nāma” iti pāṭhāntare eṣottama iti nirdeśaḥ pūrvatrāsiddhavidher anityatvāt sādhuḥ||8||–

ab.seg: uttamam āha– vyādhir ity ādi| eṣa ‘eṣā uttamā’ iti pā.| uttamo nāma vyādhiḥ śūkājīrṇanimittajo bhavati, śūkājīrṇaṃ punaḥ punar duravacāritaśūkavikṛtirūpam eva, tad eva nimittaṃ tato jāyata iti| ‘ ‘vyādhireṣottamā’ iti pā.| vyādhir eṣottama’ iti nirdeśaḥ| ‘pūrvatrāsandhividhe ... ’ iti pā.| pūrvatrāsiddhavidher anityatvāt sādhuḥ||8||

lg.l: chidrair aṇumukhair liṅgaṃ ‘cittam’ iti pā. | citaṃ yasya samantataḥ ||9||

ab.seg: vātaśoṇitajo vyādhiḥ sa jñeyaḥ śataponakaḥ | (su. ni. 14) ||11||

div.ab: śataponakam āha– chidrair aṇumukhair ity ādinā| chidrair iti duravacāritaśūkadoṣajanitavātaśoṇitajaiḥ, citam upacitam, ata eva cikitsāyāṃ lekhanopadeśaḥ| śataponakaś cālanikā, tattulyatvāt śataponakaḥ||9||–

śataponakam āha– chidrair ity ādi| yasya liṅgaṃ chidraiḥ sūkṣmamukhaiḥ samantataḥ sarvataś citaṃ vyāptaṃ, sa vyādhiḥ śataponako jñeyaḥ| chidrair iti duravacāritaśūkajanitavātaśoṇitajaiḥ| śataponakaś cālanikā, tattulyaḥ śataponakaḥ||9||–
vātapittakṛto jñeyas tvakpāko jvaradāhakṛt ||10|| (su. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: tvakpākam āha– vātapittakṛta ity ādi| śūkadoṣeṣu kvacit kasyacit doṣasyābhidhānaṃ śūkaviśeṣād āhārācārabhedāc ca ‘pūrvaṃ sambandhanīyam’ iti pā.| samarthanīyam||10||

tvakpākam āha– vātety ādi| vātapittakṛtaḥ tvakpākanāmā vyādhir jñeyaḥ| sa ca jvaradāhau karoti| ayaṃ ca duravacāritaśūkadūṣitavātapittaja ity arthaḥ| ‘śūkaṃ doṣeṣu’ iti pā.| śūkadoṣeṣu kvacit kasyacid doṣasyābhidhānaṃ śūkaviśeṣād āhārādibhedāc ca samarthanīyam||10||

div.ab:
kṛṣṇaiḥ sphoṭaiḥ saraktābhiḥ piḍakābhir nipīḍitam |
yasya vāsturujaś cogrā jñeyaṃ tac choṇitārbudam ||11|| (su. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: śoṇitārbudam āha– kṛṣṇaiḥ sphoṭair ity ādinā| piḍakābhir iti svalpābhir nipīḍitaṃ liṅgam iti boddhavyam| yasya vāsturuja iti vāstu vraṇādhiṣṭhānaṃ, tatra rujaḥ, agādhocchritamāṃsaśothatvāt| ‘bastirujaś cogrā’ iti pāṭhāntaram| arbudaṃ duravacāritaśūkajaśoṇitakṛtam||11||

śoṇitārbudam āha– kṛṣṇair ity ādi| piḍakābhir iti svalpābhiḥ nipīḍitaṃ liṅgam iti boddhavyam| yasya vāsturuja iti vāstu vraṇādhiṣṭhānam| ‘tatra rujaḥ’ iti pā.| tatra ugrā rujaḥ, ‘ ... māṃsaśoṣatvāt’ iti pā.| agādhocchritamāṃsaśothatvāt| ‘bastirujaś cogrāḥ’ iti pāṭhāntaram| sarvadā duravacāritaśūkajaśoṇitakṛtam||11||

div.ab: māṃsadoṣeṇa jānīyād arbudaṃ māṃsasambhavam |12| (su. ni. a. 14) |
māṃsārbudam āha– māṃsadoṣeṇety ādi| māṃsadoṣeṇeti śūkapātānantaraṃ prahārādinā kṛtena māṃsadoṣeṇa|12|–
māṃsārbudam āha– māṃsadoṣeṇety ādi| śūkapātānantaraṃ ‘pramehādinā’ iti pā.| prahārādinā kṛtena māṃsadoṣeṇa, atrāpi śoṇitaṃ hetuḥ, māṃsārbudasañjñā|12|–

śīryante yasya māṃsāni yasya sarvāś ca vedanāḥ ||12||
vidyāt taṃ māṃsapākaṃ tu sarvadoṣakṛtaṃ bhiṣak | (su. ni. a. 14) |
māṃsapākam āha– śīryante yasyety ādi| śīryante galanti, sarvāś ca vedanā iti vātapittakaphajāḥ||12||–
māṃsapākam āha– śīryanta ity ādi| śīryante galanti| sarvāś ca vedanāḥ iti vātapittakaphajāḥ, ayaṃ tridoṣajaḥ||12||–
vidradhiṃ sannipātena yathoktam iti nirdiśet ||13|| (su. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: vidradhim āha– vidradhim ity ādi| sannipātena yathoktam iti ‘nānāvarṇarujāsrāvaḥ’ ity ādinā sannipātajavidradhilakṣaṇaṃ vidradhim iha jānīyād ity arthaḥ||13||
vidradhim āha– yathoktam ity ādi| sannipātavidradhilakṣaṇena jānīyāt| vidradhinidānoktaṃ ‘nānāvarṇarujāsrāvaḥ’ ity ādinā||13||

div.ab:
kṛṣṇāni citrāṇy athavā śūkāni saviṣāṇi vā |
pātitāni pacanty āśu meḍhraṃ niravaśeṣataḥ ||14||
kālāni bhūtvā māṃsāni śīryante yasya dehinaḥ |
sannipātasamutthāṃs tu tān vidyāt tilakālakān ||15|| (su. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: tilakālakam āha– kṛṣṇānīty ādi| citrāṇīti nānāvarṇāni| saviṣāṇīti śūkānāṃ saviṣatve 'pi viśeṣārtham uktam| kālānīti kṛṣṇāni, kṛṣṇatilatulyatvāt tilakālakasañjñā| śīryante galanti||14-15||

tilakālakam āha– kṛṣṇānīty ādi| yasya puṃsaḥ śūkāni kṛṣṇāni, athavā citrāṇi, athavā saviṣāṇi, tāni saṃhatyāśu śīghraṃ niravaśeṣataḥ samagraṃ meḍhraṃ pacanti, kṛṣṇāni kṛṣṇavarṇāni, citrāṇīti śuklapītanīlādinānāvarṇāni, saviṣāṇīti śūkānāṃ saviṣatve 'pi viśeṣārtham uktaṃ, tathā kālānīti kṛṣṇāni pariṇatatilaphalavarṇāni bhūtvā śīryanti galanti, tān sannipātajān tilakālakān vidyāt, kṛṣṇatilatulyavarṇatvāt tilakālakasañjñā||14-15||

div.ab:
tatra māṃsārbudaṃ yac ca māṃsapākaś ca yaḥ smṛtaḥ |
vidradhiś ca na siddhyanti ye ca syus tilakālakāḥ ||16|| (su. ni. a. 14) | ‘śūkadoṣeṣvasādhyatāha’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: śūkadoṣeṣv asādhyān āha– tatra māṃsārbudam ity ādi| yac ceti cakāro 'yaṃ bhinnakramaḥ, sa ca na siddhyatīty anantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ; tena sādhyatā'py eṣām aciratvādinā bhavati, ata eva pratyākhyāya cikitsāvidhānam upapannam iti gadādharaḥ| durjñānāt sādhye eva asādhyatāropād asampūrṇāvasthāyām asādhye 'pi kriyāsiddheś ca mā nivartatāṃ bhiṣag iti pratyākhyāya cikitsāṃ kāruṇikatayā ācārya upadiśatīti mantavyam||16||

śūkadoṣeṣv asādhyatām āha– tatrety ādi| tatra teṣu śūkadoṣeṣu madhye yan māṃsārbudaṃ, ‘tathā yo māṃsapākaḥ’ iti pā.| tathā yo māṃsapākaḥ, tathā vidradhiḥ, tathā ye ca tilakālakāḥ syuḥ, ete na sidhyanti| ye ceti cakāro bhinnakramaḥ, sa ca na siddhyatīty anantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| tena sādhyatā'py eṣām aciratvādinā bhavati, ata eva pratyākhyāya cikitsāvidhānam upapannam iti gadādharaḥ||16||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne śūkadoṣanidānaṃ samāptam ||48||
iti ‘śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyām’ iti pā.| śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ śūkadoṣanidānaṃ samāptam||48||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyakṛtāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ śūkadoṣanidānaṃ samāptam||48||

div.head: kuṣṭhanidānam
div.ab:
atha kuṣṭhanidānam |
virodhīny annapānāni dravasnigdhagurūṇi ca |
bhajatām āgatāṃ chardiṃ vegāṃś cānyān pratighnatām ||1||
vyāyāmam atisantāpam atibhuktvā niṣeviṇām |
gharmaśramabhayārtānāṃ drutaṃ śītāmbusevinām ||2||
ajīrṇādhyaśināṃ caiva pañcakarmāpacāriṇām |
navānnadadhimatsyātilavaṇāmlaniṣeviṇām ||3||
māṣamūlakapiṣṭānnatilakṣīraguḍāśinām |
vyavāyaṃ cāpy ajīrṇe 'nne nidrāṃ ca bhajatāṃ divā ||4||
viprān gurūn dharṣayatāṃ pāpaṃ karma ca kurvatām |
vātādayas trayo duṣṭās tvagraktaṃ māṃsam ambu ca ||5||
dūṣayanti sa kuṣṭhānāṃ saptako dravyasaṅgrahaḥ |
ataḥ kuṣṭhāni jāyante sapta caikādaśaiva ca ||6|| (ca. ci. a. 7) |

ab.seg:
aṣṭādaśasaṅkhyārūpeṇa tulyatvāt kuṣṭhanidānam ucyate| viśeṣeṇa kuṣṭhajanakaṃ nidānam āha– virodhīnīty ādi| virodhīni “na matsyān payasā'bhyavaharet” (ca. sū. a. 26) ity ādinoktāni| bhajatām iti pūrveṇa sambadhyate| āgatām iti upasthitavegām| vegāṃś cānyān iti mūtrapurīṣādivegān| vyāyāmam atisantāpam atibhuktveti bhuktvā vyāyāmam atiyujya santāpam atiyujya ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca niṣeviṇām iti etayor eva sevanaśīlānāṃ; niṣeviṇām ity anena saha prathamataḥ sambandhe kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī syāt, tataś ca vyāyāmasyātisantāpasyātiniṣeviṇām iti prayogaḥ ‘prasajjeta’ iti pā.| prasajyeta| “śītoṣṇalaṅghanāhārān kramaṃ muktvā niṣeviṇām” iti pāṭhāntare śītoṣṇādīnāṃ ‘yadā yena krameṇa’ ityasya sthāne ‘yathākrameṇa’ iti pā.| yadā yena krameṇa sevyatvam uktaṃ, tadvaiparītyena tān sevyamānān| śītoṣṇalaṅghanāhārān ity anantaraṃ pratīti draṣṭavyaṃ, tena śītoṣṇādīn prati yaḥ kramas taṃ muktvā eteṣām eva niṣeviṇām| gharmaśramabhayārtānām iti gharmādibhir ārtatve sati drutam aviśramya śītāmbusevinām| gharma ātapaḥ| ajīrṇādhyaśinām iti ajīrṇam āmam annam, apakvam iti yāvat, tad bhuñjānānām; adhyaśinām āhāre evāpariṇate bhuñjānānām| aśinām iti ajīrṇādhiśabdābhyāṃ saha ‘sambadhyate’ iti pā.| sambandhyate| pañcakarmāpacāriṇām iti pañcakarmaṇi kriyamāṇe apacāriṇām| navānnadadhimatsyānīti atiśabdo navānnādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ sambadhyate| vyavāyaṃ cāpy ajīrṇa iti ‘vidagdhādirūpe'nne’ iti pā.| vidagdhādirūpe ajīrṇe| dharṣayatām iti abhibhavatām| pāpaṃ karma ca kurvatām ity anenaiva viprādidharṣaṇe labdhe punas tadvacanaṃ viśeṣārtham| doṣadūṣyasaṅgraham āha– vātādaya ity ādinā| vātādīnāṃ tritve pratīte 'pi traya iti vacanaṃ sarvakuṣṭheṣu militānām eva trayāṇāṃ duṣṭipradarśanārtham| dravyasaṅgraha iti dravyam ārambhakaṃ kāraṇam ucyate; yathā– “rasanārtho rasas tasya dravyam āpaḥ kṣitis tathā|” (ca. sū. a. 1) iti| arthalabdham api saptakam iti padaṃ sarvatra saptakaniyamārthaṃ punar uktam| nanu, visarpāṇāṃ samutpāde etāvaty eva sāmagrī, yad uktam–
“raktaṃ lasīkā tvaṅmāṃsaṃ dūṣyaṃ doṣās trayo malāḥ|
visarpāṇāṃ samutpattau vijñeyāḥ sapta dhātavaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 21) iti| ‘lasīkāvacca’ iti pā.| lasīkayā ca tatrodakam ucyate, tat kinnibandhanaḥ kuṣṭhavisarpayor bhedaḥ? ucyate– kuṣṭhaṃ cirakriyaiḥ sthirair aprabalaraktapittair doṣair janyate, visarpas tv aciravisarpaṇaśīlaiḥ prabalaraktapittaiḥ; kuṣṭhe gurupradharṣaṇaparadravyāpahārādayo nimittaṃ, na visarpe| anye tv āhuḥ– visarpā vātādibhir ekaikaśo 'pi bhavanti, yad uktam– “pṛthak trayas tribhiś caiko visarpā dvandvajās trayaḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 21) iti, kuṣṭhaṃ tu tridoṣajam eveti| kiṃ tv etat samādhānaṃ tridoṣajatve 'pi visarpāṇām ekadoṣajakuṣṭhavad ekadoṣajatvakīrtanaṃ saṅgatam iti na manoharam| ataḥ kuṣṭhānīti ata ity asmāt doṣadūṣyasamudāyāt| sapta caikādaśaiva ceti vicchedapāṭhena saptānāṃ mahākuṣṭhatvam ekādaśānāṃ kṣudratvam iti bodhayati||1-6||

aṣṭādaśarūpasaṅkhyātulyatvāt kuṣṭhanidānam ucyate| viśeṣeṇa kuṣṭhajanakaṃ nidānam āha– virodhīnīty ādi| etad ācaratāṃ nṛṇāṃ kuṣṭhāni jāyante iti sambandhaḥ| virodhīni kṣīramatsyādīni bhajatām iti sambadhyate| āgatām iti upasthitavegāṃ chardiṃ, tathā vegāṃś cānyān iti mūtrapurīṣādivegān, pratighnatāṃ pratighātaṃ kurvatām| vyāyāmam atisantāpam atibhuktveti bhuktvā vyāyāmam atiyujya santāpam atiyujya niṣeviṇām iti| etayor eva sevanaśīlānāṃ, niṣeviṇām ity anena prathamataḥ sambandhe kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī syāt; tatra vyāyāmasyātisantāpasyātiniṣeviṇām iti prayogaḥ prayujyate| śītety ādi śītoṣṇādīnāṃ tu yadā yena krameṇa sevyatvam uktaṃ, tadvaiparītyena tān sevamānānām| gharma ātapaḥ| ajīrṇādhyaśinām ity ādi| ajīrṇam anagnipakvam annaṃ, carvaṇam iti yāvat, tadbhojinām| adhyaśinām, āhāra evāpariṇate bhuñjānānām| aśinām iti ajīrṇādhibhyāṃ saha sambadhyate| pañcakarmāpacāriṇām iti pañca karmāṇi vamanavirekādīni, teṣām apacāriṇāṃ vyāpattvayoginām| navānnadadhimatsyātīti, atiśabdo navānnādiguḍāntaiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| vyavāyaṃ cāpy ajīrṇe 'nne ity ādi| vyavāyaṃ maithunaṃ, vidagdharūpe ajīrṇe; divā ca nidrāṃ bhajatām| dharṣayatām iti abhibhavatām| pāpaṃ karma ca kurvatām ity anenaiva viprādidharṣaṇe labdhe punas tadvacanaṃ viśeṣārthapratipādakam| doṣadūṣyasaṅgraham āha– vātādaya ity ādi| vātādīnāṃ tritve pratīte 'pi traya iti vacanaṃ sarvakuṣṭheṣu militānām eva trayāṇāṃ duṣṭipradarśanārtham| dravyasaṅgraha iti dravyam ārambhakaṃ kāraṇam ucyate| yathā– “rasanārtho rasas tasya dravyam āpaḥ kṣitis tathā|” iti| arthalabdham api saptakam iti padaṃ sarvatra saptakaniyamārthaṃ punar uktam| nanu, visarpāṇām apy utpattyādau etāvaty eva sāmagrī| yad uktam–
“raktaṃ lasīkā tvaṅmāṃsaṃ dūṣyaṃ doṣās trayo malāḥ|
visarpāṇāṃ samutpattau vijñeyāḥ sapta dhātavaḥ||” iti| tat kuṣṭhavisarpayoḥ ko bhedaḥ? ucyate– kuṣṭhaṃ cirakriyaiḥ sthirair aprabalaraktapittair doṣair janyate, visarpas tv aciravisaraṇaśīlaiḥ prabalaraktapittaiḥ, kuṣṭhe gurupradharṣaṇaparadravyāpahārādayo nimittaṃ, na visarpe| anye tv āhuḥ– visarpā vātādibhir ekaikaśo 'pi bhavanti, yad uktam– “pṛthak trayas tribhiś caiko visarpā dvandvajās trayaḥ|” iti; kuṣṭhaṃ tridoṣajam eveti| kintv ayaṃ samādhiḥ tridoṣajatve 'pi visarpāṇām ekadoṣakuṣṭhavad ekadoṣajatvakīrtanaṃ saṅgatam iti na manoharam| kuṣṭhasaṅkhyām āha– ata ity ādi| ata ity asmād doṣadūṣyasamudāyāt sapta tathā ekādaśa kuṣṭhāni jāyante| sapta caikādaśaiveti vicchedapāṭhena saptānāṃ mahākuṣṭhatvam ekadaśānāṃ kṣudratvam iti bodhayati||1-6||

div.ab:
kuṣṭhāni saptadhā doṣaiḥ pṛthag dvandvaiḥ samāgataiḥ |
sarveṣv api tridoṣeṣu vyapadeśo 'dhikas tv ataḥ ||7|| (vā. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: kuṣṭhānāṃ tridoṣajatve 'pi ulbaṇadoṣeṇa saptaprakāratām āha– kuṣṭhānīty ādi| doṣaiḥ pṛthak trayaḥ, dvandvais trayaḥ, samāgataiḥ sannipātair eka iti saptatvam| vyapadeśo 'dhikaṃ tv ataḥ iti yathā– vātena kuṣṭhaṃ kāpālam ity ādi||7||

kuṣṭhānāṃ tridoṣajatve 'py udrekadoṣeṇa saptaprakāratvam āha– kuṣṭhānīty ādi| kuṣṭhāni saptadhā saptaprakārāṇi, katham ity āha pṛthag doṣaiḥ vātena, pittena, śleṣmaṇā, trīṇi; tathā tair eva doṣair dvandvair vātapittābhyāṃ, vātakaphābhyāṃ, kaphapittābhyāṃ trīṇi, tathā tair eva doṣaiḥ samāgataiḥ sannipatitair ekam, iti saptatvam| nanv evaṃ saty ekadoṣajaṃ dvidoṣajaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ tat sarvaṃ tridoṣajaṃ syād ity āha– sarveṣv ity ādi| sarveṣv api kuṣṭheṣu tridoṣajeṣu ayamevameva pāṭhamūrīkaroti| satsv adhikatvataḥ adhikatvād vyapadeśo nirdeśaḥ kāryaḥ, sannipātasya samaviṣamatvāt; yathā– vātena kuṣṭhaṃ kāpālam ity ādi||7||

div.ab:
atiślakṣṇakharasparśasvedāsvedavivarṇatāḥ |
dāhaḥ kaṇḍūs tvaci svāpas todaḥ koṭhonnatir bhramaḥ ||8||
vraṇānām adhikaṃ śūlaṃ śīghrotpattiś cirasthitiḥ |
rūḍhānām api rūkṣatvaṃ nimitta'lpe 'tikopanam ||9||
romaharṣo 'sṛjaḥ kārṣṇyaṃ kuṣṭhalakṣaṇam agrajam | (vā. ni. a. 14) |

pūrvarūpam āha– atiślakṣṇety ādinā| atiślakṣṇaḥ atimasṛṇaḥ| kharo rūkṣaḥ ‘atiślakṣṇo vā kharo vā sparśaḥ (kharaḥ karkaśaḥ)|’ iti pā.| (kharaḥ karkaśaḥ), atiślakṣṇo vā kharo vā sparśaḥ| svedāsvedau svedavahasroto 'varodhānavarodhakṛtau| svāpaḥ sparśājñānam| koṭhonnatiḥ varaṭīdaṣṭasaṅkāśaḥ śothaḥ koṭhaḥ, tasyonnatiḥ| śīghrotpattiś cirasthitiś ca vraṇānām eva| nimitte 'lpe 'tikopanam iti anyathā'pi duṣṭaśoṇitatvād vraṇānāṃ dehagatānām alpe 'pi hetau kopaḥ| kuṣṭhalakṣaṇam agrajam iti kuṣṭhānāṃ pūrvarūpam ity arthaḥ||8-9||–

pūrvarūpam āha– atīty ādi| atiślakṣṇādikaṃ kuṣṭhalakṣaṇam aprajam iti kuṣṭhānāṃ pūrvarūpam ity arthaḥ| atiślakṣṇa iti atimasṛṇaḥ, kharo rūkṣaḥ, atra ‘atha vā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| atiślakṣṇo vā kharaḥ sparśaḥ| svedā'svedāv iti svedavahasrotovarodhānavarodhakṛtau| vivarṇatā vaivarṇyaṃ, dāhaḥ sarvāṅgīṇaḥ, kaṇḍūḥ tvaci, svāpaḥ sparśājñatvaṃ, koṭhonnatiḥ varaṭīdaṃśasaṅkāśaḥ śophaḥ koṭhaḥ tasyonnatiḥ, ‘bhramaḥ’ ityatra ‘śramaḥ’ iti pā.| śramo 'nāyāsajaḥ| śīghrotpattiś cirasthitiḥ vraṇānām eva| alpe 'pi nimitte kopo vraṇānām||8-9||–

kṛṣṇāruṇakapālābhaṃ yad rūkṣaṃ paruṣaṃ tanu ||10||
kāpālaṃ todabahulaṃ tat kuṣṭhaṃ viṣamaṃ smṛtam |
rugdāharāgakaṇḍūbhiḥ parītaṃ romapiñjaram ||11||
udumbaraphalābhāsaṃ kuṣṭham audumbaraṃ vadet |
śvetaṃ raktaṃ sthiraṃ styānaṃ snigdham utsannamaṇḍalam ||12||
kṛcchram anyonyasaṃyuktaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ maṇḍalam ucyate |
karkaśaṃ raktaparyantam antaḥśyāvaṃ savedanam ||13||
yad ṛṣyajihvasaṃsthānam ṛṣyajihvaṃ tad ucyate |
saśvetaṃ raktaparyantaṃ puṇḍarīkadalopamam ||14||
sotsedhaṃ ca sarāgaṃ ca puṇḍarīkaṃ tad ucyate |
śvetaṃ tāmraṃ tanu ca yad rajo ghṛṣṭaṃ vimuñcati ||15||
prāyaś corasi tat sidhmam alābukusumopamam |
yat kākaṇantikāvarṇaṃ sapākaṃ tīvravedanam ||16||
tridoṣaliṅgaṃ tat kuṣṭhaṃ kākaṇaṃ naiva sidhyati | (ca. ci. a. 7) |

saptamahākuṣṭhānāṃ lakṣaṇam āha– kṛṣṇāruṇakapālābham ity ādi| kṛṣṇāruṇakapālābhaṃ kṛṣṇāruṇakapālavarṇaṃ, kapālaṃ ‘śarkarāśakalam’ iti pā., ‘karkarāśakalam’ iti ca pā.| kharparaśakalam| paruṣaṃ kharasparśam| tanu tanutvak, viṣamaṃ duścikitsyam| ‘audumbaramāha– rugityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | audumbaram āha– rug ity ādi| romapiñjaram iti romabhiḥ piñjaraṃ kapilaromam ity arthaḥ| ‘maṇḍalakuṣṭhamāha– śvetetyādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | maṇḍalakuṣṭham āha– śvetety ādi| sthiraṃ kaṭhinaṃ, ‘styānaṃ sāndraṃ sadalaṃ vā|’ iti pā.| styānam ārdraṃ sajalaṃ vā| utsannamaṇḍalam udgatamaṇḍalam| kṛcchraṃ kṛcchrasādhyam| anyonyasaṃyuktam iti aparāparair militam| ‘ṛṣyajihvamāha– karkaśamityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ṛṣyajihvam āha– karkaśam ity ādi| ṛṣyajihvasaṃsthānam iti ṛṣyo nīlāṇḍo hariṇaḥ, ‘‘robhu’ iti prasiddhaḥ,’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ‘robhu’ iti prasiddhaḥ, tasya jihvākāram| ‘puṇḍarīkamāha– saśvetamityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | puṇḍarīkam āha– saśvetam ity ādi| puṇḍarīkadalopamam iti puṇḍarīkaṃ raktapadmaṃ tatpatropamaṃ, tena saśvetaṃ raktaparyantam| sarāgam iti salohitaṃ, madhye ‘saśvetalohitamityarthaḥ’ iti pā.| śvetalohitam ity arthaḥ| ‘sidhmalakṣaṇamāha– śvetamityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sidhmalakṣaṇam āha– śvetam ity ādi| śvetaṃ tāmram iti śvetalohitātmakam| prāyaś corasīty urasi tadbāhulyena bhavati, kaphapradhānatvāt| prāyograhaṇād anyatrāpi bhavati| ‘kākaṇamāha– yadityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kākaṇam āha– yad ity ādi| yat kākaṇantikāvarṇam iti kākaṇantikā guñjā| guñjāsavarṇatvena ca madhye kṛṣṇam ante raktam, athavā madhye raktam ante kṛṣṇam| kuṣṭhatvenaiva ‘tridoṣajalakṣaṇatve’ iti pā.| tridoṣalakṣaṇatve siddhe tridoṣaliṅgam iti punar uktaṃ prabaladoṣatrayaliṅgatvopadarśanārtham| iti saptamahākuṣṭhāni| mahattvaṃ caiṣāṃ śīghram uttarottaradhātvavagāhanabahudoṣajatvakriyābhūyastvayogāt||10-16||–

saptamahākuṣṭhānāṃ lakṣaṇam āha– kṛṣṇety ādi| kṛṣṇāruṇā ye sphuṭitaghaṭyāḥ khaṇḍās tadvarṇam, anye kṛṣṇāruṇakapālaśarkarāvarṇam āhuḥ| rūkṣaṃ rūkṣasparśaṃ, paruṣaṃ kharasparśam| tanu tanutvak, todabahulaṃ todāḍhyaṃ, viṣamaṃ duścikitsyam| audumbaraṃ kuṣṭham āha– rug ity ādi| rugdāharāgakaṇḍūbhir yuktaṃ, romapiñjaram iti romabhiḥ piñjaraṃ kapilaroma ity arthaḥ| udumbaraphalābhāsaṃ pakvodumbaravarṇam| maṇḍalakuṣṭham āha– śvetam ity ādi| evaṃvidhaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ maṇḍalaṃ maṇḍalasañjñayocyate, śvetaṃ raktaṃ tadābhāsaṃ, sthiraṃ kaṭhinaṃ, styānaṃ sāndraṃ sadalaṃ vā, utsannamaṇḍalaṃ unnatamaṇḍalaṃ, kṛcchraṃ kṛcchrasādhyaṃ, ayamevameva pāṭhamūrīkaroti| anyonyasaṃsaktam iti, ‘aparāparairmilitam’ iti pā.| parasparair militam| ‘yadṛkṣajihvasaṃsthānamṛkṣajihvam’ iti pā.| ṛkṣajihvam āha– karkaśam ity ādi| karkaśaṃ kharasparśam| ṛkṣo nīlāṇḍo hariṇa iti, anye ṛkṣaḥ ‘rīcha’ ity āhuḥ, tajjihvākāram| puṇḍarīkam āha– saśvetam iti| puṇḍarīkaṃ śvetakamalaṃ, tasyopamaṃ, tena saśvetaṃ raktaparyantaṃ madhye śvetaṃ prānteṣu raktam| sotsedham unnatam| sarāgam iti prānte 'dhikarāgapratipādakaṃ, sarāgam ity atra ‘sadāham’ iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ| sidhmalakṣaṇam āha– śvetam ity ādi| śvetaṃ tāmram iti śvetalohitātmakaṃ, tanu aghanaṃ, yat ghṛṣṭaṃ sad rajaś cūrṇaṃ muñcatīti| prāyaś corasīty ādi| urasi bāhulyena bhavati, kaphapradhānatvāt| prāyograhaṇād anyatrāpi boddhavyam| kākaṇam āha– yad ity ādi| kākaṇantikā guñjā, tatsamavarṇatvena madhye kṛṣṇam ante 'tiraktam, athavā raktam ante kṛṣṇaṃ, tathā sapākaṃ, tathā tīvravedanaṃ, tathā tridoṣaliṅgaṃ, tat kākaṇākhyaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ naiva sidhyati| kuṣṭhatvenaiva tridoṣaliṅgatve siddhe tridoṣaliṅgam iti punar uktaṃ ‘tat’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tat prabaladoṣatrayaliṅgopadarśanārtham| iti sapta mahākuṣṭhāni| mahattvaṃ caiṣāṃ śīghram uttarottaradhātvavagāhanabahuladoṣajanyatvakriyābhūyastvayogāt||10-16||–

asvedanaṃ mahāvāstu yan matsyaśakalopamam ||17||
tad ekakuṣṭhaṃ, carmākhyaṃ bahalaṃ hasticarmavat |
śyāvaṃ kiṇakharasparśaṃ paruṣaṃ ‘kiṭṭibham’ iti pā., ‘kiṭṭimam’ iti pā., ‘kiṭimam’ iti vā pā. | kiṭibhaṃ smṛtam ||18||
vaipādikaṃ pāṇipādasphuṭanaṃ tīvravedanam |
kaṇḍūmadbhiḥ sarāgaiś caḥ gaṇḍair alasakaṃ citam ||19||
sakaṇḍūrāgapiḍakaṃ dadrumaṇḍalam udgatam |
raktaṃ saśūlaṃ kaṇḍūmat sasphoṭaṃ ‘dalayatyapi’ iti pā. | yad galaty api |
tac carmadalam ākhyātaṃ saṃsparśāsaham ucyate ||20|| (ca. ci. a. 7) |
sūkṣmā bahvyaḥ piḍakāḥ srāvavatyaḥ pāmety uktāḥ kaṇḍumatyaḥ sadāhāḥ |
saiva sphoṭais tīvradāhair upetā jñeyā pāṇyoḥ kacchur ugrā sphicoś ca ||21||
sphoṭāḥ śyāvāruṇābhāsā visphoṭāḥ syus tanutvacaḥ |
raktaṃ śyāvaṃ sadāhārti śatāruḥ syād bahuvraṇam ||22||
sakaṇḍūḥ piḍakā śyāvā bahusrāvā vicarcikā | (ca. ci. a. 7) |

ataḥ param ekādaśakṣudrakuṣṭhāny ucyante– asvedanam ity ādi| mahāvāstu mahāsthānam| matsyaśakalopamam iti matsyasya tvaksadṛśam| carmākhyaṃ carmakuṣṭham| ‘bahulamapattalam’ iti pā.| bahalam apattalam| ‘kiṭibhamāha– śyāvamityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kiṭibham āha– śyāvam ity ādi| kiṇakharasparśam iti kiṇo vraṇasthānam| paruṣaṃ rūkṣam| vaipādikam iti vipādikāyāḥ svārthe 'ṇ| ‘alasakamāha– kaṇḍūmadbhirityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | alasakam āha– kaṇḍūmadbhir ity ādi| gaṇḍair iti sphoṭaiḥ| ‘dadrumaṇḍalamāha– kaṇḍvityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | dadrumaṇḍalam āha– kaṇḍv ity ādi| dadrumaṇḍalam iti maṇḍalarūpatayotpādāt dadrumaṇḍalam iti kīrtanam| nanu, katham asya carake kṣudratvenābhidhānaṃ, suśrute mahākuṣṭhe dadror uktatvāt; tathā sidhma carake mahākuṣṭhe, suśrute kṣudrakuṣṭhe darśitam| ucyate– asitā dadrur avagāḍhamūlā suśrute mahākuṣṭham, asitetaradadruś carake 'navagāḍhamūlā kṣudrakuṣṭhaṃ, suśrute asitetaradadrvā visarpakuṣṭhe 'ntarbhāvaḥ, visarpaṇayogāt; tathā'vagāḍhaṃ sidhma carake mahākuṣṭhaṃ, sidhmapuṣpikā tu tvaṅmātragatā suśrute kṣudrakuṣṭham; asitadadrau asitasidhmano 'varodha iti gadādharaḥ| jejjaṭas tv āha– carakoktaṃ sidhmaiva suśrute dadruśabdābhihitaṃ, nāmabhedaḥ kevalaṃ paraṃ na vastubhedaḥ, santi hy arthāntarāṇi samānaśabdābhihitānīty avirodhaḥ| kintv iyam asādhvī vyākhyā, lakṣaṇavailakṣaṇyāt; kiñ ca carakasuśrutayoḥ kuṣṭhaṃ prati bahuprakāro virodhaḥ, tathā hi suśrutoktam aruṇaṃ na carake paṭhyate, maṇḍalaṃ carakoktaṃ na suśrute, kṣudrakuṣṭhe carakoktacarmākhyālasakaśatāruprabhṛtīni na suśrute, ‘suśrutoktakṣudrakuṣṭhārakasādayaśca’ iti pā.| suśrutoktakṣudrakuṣṭhālasakādayaś ca na carake; tasmād ayaṃ samādhir ucitaḥ– kuṣṭhānām asaṅkhyeyatvam iti kecit carake, kecit suśrute kuṣṭhaprakārā ucyante| uktaṃ hi carake– “kuṣṭhaṃ saptavidham, aṣṭādaśavidham, asaṅkhyeyaṃ vā|” (ca. ni. a. 5) iti| ‘carmadalamāha– raktamityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | carmadalam āha– raktam ity ādi| yad galaty apīti galati vidīryate| ‘śatārumāha– raktetyādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śatārum āha– raktety ādi| śatārur iti bahuvraṇayogānvitaṃ nāma| ‘vicarcikāmāha– sakaṇḍvityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vicarcikām āha– sakaṇḍv ity ādi| sakaṇḍūḥ piḍakā śyāvā bahusrāvā vicarciketi atra kaphakāryaṃ kaṇḍūḥ, bahusrāvatvaṃ pittāt, śyāvatvaṃ vātāt; evaṃ sarvatra doṣatrayaliṅgam ūhyam| nanu, ekakuṣṭham ārabhya vicarcikāparyantena dvādaśakṣudrakuṣṭhāni bhavanti, tat katham ekādaśeti? ucyate– vicarcikaiva pādayor bhavantī vidāraṇayogād vipādikā bhavati, tena na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| tathā ca bhojaḥ–
“doṣāḥ pradūṣya tvaṅmāṃsaṃ pāṇipādasamāśritāḥ|
piḍakāṃ janayanty āśu dāhakaṇḍūsamanvitām||
dālyate tvak kharā rūkṣā pāṇyor jñeyā vicarcikā|
pāde vipādikā jñeyā sthānānyatvād vicarcikā||” iti gadādharaḥ| anye tv āhuḥ– saiva sphoṭais tīvradāhair ity abhidhānena pāmaiva tīvradāhabṛhatsphoṭayuktā ‘kacchurna’ iti pā.| kacchūḥ, na tato bhinneti||17-22||–

ab.seg:
ataḥ prabhṛty ekādaśa kṣudrakuṣṭhāny āha– ‘tatraiva kuṣṭhamāha’ iti pā.| tatra carmakuṣṭham āha– asvedanam ity ādi| tad ekakuṣṭhaṃ nāma, atra ‘yad’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| asvedanaṃ svedarahitaṃ, mahāvāstu ‘mahāsthānam’ iti pā.| mahādhiṣṭhānam| matsyaśakalopamam iti matsyatvakkhaṇḍasadṛśam| carmakuṣṭham āha– hasticarmavat, bahulam apattalam| kiṭṭibham āha– śyāvam itvādi| tat kiṭṭibhanāma kuṣṭhaṃ smṛtam| śyāvaṃ śyāvavarṇaṃ, kiṇakharasparśam iti kiṇo vraṇasthānaṃ, tadvat kharasparśaṃ karkaśaṃ, paruṣaṃ rūkṣaṃ, kiṭṭibhākhyaṃ kuṣṭham| vaipādikam āha– pāṇipādayoḥ sphuṭanaṃ vidāraṇaṃ, vaipādikaṃ kuṣṭham| alasakuṣṭham āha– kaṇḍūmadbhir iti| gaṇḍaiḥ sphoṭaiḥ, citaṃ yuktam, alasakākhyaṃ kuṣṭham| dadrumaṇḍalam āha– sakaṇḍūrāgāḥ kaṇḍūrāgasaṃyuktāḥ piḍakā yatra tat sakaṇḍūrāgapiḍikaṃ, tathā udgatam utsannam, evaṃvidhaṃ maṇḍalaṃ yat, tad dadrunāma kuṣṭham| nanu, katham asyāś carake kṣudratvenābhidhānaṃ, suśrute mahākuṣṭhatveneti, tathā sidhma carake mahākuṣṭhe, suśrute kṣudrakuṣṭhe darśitaṃ? ucyate– asitā dadrur avagāḍhamūlā suśrute mahākuṣṭham, asitetaradadvrā visarpakuṣṭhe 'ntarbhāvaḥ, visarpaṇayogāt| tathā sidhma carake mahākuṣṭhe, sidhmapuṣpikā tu tvaṅmātragatā suśrute kṣudrakuṣṭham ity ādi| carmadalam āha– raktam iti| dalayati vidārayati, etādṛśapāṭhābhiprāyeṇa| asparśasahaṃ ca vastrādisparśanākṣamaṃ, tac carmadalanāma| pāmām āha– sūkṣmā iti| evaṃvidhāḥ piḍakāḥ pāmā ity uktā vaidyair ity arthaḥ| bahvyaḥ prabhūtāḥ, srāvavatyaḥ srāvayuktāḥ, kaṇḍūmatyaḥ kaṇḍūyuktāḥ| kacchum āha– saiveti| saiva pāmā pāṇyoḥ hastayoḥ| sphicoḥ kaṭiprothayoś ca kacchuḥ kathyate| tīvradāhaiḥ tīvrasantāpaiḥ, sphoṭair ity arthaḥ| sphoṭam āha– sphoṭā iti| sugamam| śatārum āha– raktam iti| śatārur iti bahuvraṇayogād anvitaṃ nāma| vicarcikām āha– sakaṇḍūr iti| sakaṇḍūḥ piḍakā bhavet| śyāvā varṇataḥ, bahusrāvā bhūriprasrāvā| atra kaphakāryaṃ kaṇḍūḥ, bahusrāvatvaṃ pittāt, śyāvatvaṃ vātāt, evaṃ sarvatra doṣatrayaliṅgam ūhyam| nanv ekakuṣṭham ārabhya vicarcikāparyantena dvādvaśa kuṣṭhāni bhavanti, tat katham ekādaśety ucyate– vicarcikaiva ‘pādayorbhavati’ iti pā.| pādayor bhavantī vidāraṇayogād vipādikā ‘bhavati’ iti pā.| kathyate, tena ‘na’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| tathā ca bhojaḥ–
“doṣāḥ pradūṣya tvaṅmāṃsaṃ pāṇipādasamāśritāḥ|
piḍakā janayanty āśu dāhakaṇḍūsamanvitām||
dahyate tvak kharā rūkṣā pāṇyor jñeyā vicarcikā|
pāde vipādikā jñeyā sthānānyatvād vicarcikā||” iti||17-22||

lg.l: kharaṃ śyāvāruṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ vātāt kuṣṭhaṃ savedanam ||23||
pittāt ‘prakuthitam’ iti pā. | prakvathitaṃ dāharāgasrāvānvitaṃ matam |

div.ab: doṣatrayaniyataṃ kuṣṭhaliṅgam āha– kharaṃ śyāvāruṇam ity ādi| śyāvāruṇam iti śyāvaṃ vā aruṇaṃ vā bhavati| carake kuṣṭham adhikṛtya doṣaviśeṣakuṣṭhajanakahetūnāṃ parasparaṃ jñāpyajñāpakatvam uktaṃ; yathā– “kuṣṭhaviśeṣair doṣāḥ doṣaviśeṣaiḥ upalabdhacarakasaṃhitāmūle ‘punaśca’ iti pā.| punaḥ kuṣṭhāni| jñāyante upalabdhacarakasaṃhitāmūle ‘tairheturhetustāṃśca’ iti pā., madhukośavyākhyāpratiṣu tu ‘tairhetubhistāṃśca’ iti pā., ‘te hetuṃ hetustāṃśca’ iti ca pā.| te hetuṃ hetus tāṃś ca prakāśayati||” (ca. ci. a. 7) iti||23-24||–

doṣatrayaniyataṃ kuṣṭhaliṅgam āha– kharam ity ādi| śyāvaṃ atra ‘vā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| aruṇaṃ vā bhavati, savedanaṃ vedanāyuktam, etad vātakuṣṭhaṃ jānīyāt| pittāc ca prakvathitaṃ śaṭitam iva| ‘yuktaṃ ca kaphāt’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yuktaṃ ca kaphāt kledi klinnatāyuktaṃ, ghanaṃ nibiḍam| dvandvaje kuṣṭhe dvidoṣaliṅgaṃ, sānnipātike tridoṣaliṅgam||23-24||–

tvaksthe vaivarṇyam aṅgeṣu kuṣṭhe raukṣyaṃ ca jāyate ||25||
tvaksvāpo romaharṣaś ca svedasyātipravartanam |
kaṇḍūr vipūyakaś caiva kuṣṭhe śoṇitasaṃśrite ||26||
bāhulyaṃ vaktraśoṣaś ca kārkaśyaṃ piḍakodgamaḥ |
todaḥ sphoṭaḥ sthiratvaṃ ca kuṣṭhe māṃsasamāśrite ||27||
kauṇyaṃ gatikṣayo 'ṅgānāṃ sambhedaḥ kṣatasarpaṇam |
medaḥsthānagate liṅgaṃ prāg uktāni tathaiva ca ||28||
nāsābhaṅgo 'kṣirāgaś ca kṣateṣu krimisambhavaḥ |
svaropaghātaś ca bhaved asthimajjasamāśrite ||29||
dampatyoḥ kuṣṭhabāhulyād duṣṭaśoṇitaśukrayoḥ |
yad apatyaṃ tayor jātaṃ jñeyaṃ tad api kuṣṭhitam ||30|| (su. ni. a. 5) |

ab.seg:
idānīm uttarottarasaptadhātugatakuṣṭhasya lakṣaṇaṃ krameṇāha– tvaksthe vaivarṇyam ity ādi| tvakśabdenātra raso 'bhidhīyate, dhātuprastāvāt; tvakśabdena rasasyābhidhānaṃ tātsthyāt; jejjaṭas tu tvacam evāha| bāhyāyās tvacaś carake udakadharatvenokte rasagrahaṇasyānarhatvād dvitīyā'sṛgdharā'troktā, udakāc ca raso bhinnaḥ; tathā hy uktam– “udakaṃ daśāñjalimitaṃ, raso navāñjalimitaḥ|” (ca. śā. a. 7) iti| rasaṃ vihāya raktādyuktiś ca prāg eva rasaṃ kroḍīkṛtya tiryaksirāgatair doṣaiḥ kuṣṭhajananāt, sirāsu raktavyavasthiteś ceti tasyāśayaḥ| sākṣād rasa ity anabhidhānād bṛhatkuṣṭhaṃ rasagataṃ na bhavatīti nāśaṅkanīyam| yataḥ suśrutenaivoktam– “teṣāṃ tu mahattvaṃ sarvadhātvanusāritvāt|” (su. ni. a. 5) iti, sarvaśabdena ca rasasyāpi grahaṇam| bhoje 'py uktam–
“praduṣṭāḥ pracyutā doṣā rasāsṛṅmāṃsasaṃśritāḥ|
kuṣṭhāni janayanty āśu śarīreṣu śarīriṇām||” iti| “tvaksrāvo romaharṣaś ca svedasyātipravartanam|” iti| etat kecit śoṇitagatasyaiva liṅgaṃ manyante, anye rasagatasyeti| iha raukṣyaṃ svedātipravṛttir lomaharṣaś ca kuṣṭhārambhakadoṣaiḥ svedavahasrotoduṣṭyā bhavati| yad uktam–
“svedavāhiṣu duṣṭeṣu pāruṣyaṃ romaharṣaṇam|
atisvedanam asvedaḥ paridāhaś ca jāyate||” iti| vipūyaka iti ‘viśeṣaṇam’ iti pā.| viśeṣeṇa pūyayogitvam| kauṇyaṃ karabhaṅgaḥ| aṅgānāṃ sambheda iti aṅgānāṃ bhaṅgaḥ| prāg uktāni tathaiva ceti rasaraktamāṃsadhātugatakuṣṭhaliṅgānīty arthaḥ; etac caikatrābhihitam api krameṇa parāparadhātuduṣṭau pūrvapūrvadhātuduṣṭiliṅgakhyāpanaparaṃ, nyāyasya samānatvāt| yad ucyate– “samāneṣv artheṣv ekatrābhihito vidhir anyatrāpy āsañjanīyaḥ|” iti śukragatakuṣṭhaliṅgam āha– dampatyor ity ādi| kuṣṭhaṃ śukragatam apatyena vyajyata ity arthaḥ| atra śukraduṣṭilakṣaṇaprastāvena tattulyakāryā strīgatā''rtavaduṣṭir apy uktā| tad apīty apiśabdāt pūrvoktāny api rasādimajjāntargatakuṣṭhaliṅgāni bhavanti| kuṣṭhitam iti sañjātaṃ kuṣṭham asyeti tārakāditvād itac| atra duṣṭaṃ śukram ārtavaṃ vā sarvathā bījatvānupaghātād apatyajanakaṃ, parantu vikṛtaṃ janayatīti draṣṭavyam||25-30||

idānīm uttarottarasaptadhātugatakuṣṭhalakṣaṇaṃ krameṇocyate– tvag ity ādi| tvakśabdenātra raso vācyaḥ, dhātuprastāvāt; tvakśabdena rasasyābhidhānaṃ, tātsthyāt| bṛhatkuṣṭhaṃ rasagataṃ na bhavatīti na śaṅkanīyaṃ, yataḥ suśrutenoktam– “teṣāṃ tu mahattvaṃ sarvadhātvanusāritvāt|” iti| ataḥ sarvaśabdena rasasyāpi grahaṇam| bhoje 'py uktam–
“praduṣṭāḥ pracyutā doṣā rasāsṛṅmāṃsasaṃśritāḥ|
kuṣṭhāni janayanty āśu śarīreṣu śarīriṇām||” iti| vaivarṇyam aṅgānāṃ vivarṇatā| raukṣyaṃ ca svedātipravṛttir lomaharṣaś ca kuṣṭhārambhakair doṣaiḥ svedavahasrotoduṣṭyā bhavati| yad uktam–
“svedavāhiṣu duṣṭeṣu pāruṣyaṃ romaharṣaṇam|
atisvedanam asvedaḥ paridāhaś ca jāyate||” iti| raktagatam āha– kaṇḍūr ity ādi| vipūyaka iti viśeṣeṇa pūyayogitvam| māṃsagatam āha– bāhulyam ity ādi| bāhulyaṃ sthūlamaṇḍalatā, sphoṭaḥ tvacaḥ sphuṭanaṃ, sthiratvam acalatvam| medogatam āha– kauṇyam ity ādi| kauṇyaṃ karabhaṅgaḥ, gatikṣayo gamanāśaktiḥ, aṅgānāṃ sambhedaḥ aṅgabhaṅgaḥ, kṣataprasaraṇaṃ, prāg uktāni rasaraktamāṃsagataliṅgāni, etac caikatrābhihitam api krameṇa parāparadhātuduṣṭau pūrvadhātuduṣṭiliṅgakhyāpanaparaṃ, nyāyasya samānatvāt| yad ucyate– “samāneṣv artheṣv ekatrābhihito ‘vidhiranyatrāpyāśaṅkanīyaḥ’ iti pā.| vidhir anyatrāpy āsañjanīyaḥ” iti| asthimajjagatam āha– nāsety ādi| nāsāyā bhaṅgo 'vadaraṇam, akṣirāgo netralauhityaṃ, kṣateṣu kṛmisambhūtiḥ, svarahāniś ca| śukragatakuṣṭhaliṅgam āha– dampatyor ity ādi| dampatyoḥ strīpuruṣayoḥ, kuṣṭhabāhulyāt śukrārtavayor duṣṭiḥ, śukragatakuṣṭham apatyena vyajyata ity arthaḥ| atra śukraduṣṭilakṣaṇaprastāvena ca tattulyakāryā strīgatārtavaduṣṭir apy uktā| tad apīty apiśabdāt pūrvoktāny api rasādimajjāntargatakuṣṭhaliṅgāni bhavanti, anye kuṣṭhilam iti paṭhanti; tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| tatra duṣṭaṃ śukram ārtavaṃ vā sarvathā bījatvānupaghātād apatyajanakaṃ, paraṃ tu vikṛtaṃ janayatīti draṣṭavyam||25-30||

div.ab:
sādhyaṃ tvagraktamāṃsasthaṃ vātaśleṣmādhikaṃ ca yat |
medasi dvandvajaṃ yāpyaṃ varjyaṃ majjāsthisaṃśritam ||31||
krimitṛḍdāhamandāgnisaṃyuktaṃ yat tridoṣajam |
prabhinnaṃ prasrutāṅgaṃ ca raktanetraṃ hatasvaram ||32||
pañcakarmaguṇātītaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ hantīha mānavam | (su. sū. a. 33) |

sādhyādibhedam āha– sādhyaṃ tvagraktamāṃsastham ity ādi| vātaśleṣmādhikaṃ ca yad iti ‘carmaikakuṣṭhaṃ kiṭibhādi varjyam’ iti pā.| ekakuṣṭhakiṭibhādivarjyam| majjāsthisaṃśritam iti atra majjāsthipratyāsattyā ‘śukrasya tadgatasya ... ’ iti pā.| śukragatasyāpy asādhyatvaṃ boddhavyam| prabhinnam iti vidīrṇam| pañcakarmaguṇātītam iti pūrvarūpakriyayā saha rasādidhātūnāṃ caturṇāṃ kriyākalāpāḥ pañcakarmāṇi, teṣāṃ guṇā vīryāṇi, tāny atīto yaḥ sa tathā, asthimajjāgata ity arthaḥ; tāś ca kriyāḥ pūrvarūpe śodhanam ubhayataḥ; tvakprāpte śodhanālepanādi, raktaprāpte śodhanālepanakaṣāyapānaśoṇitāvasekādi, evaṃ māṃsamedasor api draṣṭavyam iti| athavā yaduktam– “kuṣṭheṣu caiva sarveṣu pañcakarmāṇi kārayet| pakṣe pakṣe ca vamanaṃ, māsi māsi virecanam| ṣaṇmāsena sirāmokṣo, nasyaṃ saptadināntaram||” iti kvacitpustake'dhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate | pañcakarmāṇi vamanādīni, teṣāṃ guṇāḥ phalāni, tāny atītam||31-32||–

idānīṃ dhātvanukrame 'pi sādhyādibhedam āha– sādhyam ity ādi| tvagraktamāṃsasthaṃ vātaśleṣmādhikaṃ ca yat tat sādhyaṃ, vātaśleṣmādhikaṃ ca yad iti ‘carmaikakuṣṭhakiṭṭibha ... ’ iti pā.| carmaikakuṣṭhakiṭibhasidhmālasavipādikā vātaśleṣmajāḥ sādhyāḥ, medogataṃ dvandvajaṃ yāpyam, asthimajjāsaṃśrayaṃ varjyam| atra majjāsthipratyāsattyā śukrasya tadgatasyāpy asādhyatvaṃ boddhavyam| punaś cāsādhyalakṣaṇam āha– kṛmīty ādi| prabhinnaṃ vidīrṇaṃ, prasrutāṅgaṃ ‘prasrāvayuktaṃ śarīram’ iti pā.| prasrāvayuktaśarīraṃ, hatasvaraṃ ghargharasvaraṃ, pañcakarmaguṇātītaṃ pañcakarmāṇi vamanādīni teṣāṃ guṇāḥ phalāni, tāni niṣphalīkṛtya jātam||31-32||–

vātena kuṣṭhaṃ kāpālaṃ pittenaudumbaraṃ kaphāt ||33||
maṇḍalākhyaṃ vicarcī ca ṛṣyākhyaṃ vātapittajam |
carmaikakuṣṭhaṃ kiṭibhaṃ sidhmālasavipādikāḥ ||34||
vātaśleṣmodbhavāḥ śleṣmapittād dadruśatāruṣī |
puṇḍarīkaṃ savisphoṭaṃ pāmā carmadalaṃ tathā ||35||
sarvaiḥ syāt kākaṇaṃ pūrvatrikaṃ dadru sakākaṇam |
puṇḍarīkarṣyajihve ca mahākuṣṭhāni sapta tu ||36|| (vā. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: kuṣṭheṣu cikitsārthaṃ pradhānaṃ doṣam āha– vātena kuṣṭhaṃ kāpālam ity ādi| vicarcy api kaphāt tatheti śleṣmapittāt, tena dadruprabhṛti carmadalāntaṃ śleṣmapittajam ity arthaḥ| pūrvatrikam iti kāpālodumbaramaṇḍalākhyam| ataḥ saptamahākuṣṭhād anyat kṣudrakuṣṭham||33-36||

div.ab: kuṣṭheṣu cikitsārthaṃ doṣaprādhānyam āha– vātenety ādi| sugamam| anyad api doṣaprādhānyam āha– carmeti| dadruśatāruṣī dve kuṣṭhe na kevalaṃ śleṣmapittāt, yāvat puṇḍarīkaṃ tathā visphoṭaṃ tathā pāmā tathā carmadalaṃ jāyate, tatheti śleṣmapittāt; tena dadruprabhṛti carmadalāntaṃ śleṣmapittādhikasannipātajam ity arthaḥ| sarvair iti sarvais tribhir eva samair doṣaiḥ kākaṇaṃ nāma kuṣṭham utpadyate| etāni aṣṭādaśa kuṣṭhāni bhavanti teṣāṃ madhye pūrvaṃ trikam iti kāpālodumbaramaṇḍalākhyaṃ dadru kākaṇaṃ puṇḍarīkam ṛkṣajihvaṃ ceti mahākuṣṭhāni syuḥ| ataḥ saptamahākuṣṭhād anyat kṣudrakuṣṭhaṃ boddhavyam||33-36||–

kuṣṭhaikasambhavaṃ śvitraṃ kilāsaṃ vāruṇaṃ bhavet |
nirdiṣṭam aparisrāvi tridhātūdbhavasaṃśrayam ||37||
vātād rūkṣāruṇaṃ, pittāt tāmraṃ kamalapatravat |
sadāhaṃ romavidhvaṃsi kaphāc chvetaṃ ghanaṃ guru ||38||
sakaṇḍūraṃ kramād raktamāṃsamedaḥsu cādiśet |
varṇenaivedṛg ubhayaṃ kṛcchraṃ tac cottarottaram ||39|| (vā. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg:
tvagduṣṭitulyatvād atraiva kilāsam āha– kuṣṭhaikasambhavam ity ādi| kuṣṭhena saha ekaṃ samānaṃ viruddhāśanapāpakarmādi sambhavo nidānaṃ yasya tat tathā, kuṣṭhena saha samānacikitsitatvaṃ ca boddhavyaṃ, “kuryāc cāsmai kuṣṭhoktaṃ vidhānam” iti vacanāt| carake tv asya hetuviśeṣo 'pi paṭhyate, yathā–
“vacāṃsy atathyāni kṛtaghnabhāvo nindā gurūṇāṃ gurudharṣaṇaṃ ca|
pāpakriyā pūrvakṛtaṃ ca karma hetuḥ kilāsasya virodhi cānnam||” (ca. ci. a. 7) iti| kilāsam eva māṃsamedaḥsamāśrayaṇayogatvād aruṇaṃ śvitraṃ ca bhaṇyate| tvaggatam eva kilāsaṃ, tasya lakṣaṇaṃ nirdiṣṭam aparisrāvīti| srāvo hi raktādiduṣṭyā bhavati, tenāsya tvaggatatvena srāvābhāvaḥ| uktaṃ ca– “tvaggataṃ ca yad asrāvi tat kilāsaṃ prakīrtitam|” iti| tridhātūdbhavasaṃśrayam iti tridhātus trayo doṣās tathā raktamāṃsamedāṃsi saṃśrayo 'dhiṣṭhānaṃ yasya tat tathā; athavā tridhātuḥ raktamāṃsamedāṃsi udbhavāya saṃśrayo yasya tat tathā, doṣās tu sarvasādhāraṇatvāt labhyanta eva| nanu, yadi dhātutrayāśritaṃ kilāsaṃ, tat kathaṃ
“yadā tvacam atikramya tad dhātūn avagāhate|
hitvā kilāsasañjñāṃ ca kuṣṭhasañjñāṃ labhet tadā||” iti viśvāmitravacanaṃ kilāsasañjñāpratikṣepakaṃ na virudhyate? tathā “tvaggatam eva kilāsaṃ” (su. ni. a. 5) iti suśrute 'vadhāraṇaṃ viruddham? ucyate– viśvāmitravacanasya tāvad ayam arthaḥ pratyetavyaḥ– yadoktaraktādigatasamastakuṣṭhalakṣaṇajanakatayā dhātūn avagāhate tadā na tat kilāsaṃ, kiṃ tarhi kuṣṭhajanakahetvantarabṛṃhitadoṣopaplavāt dhātūn dūṣayet, tathā ‘hetulabdhalakṣaṇa ... ’ iti pā.| hetulakṣyalakṣaṇam aruṇādikuṣṭhaṃ tat; anyad itararaktādigatakuṣṭhaliṅgavyatiriktam utpādasamakālabhāviraktatāmrādi-varṇatāmātrakārakaṃ raktādigatadoṣajanyaṃ kilāsam eva, anyathā raktādigatakilāsalakṣaṇena carakoktena virodhaḥ syāt| sa yad āha–
“doṣe raktāśrite raktaṃ, tāmraṃ māṃsasamāśrite|
śvetaṃ medaḥsthite śvitraṃ, guru tac cottarottaram||” (ca. ci. a. 7) iti| carake hi kilāsasyaiva dhātutrayasambandhakṛtavarṇena dāruṇādisañjñāntaramātraṃ kṛtaṃ, suśrute 'pi tvaggatam evety anena raktādiduṣṭyā viśiṣṭaraktādigatamahākuṣṭhaliṅgarahitatvaṃ, tathā kṣudrakuṣṭhavad yugapadraktalasīkātvaṅmāṃsasandūṣakatvavirahaḥ khyāpyate; athavā evakāro 'yogavyavacchede, yathā– nīlaṃ sarojaṃ bhavaty eveti| uktaprakāreṇa ‘dhātutrayamātratvenaikadoṣajatvena’ iti pā.| dhātutrayamātragatatvenaikadoṣajatvena cāsya kuṣṭhād bhedaḥ; “śvitrasañjñāṃ labhet tadā” iti jejjaṭapāṭhe tu śvitrasañjñāmātravyavahāraḥ kilāsasya, na punar arthabhedaḥ kaścid iti| bhālukinā tu dhātubhedena kilāsasya sañjñāntaraṃ darśitam–
“vāruṇaṃ tat tu vijñeyaṃ māṃsadhātusamāśrayam|
medaḥśritaṃ bhavec chvitraṃ, dāruṇaṃ raktasaṃśrayam||” iti| tathā carake 'pi– “dāruṇaṃ vāruṇaṃ śvitraṃ kilāsaṃ nāmabhis tribhiḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 7) iti| tenehāpi tathā boddhavyam| kramād raktamāṃsamedaḥsu cādiśed varṇenaivedṛg ubhayam iti īdṛśam eva ‘varṇenāruṇatāmraśvetena’ iti pā.| varṇenāruṇaṃ tāmraṃ śvetaṃ ca kilāsaṃ raktamāṃsamedaḥsu yathākrameṇādiśet| ubhayam iti vraṇajaṃ doṣajaṃ ca tac chvitraṃ bhavati, tathā ca bhojaḥ–
“śvitraṃ tu dvividhaṃ vidyād doṣajaṃ vraṇajaṃ tathā|
tatra mithyopacārād dhi vraṇasya vraṇajaṃ smṛtam||
doṣajaṃ ca dvidhā proktam ātmajaṃ parajaṃ tathā|
parasaṃskārasaṃsparśād yat tat parajam ucyate|
tad ātmajaṃ vijānīyād yad deheṣv anilādijam||” iti| raktādidhātutrayagatasya ca kilāsasya dūṣyaprabhāvād yasya kasyāpi doṣasya sambandhaniyatā evāruṇādayo varṇā boddhavyāḥ, yadi tu tatra doṣaniyato varṇaḥ kalpyate tadā varṇātideśo vyarthaḥ syāt, vātād rūkṣāruṇam ity ādinaiva siddhatvāt| yady evaṃ doṣeṇātra varṇābhidhānaṃ viphalaṃ, nirviṣayatvāt; naivaṃ, tvaṅmātragate kilāse doṣavarṇasya caritārthatvāt| hanta tarhi kathaṃ raktādigatatvam asya niścetavyaṃ? tvaggate svabhāvenāruṇādivarṇasya sadbhāvena sandigdhatvāt| ucyate– krameṇāruṇādivarṇotpādād raktādigatatvaṃ niścetavyam, utpattimātre tv aruṇādiyogāt tvaggatatvam iti||37-39||

tvagduṣṭitulyatvād atraiva kilāsam āha– kuṣṭhaikasambhavam iti| kuṣṭhena saha ekaḥ samānaḥ viruddhāśanapāpakarmādi sambhavo nidānaṃ yasya tat tathā, kuṣṭhatulyanidānam ity arthaḥ| kuṣṭhena saha samānacikitsitatvaṃ ca boddhavyam| “kuryāc cāsmai kuṣṭhaduṣṭaṃ vidhānam|” iti vacanāt| carake tv asya hetuviśeṣo 'pi paṭhyate| yathā–
“vacāṃsy atathyāni kṛtaghnabhāvo nindā gurūṇāṃ gurudharṣaṇaṃ ca|
pāpakriyā pūrvakṛtaṃ ca karma hetuḥ kilāsasya virodhi cānnam||” iti| kilāsam eva māṃsamedaḥsamāśrayeṇa yogitvād dāruṇaṃ śvitram iti bhaṇyate| tvaggatam eva kilāsaṃ, tasya lakṣaṇaṃ nirdiṣṭam– aparisrāvīti| srāvo hi raktādiduṣṭyā bhavati, tenāsya tvaggatatvena srāvābhāvaḥ| uktañ ca– “tvaggataṃ tu yad asrāvi tat kilāsaṃ prakīrtitam|” iti| tridhātūdbhavasaṃśrayam iti tridhātuśabdena pṛthag doṣāḥ, atra ‘śukravidhāḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| tridhātuḥ saṃśrayo yasya tat tathā, athavā tridhātuḥ raktamāṃsamedāṃsi, tena vātādinā pṛthag udbhava utpādas tathā raktamāṃsamedāṃsi saṃśrayo 'dhiṣṭhānaṃ yasya tat tathā| vātādinā dhātusaṃśrayabhedena varṇabhedam āha– vātād ity ādi| vātāt śvitraṃ rūkṣaṃ sparśataḥ, aruṇaṃ raktaṃ varṇataḥ| pittād ity ādi| pittāt śvitraṃ kamalapatravat padmadalam iva tāmraṃ varṇena bhavet| tathā sadāhaṃ dāhayuktam| romavidhvaṃsi romaghāti| kaphād iti kaphāt śvitraṃ śvetaṃ śuklaṃ, ghanaṃ sāndraṃ, tathā guru aṅgenānubhūyate, tathā saha kaṇḍvā vartate iti ‘sakaṇḍu ca’ iti pā.| sakaṇḍu kaṇḍuyuktam| kramād raktamāṃsamedassu cādiśet varṇenaivedṛg ubhayam iti īdṛśam eva varṇenāruṇatāmraśvetena kilāsaṃ raktamāṃsamedassu yathākrameṇādiśet| ubhayam iti vraṇajaṃ doṣajam iti tat śvitraṃ bhavati| tathā ca bhojaḥ–
“śvitraṃ tad dvividhaṃ vidyād doṣajaṃ vraṇajaṃ tathā|
tatra mithyopacārād dhi vraṇasya vraṇajaṃ smṛtam||
doṣajaṃ dvividhaṃ proktam ātmajaṃ parajaṃ tathā|
parasaṃskārasaṃsparśād yat tat parajam ucyate|| tad ātmajaṃ vijānīyād yad deheṣv anilādijam|” iti||37-39||

div.ab:
aśuklaromā'bahulam asaṃśliṣṭam atho navam |
anagnidagdhajaṃ sādhyaṃ śvitraṃ varjyam ato 'nyathā ||40||
guhyapāṇitalauṣṭheṣu jātam apy acirantanam |
varjanīyaṃ viśeṣeṇa kilāsaṃ siddhim icchatā ||41|| (a. saṃ. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg:
tasya sādhyatvam asādhyatvaṃ cāha– aśuklety ādi| aśuklaroma kṛṣṇaroma, abahulaṃ tanu, asaṃśliṣṭaṃ parasparam asaṃyuktam, anagnidagdhajaṃ agnidagdhajaṃ yan na bhavati, etat sādhyam| ato 'nyathā ‘anyathokta ... ’ iti pā.| ato 'nyathoktasarvaprakāram asādhyaṃ, carake 'py evaṃvidhasyāsādhyatvam uktam| yathā–
‘yatparasparato'bhinnaṃ bahu yadraktalomavat’ iti vartamānacarakapratiṣu pāṭhaḥ| “yac chuklaroma bahulaṃ yat saṃlagnaṃ parasparam|
yac ca varṣagaṇopetaṃ tac chvitraṃ naiva sidhyati||” (ca. ci. a. 7) iti| guhyapāṇitalauṣṭheṣv iti talam atra pādatalaṃ suśrute ‘ante jātam’ iti sāmānyena nirdeśāt||40-41||

tasya sādhyā'sādhyatvam āha– aśuklety ādi| aśuklaroma yāvan na romāṇi śuklāni bhavanti, abahulaṃ tanu, asaṃśliṣṭaṃ mithaḥ parasparam asaṃyuktam, agnidagdhajaṃ yan na bhavati; etat sādhyam| ato 'nyathā uktaprakāraviparītam asādhyam| yad uktaṃ carake–
“yat śuklaroma bahulaṃ yat saṃlagnaṃ parasparam|
yac ca varṣagaṇopetaṃ tac chvitraṃ naiva siddhyati||” iti| asādhyam āha– guhyety ādi| eṣu sthāneṣv anavam api tyājyam| guhyaṃ liṅgaṃ, talam atra pādatalam||40-41||

div.ab:
prasaṅgād gātrasaṃsparśān niḥśvāsāt sahabhojanat |
ekaśayyāsanāc caiva vastramālyānupalenāt ||42||
kuṣṭhaṃ jvaraś ca śoṣaś ca netrābhiṣyanda eva ca |
aupasargikarogāś ca saṅkrāmanti narān naram ||43|| (su. ni. a. 5) |

ab.seg: kuṣṭhasya saṃsargajaprasaṅgena sarvān eva saṃsargajān rogān āha– prasaṅgād ity ādi| prasaṅgo maithunam, athavā prasaṅgaḥ sātatyaṃ; tena kṛtāt gātrasaṃsparśādeḥ| aupasargikarogā iti ‘aupasargikaromāḥ śītalikādayaḥ’ iti ḍalhaṇaḥ| aupasargikāḥ pāparogādayo bhūtopasargajāś ca| saṅkrāmanti āviśanti| rogasaṅkrāntiś ca kuṣṭhiprabhṛtipāpijanasaṃsargeṇa pāpasaṅkrānter vikāraprabhāvād vā boddhavyā||42-43||

kuṣṭhasya saṃsargajatvaprasaṅgenaiva saṃsargajān rogān āha– prasaṅgād ity ādi| prasaṅgo maithunam, athavā prasaṅgo nairantaryaṃ, tena kṛtāt gātrasparśādeḥ| aupasargikarogādayo bhūtopasargajā rogāḥ| saṅkrāmanti āviśanti| rogasaṅkrāntiś ca kuṣṭhiprabhṛtipāpijanasaṃsargeṇa pāpasaṅkrānter vikāraprabhāvād vā boddhavyā||42-43||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne kuṣṭhanidānaṃ samāptam ||49||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ kuṣṭhanidānaṃ samāptam||49||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyapraṇītāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ kuṣṭhanidānam||49||

atha śītapittodarda-koṭhanidānam |
śītamārutasaṃsparśāt praduṣṭau kaphamārutau |
pittena saha sambhūya bahir antar visarpataḥ ||1||

tvagduṣṭidoṣatrayajanyatvasāmānyāt kuṣṭhānantaraṃ śītapittodardādinidānam| tasya doṣatrayajanyatvam āha– śītamārutasaṃsparśād ity ādi| pittena saha sambhūyeti svahetūpacitena pittena sambhūya militvā| bahir antar iti bahis tvaci, antaḥ śoṇitādau; visarpataḥ prasarataḥ||1||

tvagduṣṭidoṣatrayajanyatvasāmānyāt kuṣṭhānantaraṃ śītapittādinidānam| tasya doṣatrayajanyatvam āha– śītety ādi| praduṣṭau kupitau kaphamārutau svahetūpacitena pittena saha militvā, bahis tvaci, antaḥ śoṇitādau, visarpataḥ prasarataḥ||1||
pūrvarūpam āha– pipāsety ādi| raktalocanatā prabhāvāt| pūrvarūpasya lakṣaṇam iti pūrvarūpasya svarūpam ity arthaḥ; na tu lakṣaṇam atra liṅgaṃ, pipāsādivyatiriktasya pūrvarūpasyābhāvāt||2||

tasya pūrvarūpam āha– pipāsety ādi| atra raktalocanatā prabhāvāt| pūrvarūpasya lakṣaṇam iti pūrvarūpasyopalambhanaṃ, na tu lakṣaṇaṃ liṅgaṃ; ‘pipāsādervyatiriktasya’ iti pā.| pipāsādivyatiriktasya pūrvarūpasyābhāvāt||2||

lg.l: udardam iti taṃ vidyāc chītapittam athāpare |

ab.seg: udardalakṣaṇam āha– varaṭīty ādi| sakaṇḍūs todabahulaś chardijvaravidāhavān iti atra kaṇḍūḥ kaphāt, todo vātāt, chardijvaravidāhāḥ pittād iti doṣatrayaliṅgam| anayoḥ śītapittodardayoḥ samānasaṃsthānatve 'pi vātādhikaṃ śītapittaṃ, kaphādhika udardaḥ||3-4||

udardalakṣaṇam āha– varaṭīty ādi| varaṭī kīṭaviśeṣaḥ, taddaṣṭasadṛśākāraḥ, bahiḥ śarīre śotho jāyate| atra kaṇḍūḥ kaphāt, todo vātāt, chardijvaravidāhāḥ pittād iti doṣatrayaliṅgam; apare śītapittam ity āhuḥ| anayor doṣadvayādhikatvam āha– vātādhikam ity ādi| anayoḥ śītapittodardayoḥ samānasaṃsthānatve 'pi vātādhikaṃ śītapittaṃ, kaphādhika udardaḥ||3-4||

lg.l: sotsaṅgaiś ca sarāgaiś ca kaṇḍūmadbhiś ca maṇḍalaiḥ |
śaiśiraḥ kaphajo vyādhir udarda iti kīrtitaḥ ||5||

ab.seg: udardasya dharmāntaram āha– sotsaṅgair ity ādi| utsaṅgaiḥ madhyanimnaiḥ| śaiśira iti śiśirasambhavaḥ||5||
udardasya dharmāntaram āha– sotsaṅgair ity ādi| madhyanimnaiḥ, śaiśiraḥ śiśirasambhavaḥ||5||

lg.l: utkoṭhaḥ sānubandhaś ca koṭha ity abhidhīyate ||6||

ab.seg: tvagduṣṭisāmyād atraiva koṭho 'bhidhīyate– asamyagvamanety ādi| asamyaktvaṃ vamanasyāyogamithyāyogādinā, tathodīrṇānāṃ pittaśleṣmānnānāṃ nigraho vegavidhāraṇaṃ, tair maṇḍalāni jāyante, sa koṭhaḥ| athavā'yam arthaḥ– asamyagvamanodīrṇau pittaśleṣmāṇau, tathā'nnanigraha upasthitavegasyānnasya nigrahaḥ chardinigrahaḥ iti yāvat, tair hetubhir bhavanti| vamanasya cāsamyaktvam ayogamithyāyogābhyāṃ jñeyam, atiyogasya tu ‘pittaśleṣmakopakatvāt’ iti pā.| pittaśleṣmakoṭhākaratvāt| etena hetulakṣaṇabhedād bhinnaḥ koṭha udardāt| koṭho niranubandhaḥ| tathā coktam– “kṣaṇikotpādavināśaḥ koṭha iti nigadyate tajjñaiḥ|” iti sānubandha utkoṭho 'bhidhīyate| sānubandhatā ca punaḥpunarbhavanena||6||

tvagdoṣasāmānyād atraiva koṭhaḥ procyate| sānubandha utkoṭho 'bhidhīyate| atra ‘sānubandhatā ca punaḥpunarbhavatveneti| tathā coktam– “kṣaṇikotpādavināśaḥ koṭha iti nigadyate tajjñaiḥ” iti sānubandha utkoṭho'bhidhīyate|’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| asamyaktvaṃ vamanasyāyogamithyāyogādinā, udīrṇāni preritāni pittaśleṣmānnāni, teṣāṃ nigrahaiḥ śarīre maṇḍalāni vartulakamalādīni atikaṇḍumanti lauhityayuktāni bahūni ca jāyante, athavā'yam evārthaḥ– asamyagvamanenodīrṇau pittaśleṣmāṇau, tathā'nnanigrahaḥ upasthitavegasyānnasya nigrahaḥ chardinigraha iti yāvat, tair bhavanti| vamanasya cāsamyaktvam ayogamithyāyogābhyāṃ jñeyam, atiyogasya pittaśleṣmakopakatvāt, etena hetulakṣaṇabhedād bhinnaḥ koṭha udardād iti| koṭho niranubandhaḥ, agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tathā coktam– “kṣaṇikotpādavināśaḥ koṭha iti nigadyate tajjñaiḥ” iti| sānubandha utkoṭho 'bhidhīyate| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sānubandhatā ca punaḥpunarbhavaneneti||6||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne śītapittodardakoṭhānidānaṃ samāptam ||50||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ śītapittodardakoṭhanidānaṃ samāptam||50||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ śītapittodardakoṭhanidānam||50||

athāmlapittanidānam |
viruddhaduṣṭāmlavidāhipittaprakopipānānnabhujo vidagdham |
pittaṃ svahetūpacitaṃ purā yat tad amlapittaṃ pravadanti santaḥ ||1||

koṭhahetau pittaśleṣmollekhāt pittaśleṣmamilanarūpasyāmlapittasya nidānam| nidānapūrvakam amlapittasya svarūpam āha– viruddhety ādi| viruddhaṃ kṣīramatsyādi, duṣṭaṃ vyāpannam annaṃ; vidāhisthāne vidagdheti pāṭhāntare vidagdhaṃ bharjitaṃ; pittaprakopipānānnabhuja iti pittaprakopi pānaṃ takrasurādi, annam āśudhānyamāṣādi; pittaprakopipānānnagrahaṇenaivāmlavidāhino grahaṇe siddhe tadabhidhānaṃ viśeṣārthaṃ; ‘pittaprakopaṇādyannabhuja’ iti pāṭhāntare ādiśabdāt kaphādiprakopaṇam annaṃ gṛhyate| evaṃvidhapānānnam upabhuñjānasya vidagdhaṃ kupitaṃ, svahetūpacitaṃ purā yad iti varṣāsu jalauṣadhigatavidāhādibhiḥ svahetubhir upacitaṃ sañcayam āpannam| yad uktam– “varṣāsv amlavipākitvād adbhir auṣadhibhis tathā|” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| vidāhādyamlaguṇodriktaṃ pittam amlapittam||1||

koṭhahetau pittakaphollekhāt pittakaphamilitarūpasyāmlapittasyāto 'nantaraṃ nidānam| tatra nidānapūrvakam amlapittasya svarūpam āha– viruddhety ādi| viruddhaṃ kṣīramatsyādi, duṣṭaṃ vyāpannam annam| vidāhisthāne ‘vidagdha’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, tatra vidagdhaṃ bharjitam| pittaprakopipānānnabhuja iti pittaprakopi pānaṃ takrasurādi, annam āśudhānyamāṣādi, ‘pittaprakopaṇādyannabhujaḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare ādiśabdāt kaphādiprakopaṇam annaṃ gṛhyate, evaṃvidhapānānnaṃ bhuñjānasya vidagdhaṃ kupitaṃ, svahetūpacitaṃ purā yad iti varṣāsu jalauṣadhigatavidāhādibhir hetubhiḥ upacitaṃ sañcayam āpannaṃ, yad uktam– “varṣāsv amlavipākitvād adbhir oṣadhibhis tathā” iti| pittaprakopipānānnagrahaṇenaivāmlavidāhino grahaṇe siddhe tadabhidhānaṃ viśeṣārtham||1||
tasya liṅgam āha– avipākety ādi| avipāka ity āhārāpākaḥ, klamo 'nāyāsajaḥ śramaḥ| amlapitte pittaṃ pradhānaṃ, vātakaphāv apy atrānugau gauravodgārakampādinā jñeyau||2||
tasya liṅgam āha– avipākety ādi| avipākaḥ āhārāpākaḥ, klamo 'nāyāsajaḥ śramaḥ, amlapitte pittaṃ pradhānaṃ, vātakaphāv apy atrānugau gauravodgārakampādinā jñeyau||2||

tasya kadācid adha-ūrdhvagamanabhedād dvividhasyādhogatiṃ tāvad āha– tṛḍdāhety ādi| mūrchā sarvathā jñānaśūnyatvaṃ, moho viparītajñānam| prayāty adho vety atra vāśabdo bhāvyūrdhvagamanāpekṣayā| vividhaprakāram iti haritpītakṛṣṇaraktādibahuvarṇatvadurgandhitvayogān nānāvidham| kadācid iti na sarvakālam||3||

tasya kadācit kāyordhvādhogamanabhedād vividhasyādhogatiṃ tāvad āha– tṛḍ ity ādi| adho vividhaprakāraṃ kadācit prayāti, tathā tṛḍdāhādikāri, tathā hṛllāsādikaraṃ, mūrchā sarvathā jñānaśūnyatvaṃ, moho 'tra viparītaṃ jñānam| prayāty adho vety atra vāśabdo bhāvyūrdhvagamanāpekṣayā; vividhaprakāram iti haritapītakṛṣṇaraktādibahuvarṇatvadurgandhitvayogān nānāvidham| kadācid iti na sarvakālam||3||

lg.l: māṃsodakābhaṃ tv atipicchilācchaṃ śleṣmānujātaṃ vividhaṃ rasena ||4||
bhukte vidagdhe tv athavā'py abhukte karoti tiktāmlavamiṃ kadācit |
udgāram evaṃvidham eva kaṇṭhahṛtkukṣidāhaṃ śiraso rujaṃ ca ||5||

ab.seg: karacaraṇadāham auṣṇyaṃ mahatīm aruciṃ jvaraṃ ca kaphapittam | janayati ‘ ... roganicayam’ iti pā. | kaṇḍūmaṇḍalapiḍakāśatanicitagātrarogacayam ||6||

ūrdhvagatim āha– vāntam ity ādi| nīlaṃ snigdhakṛṣṇaṃ, kṛṣṇaṃ mardanāñjanavad rūkṣakṛṣṇam, āraktam īṣallohitaṃ, ‘raktābhamantarlohitam’ iti pā.| raktam antarlohitam| māṃsodakābham iti māṃsadhāvanatoyābhaṃ kṛṣṇalohitam ity arthaḥ| vividhaṃ raseneti rasena lavaṇakaṭutiktākhyena nānārūpam| karoti tiktāmlavamim iti tiktasya amlasya vā vamiṃ ‘vāntim’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vāntiṃ karoti| udgāram evaṃvidham eveti atra karotīti sambadhyate, evaṃvidham iti ‘amlapittam’ iti pā.| amlatiktam| kaṇṭhahṛtkukṣidāhaṃ śiraso rujaṃ ceti atrāpi karotīti sambadhyate| karacaraṇety ādi– kaṇḍūmaṇḍalapiḍakāśatanicitagātrarogacayam iti kaṇḍvādinicitagātraṃ ca rogacayaṃ ceti dvandvaḥ, tena kaṇḍvādinicitagātraṃ ‘roganicayam’ iti pā.| rogacayaṃ karotīty arthaḥ; ‘roganicayo ... ’ iti pā.| rogacayo 'vipākotkleśādiḥ||4-6||

ūrdhvagatim āha– vāntam ity ādi| harit śākapatrābham, nīlaṃ cāṣapakṣaprabhaṃ snigdhakṛṣṇaṃ, kṛṣṇam añjanābham, āraktam īṣallohitaṃ, raktam atyantalohitaṃ, māṃsodakābhaṃ māṃsadhāvanatoyābham, acchaṃ nirmalam| vividhaṃ rasena lavaṇakaṭutiktākhyenānurūpaṃ karoti| āhārasyāvasthām āha– bhukta ity ādi| bhukte āhāre vidagdhe athavā kadācid abhukte 'pi sati tiktāmlavamiṃ karotīti sambadhyate| amlapitte kaphapittavat sāmānyam āha– karety ādi| kaphapittaṃ karacaraṇadāhādikaṃ janayati, tathā kaṇḍūmaṇḍalapiḍakācitagātraroganicayam iti kaṇḍvādinicitagātraṃ ca roganicayaś ceti dvandvaḥ| tena kaṇḍvādinicitagātraṃ ‘roganicayaḥ ... ’ iti pā.| rogacayaṃ karotīty arthaḥ| ‘roganicayaḥ ... ’ iti pā.| rogacayaḥ avipākotkleśādiḥ||4-6||

lg.l: cirotthito bhaved yāpyaḥ, kṛcchrasādhyaḥ sa kasyacit ||7||

ab.seg: sādhyatvādikam āha– roga ity ādi| kṛcchrasādhyaḥ sa kasyacid iti ahitāhārācāraśīlinaḥ kasyacic cirotthito 'pi kṛcchrasādhyaḥ||7||

sādhyatvādikam āha– roga ity ādi| ayam amlapittākhyo rogo navaḥ san yatnāt saṃsādhyate, cirotthito yāpyo bhavet| kasyacid ity ādi| ahitāhārācāraśīlinaḥ kasyacic cirotthito 'pi kṛcchrasādhya ity arthaḥ||7||

lg.l: sānilaṃ sānilakaphaṃ sakaphaṃ tac ca lakṣayet |
tamaso ‘darśanavibhramapramohaharṣāṇyanilakopāt’ iti pā., ‘darśanavibhramaharṣaṇamohāśca vātayute’ iti vā pā. | darśanavibhramavimohaharṣāṇy anilakopāt ||9||
ubhayam idam eva cihnaṃ mārutakaphasambhave bhavaty amle |
bhramo mūrchāruciś chardir ālasyaṃ ca śirorujā |

ab.seg: tatraiva ‘kevalānilakaphamilitānilakaphamātrāṇām’ iti pā.| kevalānilakaphānilakaphamātrāṇāṃ saṃsargam āha– sānilam ity ādi| bhiṣaṅmohakaram iti tasyordhvādhaḥpravartamānatvena chardyatīsārābhyāṃ sakāśād bhedasya ‘durjñānatvāt vaidyasya mohakaratvam|’ iti pā.| durjñeyatvāt vaidyamohakaratvam| ‘kaphetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kaphety ādi– sādavamilepā ity atra sādo 'ṅgasādaḥ, lepaḥ śleṣmaliptāsyatā| dahanabalasādeti sādaśabdo dahanabalābhyāṃ sambadhyate||8-12||

tasminn anilakaphasaṃsargam āha– sānilam ity ādi| tac cāmlapittaṃ sānilaṃ savātaṃ, sānilakaphaṃ savātakaphaṃ lakṣayet| doṣaliṅgena vātapittakaphaliṅgenety arthaḥ| yatas tad bhiṣaṅmohakaraṃ vaidyabhrāntijanakaṃ, tasyordhvādhaḥpravartamānatvena chardyatīsārābhyāṃ bhedasya ‘durjñānatvāt’ iti pā.| durjñeyatvāt| sānilasyāmlapittasya lakṣaṇam āha– kampety ādi| ‘vibhramaharṣaṇamohāśca vātayute’ iti pā.| vātayute 'mle kampādayastathā tamodarśanādayo bhavanti| kaphānugatasya lakṣaṇam āha– kaphety ādi| kaphānugate 'mle kaphaniṣṭhīvanādiliṅgaṃ syāt| sādavamilepā iti sādaḥ aṅgasādaḥ, lepaḥ kaphaliptāsyatā| dahanabalasādeti sādaśabdo dahanabalābhyāṃ sambandhyate, anyat sugamam||8-12||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne 'mlapittanidānaṃ samāptam ||51||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāmlapittanidānaṃ samāptam||51||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyām amlapittanidānam||51||

div.head: visarpanidānam
div.ab:
atha visarpanidānam |
lavaṇāmlakaṭūṣṇādisaṃsevādoṣakopataḥ |
visarpaḥ saptadhā jñeyaḥ sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāt ||1||
pṛthak trayas tribhiś caiko visarpā dvandvajās trayaḥ |
vātikaḥ paittikaś caiva kaphajaḥ sānnipātikaḥ ||2||
catvāra ete vīsarpā vakṣyante ‘dvandvaśāstrataḥ’ iti pā. | dvandvajās trayaḥ |
āgneyo vātapittābhyāṃ granthyākhyaḥ kaphavātajaḥ ||3||
yas tu kardamako ghoraḥ sa pittakaphasambhavaḥ |4| (ca. ci. a. 21) | ‘ ... vighātādraktaduṣṭau’ iti pā.|

amlapittasambhavaccharder vegavidhāraṇād raktaduṣṭau satyāṃ ‘ ... sāmānyāt’ iti pā.| visarpotpatter hetusāmyāt tadanantaraṃ visarpanidānam| chardivegavighātasya raktadūṣakatve carakavacanaṃ yathā–
“ ‘chardivegavighātāttu’ iti pā.| chardivegapratīghātāt kāle cānavasevanāt|
‘śaratkālasvabhāvācca’ iti pā.| śaratkālaprabhāvāc ca śoṇitaṃ sampraduṣyati||” (ca. sū. a. 24) iti| tasya nidānapūrvikāṃ saṅkhyāṃ niruktiṃ cāha– lavaṇāmlety ādi| “visarpo na hy asaṃsṛṣṭo raktapittena lakṣyate|” iti vacanāt lavaṇāmlādikaṃ viśeṣeṇa raktapittanidānam uktam| saṃsevayā satatasevayā doṣakopaḥ saṃsevād doṣakopas tataḥ| atra, ādigrahaṇāt carakoktānāṃ ‘ ... piṇḍākīprabhṛtīnām’ iti pā.| haritaśākaśiṇḍākīprabhṛtīnāṃ grahaṇam| saptadheti ulbaṇaikaikadoṣajās trayaḥ, sannipātaja ekaḥ, trayo dvandvajāḥ, iti saptaprakāratvam uktam| sarvataḥ parisarpaṇād iti sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāt parisarpaḥ, vividhaṃ sarpāṇād visarpaḥ| yad uktaṃ carake–
“vividhaṃ sarpati yato visarpas tena sa smṛtaḥ|
parisarpo 'thavā nāmnā sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāt||” (ca. ci. a. 21) iti||1-3||–

ab.seg:
amlapittasambhavaccharder vegavighātād raktaduṣṭau satyāṃ visarpotpatter hetusāmānyāc cānantaraṃ visarpanidānam āha– chardivegavighātasya ca raktadūṣakatve carakavacanaṃ yathā–
“chardivegavighātāt tu kāle cānavasevanāt|
śaratkālasvabhāvāc ca śoṇitaṃ sampraduṣyati||” iti| tasya nidānapūrvikāṃ saṅkhyāṃ niruktiṃ cāha– lavaṇety ādi| lavaṇādibhir visarpo rogo bhavati, sa saptadhā jñeyaḥ| “visarpo na hy asaṃsṛṣṭo raktapittena” iti vacanāl lavaṇādikaṃ viśeṣeṇa raktapittanidānam uktam| eṣāṃ santatasevayā doṣakopaḥ| ‘ ... piṇḍākīprabhṛtīnām’ iti pā.| ādigrahaṇāc carakaktaharitaśākaśiṇḍākīprabhṛtīnāṃ grahaṇam| sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāt parisarpaḥ, vividhaṃ sarpatīti visarpaḥ| yad uktaṃ carake–
“vividhaṃ sarpati yato visarpas tena sa smṛtaḥ|
parisarpo 'tha vā nāmnā sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāt||” iti| saṅkhyāsamprāptim āha– pṛthak trayas tribhiś caiko visarpā dvandvajās traya ity ādi sugamam| āgneya ity ādi sugamam||1-3||

lg.l: raktaṃ lasīkā tvaṅ māṃsaṃ dūṣyaṃ doṣās trayo malāḥ ||4||

ab.seg:
visarpāṇāṃ samutpattau vijñeyāḥ sapta dhātavaḥ | (ca. ci. a.
21) tatra vātāt sa vīsarpo vātajvarasamavyathaḥ ||5||

kaphāt kaṇḍūyutaḥ snigdhaḥ kaphajvarasamānaruk | (vā. ni. a. 13) |
sannipātasamutthaś ca sarvaliṅgasamanvitaḥ ||7||

sarveṣām eva raktādidūṣyacatuṣṭayadoṣatrayajanyatvam āha– raktam ity ādi| visarpasya samānasāmagrīkatve 'pi kuṣṭhād bhedaḥ kuṣṭhādhyāye eva nirūpitaḥ| doṣaśabdenaiva vātādigrahaṇe siddhe malā iti ‘yat’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yat kṛtaṃ, tad atyarthaduṣṭyā śarīramalinīkaraṇatvaṃ doṣāṇāṃ pratipādayitum| sannipātaje 'sādhyatvam api “sarvātmakaḥ kṣatakṛtaś ca na siddhim eti|” (su. ni. a. 10) iti vacanāt| tena vikṛtiviṣamasamavetatvam asya| carake tv antarjabahirjabhedena visarpaḥ paṭhitaḥ| yad āha–
“marmopaghātāt sammohād ayanānāṃ vighaṭṭanāt|
tṛṣṇātiyogād vegānāṃ viṣamaṃ ca pravartanāt||
vidyād visarpam antarjam āśu cāgnibalakṣayāt|
ato viparyayād bāhyam anyaṃ vidyāt svalakṣaṇaiḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 21) iti||4-7||

sarveṣām eva raktādidūṣyacatuṣṭayajanyatvam āha– raktam ity ādi| visarpasya samānasāmagrīkatve 'pi kuṣṭhād bhedaḥ kuṣṭhādhyāya eva nirūpitaḥ, doṣagrahaṇenaiva vātādigrahaṇe siddhe malā iti yat kṛtaṃ tad atyarthaduṣṭyā śarīramalinīkaraṇatvaṃ doṣāṇāṃ pratipādayitum| ‘asya tvagantare vraṇagatam’ ityādirbodhyaḥ| lasīkā jalaṃ, tvakśabdenātra atra ‘tvageva’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| rasasya saptadhātuṣu klṛptatvāt| vātajaṃ visarpam āha– tatrety ādi| vātajvarasamavyatha iti ‘vepathur viṣamo vegaḥ’ ity ādikaḥ| nistodaḥ śūlena tudyata iva, bhedo vidīryata iva, artiḥ pīḍā, ‘bhedārtyāyāmaharṣavān’ iti pā.| āyāmo vistāravān, harṣo romaharṣaḥ| paittikam āha– pittād ity ādi| drutagatiḥ śīghragatiḥ| pittajvaraliṅga iti “vegas tīkṣṇo 'tisāraḥ” ity ādikaḥ| atilohito 'tiriktaḥ| kaphajam āha– kaphād ity ādi| kaphajvarasamāna iti “staimityaṃ stimito vegaḥ” ity ādikaḥ| sānnipātikam āha– sannipātety ādi| sarvadoṣalakṣaṇair yukta ity arthaḥ| sannipātaje 'sādhyatvam uktaṃ “sarvātmakaḥ kṣatakṛtaś ca na siddhim eti” iti vacanāt| tena vikṛtiviṣamasamavetatvam asya| carake ‘tvasyāntarjabahirjabhedena’ iti pā.| tv antarjabahirjabhedena visarpaḥ paṭhitaḥ| yad āha–
“marmopatāpāt sammohād ayanānāṃ ca ghaṭṭanāt|
tṛṣṇātiyogād vegānāṃ viṣamaṃ ca pravartanāt|
vidyād visarpam antarjam āśu cāgnibalakṣayāt|
ato viparyayād bāhyam anyad vidyāt svalakṣaṇaiḥ||” iti||4-7||

div.ab:
vātapittāj jvaracchardimūrchātīsāratṛḍbhramaiḥ |
granthibhedāgnisadanatamakārocakair yutaḥ ||8||
karoti sarvam aṅgaṃ ca dīptāṅgārāvakīrṇavat |
yaṃ yaṃ deśaṃ visarpaś ca visarpati bhavet sa saḥ ||9||
śāntāṅgārāsito nīlo rakto vā''śu ca cīyate |
agnidagdha iva sphoṭaiḥ śīghragatvād drutaṃ sa ca ||10||
marmānusārī vīsarpaḥ syād vāto 'tibalas tataḥ |
vyathate 'ṅgaṃ haret sañjñāṃ nidrāṃ ca śvāsam īrayet ||11||
hikkāṃ ca sa gato 'vasthām īdṛśīṃ labhate na nā |
kvacic charmāratigrasto bhūmiśayyāsanādiṣu ||12||
ceṣṭamānas tataḥ kliṣṭo manodehapramohavān |
duṣprabodho 'śnute nidrāṃ so 'gnivīsarpa ucyate ||13|| (vā. ni. a. 13) |

ab.seg: āgneyavisarpam āha– vātapittād ity ādinā| dīptāṅgārāvakīrṇavad iti jvaladaṅgāreṇaiva vyāptam aṅgaṃ manyate| śāntāṅgārāsita iti nirvāṇāṅgāravat kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ sa deśo bhavati| nīlo rakto veti sa deśaḥ snigdhanīlo rakto vā bhavati| agnidagdha iveti agnidagdhadeśa iva| śīghragatvād iti śīghrakāritvāt| marmānusārī hṛdayādyanusārī| vyathate 'ṅgam ity atrāntarbhāvito ṇyarthaḥ, tena vyathayatīty arthaḥ| nidrāṃ cety atra hared iti sambadhyate| śarma sukham| duṣprabodho 'śnute nidrām iti nidrāṃ maraṇarūpāṃ prāpnoti||8-13||

vātapittajam āgneyākhyaṃ visarpam āha– vātapittād iti| vātapittajo 'yaṃ sañjñeyaḥ| jvarādibhir upadravair yutaḥ| dīptāṅgārāvakīrṇavad iti jvaladaṅgāreṇeva vyāptam aṅgaṃ manyate| śāntāṅgārāsita iti nirvāṇāṅgāravat kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ, nīlaḥ cāṣapakṣivad vā rakto vā sa deśo bhavati| agnidagdha iveti āśu śīghram agnidagdha iva sphoṭair upacīyate vṛddhiṃ nīyate, śīghragatvāt śīghrakāritvāt, drutaṃ śīghraṃ, sa visarpaḥ, marmānusārī hṛdayānusārī, atīva balavān vātaḥ| vyathate 'ṅgam iti atrāntarbhāvito ṇyarthaḥ, tena vyathayatīty arthaḥ| nidrāṃ sañjñāṃ ca haren nāśayet| śvāsaṃ hikkāṃ ca īrayet prakopayet| īdṛśīm avasthāṃ gato nā puruṣaḥ, kvacic charma sukhaṃ na prāpnoti, keṣu bhūmiśayyāsanādiṣu, ‘tataḥ’ ityatra ‘svataḥ’ iti pā.| svataḥ ātmanaiva, kliṣṭaḥ pīḍitaḥ, ceṣṭamāno ‘vikṛtāṃ iti pā.| viddhatāṃ ceṣṭāṃ kuryāt, duḥkhaprabodhaḥ manodehaśramodbhavāṃ nidrāṃ maraṇarūpām, aśnute prāpnoti||8-13||

div.ab:
kaphena ruddhaḥ pavano bhittvā taṃ bahudhā kapham |
raktaṃ vā vṛddharaktasya tvaksirāsnāyumāṃsagam ||14||
dūṣayitvā tu dīrghāṇuvṛttasthūlakharātmanām |
granthīnāṃ kurute mālāṃ saraktāṃ tīvrarugjvarām ||15||
śvāsakāsātisārāsyaśoṣahikkāvamibhramaiḥ |
mohavaivarṇyamūrchāṅgabhaṅgāgnisadanair yutām ||16||
ity ayaṃ granthivīsarpaḥ kaphamārutakopajaḥ |17| (vā. ni. a. 13) |

granthivisarpam āha– kaphena ruddha ity ādi| kapheneti svahetukupitena, pavanaḥ svahetukupitaḥ, tena kaphamārutajatvam asyopapannaṃ bhavati| bhittvā taṃ bahudhā kapham iti kaphaṃ vistārya| raktaṃ veti dūṣayitvety anena vakṣyamāṇena sambadhyate| dīrghāṇuvṛttasthūlakharātmanām iti vṛttaṃ vartulaṃ, sthūlam ucchūnaṃ, kharaṃ kaṭhinam, evaṃrūpāṇāṃ granthīnāṃ mālāṃ karoti, ayaṃ ca granthivisarpaḥ suśrute 'pacīsañjñayā paṭhyate||14-16||–

kaphamārutajaṃ granthivisarpam āha– kaphenety ādi| kaphena svahetukupitena, svahetukupitaḥ pavanaḥ, kaphaṃ bhittvā vidārya, raktaṃ ca dūṣayitvety anena vakṣyamāṇena sambadhyate, vṛddharaktasya manuṣyasya| tvaksirāsnāyumāṃsagam iti raktaviśeṣaṇam| dīrghāṇuvṛttasthūlakharātmanām iti aṇu sūkṣmaṃ, vṛttaṃ vartulaṃ, sthūlam asūkṣmaṃ, kharaṃ kaṭhinam, evaṃrūpāṇāṃ granthīnāṃ mālāṃ karoti||14-16||–

kaphapittāj jvaraḥ stambho nidrā tandrā śirorujā ||17||
aṅgāvasādavikṣepau pralepārocakabhramāḥ |
mūrchāgnihānir bhedo 'sthnāṃ pipāsendriyagauravam ||18||
āmopaveśanaṃ lepaḥ srotasāṃ sa ca sarpati |
prāyeṇāmāśayaṃ gṛhṇann ekadeśaṃ na cātiruk ||19||
piḍakair avakīrṇo 'tipītalohitapāṇḍuraiḥ |
snigdho 'sito mecakābho malinaḥ śothavān guruḥ ||20||
gambhīrapākaḥ prājyoṣmā spṛṣṭaḥ klinno 'vadīryate |
paṅkavac chīrṇamāṃsaś ca ‘ ... śirāgaṇaḥ’ iti pā. | spaṣṭasnāyusirāgaṇaḥ ||21||
śavagandhī ca vīsarpaḥ kardamākhyam uśanti tam |22| (vā. ni. a. 13) |

kardamavisarpam āha– kaphapittād ity ādi| stambha iti gātrasya stabdhatā, āmopaveśanam āmasya varcasas tyajanam| sa ca ‘visarpati’ iti pā.| sarpati prāyeṇāmāśayaṃ gṛhṇann ekadeśam iti ‘ ... sthānatvāt’ iti pā.| kaphapittayor āmāśayasthatvāt prāyeṇāmāśaye bhavann ekadeśavyāpī bhavatīty arthaḥ| piḍakair iti piḍakābhiḥ| malina iti maladigdhaḥ| gambhīrapāka ity antaḥpākaḥ, prājyoṣmā pracuroṣmā| spaṣṭasnāyusirāgaṇa iti pūtimāṃsagalanena snāyvādīnāṃ spaṣṭatā| kardamākhyam uśanti tam iti taṃ kardamasārūpyāt kardamākhyam icchanti||17-21||–

ab.seg: kaphapittātmakaṃ kardamavisarpam āha– kaphapittād ayaṃ jñeyaḥ| stambho gātrasya stabdhatā, aṅgāvasādaḥ aṅgakhedaḥ, vikṣepaḥ aṅgānām itaś cetaś ca preraṇam| indriyagauravam iti cakṣurādīnāṃ gauravam| āmopaveśanam ity ādi| āmasya varcasas tyajanam| lepaḥ srotasāṃ śuṣirāṇāṃ liptatā śleṣmādinā| prāyeṇāmāśayaṃ gṛhṇann iti kaphapittayor āmāśayasthānatvāt; prāyeṇāmāśaye bhinnaikadeśavyāpī bhavatīty arthaḥ| na cātipīḍākaraḥ| piḍakaiḥ piḍakābhir avakīrṇo vyāptaḥ, kimbhūtaiḥ atipītalohitapāṇḍuraiḥ| asitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ, mecakābhaḥ añjanābhaḥ, malino maladigdhaḥ| gambhīrapāka iti antaḥpākaḥ, prājyoṣmā pracuroṣmā| sphuṭasnāyusirāgaṇa iti pūtimāṃsāpagamena snāyvādīnāṃ ‘spaṣṭatā’ ityatra ‘sphuṭatā’ iti pā.| sphuṭatā| kardamākhyam uśanti taṃ kardamasārūpyāt kardamākhyaṃ kathayanti||17-21||

lg.l: bāhyahetoḥ kṣatāt kruddhaḥ saraktaṃ pittam īrayan ||22||

ab.seg:
(vā. ni. a. 13) |
jvarātisārau vamathus tvaṅmāṃsadaraṇaṃ klamaḥ |
arocakāvipākau ca visarpāṇām upadravāḥ ||24||

kṣatavisarpam āha– bāhyahetor ity ādi| ayaṃ ca pittaje visarpe 'ntarbhāvanīyaḥ, tena na saṅkhyādhikyam| tathā ca bhojaḥ–
“śastraprahārais tais tais tu ‘vyāladanta...’ iti pā.| vyāḍadantanakhair api|
kṣate vā'py athavā bhagne bahudoṣasya dehinaḥ||
raktaṃ pittaṃ ca kupitaṃ vraṇam āśu prapadyate|
kurutas te samete tu ‘vraṇaśothe’ iti pā.| vraṇotsedhaṃ sudāruṇam||
ācitaṃ tanuvisphoṭaiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ pītakasannibhaiḥ|
pittavīsarpaval liṅgaṃ tasya śeṣaṃ vinirdiśet||” iti||22-24||

kṣatajam āha– bāhyahetor ity ādi| śyāvalohitaṃ varṇena| ayaṃ kṣatajo visarpaḥ pittaje 'ntarbhāvanīyaḥ, tena na saṅkhyādhikyam| tathā ca bhojaḥ–
“śastraprahārais tais tais tu vyāladantanakhair api|
kṣate vā'py atha vā bhagne bahudoṣasya dehinaḥ||
raktaṃ pittaṃ ca kupitaṃ vraṇam āśu prapadyate|
kurutas te samete tu vraṇotsedhaṃ sudāruṇam|| ācitaṃ vraṇavisphoṭaiḥ kṛṣṇapītasamanvitaiḥ| ‘pittavīsarpaliṅgaṃ ca’ iti pā.| pittavīsarpaval liṅgaṃ tasya śeṣaṃ vinirdeśet||” iti| visarpopadravān āha– jvarety ādi| māṃsadaraṇaṃ māṃsavidaraṇam| śeṣaṃ sugamam||22-24||

div.ab:
sidhyanti vātakaphapittakṛtā visarpāḥ sarvātmakaḥ kṣatakṛtaś ca na siddhim eti |
pittātmako 'ñjanavapuś ca bhaved asādhyaḥ kṛcchrāś ca marmasu bhavanti hi sarva eva ||25|| (su. ni. a. 10) |

ab.seg:
sādhyatvādikam āha– sidhyantīty ādi| pittātmako 'ñjanavapur iti atyantam udriktapitto 'ñjanasamavarṇatanuḥ, agnivisarpākhyo na sādhya iti vyākhyānayanti| kṛcchrāś ca marmasv iti asādhyatvena kṛcchratvaṃ boddhavyam| yad āha bhojaḥ–
“varjyas tu kṣatajas teṣāṃ sannipātāt tu yo bhavet|
bhiṣajā jānatā tyājyāḥ sarva eva tu marmajāḥ||” iti||25||

sādhyāsādhyān āha– siddhyantīty ādi| ekaikadoṣajanitās trayaḥ sādhyāḥ, tridoṣajaḥ kṣatajaś cāsādhyaḥ| pittātmako 'ñjanavapur iti paittiko yo 'tyantam udriktapittatvād añjanasavarṇaḥ so 'sādhyaḥ, agnivīsarpo na sādhyaḥ; kṛcchrāś ca marmasv iti asādhyatvaṃ kṛcchratvena boddhavyam| tathā ca bhojaḥ–
“tyājyas tu kṣatajas teṣāṃ sannipātāc ca yo bhavet|
bhiṣajā jānatā tyājyāḥ sarva eva tu marmajāḥ||” iti||25||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne visarpanidānaṃ samāptam ||52||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ visarpanidānaṃ samāptam||52||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ visarpanidānam||52||

div.head: visphoṭanidānam

ab.seg:
atha visphoṭanidānam |
kaṭvamlatīkṣṇoṣṇavidāhirūkṣakṣārair ajīrṇādhyaśanātapaiś ca |
tathartudoṣeṇa viparyayeṇa kupyanti doṣāḥ pavanādayas tu ||1||

lg.l: tvacam āśritya te raktamāṃsāsthīni pradūṣya ca |

ab.seg: prāyeṇa doṣadūṣyacikitsāsāmyād visphoṭanidānam āha– kaṭv ity ādi| ajīrṇādhyaśanātapaiś ceti ajīrṇāśanam apakvadravyasyāśanam, adhyaśanam ajīrṇe bhojanam; athavā ajīrṇaṃ svarūpato hetur adhyaśanaṃ ca| ṛtudoṣeṇeti śītoṣṇādīnām atiyogena| viparyayeṇeti ṛtuviparyayaś ca ṛtusvabhāvasyānyathābhāvaḥ| ebhir hetubhir yathāsambhavaṃ pratyekaṃ doṣatrayaprakopo boddhavyaḥ| jvarapuraḥsarān ity anena jvarasya pūrvarūpatāṃ darśayati||1-2||

prāyeṇa doṣadūṣyacikitsitatvatulyatvād ato 'nantaraṃ visphoṭanidānārambhaḥ, tasya nidānam āha– kaṭv ity ādi| ajīrṇāśanam apakvadravyāśanam| adhyaśanam ajīrṇabhojanam| ‘tathartudoṣeṇa’ iti pā.| athartudoṣeṇa viparyayeṇeti śītoṣṇāder atiyogena ṛtudoṣaḥ, ṛtuviparyayaḥ ṛtusvabhāvasyānyathābhāvāt; ebhir hetubhiḥ yathāsambhavaṃ pratyekaṃ doṣatrayaprakopo boddhavyaḥ| visphoṭakasamprāptim āha– tvacam ity ādi| jvarapuraḥsarān ity anena jvarasya pūrvarūpatāṃ darśayati||1-2||

lg.l: kvacit sarvatra vā dehe visphoṭā iti te smṛtāḥ ||3||

ab.seg:
(su. ni. a. 13) |
śiroruk śūlabhūyiṣṭhaṃ jvaras tṛṭ parvabhedanam |
sakṛṣṇavarṇatā ceti vātavisphoṭalakṣaṇam ||4||

seg.note: asmātpūrvaṃ kvacitpustake ‘kaṇḍūrdāho jvaraśchardiretaistu kaphapaittikaḥ’ iti paṅktiḥ upalabhyate

lg.l: kvacitpustake agrimapaṅktiḥ ekaślokapūrvaṃ upalabhyate kaṇḍūr dāho jvaraś chardir etais tu kaphapaittikaḥ |8|

div.ab:
visphoṭasvarūpam āha– agnidagdhanibhā ity ādi| raktapittajā iti sarvatraiva visphoṭe raktapittayor avyabhicāritvaṃ, yathā śūle vātasya; vātānubandho 'py atra boddhavyaḥ| yad āha bhojaḥ–
“yadā raktaṃ ca pittaṃ ca vātenānugataṃ tvaci|
agnidagdhanibhān sphoṭān kurutaḥ sarvadehagān|| sajvarān saparīdāhān vidyād visphoṭakāṃs tu tān||” iti||3-7||–

ab.seg:
visphoṭakasāmānyaliṅgam āha– agnīty ādi| sajvarā iti jvaras teṣāṃ pūrvarūpatvena jñeyaḥ| raktapittajā iti sarvavisphoṭeṣu raktapittayor avyabhicāritvaṃ sūcitaṃ śūleṣu vātasyeva| yad uktaṃ bhoje–
“yadā raktaṃ ca pittaṃ ca vātenānugataṃ tvaci|
agnidagdhanibhān sphoṭān kurutaḥ sarvadehagān|| sajvarān saparīdāhān vidyād visphoṭakāṃs tu tān|” iti| kvacid iti kvacic charīradeśe| vātikavisphoṭam āha– śira ity ādi| śūlaṃ śarīrasya todarūpaṃ, parvabhedanaṃ sandhisphuṭanam| paittikam āha– jvarety ādi| sugamam| ślaiṣmikam āha– chardīty ādi| ‘vātapaittikamāha– vātetyādi sugamam|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake ‘kaphajaprasaṅgāt kaphapaittikamāha– kaṇḍūrityādi| etairlakṣaṇaiḥ kaphapaittiko jñeyaḥ|’ etatpāṭhasya paścādupalabhyate | vātapaittikam āha– vātety ādi sugamam| kaphajaprasaṅgāt kaphapaittikam āha– kaṇḍūr ity ādi| etair lakṣaṇaiḥ kaphapaittiko jñeyaḥ| ‘kaphavātikamāha– kaṇḍviti| staimityamiti niścalatvam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kaphavātikam āha– kaṇḍv iti| staimityam iti niścalatvam||3-7||

lg.l: pralāpo vepathus tandrā so 'sādhyaḥ syāt tridoṣajaḥ ||9||

ab.seg: sānnipātikalakṣaṇam āha– madhya ity ādi| madhye nimnonnato 'nte ceti madhye nimno 'nte connata ity arthaḥ| nimnonnata iti prayogo 'siddhasyānityatvena| evaṃ ‘sampūrṇā lakṣaṇe’ iti pā.| sampūrṇalakṣaṇo yas tridoṣajaḥ so 'sādhyaḥ||8-9||

tridoṣajam āha– madhya iti| madhye nimnaḥ, ante connata ity arthaḥ| ayametādṛśameva pāṭhaṃ manute| alpaprapākata iti alpapākavān ity arthaḥ| moha indriyāṇām| evaṃ sampūrṇalakṣaṇo yas tridoṣajaḥ so 'sādhyaḥ||8-9||

lg.l: veditavyās tu raktena paittikena ca hetunā ||10||
na te siddhiṃ samāyānti siddhair yogaśatair api |
