kliṣṭāṃs tāṃs tāṃs tarjitāṃs tāḍitāṃś ca pūjāhetor hiṃsyur ete kumārān||” iti| udvijata iti udvigno vihvalo bhavati; na tu bibhetīty ayam asyārthaḥ, trasyatīty asyopāttatvāt| kūjatīti avyaktanādaṃ karoti, bhruvau kṣipati bhrūbhaṅgaṃ racayati, dantauṣṭham ity atra kṣipatīti sambadhyate| kṣipati khādati, dhātūnām anekārthatvāt| ‘bhinnaviṭsvara iti’ iti pā.| bhinnaviḍ ity ādi| bhinnaviṭ bhinnamalaḥ, bhinnasvaraḥ svarabhedavān| māṃsaśoṇitagandhir iti visragandhiḥ| na cāśnātīti pūrvavan na bhakṣayatīty arthaḥ| etat sarvaṃ grahāṇāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇam||17-19||–

sāmānyaliṅgam abhidhāya ‘viśeṣaliṅgamāha’ iti pā.| viśeṣagrahaliṅgam āha– ekanetrasyety ādi| ekanetrasya vāmasya dakṣiṇasya vā ‘srāvaḥ srutiḥ’ iti pā.| srāvo 'śrusrutiḥ prabhāvāt; gātrasya srāvo gharmayuktagātratety arthaḥ| spandanakampanam iti spandanaṃ manāk calanaṃ, kampanaṃ mahatā vegena vepanaṃ; spandanaṃ kampanaṃ vā bhavatīty arthaḥ| vakrāsyo vakramukhaḥ| raktagandhika ity etat sāmānyalakṣaṇalabdham apy atiśayārtham uktam; evam anyatrāpi sāmānyalakṣaṇe punarukte vyākhyeyam||20-21||–

viśeṣaliṅgaṃ tatra skandagrahagṛhītalakṣaṇam āha– ekety ādi| skando 'tra skandavinodārthaṃ rudreṇa sṛṣṭo grahaḥ, na punar bhagavān kārtikeyaḥ| ekanetrasya vāmasya dakṣiṇasya vā srāvo 'śrusrutir bhavati prabhāvāt, gātrasya srāvo gharmayuktagātratety arthaḥ, spandanaṃ kampanam iti| spandanaṃ manāk calanaṃ, kampanaṃ mahatā vegena vepanaṃ vā bhavatīty arthaḥ| vakrāsya iti vakramukhaḥ| raktagandhika ity etena sāmānyalakṣaṇalabdham apy atiśayārtham uktam||20-21||– ‘naṣṭasaṅgo’ iti pā. |

ab.seg: skandāpasmāralakṣaṇam āha– ‘naṣṭetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | naṣṭety ādi| naṣṭasañjño mūrchitaḥ san phenaṃ ‘vamet yathā naṣṭasaṅgo phenaṃ vamet tathā sañjñāvānatiroditi’ iti pā.| vamati, tathā sañjñāvān sann atiroditi||22||
skandāpasmāralakṣaṇam āha– naṣṭety ādi| naṣṭasañjñaḥ san phenaṃ vamati, sañjñāvān jñānavān atiroditi, naṣṭasañjño mūrchitaḥ||22||

div.ab:
srastāṅgo bhayacakito vihaṅgagandhiḥ sāsrāvavraṇaparipīḍitaḥ samantāt |
sphoṭaiś ca pracitatanuḥ sadāhapākair vijñeyo bhavati śiśuḥ kṣataḥ śakunyā ||23|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 27) |

ab.seg:
śakunīlakṣaṇam āha– srastāṅga ity ādi| srastāṅga iti aṅgasraṃsavadvyathāvān| bhayacakita iti bhayahetur bhayaṃ bhayānakam ucyate, tataś cakitaḥ; asati bhayahetau trasyatīty arthaḥ| vihaṅgagandhir iti vihaṅgasyeva gandho yasya sa tathā, ‘upamānāc ca’ iti samāsānta ‘i’ pratyayaḥ| vihaṅgaśabdena jalacarā māṃsādāś ca pakṣiṇo gṛhyante, visragandhitvāt| hiraṇyākṣe 'py uktam–
“saṃsrāvadāhapākādyaiś citaḥ sphoṭair bhayānvitaḥ|
srastāṅgo visragandhiḥ syāc chakunyā pīḍitaḥ śiśuḥ||” iti| sāsrāvavraṇaparipīḍita iti sphoṭair eva vidīrṇair vraṇarūpam āpannaiḥ paripīḍitaḥ| sphoṭaiś ca pracitatanur iti navanavaiḥ sphoṭair vyāptatanuḥ| kṣata ity abhibhūtaḥ||23||

śakunīgrahalakṣaṇam āha– srastety ādi| srastāṅgaḥ aṅgasraṃsanavyathāvān| bhayacakita iti bhayahetur bhayaṃ bhayānakam ucyate, tataś cakitaḥ asati bhayahetau trasyatīty arthaḥ| vihaṅgaśabdena jalacarā māṃsādāś ca pakṣiṇo gṛhyante visragandhitvāt| hiraṇyākṣe 'py uktam–
“saṃsrāvadāhapākādyaiś citaḥ sphoṭair bhayānvitaḥ|
srastāṅgo visragandhiḥ syāc chakunyā pīḍitaḥ śiśuḥ||” iti| sāsrāvavraṇaparipīḍita iti sphoṭair eva vidīrṇair vraṇarūpatām āpannaiḥ paripīḍita ity arthaḥ| sphoṭaiś ca pracitatanur iti navanavaiḥ sphoṭair vyāptatanuḥ| kṣata ity abhibhūtaḥ||23||

lg.l: vraṇaiḥ sphoṭaiś citaṃ gātraṃ paṅkagandhaṃ sraved asṛk |
mūtragandhī ca bahvāśī ‘mukhamaṇḍatikāgrahī’ iti pā. | mukhamaṇḍikayā bhavet ||28||

ab.seg:
‘chardispandanakaṇṭhāsyaśoṣamūrchāvigandhitā’ iti pā. | chardispa(sya)ndanakaṇṭhāsyaśoṣamūrchāvigandhitāḥ |
ūrdhvaṃ paśyed daśed dantān ‘naigameyaṃ graham’ iti pā. | naigameyagrahaṃ vadet ||29||

lg.l: taṃ bālam acirād dhanti grahaḥ sampūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ |
agrimapaṅktiḥ nopalabhyate viparītatamaṃ sādhyaṃ cikitsed acirārditam ||30||

ab.seg: revatīgrahalakṣaṇam āha– vraṇair ity ādi| ‘vraṇaiḥ sphoṭaiścitaṃ gātraṃ paṅkagandhaṃ sravedasṛgiti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ| vraṇaiḥ purāṇaiḥ, sphoṭair avidīrṇair nūtanaiḥ, citaṃ vyāptam| ‘gātraṃ paṅkagandhaṃ sravedasṛgiti’ iti adhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ| gātram iti kartṛpadaṃ, paṅkagandhaṃ ‘śaṭitakardamagandham’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śaṭitakardamagandhaṃ, ‘samāsāntavidheranityatvādupamānāccetīpratyayo na bhavati|’ iti pā.| samāsavidher anityatvād ipratyayo na bhavati| pūtanālakṣaṇam āha– atīsāra ity ādi| ‘grastaḥ pūtanayā śiśuriti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| grasta iti gṛhīta ity arthaḥ||24-30||

revatīgrahalakṣaṇam āha– vraṇair ity ādi| vraṇaiḥ purāṇaiḥ, sphoṭair navaiḥ, paṅkagandhaṃ kardamagandham asṛk sravet| pūtanāgrastalakṣaṇam āha– atīsāra ity ādi| tiryak vā dakṣiṇanetraprāntasyāvalokanam, udvigno vyagracittaḥ, grasto gṛhītaḥ| andhapūtanayā grastam āha– chardir ity ādi| vasāyā māṃsasnehasya gandhavān| śītapūtanāgrastalakṣaṇam āha– vepata ity ādi| sugamam| mukhamaṇḍalikāgrastalakṣaṇam āha– prasannety ādi| ‘udgataśirābhi ... ’ iti pā.| udgatasirābhir vyāptasirāḥ, mūtragandhīti bastamūtragandhaḥ, bahvāśī bahubhakṣaṇaśīlaḥ| ‘naigameṣu grastalakṣaṇamāha’ iti pā.| naigameyagrastalakṣaṇam āha– chardir ity ādi| syandanaṃ lālāsrāvaḥ, athavā gharmāmbusrāvaḥ| sādhyāsādhyalakṣaṇam āha– prastabdhākṣa ity ādi||24-30||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne bālaroganidānaṃ samāptam ||68||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ bālaroganidānaṃ samāptam||68||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyakṛtāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ bālaroganidānaṃ samāptam||68||

div.head: viṣaroganidānam

ab.seg:
atha viṣaroganidānam |
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva dvividhaṃ viṣam ucyate |
mūlādyātmakam ādyaṃ syāt paraṃ sarpādisambhavam ||1||

pāriśeṣyād viṣaroganidānam ucyate– sthāvaram ity ādi| viṣādajanakatvād viṣaṃ; tac ca dvividham– sthāvaraṃ, jaṅgamaṃ ca| mūlādyātmakam iti ādyaṃ sthāvaraṃ mūlādirūpaṃ daśavidhaṃ; yad uktaṃ suśrute
“mūlaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ tvak kṣīraṃ sāra eva ca|
niryāso dhātavaś caiva kandaś ca daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ||” (su. ka. a. 2) iti| tatra klītakāśvamārakaguñjāsugandhagargarakaraghāṭavidyucchikhā'nantā-vijayānīty aṣṭau mūlaviṣāṇi, viṣapatrikālambāsuradārukarambhamahākarambhāṇi pañca patraviṣāṇi, ‘ ... nandanakaṅkolasārapākāni’ iti pā.| kumudvatīveṇukākarambhamahākarambhakarkoṭakareṇukakhadyotaka-carmarībhagandhāsarpaghātinandanasārapākāni dvādaśa phalaviṣāṇi, vetrakādambavallījakarambhamahākarambhāṇi pañca puṣpaviṣāṇi, antrapācakakartarīyaśaileyakarambhanandanakaraghāṭavarāṭakāni sapta tvaṅniryāsasāraviṣāṇi, kumudaghnīsnuhījālakṣīrīṇi trīṇi kṣīraviṣāṇi, phenāśmabhasma haritālaṃ ca dve dhātuviṣe, ‘ ... markeṭakāni’ iti pā.| kālakūṭavatsanābhasarṣapakapālakardamakavairāṭakamustakamahāviṣa-prapauṇḍarīkamūlakahalāhalaśṛṅgimarkaṭakāni trayodaśa kandaviṣāṇi, etāni prāṇaharāṇi; evaṃ pañcapañcāśat sthāvarāṇi viṣāṇi bhavanti| eṣāṃ ca vyādhapulindādibhyo vyaktijñānaṃ kartavyam| paraṃ sarpādisambhavam iti paraṃ jaṅgamaṃ, tac ca ṣoḍaśābhidhānam– dṛṣṭiniḥśvāsadaṃṣṭrānakhamūtrapurīṣaśukralālārtavamukhasandaṃśaparditagudāsthi-pittaśūkaśavabhedāt| parditaṃ pāyukṛtaḥ kutsitaśabdaḥ; ‘parda’ kutsite śabde, ity asya prayogāt| tatra dṛṣṭiniḥśvāsaviṣā divyāḥ sarpāḥ, bhaumāḥ sarpā daṃṣṭrāviṣāḥ, mārjāramakaravyāghrādayo daṃṣṭrānakhaviṣāḥ, picciṭakauṇḍinyādayo mūtrapurīṣaviṣāḥ, mūṣikāḥ śukraviṣāḥ, vṛścikavaraṭyucciṭiṅgādaya “āraśabdenātra vṛścikādilāṅgūlasthitaḥ kaṇṭako bhaṇyate, tasya ca sthūlaśūkarūpatvācchūkagrahaṇenaiva grahaṇam; ata eva dṛṣṭiniḥśvāsetyādisūtre pṛthaṅnodāhṛtamāragrahaṇam|” iti ḍalhaṇaḥ| ārāviṣāḥ, lūtā ‘lālāsparśaviṇmūtra ... ’ iti pā.| lālārtavaviṇmūtraśukramukhasandaṃśaviṣāḥ, citraśīrṣakaśatadārukaśārikādayo mukhasandaṃśadaṃṣṭrāparditagudapurīṣaviṣāḥ, viṣahatāsthimatsyāsthiprabhṛtayo 'sthiviṣāḥ, ‘śakunīmatsyādayaḥ’ iti pā.| śakulīmatsyādayaḥ pittaviṣāḥ, sūkṣmatuṇḍabhramarādayaḥ śūkaviṣāḥ, kīṭasarpadehā gatāsavaḥ śavaviṣāḥ| eṣāṃ ca suśrutasya kalpasthāne vistaro draṣṭavyaḥ||1||

pāriśeṣyād viṣaroganidānam ucyate| viṣādajanakatvād viṣaṃ, tac ca dvividham– sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca| taddvaividhyam āha– sthāvaram ity ādi| mūlādyātmakam iti ādyaṃ prathamam, adanīyam ādyam ity anye| sthāvaraṃ mūlādisvarūpaṃ daśavidham| yad uktaṃ suśrute– “daśādhiṣṭhānam ādyaṃ syād dvitīyaṃ ṣoḍaśāśrayam|” iti,
“mūlaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ tvak kṣīraṃ sāra eva ca|
niryāso dhātavaś caiva kandaś ca daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ||” iti ca| tatra klītakāśvamārakaguñjāsugandhagargarakaraghāṭakavidyucchikhā'nantā-vijayānīty aṣṭau mūlaviṣāṇi, viṣapatrikālambāsuradārukarambhamahākarambhāṇi pañca patraviṣāṇi, kumudvatīveṇukākarambhamahākarambhakarkoṭakareṇukakhadyotaka-carmarībhagandhāsarpaghāticandanakaṅkolasārapākāni dvādaśa phalaviṣāṇi, vetrakādambavallīkarambhamahākarambhāṇi pañca puṣpaviṣāṇi, antrapācakakartarīyaśaileyakarambhanandanakaraghāṭavarāṭakāni sapta tvaṅniryāsasāraviṣāṇi, kumudaghnīsnuhījālakṣīrīṇi trīṇi kṣīraviṣāṇi, ‘phenāśmabhasma’ iti pā.| phenāśma haritālaṃ ca dve dhātuviṣe, kālakūṭavatsanābhasarṣapakapālakardamavairāṭakamustakaśṛṅgīprapauṇḍarīka-mūlakahālāhalamahāviṣamarkaṭakānīti trayodaśa kandaviṣāṇi; evaṃ pañcāśat sthāvaraviṣāṇi bhavanti| eṣāṃ vyādhapulindādibhyo vyaktijñānaṃ kartavyam| paraṃ sarpādisambhavam iti paraṃ jaṅgamaṃ; tac ca ṣoḍaśābhidhānam| ‘dṛṣṭiṃ niḥśvāsa ... ’ iti pā.| dṛṣṭiniḥśvāsadaṃṣṭrānakhamūtrapurīṣaśukralālāsparśamukhasandaṃśaviśardhita-gudāsthipittaśūkaśavabhedāt| parditaṃ viśardhitaṃ pāyukṛtaḥ kutsitaḥ śabdaḥ ‘śṛdhu śabdakutsāyām’ ity asya prayogāt| tatra dṛṣṭiniḥśvāsaviṣā divyāḥ sarpāḥ, bhaumās tu daṃṣṭrāviṣāḥ, mārjāraśvamakaravyāghrādayo daṃṣṭrānakhaviṣāḥ, picciṭakauṇḍinyādayo mūtrapurīṣaviṣāḥ, ‘sarpalādayo’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sarpalādayo mūṣikāḥ śukraviṣāḥ| vṛścikavaraṭīmatsyocciṅgaṭādaya ārāviṣāḥ, lūtā lālāsparśaviṇmūtraśukrārtavamukhasandaṃśaviṣāḥ, makṣikājalāyukādayo mukhasandaṃśaviṣāḥ, citraśīrṣakaśatadārukasārikādayo mukhasandaṃśadaṃṣṭrāviśardhitagudapurīṣaviṣāḥ, viṣahatāsthimatsyāsthiprabhṛtayo 'sthiviṣāḥ, ‘śakunīmatsyādayaḥ’ iti pā.| śakulīmatsyādayaḥ pittaviṣāḥ, sūkṣmatuṇḍabhramarādayaḥ śūkaviṣāḥ, kīṭasarpadehā vyasavaḥ śavaviṣā iti| eṣāṃ ca suśrutasya kalpasthāne vistaro draṣṭavyaḥ||1||

div.ab:
nidrāṃ tandrāṃ klamaṃ dāham apākaṃ lomaharṣaṇam |
śothaṃ ‘caivātīsāram’ iti pā. | caivātisāraṃ ca jaṅgamaṃ kurute viṣam ||2|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |3| ‘atra ca’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: tatra jaṅgamaviṣasya bahvadhiṣṭhānatvena prādhānyāt sarvavegānugataṃ sāmānyaliṅgam āha– nidrām ity ādi| etat subodhyam||2||

div.ab:
sthāvaraṃ ca jvaraṃ hikkāṃ ‘dantaharṣagalagraham’ iti pā. | dantaharṣaṃ galagraham |
phenacchardyaruciśvāsaṃ mūrchāṃ ca kurute ‘viṣam’ iti pā. | bhṛśam ||3|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |4| ‘sthāvarasāmānyaliṅgamāha’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: sthāvarasya sāmānyaliṅgam āha– sthāvaraṃ cety ādi| phenacchardir iti phenasya chardiḥ||3||
tatra jaṅgamaviṣasya sāmānyena liṅgam āha– nidrām ity ādi| phenacchardīti phenasya chardir ity avagamyate||3||

div.ab:
iṅgitajño manuṣyāṇāṃ vākceṣṭāmukhavaikṛtaiḥ |
jānīyād viṣadātāram ebhir liṅgaiś ca buddhimān ||4||
na dadāty uttaraṃ pṛṣṭo vivakṣur moham eti ca |
apārthaṃ bahu saṅkīrṇaṃ bhāṣate cāpi mūḍhavat ||5||
hasaty akasmāt ‘sphoṭedaṅgulī ... ’ iti pā. | sphoṭayaty aṅgulīr vilikhen mahīm |
vepathuś cāsya bhavati trastaś cānyonyam īkṣate ||6||
vivarṇavaktro dhyāmaś ca nakhaiḥ kiñcic chinatty api |
ālabhetāsanaṃ ‘dīnaḥ’ iti pā. | dīnaṃ kareṇa va śiroruham ||7||
vartate ‘viparītaśca’ iti pā. | viparītaṃ ca viṣadātā vicetanaḥ | (su. ka. a. 1) |

viṣadātṛlakṣaṇam āha– iṅgitajña ity ādi| abhiprāyasūcakam īhitam iṅgitaṃ, tajjño vaidyo vācā kriyayā mukhavaikṛtyādinā ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca viṣadātāraṃ jānīyāt| ebhir vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇaiḥ| na dadāty uttaraṃ pṛṣṭa iti svīyāsatkarmajanitavyāmohāt| apārtham ity anarthakam| saṅkīrṇam ity asphuṭam| hasaty akasmād iti ‘ahāsāddhetorapi’ iti pā.| ahetor api hasati| bhayajavāyujanitaparvavyathāpanodanāyāṅgulīḥ sphoṭayati| kriyāntarakaraṇasūcanāya mahīṃ vilikhati| ‘bhītaḥ san pratyekaṃ vīkṣate|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhītaḥ san pratyekaṃ vīkṣate| dhyāma iti dagdhasamavarṇaḥ| kiñcit tṛṇādikam| vartate viparīta iti vāraṃ vāraṃ parivartya tiṣṭhati||4-7||–

avanīpateḥ parikarmiṇo viṣam avacārayantīti teṣāṃ viṣadātṝṇāṃ lakṣaṇam āha– iṅgitajña ity ādi| abhiprāyasūcakam īhitam iṅgitaṃ, tajjño vaidyaḥ vācā kriyāmukhavaivarṇyādibhir viṣadātāraṃ jānīyāt, etair liṅgaiś ceti vakṣyamāṇaiḥ| tāny eva liṅgāny āha– nety ādi| ātmīyā'satkarmajanitavyāmohāt, apārtham iti nirarthakaṃ, saṅkīrṇam iti asphuṭam| hasaty akasmād ity ādi| ahāsahetor api hasati| bhayajavāyusambhūtaparvavyathāpanodāyāṅgulīḥ sphoṭayati| kriyāntakaraṇasūcanāya mahīṃ kiñcil likhati| trastaś cānyonyam īkṣata iti svapāpakarmopalambhabhayenānyonyam īkṣate| dhyāma iti dagdhasamavarṇaḥ, malinavastravarṇa iti ‘ḍallanaḥ’ iti pā.| ḍallaṇaḥ||4-7||–

udveṣṭanaṃ mūlaviṣaiḥ pralāpo moha eva ca ||8||
jṛmbhaṇaṃ vepanaṃ śvāso ‘jñeyam’ iti pā. | mohaḥ patraviṣeṇa tu |
‘mukhaśothaḥ’ iti pā. | muṣkaśothaḥ phalaviṣair dāho 'nnadveṣa eva ca ||9||
bhavet puṣpaviṣaiś chardir ādhmānaṃ śvāsa eva ca |
tvaksāraniryāsaviṣair upayuktair bhavanti hi ||10||
āsyadaurgandhyapāruṣyaśirorukkaphasaṃsravāḥ |
phenāgamaḥ kṣīraviṣair viḍbhedo gurugātratā ||11||
hṛtpīḍanaṃ dhātuviṣair mūrchā dāhaś ca tāluni |
prāyeṇa kālaghātīni viṣāṇy etāni nirdiśet ||12|| (su. ka. a. 2) |

ab.seg: mūlādiviṣāṇāṃ pramādād upayuktānāṃ pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇam āha– udveṣṭanam ity ādi| udveṣṭanaṃ ‘daṇḍādimardanavadvyathā’ iti pā.| daṇḍavimardanavadvyathā| mūlaviṣair ity aṣṭavidhair api, evaṃ patrādīnām uktānāṃ yāvatsaṅkhyākānām ekaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇam avagantavyam| prāyeṇa kālaghātīnīti etāni nava mūlādiviṣāṇi kālāntareṇa mārakāṇi bhavantīty arthaḥ| kandaviṣaṃ tu ‘daśamamatitīkṣṇatvād ... ’ iti pā.| trayodaśavidham atitīkṣṇatvād vyavāyivikāśyādiguṇayogāt tadātvena mārakam||8-12||

navānāṃ mūlādiviṣāṇāṃ pramādād upayuktānāṃ pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇam āha– udveṣṭanam ity ādi, udveṣṭanaṃ daṇḍādimardanavadvyathā| mūlaviṣair aṣṭavidhair api|| patraviṣalakṣaṇam āha– jṛmbhaṇam ity ādi| jṛmbhaṇaṃ jṛmbhābāhulyam| phalaviṣalakṣaṇam āha– ‘muṣketyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | muṣkety ādi| muṣkayoḥ śvayathuḥ| puṣpaviṣalakṣaṇam āha– ‘bhavedityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhaved ity ādi| tvaksārety ādi tvagviṣaiḥ sāraviṣair niryāsaviṣaiḥ pṛthak tribhiḥ| pāruṣyaṃ kharasparśatvaṃ mukhasyaiva, kaphasaṃsravaḥ śleṣmāsrāvaḥ| kṣīraviṣalakṣaṇam āha– phenety ādi| sugamam| dhātuviṣam āha– hṛd ity ādi| dhātuviṣaiḥ haritālādikaiḥ| eṣāṃ kālāvadhim āha– prāyeṇety ādi| etāni nava mūlādiviṣāṇi kālāntareṇa ghnanti| kandaviṣam api daśamam atitīkṣṇatvād vyavāyivikāśyādiguṇayogāt tadātvena mārakam||8-12||

div.ab:
sadyaḥ kṣataṃ pacyate yasya jantoḥ sraved raktaṃ pacyate cāpy abhīkṣṇam |
kṛṣṇībhūtaṃ klinnam atyarthapūti kṣatān māṃsaṃ śīryate cāpi yasya ||13|| tṛṣṇā mūrchā jvaradāhau ca yasya digdhāhataṃ taṃ puruṣaṃ vyavasyet | liṅgāny etāny eva kuryād amitrair vraṇe viṣaṃ yasya dattaṃ pramādāt ||14||
sapītaṃ gṛhadhūmābhaṃ purīṣaṃ yo 'tisāryate |
phenam udvamate cāpi viṣapītaṃ tam ādiśet ||15|| (su. ka. a. 3) |

ab.seg: viṣaliptaśastrahatasya liṅgam āha– sadya ity ādi| pacyate cāpy abhīkṣṇam iti sadyas tāvat pacyate, paścād api punaḥ punaḥ pākam eti||13-15||

viṣaliptaśastrahatasya liṅgam āha– sadya ity ādi| sadyas tāvat pacyate paścād api punaḥ punaḥ pākam eti| digdhāhataṃ viṣaliptaśastrahatam| śatrubhir vraṇasañcāritaviṣalakṣaṇam āha– liṅgānīty ādi| etāny eva pūrvoktāni, amitraiḥ śatrubhiḥ, vraṇe śastravraṇe, pramādāt anavadhānāt| tantrāntare viṣapītalakṣaṇam–
“sapītaṃ gṛhadhūmābhaṃ purīṣaṃ yo 'tisāryate|
phenam udvamate cāpi viṣapītaṃ tam ādiśet||” iti||13-15||

sthāvaram abhidhāya jaṅgameṣv atitīkṣṇatvena sarpaviṣe vācye tadāśrayān sarpān āha– vātapittakaphātmāna ity ādi| bhogī phaṇī, maṇḍalī maṇḍalavad rathāṅgalāṅgalādirūpamaṇḍalayuktaḥ| rājilaś citradīrgharekhāvān; ete yathākramaṃ vātādyātmāno vātādiprakṛtayaḥ| vyatikarajān sarpān darśayati– dvyantarā dvandvarūpiṇa iti| dvayor antaraṃ viśeṣo yeṣu te tathā| yathā– phaṇinā maṇḍalinyāṃ gonasā jātāḥ, maṇḍalinā gonasena ca phaṇinyāṃ kṛṣṇasarpāḥ, evam anye 'pi jātisaṅkarā ūhyāḥ| ‘vyantarā’ iti pāṭhe sa evārthaḥ, viśabdasya dvyarthatvāt; tathā ‘vibhavān mahān ākāśaḥ’ ity atra vyākhyātaṃ, vibhavād iti dvibhāvāt; dvibhāvaś ca sarvamūrtadravyaiḥ saṃyogaḥ ‘sarvatra sarvopalambhaśceti’ iti pā.| sarvatra upalambhaś ceti| dvandvarūpiṇa iti dvayoḥ phaṇimaṇḍalinor vātapittaprakṛtayor yat prakṛtitvaṃ tan militaprakṛtitvam eṣām ity arthaḥ, vātapittaprakṛtayor athavā dvayor yad doṣayo rūpaṃ tadrūpam ity arthaḥ||16||

sthāvaram abhidhāya jaṅgameṣv atitīkṣṇatvena sarpaviṣe vācye tadāśrayān sarpān āha– vātety ādi| bhogī phaṇī, maṇḍalī rathāṅgalāṅgalādirūpamaṇḍalayuktaḥ, rājilaś citradīrgharekhāvān, ete yathākramaṃ vātapittakaphaprakṛtayaḥ| vyatikarajān sarpān darśayati– dvyantarā dvandvarūpiṇa iti| dvyantarāḥ dvayor antaraṃ viśeṣo yeṣu te tathā, yathā– phaṇinā kṛṣṇasarpeṇa maṇḍalinyāṃ gonasā jātāḥ, maṇḍalinā vā gonasena ca| phaṇinyāṃ kṛṣṇasarpāḥ, evam anye 'pi jātivyatikarā ūhyāḥ| dvandvarūpiṇa iti dvayor yo bhāvaḥ; tadvanta ity arthaḥ||16||

lg.l: rājilottho bhaved daṃśaḥ sthiraśothaś ca picchilaḥ |

ab.seg: bhogiprabhṛtikṛtadaṃśeṣu vātādīnāṃ liṅgam āha– daṃśo bhogikṛta ity ādi| sarvavātavikārakṛd ity anenaiva kṛṣṇatve siddhe ‘taduktiravaśyaṃ bhavanakhyāpanārtham’ iti pā.| taduktir avaśyambhāvitvakhyāpanārtham, evam uttaratrāpi pītādyabhidhānam||17-18||
bhogiprabhṛtibhiḥ kṛtadaṃśeṣu lakṣaṇaṃ vātādīnām āha– daṃśa iti| sarvavātavikārakṛd ity anenaiva kṛṣṇatve siddhe taduktir avaśyambhāvitākhyāpanārtham| evam uttaratrāpi pītādyabhidhānam||17-18||

div.ab:
aśvatthadevāyatanaśmaśānavalmīkasandhyāsu catuṣpatheṣu |
yāmye ca daṣṭāḥ parivarjanīyā ṛkṣe ‘śirāmarmasu’ iti pā. | sirāmarmasu ye ca daṣṭāḥ ||19|| (su. ka. a. 3) |

ab.seg:
viśiṣṭadeśādidaṣṭasyāsādhyatvam āha– aśvatthety ādi| yāmye ceti bharaṇyām| ṛkṣe nakṣatre| marmasv iti āśughātiṣu| yāmye ceti cakāreṇārdrāśleṣāmaghāmūlakṛttikānāṃ grahaṇam| yad uktam anyatra–
“caityāyatanavalmīkaśmaśāneṣu catuṣpathe|
ārdrāśleṣāmaghāmūlakṛttikābharaṇīṣu ca||
pañcamyāṃ sandhyayor daṃśe marmasv āśuhareṣu ca|
daṣṭāḥ kaṣṭena jīvanti yadi dūtādisampadaḥ||” iti||19||

viśiṣṭadeśanakṣatradaṣṭasyāsādhyatvam āha– aśvatthety ādi| yāmye ceti bharaṇyāṃ yāmye ity atra “pitrye” iti pāṭhaḥ| pitrye maghāyāṃ, ṛkṣe nakṣatre| ye ca marmasu daṣṭāḥ syus te 'pi tyājyāḥ| marmasv iti āśughātiṣu| yāmye ceti cakāreṇārdrāśleṣāmaghāmūlakṛttikādīnāṃ samuccayanam| yad uktam anyatra–
“caityāyatanavalmīkaśmaśāneṣu catuṣpathe|
ārdrāśleṣāmaghāmūlakṛttikābharaṇīṣu ca||
pañcamyāṃ sandhyayor daṃśe marmasv āśuhareṣu ca|
daṣṭāḥ kaṣṭena jīvanti yadi dūtādisampadaḥ||” iti||19||

div.ab: darvīkarāṇāṃ viṣam āśughāti sarvāṇi coṣṇe dviguṇībhavanti |20| (su. ka. a. 3) | ‘darvītyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate |

darvīty ādi| darvīkarāṇāṃ ‘viṣamāśughātīti’ iti pā.| viṣam āśu hanti aśvatthādau viśeṣeṇa ‘darvīkarāṇāṃ viṣamāśumārakam’ iti pā.| darvīkarāṇām āśumārakaṃ; darvīkarāḥ phaṇinaḥ| sarvāṇi coṣṇe dviguṇībhavantīti uṣṇasaṃyoge sati sarvāṇi viṣāṇi svarūpato dvaiguṇyaṃ bhajante; “sarvāṇi coktāni yathākrameṇa” iti pāṭhāntare ayam arthaḥ– sarvāṇi bhogimaṇḍalirājilaviṣāṇi yathākrameṇa yathoddiṣṭakrameṇa uktāny aśvatthādiṣv āśughātīni| darvīkaraviṣasya pṛthag upādānaṃ viśeṣārtham|20|–

darvīkarāṇām ity ādi| aśvatthādau viśeṣeṇa darvīkarāṇāṃ viṣam āśughātakaṃ, darvīkarāḥ phaṇinaḥ| sarvāṇi coṣṇe asyāyameveṣṭaḥ pāṭhaḥ| viguṇībhavantīti uṣṇasaṃyoge sarvāṇi viṣāṇi svarūpato vaiguṇyaṃ bhajante “sarvāṇi coṣṇe dviguṇībhavanti” iti pāṭhe sarvāṇy aśeṣāṇi ‘viṣāṇyadanakāle’ iti pā.| viṣāṇy uṣṇakāle dviguṇībhavanti dviguṇaśaktīni bhavanti| “sarvāṇi cordhve dviguṇībhavanti” ity apare paṭhanti| ūrdhve deśa ity arthaḥ| “sarvāṇi coktāni yathākrameṇa” iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, tadāyam arthaḥ– sarvāṇi maṇḍalirājilaviṣāṇi yathākrameṇa yathopadiṣṭakrameṇoktā'śvatthādiṣv āśughātīni| darvīkaraviṣasya pṛthag upādānaṃ viśeṣārtham|20|–

ajīrṇapittātapapīḍiteṣu bāleṣu vṛddheṣu bubhukṣiteṣu ||20||
kṣīṇakṣate mehini kuṣṭhayukte rūkṣe 'bale garbhavatīṣu cāpi | (su. ka. a. 3) |

evam apareṣv api āśughātitvaṃ sambhavati, tān āha– ajīrṇety ādi| ajīrṇapittātapapīḍiteṣv iti ajīrṇini doṣatrayaprakopāt, pittātapapīḍitayo raukṣyāt, bālavṛddhayor asampūrṇakṣīṇadhātutvena viṣavegāsahatvāt, bubhukṣiteṣv iti ‘vātapittavṛddhyā’ iti pā.| pittavṛddhyā uṣṇadehatvāt, kṣīṇakṣata iti kṣatakṣīṇe bahulavātaduṣṭeḥ, mehini doṣatrayaprakopāt, kuṣṭhayukte raktādidoṣāt, rūkṣe vātakopāt, abale kleśāsahatvāt, garbhavatīṣu garbheṇotkṣiptadoṣatvāt; eṣu viṣam āśughātīti||20||–

apareṣu yeṣu yathā''śughātitvaṃ sambhavati tān āha– ajīrṇety ādi| ajīrṇini doṣatrayaprakopād viṣam āśughāti, pittātapapīḍitayo raukṣyāt, bālavṛddhayor asampūrṇakṣīṇadhātutvena viṣavegāsahatvāt| bubhukṣiteṣv iti vātapittavṛddhyoṣṇadehatvāt| kṣīṇakṣata iti kṣatakṣīṇe bahulavātaduṣṭeḥ, mehini doṣatrayakopāt, ‘kuṣṭhaduṣṭe’ iti pā.| kuṣṭhajuṣṭe raktādidoṣāt, rūkṣe vātakopāt, abale vegāsahatvāt, garbhavatīṣu garbheṇotkṣiptadoṣatvāt; eṣu viṣam āśughātīti||20||–

śastrakṣate yasya na raktam eti rājyo latābhiś ca na sambhavanti ||21||
śītābhir adbhiś ca na romaharṣo viṣābhibhūtaṃ parivarjayet tam |
jihmaṃ mukhaṃ yasya ca keśaśāto nāsāvasādaś ca sakaṇṭhabhaṅgaḥ ||22||
kṛṣṇaḥ saraktaḥ śvayathuś ca daṃśe hanvoḥ sthiratvaṃ ca vivarjanīyaḥ |
vartir ghanā yasya nireti vaktrād raktaṃ sraved ūrdhvam adhaś ca yasya ||23||
daṃṣṭrānipātāś caturaś ca yasya taṃ cāpi vaidyaḥ parivarjayec ca |
unmattam atyartham upadrutaṃ vā hīnasvaraṃ vā'py atha vā vivarṇam ||24||
sāriṣṭam atyartham aveginaṃ ca jñātvā naraṃ karma na tatra kuryāt | (su. ka. a. 3) |

idānīṃ sarvathā varjanīyam āha– śastrakṣata ity ādi| rājyo latābhiś ceti rājyo lekhāḥ latābhis tāḍanān na bhavanti| ‘anavāyane'pyuktam’ iti pā.| tad uktam ālambāyane–
“naiti raktaṃ kṣatād yasya latāghātair na rājikāḥ|
na lomaharṣaḥ śītādbhir varjayet taṃ viṣārditam||” iti| jihmaṃ vakraṃ, stabdham iti kārtikaḥ| keśaśāta iti karṣaṇāt keśotpāṭaḥ| kaṇṭhabhaṅgo grīvāyā ‘adhāraṇam’ iti pā.| avidhāraṇam| hanvoḥ sthiratvaṃ hanudvayasya lagnatvam| vartir ghaneti lālārūpā vartiḥ| raktaṃ sraved ūrdhvam adhaś ca yasyeti mukhanāsāgudādibhyaḥ śoṇitasrāvaḥ| daṃṣṭrānipātāś caturaś ceti catvāra iti prāpte catura iti nirdeśaḥ ‘ayāgavidheranityatvāt’ iti pā.| āgamavidher anityatvāt, yathā– “agrataś caturo vedā” ity ādi| unmattam atyartham upadrutam iti unmattam atyartham unmādavantam, upadrutaṃ jvarātisārādibhir atyartham upadrutam| hīnasvaraṃ vaktum asamartham| vivarṇaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇam| sāriṣṭaṃ nāsābhaṅgādiyuktam| aveginaṃ ‘prathamādivegarahitam’ iti pā.| gamanādivegarahitaṃ, ‘viṇmūtravegādirahitamiti’ iti pā.| viṇmūtrādivegarahitam iti kārtikaḥ||21-24||–

sarvathā varjanīyam āha– śastrety ādi| rājyo lekhāḥ latābhis tāḍite 'ṅge na sambhavanti nocchalanti| atrālambāyane 'py uktam–
“naiti raktaṃ kṣatād yasya latāghāte na rājikāḥ|
na lomaharṣaḥ śītādbhir varjayet taṃ viṣārditam||” iti| aparaṃ varjyam āha– jihmam ity ādi| jihmaṃ vakraṃ, stabdham iti kārtikaḥ| keśaśātaḥ gharṣaṇāt keśotpāṭaḥ, kaṇṭhabhaṅgena grīvāyā adhāraṇaṃ, hanvoḥ sthiratvaṃ hanudvayasya lagnatvam| aparam api varjyam āha– vartir ity ādi| lālārūpā vartir yasya mukhān nirgacchati| raktaṃ sraved ūrdhvam adhaś ceti mukhanāsāgudamehanādibhyaḥ śoṇitasrāvaḥ| ‘daṃṣṭrānipātāścatura’ iti pā.| daṃśanipātāś catura iti catvāra iti prāpte 'nityatvād āgamābhāvaḥ| anyam api varjyam āha– unmattam ity ādi| unmattaṃ unmādavantaṃ, jvarātisārādibhir atyartham upadrutaṃ ca, hīnasvaraṃ vaktum asamarthaṃ, vivarṇaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ, sāriṣṭaṃ nāsābhaṅgādiyuktam, aveginaṃ prathamādivegarahitaṃ, ‘viṇmūtraṃ vegarahitamiti’ iti pā.| viṇmūtravegarahitam iti kārtikaḥ||21-24||–

jīrṇaṃ viṣaghnauṣadhibhir hataṃ vā dāvāgnivātātapaśoṣitaṃ vā ||25||
svabhāvato vā guṇaviprahīnaṃ viṣaṃ hi dūṣīviṣatām upaiti | (su. ka. a. 2) |

sthāvarajaṅgamaviṣam eva jīrṇatvādibhir viśeṣair dūṣīviṣasañjñāṃ labhate; tad āha– jīrṇam ity ādi| viṣaghnauṣadhibhir iti agadādibhiḥ| dāvāgnivātātapaśoṣitaṃ veti dāvāgnir vanāgniḥ| svabhāvato vā guṇaviprahīnam iti svabhāvād eva kim api viṣaṃ ‘vyavāyivikāsiprabhṛtiṣu’ iti pā.| vyavāyivikāśiprabhṛtiṣu daśasu guṇeṣu madhye ‘ekadvitriguṇahīnam’ iti pā.| ekadvitryādiguṇahīnaṃ yadi bhavati tadā dūṣīviṣatām upaiti||25||–

sthāvarajaṅgamaviṣam eva jīrṇatvādibhiḥ kāraṇair dūṣīviṣasañjñāṃ labhate; tad āha– jīrṇam ity ādi| viṣaghnauṣadhibhir iti agadādibhir hatavīryaṃ, dāvāgnivātātapaśoṣitaṃ ceti dāvāgnir vanāgniḥ| svabhāvata iti svabhāvād eva kim api vikāśivyavāyiprabhṛtiṣu daśasu guṇeṣu madhye ekadvitryādiguṇahīnaṃ sad dūṣīviṣatāṃ prāpnoti||25||–

vīryālpabhāvān na nipātayet tat kaphānvitaṃ varṣagaṇānubandhi ||26||
tenārdito bhinnapurīṣavarṇo vaigandhyavairasyayutaḥ pipāsī |
mūrchāṃ bhramaṃ gadgadavāgvamiṃ ca viceṣṭamāno 'ratim āpnuyād vā ||27|| (su. ka. a. 2) |

ab.seg: guṇahīnatām eva kāryeṇa darśayati– vīryālpabhāvād ity ādi| na nipātayed iti na ‘mārayet’ iti pā.| mārayati sadyaś cireṇa vā| kaphānvitam iti kaphānvitaṃ sat mandībhūtauṣṇyādiguṇaṃ na ‘mārayet’ iti pā.| mārayati| varṣagaṇānubandhīti apākāc cirasthāyi| tenārdito bhinnapurīṣavarṇa iti tena ‘gararūpeṇa pīḍitaḥ’ iti pā.| dūṣīviṣeṇārditaḥ; bhinnaśabdo 'tra purīṣavarṇābhyāṃ pratyekam abhisambadhyate, bhinnavarṇo vivarṇaḥ| vaigandhyavairasyayuta iti viruddhagandhamukhavairasyayuktaḥ| viceṣṭamāno viruddhāṃ ceṣṭāṃ kurvan, aratim asukhaṃ labhate||26-27||

tām eva guṇahīnatāṃ kāryeṇa darśayati– vīryety ādi| tadvīryasyālpatvāt| na nipātayet na mārayet, sadyaś cireṇa vā| kaphānvitaṃ ‘sanmandībhūtauṣṇyādiguṇāt’ iti pā.| san mandībhūtauṣṇyādiguṇatvāt na mārayati, varṣagaṇānubandhi apākāc cirasthāyi| tena gararūpeṇa ye doṣā bhavanti, tān darśayann āha– teneti| tena gararūpeṇa viṣeṇa pīḍito bhinnapurīṣavarṇādikaḥ syāt, bhinnaśabdo 'tra purīṣavarṇābhyāṃ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| bhinnavarṇo vivarṇaḥ| vigandhavairasyayuta iti viruddhagandhamukhavairasyayuktaḥ, viceṣṭamāna iti viruddhāṃ ceṣṭāṃ kurvan, aratim asukhaṃ labhate||26-27||

div.ab:
āmāśayasthe kaphavātarogī pakvāśayasthe 'nilapittarogī |
bhavet ‘samuddhasta ... ’ iti pā. | samuddhvastaśiroruhāṅgo vilūnapakṣas tu yathā vihaṅgaḥ ||28|| (su. ka. a. 2) |

ab.seg: sthānaviśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭaliṅgam āha– āmāśayastha ity ādi| kaphāvṛtatvena vātakopa āmāśaye, tena kaphavātarogīty uktam| anilapittarogīti pakvāśaye duṣṭavātasambandhena ‘pratyāsannāśayasya’ iti pā.| pratyāsannasyāśayasthasya pittasya kopaḥ| bhavet samuddhastaśiroruhāṅga iti atrāṅgaśabdāt paraṃ ruhaśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ; tenāyam arthaḥ– samuddhastaśiroruhāṅgaruhaḥ, śiroruhāḥ keśāḥ, aṅgaruhaṃ loma; tad uktam ālambāyane– “sīdanti keśalomāni tasmin pakvāśayaṃ gate|” ity ādi| vilūnapakṣas tu yathā vihaṅga iti muṇḍitapakṣaśakunisadṛśaḥ, etat pakvāśayagatasyaiva liṅgam||28||

sthānaviśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭaliṅgam āha– āmāśayastha ity ādi| kaphāvṛtatvena vātakopaḥ āmāśaye, tena kaphavātarogīty uktam| anilapittarogīti pakvāśaye duṣṭavātasambandhena pratyāsannāśayasya pittasya kopaḥ| bhavet samuddhastaśiroruhāṅga iti atrāṅgaśabdāt paraṃ ruhaśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ, tenāyam arthaḥ– samuddhastaśiroruhāṅgaruhaḥ| śiroruhaḥ keśaḥ, aṅgaruhaṃ lomety arthaḥ| tad uktam ālambāyane– “sīdanti keśalomāni tasmin pakvāśayaṃ gate|” iti| vilūnapakṣas tu yathā vihaṅga iti muṇḍitapakṣaśakunir iva| ‘etena’ iti pā.| etac ca pakvāśayagatasyaiva liṅgam||28||

div.ab:
sthitaṃ rasādiṣv athavā yathoktān karoti dhātuprabhavān vikārān |
kopaṃ ca śītāniladurdineṣu yāty āśu pūrvaṃ śṛṇu tasya rūpam ||29|| (su. ka. a. 2) |

ab.seg: tasya rasādidhātugatasya liṅgam āha– sthitaṃ rasādiṣv ity ādi| yathoktān karoti dhātuprabhavān vikārān iti suśrute vyādhisamuddeśīyādhyāyoktān annā'śraddhādīn karoti; kopaṃ ca śītāniladurdineṣu yātīti kaphasambandhāt śītādau kāle kopaṃ yāti| pūrvaṃ śṛṇu tasya rūpam iti pūrvarūpaṃ śṛṇv ity arthaḥ||29||

tasya rasādidhātugatasya liṅgam āha– sthitam ity ādi| yathoktān suśrute vyādhisamuddeśīyoktān annā'śraddhādīn karoti| kopaṃ ca śītety ādi kaphasambandhāt śītādau kāle śīghraṃ kopaṃ yāti| pūrvaṃ śṛṇu tasya rūpam iti pūrvarūpaṃ śṛṇv ity arthaḥ||29||

div.ab:
nidrāgurutvaṃ ca vijṛmbhaṇaṃ ca viśleṣaharṣāv athavā'ṅgamardam |
tataḥ karoty annamadāvipākāv arocakaṃ maṇḍalakoṭhajanma ||30||
māṃsakṣayaṃ pādakarapraśothaṃ mūrchāṃ tathā chardim athātisāram |
dūṣīviṣaṃ śvāsatṛṣājvarāṃś ca kuryāt pravṛddhiṃ jaṭharasya cāpi ||31|| (su. ka. a. 2) |

ab.seg: tad evāha– nidrety ādi| viśleṣaharṣāv iti viśleṣo gātrasya śaithilyaṃ, harṣo romaharṣaḥ| etāni vātakaphajāni liṅgāni| tata iti pūrvarūpād anantaram| annamadāvipākāv iti annamadaḥ anne bhukte mado harṣaḥ annamadaḥ; kārtikas tu annavikṣepaṇam annamadam āha– annamado rasājīrṇam iti gadādharaḥ; avipāko 'nnasyāpākaḥ| pādakarapraśotham iti pāde kare ca prakṛṣṭaṃ śothaṃ karoti| “mūrchāṃ tathā chardim athātisāram” ity asya sthāne “pralepakaṃ chardim” ity ādi pāṭhāntare ‘pralepakatvena svedapravṛttyā gātraliptatvam’ iti pā.| pralepakaṃ svedapravṛttyā picchilaṃ gātraṃ, jvaraviśeṣaṃ vā||30-31||

tad evāha– nidrety ādi| viśleṣo gātraśaithilyaṃ, harṣo romaharṣaḥ, aṅgamardo vedanāviśeṣaḥ; etāni vātakaphajāni, tata iti pūrvarūpād anantaram| annamadāvipākāv iti anne bhukte mado harṣo 'nnamadaḥ, kārtikas tu annavikṣepaṇam annamadam āha, annamado rasājīrṇam iti gadādharaḥ; avipāko 'nnasya pākābhāvaḥ| pādakarapraśotham ity ādi pāde kare ca prakṛṣṭaṃ śophaṃ karoti| mūrchāṃ tathā chardim athātisāram ity asya sthāne “pralepakaṃ chardim athātisāram” iti pāṭhāntaram| tatra pralepakaṃ picchilasvedapravṛttyā gātraliptiṃ, jvaraviśeṣaṃ vā karoti||30-31||

div.ab:
unmādam anyaj janayet tathā'nyad ānāham anyat kṣapayec ca śukram |
gādgadyam anyaj janayec ca kuṣṭhaṃ tāṃs tān vikārāṃś ca bahuprakārān ||32|| (su. ka. a. 2) |

ab.seg: tad eva nānāprakāraṃ yad yat karoti tat tad āha– unmādam anyad ity ādi| kṣapayec ca śukram iti ṣāṇḍhyaṃ karotīty arthaḥ| tāṃs tān iti visarpavisphoṭakādīn||32||
tad eva nānāprakāraṃ yad yat karoti tat tad āha– unmādam ity ādi| gādgadyaṃ gadgadavākyatām| tāṃs tān iti visphoṭakādīn||32||

div.ab:
dūṣitaṃ deśakālānnadivāsvapnair abhīkṣṇaśaḥ |
yasmāt sandūṣayed dhātūn tasmād dūṣīviṣaṃ smṛtam ||33||
sādhyam ātmavataḥ sadyo yāpyaṃ saṃvatsarotthitam |
dūṣīviṣam asādhyaṃ syāt kṣīṇasyāhitasevinaḥ ||34|| (su. ka. a. 2) |

ab.seg:
dūṣīviṣasya niruktim āha– dūṣitam ity ādi| deśakālānnadivāsvapnair iti deśaḥ pracurānilaśītavṛṣṭir anūpādiḥ, kālaḥ śītāniladurdinādiḥ, annaṃ ‘surātilakulatthādi’ iti pā.| yavatilakulatthādi, tair dūṣitaṃ kopitam| abhīkṣṇaśaḥ punaḥ punaḥ| dhātudūṣakatvena dūṣīviṣam| ‘kṛtrimam’ iti pā.| saṃyogajaṃ viṣaṃ dvividham– ekaṃ saviṣāviṣasaṃyogakṛtaṃ kṛtrimasañjñam, aparaṃ nirviṣadravyakṛtaṃ garasañjñam| yad āha vṛddhakāśyapaḥ–
“ ‘kṛtrimam’ iti pā.| saṃyogajaṃ ca dvividhaṃ tṛtīyaṃ viṣam ucyate|
garaḥ syād aviṣaṃ tatra, saviṣaṃ kṛtrimaṃ matam||” iti| ata eva rasāyane carakaḥ– “daṃṣṭrāviṣe mūlaviṣe sagare kṛtrime viṣe|” iti||33-34||

dūṣīviṣalakṣaṇam āha– dūṣitam ity ādi| deśaḥ pracurānilaśītavarṣātapaḥ, kālaḥ śītāniladurdinādiḥ, annaṃ yavatilakulatthādi; annasyopalakṣaṇatvād vyavāyavyāyāmakrodhādayo 'pi grāhyāḥ; tair dūṣitaṃ kopitam, abhīkṣṇaśaḥ punaḥ punaḥ| dhātudūṣakatvena dūṣīviṣam|| idānīṃ sādhyayāpyapratyākhyeyaṃ ca darśayann āha– sādhyam ity ādi| sugamam| ‘kṛtrimaviṣam’ iti pā.| saṃyogajaviṣaṃ dvividham– ekaṃ saviṣā'viṣasaṃyogakṛtaṃ kṛtrimaviṣam, aparaṃ nirviṣadravyakṛtaṃ garasañjñam| yad āha vṛddhakāśyapaḥ–
“saṃyogajaṃ ca dvividhaṃ tṛtīyaṃ viṣam ucyate|
garaḥ syād aviṣaṃ tatra saviṣaṃ kṛtrimaṃ matam||” iti| ata eva rasāyane carakaḥ– “daṃṣṭrāviṣe mūlaviṣe sagare kṛtrime viṣe|” iti| ātmavataḥ pathyāśinaḥ| kṣīṇasya kṣīṇadhātoḥ||33-34||

lg.l: saubhāgyārthaṃ striyaḥ svedaṃ rajo nānāṅgajān malān |
śatruprayuktāṃś ca garān ‘prayacchantyannamāśritān’ iti pā. | prayacchanty annamiśritān ||35||
taiḥ syāt pāṇḍuḥ kṛśo 'lpāgnir garaś cāsyopajāyate |
jaṭharaṃ grahaṇīdoṣo yakṣmā gulmaḥ kṣayo jvaraḥ |

ab.seg: etad dvayam api darśayitum āha– saubhāgyārtham ity ādi| striyaḥ saubhāgyārthaṃ ‘śatruprayuktyā’ iti pā.| śatruprayuktā vā saviṣajantūnāṃ svedaṃ, rajaś cūrṇaṃ, nānāṅgajān nānāgarakarān malān annādau dadati| tair iti svedarajaḥprabhṛtibhiḥ| garaś cāsyeti apākāj jaṭharāvasthitasvedādir eva garaḥ, ata eva tasyodarāmayaḥ; kiṃ vā vakṣyamāṇamarmapradhamanādilakṣaṇo vyādhir garaḥ| marmapradhamanaṃ marmavyathā| śothalakṣaṇam iti śotha eva lakṣaṇam| jaṭharam udaram| anyasya vyādher liṅgāni darśayed iti anyasya visphoṭāder liṅgaṃ darśayati||35-37||

etac ca dvayam api darśayitum āha– saubhāgyārtham ity ādi| striyaḥ saubhāgyārthaṃ śatruprayuktyā vā saviṣajantūnāṃ svedaṃ, rajaḥ cūrṇaṃ, nānāṅgajān malān annādau dadati| tair iti svedarajaḥprabhṛtibhiḥ| gara evāsyopajāyata iti apākāt jaṭharāvasthitasvedādir eva garaḥ, ata eva tasyodarāmayaḥ| marmapradhamanaṃ marmavyādhiḥ| śothalakṣaṇam iti śotha eva lakṣaṇam| jaṭharaṃ udaram| anyasya vyādhe raktapittādeḥ||35-37||

div.ab:
yasmāl lūnaṃ tṛṇaṃ prāptā muneḥ prasvedabindavaḥ |
tasmāl lūtās tu bhāṣyante saṅkhyayā tāś ca ṣoḍaśa ||38|| (su. ka. a. 8) |

ab.seg:
samprati lūtānāṃ ghoraviṣatvapratipādanārtham aitihyam āha– yasmāl lūnaṃ tṛṇam ity ādi| iti kila śrutiḥ– “viśvāmitro narapatiḥ kāmadhenor balātkāraparigraheṇa munisattamaṃ vaśiṣṭhaṃ kopayāñcakāra, kupitena ‘tenāntarjvalanavirala ... ’ iti pā.| tenāntarjvaladaviralakopānalajvalitaṃ kukulayugalam iva bahalapāṭalaṃ locanadvayaṃ vahatā bhagavān ravir avalokitaḥ| tatas tasya ‘bhrukuṭiloṭṭabhavo bhayaṅkaro lalāṭataṭaprasyandī’ iti pā.| bhrūkuṭibhayaṅkaralalāṭataṭaprasyandī svedabindūtkaraḥ pracaṇḍataraḥ pratyāsannalūnatṛṇe ‘dhenvarthamupātte’ iti pā.| dhenvarthaṃ sambhṛte nipatito lūtā'bhūt|” iti| tās tu ṣoḍaśa| yad āha suśrutaḥ–
“trimaṇḍalā tathā śvetā kapilā ‘pītikā’ iti pā.| pītakā tathā|
lālāmūtraviṣā raktā kaṭhinā cāṣṭamī smṛtā|
sauvarṇikā lājavarṇā jāliny ekapadī tathā|
kṛṣṇā'gnivaktrā kāṇḍā ca mālāguṇy aṣṭamī matā||” (su. ka. a. 8) iti||38||

samprati lūtānāṃ ghoraviṣatvapratipādanārtham aitihyam āha– yasmād ity ādi| yasmāt kāraṇāt muneḥ prasvedabindavo lūnaṃ tṛṇaṃ prāptāḥ, tasmāl lūtā bhāṣyante, tā lūtāḥ saṅkhyayā ṣoḍaśa bhavanti| iti kila śrutiḥ– ‘yat kāmadhenor balāt parigraheṇa viśvāmitro nṛpatir vaśiṣṭhaṃ kopayāmāsa, tena ca ‘kupitenāntarjvalanavirala ... ’ iti pā.| kupitenāntarjvaladaviralakopānalajvalitaṃ kukulayugalam iva bahalapāṭalaṃ nayanayugalaṃ vahatā bhagavān ravir avalokitaḥ| tatas tasya bhṛkuṭibhayaṅkaralalāṭataṭaprasyandī svedabindūtkaraḥ pracaṇḍataraḥ pratyāsannalūnatṛṇe dhenvarthaṃ sambhṛte nipatito lūtā'bhūta||’ iti| tās tu ṣoḍaśa| yad āha suśrutācāryaḥ–
“trimaṇḍalā tathā śvetā kapilā pītikā tathā|
lālāmūtraviṣā raktā kaṭhinā cāṣṭamī smṛtā||
sauvarṇikā lājavarṇā jāliny eṇīpadī tathā|
kṛṣṇā snigdhamukhī kāṇḍā mālātuṇḍy aṣṭamī tathā|| tāsām aṣṭau kṛcchrasādhyā varjyās tāvatya eva tu|” iti| matāntareṇotpattir anyathā varṇyate–
“anye vadanti bhuktasya duṣṭasyānnasya mūrchanāt|
sambhavanti viṣasphoṭā ye lūtākīṭalakṣaṇāḥ|| yathāsvaṃ dhārayantas te lūtākīṭās tu kīrtitāḥ|” iti||38||

div.ab:
tābhir daṣṭe daṃśakothaḥ pravṛttiḥ kṣatajasya ca |
jvaro dāho 'tisāraś ca gadāḥ syuś ca tridoṣajāḥ ||39||
piḍakā vividhākārā maṇḍalāni mahānti ca |
śothā mahānto mṛdavo raktāḥ śyāvāś calās tathā ||40||
sāmānyaṃ sarvalūtānām etad daṃśasya lakṣaṇam | (su. ka. a. 8) |42|

tāsāṃ ‘sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha’ iti pā.| sāmānyadaṃśalakṣaṇam āha– tābhir daṣṭa ity ādi| daṃśakotha iti daṃśadeśe pūtibhāva ity arthaḥ| pravṛttiḥ kṣatajasyeti raktasya pravartanam| sarvalūtānām iti asādhyāṣṭavidhasauvarṇikādilūtānām eva sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam| ‘yatastrimaṇḍalānām’ iti pā.| yatas trimaṇḍalādīnām aṣṭānāṃ kṛcchrasādhyatvaṃ, tābhir daṣṭe śiroduḥkham ity ādinā sāmānyalakṣaṇam abhidhāya sauvarṇikādyanantaram etat paṭhitavān suśrutaḥ| mādhavakareṇa tu ṣoḍaśānāṃ lūtānāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇam etad ity abhiprāyeṇa paṭhitam iti||39-40||–

ab.seg:
tāsāṃ sāmānyadaṃśalakṣaṇam āha– tābhir ity ādi| ‘daṃśakothaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | daṃśakothaḥ daṃśadeśe pūtibhāva ity arthaḥ| pravṛttiḥ kṣatajasyeti raktapravartanam| sarvalūtānām ity ādi| asādhyāṣṭavidhasauvarṇikādilūtānām etat sāmānyalakṣaṇam iti pratyetavyam| yataḥ kṛcchrasādhyatvam aṣṭavidhatrimaṇḍalādilūtānām|
“tābhir daṣṭe śiroduḥkhaṃ kaṇḍūr daśe ca vedanā|
bhavanti ca viśeṣeṇa gadāḥ ślaiṣmikavātikāḥ||” iti| evaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇam abhidhāya sauvarṇikādyanantaram etat, tābhir daṣṭe ‘daṃśakotha’ ity ādikaṃ paṭhitavān suśrutaḥ| mādhavakareṇa tu ṣoḍaśalūtānāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇam etad ity abhiprāyeṇa paṭhitam iti||39-40||

div.ab:
daṃśamadhye tu yat kṛṣṇaṃ śyāvaṃ vā jālakācitam ||41||
ūrdhvākṛti bhṛśaṃ pākaṃ kledaśothajvarānvitam |
dūṣīviṣābhir lūtābhis tad daṣṭam iti nirdiśet ||42|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: trimaṇḍalādayo 'ṣṭau dūṣīviṣās tāsāṃ lakṣaṇam āha– daṃśamadhye tv ity ādi| ūrdhvākṛtīti ūrdhvagasvarūpam; anye ‘dagdhākṛti’ iti paṭhanti, tad vyaktārtham| dūṣīviṣābhir iti kālāntaraprakopiviṣābhiḥ| daṣṭam iti daṃśam||41-42||

trimaṇḍalādayo 'ṣṭau dūṣīviṣās tāsāṃ lakṣaṇam āha– daṃśamadhya ity ādi| ūrdhvākṛti ūrdhvagasvarūpam| dūṣīviṣābhir iti ‘kālāntare prakopiviṣābhiḥ’ iti pā.| kālāntaraprakopiviṣābhiḥ, daṣṭam iti daṃśanam||41-42||
ab.note: ‘sarpāṇāmeva viṇmūtrāt kīṭāḥ syuḥ kīṭajāstu tāḥ dūṣīviṣāḥ prāṇaharā iti saṅkṣepato matāḥ’ iti pā. |

div.ab:
, ‘śothaḥ’ iti pā. | śothāḥ śvetāḥ sitā raktāḥ pītā ‘sapiḍakā jvarāḥ’ iti pā. | vā piḍakā jvaraḥ |
‘prāṇāntikābhiḥ’ iti pā. | prāṇāntikāś ca jāyante śvāsahikkāśirograhāḥ ||43|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: sauvarṇikādīnām aṣṭānām asādhyānāṃ prāṇaharāṇāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇam āha– śotha ity ādi| prāṇāntikā iti prāṇaharāḥ||43||
sauvarṇikādayo 'ṣṭāv asādhyāḥ prāṇaharāḥ, tāsāṃ lakṣaṇam āha– śotha ity ādi| anye “śvetā sitā raktāḥ pītā ca” iti paṭhanti| tatra piḍakā jvaraś ca| prāṇāntikāḥ prāṇaharāḥ||43||

div.ab:
ādaṃśāc choṇitaṃ pāṇḍumaṇḍalāni jvaro 'ruciḥ |
lomaharṣaś ca dāhaś cāpy ākhudūṣīviṣārdite ||44|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: ākhudūṣīviṣalakṣaṇam āha– ādaṃśād ity ādi| ādaṃśāt śoṇitam ity atra ‘galati’ iti śeṣaḥ| ākhavaḥ śukraviṣāḥ| yad uktam– “śukraṃ patati yatraiṣāṃ ‘śukraspṛṣṭāḥ’ iti pā.| śukraspṛṣṭaiḥ spṛśanti yat|” (su. ka. a. 7) iti||44||
ākhudūṣīviṣalakṣaṇam āha– ādaṃśād ity ādi| ādaṃśāc choṇitam ity atra galatīti śeṣaḥ||44||

div.ab:
mūrchāṅgaśothavaivarṇyakledaśabdāśrutijvarāḥ |
śirogurutvaṃ lālāsṛkchardiś cāsādhyamūṣikaiḥ ||45|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: prāṇaharamūṣikalakṣaṇam āha– mūrchety ādi| aṅgaśotheti mūṣikākāra evāṅgaśotho jñeyaḥ| yad uktam anyatra– “cīyate granthibhiś cāṅgam ākhuśāvakasannibhaiḥ|” (su. ka. a. 7) iti| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śabdāśrutiḥ bādhiryam; anye ‘mandā ruciḥ’ iti paṭhanti asādhyamūṣikaiḥ māraṇātmakaiḥ||45||

prāṇaharamūṣakalakṣaṇam āha– mūrchety ādi| aṅgaśotheti mūṣikākāro 'ṅgaśopho boddhavyaḥ| yad uktam anyatra– “cīyate granthibhiś cāṅgam ākhuśāvakasannibhaiḥ|” iti| evaṃ pāṭhābhiprāyeṇa| mandaśrutir iti bādhiryam| anye ‘mandāruciḥ’ iti paṭhanti| asādhyamūṣikaiḥ māraṇātmakaiḥ||45||

div.ab:
kārṣṇyaṃ śyāvatvam athavā nānāvarṇatvam eva vā |
moho 'tha varcaso bhedo daṣṭe syāt kṛkalāsakaiḥ ||46|| (ca. ci. a. 23) | ‘kṛkalāsaiḥ daṣṭaliṅgamāha’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: kṛkalāsadaṣṭaliṅgam āha– kārṣṇyam ity ādi| ‘varcaso bhedo'tisāraḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | varcaso bhedo 'tisāraḥ||46||
kṛkalāsadaṣṭalakṣaṇam āha– varcaso bheda ity ādi| ‘varcaso bhedaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | varcaso bhedaḥ atisāraḥ| ‘syācca kṛkaṇṭakaiḥ’ iti pā.| kṛkaṇṭakaḥ kṛkalāsaḥ||46||

div.ab:
dahaty agnir ivādau ca bhinattīvordhvam āśu ca |
vṛścikasya viṣaṃ yāti daṃśe paścāt tu tiṣṭhati ||47||
daṣṭo 'sādhyaś ca hṛdghrāṇarasanopahato naraḥ |
māṃsaiḥ patadbhir atyarthaṃ vedanārto jahāty asūn ||48|| (ca. ci. a. 23) | ‘vṛścikaviṣaliṅgaṃ tadviṣādharasaṅkhyāṃ cāha’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: vṛścikaviṣaliṅgam āha– dahaty agnir ivety ādi| ‘vṛścikaḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vṛścikaḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ, sa ca ārāviṣaḥ| daṣṭo 'sādhyaś ca hṛdghrāṇarasanopahato nara iti yadā kvacitpustake ‘hṛdayanāsājihvopaghāto bhavati tadā’ etatsthāne ‘hṛdayanāsājihvopahatastadā’ iti pā.| hṛdayanāsājihvopaghāto bhavati tadā taddaṣṭo na sādhyaḥ| māṃsaiḥ patadbhir atyarthaṃ vedanārto jahāty asūn ity ādinā'yam aparo 'sādhyaprakāraḥ| ‘daṣṭo 'sādhyais tu’ iti pāṭhapakṣe 'sādhyaiḥ sadyaḥprāṇaharair vṛścikair daṣṭo yathoktaliṅgo bhavati| carake 'py ayam eva pāṭhaḥ||47-48||

vṛścikadaṣṭalakṣaṇam āha– dahatīty ādi| ūrdhvam upariṣṭād āśu yāti paścāc ca daṃśe tiṣṭhati| vṛścikadaṣṭāsādhyalakṣaṇam āha– hṛdghrāṇarasanopahato nara ity ādi| yadā hṛdayanāsājihvopaghāto bhavati, tadā daṣṭo na sādhyaḥ| māṃsaiḥ patadbhir atyarthaṃ vedanārto jahāty asūn ity ayam aparo 'sādhyaḥ| ‘daṣṭo 'sādhyaiḥ’ iti pāṭhe asādhyaiḥ sadyaḥprāṇaharair vṛścikair daṣṭo yathoktaliṅgo bhavati||47-48||

div.ab:
visarpaḥ śvayathuḥ śūlaṃ jvaraś chardir athāpi ca |
lakṣaṇaṃ kaṇabhair daṣṭe ‘daṃśaścaiva viśīryate’ iti pā., ‘daṃśaścaivāvaśīryate’ iti ca pā. | daṃśaś caivāvasīdati ||49|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: kaṇabhadaṣṭaliṅgam āha– visarpa ity ādi| kaṇabhaḥ kīṭaviśeṣaḥ||49||
kaṇabhadaṣṭalakṣaṇam āha– visarpa ity ādi| kaṇabhaḥ kīṭaviśeṣaḥ| viśīryate galati||49||

div.ab:
hṛṣṭalomocciṭiṅgena stabdhaliṅgo bhṛśārtimān |
daṣṭaḥ śītodakeneva siktāny aṅgāni manyate ||50|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: ucciṭiṅgadaṣṭaliṅgam āha– hṛṣṭaromety ādi||50||

ucciṭiṅgadaṣṭaliṅgam āha– hṛṣṭarometi| ucciṭiṅganāmnā vṛścikena daṣṭaḥ pumān, hṛṣṭaromā kaṇṭakitadehaḥ, stabdhamehanaḥ, tathā bhṛśārtiyuktaḥ| śītodakenevāṅgāni siktāni manyate| suśrutas tu ucciṭiṅgaṃ kīṭaviśeṣam āha||50||

div.ab:
ekadaṃṣṭrārditaḥ śūnaḥ sarujaḥ pītakaḥ ‘satṛḍ’ iti pā. | satṛṭ |
chardir nidrā ca saviṣair maṇḍūkair daṣṭalakṣaṇam ||51||
matsyās tu saviṣāḥ kuryur dāhaṃ śothaṃ rujaṃ tathā |
kaṇḍūṃ śothaṃ jvaraṃ mūrchāṃ saviṣās tu jalaukasaḥ ||52|| (ca. ci. a. 23) | ‘saviṣamaṇḍūkadaṣṭaliṅgamāha’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: saviṣamaṇḍūkādidaṣṭaliṅgam āha– ekadaṃṣṭrārdita ity ādi| svabhāvād ekayā daṃṣṭrayā kṛto daṃśo bhavati||51-52||

saviṣamaṇḍūkadaṣṭalakṣaṇam āha– ekety ādi| svabhāvād ekadaṃṣṭrayā kṛto daṃśo bhavati|| saviṣamatsyalakṣaṇam āha– matsyā ity ādi| sugamam| saviṣajalaukādaṣṭalakṣaṇam āha– ‘kaṇḍūmityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kaṇḍūm ity ādi| kuryur iti ‘pūrvakriyāsambandhaḥ’ iti pā.| pūrvakriyayā sambandhaḥ||51-52||

div.ab: vidāhaṃ śvayathuṃ todaṃ svedaṃ ca gṛhagodhikā |53| (ca. ci. a. 23) |
gṛhagodhikādaṣṭaliṅgam āha– vidāham ity ādi| gṛhagodhikā jyeṣṭhī, anye tu bhrāmarakam āhuḥ| atra vakṣyamāṇaṃ kuryād iti sambandhanīyaṃ, tena vidāhādīnāṃ karmatvam|53|–
gṛhagodhikādaṣṭalakṣaṇam āha– vidāham ity ādi| gṛhagodhikā brāhmaṇīti loke, anye bhramarakam āhuḥ| atra vakṣyamāṇaṃ ‘kuryāt’ iti sambandhanīyam|53|–
daṃśe svedaṃ rujaṃ dāhaṃ kuryāc chatapadīviṣam ||53|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: śatapadīdaṣṭalakṣaṇam āha– ‘daṃśe ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | daṃśe ity ādi| kuryāc chatapadīviṣam iti śatapadī kāruṇḍikā||53||
śatapadīviṣaṃ daṃśe svedaṃ rujaṃ dāhaṃ kuryāt| śatapadī kāraṇḍī||53||

div.ab:
kaṇḍūmān maśakair īṣacchothaḥ smān mandavedanaḥ |
asādhyakīṭasadṛśam asādhyaṃ maśakakṣatam ||54|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: maśakadaṣṭaliṅgam āha– kaṇḍūmān ity ādi| asādhyakīṭasadṛśam iti asādhyakīṭair lūtādibhiḥ samalakṣaṇam iti| asādhyaṃ ‘maśakakṣatamiti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | maśakakṣatam iti pañcasu maśakeṣu madhye ‘parvatīya ... ’ iti pā.| pārvatīyamaśakakṣatam asādhyam| yad āha suśrutaḥ– “ ‘parvatīyaistu’ iti pā.| pārvatīyais tu kīṭaiś ca prāṇaharais tulyalakṣaṇam|” iti||54||

maśakadaṣṭalakṣaṇam āha– ‘kaṇḍūmānityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kaṇḍūmān ity ādi| sugamam| asādhyakīṭasadṛśam ity ādi asādhyakīṭair lūtādibhiḥ samavedanam ity arthaḥ| asādhyaṃ maśakakṣatam iti pañcasu maśakeṣu parvatīyamaśakakṣatam asādhyam| suśrute 'py uktam– “parvatīyais tu kīṭakaiḥ prāṇaharais tulyalakṣaṇam|” iti||54||

div.ab:
sadyaḥprasrāviṇī śyāvā dāhamūrchājvarānvitā |
piḍakā makṣikādaṃśe tāsāṃ tu sthagikā'suhṛt ||55|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: makṣikādaṣṭaliṅgam āha– ‘sadya ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sadya ity ādi| tāsāṃ ca sthagikā'suhṛd iti kvacitpustake ‘tāsāṃ suśrutoktaṣaṇmakṣikāṇām’ etatsthāne ‘kāṇḍarikādisuśrutoktaṣaṇmakṣikāsu’ iti pā.| tāsāṃ suśrutoktaṣaṇmakṣikāṇāṃ madhye sthagikā prāṇaharety arthaḥ||55||
makṣikādaṣṭalakṣaṇam āha– sadya ity ādi| tāsāṃ tu suśrutoktānāṃ madhye sthagikākhyā makṣikā asuhṛt prāṇaharīty arthaḥ||55||

lg.l: catuṣpadbhir dvipadbhiś ca nakhadantaviṣaṃ ca yat |
‘pūyate’ iti pā. | śūyate pacyate vā'pi sravati jvarayaty api ||56||

ab.seg: catuṣpadbhir iti ‘catuṣpadā’ iti pā.| catuṣpādā vyāghrādayaḥ| ‘dvipadā’ iti pā.| dvipādā vanamānuṣavānarādayaḥ||56||

catuṣpadadvipadadaṣṭalakṣaṇam āha– catuṣpadbhir ity ādi| catuṣpadā vyāghrādayaḥ, dvipadā mānavavānarādayaḥ, tair yat nakhakṣataṃ dantakṣataṃ ca, ‘pūyate’ ityatra ‘śūyate’ iti pā.| tac chūyate śophayuktaṃ bhavati, tathā pacyate, tathā sravati, tathā jvarayati||56||

lg.l: suptatā jāyate daṃśe kṛṣṇaṃ cātisravaty asṛk |

ab.seg: atra kecit viṣādhikārasāmānyāt śvādīnām api vyāghrādīnāṃ bhallakānāṃ viṣalakṣaṇaṃ bhaṇanti| tad āha– śvetety ādi| śvā kukkuraḥ, śṛgālaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tarakṣur mṛgaśatrur vyāghraviśeṣaḥ, caraṣa iti loke, ṛkṣo bhallūkaḥ atilomaśaḥ, ṛccha iti loke prasiddhaḥ| ādiśabdād vṛkacitrādayo hiṃsrāḥ paśavo grāhyāḥ| śvādīnāṃ yadā anilo vāyuḥ śleṣmapraduṣṭaḥ san sañjñāvahāśritaḥ sañjñāvahasrotogataḥ sañjñāṃ samyagjñānaṃ muṣṇāti harati| samyagjñānaharaṇāc ca hīdṛśo bhavatīty āha– tadety ādi| prasrastaṃ sthānacyutaṃ, lāṅgūlaṃ vāladhiḥ, mehanaṃ ca| prasrastaśabdo lāṅgūlādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambandhanīyaḥ| atilālāvān atiśayena lālāsrāvayuktaḥ| avyaktabadhiro 'ndhaś ca na vyakto badhiro 'ndho vety arthaḥ| anyonyam abhidhāvati parasparaṃ daṣṭum abhidhāvati| hanuskandhasthāne ‘śūnaskandhaḥ’ iti kecit paṭhanti| ‘pramūḍho 'nyatamas teṣāṃ khādan viparidhāvati|’ ity atrottarārdhaṃ kecit paṭhanti| eṣāṃ madhye 'nyatama ekatamaḥ pramūḍhaḥ san khādan viśeṣeṇa paridhāvati| teneti daṃṣṭriṇā| suptatā bādhiryam| upalakṣito yukta ity arthaḥ||57-60||

div.ab:
yena cāpi bhaved daṣṭas tasya ceṣṭāṃ rutaṃ naraḥ |
bahuśaḥ pratikurvāṇaḥ kriyāhīno vipaśyati ||61||
daṃṣṭriṇā yena daṣṭaś ca tadrūpaṃ yas tu paśyati |
apsu cādarśabimbe vā tasya tad riṣṭam ādiśet ||62||
trasyaty akasmād yo 'bhīkṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā'pi vā jalam |
jalatrāsaṃ tu taṃ vidyād riṣṭaṃ tad api kīrtitam ||63|| ‘adṛṣṭo’ iti pā. |
adaṣṭo vā jalatrāsī na kathañcana siddhyati |
prasupto votthito vā'pi svasthas trasto na siddhyati ||64|| (su. ka. a. 7) |

ab.seg:
idānīṃ śvādidaṣṭasya riṣṭam āha– yenety ādi| ceṣṭāṃ kriyāṃ, rutaṃ śabdaṃ, bahuśaḥ anekavāraṃ, pratikurvāṇaḥ anukurvan, kriyāhīnaḥ svakīyakāyādivyāpārarahitaḥ| idānīm aparam apy ariṣṭaṃ nirdiśann āha– daṃṣṭriṇety ādi| taddaṃṣṭrirūpadarśanam ariṣṭaṃ maraṇalakṣaṇam| punar aparam ariṣṭaṃ nirdiśann āha– trasyatīty ādi| akasmāj jalatrāsahetuṃ vinā, apiśabdāt śrutvā'pi jalatrāsarogaṃ jānīyāt tasyeti sambandhaḥ| riṣṭam ity ādi| tad api jalatrasanam ariṣṭaṃ maraṇaṃ kīrtitam| etac cāriṣṭaṃ daṣṭasya| atrārthe tantrāntare– “vyādhitena śvādinā daṣṭasya śleṣmā kupitaḥ srotovāhinīr dhamanīr anupraviśya sañjñānāśam āpādayati| tato naraḥ ‘spṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca jalaṃ trasyati, tadriṣṭaṃ jānīyāt’ iti pā.| spṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca jalaṃ trasyati, tasyāpi tad riṣṭaṃ jānīyāt|” iti| ‘evamadṛṣṭasyāpi’ iti pā.| evam adaṣṭasyāpi jalatrāso riṣṭam eveti darśayann āha– ‘adṛṣṭa’ iti pā.| adaṣṭa ity ādi| asminn arthe tantrāntare–
“ ‘adṛṣṭasyāpi’ iti pā.| adaṣṭasyāpi jantor hi jalatrāso bhaved yadi|
tasyāriṣṭaṃ hi bhiṣajo bruvate viṣacintakāḥ|| jalaṃ vinā jalatrāso jāyate śleṣmasañcayāt|” iti| atha coktam–
“buddhisthānaṃ yadā śleṣmā kevalaḥ pratipadyate|
tadā buddhau niruddhāyāṃ śleṣmaṇā'dhiṣṭhito naraḥ||
jāgrat supto 'thavā''tmānaṃ majjantam iva manyate|
salilāt trasyati tadā jalatrāsaṃ tu taṃ viduḥ||
śleṣmaghnaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ śodhanaṃ śamanāni ca|
āhārasya vidhānena yāvat sa prakṛtiṃ vrajet||” iti| ayaṃ jalatrāsaḥ kupitakaphasya bhavatīti riṣṭaṃ na bhavati| ata evā'tra cikitsopadeśaḥ| ‘dṛṣṭasya’ iti pā.| daṣṭasya tu riṣṭam eva, tathā svasthasya jāgrato vā jalam antareṇa trāso riṣṭam eveti darśayann āha– prasupta iti| sugamam||61-64||

div.ab:
praśāntadoṣaṃ prakṛtisthadhātum annābhikāmaṃ samamūtraviṭkam |
prasannavarṇendriyacittaceṣṭaṃ vaidyo 'vagacched aviṣaṃ manuṣyam ||65|| (su. ka. a. 6) |

ab.seg:
viṣāturaḥ kīdṛśo nirviṣo bhavatīti darśayitum āha– praśāntadoṣam ity ādi| annābhikāmam ity anena prakṛtisthāgnitoktā| yad āha carakaḥ–
“prāyeṇopahatāgnitvāt sapiccham atisāryate|
prāpnoti cāsyavairasyaṃ na cānnam abhinandati||” iti| samamūtraviṭkam iti akṣīṇānatiriktamūtrapurīṣam| anye ‘ ‘samamūlajihvam’ iti pā.| samasūtrajihvam’ iti paṭhanti, tadā'yam arthaḥ– samam avikṛtaṃ ‘mūlam’ iti pā.| sūtraṃ jihvā ca yasya sa tathā; etena viṣajuṣṭā jihvā na rasabodhinī bhavati, ‘mūlamapi’ iti pā.| sūtram api jihvāyāṃ viṣaprabhāveṇa kvacitpustake ‘vaikṛtaṃ bhavatīti pratipādayati’ etatsthāne ‘vikṛtaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ’ iti pā.| vaikṛtaṃ bhavatīti pratipādayati| jihvāgrahaṇenaiva ‘mūlagrahaṇe’ iti pā.| sūtragrahaṇe siddhe tasya ca rasagrahaṇe anuguṇatvapratipādanārthaṃ pṛthagupādānam| anena ślokena “samadoṣaḥ samāgniś ca” (su. sū. a. 15) ity ādiślokasya sakala evārtha upabaddhaḥ||65||

aviṣo naraḥ kīdṛśo bhavati tad darśayitum āha– asyāyameveṣṭaḥ pāṭhaḥ| prasannadoṣam ity ādi| prasannadoṣaṃ ‘svabhāvasthitavātādikam’ iti pā.| samāvasthitavātādikam| prakṛtisthadhātum iti dadhatīti dhātavo rasādayo malādayaś ca| annābhikāmaṃ bhojanābhilāṣam, annābhikāmam ity anena prakṛtisthāgnitoktā| yad āha carakaḥ–
“prāyeṇopahatāgnitvāt sapiccham atisāryate|
prāpnoti cāsyavairasyaṃ na cānnam abhinandati||” iti| samamūtraviṭkam iti akṣīṇānatiriktamūtrapurīṣam| anye ‘samamūlajihvam’ iti paṭhanti, tadāyam arthaḥ– samam avikṛtaṃ mūlaṃ jihvā ca yasya sa tathā| etena viṣaduṣṭajihvā rasavedinī na bhavati, mūlam api jihvāvat viṣaprabhāveṇa vikṛtaṃ bhavatīti pratipādayati| jihvāgrahaṇenaiva mūlagrahaṇe siddhe, tasya rasagrahaṇe 'rdhaguṇatvapratipādanārthaṃ pṛthagupādānam| anena ślokena “samadoṣaḥ samāgniś ca” ity ādeḥ ślokasya sakala evārtho nibaddhaḥ| vaidyo 'vagacched aviṣaṃ manuṣyam iti uktalakṣaṇaḥ puruṣo 'viṣo bhavati, viparītalakṣaṇas tu viṣāturaḥ| tathā hi–
“pravṛddhadoṣā'prakṛtisthadhātum anannakāṅkṣaṃ ‘śatamūlajihvam’ iti pā.| hatamūlajihvam|
viruddhavarṇendriyavittaceṣṭaṃ vaidyo 'vagacchet saviṣaṃ manuṣyam||” iti| idaṃ saviṣāviṣalakṣaṇam iti||65||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne viṣanidānaṃ samāptam ||69||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ viṣanidānaṃ samāptam||69||
‘sūktimuktāvalīgumphe’ iti pā.| sūktimuktāvalīgranthe guruṇā yan na gumphitam|| mayā samastam agranthi tad girā ‘śuddhamuktayā’ iti pā.| śuddhiyuktayā||1||
guṇanidhigurubaddhe dāmni vāṅmālatīnāṃ paramaparimalaśrīdhāmni labdhāvalambam|| sphurati vacanakundaṃ mandasaurabhyaleśād vacanam api madīyaṃ kiñcid etat kadācit||2||
iti śrīvijayarakṣitaśrīkaṇṭhadattābhyāṃ viracitā madhukośavyākhyā samāptā||69||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyām ātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ viṣanidānam||69||

atha viṣayānukramaṇikā |
jvaro 'tisāro grahaṇī cārśo 'jīrṇaṃ visūcikā |
alasaś ca vilambī ca krimirukpāṇḍukāmalāḥ ||1||

lg.l: kāso hikkā saha śvāsaiḥ svarabhedas tv arocakaḥ ||2||
chardis tṛṣṇā ca mūrchādyā rogāḥ pānātyayādayaḥ |
prameho madhumehaś ca piḍakāś ca pramehajāḥ ||5||
medas tathodaraṃ śotho vṛddhiś ca galagaṇḍakaḥ |
vidradhir vraṇaśothaś ca dvau vraṇau bhagnanāḍike |

ab.seg: asmin granthe rogasaṅgraham āha– etādṛśapāṭhābhiprāyeṇa| jvarātisārāv ity ādi| grahaṇyaś catasraḥ| ekasminn ajīrṇanidāne visūcikālasavilambikā jñeyāḥ| pānātyayādayaḥ pānavibhramādayaḥ| piḍakāḥ pramehoktāḥ| etādṛśapāṭhābhiprāyeṇa| medodoṣo medorogaḥ| upadaṃśo meḍhrarogaḥ| tvagāmayaḥ kuṣṭharogaḥ| ayamevameva pāṭhamaṅgīkaroti| romāntyo masūrikābhedaḥ| āsyaṃ mukham| rugviniścaye ayam uddeśaḥ||9||
subhāṣitaṃ yatra yad asti kiñcit tat sarvam ekīkṛtam atra yatnāt | viniścaye sarvarujāṃ narāṇāṃ śrīmādhavavenendukarātmajena ||10||

lg.l: yat kṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ kiñcit kṛtvaivaṃ rugviniścayam |

ab.seg: granthakāraḥ svapakṣam āha– subhāṣitam ity ādi| sugamam||10-11||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracitaṃ mādhavanidānaṃ samāptam ||70||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitā mādhavanidānaṭīkā''ṅkadarpaṇākhyā samāptā||70||
